Name: Hotel de Normandie
Description: We parked our 25ft motorhome in front of Hotel de Normandie. The host Philippe is such a nice person, he loves travellers. He let us park right in front of the hotel and gave us access to shower, toilet and well as wifi. 10,000 pesos. The place is tranquil, just under huge eucalyptus trees. There is a bus that goes into town from down the road.

Location: Cl. 29d #20-157 a 20-245, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Free Parking
Description: We parked our van for 2 nights here (next to the soccer field and church). After the first night a guy washed our van without asking and then wanted money. Paid him 2000 cause we parked there for another night and didn't want to have issues. Reasonable priced sports bar across the street where the soccer players hang out. We didn't sleep in the vehicle but I think it's not an issues especially if you give a little tip (not too sure if that guy was official but he was hanging around there).

Location: Cra. 3, Silvia, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Station De Servicio
Description: Small petrol Station, colosed at night, quiet with toilet. Big flat area

Location: Zapatoca-Girón, Zapatoca, Santander, Colombia
Name: Sogamoso Canyon - Free
Description: Huge parking area by the Canyon. We asked the owner of the little snack shop if we can camp here for the night and he said no problem. There are washrooms at the snack shop as well as snacks, cold drinks and empanadas. Possibly more food as well but we never asked. Nice view over the Canyon and free.

Location: Cra. 32 #31-106, Arboletes, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: FREE Camping Parking
Description: Near to a paid camping and the city centre.

Location: Cl. 20d #6b-1 a 6b-81, Valledupar, Cesar, Colombia
Name: San Luis Welder
Description: a great sheet metal shop with welding and machining tools. if something's broke and its metal they can fix it here :-)

Location: Cra. 10, Zapatoca, Santander, Colombia
Name: La Cueva Del Nitro
Description: 2000 pesos to check out the cave. They do tours which are 12 hours long the lady at the entrance said!

Location: Socorro Santander, Pinchote, Santander, Colombia
Name: San Gil Plaza
Description: Plaza with little shops and a supermarket where dogs are allowed inside! Free parking

Location: Cra. 1s #2-22, Nemocón, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Mina De Sal Nemocón
Description:
Awesome salt mine to visit.
Price is 45000 COP p/p with a 90 minute tour.
Available in Spanish but it is possible to have in English with extra cost (around 50000 cop).
The dogs can be allowed inside if the guide is agreed.
WiFi free access.

Location: Cl. 3 Nte., Popayán, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Opposite From Olympia Supermarket
Description: There is a Toilet available at Olympia Supermarket.

Location: Cl. 1 Bis #8-1 a 8-107, Popayán, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Car Part Quarter and Mechanics
Description: Any kind of parts for cars

Location: Puerto Libre-Puerto Boyaca, Puerto Boyacá, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: hotel holanda
Description: trucker hotel. very good acomodation and cheap.

Location: Vía a La Buitrera, Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: The Bruitera Club De La Sena
Description: Recreational park.  Secure, with swimming pool.  35000 per person per night. WiFi, cold showers and electricity available.   Not exactly designed for camping, but they have a dormitory so are used to overnight visitors.   Gate is wide and about 3m high.  Really big rigs might struggle, or get stuck right next to the road.

Location: Parque De La Sal, Zipaquirá, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Zipaquira Salt Cathedral
Description: Audio guide is included in every language. Expensive: See check-ins. Extra charge for parking.

Location: Cra. 19 #11B-65, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Clinica veterinaria animal vet
Description: Ran by doctor Edna and her husband. We left Helen here while we went to Tayrona NP $25,000 per day. They also gave her, her annual shots 50,000 for the shots. they also bathe Helen, cleaned her ears, brushed her teeth and trimmed her nails!

Location: Cl. 24a #74a-1 a 74a-99, Bogotá, Colombia
Name: Ingelox Ingeniera Logistics Integral
Description: Shipping agent. Located on the second floor above the panaderia.

Location: El Colegio - El Charquito, Soacha, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Abandoned Hotel, Museum And Waterfall
Description: It is an abandoned Hotel that has since been turned into a Museum  (9000 pp). It has a beautiful view to a waterfall. There is free parking along the road or paid parking at the hotel for 2000. There is also a bunch of stands with food and drinks.

Location: Club Aerosport, Unnamed Rd,, Flandes, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Xielo Skydive
Description: Awesome place and great people if you wanna jump out of an airplane! They offer great pricing and a well organized dropzone. Tandem for 550.000 and they also are very welcoming to experienced skydivers and offer rental gear. They take credit card! After jumping we were allowed to camp here as well. They have bathrooms, showers and a pool. They do have power here and may allow you to plug in.

Location: Ambalema, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Maggie's Shapely Banks
Description:
Driving north along the Rio Magdalena valley, we found this quiet hidden spot by checking every trail off the main road.
Drive west over the bridge from Cambao, then first right down the track. There are potentially a few sites along the way, the one marked is about 500m in, past a gate and cattle grid, right on the river with a place to swim if you don't mind getting muddy feet.
Gas station in Cambao accepts visa.

Update April 2022: You might get a visit by the police and will be asked to move to the police station. Super friendly guys though. Otherwise a nice spot, but definitely a ton of Moskitos in the rainy season.

Location: Unnamed Road, Guadalupe, Santander, Colombia
Name: Las Gachas
Description: Beautiful natural swimming holes in the river. 15 minute walk from the cafe marked nearby, or other tracks, ask in Guadalope. Free!

Location: Via Principal San Agustin, San Agustín, Huila, Colombia
Name: Parque Arqueológico Nacional San Agustín
Description:
Largest necropolis in the world & over 50 statues on display in natural settings. Nice park to spend a few hours. Dogs are allowed in the park. 65,000 pp for a passport that allows access to several sites in the area. 
A world UNESCO designated archaeological site containing burial sites, stone statues and a museum. Amazing look back in time and also has a hilltop lookout over the mountainsides. Our guide was a local man named Marino Bravo. He has been a guide for over forty years and has amazing knowledge of the entire area. His WhatsApp number is +57 313 221 4006

Location: Via Playa Camarones, Riohacha, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Gas
Description: 30,000 ask for LA Trenza they will transfer gas from one bottle to another

Location: Cra. 2 #1-2, Barichara, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hostal Artepolis
Description: Beaitiful hostel with amazing views over the valley and surrounding mountains. Big parking lot. We paid 55.000 for a double room with private bathroom. Good wifi. Cold shower. Great bathroom with open roof so you can have a shower while admiring the views! :) They also have dorms but I don't know the price. Nice French owner who knows the area very well and who can recommend hikes or organise horse rides. Super nice staff. Parking is not levelled at all so we did not even ask to camp.

Location: Paz P Bello, Pueblo Bello, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Pueblo Bello Town
Description: We parked right next to a community park/plaza. Nice mountain views, and fresh air. We stopped here on our to Nebusimake, which we are trying to arrange transportation with the locals. Movistar cell tower here

Location: Cartagena-Barranquilla, La Boquilla, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Autolavado CAR RESCUE
Description:
Carwash close to the Hotel Bellavista.
Perfect before shippment.

We paid COP 17'000.- to clean the outside (they also clean the interior of your car if you want) of our campervan.

Location: Bucaramanga-San Alberto, Rionegro, Santander, Colombia
Name: La Cábaña Del Gordo
Description: Restaurant, hotel, Truck stop, Car wash, súper friendly people. Restrooms and showers available. They even gave us electricity and we only paid for the cars ash 10,000 pesos (12.7.19: 4000 pesos for 2 people in a truck Camper)

Location: Villagarzon-Mocoa, Mocoa, Putumayo, Colombia
Name: Nuevo Mundo Camping - Hostel - Cabañas Mocoa
Description:
Nice place beside the street a little outside Mocoa, just above the Mocoa River. The owners are really nice and they would love to have other overlanders. You can park on the parking lot in front of the house or drive up to a grassy area for camping. There is a firepit for cooking, an outdoor shower and toilets you can use. Indoors showers and wc. They also have running water (potable) and electricity if you need them. Slow wifi. 
30K per vehicle 
Phone number is you want to contact in advance: +573107515220

Location: Cl. 28 #6-2 a 6-120, Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Tecnomotriz - Professional Auto Shop
Description:
Large professional mechanic shop with multiple lifts and equipment. Specialist in 4x4s. Owner is Henry Moller, speaks English, and is also a moto enthusiast.+57 24438112 / +573155554342 whatsapp.

this area also has a lot of car repair and part shops nearby

Location: Cra. 18 #11c-47 a 11c-109, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Agua Nevada
Description: 4,000 COB to refill the 20 liter jug. 1,200 for 6l bag, 1000 to refill 6l.  50,000 for 140 liters!!

Location: Socorro Santander, Pinchote, Santander, Colombia
Name: Gas del Fonce
Description:
New location for Gas del Fonce. Were able to fill up our US tank. The entrance is right next to a Virgin Mary statue.

Best to call ahead to arrange a time. +57.311.482.0123

I needed my own adapter for my small bottle as he doesn't have any.

Location: Cra. 17c #23-2 a 23-80, Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: VW Mecanic Fajardo
Description:
Great VW shop with very friendly mecanics. Jose looked after my 82 aircooled FI Vanagon. Can help with bugs and Kombis as well. 

318 828 8605 and 316 526 3682

on street 17c.

User reports:Jose did a great job and fixed all mechanical issues we had. We have a Westfalia Vanagon ‘84. Wasn’t expensive at all.

Location: Bucaramanga-Pamplona, Piedecuesta, Santander, Colombia
Name: Basketball Court
Description: Have you ever parked and slept in a basketball court? Well you can park here :) beautiful secluded and very cold place

Location: Cl. 39 #65-40 a 65-90, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: bike mechanic
Description: a small shop we had a few jobs done on the klr we didnt have the tools to do ourselves.

Location: Cra. 2 #26-24, Ibagué, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Enoj's Workshop (forgot its official name)
Description: Workshop of VW enthusiast Enoj. He is well connected to the Ibague Volkswagen Club and lots of great VW people happy to help you. All repairs were done well, the price was good, at times I had to wait a few hours. Enoj and his staff are friendly, intelligent guys. Camping in the workshop might be difficult but check with Enoj. Wifi next door at shop.

Location: La Boquilla-Arroyo De Piedra, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Rest Area
Description: Free accomodation. Rest area right afterbefote a toll booth coming from Barranquilla to Cartagena. Includes a restroom area and a small snack kiosk.

Location: Av. 1 Nte. #6 Norte-25 a 6 Norte-79, Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: SEGUROS DEL ESTADO Cali
Description: Selling SOAT- Insurance, also just for 1 month (probably you have to insist).

Location: San Agustin-Pitalito, Pitalito, Huila, Colombia
Name: MONTAGAS Pitalito
Description: Filled up propane gas bottle (US Standard 1 Gallon).

Location: Unnamed Road, La Cruz, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Tejumbina hot springs
Description: Nice hot springs with multiple pools and showers.  3000cop to enter.  There's also a beautiful waterfall behind it.  It is possible to park vehicle right outside and camp overnight although we did not do this.  No WiFi.  The locals are super friendly and very curious when they see a foreign vehicle.  Really cute mountain town.

Location: El Tablon - Mojarras, Taminango, Nariño, Colombia
Name: David Workshop
Description: Stopped here coz we had loose wheel bolds and due to this a broken bearing. David solved all in 1 hour.

Location: Unnamed Road, Buenaventura, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: San Cipriano Railway
Description:
Here in you will enjoy the african atmosphere of colombia and enter the tropical forest of the San Cipriano Reserve on a motorbike running on the train tracks. You will then refresh yourself in the clear river of the pueblito. 11000 COP pp with return. 
Let your car at the first parquadero (12000 p day). The very friendly owner let us use his shower and bathroom and give us is Wi-Fi :

Location: Cra. 22 #5-2 a 5-100, Aguachica, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Hotel Calle Real - secure parking
Description: 20000 per vehicle (down from 25000), to camp in hotels secure parking lot. Has a pool which has toilets, change room and outdoor shower which we could use. Wifi pword: 10833676. Felt a lot more secure here then in the truck parking lot hotel. Only a small parking lot so only 4WD/van campers would fit here.a

Location: Vía al Municipio de Los Santos, Los Santos, Santander, Colombia
Name: Parqueo Los Santos
Description: Basic, red dust car park with beautiful views over the chica canyon, right above the rock climbing area. We chose to stay here instead of the hostel as it was 15000 per car instead of per person. It has basic shower and toilet. Quiet at night. Family lives on site in home on one side of car park. We parked up on the raised area for more privacy. Rock climbing site is owned by hostel, pd 2500pp to climb for the day.

Location: Cucaita-Tunja, Tunja, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Suisse Gourmet's
Description: absolut delicious food...go for the menu del dia....swiss food in this restaurant run by an swiss cook and butcher...delicious and worth every peso....they also sell best meat and cheese in the Restaurant...

Location: Cra. 1e #39-2 a 39-36, Tunja, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Marca Business Center
Description:
OFFICE 514
Sura office
we could get the Soat there.
But they told us...you have to take two month....even when one would be enough....paid 124
000 pesos for two month

Location: Sta. Marta - Cerro Kenedy, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Finca Hostal Bolivar
Description:
Owner's updated: 25.12.2024
BIENVENIDOS! WELCOME! WILLKOMMEN!

Finca Hostal Bolivar offers the following:
Secure Parking/Campground for Motorhomes.
The parking offers: 
- clean toilets and HOT showers!!
- kitchen facilities 
- BBQ area
- Free Drinking water 
- watertap, electrical outlets 
- fast WIFI
- private access to Minca river
- video surveillance 24h
- common area
- laundry service 
- private sunset viewpoint

Price per car/motorhome (1-2 Pax) is  60'000 COP/night in low season. (additional Person 20'000 COP)

Price per car/motorhome (1-2 Pax) is  75'000 COP/night  IN HIGH SEASON. (additional Person 25'000 COP)
High season starts the 20th of December until 31th of March.

The entrance is 2.7m (edge)/3.3m (center) high and 3.4m wide. It fits only campervans with a length of max 5m!


The Parking/Campground is located at the mainroad to Pozo Azul, 300m from towncenter Minca. Use our telephone reception (yello building) for Check-In and Information.
Tel: +57 322 280 83 42
E-Mail: fincahostalbolivar@gmail.com
Website: bolivarhostelminca.com

Location: Unnamed Road, Cerrito, Santander, Colombia
Name: Rural School Parking Lot
Description: It's a 20min drive from the main hwy55. Spot has no amenities other than a great view of the unfolding valley below. Very quiet. School gets out early so it's a comfortable spot to spend the night and continue on the next morning.

Location: Unnamed Road, Cerrito, Santander, Colombia
Name: Cascada El Mortino
Description:
Come see this...it's free and visible from the well-maintained gravel road. You can hike to the falls as well.
This is the Cascada El Mortiño if I am not wrong.
There is a waterfall in the area which must be much higher up, I didn't quite get to it.

Location: Cerrito-Chitagá, Presidente, Chitagá, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: Laguna De Salado
Description: Drive on a grave/dirt road for 3kms off of hwy55. When you get to the green gate it is/was unlocked. From there it's 300 mts to a stunning high altitude lake, a waterfall as a backdrop, and wild trout fishing! (Caught small to medium sized Rainbows). Plenty of open flat spaces to camp/boondock. There is another lake above the waterfall called Tambor. Very quiet, no one around. Seems like the place was a failed tourism venture given the two empty houses.

Location: Cra. 8 #7-1 a 7-113, Popayán, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Popayan inn
Description: Very Nice hôtel, great location, 2 blocks from the plaza. Very clean - nice owner - he gives good info about city and surroundings. 90.000 COP/night for quad room. Secure parking in from for 10.000 COP/night. Possible to order Bfast for 5000 COP - really recommended!

Location: Cra. 3 #8-1 a 8-99, Pitalito, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hotel Napoles
Description:
A nice clean, quiet hotel with friendly staff, good WIFI and a comfortable bed. The hot water wasn't working when we were there but other than that no complaints. There is secure parking under the hotel included in the price. Our Pathfinder fit in there easily but higher vehicles may not. 

They squeezed us a fresh orange juice in the morning which was a nice touch. Ask for a room towards at the back of the hotel away from the road.

The stated price was 80,000 Pesos but this is negotiable (we paid 50,000).

Location: Cra. 67 #12A-81, Bogotá, Colombia
Name: Hotel el Marques de San Rafael
Description: Orange front.  secure parking, 4x4s and motos only. 50k per double room. hot water. stable wifi. nice owners.

Location: Cra. 26 #70-21, Bogotá, Colombia
Name: Land Rover Parts
Description: Parts shop (lots of Britpart!) for many Land Rover types including Defender. Run by a lovely man called Richard and his son Alex has another Land Rover shop across the road. Mechanic nearby who works on land rovers, toyotas and much more.

Location: Cl. 67 #20-1 a 20-91, Bogotá, Colombia
Name: Tecniautos Fores: Land Rover/Toyota +more
Description: Taller/mechanic that will repair land rovers, toyotas and much more. Great service and great work done to our defender. They also have an amazing sticker collection...!

Location: Neiva-San Agustín, Garzón, Huila, Colombia
Name: Behind Terpel
Description: Big gravel area hidden behind terpel gas station. We asked there and they said it's ok to stay there for one night. Very quiet at night. Free

Location: Autopista Medellín-Bogotá, Guarne, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Gases De Antioquia
Description: Planta de Gas propano. They filled our american tank, 20.700 COP 8kg

Location: Cl 14A #16a-1, Riohacha, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Pura Guajira Hostel
Description: Very nice and clean hostel in Riohacha, runnend by a Colombian/Italian couple: Ricardo and Beatrice. Unfortnially no secured parking, but the neighborhood is concidered as safe. Security during the night in a dead end street. It felt for me safe to park my motorbike on the street in front of the hostel. Well equipped kitchen to cook your own dish, laundry, wifi, hamacs, roofterrace and a good atmosphere.  Lugauge storage for stuff you don't need during your trip to Punto Gallinas. Private room with ac and private bathroom: 125.000 p/n. 8 bed dorm, private bathroom + fan: 29.000p/n. 4 bed dorm, shared bathroom + fan: 32.000 p/n. Ricardo and Beatrice are a good help, knows the do and don't about the north and do everything to help you planning your trip to Punto Gallinas.

Location: Cra 43A #5a-31, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Mercados Campesinos
Description: Small Farmers Market with organic fruits and vegetables, homemade products, small food stalls. Only on Sunday from 08-13 hr

Location: Cl. 8 #43B-06, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: 24hr Parking Astorga
Description: 24hr Parking in the very nice neighbourhood Poblado with many restaurants and bars nearby. COP 24'000 for 24hrs, price per hour. Very friendly and helpful people. The only downside is that there are hours where you need to stay in your vehicle in order not to trigger off the alarm system. For example FR/SA after 24:00, SU after 17:30, MO-THU after 20:00. They also offer car wash.

Location: Unnamed Road, Patía, Cauca, Colombia
Name: El Refugio
Description: Is a peaceful retreat tucked neatly away in Patia’s richest woodland. It’s a haven filled with lots of the local flora and fauna. You mind is sure to be at peace with the captivating landscape this beautiful place has to offer. May it be taking a plunge in the waters of the tempting pool, unwinding in the placid river or feeling welcomed by the warm Colombian hospitality, this hidden gem is definitely one to be explored.

Location: Unnamed Road, Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Finca Lindavia
Description:
Dog boarding and training.
Guardería y adiestramiento para perros.

Location: Unnamed Road, Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Finca Lindavia
Description:
Dog boarding  and training
Guardería y adiestramiento para perros

Location: Cra. 26 #9-61 a 9-143, Puerto Asís, Putumayo, Colombia
Name: Residencial Patiño
Description: Basic but very economic lodging we paid 16,000 Colombian pesos for the couple. Clean and with garage !! And wifi. The bad thing is that the shower is cold water ... It is so hot that it is bearable :)

Location: Marquetalia-Victoria, Victoria, Caldas, Colombia
Name: El Bosque
Description: Very nice facilities lined with palm trees, Huge swimming pool, volleyball, soccer, outdoor kitchen,  4000 peso/ day for swimming. Camping 25,000 peso includes all facilities. Showers. Very friendly owner- Henry speaks English.

Location: Marquetalia-Victoria, La Dorada, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Hacienda Villa Clara
Description: Great place to camping by river, showers, wc, electricity, big open area with mountain view. Friendly host David and his family. Actual spot maybe 1 km from these coordinates.

Location: Calle 11, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154001, Colombia
Name: Molino del Balcón
Description:
ADMIN NOTE:  be aware of the dogs, travelers have been bitten here. 

This place is awesome. The property is 2.5 acres, about 200 meters to the main square and is 449 years old. It's still belongs to the original family. There is a shower, clean bathroom, and lots of chillin areas. There's dogs, sheep/goats all different types of birds and fish, water running in the original water way, it's pimp. They asked the 3 of us to pay 15,000cop each. My dog was free.

Location: Bogota-Guatavita, La Calera, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Santiamen Restaurant
Description: This place has really really great food, and there is a bakery attached, owned by other people that is fantastic as well. Lots of parking around and I think you can talk to the owners about parking on there property, or just park out front and chill on there patio. They speak English and have lots of different beers including tons of German beers.

Location: Cl. 76 #24-23, Bogotá, Colombia
Name: JP Multi Servicio
Description: Awesome mechanic, found parts that iguana 4x4 couldn't. Told me that they needed a new track bar and some other parts and then when I came back they said they didn't need them, so I saved a few hundred dollars. They are very honest. Also took my truck to a car wash for me and did the best job I've ever seen. (It was the dirtiest it's ever been) His prices were much better than iguana 4x4 too.

Location: Unnamed Road, Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, Colombia
Name: Cardisch Hospedaje
Description: This place is the last hotel before the hot springs. The gym is super chill, he speaks Spanish and English really well and lives in the states a lot of the time. He was cool with us using his kitchen and there is a nice river in the back. Dog friendly and cheap aswell.

Location: Dg. 35 #7-2 a 7-100, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Motorcycle Insurance (Seguros Del Estado)
Description:
Only specific insurance companies sell motorcycle insurance. this is one of them located on the 8th Floor within the 'ComFamiliar' building. There really are not any signs, you might have to ask if you struggle to find it as you enter what appears to be side doors. The insurance company is called Seguros Del Estado, which I was directed to from DINA

paperwork required
1 copy TIP
1 copy title
1 copy license
1 copy passport (no stamp copy needed)

Location: Unnamed Road, San José de Isnos, Huila, Colombia
Name: mirador del magdalena
Description:
Nice view over the rio magdalena valley.   Entry 3000 pesos - if you camp (8000 pesos) you don't have to pay the entrance to the mirador.
Got a free coffee in the morning!

Location: Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, Colombia
Name: EcoGlampling
Description:
Mod note -  reported that site is not ready for customers as at early 2017
Owners Andres, Marcela, and William are carving out an Overlanding Paradise in the outskirts of Los Nevados National Park. The site is right in the heart of El Eje Cafetero and 2kms from Santa Rosa Del Cabal hotsprings. It is bordered by two cool water creeks and covered in lush mountain vegetation. The ecoglamping site will have space for rigs, tents, hot/cold water pools, and a bar/restaurant. You will not want to bypass this mountain retreat! At the time of this post, the construction of the camp was scheduled for October and ready to receive overlanders in December.

Location: Purificacion-Prado, Prado, Tolima, Colombia
Name: FincaI El Manial Restaurant
Description: At the street near Purificación. 30k pN on sandy ground, sorruonded by lots of ducks. Nobody needs warm showers here.

Location: Puerto Lopez - Puerto Gaitan, Puerto López, Meta, Colombia
Name: Hotel Campestre Luna Roja
Description:
This place has to great assets: its elevated location provides beautiful views right the camping spot; and the swimming pool is nice, big and clean. On the downside the caretaker (he is not the owner) is unfriendly and has no service attitude. The toilets are without seats and paper and the showers are truly outdoor and without privacy. It's a bit close to the road and there are fuel trucks all night.
25k pp pn. Expensive but the views at sunset are fantastic.

Location: Puerto Lopez - Puerto Gaitan, Puerto López, Meta, Colombia
Name: La Sonora
Description: Gasstation at the road. But the restaurant is not good.

Location: Potosí - Puerto Gaitán, Villavicencio, Meta, Colombia
Name: Coomavicure
Description: A place with cabañas and a big, clean pool. Toilets and showers are clean too. The people are very friendly. We asked, if we could camp here with our RV and they said yes. They wanted 25k pp and we offered 20k. It was oK. The showers are "cold", but nobody needs hot showers here!

Location: El Centro, Ciudad de Zipaquirá, Zipaquirá, Ciudad de Zipaquirá, Sabana Centro, RAP (Especial) Central, 250252, Colombia
Name: Parking Lot. Salt Cathedral
Description: This place is NOT closed. We had headed for the lower parking lot but it was blocked off and said, “buses” so we drove to this upper lot. The only level spot was at the very end. Free wi fi – no password needed. With antenna it was better. It was so much closer to the entrance than the lower lot. Other campers were parked in lower lot the next day. 14000 for 24 hours

Location: Cra. 26 #32-70, Bucaramanga, Santander, Colombia
Name: Osvarca automotriz
Description: Good all round mechanic, fair guy who goes out of his way to help you.

Location: Villagarzon-Mocoa, Mocoa, Putumayo, Colombia
Name: Hostal El Portal Fin Del Mundo
Description: Very quiet and nice - 45.000/double with use of the kitchen

Location: Unnamed Road, Paratebueno, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Los Clavellinos
Description: Camping was free just bought a few reasonably priced beers and coffees from the store.

Location: Cl. 23 #20-1 a 20-113, Paipa, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: La Posada
Description:
Address: Calle 23 #20-37, Paipa, Boyacá, Colombia

La Posada is in an old colonial building with high ceilings large doors and open courtyards. They allowed us to store our motorcycles in the courtyards. The room was large and clean and has a electric shower with hot water. The room cost 20,000 pesos per person per night and has a queen bed well as a single bed.  The room was extremely clean and comes with a desk, chair and TV.

Location: Unnamed Road, Salento, Quindío, Colombia
Name: Whater plant next to the river SALENTO
Description: Very nice, safe, sound of the river, security 24hs, ligth, whater, full nature... free. Ask to the guard of the whater plant for past the nigth. No problem very gentelman.

Location: Cra 3 #17-93, Ibagué, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Hotel imperio

As well you have to hire a guide (35000.-/day) if you intend to see the sights like lookouts, waterfalls and so on. Either you take the guide into your vehicle or he follows you with his motorbike. If you head further east you will enter the Purace NP. On its official website foreigners have to pay 23000.-/p.p. entrance fee. The indigenas told us that we do NOT have to pay this fee. We do not know what is true because we decided to skip this Circus and head back to Popayan. If you tell them that you are heading straight to La Plata in the east without stopping you are excempt from these fees. The indigenas were patroling the area, so chances that you would get seen while visiting the sights (illegally) were high. In our opinion this is just a profitable and easy way to make some money, something we did not want to support.

Description:

I took the backroad from Chinchina to the fork in the road called Las Trillizas. From there I wanted to go to the nevado but i encountered tour guides in lifted toyotas that told me it was not legal in a motorcycle to go there.

So I instead rode down here to the ranger station and they confirmed they would not allow me to go to the end of the road.

So from the ranger station I rode to Villamaria to make a loop.

I would like to add that the road from Chinchina to Las Trillizas is challenging. Mud holes, rocky sections, few stream crossings, steep sections. You definitely need 4x4 and high clearance, too narrow for big rigs. It was a blast on a motorcycle.

The road from here to Villamaria on the other hand is quite easy.

Both had great views.

Location: Unnamed Road, Guatapé, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Casa Kayam
Description:
Welcome to our home, a unique place and cultural center located in the heart of nature in Guatapé, Colombia (less than 2hours driving from Medellin). 

Here, the serenity of the natural environment blends with vibrant artistic dynamism, creating the ideal space for artists, digital nomads and travelers seeking inspiration and community.

We can accommodate campers in front of the main building of the hostel. You can have access to the toilets (hot water), all our common areas (fully equipped kitchen) and an electrical extension (less than 5$ per person).

We offer several types of accommodations from comfortable dorms to private rooms with stunning views and glamping options in bamboo huts. Take pleasure in a well-equipped kitchen, comfortable living room, and chill-out area that is perfect for relaxing.

Participate in activities such as slackline, skate ramps, barbecues and ping-pong tournaments. Enjoy music events, local beers and bonfires with guitars.

Join our community and live a unique experience where work, creativity and rest meet in perfect harmony.

Location: Buenaventura, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: 4x4 jungle / waterfall road
Description: On this GPS position you have to drive underneath an impressiv waterfall! This alternativ road from El Queremal to Buenaventura is a fantastic drive thru extremely dense jungle, passing countless waterfalls and tranquil villages. The central part of this 4:30hrs drive is very rough. Tire  damaging rocks, washouts and a very narrow, almost overgrown track make it passable only for 4WDs and smaller trucks. Tree branches make it hard for vehicles higher than 300cm. There is virtually no traffic. It's gravel all the way, so even in wet conditions one should get thru. We recommend to drive downhill (westwards) as you get over the rocky stretches more easy by rolling down. /// the main highway between Cali/Buga and Buenaventura is a UGLY drive with a lot of traffic (we counted 300 trucks per hour on our drive up!!!) /// Bitumen and Panamericana drivers be WARNED: if you like sealed roads and swear about potholes DO NOT DRIVE this track, you will not love it!

Friendly owners. There is a small shop selling drinks and snacks (where you can also charge phones), a clean toilet block and an outdoor shower. Huge, level, grassy area for pitching tents or parking cars/trucks/motos. Some of the Rio Claro rafting tours end here so during the day there are trucks coming and going to pick up boat-loads of tourists, but overall it's a very tranquil spot. Turn-off to the campground from the main road is at: 5.906073, -74.856185. Approx 5km on a gravel road from the turn-off to the site.

In the camping area you can hear the sound of the birds, enjoy the beautiful sunsets that are only seen in the city of Manizales. We are located 10 minutes from the central area of ​​the city where you will have the possibility to know tourist sites of this.

Location: Unnamed Road, Quipama, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Emerald mining area
Description: At this location you will encounter one of the administrativ centers of the many emerald mines around here. Administrador Sr. William Nandar can give you permission to visit Mina Real. We had a short tour, down a 30mts elevator shaft right into the mining shafts where men were digging further shafts into the mountain. Or you just drive thru the area for a look: You can see some mining shaft entrances, extracted rocks from the mines and diggers in the river beds. HOW TO GET THERE: 1) FROM THE NORTHI via Chiquinquira - Maripi - Muzo - river bridge (5.52054 -74.05553) - turn off at 5.53105 -74.14424. We drove it in the wet season and there was no way going without a 4x4: Mud, washouts, some very steep ramps. The most horrible stretch was just west of Maripi. (Do not drive south from Maripi, head west!). Driving time around 4hrs. FROM THE SOUTH: (we describe the route from north to south) From the mines head up the very steep road and then rurn right. The road heads west to Anatena landing strip and to the little town of Quipama. Some streches need definitively a 4x4. At the plaza (5.51936 -74.17861) head south (downhill) respectively right if you drive the other direction. Always follow the main road southwards. At Quatro Caminos (5.33453 -74.18768) head right (resp. left). From here the roads gets much better. Cross the river bridge at 5.30588 -74.19453. Later you will get to Villagimez (5.27570 -74.19585) and after about 4hrs to the iOverlander panorama camp at chapel. Cross river bridge at 5.17834 -74.19315 . From here it is a potholed bitumen road to Pasto (45min) and to the salt church of Zipaquiea (2hrs). Total driving time 6hrs.

Name: Hotel Baquero and secure parking also for big rigs
Description:

Ask for rooms 208 or 209 (some of the others don't have a window). Only 3 km from the airport. There was surprisingly little air-traffic noise. The place is surrounded by all sorts of car accessory shops and workshops; just ask around.
The hotel does have a secure garage for guest vehicle (max 2.6 m high). 
And just opposite is Alejandro's parqeadero: a very secure, clean and well-organized parking, COP 7000 per night, 14000 for 24 hours. The parking is maybe 30 x 15 m, surrounded by 5-6 m high walls on all sides and with a huge steel gate. No height restrictions. Alejandro and his family live on the premises so the vehicles are truly watched. It would be a safe place to leave your vehicle for weeks or months (COP 160'000 per month). Ask Alejandro if you need parts or services for your truck, he seems to know someone for each and every job.

Location: Al Pilon de Azucar y El Faro, Uribia, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Kite Center Tawi
Description:
This friendly place lies about 500 m NW and outside the "urban" area of Cabo de la Vela, right on the beach. It's spacious, very quiet at night and there is little traffic during the day, very much unlike all the other iOverlander sites located in the village. The spot can be windy but it's starkly beautiful.
Tawi and her husband (yet another Colombian-Suisse couple) provide flushing toilets (but you do the flushing with a bucket) that are cleaned daily, toilet paper and showers for COP 15.000 pp pd. There is strong Wifi 24/7. 

They can organize rough-and-tumble 24-hour trips to Punta Gallinas (all land and sea transportation there and back included, but no food, drinks or accommodation/hammock for COP 120.000, which is not much compared to other agencies; inquire  about exactly what attractions the tour visits and what exactly is included — the operator was trying to cut corners; take enough water for the journey — there's nothing to buy until you get to Punta Gallinas; wear sunscreen — the boats offer no protection from the elements). The scenery is well worth the trip!
They can also organize a guide if you'd rather drive to Punta Gallinas in your own truck, which can be impossible after heavy rain. It would be near impossible to get there by yourself plus you're left to deal with the Wayuu "checkpoints" yourself.

Location: Filandia - Ulloa, Filandia, Quindío, Colombia
Name: Steel Horse Colombia
Description:
Fellow overlanders.... after 18 months of travelling around South America on 2 motorcycles, we liked it here so much that we decided not to leave! We have spent everything we have and bought a finca/farm/hacienda in need of repair and love which we moved into on 24/12/2016! We would be delighted if you came to stay with us.

We are a 30-year old British couple from London, and have decided to change our lives completely and renovate a horse farm in need of some love whilst trying to give finca/hostal ownership in Colombia a go based on our experiences of what we think bikers and 4+ wheeled overlanders want such as (but not limited to) a smile when you arrive, a quick tour, visible price list, not "nickel and diming", hot shower, approachable owners and with some hope, doing our best to make it a nice place to stay for a few days before you move on.

Here you will find no workers (except us), a work in progress hostal/hacienda renovation, a comfortable and hopefully welcoming place to stay, home 2.5km from the center of Filandia (all downhill to the finca), 1.5 km from the Mirador of Filandia via 90% paved road and no height restriction.

 We have a stocked bar, 'honesty' beer fridge and some essentials for sale. We have the best 20mb wifi available in rural Colombia, netflix, board games, directv, hammocks, guest kitchen, many animals, toilet seats, a BBQ, secure parking (cul de sac with 2 neighbours), indoor fireplace, 3 hectares you are free to explore with papaya, oranges, lemons, limes and a bamboo "forest".

We also have a 7-month-old very friendly "street" dog we found in the gutter somewhere near Cartagena so of course, well-behaved pets are allowed on the grounds

Single rooms from 55,000 and doubles from 65,000 though bank transfer PayPal(+4% of bill) etc are welcomed forms of payment. group room also available for 2+ beds

4 wheeled vehicle camping is 28,000 per person per night

Please see the photos (it is not a building site!). We have a lot of ideas for the place and welcome your support by staying with us.

The finca (soon to be Steel Horse Colombia) is called "Finca/vereda Santa Rita", on the first gravel road to the right, 100meters before the filandia mirador if coming from filandia"
.... I'm a cowboy.... on a steel horse I ride!
steelhorsecolombia@hotmail.com

Location: Cl. 46 #44-1 a 44-85, Necoclí, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Muelle Necoclí / Ferry to Capurganá
Description:
This is the jetty of Necoclí and the departure point of the speed boat to Capurganá.

The following is a copy of parts of a Lonely Planet "Thorn Tree" note left by ccaron in June 2016; it proved very helpful for us and was still 100% accurate (I omitted some irrelevant bits, marked with […])

Title: Boat from Necocli to Capurgana
Comment: «I recently took the boat from Necocli trying to avoid going through Turbo. Excellent experience altogether. The ride does take 1h30, […]. The boat was in very good condition, we were not packed either. 
Tickets can be bought at the wharf an hour before departure or reservation can be made in adavance at the Panorama Hotel. Ticket costs 60,000 COP + 2,300 COP of port taxes (we did not have to pay this on the way back though). Baggage allowance is 10kg per person, so the charged us 1000 COP pear extra kg. 
We took the boat at 8am, but there seems to be another boat later in the day if enough passengers are found to ﬁll the boat. On Sundays there is a boat going to Sapzurro as well, through Capurgana. We took it on the way back to Necocli and they did not charge us for extra weight. Depending on the weather, we highly recommend to have your backpack put into a big garbage bag (sold for 1500-2000 or so). In case of rain or water coming into the boat, the plastic bag will keep it dry. […] We were told that the sea is pretty at this season (June- Aigust) but it gets much rougher during the dry season Dexember-February and locals tend to stay away from travels to Necocli or Turbo.
[…]»

The Hotel Panorama is the highest white building in the center of town. The receptionist was really helpful and made calls for us to investigate about the availability of accommodation in Capurganá. We were able to purchase the tickets on our Visa card the day before.

The hotel runs a safe parqueadero 100 m away (guard on duty 24 h, CPO 10.000 per 24 h).
Capurganá doesn't have an ATM so take enough cash. And don't miss Josefina's seafood!

Location: Unnamed Road, Necoclí, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje Tiki Lounge playa and camping
Description:
This cool place by the beach caters mostly to Colombian tourists. Doña Carmenza offers rooms and apartments, raised sand platforms for tent camping, food, drinks and cakes. There is space for 1-2 overlander vehicles in partly shaded, flat spots next to the main house. The beach is nice, there is plenty of driftwood for bonfires, the toilet and shower in one of the apartment blocks adjacent to the beach are new and clean (the ones in the thatched hut are so-so). If you are lucky you can spot a rare blue crab on her property.

Carmenza doesn't speak English and is only interested in overlanders willing and able to fit in and communicate with her Colombian guests, many of them long-standing regulars or loosely connected family members.

COP 15.000 pp pn. We were allowed to leave our truck here free of charge during our visit to Capurganá. The transfer to the Necoclí muelle / harbor by motocarro (3 people) was COP 12.000 each way).

To get here follow the dirt road more or less along the shoreline from Necoclí. The entrance to the property is signposted.

Location: Dg. 50 #73a-1 a 73a-97, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Secure parking even for big rigs
Description:
It's not one of the fine addresses in Medellín but it's solid and secure even if it doesn't evoke this impression at first sight.
The owner, a noble and faith-inspiring man, has run this place for 30 years and the parqueadero / taller is also a social institution providing work for some people who would otherwise life in the streets. One of the two, the owner himself or his right hand, are always on premises. Security cameras are in place. They kept our truck well for three days. 24-hour access. COP 18.000 per 24 hours.
There is space here even for very big rigs.
It's 1.2 km from Hotel 61 Prado (taxi: COP 5.500).

We stayed in Getsemaní for 10 days and had our truck parked here. The guards actually remembered us when we went back to pick something up from the truck and accompanied us to the vehicle. They all are in radio contact. We made a 10-day contract at their admin office and paid COP 20.000 per day.

-------

Location: Mingueo-Santa Marta, Dibulla, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: 4x4 camp Guadalupe Beach
Description: A camp off the touristy area of Palomino. Take turnoff 300mts east of bridge (N 11.24260 W 73.52862) to get there. In the upper area - below the main road - all cars can get to. There are grassy areas, shelters, kitchen, volleyball field and few privat cabanas (35000.-and 50000.-), some road noise. 15000.-/p. /// With a 4x4 you can drive down to three (privately owned) beaches (dry conditions only). 4 min /1.1kms driving. One is a nudist beach. Space for camping is a bit limited. On the westernmost beach is space for some cars, possibility to make a fire and a freshwater river is flowing into the sea. Down here everything is a bit run down, quite a lot of rubbish, no infrastructue but you will spend an undisturbed night right at the beachfront. Without using the upper infrastructure we paid 10000.- each. /// From this western beach a hiking trail leads up to a viewpoint and on to other (nudist) beaches (eastwards). Another trail goes west to a freshwater lagoon, birding platform, into the quiet jungle and (with some luck) to a monkey colony (at the first footbridge) after 6min walk.

Description: Small, funky hostel with room to park and camp. Dorms are 15,000COP. Relatively clean, quiet and very relaxed compared to the rest of Palomino. No wifi but small kitchen with most things. Carlos the owner is a very chilled out guy.

Location: Cra. 38 #31-35, Soledad, Barranquilla, Atlántico, Colombia
Name: Seguros del Estado
Description: 8th floor. entrance is on Av. Carlos Escallón. 124000 for 3 months.  Minimum purchase is 2 months

Location: Cl. 5a #8-2 a 8-156, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Street parking
Description:
After we had to move on behind the Hilton we came here and stayed one more night. The street is very wide, no buses, little taxis and generally less traffic than at the street next to the Hilton. The beach is just in front, little wind and very quiet during the night. Further to the tip of the road there will be even less traffic and a little park is there as well. Might be interesting for dog owners.
So pick your spot, we liked it better than parking on the street next to the Hilton.

Location: 70, Villa Del Rosario, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: Migration Office Colombia
Description: Only an exit/entry if you have no vehicle. If you have a vehicle you need to go to the other border post approx 5km away for processing your TIP.

Location: Av. 7, Cúcuta, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: DIAN Cucuta
Description:
This is the main DIAN office where you'd need to go if you need to renew your TIP. WARNING! ⚠️ We were denied the extension of our TIP because we left Colombia to cross into Venezuela without our truck. We were told they could impound our truck and make us pay a fee but let us go with a warning and advised us to leave Colombia through Ecuador and the re-enter if we wanted to obtain a new TIP. Instead we drove to Bucaramanga where we renew our TIP without issues. The documents you'd need to renew are:
- Original and copy of your current TIP
- Present your original passport with a new (recent) stamp from the migration office.
- Original and copy of your vehicle title.
- Original and copy of current and valid car insurance.

Once the docs are presented you'll be given a form to fill out. This is your official request to extend your TIP. A persons from Aduanas need to take fotos of your vehicle's VIN and license plates. 

The process for us took 2 days as they needed to get confirmation from the DIAN office in Cartagena that they in fact had issued our original TIP.

Location: Neiva-San Agustín, Hobo, Huila, Colombia
Name: Terpel station
Description:
Camping - Big fuel station with restaurant and hotel. We could camp (tent) on the left side of the hotel under the tree. Very large lot.  Access to the toilet with toilet paper and soap (really clean), and showers. The restaurant closes around 10:30pm-11pm. Quiet for a roadside sleep. 

Hotel - Clean double rooms with A/C, TV & WiFi - 35k

Perfect stop between San Agustin - Tatacoa.

Location: Manizales-La Felisa, Manizales, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Centro  Tambo La Manuela
Description:
Wifi, electricity, coffee, bathroom!   
Free, but they didn't let us stay after 7 am
Camping and RV not allowed by permit only
No permiten acampar y en casa rodante solo con permiso

Location: Vía La Felisa-La Merced, La Merced, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje Villa Amparo
Description:
We tried to arrive in Tambo, but there was a landslide and it was not possible! We stoped in other spot, near the hospedaje and met Sr Eduardo the owner! Person very friendly, with a great knowledge of Colômbia! We spent a night with him and his family! 
The place has a wonderful view and is very quiet, perfect to relax... they Offer horse rides, tours around the Finca, with waterfalls... plenty of attractions!!! best place to stay if you are looking for a quiet night or even a week or more in a finca!!!

Location: Cl. 23 #7-2 a 7-74, Neiva, Huila, Colombia
Name: Fruits and veggies shop.
Description: Very cheap place to buy your stuff near Neiva.

Location: Al Pilon de Azucar y El Faro, Uribia, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: La playa
Description:
We slept three nights on the beach. the paid places of the kite schools did not offer any service. super quiet What if there is a lot? wind.
dormimos tres noches a orillas de la playa. los lugares pagos de las escuelas de kite no ofrecían ningún servicio. super tranquilo. lo q si hay mucho. viento.

Location: Ventanas-Valdivia, Valdivia, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Hotel Monterrey
Description: White building connected to the Terpel gas station. We got a room for 25,000 COP.

Location: Ventanas-Yarumal, Yarumal, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Hotel & Restaurante El Descanso
Description: Private room with tv and bathroom. Room is clean and owner is very friendly. Good coffee too.  Owner allows to camping too.

Location: Cra. 49 #45-138, San Pedro, San Pedro de los Milagros, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Hotel El Faro
Description: Brand new hotel. Really cute and modern. We paid 60,000 COP for a double room and 3,000 COP to park our tandem bicycle. It's located on the 3rd floor of a shopping center.

Location: Cra. 3 #18-1 a 18-63, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Localish restaurant - Mio Oficina
Description:
The most local restaurant in this touristy area. 
Breakfasts from 6000cop (eggs, tomato, onion, arepa with juice or coffee etc.) 
Cheap almuerzos 7000cop. 
And cheap snacks from 2000cop. 

There are cheaper restaurants (almuerzos 5000) but it is necessary to walk further into the city or cheap greazy close by (a cheap one at night is just corner of calle 20/carerra 3). But this place is a good alternative close by.

Location: Loboguerrero - Mediacanoa, Yotoco, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Area de servicio
Description: Great place for overnight. This place is awaiting a owner since 2 years and half, but the rent is too expensive, so it's just empty! There is electricity and toilet. There is a security guy at night. 2km after this place there are several shop and restaurant. Before setting up your camp, ask at the building nearby. There is a nice lady.

Location: Paipa-Duitama, Paipa, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Gragos Gas Refill
Description: To refill partially empty 10lb bottles, we paid: 17,500COP // June 2022 for 20lbs bottle 21.500 COP.

Location: Cl. 31 #23-1 a 23-93, Girón, Santander, Colombia
Name: Town center / plaza
Description: Parking is 30,000. Very close to old town center. No size or height restrictions. Our RV is 27 ft and it went perfect. The family that manages it is very very kind. They gave us electricity and they also shared their internet with us.

Location: Cl. 17 #13-128 a 13-170, Pasto, Nariño, Colombia
Name: batericars
Description: servicio para vehículos, llanta, batería, aceite, alineación y balanceo etc... MUY RECOMENDADO, excelente atención!!

Location: Unnamed Road, Uribia, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Dunas de Taroa
Description: perfect place to chill for a couple hours. You need a good 4x4 to get here.

Location: Ubaté-Chiquinquirá, Simijacá, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Delicias Tatys -Simijaca
Description: You can camp on a flat grassy parking lot next to the dairy shop. Clean restrooms super friendly owner. (Yubert Gomez) will be happy to talk to you and give some recommendations about the area. Don't forget to get the excellent Yogurt and cheeses! 10,000 per car per night.

Location: Sta Rosa de Osos-Donmatía, Santa Rosa de Osos, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Gas station Texaco
Description: Better than nothing. Noise of the road but we slept.

Location: Cra. 82 #6b-38, Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Tyre repair
Description: Professional and modern tyre place (think it is called Gulf?), in the corner of the shopping complex.  Fixed a puncture for us quickly for 12,000. They have all the computers and equipment to do a proper rotate and balance, and you can also buy new tires here.  A couple of people speak English here.  Really nice guys.

Location: Cl. 13c #14-1 a 14-141, Valledupar, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Hotel Balop
Description:
A great and cheap small hotel - paid 50 000cop for private matrimonial room for two. Laundry 7000cop per load. Looks like it was recently built or renovated - nice spacious and clean room with a/c, shower with showerhead(one of the first rooms equipped with it we've seen in Colombia..), clean and comfortable bed with towels, nice new kitchen with refrigerator to use for the guests. Filter for potable water.
Parking outside just in front of the hotel with camera pointing there and  neighbourhood seems safe enough. Large exito very close to the hotel.
When we were here, also very fast internet for SA standards - downloading over 1MB per second. Really good deal.

Location: Vía al Valle del Cocora, Salento, Quindío, Colombia
Name: Valle de Cocora
Description:
They say this area has the densest population of hummingbirds in the world.  The most popular day hike is this loop from the parking lot (5000 or 10,000cop per car depending on lot) to the Finca located at this GPS point.   It's a shame they let the horses on the same trail as the hikers (there is a lot of smelly poo/mud soup to scramble around!).   20K entrance per person. Bring additional money if doing the longer loop as you cross private property and they charge per person (6,000/person). Some of the private parks charge $15,000/person but they have props and statues for taking photos. 
The views are lovely, much of the trail is shaded, the gradient not too bad except for one short steep section which becomes extremely slippery in rain, and if you do the additional walk to the Casa de Los Colibris (20 000cop entrance pp) you will be rewarded with a free drink and lots of hummingbirds.  

We took about 4-5 hours at a leisurely pace.  Recommended.

Location: Unnamed Road, Carmen de Carupa, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Great Wild Camping spot on top of Mountain.
Description:
Awesome quiet wild camping place at top of the mountain with gorgeous views. (Free)

From the town of Susa drive up the mountain on the Carmen de Carupa-Susa dirt road. Near the GPS coordinate points you'd need to make a sharp right up the hill. You'll end up at a level, clear, dirt spot protected from the wind with great almost 360° views. Quiet, very cold at night.

Couple of friendly farmers walked by in the morning. 

4x4 may not be needed but high-clearance is recommended.

Location: Cl. 7 #4-1 a 4-89, Mongui, Monguí, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Hospital Mercedes
Description:
Flat lot inside the hospital. 
They ask 10k for the night. 
Wifi password:  [passwords are not allowed ]
WC inside building.

Location: Unnamed Road, Guasca, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Entrance to Siecha lake Sector Chingaza NP
Description:
Camped literally on the side of the dirt road that leads to the entrance to the NP Chingaza (Siecha Lake) (free) 

10 min walk from the park ranger station where there are restrooms.

Very nice 2-3 hour hike to the lakes. 42,000 COP per person to enter NP

Location: Vía Cabo de la Vela, Kasiuoluin, Cabo de la Vela, Uribia, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 440029, Colombia
Name: Ojo de Água
Description:
We slept a night at Pilón but prefered this location. Basically one can camp everywhere out here in the desert so this spot is not really needed in this gem of a App.

The wind blows not as strong as at Pilón and the landscape is fascinating. Reminded us of the Baja in México. Lighthouse and Playa Ojo de Agua in very close proximity.

The fact why we moved over here were, sorry, the kids. During the day we had always 4 or more who played and climbed on our truck. They just came up the stairs and entered. Even one mother came up in the morning and opened the door asking for breakfast. After some hours we had enough and moved here. Around 4pm some tours came to the beach and for the sunset at the lighthouse. Otherwise nobody!
We had full moon and a super bright night in the desert.

Location: Tocancipá, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Mirador Peñas Blancas
Description: Nice wild camping spot on top of the mountain with 360° views. Place is called Mirador Peñas Blancas.

Location: 25, Pasto, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Terpel Gas Station
Description:
We were allowed to spend the night in the camper and use the bathrooms for 6.000COP,

nos dejaron pasar la noche en la camper y usar los baños por 6.000COP,

Location: Cl. 13 #6-1 a 6-105, Jardín, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Trail Head
Description: Trail head to a one hour hike around Jardín.  Trail takes you to a river and a mirador through coffee fields.  Beautiful and easy hike.

Location: Cl. 6 #4-2 a 4-92, Aguadas, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Casa de la cultura - museo del Sombrero
Description:
In front of the police station you ll find the  Casa de la cultura. Inside there is the Museo del sombrero, and other stuff of the Colombian history. When you enter go on the right side, where the office is. Ask there to visit the museum. Someone ll guide you. The director is new and wants to make some improvement of the museum. 

Everything is free. There is wifi too at the library (casacultura123456).

Location: Cl. 4 #4-1 a 4-129, Yaguara, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hotel del Lago
Description: A media cuadra del centro de la ciudad, habitaciones amplías por $60,000 COP

Location: Cl. 17, Aguadas, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Pueblito viejo
Description: An attraction of Aguadas. The make a fake old village, like before! Nice place for chilling, and good view on the city. You ll discover all the old stuff of the 19th century. Nice to have a look. There is a small restaurant upstairs.

Location: Cl. 20a #24, Girón, Santander, Colombia
Name: Street parking
Description: There are many parking lots either side of the street behind the Metro supermarket. Most of them were empty so we parked our truck alongside. Sunday evening and it got a bit busy at the evening but after 10.30pm everything was calm. Noisy at 6am. Several locals came for a chat. Nice and only 4 minutes from the Malecon per foot.

Location: Zapatoca-Girón, Zapatoca, Santander, Colombia
Name: Above the canyon
Description: Flat spot around 400 meters above the canyon, left hand side. It's large enough for a big truck. Super quiet and fantastic views.

Location: Cl. 15 #20-16 a 20-140, Riohacha, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Exito
Description:
Last large Exito store on the way to Cabo de la Vela - you can stock up here on basically anything, good choice of meat, veggies, home, car maintenance, clothes and international stuff.
Buy bags or small bottles of water for the locals, especially if you want to go in your own car to Punta Gallinas. Look out for the green sign on the left hand side of the building, the car park is down there and free.

Location: Vía Vda. Mazo, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Zarzamora Cafe (ex Mazamorra)
Description: Cute little side of the road cafe. Good coffee, hot chocolates, freshly made bread and yum sandwiches (pesto plus ingredients for only $7k). Family owned and nice people. Veggie and vegan options available. Super pleasant.

Location: Cra. 5 #9-1 a 9-99, Jardín, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Macanas coffee
Description: Really cool cafe - colourful decor, plants everywhere, mosaic and tiled tables, amazing coffee and delicious cakes. Wifi didn’t work for us... No seating on the plaza, it’s all out the back. No sign out front, it’s through yellow doorway. More of a modern / hipster cafe than those dotted around the plaza full of cowboy hats.

Location: Timbío-Popayán, Popayán, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Diesel del pacifico
Description:
Diesel mechanics. Large workshop, work very well and are very friendly! 

Mecánica diesel. taller grande, trabajan muy bien y son muy amigables!

Location: Cl. 4 #5-8, Salento, Quindío, Colombia
Name: Etnia Arte & Sabor
Description: The best meal I've had in Colombia. The trout and beef menu de día was delicious plus the soup! Oh the soup! The owner/chef is a wonderful lady and has so much to share so go early and sit at the kitchen bar seats to chat. Being a chef myself, she does things very well and most importantly fills it with love. We are here both nights we were in town. She sued to be number 4 on Tripadvisor but they wants her to pay to stay there which she didn't believe in so they bumped her down to 9th.

Location: Cra. 7d #155-2 a 155-98, Bogotá, Colombia
Name: Harold Silva Trailers factory
Description: Fantastic place to fix almost every thing. Harold is à great Guy Who makes Trailers and he Will be pleased to help you fixing your RV

Location: Cl. 10, Curiti, Curití, Santander, Colombia
Name: Balneario Pescaderito
Description:
3k for parking or 10k COP to stay overnight per car. Huge area, but very basic. Clean toilets, cold showers. We got offered boiled river water.
We didn't try the restaurant and we don't know their prices. No noise, not even music during the day.

The river curutí itself is free and one can swim or pitch a tent wherever one wants. Many fireplaces testify this. You can hike along the river/canyon for quite a bit. Very nice scenery and clean refreshing water!

Avoid Saturday or Sunday! Otherwise very calm and relaxed atmosphere. 
The village of Curití is restricted to vehicles of 8.5 tons!

Location: Duitama-Charalá, Gambita, Santander, Colombia
Name: At the mountain road
Description:
Right next to the street, flat parking in front of a property. We asked the old man if we can park there and he agreed instantly. Offered drinking water.
Spot large enough for one truck, very nice view over the mountain and of course it is super quiet.

Location: Cra. 34 #3-178 a 3-322, Cali, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: El parque del perro
Description:
You can park here, it seems safe to sleep.

se puede parquear, parece seguro para dormir.

Location: Malagana-San Onofre, María La Baja, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: El Playon, Large Truck Parking
Description: Large truckparking. In the back pretty quiet. With restaurant and hospedaje. Only boondocking 10.000 per night.

Location: Cl. 12 #7-1 a 7-99, Villa de Leyva, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Panadería Astral
Description:
Different kinds of breads and rolls. Variety is changing every day, but that does not matter. One of the best bakeries we found in America.
No sweets, but assorted mermeladas and jams. opens daily at 8.30am

Location: Cl. 14 #8-2 a 8-128, Villa de Leyva, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: La Waffeleria,
Description: Good waffles, very good juice, fast WiFi and perfect service in an extraordinary ambience.

Location: Cl. 25 #8b-240 a 8b-300, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Oh la la
Description: A french chef. Very good meal. The place are in pesos it's quite cheap. A very large choice of plates, Toulouse sausage, campain pate, quiche, ceviche, sopas. ...

Location: Titiribí-Amagá, Amaga, Amagá, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Hotel Casa Real
Description: Nice hotel with swimming pool and bar. Private room with tv, bathroom and fan for $35,000. Clean and new.

Location: Vía al Valle del Cocora, Salento, Quindío, Colombia
Name: private parking
Description:
Very large private parking. 10 thousand cop the night. There is nothing more than breathtaking views of the valley. Very quiet and lonely at night. Closes everything and nobody is left.

parqueadero privado muy amplio. 10 mil cop la noche. No hay nada más que impresionantes vistas al valle. muy tranquilo y solitario en la noche. cierra todo y no queda nadie.

Location: Cl. 69 #17-2 a 17-98, Bogotá, Colombia
Name: Hipermar fish
Description: Really good fish and sushi restaurant. Generous portions :) with affordable prices.

Location: Cra. 2 #6-1 a 6-109, Salento, Quindío, Colombia
Name: Casa La Eliana
Description: Really great curries and naan bread.  Also a nice hostel with fast internet and good showers.

Location: Av. El Poblado #30-2 a 30-182, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Ruta 40 - BMW Motorrad dealership
Description:
BMW motorcycles dealership and a workshop. Owned by Mauricio, BMW Motorrad off-road instructor and a very nice person! They also sell tires. 
 (Metzeler, Heidenau and Continental). People work very carefully, check the bikes thoroughly and charge a decent price (which is still higher than in US or Europe, but much lower than for example in Chile).
A great place!

Location: Cra. 37 #8a-59 a 8a-167, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Cafe Pergamino
Description: Fantastic coffee shop in super trendy part of Medellin. Laid back vibe. Indoor and outdoor eating. Light meals and pasteries too. Owner sources the coffee from three local plantations so very ethical. Fast wifi. Power points for charging your devices.

Location: Unnamed Road, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Reserva Biologica Caoba
Description: Natural Reserve and Eco-Lodge with Restaurant. Confortable accommodations in the tropical forest. Collection of plants and historical site. Animal encounters. Looks more like staying in a botanical Garden in the forest. 11 km from Santa Marta, 8 km dirt road. The last 3 km are the most challenging ones. 4x4 needed.  crossing of a river, but not a big one.

Location: Cl. 12 #68c-2 a 68c-92, Bogotá, Colombia
Name: Assumar Peter Auchter Mechanic
Description:
Workshop with german owner for weldings, works with stainless steal and other metals. He and his crew are very helpful!!! 
Tel. Bogota D.C. 420 6077 or. 420 6099 or. 260 3759 
www.assumarltda.com

Location: Cra. 18 #26-4 a 26-74, Manizales, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Pixel gráfica digital
Description:
Digital printing of stickers. Very cheap and fast. Excellent place to do the trip traces or plotted for the car. Ask for Cristian


Impresión digital de stickers banderas señalizacion. Muy barato y rápido. excelente lugar para hacer las calcos del viaje o ploteados para el carro. Preguntar por Cristian

Location: Cra. 14 #32-174 a 32-330, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Nissan - stay away!
Description:
We had a small oil leak (first mechanical problem after 50k kilometres, not bad) and a small noise somewhere from a wheel - and because we had some spare time, we decided to go and fix it. We were passing by this authorized Nissan dealership / mechanic and the owner came out to take a picture of our chilean Nissan and asked if we need something done - in my life, I had mostly bad experience with the authorized dealers but I gave in and we had them check it.
They quickly said that some support of the engine is causing the noise and needs to be replaced - and that the oil leak is from some bearing or seal and it needs replacing too. Could not even give us an estimate saying how much it would roughly cost and we had to leave the car there. I told them I don't want anything done until I know how much it would be (always do that btw). They wanted me to sign some paper that they will do an inspection - I didn't sign. When I asked if that's free, they said no... about 80 000 COP. Go figure...
Next morning, we came there and after waiting 3 hours they gave us estimate for about 1.5 million COP (500 usd!) - I almost laughed, looked at the list of things - and saw there changing of timing belt, coolant, the seal and the engine support.
We thanked them (for nothing), left and went to Freddy Toyota. The best part comes now.
The oil leak wasn't caused by any seal, just by some small hole somewhere that they quickly fixed. And the noise was no engine support, just needed to tighten some nuts :) So both problems were diagnosed badly, or they actually lied to us. Freddy fixed it in 1 day and for 200 000COP, so 1/8th of the price.
Keep away from authorized dealers, sorry to say that. If you don't, absolutely _always_ ask for how much it's going to cost before agreeing on doing anything, or signing anything.

Location: Autopista Medellín-Bogotá, San Luís, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Hotel Balcones de Oriente
Description:
A big truck - stop. Room with private bathroom for two people - 40 000cop. Wifi works fine, restaurant has a very friendly chef, who can also make a nice breakfast.
Parking is a big lot right by the road, but they have space for 3 cars under the roof. It's open, but can be "covered up" with trucks, so won't be visible from the road.

Location: Cl. 122 #17a-2 a 17a-88, Bogotá, Colombia
Name: street parking Calle 122
Description:
One of the rare occasions where one can park in the street. We were not allowed to park our 8 ton truck at the shopping mall close by, but as in that street are many small shops (for us important the outdoor shops) it's ok to park there. Slept there as well, bit noisy.

Not sure for how many days that would work...

Location: Cra. 7 #7-1 a 7-91, La Hormiga, Valle Del Guamuez, Putumayo, Colombia
Name: Trasladar Express S.A.S.
Description: The only place in Hormiga that insures foreign vehicles. We found two other SOAT providers, but they handled domestic vehicles only. Due to a combination of complex procedures and forms, poor quality equipment and an incompetent agent it took from 1 pm to 4:30 pm to complete the whole process.

Location: Cra. 11 #15-1 a 15-129, Ipiales, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Hotel Avanti
Description:
Very clean place with secure parking in underground garage. Paid 70.000 for only me, one night. Private bathroom in the room. Internet is fast.
I drove past this place while I tried to get to another hotel mentioned on iOverlander, but the city was too busy as it was Saturday and there was a market so I just stopped here.
Neighborhood doesn't look too good, there are shops a block away, but the allays were dark. If you need to do some shopping, it's probably better to arrive in the afternoon when it's still light.

Location: 50, Guaduas, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Hotel Shalom PHE
Description: Nice hotel with the garage. Prices about 70000!pesos per two. Nice owners:) the owner's daughter teached me Spanish:)

Location: Vía San Pedro - Numancia, San Pedro, Sucre, Colombia
Name: San Pedro, Hotel El Conductor
Description: Rooms where you can put your bicicletas in the room. Nice persons. Paid 20.000 COP for one night/one person. There is a gas stadion on the other side maybe it's an option for parking.

Location: Cra. 14 Sur, Barranquilla, Atlántico, Colombia
Name: The Shakira statue
Description:
I am speechless... C'mon, seriously guys - how has noone listed the Shakira statue as a point of interest yet?! Barranquilla is the hallowed birthplace of the most famous Colombian sweetheart.  A national treasure, for sure! 

Her words will surely echo through the ages... "lucky that my breasts are small and humble, so you don't confuse them for mountains."

Inspirational stuff.   Lol.

Location: Vía Palestina, Chinchiná, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 176020, Colombia
Name: Lago Cameguadua
Description: MODERATOR NOTE: Place removed because camping is illegal here.  Day Use Only, Signs posted and enforced

Location: Puerto Lebrija-La Gomez, Sabana de Torres, Santander, Colombia
Name: Freeway Hotel Restaurant
Description: Super convenient, on highway, 24hr restaurant. 50k COP for 2

Location: Cl. 10 #5-2 a 5-90, Riosucio, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Hotel Real Plaza
Description: Nice hotel. Our room had a tv, fan, fridge, balcony, and hot shower. I think we paid 50,000 COP. They also have laundry service, which is great as there are no laundromats in Riosucio. There's free coffee too; and they have menus from neighborhood restaurants in the lobby.

Location: Cl. 18 #9-1 a 9-151, Valledupar, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Hotel Aparta Napoles
Description: Simple hotel in a good location. Paid 35.000 COP for a private room w a/c.  Front desk woman was very friendly. Allowed me to park my moto inside at night.

Location: Cra. 10 #11-3 a 11-35, Pelaya, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Pelaya, Hotel Santoris
Description: Paid 30.000 COP for one room/person/night with toillette+shower and a/c + ventilator and tv. No problem to place my bicycle in my room. Several rooms available and mostly with one double bed and an extra bed. There is place for car parking in front of the hotel.

Location: Cra. 17 #4-1 a 4-111, Aguachica, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Aguachica, Hotel Escocia
Description: 25.000 COP for person/night. Clean rooms and calm location. Restaurants, shops, supermarket nearby. Free coffee and wifi!! Enough space for my bicycle in front of the bed. Mattress is super, not as soft as often. No a/c but ventilator. Bathroom is tiny, when you take a shower, mostly everything get wet. No problem for me.

Location: Mediacanoa-La Virginia, Ansermanuevo, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Pancho Anca Hotel
Description: Trucker hotel, but clean and pleasant. Paid 28,000 COP for a double room with A/C and tv. We were downstairs, so there was a bit of noise, but not too much.

Location: Cra. 3 #3-298 a 3-830, La Vega, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: NYX hotel
Description: Nice place to stay-not so expensive. 80000 per doble. Very very very clean. With swimming pool. Great coffee:)) not many touristvsonsimetimes you have the swimmin pool only for you:) hot water, posible to ask about loundry with dryier.  Own parking, closed gate, nice climate.

Location: Av. Julian Buchelly, Pasto, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Mil Mangueras

Location: Cl. 40 #14-1 a 14-131, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia

Location: Cl. 25 #8b-239 a 8b-299, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Dadis del centro de salud Fátima
Description: Here you can get the yellow fever vaccine for free at the clinic.

Location: Finca La Alsacia, Carrera 7, Buenavista, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 632060, Colombia
Name: Finca La Alsacia
Description:
If you're looking for an autenthic experience in a coffee farm, the Finca Dom Leo, with it's "Caficultur" tour, is the best you will find. Dom Leo is the farm owner and, at this little and high town, with the help of Carlos, his Brother in Law, takes you for a great Colombian experience. You can be hosted at the farm if you want to, sleeping and eating like everybody that works there. I really recommend! 
The place in the map is the center or the town - you just need to get there and as for Dom Leo, everybody knows him and the people is helpful and kind. We stay with our big rig in front at the school, the only leveled place to sleep, with a beautiful view.

Location: Uribia-Puerto Bolivar, Uribia, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Cactus Forest
Description: I turned off here to avoid the tolls that have been reported further up the road. This was fantastic to explore. You start off in a cactus forest. Tracks everywhere. Point your compass in the direction you want to go and have some fun. I travelled solo and never felt threatened. Make sure you have plenty of water. It's very remote. Fun conditions.

Location: Cra. 3 #8-82, Ipiales, Nariño, Colombia
Name: SOAT - Exito Supermarket

Supermarket "Exito" sells SOAT, we paid 133000 cop for 2 months (VW T3), fast, easy reachable and good place to park.

Only Monday to Friday

Location: Autopista Medellín-Bogotá, Sonsón, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Restaurante parrilla del campo
Description: The owner Ramiro allowed us to stay in the back of his restaurant for free. Very nice guy.

Location: Unnamed Road, Salento, Quindío, Colombia
Name: Reserva Natural Kasaguadua
Description: Kasaguadua is a private nature reserve. The area used to be a coffee farm but is now being restored to original cloud forest. We had an absolutely superb tour, guided by the passionate Carlos, one of the 3 men running the site. Focus was not so much on plant names and their use, but more on the biological aspects: how plants have adapted to an environment with abundant sun and water and without seasons as well as the process of development over time. On site is a small guesthouse as well. Tours start at 9 am, reservations are compulsory and can be made by the accommodations in the environment. Highly recommended!

Location: Unnamed Road, Guadalupe, Santander, Colombia

Location: Cra. 3 #1s-2 a 1s-214, Guaduas, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Park in front of police station
Description: Local police was very friendly and helpful. Quiet place overnight.

Location: Cra. 44, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Street Parking
Description:
Street. Very quiet in front of football training ground. Like all the surrounding area at the river park, the locals come to smoke churros the size of a canyon.
.....
calle cortada muy tranquila frente a campo de entrenamiento de fútbol.  como toda la zona de los alrededores al parque del río, los lugareños vienen a fumar churros del tamaño de un cañon. 
Pasamos una noche aquí y todo súper bien, hace un poco de calor ya que no corre tanta brisa y al ser junto a un parque debes acostumbrarte a ver grupos de jóvenes fumando marihuana, pero si no tienes problema con esto todo está bien, no tiene ningún nivel de inseguridad, puntos negativos el acceso a baños no es posible en la zona, solo una bomba de gasolina a dos o tres calles.

Location: Cl 24A #20-2 a 20-96, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Hotel Puerto de Manga
Description:
Very nice hotel in Manga, the port side of town but still very near the historical center. It's located in a quiet residential neighbourhood. Rooms are clean, ensuite bathrooms, swimming pool, kitchen. 
No parking available, but we parked the car in the street just in front of the hotel and did not have any problems at night.
150k per room, breakfast included.
