Description: Large and level lot behind the restaurant. 30k per vehicle for 24hours. Guards are very nice, restaurant owner nicer. We had arranged to come here as the owner is Friend of Santiago from mi Refugio in Villa de Leyva. But it appears that other park overnight here as well, and they didn't mind us being here at all. We were able to use the bathrooms through the night as well. hamburgers in the restaurant are huge and yummy. Free Wifi in the restaurant, large enclosed patio area that you can hang out in during the day. some of our devices could reach the wifi in the far end of the lot as well.

Location: Vía Cienaga - Barranquilla, Puebloviejo, Tasajeras, Puebloviejo, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Corrupt police
Description: This road seems to be famous for corrupt police. We drove down from Santa Marta towards Cartagena. Police stopped us because we crossed a double line - yes we made a mistake. But when they told us how little they earned as policemen, I told them we respect the work they are doing and we are happy to pay a fine, but we are not ok with paying on the spot to these two - meaning no bribery with us, but fine no problem. All in different words and politely, so after short discussions they let us go with a warning. Obey the rules on this road especially!

Location: Cra. 14 #7-49 a 7-67, San Juán Nepomuceno, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: San Juan Church on the road to Medelin
Description:
Parking lot on side of the church just near the police station. Free.
Nice place with sport games, trees and flowers.
Street food at night. A bit noisy on the day but calm all night long even on a saturday night.
The police is very nice and told us it is ok to stay and to ask them if we need something. Just park not to close to the police station (police secure area).

Location: Cra. 9a #20-23 a 20-103, Caucasia, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: caucasia center
Description: Free parking place in the middle of town. calm all night and secure. very friendly people. highly interested in the RV and trip. free wifi.

Location: Calle 10, Diurba, Facatativá, Sabana Occidente, Cundinamarca, 253051, Colombia
Name: Facatativa place
Description: a nice place in front of a church. ok with local "casa de policia" but on the other side to be out the perimeter of security. no facilities but nice people and quiet at night until 6AM. good for 1 night.

Location: Cl. 28 #5-1 a 5-99, Bogotá, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero Yordin
Description: Parking ok for overnights, Raul is very friendly and welcoming, let us fill up our water tank. We paid 60000 for two all days, including a Sunday which is more expensive in the area.

Location: Kiosko el Bonny, Carrera 1, El Laguito, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130018, Colombia
Name: El Bony boxer’s restaurant
Description:
Owner is olympic champion, in restaurant are his old photoes. Restaurant is on the beach.
This is kind of local restaurant, and the prices are not expensive. 
We had two jugos naturales, ceviche mix (medium size) and two main meals (both sea foods). We paid 57.000 pesos. 
Portions was big and it was really tasty. We can recomended this place.

Location: Café Internet, Carrera 10B, Valdivia, Norte, Antioquia, 052037, Colombia
Name: ATM
Description: ATM in village, near main square, where is na amazing church. And a lot of shops, restaurants, coffee, etc.

Location: Punto Amarillo, Via Llanos de Cuiba - Yarumal, Barrio Media Aguas, Yarumal, Norte, Antioquia, 052030, Colombia
Name: Texaco station with shower
Description:
Texaco gas station. They accept credit card.
Clean toilet and shower. Cold water, but just for 500 pesos.
And coffee, but just sweet - for 2.000 pesos. 
Near is restaurant Rinch Ric.

Location: Centro Comercial Puerta del Norte, Avenida 55, Niquía, Bello, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 051053, Colombia
Name: Shopping Mall with free Wi-Fi
Description:
Huge shopping mall - lot of shops, restaurants and thinks for reparing and camping. 
In “Homecetre” is free Wi-Fi.

Location: Carrera 6, La Hormiga, Valle del Guamuez (La Hormiga), Putumayo, Colombia
Name: Servicios Integrales para la Movilidad
Description:
ADMIN NOTE: User reports:"They overprice the insurance fees a 120%. They are not willing to make corrections of there own mistakes. I made a petition at the insurance main office in the next big town."

SOAT sold to foreign vehicles. I could not find the other place listed. 200k for 2 months for a moto. Process easy and fast. The place is a tiny booth between Emcofunerales and Suzuki store

Location: San Fernando, Calle 11, Zona Rosa, Chinchiná, Centrosur, Caldas, 176020, Colombia
Name: Parking for big trucks
Description:
We found this secure parking area near city centre. Perfect for trucks 4,5 m high.
For small car is 1.500 per hour, for bigger 2.000 per hour and for motorbikes is 600 pesos per hour.

Location: Estación de Servicio Mobil, Ruta del Sol, Puerto Salgar, Bajo Magdalena, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Ruta 45
Description: if you need a good tank of "premium diesel" this place was not much more than the regular diesel. local mechanics directed me here after a clogged fuel filter issue.

Location: Hosteria Ambeyma, Entrada Hosteria Ambeyma, Garzón, Centro, Huila, 414020, Colombia
Name: Hosteria Ambeyma
Description: Big room with private bathroom & balcony. It is not the newest but clean and away from main street. With fan 45k, with AC 60k. The down for us were no warm shower either wifi signal in the room. There are one 15m sport pool and a kids pool with kids slide, very nice for a hot day. Warning: if there is an event may get very very noisy. We had one on Sat., fortunately they left 11pm-7am quiet.

Location: Calle 43, Localidad Norte - Centro Histórico, Perímetro Urbano Barranquilla, Barranquilla, Atlántico, 080002, Colombia
Name: Mar Azul
Description: A basic hotel. A room with a big bed and a ventilator 30,000, with AC 45,000. Rooms small but clean etc. A small motorcycle can be brought inside.

Location: Calle 29, La Bocana, La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, 055060, Colombia
Name: Vegas del Farallon
Description:
Paid 60,000 COP for two people in a room with double bed. Nice place with a swimming pool. Gated parking. 

Check out is at 8:30am for some reason.

Location: Calle 6, Córdoba, Pacífico, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Bongo Hotel
Description: Hotel next to parking lot. Paid 35k COP for a comfy room with AC. Parking is not gated but you can pull up right next to the hotel.

Location: Plaza de Bolívar, Carrera 8, UPZs Localidad La Candelaria, Localidad La Candelaria, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 111711, Colombia
Name: tourist office
Description: free english city tour at 2:00 pm daily. only 20 spots so either register or stop by in advance if it’s a busy season.

Location: Agustiniano Coffee, Obando-San Agustín, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, 418060, Colombia
Name: Vis à Vis Posada Campesina
Description: Correct name of place: Finca El Manantial. Posada Campesada was fully booked and therefore we ended up at their neighbors. They also offer space for camping (tent and cars) as well as a dorm & room (no idea of the price). We had a level spot and as a courtesy they offered us coffee upon arrival and showed us a YouTube Video about the sights on their big flat screen at the dorm. Everything is very  simple but the owner is very zealous and helpful. Bathroom very clean and shower lukewarm. There is a little covered terrace with chairs, a table and a hammock as well as light and electricity sockets. They also provide a small kitchen (not so clean) with a fridge and cooking stove for use. A big green meadow offers enough space for lots of tents and there is no hight restriction for big rigs. WiFi works well. He asked for COP 10‘000 pp/pn, only recently opened up the business.

Location: Filandia, Fría, Quindío, 634001, Colombia
Name: Tuk Tuk Restaurante Bar
Description: Beautiful view. The prices were on the high side (Mains cost 25,000 to 30,000), although the service was excellent. We had the Pad Thai, lots of chicken and shrimp on it, but very saucy and little or no spice. The ingredients seemed very fresh, including the tamarind.

Location: Huitaca hostel, 20HL01_2, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, 418060, Colombia
Name: Hostel Huitaca
Description: Finca / Hostel Huitaca  A organic coffee Finca . Only a 10 minute walk to San Agustin. Very quiet and you can get meals here. I got a beautiful room over looking the farm with private bath and a great porch for 30,000

Location: Rodadero, Calle 11A, Peñon del Rodadero, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470005, Colombia
Name: Bunsizanisi
Description:
Excellent hotel with nice view on the sea. Recently open (1 year), nice room with air conditionning and very clean swimming pool. We paid 60$ for 4 people (2 adults and 2 kids) with breakfast. Possibility to use kitchen to cook. 
Info@bunsizani.com
Tel: +573008494109

Location: Portal de Cerritos, Pereira, Risaralda, 660007, Colombia
Name: Carulla
Description: Big Carulla Supermarket with international stuft. And a Parkinglot!

Location: Nahuali, Sendero ecológico, Com. Negra Sapzurro, Acandí, Darién, Chocó, 278017, Colombia
Name: Sapzurro to Turbo
Description:
Contact Mario - he can sort out getting you and your bike from Sapzurro to Turbo or vice versa. The price is far too much but it was the only option I could find. $150 for motorcycle and $25 for you. It’s a Cargo boat that leaves every Monday or Tuesday early in the AM. I ended up having to pay an additional $40 to the crew for going in between boats to get to the dock at Turbo. They wouldn’t take my bike off the boat until I paid. Make sure you have enough money before arriving in Sapzurro, no ATM’s available and you want to spend as little time in Turbo as possible. 

This location is also Mario’s La Posada and campground, nice grassy place for camping right on the beach with new bathrooms and showers. Can park bike right next to your tent. 

Mario
+57 310 4102245

Location: Vereda Guásimo, Angostura, Norte, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Ferny Logging Road
Description:
Rare wild camping opportunity in Columbia.  

The spot is pretty basic and is just a small turnout off a quiet logging road, but there is no one around and it's in the woods.  We camped right in the turnout and were very happy, but from here another small steep road leads down the hill 100m to a very pretty, secluded spot.  It was wet when we were here so decided not to risk it in our 2wd Sprinter, but if you had 4wd it would be no problem.  Recommend that you walk it first.  

There is some road noise from the main highway but it's not too obtrusive.  From what we saw this small road is used for pretty much only for logging.  All traffic was large trucks or motos, no buses or people walking.  Friendly waves all around.  No traffic at night.  Big rigs might have some trouble maneuvering in the tight area and finding a level spot.  

We've found that there are not many true wild camping spots in Colombia so we were excited to find this place.  We ended up staying two nights to get some chores done on the van.

Location: 0-57, Carrera 1, UPZ La Candelaria, Localidad La Candelaria, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 111711, Colombia
Name: Sayta
Description:
This lovely little hostel was our home for over a month. We bought our car in Bogotá and converted it in front of the hostel.
Jon has been the most amazing host, friend and supporter. Without him Bogotá wouldn't have been the same. He has a beautiful heart and loves to help and make people laugh. 
Breakfast is included and you are invited to help yourself to coffee the whole day. 

The double room is 60.000COP, try to get the one upstairs, it's much nicer. 
There are secure parking lots all around that cost 12.000COP for 12h during the night.

Give Jon a hug from us, we miss him a lot!

Location: Cra. 9 #70-2 a 70-98, Bogotá, Colombia
Name: Brot
Description:
Oh, how we miss their almond croissants!

The bread however was not worth the money.

Location: Memory Corp, Calle 18, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Fontibón, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 110931, Colombia
Name: DIJIN
Description:
This is the place to get the car you are interested in checked by Interpol if it has any criminal record. 
During the week there is a small bus in front of it where you can pay the cost. Otherwise you have to go to a certain bank (unfortunately forgot which one) to pay the cost there. Of cause there is not a single one close by. So better pay the slightly higher price and safe the time.

Location: Carrera 3C, Aeromar, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470006, Colombia
Name: La Rayuela Hostal y Cabaña
Description:
Country hostal with 4 rooms with a/c and space for 6 cars. It is 5 minutes from airport, 10 minutes from rodadero. Kitchen, Laundry and a small pool. we want you to feel at home here. Camping area for $ 8 a person , enough space for caravans and motorcycles

tel 3106401965 or 3054399212
.....

Es un hostal campestre que queda a 5 minutoss del aeropuerto, 10 del rodadero y 30 de santa marta. Contamos con habitaciones con aire acondicionado, cocina, lavanderia, parqueadero privado y una refrescante piscina, zona de camping. Especial para viajeros con carros, motos y bicicletas por solo $ 30 mil pesos por persona. Ayudamos  a viajeros con problemas en autos

Location: San Antero, Costanera, Córdoba, Colombia
Name: Julios Place
Description: Private big nice huts close to the beach with 2 bedrooms, bathroom and kitchen for 40.000 pP. Julio is very nice and likes guests very much.

Location: Cl. 32 #9A-16, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Calypso - Material for wrapping bycile for the boats
Description:
FOR CYCLISTS!!
If you go on a boat and you are searching for a plastic to wrap your bycicle - this is the place to go! You can buy it on meters in different sizes and strenght types :)

Location: Carrera 20 Sur, Comuna 9 - Picaleña, Perímetro Urbano Ibagué, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, 730006, Colombia
Name: Motorysa - Mercedes Freightliner Workshop
Description: Had been here with our Mercedes Atego. Friendly, helpful guys. Had some small things to repair. They can order original Mercedes Parts.

Location: Calle 34, Cádiz, Comuna 10 - Estadio, Perímetro Urbano Ibagué, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, 730002, Colombia
Name: seguros del estado
Description: easy fast and organized. go here to renew vehicle insurance.

Location: Coliceo Cubierto, Carrera 6, GRANJA IE TECNICA DE MONGUI, Monguí, Sagamuxi, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Free grassy space in front of gym. Police approved
Description:
Grassy space in front of a gymnasium. Very muddy in rainy season, but could sped one night with our 21 feet rig.
No amenities, but quiet for a night. The only place to stay in Mongui.

Petit terrain en herbe devant une salle de basket . une  petite partie plate. 
Une nuit passée ici sans soucis. Je pense que c'est public, sans certitude.
Gros camping car ok.

Location: Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Free wild camp - great view
Description: We did not sleep here, but stoped for a lunch break. In our opinion this is the best place on this road. There is a place for one car to park next to a road. Only infrastructure is a nice bench to enjoy the view.

Location: Calle 15, Bosconia, Cesar, 201020, Colombia
Name: Hotel Casa Vieja
Description:
Probably the nicest room we’ve stayed in the entire trip, but you wouldn’t know it from the outside. AC, fast wifi, flatscreen, super clean, great shower (cold)/ bathroom and secure parking that will fit larger rigs (maybe not bus size). 40000 for a room for 2.

There is no sign outside, just a big black gate. Knock loudly or ring the bell. The owner’s name is Alfredo. If heading south, turn right before La Piña restaurant (which has typical set plate meals for 10000).

update 2023: its 60k now, you can ask for 50k

Location: Nueva Granada (Granada), Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Truck Stop
Description: We didn't stay here but big truck stop with a nice restaurant. Plenty of parking spots.  No shade.

Location: Unnamed Road, Barichara, Santander, Colombia
Name: Zuasinca Hostal Campestre
Description: Established country hostel, 1.5Km from the main town of Barichara. Great place to stay, lovely hosts (Stella & Carlos). Four ample cabañas with own bathroom and availability of shower/bathroom for overland guests. Stella is a fabulous cook! Cost of meals is reasonable and delicious. $25,000 COP per night for vehicles. Large enough to park a couple of medium to large size rigs.

Location: Pino hostel, cabins, and camping, Subida San Pedro Claver, La Pola, Santa Fe de Antioquia, Occidente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Las Cabañas de Pino
Description:
We didn’t mean to stay 4 nights but this place is an oasis! We did not camp but it is available for 15,000 cop per person per night (edit: price is 25000). Grassy shady area for one maybe 2 vehicles, probably not appropriate for bigger rigs. There are bathrooms and showers and a kitchen you can use. Just outside of town but a quick walk to centro, maybe 10 minutes. Víctor Manuel is very nice and you may be able to negotiate price. We stayed in a nice cabana for 40,000 cop per person, it had a comfortable bed and a kitchen. Very tranquil at night! The pool is divine. 
———-
Access: 
from road 62 take the northernmost street in Santa Fe by the sports field. Don’t drive through the town as GPS might tell you coming from south. 
Big rigs: 
no problem at all for our Iveco daily 6,30 m long, no height restriction. In our opinion even a 8 m rig or longer would fit here. There is almost no restriction despite the area is occupied by other cars.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Motorcycle Ferry
Description:
*Motorcycles only.
.....
10000 for 2 people and one bike. Small boat, ok for big adv bike like 1200gs. Very easy. 

After the boat (going from Villavieja to Aipe), it will only be a small camino, crossing 3 very small bridges, 1 river crossing and riding in the middle of the field with the cows...enjoy !!

Location: Casa Abril, Calle del Quero, San Diego, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 472000, Colombia
Name: Makako Chillout Hostel
Description: Nice mellow hostel ran by two young local women. Really good location near restaurants and cafes. Space to squeeze in two motorcycles behind the locked front door.  Dorms $13

Location: Hotel Madre Laura, 8-61, Carrera 7, Jericó, Cabecera Municipal Jericó, Jericó, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056010, Colombia
Name: Hotel Madre Laura
Description: New Hotel. 35.000 for single (large bed) room with private bathroom. Breakfast included. Nice room. 5 min. Walk from the plaza. Safe underground parking for motorcycles and cars. Amazing hot shower.

Location: Banco Agrario, Calle 4, Guaca, García Rovira, Santander, Colombia
Name: Guaca parque principal
Description: Very good for overnight. We got permission from police station and parked in front of the Church. It is quite at night. Police station is nearby and the town is safe. Little shops, restaurants around. Restroom in small hotel-restaurant for 500 COP.

Location: I. E DEL SUR, Carrera 2, Centenario, Ipiales, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, 524060, Colombia
Name: Good and cheap welder
Description:
We had a problem with bumper on our Mercedes motorhome. This welder (Soldador in Spanish) was fast and helpfull. He can not speak English and he do not accept credit cards, but he helps us and price was really cheap, only 10.000 pesos for his work. 
He closed his garage on lunch time.

Location: Hotel 47, 45-47, Calle 47, Colón, Comuna 10 - La Candelaria, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050015, Colombia
Name: Hotel 47
Description: Suuuuper fancy hotel with rooftop bar, best showers ever and superclean and comfortable rooms. We paid 17€, about 25 USdollar, for a super luxurious room including breakfast (2 persons, via booking.com). Metro station in short walking distance. They have secured parking for rigs up to about 2.40m high, and there's several parking lots for bigger rigs further in the street. They even have rooms with private jacuzzi's... looked very nice. Highly recommended!

Location: Cra. 5 #32, Neiva, Huila, Colombia
Name: La casa del Amortiguador
Description: New shock absorbers !!! free review and installation !! Cra. 5 No. 1a - 94 neiva - huila ws 314 421 85 79 Tel. 860 04 57 narlyg@hotmail.es

Location: La Francesa, 5-54, Carrera 6, Puente Nacional, Vélez, Santander, Colombia
Name: Villa del puente real
Description:
A nice moderne hotel.
clean big rooms, just downtown with a safe parking. 
rooms for two around 50 000 pesos

Location: Estación de Bomberos, Calle 6, Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631027, Colombia
Name: hostal Bonaire
Description:
As we were in Salento during  « Semana Santa », all the good places on iOverlander were full.
We found this little hostal in the house of the owners. Very friendly, free and very good expresso all day long. We had a double room for 50000.
No parking but I managed to put my Vstrom 650 without the luggage inside the little garden. I think you can put up to 3 motorcycle inside.
Very calm, clean and peaceful place, 5mn by foot from the center.
Hot shower, fast WiFi.

Location: Bacco trattoria, Calle del Quero, San Diego, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 472000, Colombia
Name: Girasoles vegetarian menu
Description: Vegetarian meal of the day for 12.900. This includes soup, meal and juice. They accept cards and also have a wifi.

Location: TELE PUNTO COM, Calle de San Andrés, Getsemaní, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 472000, Colombia
Name: Blue Sailing veleros
Description:
Para viajar a Panamá, por las Islas San Blas, en velero. 
El trato con el cliente no es el mejor pero pudimos contratar un buen servicio, cuesta 550 dólares por persona, bastante caro pero el servicio en el barco es de los Mejores. 
El viaje dura 5 días, 2 de navegación en mar abierto y 3 paseando por distintas islas de San Blas. 
Viajamos en el velero Koala Sailing, con el capitán Fabián Arcila, excelente viaje. Comida de primera, el trato en el barco es de los mejores, las islas son fabulosas y la tripulación está al servicio de lo que necesites.

Location: Ocaña - Cucuta, Rancho Grande, Abrego, Occidente, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: Donna Josefa
Description:
Qute Little Hotel with a huge Parking, the food is excellent and inexpensive. Use of toilets and showers. Direkt on the river als for bathing.
They asked for no fee...

Location: 60, San Luis, Oriente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Restaurant with a view
Description: Not sure about the name of this family run restaurant, but they have delicious food and fresh juices. Perfect stop for lunch on your way to Medellín.

Location: Terpel, Ruta del Sol, Aguachica, Gamarra, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Terpel 24h
Description: Heading north on Route 45 (which is a good highway) there was this surprise: a top modern Terpel with reasonable fuel prices and ample concrete parking outside of any visible settlement. 24h shop & A/C Bistro with free Wifi, food and coffee (rather expensive). Friendly staff. Modern & clean bathroom including free showers. Overnight stay in a rig should be possible, even in front of illuminated bistro, however we do not know if they have a safety guard during nighttime.

Location: Unnamed Road, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Los Hermanos Hostel
Description: Another Hostel on the beach. We stayed on the estacionamiento for 20 pppn. Nice place but it ran off water twice. There is a very nice hostel next to it, Las Brisas but don't know if you can overland.

Location: Calle 9, Norcasia, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, 175001, Colombia
Name: Hostal La Casita de Anny
Description: cheap and nice place to stay, 15.000 COP per person per night, with garage for cars and motorcycles. tv, fast Wi-Fi and for the price, the place is nice.

Location: Lost Inn, San Gil - Tabor - Curiti - Paloblanca, San Gil, Curití, Guanentá, Santander, 684037, Colombia
Name: La Hacienda San Gil
Description:
Cool hostel about 4 miles outside of town with great views of San Gil and surrounding mountains. Right now being ran by Jane, a British woman who is very friendly. There’s a huge concrete slab in front of the hostel where rigs can park and set up camp. Can set up a tent on the grass as well. Nice and clean facilities inside, hot showers, big kitchen, good WiFi. Road up here is a little sketchy on motorcycle if muddy but not a huge problem. Highly recommended.

Dorms: 20,000 COP
Family style Dinner: 35,000 COP

Jane’s # 
tel:+447930367781

Location: 12:12, 4-16, Calle 67, UPZs Localidad Chapinero, Localidad Chapinero, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 110231, Colombia
Name: El Khalifa
Description: Very nice restaurant that serves food from the Middle East. It's delicious and a good change if you're a bit tired of rice. Price range from 17'000 to 30'000 COP.

Location: Carrera 21, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520003, Colombia
Name: vet
Description: 20,000 for exit certificate. very thorough check but fast and easy

Location: Casería El Chapetón, Macaravita, San Mateo, Norte, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Parking lot.
Description: There is a free parking lot at the riverside of the road. You can park 50 meters away. No traffic so it is quiet. The sound of the river only. The spot is big enough for any size of the rig. A very friendly family lives next to spot. You can use their facilities for a donation.

Location: Panamericana, CHAPAL, Comuna 5, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520003, Colombia
Name: lubricentro do merdardo
Description: fast easy oil change big bays for large trucks. right on main road. wide selection of oils

Location: Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056050, Colombia
Name: Ecoexplora
Description:
Small local run hospedaje with large secure grass field area for camping.  Not sure it has an official name, but it’s next door to the Canto de Agua backpackers Hostel.  Asked for 25,000pp (20,000 pp Feb 2025)

The owner is friendly, but pretty hands off.  The bathrooms were kept somewhat clean and the very cold showers very refreshing.  Couple of nice dogs on the premises that seemed ok with the dogs of other guests.  There is a kitchen in a small covered area but only had running water, a wood stove and power (didn’t use).  Didn’t seem super functional.  Free plántanos available.  This would be a great place for big rigs.  

We were really happy with this spot, and would recommend it.  It’s an easy, 1km, walk to town.  Nice area and reasonably quiet.  You have a nice view on to a field of peppers and bananas.  Rosters are a bit bad but your in Colombia, get used to it.

Location: Cra. 27, Manizales, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Residencias Universidad de Caldas
Description: Close to the Palo Grande stadium, the University of Caldas male residencies. You can park, ask permission to a student to use the bathroom and kitchen.

Location: 40VL11, Calima, Centro, Valle del Cauca, 760530, Colombia
Name: Pescao Kite Surf (+Hotel+Tourist attraction)
Description: Great place to stop and kitesurf. They also provide accommodation (rooms 100,000 COP pn for 2 including breakfast, tents inside 30,000 COP).  We spoke with Pescao and stayed about 250m up the road in our van, very secure and right on the waterfront. Kiting here is 20,000COP per day, they have a boat so very safe (rescues are 20,000 COP). Also provide breakfast and lunch - best cooked trout we’d had and allow use of kitchen in the evening (just ask). Great place. Everyone really friendly. You can rent equipment or take lessons. Contact 311 352 3293 or find them on www.pescaokitesurf.com.

Location: Calle 24, San Bernardo, Comuna 16 - Belén, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050024, Colombia
Name: Lubricantes la 24
Description:
This is a very good place to change oil and filters. They also sell many things for the car. 
The people here was very nice with us and they helped us a lot.

Location: Urb. La Española, Torices, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130001, Colombia
Name: Miguel's Casa Espanola
Description:
Great apartment-like accommodations in a clean, secure, gated neighborhood. 15 minute walk to old town, 10 minute walk to Castle and mall. Paid 200,000 COP for 3 nights ($23/night) in private room with a/c, private bathroom, shared kitchen & living area with tv & good wifi.  He also has dorm/hostal accommodations for less is new remodeled building. Miguel is great host, speaks English and will help with directions/maps/suggested day trips/food/shopping, etc. Contact him via WhatsApp.     
+57 315 7496032

Location: Cl. 37 #18c Bis-3 a 18c Bis-79, Cartagena, Bolívar, Colombia

Garage for motorcycle and car. Wifi very good. 136 000 COP per double room with TV. Beer cold and at a good price. Very good breakfast included.

Location: Darcy Hospedaje, Carrera 2, Natagaima, Sur, Tolima, Colombia

Location: Carrera 3, Urbanizacion Villa Laura, San Mateo, Norte, Boyacá, 151201, Colombia

And a nice free breakfast and a great social room on the top floor w darts and games. Hot and powerful showers. Has a restaurant opening soon. Location: T-shirt lab, Avenida Carrera 11, UPZs Localidad Chapinero, Localidad Chapinero, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 110221, Colombia
Name: French Embassy
Description:
My passport has been robbed so I went to the embassy to do an emergency passport. Here is what you have to do:

1) Ask via the embassy website an appointment  (not possible to book it directly by phone or at the embassy)

2) Bring with you a copy of the stolen passport, a new photo, the police complaint for the robbery, a proof of address, some cash (you have to pay the equivalent of 45euros in COP for an emergency passport, for a regular passport it's 96euros). Last thing you have to bring is your travel itinerary with a copy of the flight Colombia -> France. In our case we were leaving the country by car so we brought nothing. It was not a problem.

30min later we were out with our emergency passport! Really efficient.

Location: St vendor /arepas, Avenida Carrera 30, Parque Américas, UPZs Localidad Puente Aranda, Localidad Puente Aranda, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 111611, Colombia
Name: jumbo supermarket

Location: Los Naranjos, Guatapé, Oriente, Antioquia, 053854, Colombia
Name: Guatape
Description:
**This is a temporary spot before we start construction on a new house.** WhatsApp me at +56 9 5664 1729 the day of or day before you want to arrive. 

Space for 2 vehicles to park on private land about 10 min from the village. There are 14 acres to roam around with lake access and amazing views. You’re welcome to pitch a tent anywhere on the property - there are several great spots. You can also use a roof tent or big rig. 

There is a house on the property - if it is rented, camping will not be permitted. However - you are welcome to use the downstairs bathroom (recently remodeled) with electricity and a hot shower. There is also a charcoal grill that can be used. 

I’m not doing this for money - but I ask 30,000 cop for Sonia the housekeeper to grant you access to the property and clean the bathroom. There will be satellite WiFi - however it is expensive. Mobile phones work well. 

If you would like to stay in the house, I will offer it at $50 a night to overlanders only. We paid $100 a night when staying and have furnished it to a higher standard since. Feel free to book direct or ask and I’ll send a special offer. 

https://abnb.me/zwdM5maIqM

Once completion of the bigger house is done we will be opening the property up to more overlanders.

Location: 23, Planeta Rica, San Jorge, Córdoba, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Rancho Santana
Description: Restaurant with good Angus steak. We had dinner at the recommendation of a local and asked if we could spend the night in the parking lot. Open style restaurant and washroom is available all night. Police will also circle through restaurant parking lot during night and that is normal.

the decoration of the restaurant is great and already worth a visit.
seperate parking area across the road: parking is 7.000cop (weekend night probably 14.000cop) and they allowed us to stay overnight. free fast wifi, toiletts.

Location: Vía San Agustin, San Agustín, Huila, Colombia
Name: Camping La Cumbre Del Macizo
Description:
"The Camping “La Cumbre del Macizo” is a very nice place, located very close to the different tourist sites of the archaeological zone of San Agustín. It is only 800 meters from the urban center of the small town and 1400 meters from the Archaeological Park. This beautiful and cozy place, ideal for Overlanders by car (motorhome), motorcycle or bicycle, offers you everything so that you can enjoy the greatest comfort during your stays in San Agustín, it consists of a large green area for parking and camping, native forest, WIFI, bathrooms, showers hot water, campfire area with free firewood, fully equipped kitchen for free use (spectacular), parking for small, medium and large camper platforms, very comfortable rooms with private bathroom, excellent service from its owners. COP $40,000 per vehicle (2024). Location phone number +57 3204780261

Additionally, you can hire ATV (quad bikes) tours on horses or in vans to the tourist sites of San Agustín such as La Chaquira, La Pelota, El Purutal, Magdalena Strait, Alto de las Piedras Park, Alto de los Ídolos Park, Salto del Mortiño, Isnos
Very steep road but there is a small detour from Altos de Yerbabuena restaurant.

Location: Monkeys in the trees, Calle de la Media Luna, Getsemaní, La Matuna, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 472000, Colombia
Name: Sloths&Monkeys - Parque el Centenario
Description:
We walked through this parc several times until a friend told us, that there are sloths and monkeys living there.
We returned and indeed, there are 2 3-toed-sloths (one even had a baby) and cotton-top tamarins living in this relatively small parc! You might need some time to find them, because nobody seems to care about them. But if you find them, many locals will join you in taking pictures and selfies... ;) There are also many iguanas there.
Not sure how the animals got there and actually we felt pretty sad for them. We assume they have been pets and released there. If you have not seen them in the wild, this is a good spot to see them...

Location: Las Cabañas, Panamericana, Chachagüí, Centro, Nariño, Colombia

Description:
a nice hostel in chachagui with a wonderful family with 3 kids. they invited us for coffee, made us try their colada. we felt at home. we paid 25000 for a matrimonial. there is a swimming pool too. wifi is working fine. showers are cold. there is a large inner court where bikes can be stored. 
the village is located 1.3 km further when going to Popayan.

Location: Colombia
Name: Mistica Hostel at Isla Palma
Description:

Very private. We stayed at hostel that is very nice for a couple of nights after shipping our van back to US from Cartagena. It was less expensive to rent car from airport than public transit but we did have about 25,000 COP in tolls getting here that we had forgotten about but no big thing. Private zoo at hostel with cayman, flamingos, deer, parrots etc. Also lots of wildlife on island.

Location: Via Valdivia - Puerto Valdivia, Valdivia, Norte, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: K’Piros Hotel & Restaurant
Description:
Trucker restaurant and hotel facing the mountains. 20,000 COP for a room with double bed. Rooms are clean and quiet enough given that there are often trucks outside. Cold water but it’s not cold enough here to really need hot water. The owner is a really nice guy named Edilberto but only speaks Spanish. There’s no internet but if you have data on your phone there’s service up here. Llanteria next door so you can get some repairs done while you eat.  

There’s a watchman at night so it’s safe to park both for big rigs and bikes. Everyone around is very friendly.

Description: Huge truck service, very knowledgeable professional. Authorized service of IVECO, CASE, INTERNATIONAL, but they can do ANY TRUCK. With their facilities it seems there is nothing they can’t do. They open @ 07:45. Suggest arriving early, so you can have priority.

--

Description: A great little hostel/hotel in San Agustin. 50000 for a double with private bathroom, good WiFi and hot water! Nice balcony to sit on and roof terrace. He owner can also arrange a jeep tour of the sights as well as horse riding trip if you want it!

Location: Guaimaro Campsite, Barichara - Guane, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Camping Guaimaro
Description:
Camping Guaimaro is nestled on a privately owned secluded plateau, just a 10-minute drive away from Barichara and surrounded by panoramic mountain views. Its location is convenient to unwind and to explore the area, with a direct trail to Barichara (35 min.) and another one nearby to Guane (1,5 hours). It´s a place for people who seek nature and tranquility, with plenty of flat space so you can find yourself a nice spot.

After traveling the world, we converted the finca´s old tobacco farmhouse and started several sustainable and regenerative projects. On our site, we have municipal water, free Internet access, a BBQ-fire pit and electricity (110/220). Furthermore, there are solar-heated outdoor showers, a kitchen/communal area, a washing machine (incl. soap nuts) and we also offer freshly baked bread, beer and homemade jam. Please note that toilets with chemicals cannot be emptied here. We speak your language.

Camping: 25.000 pesos pp/pn (from 12 years of age onward). Children 4-11 years old 12.000 pesos and children up to 3 years old are free of charge. Electrical connection to RV 10.000 pesos pn. Tuk-tuk’s between campsite and Barichara COP 9.000. There is no height restriction. WhatsApp/Phone: +57 3124901654 / +57 3108565180

Location: Che Parcero, Carrera 5, Dibulla, La Guajira, 446009, Colombia

Description:
Really nice restaurant with great pizzapans and Argentinian empanadas (from the oven). We didn’t try the empanadas (yet) but the pizzapans were really tasty! And a very good price, 11.000 for a pizzapan and juice (9.000 for only te pizzapan). They also have coffee and some sweets (pie & cookies), but we didn’t try those.
Also, their WiFi connection is good and quite fast.

Location: Calle 16, Girardot, Alto Magdalena, Cundinamarca, 252432, Colombia
Name: Hotel tropical  Girardot

Name: Casa Marques del Pedregal
Description: really nice place, 6 rooms(double bed per room/bath), nice kitchen, roof top pool (a must), good ac & good wifi. we paid $125,000pesos per night but got a discount cause we stayed longer due to an issue with shipping our motos. Cartagena is expensive but this place is worth it. Carulla grocery store is 12min walk, secure parking is 5min walk, old town in 10min walk. can find on booking.com

Location: Buenavista, Calle 29A, Urbanizacion Nevada, Localidad 1 Cultural Tayrona - San Pedro Alejandrino, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470001, Colombia
Name: Buena Vista Shopping Mall
Description:
shopping mall and big parking area. high restriction 4 meter, 2.50 wide. 
not allowed to stay overnight.

Location: Calle 33, Lo Amador, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130001, Colombia
Name: Adolfredo Zuñiga & Hijos
Description:
Our experience isn't really good but I'll try to remain objective because I don't think the place is actually bad. Our RV (7.3 idi diesel) suddenly had a bad rod and crankshaft, big deal. Luckily, the parts were available from Bogotá, still it took a week to reach. Then they worked slowly on rebuilding the engine (about a week) and re-mounting it(almost a week as well). Then a new problem appeared : a deep cloud of blue smoke coming from the exhaust and other less critical problems too.
One week, the issue isn't yet solved and I decided to leave to Barranquilla at a workshop where they're specialised in diesel.
They're not bad, they're coastal... Their style of working doesn't have any standard, still they are capable to fix plenty of things, but I would avoid expecting big issues to be fixed smoothly here, so be careful. Best is go to Barranquilla that seems to have a much better reputation than cartagena for mechanics.

Location: Troncal Central, Pescadero, Piedecuesta, Santander, 681011, Colombia
Name: Side road. Freshen up.
Description: Uneven place next to the river. If you need a wash or a rest next to a river, this is a good stop. Didn’t camp here but sure you can if needed.

Location: Agustín Codazzi, Cesar, 202050, Colombia
Name: Truckers Hotel
Description: Simple Hotel, basic, a/c and cold shower. Paid 30k for a double room. Parking safe but outside.

Location: Pedregal, Imués, La Sabana, Nariño, Colombia
Name: El Balcon Hotel
Description: Reasonable mid range hotel. Room clean and spacious. Rooms at back are quiet- front rooms might get some road noise. Only cold water in shower but ok. Fan in room but no A/C. Good secure parking inside courtyard with plenty of room for bikes through to mid size campers but big rigs might struggle to get in. Price 30,000 for double with own shower no breakfast.

Location: Pizza Neckarsulm, Calle 6, Villa Holanda, Mariquita, Norte, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Hotel Neckarsulm
Description: Great place with pool and restaurant in the middle of Mariquita. The hotel is run by a lovely couple that too great care of me during my stay. Secure parking inside the premises. Not on Booking.com. Paid 30’000 with ventilator for myself and motorcycle (free parking). 50’000 for 2. Quiet at night.

Location: Manaure, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Playa Mayaco
Description: Camped for free at Alcides Rodriguez’s spot. He said it was free, just pay if we ate or drank something next day. Very cool and friendly. Some kids came around asking for money, but overall extremely safe and quiet.

Location: Carrera 14A, El Altico, Comuna Centro, Perímetro Urbano Neiva, Neiva, Norte, Huila, 410400, Colombia
Name: Veterinarian El Bosque
Description:
Before we cross the border to Ecuador we went here to get a health certificate/export certificate. 
The vet was super friendly, but didn’t speak English. The certificate costs 50.000 COP

Location: Buenavista, Capital, Quindío, 632060, Colombia
Name: Gran mirador hotel
Description:
we paid 75k for a double room including breakfast, owner also made us dinner for 10k each.

very steep road up to hotel, slick in the rain with height restriction but there is a place to park outside of his gate, town is very peaceful

m/c's and smaller rigs will fit, loads of parking space

Location: Palacio de Justicia, Calle 9, San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, 684031, Colombia
Name: Químicos (Alcohol)
Description: Looks a little like a perfume store but it's a chemist who sells 96% alcohol. Right on the corner of Carrera 10 & Calle 9. 5000COP for 500ml. Think they'll fill your own container if you have one, otherwise they have bottles.

Location: 90, El Totumo, Necoclí, Urabá, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Petromil
Description:
A good and safe place. Had a nice chat with a trucker and was very safe and silent. Bathrooms are clean and have toilet paper and soap. Has a hotel as well, but apparently 50.000 p.p. 
Guess you could put up your tent here as well, it has a big grass field.

Location: Zona Franca Palmaseca, Palmira, Sur, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Aviation museum - Museo aero fenix
Description: Museum with nice collection of planes and helicopters. Open from 8am - 4pm. Sundays 9 - 4pm. 20000COP for adults.

Location: El Paso, Cesar, Colombia
Name: El Mister
Description:
We made a mistake turning on our inverter with the fridge connected on power and automatic mode AND the battery 110 volts charger too! It resulted in a fire in the battery compartment (living cell) and some short circuit in the engine starter. These people came to take down the starter and fix it, all in 2 hours. Now they're changing all my burnt cables in the battery compartment, with the hope that the inverter isn't dead.
They claim to be handling electrical, scanner, all brands, air conditioning, general mechanics. Very friendly and helpful, no boasting like other places.

Location: El Paso, Cesar, Colombia
Name: As Altos de Salomé
Description:
Very nice hotel with cheap restaurant and great swimming pool. Little pricey at 100k for a double (large) bedroom but worth it.
There's an auto wash right next door.

Location: La Loma de Calenturas, El Paso, Cesar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Lavado de Autos
Description:
Huge fenced and guarded parking lot across the street. Ask at Lavado Autos, they didn't ask anything yet we gave 5000 to the watchman. Very friendly people. Big nice swimming pool across the street at 12000 per head, restaurant too.
The town is surrounded by 3 important coal mines. For that, it's packed with mechanical workshops. We dealt with 3 of them, all were friendly helpful and cheap. Nice place.

Location: Rincón del Mar, San Onofre, Morrosquillo, Sucre, 707017, Colombia
Name: Manuel’s House
Description:
Manuel’s house and parking is down the street where cars can’t pass anymore. He takes care of your car and can offer different tours. He is really friendly and gave us food and chatted about cock-fighting. There’s a basic toilet and shower. It was by donation. We traded stuff with him. Very safe genuine vibe in the village.

Manuel asked me to deliver this message. Parking is paid 20,000 pesos for 24 hours. because there are many travelers who left without paying

Location: Jamundí, Sur, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Rio Claro
Description: large picnic/rec area with caretaker . little noise from the road but  safe and free next to the river with the wildlife . Few overnight  options on this road south to the Panam avoiding the tolls

Location: Carrera 52, Camino Real - Joaquín Borrero Sinisterra, Comuna 19, Perímetro Urbano Santiago de Cali, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, 760040, Colombia
Name: Dog Park #2
Description: After checking out the 'closed' dead end road on IO, parked in this green park, quiet, safe. free, and nobody to aggravate  as it's a public space. gated houses around some with watchmen.

Location: Carrera 16, Belalcázar, Comuna 9, Perímetro Urbano Santiago de Cali, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, 760044, Colombia
Name: repuesto city
Description: all the parts you will ever need are here

Location: Esso, Panamericana, Comuna 5, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520003, Colombia
Name: Mister Pollo
Description:
In the large parking lot of the restaurant Míster Pollo. After asking permission from the administrator, it is safe, spacious, bathrooms in the restaurant. Good attention. Wifi and plug to charge devices in the restaurant 24 hours

 mister pollo is located in the same rute but 15 minutes after. At the end of Pasto (to Popayan)

Location: Bakery, Calle 4, Paicol, Occidente, Huila, Colombia
Name: Ecoturistars Paicol
Description: Paicol is a really beautiful and peaceful town and there are lots of things to see! They've got a great cave Caja del Agua. You need to go there with a guide and they give you all equipment. Just talk to Jeison or his team at Ecotiristars at the main square (Just in front of the church). It takes around 1,5 hr and costs 25mil pp. There is also a cool waterfall where you can do rappelling. Locals are really friendly nd they would love to see some foreign tourists in their town. They told us about some camping areas as well. Just talk to Jeison, he will help you with everything! They dont speak English but are really patient so basic Spanish is enough! Dont miss this place and have fun! :)

Location: El Paso, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Taller Llantera Luna
Description: General mechanic, works mainly on trucks. Fixed a leak we had with the transmission cooler in no time and cheap.

Location: Carrera 10, Comuna 4 - Occidental, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680006, Colombia
Name: Almacén y taller
Description: Bikes parts and repair all brands. Just passed by and found it cool that they advertise Moto Guzzi. Didn't need their services though, so check it out.

Location: Calle 22B, Localidad 2 Histórica - Rodrigo de Bastidas, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470001, Colombia
Name: la casa del agua
Description: here you can refill bottles at a 24 hour kiosk at just at the back corner of the terpel station. $3k for 19L jug. only accepts 1k coins

Location: 60, Las Quinchas, Otanche, Occidente, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: top of mountain camping
Description: Great location with with amazing views when its not foggy. there is water, electricity, cover, and flat spots for any size rig. military showed here to walk the area but were very nice and helped with areas to visit.

Location: Pijao, Cordillerana, Quindío, 632060, Colombia
Name: Finca Villa Gloria (Don Leo)
Description:
There is another entry for Don Leo that I think is incorrect. We asked around and everybody said this is the real Don Leo. Indeed he is a really great guy and has a wonderful coffee farm. 

He has a seperate structure where one can stay for 100,000 or you can camp in your vehicle for free if you take the tour. they gave us free breakfast and lunch with the tour too, which was 20k, so awesome awesome value! His number 316 718 5598. email: cafedonleo01@gmail.com 

highly recommended!!!

Location: Carrera 5, Puerto Boyacá, Occidente, Boyacá, 155201, Colombia
Name: Hotel Palaguas
Description: hotel with a pool--it was 99.5F when we rolled in! matrimonial for 80,000 but we negotiated to 70,000. good wi-fi, nice rooms, very clean, exceptionally friendly staff. there is also a YMCA office here and they do swim classes. a little more than we usually spend, but it was well worth it. really good food nearby, or they have a restaurant.

Location: Calle 64A, UPZ Los Alcázares, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 111221, Colombia
Name: serviamortiguadores
Description:
family business specialized in suspensions and shock absorbers. they changed the two shock absorbers found in Colombia for Fiat, Peugeot, Citroen ...

Solutions for all brands

very friendly

Location: Super Mercado Mercaldas Centro, Carrera 22 Bolívar, Pasaje Comercial Bancafe, Comuna Cumanday, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, 170001, Colombia
Name: Moto gears & parts
Description:
There are a lot of motorbike gears and parts in this area. If you need refresh your stuff, good to come here and have a look, many choices 
*ex: new Michelin Anakee iii: 140/80 R 17, under USD 180

Location: Viñedo Ain Karim, Vía a Moniquirá, Sutamarchán, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 153860, Colombia
Name: Marques de Villa de Leyva
Description: Vineyard and winery. two options for tour and tasting. the "valor" option gets you a guided tour and two tastings (red, 2oz. each) with cherries and chocolate for 22,000 pesos. we did this, but if you've been to a winery/vineyard before and know how wine is produced, skip it and go straight to the bodega. for the same price, you can get 2 full glasses of wine and sit in the courtyard enjoying the day. the second tour/tasting option involves more tastings and more food. sorry, don't remember the price. winemaking is new to Colombia, relatively speaking--the tour guide was very knowledgeable about the winery, and wine science. tour was completely in Spanish. they also sell cheeses and meats in the bodega, and vineyard is in a beautiful setting.

Location: Salto El Mortiño, San Agustín to Popayan, Villa Del Prado, Isnos, Sur, Huila, Colombia
Name: Salto El Mortiño
Description:
We came just to see the waterfall, but it was so nice and they offered dinner and camping. 10,000 for 2 in our camper. 

Entry only is 3000 pp.

Location: Museo del Oro Quimbaya, Avenida Bolívar, Urbanización La Mariela, Comuna Quimbaya, Perímetro Urbano Armenia, Armenia, Capital, Quindío, 632001, Colombia
Name: Museo del Oro
Description: FREE small museum with local gold artifacts and jewelry  some info in English .Secure parking. Banos. Not possible to overnight park

Location: Carlos Lleras Restrepo, Carrera 5, Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631020, Colombia
Name: la Sauces
Description: secure parking 24hr and able to sleep in the car for 10k. toilets and Coffee shop on site for breakfast ..quieter /cheaper/and less exposed  than rip off restaurant called MERIKA ...no entry height restrictions

Location: San Sebastián del Pastelillo Fort, Calle 24, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130001, Colombia
Name: Marina Club de Pesca de Cartagena
Description:
We got our propane bottle filled at the marina. We have a green German 11 kg bottle with US adapter. We asked the guard at Marina Club de Pesca and he arranged it. He called to a company who fills gas bottles, we had to leave our bottle there and the next day he returned it to us full. price for 5 kg propane (11 kg bottle in total) 40.000 pesos. They were very friendly and helpful, even though we didn't have a boat. 

To reach the place first you have to enter the wall, you first reach a large parking lot, walk to the end, at your right hand site there is the entrance to Marina Club de Pesca. Ask the guard.

Location: Carrera 42C, UPZ Quinta Paredes, Localidad Teusaquillo, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 111321, Colombia
Name: De Pelicula aparta
Description: Beautiful hotel. 156000 COP with breakfast over for a double room. Parking for motorcycles and small cars. Room with kitchenette, wifi, 50 m2, sauna and massage, excellent location in a safe area. Excellent beds, good service.

Location: Hacerpan, Carrera 3, El Encanto, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Techo de Paja helping travelers
Description:
It's an economic restaurant in the centre of the Encano`s village, at 5 minutes to the Lake La Cocha. The owners Carol and Andres are really lovely people. They really want to help travelers. They can help to find cheap acomodations and job too. They cook really good and cheap meals and they also help to have spiritual and ancestral anwers like to know in which places and with which people meet to have a healing experience.

Es un lugar economico en el centro del pueblo del Encano a 5 minutos de la laguna La Cocha. Los dueños Carol y Andres son personas muy amables. Ellos quieren ayudar a los viajeros. Ayudan a encontrar acomodaciones economicas o por voluntariado ecologico y tambien ayudan a encontrar lo que haga falta. Cocinan platos ricos y economicos. Tambien ayudan a encontrar las personas y los lugares justos adonde tener experiencias de sanacion ancestral.

Location: Hotel Palma Real, 20-5, Transversal 52A, El Bosque, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130001, Colombia
Name: Hotel Palma Real
Description:
A great family owned and operated hotel close to ports, shipping offices, and other related businesses. 15 minute taxi to central for 5,000 pesos. Carlos the owner speaks English and was very helpful and friendly. 
Hotel is quiet and very clean with secure parking for motos or cars. I paid 40,000 pesos for nice room with private bath, AC, and fast wifi. Highly recommended.

Location: Banco de occidente, Carrera 9, El Modelo, Comuna 1, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, 190002, Colombia
Name: la maison du croissant
Description:
excellent French bakery. you'll find what you're looking for: chocolate bread, croissant, apple slippers, crispy baguette ... and succulent quiches or ham croissants. A real treat !

excellente boulangerie française. vous trouverez votre bonheur : pain au chocolat, croissant, chaussons au pomme, baguette croustillante... et de succulentes quiches ou croissants au jambon. Un vrai régal !

Location: Estacion de policia, 19-24, Carrera 9, Zapatoca, Metropolitana, Santander, 604069, Colombia
Name: Ambrozia
Description:
The best place to lunch in zapatoca.
Friendly Zapatoca Owner, coffe, cacao and other delicious treats
The owner, Guillermo, is one the living history of the Zapatoca Region, full of knowledge about it.

Location: Calle 60, San Pedro y Libertad, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130002, Colombia
Name: Posada Cartagena Historica
Description: Great place a little outside of the old city center (40 minutes walk or 10 minutes taxi). Only a couple of rooms, with shared bathroom, a kitchen and fridge, and a small outside area. Owners are really nice. You can park in front of the posada. Not a secured parking but we felt pretty comfortable leave the truck out there. Great AC in the room!! Very fast WiFi. 10 dollars a night.

Location: Cabañas el Nevado, vía al Nevado, Güicán, Gutiérrez, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Posada Sierra Nevada
Description:
Beautiful location just below Knwara.  Old hacienda that is being revitalized.  Plenty of flat parking.  Toilet and hot shower.  we did not use the shower, yet they told us it was hot water.  Right at the trailhead for the hike. 
Be sure to get all of your permits, insurance and guide taken care of in Guican or El Cocuy BEFORE you come all the way up here.  Be aware that you must have a permit, insurance and a guide if you want to hike the trails. If you plan on doing more than one hike, secure everything you need in one of the two towns as they are an hour away on dirt track.  No need for 4x4 but road is a bit rough.

Location: Cajamarca, Centro, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Ruta 40 old road from new Viaduct
Description:
follow the old Road below the new Viaduct park out of sight  and only in this location as there are alot of landslips I explained to the great family in the only house on the road my intentions to sleep they advised me to move here#
NOTE Temporary road closure on 16th for the National Ruta to Toche then onto Salento as they are grading it

Location: Carrera 6, Alvarado, Centro, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Terpel Griffo
Description:
large flat area with toilets grass lawn and trees looking over mountain range 

night stop possible

Location: 60, Otanche, Occidente, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: rough road camp
Description: huge gravel levelled parking that you can hide from the road great view

Location: Tres Chorros, Carrera 3, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, Colombia
Name: Waterfall 3 Chorros
Description: Nice waterfall with 3 parallel veils in the jungle. It is a good two hour walk here (one way) from the signpost on the road. The first hour is on a dirt track which would also be possible to drive, it's just a bit bumpy and muddy. Then you have to cross a few cow gutters. After about 1.5 h there is a sign to go to the right. From there it's basically across the field. The signage is not very good, but as long as you don't see another sign, just go straight. There will be an old stable on top of a hill with an arrow painted on the wall, and finally a run down house which says 3 Chorros 2.500. From that house, a path leads another 20 min down into the jungle to the falls.

Location: Calle 11, Localidad 2 Histórica - Rodrigo de Bastidas, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470002, Colombia
Name: harbour parking
Description: a military surplus with bottle Camping Gaz Marylate street

Location: Finca la reserva, Filandia, Ulloa, Fría, Quindío, 634001, Colombia
Name: Finca La Playa Verde
Description:
It is with pleasure that we welcome you to our beautiful organic coffee finca for a "coffee tour", a tasting of our artisanal French cheeses, breads, brioches etc, or simply drink a coffee and talk about travel.
Do not hesitate to contact us and remember to book 2 days before for:

N'hésitez pas à nous contacter et pensez à réserver 2 jours avant pour:
