Location: Hostel Colina de Lluvia, 5-15, Carrera 4, Horizontes, Filandia, Fría, Quindío, 634001, Colombia
Name: Colina de Lluvia
Description: Great hostel, super friendly people, they let us use the shower only for 3000 COP. Hot water, clean bathroom, great experience.

Location: Margarita, Depresión Momposina, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Secured Parking lot Hotel Mompox Real
Description: Secure shaded parking lot.  We were able to get in with a Dodge Ram 3500 long box with a pop up camper (we are 2.2 metres wide, height is approx. 2.6 metres),but taller rigs would also fit.  8000 COP per 24 hours.  We stayed in a basic hotel room there as well, that they are in the process of developing, for 60,000 COP per night, with air conditioning and TV, wifi to come.  Owner Tico was very helpful.  The lot is guarded until 11pm, when they lock the gates but if you are out late, there is a bell to ring to gain entrance.

Location: Calle 35, La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, 055060, Colombia
Name: Steet parking
Description: Parking on the street without nothing special , but here there is more life than the another side of the town . A lot of street food ,not the better but cheap. And there is a very fast wifi connexion . The people are very nice

Location: Solar Hotel, Calle 5, Barrio Floriam, Pamplona, Suroccidente, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: El Solar
Description:
We went to stay here and they wanted 130,000 COP which seems really excessive for a Colombian small town.

There is a large parking lot that could fit anything, but no lighting and seemed very insecure

We are on two motorcycles and found a better place right on the main plaza

Location: Arte Moderno Ramirez Villamizar, Calle 5, Pamplona, Suroccidente, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel Ursua
Description:
This is a large colonial hotel with just a double doorway to the street, inside its HUGE.

We got a room, that had 5 beds in it for 50,000COP, good wifi and warm water

We are on two motorcycles and they let us put them inside, way in the back, if you are on a big bike with hard boxes you will have to remove them, it's a tight fit.

There is secure parking within a few minutes in all directions if you have anything but a motorcycles

Location: Carrera 8, Mogotes, Guanentá, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel Don Corzo
Description:
Right on the main square, pretty little friendly town, we are on two motorcycles and they let us ride them inside thru the front door, there is enough space for maybe 20 motorcycles inside

Warm water and average wifi, 45,000COP for a double that had 3 beds in the room

Location: Hostel, Calle 23, Taganga, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470001, Colombia
Name: Oasis ApartaHotel Taganga
Description: Not actually targeting Overlander, but a good location if you look for a place to stay in Taganga, near St. Marta. Somewhat outside and above of village, but only 20min walking to center and beach. Lots of diving centers and boats to nearby beaches & Tayrona NP. Camera surveillance of free parking lot with no hight restriction behind the house. Small, very personal hotel in a quiet,  safe part of the village. Nice pool, shared terrace with lovely views, large modern ensuite rooms with A/C and little kitchenette. Comfortable beds and clean room/bathroom. Stable WiFi and delicious breakfast included. Laundry service at additional, but reasonable price. And the best: Elisa 🇸🇪 & Arturo 🇨🇴 are terrific hosts: helpful above standard and make you feel welcome and comfortable. Check for a good deal on a booking engine or contact them by e-mail for an offer: apartahoteloasis@gmail.com

Location: Calle 5, Pailitas, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Hotel Sueño Real
Description: Another cheap hotel option in this lively little town. This one has WiFi (in/near reception area), although perhaps they all do now. Very small room with fan and cold shower: 20k.

Location: Calle 5, Tangua, Centro, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Yellow building hotel
Description: Good option if you are staying in Tangua. We had a matrimonial with Shared bathroom, hot shower, Nice view from the room for 20k (for 2 pers) we could let our bicycles in the hall, safe. The wifi only works downstairs so you have to stay in the stairs, and is slow... but still a good hotel in the center of the Town ! Probably better option than the hotel at fuel station...

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Deicer hotel
Description:
Nice hotel with a little swimming pool. Nice owners and very clean. Room matrimonial with fan 50k
Good option in villavieja

Location: Frisby, Calle 10, El Poblado, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050020, Colombia
Name: Casa 10 hostel
Description: Very Nice and clean hostel ! It is new, only opened one week ago. Dorm bed is 35k in 4 beds room, or private room for 2 is 90k. Best hot shower we had in south America !!! Very good location and friendly owner. There is a kitchen with all necessary, free coffee. Nice patio to chill... hightly recommanded !

Location: Via Llanos de Cuiba - Yarumal, Vereda El Respaldo, Yarumal, Norte, Antioquia, 052030, Colombia
Name: Las Mirlas
Description: Restaurant and Hotel. I paid 18.000 Pesos for a single room and was allowed to store my bicycle inside the restaurant for the night. The owners are really nice. Rooms are clean. The only drawback is that there is no WiFi and only poor cell service (Claro).

Location: Hotel Ventura, Autopista a Piedecuesta, Floridablanca, Metropolitana, Santander, 681004, Colombia
Name: Hotel Ventura
Description: Very nice and new hotel.  Rooms are huge and very comfortable.  shower is amazing.  plenty of space to park any size vehicle.  secure parking underground for smaller rigs, motorcycles or bicycles.  plenty of room inside the rooms for a couple of bicycles as well.  the owner has lived and traveled all over the world and speaks many languages.  staff is extremely attentive and professional.  three restaurants attached that are all good quality and consistent.  solid place to stay in this area.

Location: Sendero a "La Ponderosa Reserve", Buritaca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: El Rio
Description:
Listed as best hostel in Colombia from Hostel World. 

follow the dirt road from the main road to the end. 

really nice place along the river. Dorms, Private rooms, hammocks, and tents. 

Secure parking inside the compound. Big rigs might have to park just outside, but super secure. 

No electricity for rigs. 
Electricity for dorms and rooms.
No wifi, but 4g 

restaurant, bar, river tours. tubing. 

hammocks 25000
beds in dorms 35-45000
privates 130-200000

Location: La ruta del sol, Troncal del Magdalena Medio - Puerto Nare - Puerto Araujo, Cimitarra, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel-Restaurant Ruta del Sol
Description: Clean, air-con, no WiFi. The shower was quite warm, but they may just have been sun on the pipes/tank! Not the cheapest - 40 000 for a single ensuite room - but (for cyclists) it's the first hotel southbound from the 45/62 junction.

Location: Carrera 2, Santa Cruz de Mompos, Santa Cruz de Mompóx, Depresión Momposina, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Hotel Cacique
Description: nice and clean hotel with friendly owners, private rooms with airco and TV for only 30,000 pesos, safe parking for vehicles of any size, walking distance to the center and shops and restaurants nearby

Location: Carrera 7B, Santa Ana, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: hotel ricksort
Description: nice and clean family-run Hotel with private air-conditioned rooms for 35000 a night, motorcycle parking can be arranged if you ask nicely

Location: Palmetto Sunset, Carrera 1, El Laguito, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130018, Colombia
Name: Laundry at Cristoforo Colombo Building
Description: 4K a Kilo. Good, low price compared to others. Delivers same day in the afternoon. If you are at the Laguito is just around the corner

Location: Panamericana, Ipiales, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Hotel San Juan
Description: Very nice hostel in the village of San Huan. Parking in front of the hotel or in the backyard. Bicycles in the Room, A double Bed room for 30,000 pesos . HOT SHOWER!!!!

Location: Carrera 10A, Chinú, Sabanas, Córdoba, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero Good
Description:
Truck stop with hotel, allowed us to park with our roof top tent, cook and even gave us water from a faucet to take an outside improvised shower. Charged us 3K to park and spent 2K extra on each beer. Friendly staff! Good spot to spend the night, next to the road but not too noisy.

Of course, rooms also available at a range from 15 to 30K

Location: Hotel Restaurante Nazareth, Panamericana, El Hueco, Taminango, La Cordillera, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Hotel and Restaurant Nazareth
Description: Decent budget hotel on the way to Pasto. 25,000 for one bed .35,000’for twin room with private bathroom. Cold shower, WiFi. Rooms big and clean (we fit both our bikes in the room). There is a restaurant next door open 7am-9pm. Dinner 15,000pp; breakfast was same as dinner. Very cheap place and not bad! As of June 2024

Location: Vía Gualanday - Ibague, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Autopista parking service
Description:
Nothing special here ,just a parking service of highway . Loud place but safe and free , good if you have nothing . Toilet  and water , you ask the nice guard if you want refill your water tank of Rv.

aire d'autoroute ,rien de spécial ici . toilettes , eau . Possibilité de remplir reservoir d'eau du camping .
Parking sécurisé par guardes .
Bruyant mais gratis . 
Bien pour dépanner si arrivé tardive .

Location: La Melissa, Vía Guarinocito - La Dorada, Cabecera Municipal La Dorada, La Dorada, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, 253480, Colombia
Name: Hotel La Melissa
Description: Motel, restaurant, garage and tyre repair place on the edge of town. Quite busy/noisy. 28000 for single with fan, air con for 60000. There is WiFi, but Claro signal here is good so I didn't ask for the password.

Location: Guataqui - Cambao, La Popa, Beltrán, Magdalena Centro, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Restaurant y Estadero "El Mirador"
Description: Roadside cafe/restaurant that has rooms available upstairs. 40k for one person with AC, unsure of couple costs. Typical plancha for 15k from the restaurant. Average rooms but it’ll do the job for the night. Has a swimming pool but it’s more of an 'arrive late, leave early' type of place.

Location: Biomax, Carrera 10, Santander, Girardot, Alto Magdalena, Cundinamarca, 252432, Colombia
Name: Lalavaseco
Description:
Washing machines, dry cleaning and steam cleaning.
Very expensive for normal washing: 3500 per underwear/pair of socks, 4000 per pair of shorts/t-shirt!
But, the only place I could find.

Location: Barandillas, Zipaquirá, Sabana Centro, Cundinamarca, 271015, Colombia
Name: El Refugio La Loma
Description:
Nice place for stay on the parking lot or in the chalet of Camila. Please contact her before, because there is a gate. Mobile Phone: +57 313 4225982. Also via WhatsApp.

The place is 30 km in the north of Bogota. Very calm and peaceful. There is a 1 km way after the gate until reaching the parking area. We stayed there for a home visit for 4 weeks. There is a parking lot for approx. 4-6 vehicles. The gate was ok for us (9,5 m long). Very secure and quiet. Full nature in the middle of green hills, nice garden and flower farms.

The price for long term stay is between 200.000 and 300.000 COP a month depending on the size of the vehicle. One night is around 20.000 COP per person.

Camila rent her house also. This is very beautiful. And she is so nice and lovely.

Location: Pedregal, Imués, La Sabana, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Hotel and Restaurant Casa Blanca
Description: Hotel and restaurant in Pedregal. 25,000 - 30,000pn for double room with private bathroom. Cold water. WiFi wasn’t working. We had a room at the back so was quiet. They let us keep our bikes on the balcony. Breakfast for 10,000pp.

Location: Carrera 13, Maraya, El Jardín, Perimetro Urbano Pereira, Pereira, Risaralda, 160001, Colombia
Name: Sura
Description: We were able to easily get a one month extension of our SOAT here.  We needed to show our temporary import document.

Location: Socorro - Simacota, Socorro, El Socorro, Comunera, Santander, 683561, Colombia
Name: El Saman
Description:
Great overnight spot at restaurant closed to street, however relatively quiet due to wall between the lot and the street. Large flat parking lot. Great steak restaurant with own family cattle business. They ensure the quality "from the farm to the table".

We had one of the best meat in South America. The side dishes are great, too. Especially the different sauces. The service is very good as well. One of the owner Ricardo is very nice and helpful.

Location: Eco Andes, Vía Santa Marta, Dibulla, La Guajira, 446009, Colombia
Name: oasis hostal
Description: Great place to stay if u want to sleep in room.Only one space for smaler van or u can park opposite in gas stacion. super friendly owners help with anythink u need. we paid 20 or25 with breackfast very nice. Good wibes....

Location: 45, Pradera de Lourdes, Aipe, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hotel Las Palmas
Description: Nice motel. Relatively quiet. Good WiFi, clean rooms. 25000 for single room. Happy for me to bring bicycle into the room "so long as I didn't mark the white walls"!

Location: Bulevar Santander, Comuna 3 - San Francisco, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680006, Colombia
Name: huge parts store Ford, Mazda, Motorcraft
Description: Huge parts store, branded Ford but got others too.

Location: Carrera 15, Comuna 3 - San Francisco, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680006, Colombia
Name: Chevroford parts store
Description: You can try that one if you need parts for your Chevrolet or Ford. They got me new pistons and all the other engine parts I needed to fix my IDI 7.3 1994.

Location: Retenes y Balineras, 13-02, Calle 24, Comuna 4 - Occidental, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680006, Colombia
Name: Vesga Asociados Ltd a / have your engine rebuilt!
Description:
I couldn't believe my eyes when I saw that! My crankshaft being rebuilt here in Colombia, as well as the entire engine. For peanuts...
If you gotta go through this, then I believe Bucaramanga is the right place people here are serious and extremely professional.

Location: Calle 31, Comuna 4 - Occidental, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680006, Colombia
Name: Principal Motors & cia. Ltda
Description: It's a rather big and well equipped workshop, yet with simple, honest and very competent people. It was recommended on my request by a Ford parts dealer in Bogotá (Henry in Henford), and I'm so happy I found this gem! The owner, Diego Andres is quite a talent, very competent and almost maniac in checking all the details. He's definitely customer-oriented, he made sure that our truck is totally fine before hitting the road again. Besides, Bucaramanga is THE right place to fix a vehicle, it's got thousands of parts stores and specialists for everything and anything. We got our International 7.3 IDI diesel engine fully rebuilt; even the crankshaft was fixed in a specialised workshop (see separate entry I made). Totally amazing what these guys are capable of, and for a fraction of the price it would cost in the west. Best of all is total transparency on the costs and at no time felt being cheated, almost the opposite I would say, because even after spending much more time than planned (2.5 weeks), Diego hardly charged me more. We camped inside the workshop most of this time, there's WiFi, basic toilets and a shower, it's very quiet at night. Contact him in advance if you can, his excellent reputation keeps him quite busy. Phone + WhatsApp : +573124107853.

Location: Hotel y Restaurante, Calle 29 Vía Principal San Onofre, San José, San Onofre, Morrosquillo, Sucre, Colombia
Name: Hotel y restaurant San Onofre
Description:
I took a fan room for 1 person whit tv, toilet, its clean and safe, i paid 20'000 Col
It was space for my bike in the room.
It give rooms whit AC.
No WIFI, Open 24, it give à parking whit à gate. Friendly staff
Restaurant : Beer 2'500 Aguila
Soup Chicken whit rice 5'000
The big meal 12'000

Location: Texaco, Carrera 20, BARRIO CENTRO, Barrio La Cantaleta, Cáceres, Bajo Cauca, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Cheap hotel near fuel station
Description:
I paid 15'000 CoP. for a fan room for 1 person, whit TV, bathroom, clean, friendly staff. It was space for my bike in the room. I think no WIFI
AC 22'000 CoP.

Location: Esso, Panamericana, Chachagüí, Centro, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Hotel Oro Negro
Description: Near Eso station, i paid 20'000 cop for 1 night, 1 person, room is nice, clean, tv, wifi, Privat bathroom. It give a restaurant.

Location: Calle 2, Gigante, Centro, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hotel Casa Quinta
Description: Nice, clean and friendly hotel. 50k for single room with fan, 70k with air con. Secure parking for bikes and motos. Kitchen if you want to cook. Impressed for a highway stop over town

Location: Villa hermosa Tayrona, Vía Santa Marta - Riohacha, Vda. Los Naranjos, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Villa Hermosa Tayrona
Description:
Nice little Campground, next to the River. Space for Tents and campervans. Big rigs fit in the upper parking lot. Small restaurant. Toilets and shower are basic but clean. Nice cool off in the shallow river. Very quiet at night. Nicely done with wooden tables. Space is clean and well kept.

We didn't have many Moskitos around. Now 30k a night (for 2 people).

Location: El Playón, Metropolitana, Santander, Colombia
Name: Motarllantas Engrasa
Description:
Truckstop, Car wash, Restaurant, Hotel, Workshop.
Parking lot, were allowed to park there for the night. 
Car wash is 15000 COP for a camper.
Have toilets, and a guard.

Location: Calle 34, Fundadores, Comuna Cumanday, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, 170006, Colombia
Name: Cajas Automáticas Direcciones Hidráulicas
Description: Workshop specialised in automatic transmission. Gonna report once job is done. If possible, plan in advance they're busy.

Location: 62, Puerto Berrío, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Buomax
Description:
This has been entered as a restaurant but more importantly it's a good night stop Usual truck stop .. space behind trucks on the grass has the best spot
 Security wanted paying at 6am he gave up after 2 times of no reply IT FREE!  
 came here from a bad decision of staying at the river front in Puerto Berro very few spots on this road

Location: San Safael-San Roque, Alejandría, Oriente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Road from San Roque to San Rafael
Description:
on a road junction flat elivated grassy position with seat shelter VERY quiet at night and safe No much traffic here and patrolled by dam security.
road is rough as hell from San Roque to here ground clearance needed 4x4 would be handy.avoid when wet  low range gears used most of the way to here.
but simply the best vistas

Location: Turismo Mompos - boat tour 25kCOP, Carrera 1, Santa Cruz de Mompos, Santa Cruz de Mompóx, Depresión Momposina, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Boattour
Description: Great tour on the river and into the side arms of the river. You can see a lot of birds and iguanas. You can also have a swim in a lagoon, quite clean. Really nice and worth. 30,000 COP per person for 3 hours. 3 h p.m.

Location: Hotel Ecoturistico El Edén, Carrera 2A, Güicán, Gutiérrez, Boyacá, 151440, Colombia
Name: Hotel El Eden
Description: Nice hotel for 25000 pp. They have a small restaurant with good local plates. Wifi works good and the room was comfortable. Parking for motorcycles in the courtyard.

Location: Socotá, Valderrama, Boyacá, 151620, Colombia
Name: Hotel Gomez
Description: Basic hotel in the middle of town. 15000 cop per person. Secure parking for motorcycles, 1 or 2 small vehicles could fit too. Warm showers and slow wifi.

Location: Variante Condina, AMCO, Area Metropolitana Centro Occidente, Pereira, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Puerto Chuleta
Description:
Nice restaurant with good quality food. They let me camp on their yard for 10.000 Pesos. Including a warm
Shower

Location: El Copey, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Es La Ye showers
Description: fuel station with showers! he just ask money for the coke...

Location: RESTO RODRIGO😎CABO DE VELA, Vía Cabo de la Vela, Uribia, La Guajira, 440029, Colombia
Name: Analaüli Restaurant & Hospedaje
Description:
Neat little restaurant and hospedaje with a huge fenced parking lot. Super friendly owner. The parking lot would be suitable for big rigs but getting around the tight corner at the entrance gate might be a challenge. Give it a try, turning around is not a  problem. Toilets with buckets are available and bucket showers cost COP 2.000.
We paid COP 10.000 for our car and 2 people. Another group here paid COP 20.000 for their car and 4 people.

How to get there: drive through Cabo towards Punta Gallinas and it is the very last place in town on the right hand side.

Bonus: Excellent restaurant.

Location: Pedregal, Imués, La Sabana, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Hotel Moros
Description: Hotel with ground floor access. Indoor courtyard for secure bicycle storage and possibly motorbikes (although might be a squeeze with panniers through the corridor from the street. 30k for a single room, ICE cold SHOWER! WIFI SLOW.

Location: Drogueria Farma Luz, Calle 15, UPZ La Sabana, Localidad Los Mártires, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 111411, Colombia
Name: Alex Patiño
Description: Alex very warm person and the most important very good mechanic, helped me alot with my DR650 (which he have as as well). He got some parts if you need.. can handle with Kawasaki and BMW as well. Fair prices.

Location: Uribia, La Guajira, 440029, Colombia
Name: Lo del Toro
Description: El Toro can help with basic mechanics and request a crane if necessary. We spent the night with him while we waited for the crane, he only asked for a collaboration since the problem could not be solved. Very good people.

Location: Carrera 3, Taminango, La Cordillera, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Plaza del caffe
Description:
We stay here one night with our rv. It was safe for us and calm. There is game and football and basketball ground . The local say 's ok to stay here...
There is water(no potable) front of the football ground.

Location: City Bank, Carrera 27, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130001, Colombia
Name: Citibank - to pay the extra Seaboard bill
Description:

Description:

It may cost a bit more than other places (we paid 120,000 each for our cleanings, but they start at 80,000), but the care we received was worth the price, plus they were able to fit us in on short notice. My husband is English, and he said this was the best cleaning he ever had. 

We were so pleased with our cleanings that we also had gum graft surgery done here! Dr Castro did an excellent job, and did her best to fit us in for checkups as she knew we were traveling.

Call Adriana for an appointment: +57 4 2686922 or Whatsapp: +57 300 310 8193
You can also search for "International Smiles" on Google or Facebook.

Location: Bello, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 051053, Colombia
Name: Gases de Antioquia
Description:
Fill our fixed American propane tank. 

We stopped by here because we were desperate. Like most places in Colombia, they don't let you enter the factory. So we waited outside for the tankers that fill the big commercial tanks. They are called "carrotanques". The engineer and other factory workers didn't think that the carrotanque hose would fit, but when the carrotanque driver arrived, he looked at our tank and said no problem. He filled 13 kg for 50,000. 

So if you are passing by here, ask when the "carrotanques" will return from their daily route. I'm including the picture of the official receipt for the refill so you can show them if they are confused.

Location: Calle 73A, UPZs Localidad Engativá, Localidad Engativá, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 111031, Colombia
Name: Rolando’s camper conversion workshop
Description:
Needed some work done on my van (interior work and extra security measures). Rolando has a nice sized workshop where the van can be parked inside to work on. Rolando has his own carpentry company, but he loves working on campervans (he’s done a real nice complete build-in too, he showed me the pictures). I thought he would only be able to do carpentry work, but he does welding too. He helped me out installing extra locks and we went shopping together for parts and he helped me get deals on a car alarm and speakers. I parked my van in the street and slept in it.

It is definitely located further out of the city, but the parts around there are cheaper, and it’s still easy to access. Neighbourhood seemed safe to me.

All in all, I’m posting this message because I was so happy with how much work he did for how little money. And he is a genuine and friendly guy who really thinks along with what you want.

You will discover the Coca medicinal, cultural and spiritual.

Location: Calle 5, El Palo, Caloto, Norte, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Dangerous area
Description:
****WARNING FOR COLOMBIA SE of CALI, today 8/16/2018***

Avoid the area 3.05626, -76.34743

We were stopped this afternoon by the military at this waypoint, east of El Palo, on the road north of the river, we were riding west to east.

According to the military - Farc and the Cartels, joined forces setting off a car bomb about 10km east of this point and murdering two people. They are said to be targeting non-locals and richer looking people! They have stated they are not happy with the new President.

We tried to laugh it off telling the military we were told by local riders the area is safe...he then showed us photos of the bodies, bullet holes and all.

The Commandante stated the military or police cannot guarantee anyone's safety in this area - https://goo.gl/maps/PcYoDBfeEFJ2

Location: Sevilla, Nororiente, Valle del Cauca, 762547, Colombia
Name: Potential Theft Area
Description:
Just got a message from a fellow rider we were having a few beers with, in Filandia a few days ago, he asked me for a track with a little off road but cool views, so I gave him a 200km loop 50/50 around the Cacora Valley...he loved it.

So then he asks me for another heading south, I gave it to him, a route we had ridden just a few days before on one of our many loops in the area.

At this point https://goo.gl/maps/uhHdQvK5U3M2 this is approximately where he stalled in a rut and his meeting happened, two masked guys jumped out of the bushes when he stalled on an uphill climb. They were brandishing shotguns, and faces covered in T-shirts, wearing civvies (is how he described them) they told him to turn around, put their guns on the ground around and helped him point his bike in the opposite direction.

He WAS NOT robbed, just redirected, if he hadn't stalled they most likely would have never met...but again maybe an area to avoid right now. It is approximately 200km north of where my incident was today, so most likely totally unrelated.

When we rode that track we stopped to talk to guys with a logging company who are working the area and they told us it's all safe now, Farc has moved on so, who these guys were is anyone's guess.

Location: Hotel Tierra de Oro, Panamericana, EL LIMONAR, Santander de Quilichao, Norte, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Hotel Tierra de Oro
Description: These guys love bike and moto tourers but have plenty of space for big rigs in the forecourt too. For cyclists, they also own a little bike cafe if you need anything fixed or to do any maintenance. When they heard that I'd been robbed they took me out to dinner, gave me a nights accommodation for free and then drove me all the way to Popayan the next day. Seriously great people.

Location: Palestina, Sur, Huila, Colombia

Description: Well worth the little mission out here. This place is paradise. Fat fruit hanging from trees, organic dinners made with veggies picked from the garden. An incredibly kind and welcoming three generations of a family living here. Far from the constant din of engines, only birdsong, the river and the occasional bleating of the one sheep that lives on the property. Probably a struggle to get to it in a big rig but bike, motos and 4wd should make the effort for sure!

Location: Dibulla, La Guajira, 446009, Colombia

Description:

However most of the kitchen ware was either broken or dirty. On top of that the stove was out of gaz and he couldn’t be bothered replacing it, we should use the communal kitchen... Only after we insisted the guy at the front desk could be bothered to replace the gas. The WiFi did only work at the reception and even there it was slow as f... 
the only thing that this place has going for it is that it’s quite and a good ac. 

I am sure Taganga has other, nicer places than this one. Don’t bother coming here. I am also pretty sure that all the 10/10 point reviews in booking.com are fakes.

coffee and cacao farm. 25.000 p/p each tour. the area is beautiful and we really recommend the cacao tour. it is more than an hour walking from town to here or you can come in motor bike (15000p/p).
--
finca de café y cacao. 25.000 p/p cada Tour. el área es muy linda y recomendamos el Tour de cacao en el que podės degustar. es una hora o más caminando desde el pueblo hasta aquí. también se puede venir en moto por un costo de 15.000 p/p

Location: Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Hôtel villa mandalas
Description: Very clean hôtel. Very Nice staff. Rooms are very clean modern. All is perfect in this place. Breakfast inclued. No expensive. Parking secure no far

Location: Restaurante Monserrate, Vía Tunja - Moniquirá, Arcabuco, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154102, Colombia
Name: The Blue Hotel
Description: Brandnew, not properly cleaned up yet. On the 62, therefore very noisy. Everything is done on the cheap: the electric shower is still working , though. 30000 for a double room with private bathroom.Very slow WiFi in room. Friendly staff. Restaurant not recommended. You could park on their big car park but it would be very noisy. Didn’t ask their price for sleeping in the car.

Location: Jardín de Rocas, Calle 9; Santander, Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056050, Colombia
Name: Jardín de Rocas
Description: Amazing. Pay 15000 pesos per adult and saw so many Andes Cock-of-the-Rock.  (As cool to us as the Quetzal.) Walk down from city from 3-6 pm, or early early morning (only high season). In low season they are opened from 3.30-6PM. You can whatsapp them via the website found on Google maps.

Location: Donde Luchy, Vía a Neguanje, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Middle Entrance to Tayrona
Description:
Minimum of 100k for one person on a moto, 6k/person for insurance, 5k+ for parking with prices increasing from there. Road is in very poor condition.

Beach (average) at the end, the only thing down here to visit, is private property and charges 5k/moto and 15k/car. Has a restaurant with overpriced food. 

Not worth it unless you’re here for hiking which is all at the western entrance.

Reports of campervans not being allowed but the beach at the end is private property and I’d expect them to happily take your money, they’re definitely trying every other option they have. They asked questions about my camp gear at the western entrance but not here.

Location: La balsa, Chía, Sabana Centro, Cundinamarca, 250001, Colombia
Name: Huge grocery store Sabana Norte
Description: Big grocery store. Has an international section for all those foods you've been missing from home! Big outside parking lot with no roof.

Location: Ipiales, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, 524060, Colombia
Name: lavanderia burbujas
Description: Small laundry ran by Daniela who was a very lovely lady. Dropped our clothes off in the afternoon and collected the next day at 10am Clothes were clean and folded well good service

Location: Convento Clausura de la Hermanas Concepcionistas, Calle 7; Infante, Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056050, Colombia
Name: Hotel Diana Campestre
Description: Simple hotel on edge of town. Friendly staff. 35,000 pesos per person. Secure parking right in front of hotel (no height restriction). Can walk to everything. Just a clean hotel room with cold shower but for the parking and staying in town we thought it was worth it. This spot also over looks the river and has swings and a pool table.

Location: Cafetal Gumer, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, 418060, Colombia
Name: Coffee Farm Don Gumer - Organic Coffee
Description: Here Don Gumer will show you around his beautiful finca de cafe, where he grows his organic coffee, dries it, and roast it using a really fun method (he'll show you) he is very friendly and his coffee is magnific! here you can buy coffee and have a good conversation about the product

Location: Agustiniano Coffee, Obando-San Agustín, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, 418060, Colombia
Name: Agustiniano Coffee
Description:
Ok, this place is amazing. Here you'll meet Doña Oliva, she is the owner and she lives here in her finca. She will show you for free how the coffee process works, so you will pick your coffee from the coffee trees, you'll clean it, she'll show you where to dry it and she'll make you roast your own coffee. After that you can buy the coffee that you made or other kinds. You can also taste different kinds of coffee here, with different roasting levels, which is amazing.
She owns an association of women who work with coffee and she is really friendly, definetely our highlight of San Agustin! If you are a coffee lover this is a MUST

Location: Venga Pues Mijo, Calle 4, Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631020, Colombia
Name: Polimetria Taller de Cerámica (Ceramic workshop)
Description:
Ceramic workshop run by a super friendly young local couple, where you can buy original ceramic pieces, and you can also do a one day workshop where you will create your own piece from the beginning! from filling the molds to applying the varnish, and at the end you'll take your own piece home! Highly recommended!
.
Taller de cerámica que organiza una pareja local super simpática, donde además de poder comprar unas piezas de cerámica realmente originales, puedes realizar un taller de un día donde crearás tu propia pieza de principio a fin! Desde el llenado de moldes a aplicar el barniz, y al final te llevas tú propia pieza a casa! Realmente recomendable!

Location: Jericó, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056010, Colombia
Name: Jerico, Antioquia
Description:
A traditional house (casa de campo) a warm welcome by Dona Isabel who will be very caring during your stay.
Cel. 313 791 6211

Finca Hotel Palmeras - Un paraiso a cinco minutos del parque principal por 50000 COP desayuno incluido (agua caliente, wifi, parqueadero...). Una vista espectacular.
Une maison traditionnelle (casa de campo) un accueil chaleureux de la par de Dona Isabel qui sera aux petits soins durant votre séjour.
Cel. 313 791 6211

Location: Carrera 6, Yotoco, Centro, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Yunnior
Description: Basic hotel with place for bicycles. Quite, clean. We asked if we could use the kitchen and they let us use it. 70.000p for room with two beds. Cold water. Swimming pool.

Location: Carrera 16, Comuna 3 - San Francisco, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680001, Colombia
Name: Diesel Especialistas
Description: An excellent place for Diesel problems and they also have different mechanics. Absolutely reliable and honest. They fixed my turbo fast and at a very reasonable price. Highly recommended

Location: Paso del Mango, Bonda, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Cocoa farm tour
Description:
Great cocoa tour, had great explanations, in Spanish but made an effort to speak slow and clearly. Made our own chocolate, saw the whole process, got a chocolate facial mask and a hot chocolate. 
Really recommend great place, very calm. 
Need high clearance to get here but can stop at the shop and walk up.
On the right, across the river when you are going up.
20000 per person.
Also have massages but didn’t try.

Location: Colón, Putumayo, Colombia
Name: Hot water tub and termales
Description: Feeling dirty? Stink? Feel newborn after a visit here. COP 7.000 pp for 30 min hot water tub. Not medical clean but ok. Very hot water. Termales next to the tubs, haven't been there.

Location: Electro gas S.A. E.S.P., Pereira, Risaralda, 660007, Colombia
Name: Electrogas
Description: Gas plant at the edge of the road. filled our 2kg Argentine bottle without problem. 10000cop. European bottle 28K for 5Kg. ..... Cargaron nuestro cilindro de gas de 3 kilos argentino, a las 12 del mediodía del sábado. Excelente atención y rapidez

Location: Urapán, Carrera 9, Primero de Febrero, Centro, Perimetro Urbano Pereira, Pereira, Risaralda, 160001, Colombia
Name: Parque del infierno
Description:
park with parking area and police checkpoint 24hs. Safe and quiet, family atmosphere, very friendly and helpful police.

parque con área de estacionamiento y garita de policia 24hs. seguro y tranquilo, ambiente familiar, la policía muy amable y servicial.

Location: Finca Versalles, Patía, Sur, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Finca Versalles
Description:
Very Nice finca. Very friendly staff with Eva and Jose. Many places. You can sleep un the finca for 30000 pp or in your car for 20000 pp. you can eat here or prépare your own food in the kitchen. there is a clean swimming pool. You can see the cows, ride horses, hike and go to the river. All is perfect. Hightly recommaded.  
Maria Isabel Recalde or Eva 
Whatsapp 3186605723. 
Cellulaire 3502487525

Turn off the road 25 in Patía, at (2.066408, -77.078536) turn right. From here the road is not in maps.me.

Location: Ciclorruta Palacé, Perpetuo Socorro, Comuna 10 - La Candelaria, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050015, Colombia
Name: Hércules
Description: Place to review and fix everything related to your tires. People extremely friendly and helpful. Fair price, great job!

Location: Calle 2, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154001, Colombia
Name: La Serviceta
Description: Basic service mechanic and car wash. Really nice people. Changed our oil and filter for 10000 cop

Location: Pila de Crespo, Calle 5, San Antonio, Comuna 3, Perímetro Urbano Santiago de Cali, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, 760044, Colombia
Name: Pixel Hostel
Description: Very cool, brand new  and clean Hostel with a unique dorm concept. 14.000pp for a dorm. Big common areas (also a cool platform outside), kitchen and fast WiFi. There is space for bicycles and parking is just next doors (cars 20k, motorhomes 50k). Super friendly staff as well. Good location in San Antonio.

Location: 25-168, Carrera 52, Santa Fé, Comuna 15 - Guayabal, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050021, Colombia
Name: Luxury Pits Motorcycle
Description:
Great motorcycle mechanics. I arrived in Medellín with my poor Triumph Tiger 800 well overdue a service. Looked for the local Triumph dealer only to find that they had pulled out of Colombia a couple of years back. 

However chatting to a local guy he told me that he knew where some of the ex Triumph mechanics had set their own workshop and even took me there. 

Andres and the team did an outstanding job on my bike. A full and professional service using top quality parts. Fantastic communication even sending regular photos of progress via WhatsApp.  The bike went in tired and filthy and came out in near showroom condition. 

If you need any work done on your bike in Medellín, go here and talk to Andres and Aracely. Thoroughly recommended.

Location: Calle 72, Localidad Norte - Centro Histórico, Perímetro Urbano Barranquilla, Barranquilla, Atlántico, 080002, Colombia
Name: Hotel El Prado
Description: Very nice, old Hotel with an enormous parking even for big Campers. Historical downtown near.

Location: Parqueadero Piedra de Bolivar, Piedra de Bolivar, El Crucero, Consacá, Occidente, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Roca de Simón Bolivar
Description: this is an open place that has the Simón Bolívar stone. We spend the night here, really quiet, although it was Saturday night, there were students drinking but they left at 10PM. Awesome place for spending a night!

Location: Hacerpan, Carrera 3, El Encanto, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Techo de Paja
Description: Awesome place to park. Outside of the "Techo de paja" restaurant. Its owners Carol and Andrés (Spanish speakers) are great and kind people really helpful with the travelers, we spend a couple of days here sharing with them. They borrow the bathroom, internet and have really cheap and tasty menus.

Location: Ruta del Cable 1 - Zapatoca - Minas - Raspaculos - Villanueva - San Gil - Los Santos Pueblo y La mesa con Barco, Villanueva, Guanentá, Santander, 684021, Colombia
Name: River camp
Description: We tried to take the back road north of Villanueva to Zapatoca. There is no bridge crossing Rio Suarez, so we camped just past the small mine workers shack.The road north of Villanueva is a sweet dirt road that leads down into the canyon, 4x4 or bike only, something with clearance. We drove our loaded adventure bike there and back. We saw the mine workers leave across the river via cable cart in the morning, but no one talked to us. I really doubt there would be any issues with camping this far off the beaten path.

Location: Clínica Chitaga, Troncal Central del Norte, Chitagá, Suroccidente, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: Los Alpes
Description: Nice clean hospedaje / restaurante. Double room with private bath and hot water was 30000cop. There was room in the front of the restaurant for our motorcycle. Other than that it’s street parking

Location: CAI Telecom, Avenida Carrera 13, UPZ Las Nieves, Localidad Santa Fé, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 110311, Colombia
Name: Hotel de Lujo
Description: Cheap hotel (35 k Col pesos pr night) with secure parking and private bahtrooms - very central location in Bogota.

Location: 17-60, Carrera 15, UPZs Localidad Los Mártires, Localidad Los Mártires, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 111411, Colombia
Name: Huge motorbike accerories marked
Description: Its a whole block of small motorbike accesories shops. There are literally hundreds of them. Helmets, jackets and pants, gloves, luggage, boots, raingear etc etc. Mostly chinese and colombian stuff but also some european stuff. Also a couple of coffeeshops and restaurants within the block.

Location: Carrera 16, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, 418060, Colombia
Name: La Casa De David
Description: A small and cheap hostel. 9-10 mil pesos per night. It has parking for a 3-4 motorcycles or one mesium sized car. unfortunately not suitable for most 4wheel Overland vehicles. Its walking distance from good eating joints. Pretty basic but at effectively $3 per person, can't really complain

Location: Protección, 10-62, Avenida Calle 82, UPZs Localidad Chapinero, Localidad Chapinero, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 110221, Colombia
Name: LavaArte - DO NOT USE
Description: This place is ridiculously overpriced for laundry. Find others on google about two blocks away.  Charged $25usd for a medium bag of regular wash/dry/fold.  You can do better.

Location: Hospedaje Villa del Sol, Vía San Andres, Inzá, Oriente, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Villa del Sol
Description:
Hostel and camping next to entrance of the park

Ran by sweet lady called Rosa. There is camping behind the house with enough space for multiple rigs, not easy to find a flat space, but I found one. 
Pay 10,000 for camping
For a room pay 20,000.

Use the kitchen (pay 5000 for gas), hot showers and nice place in general. No WiFi.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Piscilodo (mudbath and natural pool)
Description:
Super nice pool with a mud bath next to it and a nice opener!

They pump water out of the ground and let it flow into the pool. Great surroundings and beers for 3.500.

You can dip yourself in the mud bath, dry out and rinse yourself and feel like a silky smooth skin newborn baby!

Location: D1, Calle 16a, Magangué, Mojana, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Hotel Doña Cande
Description: We ended up in Magangué since we arrived too late to take the ferry. A local guy recommended us this place, because of the location and security aspects. Unfortunately we had to park the bike outside of the hotel, but the good thing is that the hotel is guarded by a fierce looking guy all night, so the owners promised us it should be fine. We paid 35000 pesos for a private room with fan (50000 with AC), descent and clean. 5-10 minutes drive to the ferry.

Location: Cancha, Entrada Cancha de futbol, Anzá, Occidente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Quebrada Anzá
Description:
Soccer field with good place in the shade where to park. There is a path that skirts the ravine in which there are two wells for swimming. There are two free municipal pools during the week. The place has a bathroom and shower. Super quiet and cute town. The weekend low many people to play ball and let sell without problem.
---
Cancha de fútbol con buen lugar a la sombra donde estacionar. Hay un sendero que bordea la quebrada en la cual hay dos pozos para nadar. Hay dos piletas municipales gratuitas durante la semana. El lugar cuenta con baño y ducha. Pueblo súper tranquilo y lindo. El fin de semana baja mucha gente a jugar a la pelota y dejan vender sin problema.

Location: Vía los Santos, Vda. La Peña, Los Santos, Metropolitana, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hostal mirador la Mojarra
Description:
Really nice Hostal/ Campground. Friendly owner, stayed there for one night in our car, paid 25000 for two persons. No height restrictions.

+57 3015369279

Location: Museo Histórico Policia, Calle 9, UPZs Localidad La Candelaria, Localidad La Candelaria, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 111711, Colombia
Name: National Police Museum
Description: Tours in English and Spanish at different times of day. Free. A few interesting artifacts. Nice people and good info.

Location: La Vitrina, Variante Romelia el Pollo, Dosquebradas, Risaralda, 160001, Colombia
Name: Hotel La Vitrina
Description: Hotel right on main road so it is quite noisy but many options of rooms to choose from. $25k COP for 2 people in a double with private bathroom, soap towels and blankets provided, huge undercover private parking area, restaurant, pool table. Such a nice family running the place! Would definitely recommend for 1 night, especially since everything in surrounding area is $80k COP and up..

Location: Carrera 16, Comuna 6 - La Concordia, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680005, Colombia
Name: Puerto Marino 3
Description: One of the nicest Restaurants I ate in Colombia (or maybe even Southamerica - after 11 months on the road). It's not fancy - but a good local restaurant. Prices are reasonable. It's is a fish & marisco place. Also liked the atmosphere. Good service also. Walked a lot around in B/manga and found this most appealing.

Location: Hotel Brisas del Norte, Via Llanos de Cuivá - Santa Rosa de Osos, Barrio La Circasia, Vereda El Roble, El Chaquiro, Santa Rosa de Osos, Norte, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Brisas del Norte (Gas Station & Hotel)
Description:
Gas Station, with restaurant, big parkin, safe and although many trucks parked, it's quiet. Good place for overnight.
.....
Posto de combustível, com restaurante, grande área para estacionar, seguro e apesar de ter muito caminhão parado, é silencioso. Bom lugar pra pernoite.

Location: Terpel, Carretera de la Cordialidad / Troncal del Caribe, Cartagena, Clemencia, Dique, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Terpel
Description:
A typical "it was late and we were tired" overnight at a gasstation. We felt safe and it was surprisingly quiet. A few trucks left early in the morning. We parked in front of the hotel and asked the owner if it was ok. He was very friendly and even brought us coffee in the morning!
Free.

Location: San Felipe, Carrera 20A, UPZs Localidad Barrios Unidos, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 111211, Colombia
Name: Agro Campo veterinaria supplies
Description: Discount store for pet supplies including food, medicine, etc. Huge green and orange building with parking.  Wide selection.  Good prices. No Vet prescription needed for medications.  Another store across street with same.

Location: Vía Giron Zapatoca, Zapatoca, Metropolitana, Santander, Colombia
Name: Mirador Buenos Aires
Description: Canyon viewpoint. The road from Girón to Zapatoca is an amazing road with beautiful sights on the canyon. The beginning part is a bit rough (sandy) but after a few kilometers it gets really good, perfect twisty paved roads. Totally free visit of the canyon. Ideal for motorcycle riders. We didn't visit the Chicamocha National Parc through the official entrance, so couldn't tell if that's an added value.

Location: 62, Moniquirá, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 684511, Colombia
Name: US tank adaptor
Description: At first they say no, but after asking permission to boss they did it. American l.p. tank.

Location: Cabaña Peña Blanca, vía al Nevado, Güicán, Gutiérrez, Boyacá, 151440, Colombia
Name: Cabañas Peña Blanca
Description:
The third place to stay in the area but this one is never closed since they live on the property. Jose and his family are super welcoming. Camping in front of the house is 15k COP per car. Access to a hot shower (suicide type), power and restroom. 
Jose is also a guide for the area. He has good tips for hikes just outside the National Park. Hikes are good for acclimating or a good option for people that want to hike outside of the NP and not bother with the permits.

Location: El Hatillo, Panamericana, Chachagüí, Centro, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Finca mi Cabaña
Description: Small cheap hostel with pool, just a few km from Chachagui. Free secure parking for cars and motorcycles, maybe a big rig can fit here but no sure. $20.000 Colombian Pesos for a double bedroom with private bathroom. Restaurant nextdoor (el Hatillo) or you can ask the staff bring some food from the town.

Location: Panamericana, Contadero, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Armed Robbery
Description: Got robbed by 3 guys with nifes and machetes around 7pm as we were eating. They toke all the money passports, camera and phones. Don't stay there is not safe

Location: Mumbai Spice, 10/18, Calle 15, San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, 684031, Colombia
Name: parking market san gil
Description:
best place to park next to the market- very easy to walk over 

big rigs until max 3m if space is available. 
also carwash possible. very friendly.
 cop2000/h
very nice market! do not miss it

Location: Migracion Colombia, Avenida 3A Norte, Rincón De La Flora, Comuna 2, Perímetro Urbano Santiago de Cali, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, 760050, Colombia
Name: Migración
Description: This is where you can extend your personal visa. (Not your car TIP, that must be done at DIAN). You can do this online but ours didn't work so we came here. Fairly easy, helpful people, no line when we arrived at 8am.

Location: 45, La Gloria, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Posto Terpel
Description:
Excellent stop for overnight stay. Spacious and safe. It has clean bathrooms. It is quiet.

Excelente parada para pernoite. Espaçoso e seguro. Tem banheiros limpos. É sossegado.

Location: Calle 60, Localidad Norte - Centro Histórico, Perímetro Urbano Barranquilla, Barranquilla, Atlántico, 080002, Colombia
Name: Place to go for Kombi parts/mechanic
Description: If you're travelling in a kombi this is a good place to find parts or a mechanic. Go to the VW parts store or the bike repair store and ask for Eduardo Amador. He doesn't have a workshop anymore and works mainly here or at his house. Great guy with good connections. Insist that it be him that looks at your kombi!

Location: 60, Otanche, Occidente, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: By the river
Description: Right before the bridge there is a dirt road that goes down to the river. Side of the river is flat and wide enough to park

Location: Vía a Moniquirá, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154001, Colombia
Name: Pozos Azules
Description:
Some sulfur lagoons. If you’ve seen others probably not worth the visit. 10.000 COP pp. 
15.000 avril 2025 pp

Location: Casa Terracota, Vía a Moniquirá, Condominio La palma, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154001, Colombia
Name: Casa Terracotta
Description: A very artistic house built by an architect. If you like the style of Gaudí it’s worth a visit. 10.000 pp, you also get a tour through the house explaining the building and the art concepts inside.

Location: 60, Puerto Boyacá, Occidente, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: La Joya
Description: Nice campground on a green field with trees for shadow. Place for about 4 small rigs, plenty places for tents. Nice swimming pool, 10x15 m. Cabanas also available. 10000 per Person + 5000 for Swimmingpool.

Location: Chachagüí, Centro, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Altos de Josue
Description:
Very nice place to camp or get with your van, with an amazing view of the valley. You can get a really good rest and also hike on the area. We camped there for 3 nights with our dog, and nobody bother us at all, we were alone. 
There is bathrooom but not really clean (we cleaned one to use) and no hot shower... but if you shower at 2 or 3 pm on a sunny day, the water is really hot! 
They charged 15.000 COL pp (when we were paying they told us 20.000...but a deal is deal and we paid 15.000)

Enjoy!

Location: San Agustín, Sur, Huila, 418060, Colombia
Name: Chakira
Description: Ten minute walk to great views of valley, river and waterfalls. Stone carvings at viewpoint. Free entrance, but parking costs 4000. Baños. Drinks. Very last part of road is rough.

Location: Filters Mobil, Avenida Carrera 36, Zipaquirá, Sabana Centro, Cundinamarca, 250251, Colombia
Name: Rocky Batterias
Description: A very extensive battery shop with cheap options and also name brands. Very nice fellow (Andreas) runs it. Decent pricing. Good service.

Location: Mirador, Carrera 9, Villa Mónica, Filandia, Fría, Quindío, 634001, Colombia
Name: Tuk Tuk Restaurant and bar
Description: Very nice restaurant with an amazing view over valley and on the hills. Delicious thai food and cold lemonade (homemade).

Location: Café, Calle 2, Vereda Montecillo, Guatavita, Guavio, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Appalusa Clínica Veterinaria
Description: Fantastic, young vet. No english speaker, but will try. Has much on hand or can get within 24 hours. If doors closed, send note. He lives nearby.

Location: Iglesia Nuestra Señora de Fatima, Carrera 15, El Cadillal, Comuna 4, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, 190003, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero Santa Catalina
Description: Large, secure parking lot to leave your vehicle for days/weeks/months.  No height restriction.  Plenty of open-air parking, but also several spots under a very high roof on the side for big rig parking mostly protected from the rain.  We searched all over Popayan and this was the best option we could find (our van is 2.5m tall so wouldn't fit in most parking lots).  24 hour security, cameras everywhere (we could see our van on the camera from the office at the front), barbed wire fence all around.  (Will update when we return for our van if all was well!)

Location: Anahuac, 25VL11, Pance, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Reserva Natural Anahuac
Description: Large riverside campground for tents or vans or rental cabins.  Lots of space to spread out your stuff.  There is a main entrance where you can park and find an employee to tell them you want to van camp, then they'll have you pull back out to the road and go further up to a different entrance to the camping area.  Clean toilets, icy cold showers, restaurant, a few river-water pools, and several access points to the river.  Very friendly owner Cesar who said he's never had van campers before but would love to have more.  They have wifi but it wasn't working when we were there.  Very quiet on weekdays, I can't speak for weekends.

Location: Helados San Jeronimo, Carrera 4, Finca Bolivar, Minca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470008, Colombia
Name: Santa Isabela (Italian)
Description: Nice restaurant with good pizzas! They also have pasta/ravioli.

Location: La Monumental, Calle 43, Florida Nueva, Comuna 11 - Laureles-Estadio, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050031, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero Lorena
Description: Secure parking with no height restrictions, might even fit big rigs. They have hourly, daily, weekly and monthly rates. We parked here for four weeks while staying in Laureles and visiting a language school.

Location: Oriente, Calle 51, Los Cerros - El Vergel, Comuna 9 - Buenos Aires, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050013, Colombia
Name: Barrios La Sierra and Buenos Aires
Description:
This is the terminal of the tranvia (tram). From here you can either take the cable (cable car) to La Sierra or walk back along the tranvia to Estacion Buenos Aires.

La Sierra is probably most famous for the documentary "La Sierra - Muerte en Medellín" from 2004. It's available on Youtube with english subtitles. Nowadays it's a peaceful barrio with amazing views over Medellín, a nice park and friendly people. People are not used to tourists (yet) but are open and welcoming. If you don't feel secure enough it's also nice to just take the cable car up and down.

Along the tranvia to Buena Vista you can see multiple murals from different artist collectiv, eat in one of the many cafes and restaurants or just stroll around.

Location: El Triunfo, Saladoblanco, Sur, Huila, Colombia
Name: Sendero Cascada De Bordones

Description:
Very cute and quiet hostal with a large secured parking lot within courtyard.

Cost 65k for a dorm and 150k for a private room for two.

Average wifi, free breakast between 7.20-9.30am, free coffee all day long. Breakfast well above average. Fruit bowl with 4 types of fruits. Buffet with: 3 different kinds of breads, fruit juice, coffee and tea, cereal and milk, cheese, ham and they also cook you eggs.

Quiet place, colorful deco.  I stayed in a dorm for 4 days had the whole dorm to myself for this period. Comfy beds that are made each day and there are no bunk beds. Tall ceiling, Lockers with locks. Amazing water temperature and pressure.

My only complaint is the couches and patio furniture made from shipping pallets that aren't comfy.

I highly recommend if it fits your budget.

Also the panaderia next door sells amazing and large banana cake pieces for 1,500

Location: Jardín Botánico del Quindío, 40, Plazuelas de La Villa, Calarcá, Capital, Quindío, 632001, Colombia
Name: Jardín Botánico del Quindío
Description:
The Quindío Botanical Garden was created in 1979 as a non-profit foundation, under the leadership of Alberto Gómez Mejía, with the participation of members of the Oikos Organization, the University of Quindío and the Gardening Club of Armenia. It is structured with three main objectives: ecological conservation, scientific research and environmental education. It is also a recognized center of nature tourism, in which we strive to preserve the beauty of different landscapes. As a botanical garden we have several collections and exhibitions of plants, which you can know in detail on this page and on the occasion of your visit. We want to highlight the National Collection of Palm trees, which brings together almost all the native species of Colombia of this family, so the garden has had a remarkable international recognition.


We believe that nature works in an integral way, in close relationship of living organisms with each other and natural elements such as soil, water and climate, for which we have a beautiful and famous Butterfly Garden, an insect zoo, three birdwatching sites, a museum of Geology and soils, the Museum of the "La Linea" Tunnel, an ethnobotanical museum of palm trees and many other natural attractions. Within our philosophy of access to the community, many educational institutions in the region and the country, participate with their students in academic projects and training in scientific topics.


We are waiting for you.
