Description: Free lil hot (warm) spring next to the memorial for the scouts. Follow the trail up to a secluded natural spot next to a waterfall. Small shallow man made pool with multiple pipes feeding thermal water. We camped at the santuario. Octavio lives in the little cabin across the way they sell agua panela and arepas and can probably park vehicles there. We traveled by bicycle.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: piscilodo: mudbath & natural pool
Description: there is an entry to this location from 09.2018. you can stay overnight here. it has a big parking under trees with shadow. some branches are low. we managed with our sprinter camper van (2.80m high). entry fee to piscina is 8.000cop pp, 20.000cop pn (= 2 people + sprinter camper van) for bathing and staying overnight. slow claro reception. clean baños and showers. cold drinks are sold.

Location: La Esperanza, Ambalema, Nevados, Tolima, Colombia
Name: ferry ambalema
Description: at the moment (Feb 2020) the ferry is broken down. only lancha for pedestrians, bikes or motos. 1.500cop pp one way. from 6am to 6pm

Location: Abejorral - El Cairo, Abejorral, El Cairo, Abejorral, Oriente, Antioquia, 055030, Colombia
Name: La Peña - Hostal / Cabins / Camping / Climbing
Description:
4x4 very likely required for steep loose driveway. Big rigs ok but expect to push past some bushes on the way up. I machete’d a little and barely touched much stuff in our camper. Amazing place to stay for a few days with some great climbing for all levels from 5.6 grade and up.  

Bathrooms, kitchen, living area. Bring your own food, the currently sell soft drink, water, beer and a few packet snacks / biscuits.

Some levelling required (about 10” on one back wheel) if camping near the hostel (see camper in pics). There is also a flatter parking area about 20m further if you turn right at the top of the driveway, which may be a better option if allowed. 

3G and 4G Claro can be a bit hit and miss, usually marginally slow-ish and cuts out occasionally. Fine for low data users. Hostal Wi-Fi is around 2.0Mbs upload and download.

Location: Hotel Mónaco, Carrera 8, Cabecera Municipal Lebrija, Lebrija, Metropolitana, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel Monaco
Description: Modern, newly renovated hotel near the Plaza. Covered  & secured parking, good for cars and motorcycles, not big rigs (2.2 m clearance). We stayed in a double bedroom (comfy), smallish but has a wardrobe, tv, fan and a small desk for 50k. AC rooms at 60k, but it's cool in the evening, not worth it for us. The shower is amazing, actually has a showerhead, both hot and cold water and it has water pressure! Best shower in months. We needed to do maintenance on the motorbikes, no problem in their parking, in shade with some breeze, just perfect. We were able to check at 10 am, but even if not, we could have worked on the bikes until check-in time at 2 pm. One of the best hotels in our 5 months in Latin American countries. Highly recommend.

Location: Hotel madrigal, Carrera 19, Barrio Centro, Cabecera Municipal Duitama, Duitama, Tundama, Boyacá, 150461, Colombia
Name: Hotel Magistral
Description:
Simple hotel run by a *very* nice family. 45000 COP for two people. No parking on-site but they let us roll our motorcycles in the lobby. Paid parking available across the street. Hot shower and OK wifi.

Hotel Shalom across the street was double the price.

Location: Hostal Casa de los Taitas, carrera 7 - 40, Calle 7, Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631020, Colombia
Name: Hostal Casa de los Taitas
Description: Nice clean hostel close to the town center but far enough away to be quiet.  They have two big driveways with a locking gate and a fenced property.  It is great for motorcycles and probably good for a big rig (if you can turn off the street into their gate) or several smaller truck/campers. I got a room in a 5 person dorm for 22,000. They have a nice shared kitchen and big wrap around porches.

Location: Entrance Cascada Ventanas de Tisquizoque 1, Florian - Jesús María, Centro, Florián, Vélez, Santander, 684541, Colombia
Name: Trail to Waterfall
Description: Here starts the trail to the waterfall at a small farm where the owners change 5000 cop per person to hike. It takes around 30 minutes to get there. Amazing views when you are getting closer, nice trekking, great swimming in the pool if there isn't much water flowing. If you have 4x4, you can drive down, there is a small parking spot marked. The road down is extremely steep, you can also park in town and walk all the way down. Owners of the farm also have beautiful cabanas to rent. No camping.

Location: Estadio Beisbal, Carrera 10A, Chinú, Sabanas, Córdoba, Colombia
Name: Gas Station with shower
Description: gas station with shower and tap water goooooooood

Location: Carrera 13, Buenavista, San Jorge, Córdoba, Colombia
Name: Gas station free
Description:
parked one night by the gas station where we filled up diesel, friendly guys. free water, toilets.
you can also park but more up by the motel for 5000 the night.

Location: Guatapé, Oriente, Antioquia, 053840, Colombia
Name: Paradise shooting range
Description: Nice quiet place, hidden and with great overview. we climbed up the spot with our VW T4 2WD and drove through the flat river.

Location: paraje peñas blancas, a truchera, Riosucio, Alto Occidente, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Restaurant in the beautiful mountains
Description:
Beautiful place, the street is magical.
Good food 8000 menu pescado.

Location: Florián - La Venta, Platanillo, Florián, Vélez, Santander, 684541, Colombia
Name: Nice wild camping by the river
Description: Here is the entrance to two wild camping places that we used. If you cross the river and turn left just after, you have space for one or tow cars to sleep next to the bridge. We slept two nights there and the problem is a bit noise with the people and motorcycles crossing the bridge. It is a good option if the river is high or is raining and you afraid that river goes up (it was our case in these 2 nights). The second wild spot is THE BEST option, we spent two weeks there, you turn left following the river and drive few meters to a open rock area (see pictures), it has much more space and privacy, the bridge crossing will not be a problem anymore. Water of the river is not good for drinking according to locals. River never went up in these two weeks there, just 3-5 cm one day after the rain. Enjoy!!!!!!

Location: Autopista del Café, Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631001, Colombia
Name: Finca el Peniel
Description:
Nice Finca for camping, camper-van or cabañas. Very beautiful garden with terrace for chill and relax and a small river with a natural pool.
Owners are very friendly and will be happy to receive more iOverlanders.
Not really leveled for more than one vehicles but they can help you fix it.
Electricity, toilets, hot shower and WiFi available.
Price is 13.000 per person per night.

Location: Campoalegre, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Park & field
Description: Unused soccer field (it looks like a Savannah) and basketball courts where you can camp or park your cars. There’s a night guard to look after the construction machines so we felt safe. Beautiful view of the mountains. The bomberos don’t host cyclists so we came here

Location: Cuerpo de Bomberos Voluntarios de Altamira, Carrera 4, Altamira, Centro, Huila, Colombia
Name: Park in front of Bomberos
Description: Such a beautiful, artistic park in front of the volunteer firestation. Large place with a roof to camp under (shaped like a giant ship). Firefighters were gone when we came on a late Sunday but I’m sure they’d be willing to let you shower and give you some water. Very cute town. We felt safe. I don’t think there is space for cars.

Location: Estación de Bomberos Pitalito X2, Avenida Agustín Sierra, Pitalito, Sur, Huila, 417030, Colombia
Name: Bomberoooos
Description: Wonderful firefighter station that lets us camp in their gym. Everyone was extremely friendly. Shower, kitchen, WiFi, chill area. Couldn’t ask for more. We’re traveling by bike, but it seems like you could park a vehicle here as it’s such a big space

Location: Importadora Celeste, 24-57, Carrera 12, Sector Lago Uribe, Centro, Perimetro Urbano Pereira, Pereira, Risaralda, 660002, Colombia
Name: Street for autoparts
Description: Youll find almost everything you need on carerra 12 and calle 24. All the repuestos shops are here

Location: Garagoa, Neira, Boyacá, 152860, Colombia
Name: Pulawala
Description: Reservation Pulawala's entry, we spend a nigth there, was quiet and very cold in the morning, there was a open kitchen where the animals stolen our food

Location: Colombian Craft Beer SAS, 68 - 63, Carrera 28B, UPZs Localidad Barrios Unidos, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 111221, Colombia
Name: Brío gasolinera
Description: gas station. super quiet place to spend the night. clean bathroom. There is no shower. It has a restaurant with great arepas!!

Location: Variante de Ubaté, Ubaté, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: El Viajero - Very good menu
Description: We were looking for a restaurant that had truck drivers, normally are the best! We found this one. Very good menu for 9.5~12.000 CP. Many options available and big portion!!!

Location: Casa de campo los cactus, Vía a Tatacoa, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Mariluna
Description: This is a family's house but you can stay in a hammock or set up your tent. They have enough room you could also park your truck here.  I paid 10k for a hammock and a friend paid 7k to pitch his tent.  They have a nice bathroom with shower, toilet, and sink.  We also bought simple meals from the family.  The best part is that their property is right next to the Observatory.  We walked over to do some stargazing in the evening.  The family had a dog and several cats.  I assume they would welcome pets as well.

Location: Salsa Pura, 6-61, Calle 4, San Antonio, Comuna 3, Perímetro Urbano Santiago de Cali, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, 760044, Colombia
Name: Circe
Description: Delicious food, cozy atmosphere and friendly people. Recommened!

Location: Taller Lenes, Carrera 14B, Versalles, Comuna 8, Montería, Córdoba, 230002, Colombia
Name: Servicio Automotriz
Description:
We were sent here by a local. 
Very good mechanics about 12 men working there. Started working on our van right away and gave us free coffee while we waited.

Location: Turbaco, Dique, Bolívar, 130010, Colombia
Name: Lucho
Description: Don't go there! He works on cars there in his lot. Came there with engine problems. He "diagnosed" that my gas pump is broken and I need to order a new one (350$). Since he was working on my car, my display which shows the amount of gasoline in my car, doesn't work anymore. Went to another mechanic, who found the problems, it were the spark plugs, and fixed it in 30 minutes. Again, stay away from this place, it's a ripoff!

Location: Carrera 103, Barrio El Centro, Chigorodó, Urabá, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Humos Bar-Parrila
Description: Very nice restaurant on our way from Turbo to Medellín. Area is quite and nice to sit outside. Cool hip relaxed vibe. Good food. The owner even gave us a bowl of fruit after for free.

Location: Calle 4, Gigante, Centro, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hotel Turistico La Casona
Description: Right on the main square.  Convenient location but VERY noisy.  The owner was here and he speaks English, Spanish, French, and Italian.  Rooms are big and the place is nice.  I paid 30k for a private room with fan and cold water only.  The owner wanted 50k for a room with AC.  Breakfast is not included.  They let me park my motorcycle inside the courtyard. They also have a pool if you want to cool off.

Location: Calle 4, Chicala, Aipe, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Terpel
Description: just a trepel has station for free we stayed at after talking with the attendant. alot of road noise bit didnt have much choice as it was very late.

Location: Bbq Corn lady, Calle 6, Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631020, Colombia
Name: parrilla y vinos Juan Esteban
Description: Great restaurants Whit good food prices are ok not to expensive ..and good to have a stop here ..ate lomo mushrooms sauce with sides. 30cop..I recommend it.. The have artisanal beer BBC next door..

Location: Parroquia Nuestra Señora de la Paz, Carrera 10, Leticia, Amazonas, 910001, Colombia
Name: Parque Santander
Description: all the square is safe and available to stay all the time you want. free WiFi. no services

Location: Valero, Ráquira, Ricaurte, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Farm Raquira
Description: This place is safe. The owners are friendly.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Magdalena River Ferry
Description: A car and truck ferry from 45 to 45A, so you can go to El Desierto de Tatacoma from the North without the detour via Neiva. The capacity is two trucks at once.

Location: Calle 11, Manzanares, Alto Oriente, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Manzanares
Description:
Manzanares is a town built on a hill- so steep streets. we found three leveled places 
3. here, where we stayed, after having talked to a few neighbors. 
we had a quiet night. no infrastructure. free. claro 4g reception.

Location: Carrera 5, Marulanda, Alto Oriente, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Marulanda
Description:
we drove from manzanares to marulanda 15km/h on a gravel- and dirt road. you can see waxpalms on the way. marulanda is 2850 m high, very nice and colorful houses. we asked at the police-station at the plaza to stay here with the wonderful view. do not miss to visit la cooperativa ovina at the plaza (5.284498, -75.260531). you can buy your poncho there. the machines they use are over 130 years old. 
no infrastructure. 4g claro reception.

Location: Unknown, Calle 13, San Félix, Salamina, Norte, Caldas, Colombia
Name: San Félix
Description:
Quiet idyllic mountain village. Overlanders are welcome. Comfortable climatic conditions. There are many opportunities for hiking. The infrastructure of the village offers various grocery stores (cheese, bakery, supermarket), various bars and restaurants. We can confirm the previous entries.
this nice pueblo is worth a visit. we stayed a few days at the main plaza near the police station. there are 2 different factorys for milk products (good quality, pricelist as foto), a few restaurants and coffees, visit to the nearby waxpalms mirador. claro 4g reception

Location: Porton Uraba Hotel, Carrera 10, Dabeiba, Occidente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Portón Urbana Hotel
Description: Cyclist only - the owner of this hotel is a cyclist, runs a cycle club, and therefore allows cycle tourists to camp at the top of the hotel under a nice large roof for free.  Big tables, hammocks, shower, wifi.  Hard to go wrong!

Location: Residencia San Juan (Privat), Vía Mocoa - Pitalito, Santa Rosa, Macizo, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje before the village
Description:
First hospedaje when you arrived from Mocoa. 
A nice lady is in charge of the Hospedaje, she has a restaurant too. The lunch was good and not soo expensive.
We stayed two nights there. 
The room was clean with private bathroom. 
15000 cop for two people the first night and she made a discount on her own for the second night.
Calm and clean I recommend.

Location: Naranjal-Altamira, Altamira, Centro, Huila, Colombia
Name: Parador
Description:
Parador Los amigos, great place to stay with tent between the basketball playgrounds and the church. 
The people are friendly. It’s a safe place. We stayed with bicycle without problems. 
Little shops and restaurant are available. 
Then you will find water too. 
Nice place ! 

Parador “Los amigos”, petit coin tranquille pour rester une nuit, les habitants sont sympathiques et accueillant. 
Vous pouvez poser la tente entre le terrain de basket et l’église (ou sur le terrain de basket). 
En face quelques tiendas et restaurants où vous trouverez de tout. 
Les gérants des restaurants laissent accéder au lavabo extérieur pour avoir de l’eau où se laver un peu. 
Je recommande en toute tranquillité

Location: Carrera 27, UPZ Los Alcázares, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 111221, Colombia
Name: DOBLACORT - Aluminium and electrostatic painting
Description: It is a place where you can buy aluminium and also do electrostatic painting. They can also do projects, like cut and bend the aluminium.

Location: Carrera 51B, Sevilla, Comuna 4 - Aranjuez, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050006, Colombia
Name: Medellin Backpacker Hostel
Description: Our hostel offers our visitors an authentic local experience, full of comfort and relaxation in a central location. You will be able to enjoy one of the city’s most lively and vibrant parts of town, with nearby attractions within walking distance, such as The Botanical Garden, Explorer Park, Park of the Wishes, The University of Antioquia and the Center of Business Innovation (Ruta N). Additionally, we are minutes away from two shopping centers and a state-of-the-art gym. We have private parking convenient and secure spots near to us, as well as nearby public transportation (Metro-rail and Metro-bus).

Location: Secretaría de Salud Municipal, Calle 62, Jordan I Etapa, Comuna 9 - Picaleña, Perímetro Urbano Ibagué, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, 730002, Colombia
Name: Parque ecoturístico Yaguaré
Description:
Park is a perfect place to spend the night.  It is a safe and quiet place very close to the county of Juntas right in the combeima canyon.  They must speak with the owner, Juan Carlos, to reach an agreement on the price of the night.


El parque es un lugar perfecto para pasar la noche. Es un lugar seguro y tranquilo muy cerca del corregimiento de Juntas justo en el cañón del combeima. Deben hablar con el dueño, Juan Carlos, para llegar a un acuerdo sobre el precio de la noche.

Location: Calle 5, Paicol, Occidente, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hotel Borbón
Description: Great, clean and cheap hotel, near to The central Park o Paicol. Wifi, Cable, hot water and lovely owners.

Location: Calle 5, Zona Urbana, Mocoa, Putumayo, 860001, Colombia
Name: Metal and Paint Shop
Description:
Milton Cordoba fixed our jeep door after it was bent to hell by a truck passing  to close when we were outside of the  car with the door open. Milton is fair and honest and honestly worked magic. Did an amazing job straightening and hammering it out. He was even able to get the mfg  paint and everything! I highly recommend coming here to fix any metal work, paint or dents! fixed it all for 300000cp!

phone/ telefono : +573228051284

Location: Library and Ethnographic Musem Banco de la República, Calle 9, Leticia, Amazonas, 910001, Colombia
Name: museum free WiFi and bathroom
Description: great place. it has a lot of information. and free WiFi and bathrooms

Location: Calle 4, Leticia, Amazonas, 910001, Colombia
Name: ship to Puerto Asis
Description:
from here you take the ship to Puerto asis.
you will have to talk with the captain of the ship in place at the moment

Location: Bancolombia, Carrera 5, Aguadas, Norte, Caldas, Colombia
Name: aguadas parque central
Description:
we stayed the 2nd night here at the plaza. sn. fernando and sna. mona from the tourist office adviced us not to stay at monte monserrate at the moment, as there is no official “vigilante”. you can buy very good coffee (2,5kg for 55.000cop) or hats. 
we had a pretty quiet night. clean toilets and shower at the tourist office.

Location: Carrera 4, Jericó, Cabecera Municipal Jericó, Jericó, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056010, Colombia
Name: museo josé tomás uribe abad
Description: here is a museum donated to Jerico. he was born here 1920 and died in Medellin in 2014. entrance fee 3.000cop. open 8.00 - 12.00am and 2-5pm. weekends 9am -5am. it contains many furniture from Europe and lamps from his own factory.

Location: Sal si puedes, Carrera 3, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Plaza principal Villa vieja
Description:
We stayed a couple of nights before and after going to the desert. The police suggested the place and it was quiet enough.

Estuvimos un par de noches. Antes y luego de ir al desierto. la policía nos sugirió el lugar y resultó ser bastante tranquilo.

Location: Banco Agrario de Colombia, Carrera 8, Calle Larga, Cajamarca, Centro, Tolima, Colombia
Name: parking street between apartments
Description:
quiet safe street 
friendly neighbors, some of them offer showers and wifi, also refill bottles of water
there are guards and good shade and a little business to buy eggs milk and beer (basic important stuff)

Location: Carrera 14D, San Antero, Costanera, Córdoba, Colombia
Name: Water  - Bomberos
Description: We fill up all bottle of water. Very friendly people

Location: Hotel Los Arrayanes Campestre, Camino de bolas, La Capilla, Vélez, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel campestre Parking
Description: hotel parking  5k cop, clean bathrooms and very kind person, offered to use the hotel shower. recommended not to drive at night!

Location: De Oliva, Carrera 17, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130001, Colombia
Name: Sofias Hostel
Description:
Great place to stay, very clean. 
prices $ 10 - 13 pp with breakfast. pp
air conditioning.

Location: Patio de Bolas, Santandercito, San Antonio del Tequendama, Tequendama, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Maria Isabela
Description:
Not sure what this place is but it has a lovely spot for camping 600m down hill from Santandercito
Says a hotel on google.They may have rooms but looks run down.Seems like there are families living here.Friendly place too.10,000 for camp.Not much facilities but enough for me.There's a pond with a stream coming out where showered.It was nice even though pond water.You can use the families baños.
Ask to charge electronics.

Location: San Cipriano, Pacífico, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Hostel David
Description: Acceptable hostel with a restaurant. We paid 25.000 per person for a 4/8 person dorm (4 double beds). The restaurant is also good, 14.000 for menu del dia. They have a common area and some hammocks.

Location: 15-09, Calle 16, Centro Comercial de Cielos Abiertos, Comuna El Cafetero, Perímetro Urbano Armenia, Armenia, Capital, Quindío, 630004, Colombia
Name: Meson de las Flores
Description:
I advice to stay here. Really quiet and nice room. 
Staff are really great and helpful :)  Hot water and really good meal. 
Good location on the town.   Enjoy ! 

Super hôtel pour rester à Armenia.
Nuits calmes !  Chambres propres et très confortables. 
Douche avec eau chaude.  Personnel très accueillant et serviable.
Je recommande vivement cet hôtel proche de toutes comoditiés. 
Les repas sont délicieux.

Location: El Llanerito, Apartadó - Turbo, Apartadó, Urabá, Antioquia, 057840, Colombia
Name: El punto del sabor
Description: Restaurant buffet where you get a lot of food for only 6.000pesos. Sopa, juice and a plate full of what you choose.

Location: Carrera 7, Villa Constanza, Palermo, Norte, Huila, 410001, Colombia
Name: Street Parking behind Hotel Berdez
Description: We decided not to stay in the big parking lot by the gas station as it is noisy with traffic. Behind the hotel there is a little side street and you are protected from road noise by the hotel. We had a quiet night. There is CCTV at the back of the hotel. We used the toilet in the hotel. We had dinner at their restaurant, I would not recommend it, it was one of the worst meals we’ve had in Colombia. There is also a Justo y Bueno in the parking lot and a panadería. OK for one night

Location: Estación Biomax, Troncal del Magdalena, Cerezuela Las Garzas, Guamo, Suroriente, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Gulf Service Station
Description: 24 hr open. Asked guard who asked superior. Biggish area. Expect traffic noise. Cold showers a blessing. Clean facilities.

Location: Vía San Francisco - el Pepino - Villa Garzon, Mocoa, San Francisco, Putumayo, Colombia
Name: Big Off Road Area
Description: Good flat area if you get caught here in dark. Soggy moss underfoot but looks firm.

Location: Juegos infantiles, Carrera 84, La Floresta, Comuna 12 - La América, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050035, Colombia
Name: Medellin- Community13
Description:
Good option to visit the Communidad13 with people who live there. Simon is a swiss-colombian boy trying to help with the social issue in the Communidad13. The tour is made by young people and very interesting. It cost 45000 pesos pp for a tour of  4h including breakfast or meal with the habitant. Totally recommended! 
The agency name is Alternatour you can find it on facebook ! The meeting point is just in front of the church named « iglesia del 20 de Julio.
From the Parque de la Floresta it will cost 9000 pesos by taxi to go to the Community13.

Location: Ricar, Carrera 57, UPZs Localidad Barrios Unidos, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 111211, Colombia
Name: FERLAND
Description:
A messy, full, unlevelled parking lot. With 6x2.2m we júst fit but no room to walk around the vehicle. Quite noisy due to their dogs and traffic.
Fernando is a very friendly guy who manages this place and is very welcome with overlanders. Here you will find parking + shower (cold) + toilet + use the kitchen for 15.000 CP 24H. If you only use the parking or make jobs there, you can negotiate the price with Fernando. In the place there is a workshop, you can do upgrades in the car for a fair price. We prepared our car (Defender 110 Land Rover) to go to Amazonia here, we installed some reinforces, snorkel and did some welding jobs. We saw that they also make aluminium boxes, roof tent, rain covers, and all 4x4 projects... Come here and you will fix everything you need in the car! Rafa is his mechanic, he is also very friendly and very knowledgeable. There is no height limit and the place is well located, you can find everything you need, there is Sodimac (homecenter), supermarket (D1), etc... We really recommend this place. WhatsApp +573118313725

Location: Estación de Servicio Quinini 1, Boquerón - Fusagasugá, Fusagasugá, Sumapaz, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Biomax Gas Station
Description: Quiet and safe night, other side of the road. Guy came ask for money in the morning, but staff said it was free. Clean toilets.

Location: Calle 29 G, Urbanización Villa Marbella, Localidad 1 Cultural Tayrona - San Pedro Alejandrino, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470003, Colombia
Name: Windshields
Description: Manufactures windshields of all kinds. Owner very attentive and is also a traveler. Hosts travelers near the airport at another ioverlander point.

Location: Calle 5, Paicol, Occidente, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hotel Borbon Lavanderia
Description: The hotel was already marked but for those not looking for a hotel I added a lavanderia icon. I dropped off at 11am and they said ready for 3pm.

Location: Avenida del Ferrocarril, Urbanización Villa Marbella, Localidad 1 Cultural Tayrona - San Pedro Alejandrino, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470003, Colombia
Name: Soldadura
Description: Small welding workshop. They made us a metal box in a few hours. I guess they can do any weld or metal work.

Location: Banco Mundo Mujer, Calle 6, Garzón, Centro, Huila, 414020, Colombia
Name: Specialized Bike shop
Description: Specialized bike shop in Garzon with a lot of (expensive) Specialized bicycles but also a lot of Shimano spare parts and professional mechanics.

Location: Calle 5, Catambuco, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520003, Colombia
Name: Mechanic Mario
Description:
A very reasonably priced mechanic and super friendly! Mario and his whole family helped out in fixing our tail light. Somebody rear ended us on the road and Mario fixed the frame and installed the new tail light for a very reasonable price. 

We have a VW van 82 and there are no replacement tail lights in Pasto for Kombis.. but we found a similar one for now and Mario installed it. 

Fully recommend Mario! He also works with motors.

Location: Metro - Cencosud, Calle 10 (Ruta Verde), San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, 684031, Colombia
Name: Metro big supermarket
Description: Big supermarket where you can find all kind of food. No parking for big cars but you can let it in the street in front of the entrance next to the taxi station.

Location: Puerto Asís, Putumayo, Colombia
Name: Another port to Leticia
Description: Here is another place where the boats come before they go to Leticia. You can also try to find someone that could take your car around here.

Location: LOS REMEDIOS, Calle 15, Riohacha, La Guajira, 440001, Colombia
Name: Montallanta
Description:
Great Lubricant!

Really friendly and helpful owner. They help with a lot of small problems on our 4x4 for free and changed a tire for a fair price.

5 minutes from the town, The Firemen told us the place and how to get there, The place is spacious for parking, quite shady with trees, it is next to the river and next to the entrance of the Jagua aqueduct, it is very pleasant and quiet, you We spoke to those in charge of the aqueduct, they said we could spend the night there; we stayed 3 days.


A 5 minutos del pueblo, Los Bomberos nos indicaron el sitio y como llegar, El lugar es amplio para parqueo, bastante sombra de árboles, queda junto al río y junto a la entrada del acueducto de la Jagua, es muy agradable y tranquilo, le hablamos a los encargados del acueducto, dijeron que podíamos pernoctar alli; nos quedamos 3 días.

Location: FINCA AGROTURISTICA LA JOYA, Vía Puerto Rico, La Sultana, Puerto Rico, Ariari, Meta, Colombia
Name: Finca ecoturística La Joya
Description:
It is an ecotourism farm where they provide the service of camping, cabins, restaurant, swimming pool, BBQ area, with recreation areas, showers, bathrooms, large green areas, and hammock area, it is an ideal place for campers. Jhon Martinez is the host, cell phone 3204889372. It is a safe and quiet place, the attention received has been very special, highly recommended for us who live on the road.

*******************************************************

Es una finca ecoturística donde prestan el servicio de camping, cabañas, restaurante, piscina, zona de BBQ, con zonas de recreación, duchas, baños, amplias zonas verdes y zona de hamacas, es un sitio ideal para campistas y camperitas, atendiendo por su anfitrión Jhon Martinez, celular 3204889372, un lugar seguro y tranquilo, la atención recibida ha sido muy especial, súper recomendada para nosotros los que vivimos en ruta.

Location: Nuestra Señora de Guadalupe, Vía al Cerro de Guadalupe, Localidad Santa Fé, Bogota, Capital District, 110321, Colombia
Name: Cerro de Guadalupe
Description:
The view of the city is very good. It has a statue of the Virgin of Guadalupe. The church is at its busiest on the first Sunday of each month, and the hill is frequented by cyclists on Tuesdays, Thursdays and weekends. It is difficult to park at the top as there are few parking spaces, the road is very narrow and has many curves. There is public transportation from Caracas with 6 and taxis $ 2500 - $ 3000 per person.

La vista de la ciudad es muy buena. Tiene una estatua de la Virgen de Guadalupe. La iglesia está más concurrida el primer domingo de cada mes, y la colina es frecuentada por ciclistas los martes y jueves. Es difícil aparcar en la parte superior ya que hay pocas plazas de aparcamiento, la carretera es muy estrecha y tiene muchas curvas. Hay transporte público desde Caracas con 6 y taxis $ 2500 - $ 3000 por persona.

Beautiful place 5 minutes from Becerril, the people of the town guided us, at the edge of the road there is a short path that leads to the river, it is close, easy access, we parked next to a farm, we spoke with the owners and they said that we could spend the night there.

Guardería Canina / Hotel, Veterinaria, Etóloga, Cursos de obediencia canina, muy amables y profesionales.

******************************************

Hay que resaltar que si vienes por Chocontá la carretera es muy mala, llena de baches, aunque el paisaje es muy bello.

Location: Restaurante Martinata, 60, Bolombolo, Venecia, Suroeste, Antioquia, Región Andina, Colombia
Name: Martinata restaurant
Description:
Small local restaurant with lots of juices and delicious food. We are vegan and and ask for a “bandeja paisa” but without the meat - they gave us extra beans and salad. It was so good! 

They also have a lot of juices. The place is very clean and nice too. Well ventilated! 

Also - they are little mercadito/tiendas right in front of this place. Fruit veggies and other stuff is available. We got a big bag of oats and bananas to cook breakfast for less than $1.

Location: Hotel Posada la Porra Campestre, 60, Bolombolo, Venecia, Suroeste, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Balneario-Restaurante La Porra
Description:
This is a family run restaurant-hotel with a pool and a big green area. Camping is 40,000 and a private room is 60,000 (for two people). We were a bit hesitant to go down the steep little road that takes you from the main road to the entrance of the hotel (biking down takes 1 minute, very quick). Once we got down we were kindly welcomed, saw the room and decided to stay. 

We are on bikes and this was a perfect place to rest before the big climb to Jericó the next morning.  La porra was great! Simple and affordable - very comfy. Bikes fitted perfectly in our room, we had a fan, a tv, two beds and a private bathroom. The pool is dead during the week so veryyyyy quiet night of rest :)

Food: the restaurant has a lot of food during the weekend but during the weekdays the cook is out so they order food from another place down the main road (Martinata Restaurant) and a motorcycle will bring it to you. The place is called Martinata and is literally 5min walking (slow) down the main road. I wrote a small review for that place too, it was great food!

Location: Carrera 7, Restrepo, Piedemonte, Meta, Colombia

Description:
We stayed a night in the principal plaza. Quiet and safe.

Pasamos una noche en la plaza principal. Restrepo es un pueblo tranquilo y el lugar es seguro.

Location: Via a Jericó, Tarso, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056010, Colombia
Name: La Tienda de Caldea
Description:
Very cute little place right on the road. It has jugos naturales, café, tinto, sodas, alcoholic drinks, food (including empanadas with potatoes and a few other vegan/vegetarian opcions!)

They also sell a few snacks (chips/chocolate). There is a big green area for parking and a little rack where we locked our bikes. This was such a great stop!

Location: Hyundai, Calle 235, UPZs Localidad Suba, Localidad Suba, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 111176, Colombia

I brought our camping rig to the Dealership to do a job of insulating the cabin floor, checking the electrical connections, oil leaks.

.....

Location: Calle 16, San Pedro, Sabanas, Sucre, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje Central
Description:

50.000 for a double room with AC (with tree beds).
They also have a restaurant just down the street, Restaurante Central, with decent meals for 10.000. They do deliver the food to your room if you want.

Location: Hotel Río Pedras, 6-51, Carrera 5, Jericó, Cabecera Municipal Jericó, Jericó, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056010, Colombia
Name: Terra Nostra/local comedor
Description:
This is a wonderful place. They serve local Colombian food (so lots of meat) and also have burgers and things like that. We are a vegan and a vegetarian and we were blown away by the food here too, they gave us vegetarian options and have a nice variety of local, national beers and fruit juices as well as hot drinks (tea, tinto).

We ordered a menu de día and asked to Jade it “vegetariano, sin carnet” so extra beans/salad/plantains or an egg instead. The menu came with a jugo and a soup (plantain soup! 

If you are adventurous try the beverage named *Claro* is very typical of Medellin. It’s served cold and is made with corn and milk. The quite unique thing is that you drink it while you take small bites from *bocadillo de guayaba* (sugary guava paste). Love it

They also have a few used and new bikes for sale (specialized and local GW brand). Their mechanic is good.

Location: Vía Granada - Mesetas - Granada, Mesetas, Ariari, Meta, Colombia
Name: Estadero El Limón
Description:
It is a place next to the Guejar river and next to the El Limón bridge, it has areas for campers and camper, also with rooms, owner and bathroom, restaurant service of typical food and drinks, it has river beaches, starting point for rafting or canoeing on the Guejar river to Sanjuan de Arama, attended by Don Álvaro and his family, very attentive and helpful people.

Location: Camino a la Laguna Las Calles, Vetas, Soto Norte, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hike to Laguna de las Calles
Description:
Beautifull hike through unique paramo (mountain wetland) type of landscape. At the lake there is total silence. 
From Vetas it is about 2,5 hours walking one-way. From this point (start of the official trail) it is about 20 minutes. The trail is well marked with stones and small wooden bridges. The trail is on finca property and they ask an entry fee of 20k per person. You can either call beforehand or just show up and they will see you walking.

Location: Transversal 1B, Florián, Vélez, Santander, 684541, Colombia
Name: Roadside
Description: Spent one night here. Right in town. Pretty quiet except for some roosters. On a dirt side road so not much traffic. For 8,000 COP you can use the municipal pool up the hill to swim and shower. Enjoy!

Location: Carrera 23, Comuna 13 - Oriental, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680002, Colombia
Name: Ciclaramanga (bycicle rent and NGO)
Description:
Local run NGO who promotes cycling in Bucaramanga. They organize critical mass cycling events and workshops related to cycling. 

They are also a driving force behind the sundaymorning closure of the main street carrera 27 to use it for cycling and other sports. That's when they rent out all kinds of bicycles like tandems, MTBs and lowriders. They do that from the crossing of Carrera 27 and Calle 40A. 
They can be reached via +57 314 3901264 and they are on facebook and instagram.

Location: Flor de Lotto, 23 - 50, Calle 37, Comuna 13 - Oriental, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680006, Colombia
Name: Flor de Loto
Description: Simply an excellent vegetarian local restaurant. It is very popular by locals for their lunch menu. For 13k you get a starter, main, dessert, lemonade and tea. Very fast and friendly service. You can be in and out in 30 minutes.

Location: Los Santos, Metropolitana, Santander, Colombia
Name: El Cucharito Camping
Description:
This site is away from the weekend traffic at the Mesa de Los Santos. There is no height restriction, any vehicle will fit. The parking/camping area is a large meadow slanting south; rigs will need to be leveled. For campers, there is a basic bathroom and cold shower (plastic pipe). The water gets warm in the afternoon when the sun shines on the black tanks.
There also is a 4-burner stove, which works well, and a dish washing sink. A clothes washing sink and a washing machine are at Esther’s house.
There are two glamping huts, and Esther also rents two rooms; the rooms and the glamping share one bathroom accessible from the outside. Wifi reaches about a third of the way across the meadow.
We were there August and September, and it usually was quiet, also on weekends; sometimes, there is a neighbor who plays music too loudly for a few hours but not late at night. While we were there, no tent campers showed up, but people came to rent the glamping cabins; they all were quiet.
The last two kilometers to the site can be a bit bumpy, but locals drive it in small cars. There is a nice walk, also about 2 km, down to the village of Los Santos.
Esther is usually there, but it may be best to call/WhatsApp ahead.

Location: Guamal, Piedemonte, Meta, Colombia
Name: Estadero Paisaje ( Río Humadea)
Description:
It is a place near the river that allows camping, spending the day and spending the night with mobile homes. Its owners are very friendly people and the place is very quiet. There are bathrooms and you can bathe in the river. Highly recommended if you pass through the area. They charged us $ 10,000 a day. 

Es un lugar cercano al río que permite acampar, pasar el día y pernoctar con casas rodantes. Sus dueños son personas muy amables y el lugar es muy tranquilo. Hay baños y te puedes bañar en el río. Altamente recomendado si pasas por la zona. A nosotros nos cobraron $10.000 el día.

Location: Granada, Ariari, Meta, 504001, Colombia
Name: Estadero La corraleja
Description:
Translation: The Estadero La Corraleja offers multiple services. You can enjoy an environment with a swimming pool and large spaces, bathrooms, showers and WiFi. it also offers spacious rooms and camping areas. Its owner Don Guillermo is very friendly. a super recommended place in Granada.
El estadero la Corraleja ofrece múltiples servicios. Puedes disfrutar de un ambiente con piscina y espacios amplios, baños, duchas y WiFi. también ofrece amplias habitaciones y zonas de camping. Su dueño Don Guillermo es muy amable. un lugar super recomendado en Granada.

Location: Vda. El Tablazo, San Juan de Arama, Ariari, Meta, Colombia
Name: Playa río Guejar, vereda Monserrate bajo
Description:
They are the beaches of the river Guejar. Warning: keep in mind that it is a river and there may be floods, find the way to leave the camper and camping in a higher part, safe and quiet place, we spent five nights.
===
Son las playas del río Guejar. Advertencia: tener en cuenta que es un río y pueden haber crecientes, buscar el camino para dejar el camper y camping en una parte más alta, lugar seguro y tranquilo, pasamos cinco noches.

Location: Inntu, 74B-10, Transversal 39, Laureles, Comuna 11 - Laureles-Estadio, Zona Urbana Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, Región Andina, 0500, Colombia
Name: LAVA EN HAPPY LAUNDRY
Description:
Wash, Dry & Fold service. (Same day)
Drop off and PickUp
Pay by Load

Location: Calle 12A, Santa Anita - La Selva, Comuna 17, Perímetro Urbano Santiago de Cali, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, 760033, Colombia
Name: El Queremal, Dagua, church parking lot
Description: Beside Queremal Church there is a place where you can park your motor home, is a calm and safe street, with some music noise on weekends.

Location: Calima, Centro, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Lago Calima Entrada 4
Description: This is a camping place, where you can pay for a tent or bring your own tent. There is a beatiful view of the Lake, which is close to the camping. You can also go there with your motor home and parking there. I highly recommend visit this place from Monday to friday, because on weekends there is a lot of noise. The site offers water, showers and toilets.

Location: Terpel, 29, Salvador Allende, Comuna Quimbaya, Perímetro Urbano Armenia, Armenia, Capital, Quindío, 631001, Colombia
Name: Terpel Oro Negro Fuel Station
Description: This is a Fuel station. They allow motor homes to stay there and passed night. In this place you can find toilets and running water. Is safe because it is open 24 hours. We passed there two nights because we had a mechanical problem and the guys were very kind with us.

Location: Llanitos, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, 730010, Colombia
Name: Restaurante El Peñon
Description: This is a restaurante with a big parking lot near to the river, ubicated in Cañón del Cobeima. It is quite and safe, and at night there is a security guard. They offered us a site where we could park if we bought something in their restaurant or paid a small fee for the parking service. They also gave us water. We stayed at this place for four days and everything was perfect. Sometimes we left our motor home there and went to know other places and nothing bad happend.

Location: Carrera 12, Monterrey, Casanare, 855010, Colombia
Name: Parque Alfonso López Monterrey
Description:
Beside the park there is an area where you can park in front of the church. It is a quite neighborhood and safe. We passed there one night and nothing bad happend.

Al lado del parque hay un área donde se puede parquear al frente de la iglesia. Es una zona residencial calmada y segura. Pasamos allí una noche y nada malo pasó.

Location: Pajarito, La Libertad, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Biomax Gas Station
Description: This is a gas station where you can park and stay at night. There is security 24 hours, is not too close to the road so you can sleep well. There is showers and toilets, and also they offer water.

Location: Calle 5, Zona Urbana de Ráquira, Ráquira, Ricaurte, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Tuco Carts Parking
Description:
This is a parking lot in the entrance of the town, it is very wide and has a comfortable field. At night is closed and the person in charge lives in front. We stayed there two nights and everything was perfect. The cost was 5.000 COP per night. Felt safe.


Es un parqueadero a la entrada del pueblo, tiene un campo amplio con un pasto muy cómodo. En las noches se cierra el parqueadero y la persona a cargo vive al frente. Nos sentimos muy seguros y pasamos dos noches muy tranquilas. El costo fue de 5.000 pesos por noche.

Location: Casa Lobo, Carrera 5, Minca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470008, Colombia
Name: La Miga Agua Potable
Description: Right on the corner of the panaderia. There’s a parking lot too you can park while you fill up for a while. It’s very slow but it’s free and I couldn’t find garrafones in the stores.

Location: Autopista Medellin - Bogotá, Doradal, Antioquía., Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Restaurante donde Tavo
Description: This is a restaurant close to the main road, we asked the manager for a place where we could stay at night and he offered us a place at the back of his restaurant for free. It is a little noise but for one night is ok. The restaurant opens 24 hours.

Location: Carrera 2, Don Diego, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Río Don Diego
Description:
Translation:Nice place to stay for a few days,
It is a large parking lot next to the restaurants and is a few steps from the river, the owner of the parking lot allowed us to sell and spend the night on the weekend. You can float from the river to the sea.
the cost of parking is 5000 pesos a day and at night you can stay right here.
very quiet and safe place
Agradable sitio para estar unos días,
es un parqueadero grande junto a los restaurantes y está a pocos pasos del río, la dueña del parqueadero nos permitió vender y pernoctar el fin de semana. Se puede ir en flotador desde el río hasta el mar.
el costo del parqueadero es 5000 pesos día y en la noche puede quedarse aquí mismo.
lugar muy tranquilo y seguro

Location: La Casona de Chela Restaurante y Café, Calle 5, San Martín, Piedemonte, Meta, Colombia
Name: Parque principal San Martín
Description:
Translation:We spent five days in this place. It is relatively quiet, except on Fridays and Saturdays where there is a bit of noise from some neighboring places, however it is spacious with some shade. We recommend going to Caño Camoa which is very close.
Pasamos cinco días en este lugar. Es relativamente tranquilo, exceptuando los viernes y sábados donde hay un poco de ruido de algunos locales vecinos, sin embargo es espacioso con algo de sombra. Recomendamos ir a Caño Camoa que es muy cerca.

Location: Garzón, Centro, Huila, 414020, Colombia
Name: Hotel Parque la Casona
Description:
Most beatuful hotel finca ever known in Colombia. you have path trekking, lots of animals, horse riding, 9 artificial lakes, beautiful weather, and an incredible swiming pool. there are 4 pools. Big parking. Great restaurant. choose rooms whit internal view. 
prices for double room 250.000 COP. or 215000 from tuesday to thursday. Pool 15000 per person.
You can also spend the day: 50.000 COP with lunch. pool apart. Not allowed to sleep in the van. Reservations 318601195

Location: Tagua, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: High altitude roadside with a view
Description:
This spot is the closest parking to the turn off for the sketchy road to walk up to Cerro Kennedy (or you can 4x4/moto up that road but we only have 2WD). the view is sweet, a sliver of Santa Marta and the ocean, mountains, and a great view of Ciénaga, the long spit, and even the lights of Barranquilla at night. You can get a little bit of cell service at the big rock from Ciénaga direction. 

There's a bar at the turnoff to Cerro Kennedy with a bathroom and porch with beers and a pool table. the owner says this is technically his parking too, so we paid 5.000 for the day. He had asked 10, but wasn't there when I paid, and I also got some beers. 

It's just a pull off on the side of the road, above a coffee plantation. But the views and weather are perfect.

Down the road a little farther is a restaurant open on the weekends. pretty sleepy up here but definitely busier on the weekends.

Location: Vía Barranca de Upia - Cabuyaro, Barranca de Upía, Piedemonte, Meta, Colombia
Name: Hotel Guaicaramo
Description:
Parking is small so nothing bigger than a van or pickup camper. 
They lock the gate at night and have security guard. 
The best thing is the price. Queen bed room with A/C, fast WiFi, good TV, and warm shower is only 45,000 pesos. Oh, and a nice little pool.

Location: Vía Cimitarra - Landazuri, Aguachica, Landázuri, Vélez, Santander, Colombia
Name: Chocolate Artesanal XUE
Description:
Artesan chocolate shop where you can enjoy delicious chocolate in different presentations. Adriana is the very friendly owner. Additionally, they offer parking to spend the night.
---
chocolatería artesanal dónde puedes disfrutar de un delicioso chocolate en diferentes presentaciones. Adriana la dueña muy amable.
Adicional le ofrecen parqueadero para pasar la noche.

Location: Vía Bogotá - Villavicencio, Cáqueza, Oriente, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Cheap hotel
Description: Not a lot of hotel options between Villavicencio and Bogota. We found this one to be OK. Get a room in the back and it’s dark and quiet. Full size beds only. It’s clean with hot showers. Only 35K pesos.

Location: Dibulla, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Cabañas San Sebastian
Description: Excellent place, rooms, swimming pool, pool table, $ 15000 COP P / P, the beach is a few meters away.

Location: GHL Style Neiva, Vía San Pedro Plaza, Gualanday, Comuna Nororiental, Perímetro Urbano Neiva, Neiva, Norte, Huila, 410001, Colombia
Name: Ghl hotel
Description: If you want a little luxury after sweating it out in the desert, this is the place. Right next door to Centro Comercial San Pedro Plaza you’ll have lots of bars/restaurants. Parking in back for big rigs too.

Location: Palermo, Norte, Huila, 410001, Colombia
Name: Narrow Bridge
Description: A narrow bridge but vehicles of 2.20 and 2.35m wide will make it through.

Location: Hotel Balcones de la Pradera, Calle 23, Cabuyal, La Plata, Occidente, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hotel balcones de la pradera
Description: Nice looking hotel with swimming pool and good restaurant. 30K pesos per person. Didn’t stay. Just ate lunch. This is a lonely stretch of road from Neiva to Tierra Adentro. Not a lot of options for gas, eating, or hotels.

Location: Calle 9, El Diviso, Prado, Suroriente, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Hotel D’Mary
Description: Friendly host (though a man not called Mary..) basic double room w bathroom & WiFi, parking inside gated lobby for motorbike, & coffee in the morning for 50,000COP. Good base for a pitstop. Had good dinner at local restaurant recommended by host. Near bakery, fuel station and shops. Went to see the lake (15 mins away), looked lovely for boat tours etc but busy car park and didn’t want to leave the bike. Took the road from Prado to Baraya and on to the Tatacoa Desert, which was amazing.

Location: centro de entrenamiento físico Elmental Soul CF, Calle 165A, Gilmar, UPZ Britalia, Localidad Suba, Bogota, Bogota Capital District, Región Andina, 111156, Colombia
Name: Panadería panes y Galletas
Description:
We are a family with this local business that wants to help passing travelers, we can help them with water, wifi, lodging, shower, washing clothes and whatever they require.
---
Somos una familia con este negocio local que desea ayudar a los viajeros de paso, les podemos ayudar con agua, wifi, hospedaje, ducha, lavar ropa y lo que requieran.

Location: FERRETERIA GIRALDO, Carrera 6, Mesetas, Ariari, Meta, Colombia
Name: Parque principal
Description: Pasamos una noche en el parque principal de Mesetas y resultó ser un sitio muy tranquilo y seguro. la recomendación de la policía es no hacerse muy cerca de ellos

Location: Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, 661020, Colombia
Name: Hotel  El cortijo
Description: Hotel con amplio parqueadero. Aceptan motorhome, precios cómodos, agua, servicios sanitarios, Internet, servicio de restaurante, piscinas juegos infantiles, aceptan mascotas

Location: Calle 45, Comuna 6 - La Concordia, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680006, Colombia
Name: Home Center - Propane
Description: We found small propane cylinders here for our camp stove that usually uses the green Coleman’s. Refilling our normal tank in Bucaramanga was unsuccessful but at least we can cook until we get to another city.

Location: Canoas, a Termales de San Vicente, Predio Altamira, Vereda Potreros, Canoas, Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, Colombia
Name: Mirador CANOAS
Description: Mirador restaurante with gorgeous view. Menu with lots of dishes, fruit juices, alcohol drinks, cafe and lots chorizos just off the grill; so good! Perfect place for breakfast or lunch

Location: Villamaría, Centrosur, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Camping at former restaurant
Description:
Big covered building where the folks who live just in front let you camp for 10,000 pp. It’s the only place around to hide from the rain. This is the place to camp and then hike to Laguna Otun the next morning (5hr hike round trip).

The area for camping is a big building under construction - it is fully covered, has a concrete floor (dry floor!), plenty of electrical sockets (all of them worked!!), no lightbulbs, bathrooms with running water, a sink to do dishes/prepare food/refill water to drink, and lots of chairs and bird poop...

The workers who lived in the house in front (the people you pay to camp) told us they hope the place is done and ready to offer lodging and restaurant services by January 2022. In the meantime you can camp here and scape the rain...

To keep in mind: This is the only camping spot in the area; the Potosi Camping (at the park entrance) is no longer taking people - they will send you here. It is absurdly cold during the night so bring a good sleeping bag and many layers; it is brutal.

We rode our bikes from Santa Rosa de Cabal (going towards Manizales) and came prepared to cook since there is ***absolutely*** nothing around here. 

The hike to Otun was gorgeous. Be prepared for rain up there ! You can hike all the way to the Laguna (11km - 22km round trip). Bring snacks and a rain layers. We only hiked to the mirador (6km) where you can see Nevado Santa Isabel and the laguna, it’s was beautiful! Very recommended. Foreigners pay $47.500 to enter the park and do the hike.

Location: Catedral del sal, Mina del Sal, Zipaquirá, Sabana Centro, Cundinamarca, 250252, Colombia
Name: Cajica,
Description:
Agua Fortaleza
20l Garafones, just water 7500
friendly and fast

Location: Fómeque, Oriente, Cundinamarca, 251640, Colombia
Name: La Rana
Description:
Country house owned by a lovely family of bird and nature lovers. Yaqui, Oscar and the kids make everyone feel at home. Amazing landscapes, friendly neighborhood, full of grandma's eager to feed everyone with delicious local cuisine. Ideal for families with kids, looking for a quiet place to enjoy nature and warm company. No party allowed. Paid COP$20.000 P/p night.

Access through a dirt road, not too bad, like 15 minutes from the town "Fomeque". Check the tourist attraction entry for details about bird watching. Maximum height 2.75mts. Call before you go, cell: 310 8838037.

Finca propiedad de amantes de los pájaros. Yaqui, Oscar y los niños te hacen sentir en casa. Paisajes asombrosos, un vecindario muy amigable, lleno de abuilitas ansiosas por alimentarte con la deliciosa cocina local. Ideal para familias con niños, o buscando un lugar tranquilo para disfrutar de la naturaleza y compañía cálida. No sé permiten fiestas. Pague COP $20.000 P/p noche.

A 15 minutos del pueblo "Fomeque", por una carretera destapada, pero no muy mala. Ver la atracción turística para detalles de la observación de aves. Altura máxima 2.75mts. llamar antes de ir al cel: 310 8838037.

Location: Fómeque, Oriente, Cundinamarca, 251640, Colombia
Name: La Rana - Bird Watching - Aves
Description:
Yaqui, Oscar and the kids work tirelessly for the conservation of local birds and the ecosystem. Oscar is an ornitologist and photographer. He can guide you on sessions of Bird watching and feeding, and trekking in the area. They lead multiple conservationist programs.
A session of bird watching in their place location costs COP$40.000 P/P. A trekking day with bird watching costs COP$150.000 P/P.  Call first to: 310 8151695.
Yaqui also offers culinary tours with the neighbors whit amazing and delicious local traditional food.

Yaqui, Oscar y sus niños trabajan constantemente en diferentes programas de conservación ambiental y de aves de la zona. Oscar es un Ornitologo y fotógrafo, que puede hacer sesiones de observación de aves, alimentación de colibríes, y caminatas. La sesión de observación de aves en su finca cuesta COP$40.000 P/p. Y el día de caminata con observación de aves COP $150.000 p/p.
Llamar primero al cel: 310 8151695.
Yaqui también ofrece tours culinarios con los vecinos del área, con comida local traditional deliciosa.

Location: Reef Shepherd, 1-02, Calle 14, Taganga, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470001, Colombia
Name: Reef Shepherd Dive Center
Description:
Is an excellent dive center! They are very professional and doesn’t matter if you are an experienced or new diver, they take care of you and your equipment and that make me feel safe in all of the dives. I went with a big group but they split them in small groups by instructor. They took me wonderful pictures diving! 
Book your dives with Santiago Estrada 300 8286273. He is one of the most experienced divers specialized in underwater photography!!!

Location: Compac ll, 51-20, Carrera 6, UPZ Pardo Rubio, Localidad Chapinero, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 110231, Colombia
Name: On street parking
Description: Piece of street without forbidden parking signal, can park 4 or 5 cars.

Location: Vida Tranquila, Diagonal 20A, Charalá, Guanentá, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hostal Vida Tranquila
Description:
Nice hostal with heated swimmingpool overlooking the valley and the town Charala. They offer biljart, running toilets, sauna, relaxing chairs and cool beers. There is music ofcourse, but not too loud. 
We asked and we could pitch our tent for 20.000 in total for 1 night with 2 persons on the big grassfield.
Enough spots for several cars. The gate is locked at night.

Location: Fabrica de arepas Buenos Aires, Vía Duitama-Charalá, Vereda Santa Barbara, Duitama, Tundama, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Fabrica de Arepas Buenas Aires
Description: Almost on top of the road you will find this gem. Nothing better then a fat arepa with cheese and coffee when cold from the wind up there. The place is very popular by locals to stop by. During weekends this is the goal for many bicyclists climbing up from Duitama.

Location: Centro, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 472000, Colombia
Name: Casa Movida Hostel
Description:
Wrong location. It's on Calle 35, between Carrera 7 and Diagonal 35.
Probably the best hostel in town.
Spotless, large sleeping capsules, new slower/toilets. Café bar, pool, roof bar. Great location within the town walls.
SIM cards from supermarket around the corner. 40k pesos per night including eggs, coffee, toast, fruit for breakfast.

Location: Troncal Central del Norte, Tipacoque, Norte, Boyacá, 151001, Colombia
Name: Old school
Description: Parking near an old school beside route 55, approximately 4 kms outside Tipacoque town.

Location: Avenida los Fundadores, San Antonio, Líbano, Nevados, Tolima, 731040, Colombia
Name: El manantial (vegetarian)
Description: Small restaurant with lots of vegetarian options. It’s open until 4pm. It was a great stop! We had the menu Del día for 10,000

Location: Carrera 7A, Prados del Norte II etapa, Comuna 5 - Jordán, Perímetro Urbano Ibagué, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, 730002, Colombia
Name: Sakana sushi & ramen
Description: This is a great sushi spot. Vegan and vegetarian options as well. It’s a very cute, small, well-staffed spot. I celebrated my bday here and it was a great place to eat, drink and enjoy a nice night. The staff is wonderful and their sushi is as well.

Location: Pimienta Gourmet, Carrera 3, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Place with beans for breakfast (vegan)
Description:
Asadero de Los Gatos
We are vegan and had a hard time finding something from breakfast in this beautiful town. We are used to looking around :) so it was fun. 

We walked around town and this was the only place that offered a veganish breakfast in the whole town.

We got beans (nobody else had:), plantains, rice, a big salad, and limonada. Sounds like lunch but it was delicious.

This place is cute and offers a lot of grilled meat - so if you like meat, this is your spot too.

Location: Hospedaje Villa Cecilia, #4-42, Calle 5, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Villa Cecilia
Description:
Simple but very comfy rooms. 
AC double room is 80,000 (40 each person)
No AC double room is 70,000 (35 each)

Breakfast not included but 6,000 (arepa, huevo and coffee)

Wifi was pretty good.
Lots of mosquitos so it was nice to have the AC and the windows shut.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: cafe mael (coffee and wifi:)
Description:
This is a nice coffe shop with a very large shaded patio. Their coffee is good and their wifi is strong. They have some food, fruit juices and beer.

I appreciated the space. It’s very quiet and it has a lot of space if you are coming with kids. 

This is also the spot to come get some work done on wifi, it’s a super comfy place and the staff is very chilled and kind. We parked our bikes inside and chilled here for 2-3hrs. It was relaxing

Location: Troncal Central del Norte, Chitagá, Suroccidente, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: Paramo del Almorzadero
Description: Safe place with cabanas, a laguna, waterfall and restaurant. We didn’t try the restaurant but when we arrived we were offered agua panela. The campsite is okay, in a dirt parking spot but the owner let us use the shower and bathroom in a cute cabana with a view of the laguna. It’s a nice spot to wander the paramo a bit. No cell service. 20,000cop a night. The restaurant has wifi but we didn’t try it

Location: Pio Pio Asadero, Panamericana, RIO BLANCO, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Corrales y Peroles restaurante
Description: Good restaurant with a small zoo in the back..

Location: arte latino, Carrera 4; Bolívar, Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056050, Colombia
Name: Tacos del Mundo
Description: Good fusion food. Tacos, schwarma, pita, etc.. Good option if you’re tired of Colombian food. Good prices too..

Location: Kantarrana Casa de Campo, Carrera 5; Girardot, Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056050, Colombia
Name: Hotel Kantaranna
Description: Nice little hotel right where you turn for Cabañas La Isla. 140K pesos for 2 people with breakfast. A little overpriced for Colombia, but so is everything else in this tourist town. Hot showers, clean room. Bus stops by every hour to take you into town. Very quiet and parking for a large motorhome unlike La Isla. Worth it if you want to treat yourself..

Location: Omega, Carrera 4, Genderales, Landázuri, Vélez, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel el Mirador
Description: Simple hotel, decent wifi, cold shower, centrally located, allowed to take bike into room - steep stairs though. Don't think there is parking

Location: El barcino, Carrera 4, Pasaje Camacho, Comuna Centro, Perímetro Urbano Neiva, Neiva, Norte, Huila, 410006, Colombia
Name: Hotel & Café El Barcino
Description: Cute hotel a block from the main square. It’s 45K for a double room and 30K for only one person. Rooms are clean and beds comfy; comes with a fan and a private bathroom. The place is also a coffee shop serving limonadas and jugos as well - they have cute tables and strong wifi. Staff is very kind

Location: Calle 10, El Altico, Comuna Centro, Perímetro Urbano Neiva, Neiva, Norte, Huila, 410400, Colombia
Name: Prashanti - Vegan/Vegeterian restaurant
Description:
This was such a treat. This restaurant is a full vegan/vegetarian place with desserts and lots of other healthy products.

We had breakfast here on a Saturday morning and it was very yummy. Lunch is delicious too; they have a menu Del día. After 3pm you can order from their bigger menu. I ordered oysters mushroom with fried rice and it was delicious.

So nice to take a break from arepas and fried food.

There is wifi, lots of juices and the place is well ventilated. Cold Kombucha for sell as well:)

Location: Calle 4, Iquira, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje
Description:
Not many lodging options in this town. This is one of two.

A very simple hospedaje in the house of an old couple. They are well known for hosting people in their house. There are 4-5 rooms with single or double beds. We stayed in the first room (facing the road) with two single beds, an old tv that worked perfectly; room had a private bathroom. We each paid 15K.

The beds were very simple but the place was mostly clean and with earplugs we slept more than wonderfully. It’s a pretty chilled town but the night before there was a bit of noise, nothing terrible.

The other rooms are way quieter, they just don’t have their own bathroom. I guess you have to pick.

The old couple is very sweet. We brought our bikes inside the room and felt pretty safe.

No wifi.

Location: Cucunubá, Ubaté, Cundinamarca, 250450, Colombia
Name: Hostel Campestre los Duraznos
Description:
Cosy hostel with spaces for tent camping with a nice view overlooking the valley. The hostel has a small entry road with height restriction so it is not suitable for vans.
Tent camping is 20k with basic breakfast included.
Wifi, warm shower and potable water available. They also have rooms available.
Friendly owners who only speak Spanish.

Location: Carrera 2, La Plata, Occidente, Huila, Colombia
Name: Small tienda
Description: Small town with a few tiendas and places to eat empanadas, simple lunches and pan with tintos.

Location: Carrera 7, Oporapa, Sur, Huila, Colombia
Name: hospedaje el principe
Description:
Very nice and clean hotel with indoors parking for motorcycles or bikes. Street parking otherwise. Hotel is located in a very quiet street. 

They have three types of room; all of them have their own shower/bathroom, and tv. Wifi is strong. 

Double for 30K 
Double for 45K
Double for 50K

The only difference in the rooms is the size. We stayed in the 45K and were very comfy. The 30K is totally fine, it just had an older TV. 

They are all the main floor so no stairs. We parked our bicycles right in front of our room and it was very safe.

Staff was very kind and friendly. They have a cover garage with chairs where you can chill. It was very nice.

Location: Parqueadero 30A, Ciclovía, Fátima, Comuna 16 - Belén, Zona Urbana Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 0500, Colombia
Name: William Toyota
Description: This young man was trained by Toyota and worked for them for over 20 years. He found an opportunity to take over a shop and exclusively works on Toyota. He has worked on my lexus and my Troop Carrier and he does fantastic work with only Toyota parts. His contacts with Toyota run deep and he can get hard to find parts. He is honest to a fault.

Location: Autollantas Nutibara, Calle 32F, Fátima, Comuna 16 - Belén, Zona Urbana Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 0500, Colombia
Name: Autollanta Goodyear Nutibara

Name: Chagras Naturalia
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: Place has been reported open again in September 2024

Delicious food here. Highly recommended!

The food was all very fresh, the soup had Andean roots (ollucos, and others I forget), the main was delicious too - the salad had pickled and fresh veggies; the best salad we have had in 3 months in Colombia.

The restaurant supports indigenous communities and local campesinos/as growing veggies that are very unique to this region. 

The chef has represented Nariño/Colombia in international food festivales. We had no idea about this place just stopped here because we loved the big murals they have.

They serve Colombian traditional food focused on the Nariño cultivos - meat options too. We had a vegan fest here and the desert “chilacuan” was exquisite; we bought an extra to go! (They have them for sell).

Highly recommend this place

Location: Terminal de Transporte Terrestre, Carrera 2, Centenario, Ipiales, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, 524060, Colombia
Name: Bus terminal
Description:
Land borders are still closed with Ecuador. We biked to the border and were told that we could not cross. The options are: taking dirt roads to Tulcan or taking a bus to a big city to then fly to Quito.

1. Dirt road (trocha): we were told there are many robberies along these back roads. Robberies target anybody who might “stick out”. We were told this by local Colombians, ecuatorians in Tulcan whom we had been in touch, people at the bike shops we went, cyclist friends in Ipiales, and migrants who had recently taken the road in which unfortunately they got robbed.

2. Bus: we decided to load our bikes on a bus and go to Cali to catch a flight to Quito. There are many companies but we needed a bus with enough storage space for our bikes. We were recommended Transipiales or Boliviariano. We came to the terminal and got tickets (bring cash; there is also Bancolombia ATM inside the station) for the next day. We recommend buying 12hrs in advance.

Boliviano bus charged 50k pp from Ipiales to Cali, 12hrs. We caught the 8am bus; arrived at 7:15 to make sure we would be ready to load the bikes securely.

Bikes have an extra charge of 30k; you could negotiate this. We did not.

Location: Pizza de Pellicula, Carrera 12, San Antonio, Comuna 3, Perímetro Urbano Santiago de Cali, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, 760043, Colombia
Name: Tierradentro Café Restaurant
Description:
Very nice coffee shop-restaurant. Great brunch during the weekends. They serve mimosas as well. For vegans they have the avocado toast and fruit bowls. Most breakfasts include eggs, fruit, bacon, and coffee. It’s a nice place for cyber nomads looking for a good place w coffee, jugos and strong wifi. 

Covid: the place is very well ventilated and tables are placed under covered spaces in the patio or a big terrace. Staff wear masks at all times, there is hand sanitizer at the entrance. Important: we were asked to show our Covid vaccination card with both shots. This can be the actual card or a photo of it clearly showing your name, both shots. This is a new part of the protocol and many restaurants/cafes now have it as an entry requirement - Tierradentro is doing it.

Location: Flor de Loto, Carrera 16, San Cayetano, Comuna 3, Perímetro Urbano Santiago de Cali, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, 760043, Colombia
Name: Flor de Loto - vegan restaurant.
Description:
Small and nice vegan restaurant. It’s open Tuesday to Sunday (Monday is closed) from 4-10pm. The whole menu is vegan. They have choripanes, burguers and other fast vegan food. 

We heard they might be relocating by the end of December/2021. So they recommended to check out their social media (Instagram) for updates. If you are looking for lunch then check out their lunch spot at San Antonio called MadreSelva (included here in iO)

The Yupanqui burger or the Choripan are exquisite. Their burgers are quiet massive btw! 

It was delicious !

Location: Familia Ocampo Lopéz, Calle 2 Oeste, El Nacional, Comuna 3, Perímetro Urbano Santiago de Cali, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, 760043, Colombia
Name: Cayetano ApartaEstudio
Description:
We wanted to have access to a kitchen and found this place on Booking.

We paid 58k a night for a small studio with a double bed, a two-burner stove, a fridge, private bathroom w hot water, a closet, a plastic table with two chairs (good if you need to work), cable t.v, and a closed garage to leave our bikes safely. Our room was on the 3 floor and it had a big window facing the street w a great view of the neighborhood. It’s on a relatively quiet street, it was comfy. 

It’s a 3 story building with a narrow staircase and there is a big terrace (nothing fancy just a few chairs/tables with a nice view of the Cali and San Antonio) to chill. 

You can find it on booking as “apartastudios Cayetano” 

We were previously staying in San Antonio (just few streets up) and found San Cayetano to be more lively during the week; a lot of restaurants/cafes/stores/eateries are open *only* during the weekend in San Antonio because it’s more touristy. San Cayetano has more of a local vibe, streets at night are full of locals eating food, hanging out and there are more groceries, local bakeries, and food stands available. D1, supermarkets, fruvers, and tiendas are in every corner. It’s all 2 streets down from this location. Safe at night and folks at the other apartments are kind and keep to themselves, so it feels very private.

Location: Lenos Y Carbon, Avenida 6 Norte, Centro Comercial Chipichape, Comuna 2, Perímetro Urbano Santiago de Cali, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, 760046, Colombia
Name: Falafel y Más (inside Chipichape mall)
Description:
This was such a gem to find. It’s a Mediterranean food kiosk inside the chipichape mall (we were told this is an upscale mall). It’s in the first floor by the BBVA bank. 

Their menu is fantastic! We got the vegetarian platter with hummus, lentils, salad and really crispy falafel. Their menu includes platters w kibbes, chontaduro ceviche (!!), babaganoush, shawarma, salads, almond rice, jatafim, majadra, and schnitzel. They have limonada w mint and freshly squeezed mandarina juice; coffee and sodas available as well.

Really good !

The mall has a lot of clothing stores, restaurants and other services.

Location: Carrera 6, Jericó, Cabecera Municipal Jericó, Jericó, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056010, Colombia
Name: Hotel Santa Laura
Description:
Nice big brand new semi economical hotel just a few blocks from centro. If you don’t mind taking your rig through town they even have parking for 2 big rigs. 140K a night with breakfast. We left our rig at Ecoland for a few days. Jacuzzi on the roof at night. It was a nice break from the road and Jerico is a nice little relaxed town during the week. Weekend was busier.

Update: Came back for a second stay here and decided to park at the hotel after checking out the route. Be careful or you’ll get caught going through some tight streets and very steep hills. Google should take you up to the mirador and above the town a bit and then down behind the church. A few tight turns but not too bad. Go just past the hotel front door and parking entrance is on your left. No height restriction, but may be a tight turn for anything over 7 meters long. You can turn around at the bottom. Bit of a steep driveway.

Description:

It is a very tough road, only 4x4 vehicles!
The whole way there, the scenery  is breathtaking… Mountains, mountains and more mountains.
The most beautiful spot we have ever seen. Very few local people, really kind and friendly.
Highly recomended for those who like adventure, have the right rig and don’t mind being in the middle of nowhere without cell phone signal.

The road up is okay in dry season for most vehicles but I think a big rig could have problems (low hanging wires and narrow between overhanging roofs) . I recommend this place if you are traveling through minca :)

Location: Pueblo Bello, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Mirador de Montegrande
Description:
An amazing place to camp with a stunning view of the Sierra Nevada. 
They have a large area where you can easily put your tent or park your car/camping van. 
They also have a very nice waterfall -5min walk from the mirador-.

The mirador is 10km from the tradition Pueblo Bello -village of the indígena community of the Sierra-. 
The road to reach the Mirador and the village is in good condition (for motorcycle, bike cycle or car/camping van). 
Pueblo Bello is still very traditional, has an active industry (the mochila is very famous) and is very close to the authentical indígenas village (currently closed but should open again in January 2022). 

We paid 20.000 pesos per night for 2 for our tent. 

Rosa and Luis are a very friendly, chatty (in Spanish), helpful. 
They offer a number of services : beers, food, washing clothing ...

+573105097156 Rosa (spanish only) 

They plan to build up the place by putting kitchen, wifi, shower, billard... 
It's very nice !!

Name: Camping spot in a good location next to the river.
Description:
Camping spot in a good location next to the river. The infrastructure of the place is with bathroom, shower and energy.
It is possible to enjoy swimming pools with thermal water and also offer breakfast (I think it costs 2.5 USD)

Cost: 15,000 COP per person (4 USD)

How to get there: Before passing the entrance portal to the city (Road Cajamarca-Toche) there is a gate on the right side, if the gate is closed you can open it and follow the path to the farmhouse. The path is approximately 500 meters.

WiFi: There is no cell phone signal in the region, but the owners of the site have satellite internet, in case they need it.

Location: Salinas de Upin, Restrepo, Piedemonte, Meta, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje Amanecer Llareno
Description: This is a ‘Balneario’ with cheap rooms and a restaurant attached. Super friendly local hosts, happy to prepare us food or drinks, and serve by the pool, gave us a complementary limonada jug on arrival. 70k COP for two people per night, private bathroom. Secure parking. Family run and laid back. Two large clean swimming pools. I’d be surprised if they turned overlanders in vans away. Take Calle 7 to get here, last few kms is fairly narrow gravel. Can get loud at night however, dogs and rooster about.

Location: Mogotes, Guanentá, Santander, Colombia
Name: Pozo El Pino
Description:
A very beautiful simple campground, next to a natural pool and two amazing waterfalls.
The owners live on the premises  and sometimes put loud music on but not at night. If you are near the water you won’t hear it.
Owners are very nice, they charge COP $ 4000 entrance and $ 8000 pp/pn.
We recomend visiting during week days and off season.
Please contact Gerardo García at 3152758028. / 3154586873
They can cook for you if you ask in advance and sell beer/ soda and snacks.

Hot showers, power, kitchen undercover dining area… everything you might want. We pitched our tent in the shade of the little trees and slept better than in any Colombian hotel thus far.
Highly recommend, at times of writing price is COP 18,000 pp/pn
