We paid COP 80,000 for a king bed with private bath, I believe shared bath is 70,000.
Highly recommend if you want value for money.

Location: Calle 3, Chita, Valderrama, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Colonial Altiko’s
Description:
Best place in town, 70,000 for a queen bed, they let us park the motos in the little garage for the night.
It’s an ok place if splitting the trip from Monguí to El Cocuy (stunning ride, an must for anyone traveling 4x4 or on adv bikes, can be done with any vehicle but would be slow)
Owner of the hotel was super accommodating, village doesn’t have much to offer but it’s a resting place on an amazing road.

Location: Chita, Valderrama, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Mountain pass
Description: Amazing road for anyone looking for views and solitude. It’s a dirt road but passable with most vehicles, ideal for ADV bikes and 4x4. If you really want to be blown away do the whole road (Monguí to El Cocuy via socota and Chita) it’s breathtaking! Options to wild camp along the way or small hotels in the pueblos.

Description: Parked our van on the road next to the mirador Salto de Mico. The police said nothing would happen and they were right. Safe and overall quiet spot.

Location: Mirador de la Sierra, Carretera San Juan Nepomuceno, Güicán, Gutiérrez, Boyacá, 151440, Colombia
Name: Mirador de la Sierra
Description:
Small hostel with options to camp in either tent or van. The views are amazing and it’s very quiet at night. At 3500 meters the temps are fresh but not ridiculous, 
The owners of the place are very friendly and accommodating, we pitched our tent across the road in the paddock (less wind, better views) and were able to use their bathrooms in the restaurant.
We paid 15,000 for the 2 of us, our motos were parked in their car park… the serenity and vistas are second to none, probably one of the nicer places to wake up in!

Location: San José, Bajo Occidente, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Mirador Serranía los Santos
Description:
A mirador with space for a handful of tents and a parking place for vehicles. There's no restaurant but they have snacks and cold drinks. 
The people are very friendly and the views are spectacular. Sitting atop a ridge there's a view to two valleys. Awesome.
There's a rough, steep road up to the parking places and from there a steepish walk to the viewing platform and tent camping area. Bloody hard work on a bike but worth it. 
There's WiFi at least while it's open) and bathrooms (with paper) and cold showers. Bring food and it's a great place to stay. The tent camping spot isn't exactly flat but the views compensate.
There's no security but local houses are close, people very friendly and I felt totally safe as a solo camper.
Cost for cyclist plus tent 10k.
Also listed on Google Maps

Location: Editorial Vanegas, Carrera 5, Palenque, Salamina, Norte, Caldas, 172001, Colombia
Name: La Estancia Hotel Boutique
Description:
Salamina, Colombia

We highly recommend La Estancia Hotel Botique for your stay in the area. We loved it so much we circled back to stay again!

Jamie and Patricia, the owners are native Colombians who lived in the United States for a long time.  They are bilingual.  A huge help for the gringos with very limited Spanish. Loving care was given to this 130-year-old house.  Restoration done keeping the original charm. 

They have eight rooms available, secure parking on site for motorcycles.  Breakfast is included. 

We were covered in mud the second time we came. Jamie arranged to have our bikes washed, the sole of my boot reglued, and everyone’s boots polished!

Each room has a private bathroom and on site laundry service is available. A dry sauna and a rooftop patio with hammocks await. Adult beverages await you at their private bar. 1.5 blocks from the plaza

Good wifi, good cell service

Location: Six Avenue Hostal, #10-59, Carrera 6, Ipiales, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, 524060, Colombia
Name: Xantico Hostal
Description:
Clean, modern hostel with comfortable beds in the town center of Ipiales. Common kitchen and washing machines. Dorm beds are big and have lots of privacy. Hot showers. Dorm bed is $35,000 COL. 

Security guard at entrance helped push my motorcycle through the long entry hallway into the center common area for safe parking! Really nice people and a great find for the night before crossing into Ecuador.

Location: Calle 5, Onzaga, Santander, Colombia
Name: Cocina Traditional
Description: The best lunch we’ve had in ages. And this place is out in the boonies! This is the place to stop if your doing this dirt road. Served a hot soup on arrival, followed by a generous lunch portion, and refilling fresh juice.

Location: Estadio Municipal José María Hernández, Calle 14, Leticia, Amazonas, 910001, Colombia
Name: Hotel Madre Selva
Description: Very cool, airy hotel with a dedicated motorcycle parking. I paid about $20 for a none AC room but now I would recommend do get AC. Walkable to the town center. Super safe everywhere.

Location: Via Ferrera, Lebrija, Rionegro, Metropolitana, Santander, Colombia
Name: Via Ferrera
Description:
If you like adventure, you have the right vehicle for it (4x4, small van or ADV bike) you owe it to yourself to take a trip down this ex-railway track… for those looking for YouTube content, this might get you some views!
I am not going to add any photos to this post, you just got to come and see!!! If you are scared of heights or not comfortable with sketchy roads, maybe best you pass! NO BIG RIGS  or anything wider that a land cruiser! Height restriction to be considered but anything under 3meters should be fine… enjoy!

Location: Parcerito's hostel, #10-16, Carrera 5, Jericó, Cabecera Municipal Jericó, Jericó, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056010, Colombia
Name: Parcerito's Hostel
Description:
A beautiful hostel in the heart of the zona cafeteria, with prices ranging from COP 30 000 for a tent to 115 000 on weekdays for a large private with ensuite bathroom. Situated only 5 minutes by foot from the main town square of Jericó with a chill environment, a lovely garden, free breakfast, super fast wi-fi and shared spaces. Kitchen on site and outdoor lounge area. Hot water (electric heater).  Can be seen on Booking, Hostelworld and Google Maps.
Secure parking for a few motos,  bikes, or one SUV.
Parcerito's Hostel 
+57 3194554129

Location: Vía Curos - Málaga, Santa Bárbara, Metropolitana, Santander, Colombia
Name: End of pavement
Description: This road connection Malaga to Curos in only paved (more or less) for the 1st 20 or so kms on either end… it’s also paved between Guaca and San Andrew and then in a few random areas with paved sections ranging a few hounded meters to maybe 1.5 kms. The rest, yeah, nah… not so much! Mostly dust / gravel / rock with some less than comfortable sections. Lots of narrow sections too and of course the odd truck / bus (yes full size ones!) taking up the whole road with complete disregard to other road users. No 4x4 required but decent suspension helps! Allow at least 4 hours to make the trip. The views are amazing though!!!

Location: Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepción, Calle 13, Málaga, García Rovira, Santander, 682018, Colombia
Name: La Tapa
Description:
Probably one of the better place we have eaten at in the “off the beaten path” pueblos of Colombia! Nice restaurant, quite upmarket for a non-touristy place, our burgers were delicious (sooooo many options to chose from!) reasonable prices from 15k to 20k.
Glad we found this place!

Location: San Carlos-Vallejuelo-Palmichal, San Carlos, Oriente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Hotel Casa Campestre La Cascada
Description:
This beautiful old hotel can host up to 35 people. Delightful balconies, gardens and seating areas. 

The water falls with swimming holes below the falls are right out side their gates. 

There is a restaurant on site. We had the best fish we have had on this trip tonight. Francisco and his sister Gabriella run the hotel and speak good English. 

Great value for what we received. 

Huge property behind a locked gare. We paid 220,000 pesos for one bed two people. That price included two meals for two people. You can choose breakfast and dinner or breakfast and lunch. 

I contacted them through what’sapp. +57 311 6172522

Location: Catedral de la Inmaculada Concepción, Calle 13, Málaga, García Rovira, Santander, 682018, Colombia
Name: Mandala
Description: Nice little coffee / lunch spot. Didn’t have much in the ways of breakfast but lots of good coffee options, juices etc…

Location: REGISTRADURIA, Carrera 6B, BARRIO VILLA JARDIN, Málaga, García Rovira, Santander, 682018, Colombia
Name: Hostal Las Flores
Description: Convenient, cheap hotel close to the centre, 60,000COP p night for two of us. Large rooms. Set up more like a hotel, private bathrooms etc but there is a small kitchen you can use and full sized fridge. Large gated parking next door, no height restrictions. Abit loud at night as your right next to a main road.

Location: Cerrito, García Rovira, Santander, Colombia
Name: Alternative road
Description:
We were suggested this alternate (shorter) route as an option instead of the 55.
Standard dirt road not worse than others ;-). Pretty narrow but, hardly anyone on it and the views are AMAZING! Glad we took it, we had a lot of fun. If you are with a 4x4 or decent truck and especially with an ADV moto, you should definitely consider this road.

Location: La Pacha hostel, 64, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, 684039, Colombia
Name: La Pacha Eco-Glamping
Description: An ecological and affordable glamping hostel with yurts, hobbit house and geodesic domes plus campsite with plenty of parking space and electricity. Run by lovely Anglo Colombian family on their 4 acre organic farm. It has panoramic views, a natural swimming pool, Indian and vegetarian restaurant (amazing food) , campfires, a movie bus (!) and lots of spaces to chill out. 2 hour walk to Barichara or San Gil, 20 mins by car. Heaven!

Location: Vía moniquirá Santa Sofia, El Chobo, Moniquirá, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154290, Colombia
Name: Pozo Azul
Description: Beautiful swimming spot in a rocky mountain stream, not very flat but with various spaces for camping in 4-man tent. Popular with locals at weekends but should have the place to yourself by 6pm. Two minute walk from the tarmac road and a small museum, where you can park a car overnight or mid-size camper. Phone Don Jairo the owner +57 311 8488524.He will arrange for someone to let you in. He charged us $5.000 to park the car overnight but we also gave a donation to the museum. Campervan stay with access to museum and toilets costs $15.000 per person  negotiable.

Location: a Termales de San Vicente, Predio Altamira, Vereda Potreros, Canoas, Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, Colombia
Name: Cascada El Tigre
Description: Beautiful waterfall right off the road, maybe a two minute walk. If it’s hot enough it would be a good swimming hole but too cold for us. Nice stop on the way to the hot spring!

Location: Hotel Misión Santa Barbara, Calle 5, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, 684041, Colombia
Name: Hotel Mision Santa Bárbara
Description:
The first hotel in BarichAra. A beautiful old home restored to an old hotel. Pool, HOT WATER!, breakfast included secure parking for many motorcycles or cars. Close to the square. 
+57 313 423 1129
Www. Hotelmisionsantabarbara.com

Location: seguridad pricada EAGLE AMERICAN , vigilancia fija y escolta, Calle 6, Barrio latino, Comuna 1 - Centro, Perímetro Urbano Cúcuta, Cúcuta, Oriental, Norte de Santander, 540006, Colombia
Name: Dubai moto racing
Description: The only place we found that had batteries for large motos… there  are a number of other shops around that sell various parts for local style motos (lights, plugs oils etc…)

Location: Carrera 4, Santiago, Centro, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: Hostal Villa Flores
Description: Hotel in a tiny town of Santiago along the river, 80,000COP for a double room p night(2people). Large room. Big courtyard with a swimming pool in the middle, meals available  if you ask. Gated parking lot around the back. We broke down on the side of the road and this was the closest thing, lucky the hosts are friendly and they had space. A bit expensive for what it is but it’s the only choice around.

Location: Baré Hecho a mano, Calle 6, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, 684041, Colombia
Name: Terranat restaurante
Description: Wonderful food. Beef stroganoff and baby beef were excellent. Baby beef was cooked perfect medium. East to cut and flavorful!  We would come  back

Location: Finca la frecuencia, Path to Minca Glamping, Finca El Tabor, Minca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470008, Colombia
Name: Finca Frecuencia
Description:
Amazing place amidst Mountains and Cloud Forest. We stayed in a Bamboo House which was spectacular - hammocks, nice beds with mosquito nets, unbelievable terasse from which you got a superb view & there is even a fantastic temple to medidate, do yoga and calm down (also made of bamboo).
Food and stuff great as well.

Plan some time here, you will for sure love it!

Location: Hotel Bellavista (informal campground), Calle 46, Marbella, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 13001, Colombia
Name: Kutú Panaderia
Description: Bakery run by a very nice young couple who offers ball or baguette bread made with different flours. It also offers various desserts including black brioches stuffed with candied fruit and really good caramel sauce.

Location: Centro Histórico de Santa Marta, Calle 16, Localidad 2 Histórica - Rodrigo de Bastidas, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470002, Colombia
Name: Hostal Espiñolete
Description:
Lovely little hostel run by Danielle, the frendliest and most helpful colombian we met in out 4 weeks colombia trip. 

Hostel has everything you need such as kitchen, air-con, fans, free water, good bathrooms. For some extra comfort take the 4-bed family room. Location is also nice, in a quiet street, not far off the city center. 

Hostel has a 9+ rating on booking and i can highly recommend it.

Location: Sochagota, Vía al Lago, Paipa, Tundama, Boyacá, 150447, Colombia
Name: Free showers at “Club Nautico Colsubsidio”
Description:
Walk through the “club nautico de Colsubsidio” as if you were going to rent a boat, there are two bathrooms both with free showers! Also the bathrooms are very clean 

Camina por el club nautico de Colsubsidio hasta dónde se rentan los botes, allí hay baños con duchas gratis. También los baños son bastante limpios. 

Km 1 vía lago sochagota, club náutico Colsubsidio

Location: Carrera 10, Zapatoca, Metropolitana, Santander, 604069, Colombia
Name: Hotel Abadías
Description: Wonder clean big hotel close to the square with a huge private parkadero. Breakfast included. Very helpful staff. Hot water

Location: Notaría única, Calle 8, Horizontes, Filandia, Fría, Quindío, 634001, Colombia
Name: Allí no más
Description: A really excellent breakfast spot run by two sisters and their daughter. I ate here several times. Breakfast includes a pour over coffee, house made yogurt and fresh fruit as well as a breakfast entree of your choosing. The pancakes are delicious and wonderfully presented.

Location: Calle 30, Pie de la Popa, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130001, Colombia
Name: CJS Automotriz-Mechanic
Description:
Big place that fixes all types of cars and trucks.
Julian the owner is a nice guy and also an engineer.
Our Kia Sportage 2000 diésel, broke the engine, and here we were very welcome. They searched for spare parts. 
The place is always full. Have patience. 
Good place to solve your mechanical problems.

Location: Hospital César Uribe Piedrahita, 48-03, Carrera 7, Barrio Milla 1, Puerto Berrío, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, 053420, Colombia
Name: Casa Hotel La Mansión
Description: Great hotel close to the hospital with air conditioning, a pool, their private parking across the street and breakfast included. We paid 100k for two people one bed in a huge room. The pool was clean and a nice way to end a day of motorcycle riding!

Location: Popayán, Centro, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Green Hostal Popayan
Description:
This is firstly a hostel with 5 rooms (from 2 to 5 persons) but it could be also a place for 1 or 2 motorhomes. It could be difficult for big rigs to turn around but feasible because we did it with a trailer. 

Located 15’ road from Popayan in a Finca that the owners (a family) will make you discover surrounded by the sound of the nature.  Excellent communication with the owner, it is a pleasure to stay here. 

All commodities are present for you to have an excellent stay including a restaurant and breakfast. Very good place to visit Popayan and the area. 

Telephone number Sofia (Spanish / English speaking)
+57 319 3970 062
Carlo's number is: 3023808895, but he usually only answers WhatsApp. Another number is 3023808869.

Instagram for more pictures 
@greenhostalpopayan

Location: Hotel Jhon Marc, Carrera 4, Ipiales, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, 524060, Colombia
Name: Ipiales - Large indoor parking garage to do PCR test at Clinizad
Description:
We needed to do a PCR test around the corner at Clinizad and because the streets are narrow here and it's hard to park a van, we went to this large parking garage. Nice staff. Safe parking. 2000 Cops/hour. The entry door is really big and you have to park in the back, otherwise the parking spaces in the front will be blocked (see photo). 
If you can't fit in here, there is another open parqueadero one block further to the east on the left hand side.

Location: Migracion Colombia, Carrera 20A, Pie de la Popa, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130001, Colombia
Name: Migraciones - Cartagena
Description:
You are certainly going to use this place.
Make any appointment before through internet..
In Covid times, you need a Sita. Appointment.
We just made the extention of our Visas.
Cost: P$ 105.000,00(U$ 27,00) for extra 3 months.
We needed to make it because our car had mechanical problems and are now fixing it.
The staff here is very kind and very helpful.
You can prepare your extention through internet and come here only to pick up your documents and pay.

Location: Calle 30, 11 de Noviembre, Localidad 1 Cultural Tayrona - San Pedro Alejandrino, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470001, Colombia
Name: estacionamiento
Description: large secure parking for trucks, very large space, close to shops, noisy, people are very nice.  the bus passes in front for the center of Santa Marta.  very practical with a big rig.  5000 Cop for the night and 10000 for 24 hours

Location: Hugo's place, Calle 10, Taganga, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470004, Colombia
Name: Casa Tara
Description:
I stayed 10 days here, Andres was very friendly and allowed me to stay with my pet in a room with walking path to the garden (Very convenient for my dog). They cleaned the room every day. My pet waited in the house while I was outside during my scuba diving sessions. I payed $46000 per night. Single room with bathroom. Kitchen, living room and garden. Is 4 blocks to the beach. 

Andrés mobile +57 (316) 574-4227

Location: 27, Carrera 28A, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520002, Colombia
Name: Juan Sebastián Hotel
Description: Really glad I found this hotel! Secure, private parking garage, wonderfully hot showers, comfortable bed, clean rooms, decent wifi, walking distance to central Pasto, yet in a quiet area near the river. I paid 85,000COP including parking and breakfast.

Location: Casa Gregorio, Carrera 6, 20 de Julio, Puerto Nariño, Amazonas, 911018, Colombia
Name: Casa Gregorio
Description:
Casa Gregorio is run by the Dutch Heike her husband José and his family. This is the place where you should be for a unique jungle experience with and by local people. The accommodation is located in the San Martin de Amacayacu community. There are workshops and tours to book and Heike is a great hostess. She speaks Dutch, Spanish and English. The only way to come here is by boat via Leticia. If you make a booking you get a very clear description how you can come.
The contact for the accomodation is:
casagregorio@outlook.com
www.casagregoriolodge.com

Location: Ventas Populares la 16, Calle 16, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520002, Colombia
Name: Restaurante La Cabaña
Description: Popular lunch spot for locals for delicious inexpensive food. They have 4 or 5 plate choices, with soup and a juice for 7,500COP. Tables upstairs too.

Location: Sucre, Olaya, Occidente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Sucre ( calle cerrada)
Description:
Translation:Sucre is a town that is not usually very touristy but it is beautiful. It is a quiet place to spend a couple of days. We stayed three nights in this place, it's safe, the people are friendly and we didn't have any problems. if you come from the West do not stop coming to this place. Nearby you have the "El Salto" waterfall, a place to cool off.

Sucre es un pueblo que no suele ser muy turístico pero que es hermoso. Es un lugar tranquilo para pasar un par de días. Nosotros estuvimos tres noches en este lugar, es seguro, la gente es amable y no tuvimos ningún problema. si vienes por el Occidente no dejes de venir a este lugar. Muy cerca tienes la cascada "El Salto" sitio para refrescarse.

Location: La Catedral, 16-37, Carrera 26, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520002, Colombia
Name: La Catedral Café
Description: Wonderful coffee! Baked goods and food also looked tasty. Incredible garden out back with tables, very nice ambience throughout the cafe. Great service. Only wish I had found this place sooner, it is a sanctuary in the city. Since it is old town area, there is no parking, better to walk to it or find a parking garage nearby.

Location: Carrera 3, Coloradas, Santa Fe de Antioquia, Occidente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Parking Santa Fe
Description:
Big parking lot, accomodating all sorts of RV.
Paid 25 000 cop for 24 hours. Quiet a night, eventhough some buses or trucks leave eraly in the morning.
Within walking distance to town center.
Had  a carafon of agua purificada delivered to our camper from supermaket ( the guardian requested it for us).
Don't try to go to town center with your rig !

Location: La Plata, Occidente, Huila, Colombia
Name: Reserva Meremberg
Description: Nice nature reserve to visit with waterfall and native forest.They have rooms to rent.

Location: Hostel Casa Victoria Pijao, Calle 7, Pijao, Cordillerana, Quindío, 632060, Colombia
Name: La Cafetera Hospedaje
Description:
Cheap, cheerful, ground floor access a couple of blocks from the Plaza. Single traveller 20k for shared bathroom, 30k private. Allowed take bike into room. Very weak wifi. No.parking as far as I know and you wouldn't want to park on the street.
Cold showers but clean and very friendly hostess

Location: 90, El Totumo, Necoclí, Urabá, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Marianza
Description:
Translation:Don Ivan allowed us to park in the restaurant's parking lot. It is a very safe and quiet place next to the road. You have access to bathrooms which is very important.

Don Ivan nos permitió estacionar en el parqueadero del Restaurante. Es un lugar al lado del camino muy seguro y tranquilo. tienes acceso que baños lo cual es muy importante.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Mesón de la Tatacoa
Description: Established campground and restaurant on the quiet north road. Friendly owner, were quoted 20k pp to camp inc. use of the pool. May be able to negotiate down if don’t use pool. Small but packed fossil museum, included if camping, 5k pp if not. We had lunch there for around 20k pp (soup, large main, lemonades) but carried on to another place because there was virtually no shade options for tent camping. Valle de las Constelaciones was closed on this day.

Location: Calle 7, Isaza, Victoria, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, Colombia
Name: isaza
Description:
Translation:We stayed next to the police station, Commander Omar, who was very attentive and helpful, gave us water and guided us around the area. a very quiet night.

nos quedamos al lado de la estación de policía, el comandante Omar muy atento y servicial nos regaló agua y nos orientó por la zona. una noche muy tranquila.

Location: Hotel and restaurant, Berlín - San Diego, Pueblo Nuevo, San Diego, Samaná, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, Colombia
Name: laguna San Diego
Description:
Translation:a quiet place to spend the night, the parking lot is not very flat, there is a restaurant and a hotel.
You can take the tour of the lagoon by boat to reach some hot springs with little hot water. The boy's name is Jorge, super formal, he sold us fresh fish for 10,000 kg Cop. Parking costs 10,000 Cop per night.
We arrived at the hot spring by a path that goes around the lagoon.
4x4 vehicles or tall cars enter as you have to go through some difficult sections.

un lugar tranquilo para pasar la noche , el parqueadero no es muy plano, hay restaurante y hotel.
puedes hacer el recorrido por la laguna en lancha para llegar a unos termales de agua poco caliente. el Chico se llama Jorge súper formal nos vendió pescado fresco en 10.000kg Cop.el estacionamiento cuesta 10000 Cop noche.
nosotros hicimos la llegada al termal por un sendero que le da la vuelta a la laguna.
entran vehículos 4x4 o carros altos ya que hay que pasar unos tramos difíciles.

Location: Biblioteca Pública Municipal Francisco de Paula Santander, Calle 5, Palmar, Comunera, Santander, Colombia
Name: Palmar Plaza
Description: beautiful village between Socorro and Galan.  very peaceful and quiet during the week.  Sunday can be a bit busy during the day, but everyone leaves.  two restaurants nearby.  The plaza has the biggest tree we've ever seen.... absolutely picturesque.  Police are on the plaza and gave us permission to spend the night.  very safe and even worth a pass through if not stopping for the night.

Location: Hotel Wespedes, Calle 25, Escobar, Tuluá, Centro, Valle del Cauca, 763021, Colombia
Name: Hotel Morfeo
Description: Simple, very clean hotel a couple of blocks from the Plaza with ample ground floor parking for bikes & motos - other vehicles get free use of nearby parquedero. Poor wifi and cold showers. 31500 for solo traveller

Location: Vía Laguna de La Cocha, El Puerto, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Campestre San Vincente
Description: Just at the beginning of the road down to Laguna de la Cocha. Big flat area. Gigantic rigs could park here if they can pass the wooden bridge. Restaurant closes at 6:30pm. In the back of the building is another toilet and shower. Beware of „perros bravos“! This place has something very unique. The owner provides cages to „lock up“ your beloved pet, so it does not get torn into pieces by his dogs (NO joke). It is very quiet here and you get a nice view of the lake and the mountain range. Price was 20k pp.

Location: Orito, Putumayo, Colombia
Name: San Geronimo
Description: Swimming pool, possibilty to camp with tent on site or with your car in the parking lot.Loud music on Sunday at the pool amd from a Bar near by until 12pm. 5000 pesos per person for pool and use of the banos and showers in the camping area (clean).

Location: Hotel Wespedes, Calle 25, Escobar, Tuluá, Centro, Valle del Cauca, 763021, Colombia
Name: Hotel Jacinto Plaza
Description: Very decent place, ground floor access, store room for a bike, parking next door. 40k single traveller, cold water, fan, excellent WiFi

Location: Calle 3, Cepitá, Guanentá, Santander, 682051, Colombia
Name: Casona Tabecal
Description:
Very quaint hotel with eclectic decorations and relaxing shared space. Host is very attentive.  May need to call when you arrive in town.  Luz Dairi at 3108613184. Rooms are 70 for fan and 80 for A/C.  Mattresses
 hard but we had a good night. we couldn't find the other posada...

Location: Piscina municipal, Carrera 2, Cepitá, Guanentá, Santander, 682051, Colombia
Name: Cepita Municipal Pool
Description: refreshing dip when it's 33degrees out!  Best of all...5pesos!!  Beautiful cabanas (shared).

Location: Alto del Aguacate, Vía Alto Tierradentro, San Andrés de Pisimbalà, Inzá, Oriente, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Alto de Aguacate
Description: More burial caves, not quite as colourful and elaborate as the ones in Alto de Segovia but the view on the hike getting here make up for it. Well worth it.

Location: Mi casita, Vía San Andres, Inzá, Oriente, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje Mi Casita
Description: Family run hospedaje just a few metres from the park entrance. They have rooms with private bath, shared bath, and family rooms. Private room for the two of us was 50,000p night. Breakfast 8,000 pp, inc coffee and juice. Small rooms but clean, hot water shower, plenty of blankets. Parking space for a few vehicles, height restriction(see photo). They were very kind, did our washing for 12k, nice backyard with lots of plants, small cooking area and table we could use. Overall nice experience here for several days while hiking the surrounding trials.

Location: Carretera Pasto - Mocoa, Sibundoy, Putumayo, 861020, Colombia
Name: Hotel Las Garzas
Description: Roadside hotel on the outskirts of Sibundoy. Surprisingly lovely (although dusty) rooms, with wifi and hot showers for 50,000 COP. Also there is a water heater/cooler available, great for filling your thermos with hot tea. I was the only one staying here on a Saturday night! Plenty of parking, friendly staff.

Location: Terpel, Ruta del Sol - La Dorada - Puerto Libre, Puerto Salgar, Bajo Magdalena, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Gasolinera Terpel
Description:
Gas station, three water faucets available. Good price of gasoline.

Estación de gasolina, tres llaves de agua disponible. Buen precio de la gasolina.

Location: La Guaca Hostel, Carrera 12, Localidad 2 Histórica - Rodrigo de Bastidas, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470004, Colombia
Name: La Guaca Hostel
Description:
Nice hostel with good dorms and secure parking for motos. 35.000COP for dorm, breakfast included. Nice kitchen, AC in dorms, comfy beds with privacy curtains, cold shower but you don't need a warm one in Santa Marta. Dorms also have huge closets for lockers instead your typical tiny one that can barely fit your helmet. I was able to lock away both panniers and my tail bag and hang up my riding jacket.

Great staff and clean and secure. not the cheapest in town but a great deal for what you get. private rooms as well but not sure on the price.

Location: Drogueria Hilton, Avenida Carrera 5, UPZs Localidad Santa Fe, Localidad Santa Fé, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 110311, Colombia
Name: Quinta Av lavanderia
Description: lavenderria very close to the Macarena car park, price by weight, work done during the day, very well inventoried, washed, folded and packed.  we paid 50,000 cop for 6.5 kg of laundry.  (next door, there is a very good panaderia)

Location: Encenillo, Girardota, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 053080002, Colombia
Name: Mirador del Diamante
Description:
This is a great place during the week and it gets a little busy during weekends. We had it all to ourselves on a Tuesday night. It has cold showers, good bathrooms, you can buy firewood for a few dollars, charcoal, they have a grill and you can have a fire on the ground. Also sell beer and snacks. The ground keeper is a really nice guy who lives close buy so if you need anything just ring the owner and this chap will appear. We will be going back soon.

Whatsapp contact: +57 300 5878282 to let them know you are coming so you don't have to find the caretakers on their nearby farm.

Location: Vía Villeta - Guaduas, Cumbre, Guaduas, Bajo Magdalena, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Trucker pull off
Description: Very large dirt parking lot behind a couple of homes and a restaurant on the main road. Semi-trucks park here though it was not very full the night we stayed. No public restroom. Some hotels around, too. Big rigs, easily. Tents, possibly (depends if you’re comfortable with the semi-trucks). Pleasant view. Roadside noise. Simple and works for a night if you run out of daylight!

Location: Sesquilé, Almeidas, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Laguna del Cacique Guatavita
Description: Stayed in the parking lot at the laguna’s entrance. Asked for permission from the night guard and all was well! Level and good for one night. Wifi and restrooms available at the admissions. Wifi connection is spotty at best from the parking lot.

Location: Sesquilé, Almeidas, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Laguna del Cacique Guatavita
Description: Entrance to the historically sacred Laguna. You must go with a guide - short walk to the Laguna. Closed on Mondays

Location: La estrella, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Deep ruts
Description:
*Moderator Note: Please read all comments. 

Some deep ruts in this section. Nothing impassable currently, but worth a mention for those anticipating a drive along this road! . High clearance would make it easy. Stunning views!!

Location: EPS. INDIGENA MALLAMAS, Carrera 1 - Avenida Panamericana, Centenario, Ipiales, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, 524060, Colombia
Name: FABRIEXOSTOS J.V.
Description:
Translation:Parking and mechanical and welding workshop. friendly and hospitable. It has water and a rustic bathroom.

Parqueadero y taller mecánico y de soldadura. amigables y hospitalarios. Tiene agua y baño rústico.

Location: Terpel, Vía Rionegro - Aeropuerto, Rionegro, Oriente, Antioquia, 054040, Colombia
Name: Estación de servicio terpel
Description:
We stayed one night. We slept very well and it is very quiet. In the morning there is some movement because it is a bus parking lot so the drivers arrive to report their route. But it is very quiet. There is a bathroom, they can carry water and gasoline. It is a completely free place, just talk to the administrator and he will give you the authorization.
----------------
Nos quedamos una noche. Dormimos muy bien y es muy tranquilo. En la mañana hay algo de movimiento porque es un parqueadero de buses así que los conductores llegan a reportar su ruta. Pero es muy tranquilo. Hay baño, pueden cargar agua y gasolina. Es un lugar completamente gratis, basta con hablar con el administrador y el te dará la autorización.

Location: Dagua, Sur, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Quebrada La Elsa
Description: Sweet 2 tier waterfall, could be busy on the weekends but on a Tuesday we had the place to ourselves… stopped for a picnic lunch, option for a refreshing shower

Location: Carrera 3, Yacuanquer, Centro, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Restaurante La Delicia
Description: Restaurant with rooms upstairs. Basic, not the cleanest but for cold, wet cyclists a good hot shower!! No wifi, no parking. My bike overnighted in the restaurant. 30k single traveller

Location: Buenaventura, Pacífico, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Sendero la sirena
Description:
La Sirena is quite a spectacular place to go for a swim, not really because of the waterfall itself but more because of the surrounding forest. It’s in a deep slot canyon lush trees and vegetation, butterflies, birds… i think it was worth the trip up and the COP 10,000 for the guide which you get from the nearby tienda (you can probably make it without one if no one sees you but for the sake of helping the local economy a bit… $2.5 isn’t going to break the bank!)
Things to know before you go:
It’s a wet hike, you’ll have to cross the river a couple of times and it’s deep enough to get wet to your neck (and I am 2 meters / 6’7”) they didn’t mention that so didn’t bring a drybag… made it happen but best to know! You’ll definitely want decent shoes as it’s rocky, wet, slippery all those things…
Also, access to the village, as marked by my partner along the road, there is no access from the Buenaventura side passed aguaclara (road collapsed / no maintenance) and the road from the east side has partially collapsed 3 kms from El Danubio only allowing pedestrians and motos through. The locals are hoping for the government to fix the road but I have the feeling the rest will collapse long before there is any repairs being done!
Anyway, the ride down here is pretty spectacular and for that alone we are glad we came. Shame we couldn’t carry on as planned all the way to Buenaventura.

Location: Vía Perimetral Sur, Villa Ivon, Ipiales, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, 524060, Colombia
Name: Ipiales: Road to the border
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: WARNING! Theft reported in this location. Please use caution.

Attacked by four guys, pulled off bike and phone stolen. This was in broad daylight, about 5pm with slow moving traffic alongside. Nobody stopped to help, during or after.
All they wanted was the phone. 
(Trying to access online accounts on a new phone is frustrating! Think about proper backups separate to your phone!!)

Location: Carrera 32A, La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, 055060, Colombia
Name: Hotel Real Centro
Description: Clean rooms, cold water showers, no WiFi, 40'000 COP. Talk to Hotel Los Almendros in other part of town for contact.

Location: Carrera 14, Las Américas, Daniel Gutiérrez Arango, Caicedonia, Nororiente, Valle del Cauca, 762540, Colombia
Name: Machine shop
Description:
Small shop but very capable guys. We sheared a bolt on our pannier rack and they got it out within 10 minutes perfectly done. I am not easily impressed but these guy impressed me! They have drill press, lathe, welding equipment…
Across the road is a shop that sells all sorts of nuts and bolts in metric and footric, picked up the new bolt right there. Very successful morning!

Location: 25VL18_1, Buga, Centro, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Bendito Rancho
Description:
A very cozy place near Buga, with a delicious restaurant and beautiful little houses to rest by the river, where you can also see sloths.
They are adapting the place for campers and camping area.
The price per cabin is 200,000 pesos for a couple with breakfast included and some have a jacuzzi!

You can trek to the Miraculous Waterfall and different places!
The owner, Juan David is very friendly and very nice! Definitely worth a stop! Highly recommended!

--

Un lugar muy acogedor cerca de Buga, con un delicioso restaurante y casitas hermosas para descansar al lado del río, donde además se pueden ver osos perezosos.
Están adecuando el lugar para campers y zona de camping.
El precio por cabaña es de 200.000 pesos la pareja con  desayuno incluido y algunas tiene  jacuzzi! 
Se pueden hacer trekings hasta la Cascada del Milagroso y distintos lugares! 
El dueño , Juan David es muy amable y muy simpático! sin duda merece la pena hacer una parada!muy recomendable !

Location: Buga, Centro, Valle del Cauca, Colombia
Name: Hostal Café  Aquí me quedo
Description:
The hostel is a beautiful place where they are super colorful and very cozy! They serve delicious slushies and coffees, with sweets made daily and delicious cookies! It is open from Friday afternoon to Sunday! if you want to book the owner is called Amparo, very friendly, her phone is +5316 347 2835 Super recommended to visit and have a delicious coffee!
.....
El hostel es un lugar hermoso donde los hay! Súper colorido y muy acogedor!
Sirven deliciosos granizados y cafés,  con dulces hechos a diario y deliciosas galletas! 
Está abierto de viernes en la tarde a domingo! si quieren reservar la dueña se llama Amparo, muy amable, su teléfono es el +5316 347 2835 Súper recomendable visitar y tomar un delicioso café!

Location: 25B, Jericó, Suroeste, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: punto de servicio la pintada
Description:
It is a quiet place and trucks stop to spend the night. They have water, bathrooms, dining room, parking lots, they still don't have showers but they will add them in the future. A very complete place.

Location: Potosí-Otún, Santa Rosa de Cabal, Villamaría, Centrosur, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Mirador Laguna Otùn
Description:
I will give some facts to help decide if you want to come up here, but first let me say, we are glad we came… just a few things to know:

1/ The road to get up here is not smooth or relaxing! We did in on motos but no doubt in a 4x4 camper or truck you’ll get bounced around… it’s not challenging just 40 kms of rough get tiring after a while.

Like I said, glad we came, we spent 2 nights at the restaurant / soon to be hotel camping in one of there rooms.

2/ you have to leave your vehicle at the ranger station and from there it’s a 5.5km walk to the base of the mirador hill. It’s not an exciting or particularly scenic walk. It’s an all beat up access road, slippery in certain section when it rains, lots of lose pebble type rocks, not particularly pleasant, and that 11ams return!

3/ the hike up to the mirador is steep and you are at 4000 meters. The view however (if the weather plays nice) is stunning! But in my opinion the mirrador views alone don’t warrant the 11kms hike HOWEVER… if you have a few more kms left in you and you want to get adventurous there are some amazing trails up here (see photos) we ended up hiking a total of 17kms and 6 of those made it worth while. The trails aren’t super obvious or marked but, with a gps or a decent app on your phone you can do great things here!

4/ the weather… it all hinges on the weather. Most mornings are clear from sunrise to about 9:30 then the fog rolls in and well, there goes your lake views! And then around mid day we got rain. Talking to the locals that seems to be the trend (at least for the last 2 years) we started our hike at 0700 and headed back when it started to rain around 12:30… back at camp by 14:00.
So yeah, plan on going early which means, either start driving up at about 3:30am or sleeping up here (which we did) but consider temps at night are close to or just below freezing. There is only one sleeping option up here right now (see other post)

That’s about the extent of its, it’s a shame that 1- access road is so beat up and 2 that you can’t drive to the lake and start hiking from there (where it gets really good) walking 11 kms to get to the start of a good hiking spot with about 7 hours of decent weather window seems a bit of a waste but, doesn’t seem that park people have much interest in it all… shame really.
Also, no shelter, the mirador itself is falling apart (probably shouldn’t go up it) and when it starts to rain, it gets cold real quick so plan for all seasons up here!

Name: Colombian mobile providers: Foreign phones banned after 1 month without registration
Description:
Something we didn't know before entering Colombia: If you plan to stay longer than 1 month, you need to register your phone (not SIM card) with it's IMEI number with a Colombian provider, otherwise it will be banned and completely useless within Colombia (apparently, there is no way to unlock it once it is locked either).

You will get warning messages like this if you don't do it:

Tu equipo no esta registrado, hazlo ahora y evita sea bloqueado en 20 dias. Llama al *300 opcion 2 y sigue los pasos o ingresa a b.tigo.com/registrar

It's supposed to help against theft, but sounds BS to me. Anyway, the easiest way to avoid it is buying a Tigo SIM and activating it through their app or website. You can log in with your phone number and then go to Servicios -> Consulta tu dispositivos to activate it (the SIM card must be in the phone).

Select cédula extranjera and enter any 6 or 7 digit number, they don't check it. Once the process is complete, you get the following text:

 EL IMEI FUE REGISTRADO EXITOSAMENTE.

You can do it for multiple devices by swapping the SIM card around and repeating the process.

You can use the phone with any provider afterward.

Here you can see a lot of birds, monceys, caimans ect. That place is  is realy quiet and "Tranquilo". Señor Heiler offers tours. You can have a look to his  web site, or you can explore the  surroundings by yourselfes. It ist better to call Señor Heiler ( 3143319158) some hours before you arrive, otherwhise the gate could be closed.

Location: Marulanda, Río Blanco, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, 170003, Colombia
Name: Alto de Letras
Description:
Fantastic spot to stay overnight for
Free, with a lovely view of Nevado del Ruiz. several places for parking  .cbaside the road in a little town, nice people tell you where to go. We parked behind a house in ruins next to police station. Very safe and quiet. You can see the Nevado del Ruiz very early in the morning (6 am) just by a short walk/climb uphill (we got fumarolas wow!) No services but few restaurants/coffee shop where you can ask to use toilets. There is a place called TierrAlta where there is artisanal cheese made with European techniques.  The owner Julio is a nice guy that shows you the processing, great experience!

Location: Sopa de Letras, Padua - Alto de Letras, Letras, Herveo, Nevados, Tolima, Colombia

Es un restaurante con comida deliciosa y económica, los Dueños son muy amables nos permitieron pasar dos noches en este lugar, nos regalaron agua. Tienen servicio de baños y ducha. nos hicieron sentir como en casa

Location: Sub Estación Cambao, 45, San Juan de Rioseco, Magdalena Centro, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Opposite police station
Description:
The police picked us up at the Maggie shapely banks spot and told us it would not be safe there and we might get robbed. They were super friendly (quite the opposite of our experience in Mexico in a similar situation) and told us that it would be safer to park in front of the police station (this spot).

Not sure if it's really that dangerous or they just don't want anything to happen to tourists on their watch. Not sure how they found us either, we arrived quickly before sunset and only a few cars passed by at the other spot.

Anyways, a good place to stay and they even offered that we could use their restrooms.

Location: Centro, Norte de Santander, Colombia

Description:
I wanted to drive from Arboledas to Bochalema, but the street over the mountain was cut because of road work. On the way back I found this place.
 It is in a curve of a rocky steep road.
Access is at N 07°38`54.1" W 72°45`49.4"

The game includes explosives, although it is pretty hard to actually set them off (we managed once in the afternoon...) Still pretty fun though. You can buy drinks and food at the restaurant too. We got the rules of the game from here: https://impulsetravel.co/en/blog/98/how-to-play-tejo-a-guide-to-colombia-s-national-sport

Location: Hotel Vegas del Sol, Avenida 30, La Bocana, La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, 055060, Colombia
Name: Finca Hotel Pinares
Description: Good overnight spot operated by a friendly family. Clean, refreshing pool for cooling off on the hot, sunny days here. Nice new bathrooms and cold private showers. They had us park in a gravel area near hotel maintenance/laundry so not very scenic but quiet, private and with late afternoon shade as well as option to use 110v electricity(long cord required). Front desk sells ice cream bars and cold drinks. Good wifi usable from the parking area. We had a quiet weekday night here for 50k, 2 people and van. They seem to own two properties next to one another with the same name. Perhaps there are other options for parking etc.

Location: Vía al Mar, Baia Kristal, Serena del Mar, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130007, Colombia

Estacion de Servicio Terpel Altoque. Buenas area de parque y sevicios sanitarios gratis. Pasamos la noche. Solo piden que consumamos algo en la tienda  o compremos gas

Location: El Dorado Nature Reserve, Camino de Wimake, Cuatro casas, Wimake, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: El Almirante
Description:
Nice little finca in the middle of nowhere offering different camping options. I believe there are some really nice views here, but it was all cloudy when we arrived. They also offer food for a reasonable price (paid 20 000  for a tasty lunch).
Camping is 20 thousand per person, renting a tent is 50. There's also a simple 2-person cabin for 150. I guess there's also enough space for parking a mid-size motorhome.
The last 2.5 kms of the road aren't so good, so you might need a 4x4, or just walk leaving your vehicle at Escudo. There's no wifi, but a strong Claro signal instead.

the night was quiet just the sound of the waterfall.

30.000COP for two people.

They even made a quick check of all the liquids and checked the brakes. Excellent wifi.

Location: politécnico mayor, Calle 51, Boston, Comuna 10 - La Candelaria, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050012, Colombia

Better to take a taxi or something in that area.

Josué, the owner and his wife run the place, and are very friendly.
You negotiate the prices for everything. We started with P$ 50.000, 00 and ended with P$ 30,000,00 to camp with our rooftent and 2 Pearsons.

The buildings are new opend a year ago and still some construction going on. You need to make a reservation posible for afternoon or nigth. 
I did not know that and just showed up at the gate, made a reservation fore tha same day and paid in advance.
They let the pepole in, in groups. We were abuot 20 not more and the time is limited to 2 hours.
Entrance fee is 30 cop per person.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia

We weren’t able to continue much past this point, getting stuck in the soft sand and then unstuck, but then seeing a much larger area of soft sand and mud. Hopefully if it was dry it would be passable.

Very friendly people.

Kitchen is free to use as well as bathroom. Tents are 30.000 a night. The place is also on Google Maps including the phone number. They also offer food.

The road from Abejorral is all gravel/dirt and after Pantanillo, at times really muddy. 

Sebastian is a very nice guy, speaks English and grows his own coffee.

Description: Hotel with great location. Stayed here while motorcycle touring and used this hotel as a base camp to visit Tayrona Park, beaches, etc. Paid 60 COP ($15 US) single bed. A/C Easy to get to, on side of highway but rooms are quiet. Fast wifi. Secure locked garage parking. Rooms are basic but clean. Can’t see from highway but can walk around corner to juice bars, bakery, restaurant, motorcycle shop, etc.

Location: EDS Armero-Guayabal, Carrera 5, Zona Industrial, Armero - Guayabal, Norte, Tolima, Colombia
Name: texaco
Description: great place to stay for one night.bathrooms and gentle staff.

Location: Vía Gigante-Hobo, Hacienda La Loma, Gigante, Centro, Huila, Colombia
Name: Mirador Los Altares
Description: Really nice place with stunning views, good for relaxing and parking overnight, the place has restrooms, showers, restaurant, camping, good for big riggs, don't miss it

Location: Calle 8A, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154001, Colombia
Name: Hostal Tonito
Description: Just before the bus terminal (20 meters). An incredible beautiful place. Small, cozy colonial house. You can view the mountain and hang out in an almost personal living room. In holidays is 100.000 COP a private room for two people with private bathroom, tv, wifi and hot water. But in common days is 80.000 cop. Also if is a day during the week you can offer 60.000 cop and they could accept. In our case we arrived really late at night, and we only had 50.000 Cop in cash...as the rooms were empty and was late, they accepted us that money. Staying here is part of the beauties of Villa de Leyva. They have a kitchen. Not sure if you can use it but at least we use it to boil water. High recommended.

Location: Carrera 34, Comuna 12 - Cabecera del Llano, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680003, Colombia
Name: 24-hour Parking Lot
Description: Just got here. Clean and gated parking lot with a high clearance for taller rigs. Charged us 12,000 for 12 hours. Has washrooms and is near to a big park to walk dog and tons of restaurants. They lock the main gate at some point in night.

Location: Hotel Colonial, Calle 3, El Centro, Zipaquirá, Sabana Centro, Cundinamarca, 250252, Colombia
Name: Hotel Colonial
Description:
Nice old colonial style building with inner courtyard, ok to leave the bicycle there.
Single room 50k. Shower kinda warm.
Located very good for exploring the old city.
The only annoying thing is the bell, every guest needs to ring the bell to come back into the hotel so there are a lots of ding dongs 
They could sort it easily by why?
The building itself is very noisy anyway , like all this type of building. They got a Charme but better have the earplugs ready.

Location: Legends,barber, Barberia & tattoo cartagena, carrera 2, Carrera 2, Bocagrande, Tierra Bomba, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130001, Colombia
Name: claro sales and service
Description: giant claro store to buy SIM cards and get your phones registered. 40k for 12gigs or 100k for 80g. once your SIM card is working, don't forget to ask them to register the phone. it was an easy and fast process but they did not automatically offer that. there was a similar Tigo store like 2 blocks to the east if you prefer them.

Location: Presto, Avenida Calle 63, UPZs Localidad Chapinero, Localidad Chapinero, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 110231, Colombia
Name: San Fermín Bakery
Description:
One of those food recommendations that make iOverlander worth it. 
Here is a 1974 founded bakery and pastry that also serve breakfast and lunches till 7pm.
Very traditional, one of the best places in town to taste traditional Bogotan breakfast ( tamal, queso con chocolate y almojábana, caldo , Changua y muchos panes) . Good prices only cash.

Location: Los Naranjos, Guatapé, Oriente, Antioquia, 053854, Colombia
Name: Isla del sueño
Description:
You can camp on the island. It is flat inside and very quiet as soon as the boat go by the port.
To arrive there we rented a kayak 70 000cop for 24h
check the weather in order to avoid to be trapped by a thunderstorm.

Location: Troncal Central, Curití, Guanentá, Santander, 684037, Colombia
Name: Chocolo Colombia
Description: Regional restaurant with delicious local Santanderian menu. Definitely try their arepa chocolo with Aji.

Location: Urbanización El Ensueño, Córdoba, Cordillerana, Quindío, 632020, Colombia
Name: Soñarte coffee finca & campground
Description: This place is amazing! Patricia and her family have different spots named „soñarte“. These coordinates are where it is possible to camp. Few campers fit and for big rigs it could be challenging. You can camp on the parking lot or in the courtyard but max. 3m20 high camper can pass. Breakfast is possible for 10‘000 pp and need to be informed one day before. Area with billiard and tables in a beautiful setting full of birds. There are also very nice room to rent. The best part was the coffee tour in the finca with Patricia, 4 hours, very authentic & interesting, incl. coffee & fruit tasting! They have a Restaurant 15min walk from the finca in a beautiful setting with view over the town. Or the restaurant „Ancestro“ from her brother with great view and good food 15min by car. She also organised us a tour in a Cacao finca for the next day. Patricia‘s coffee is part of a association of women having fincas and producing their own coffee and do a lot to develop and keep the region sustainable. Best experience we could have wished to experience in a truly authentic coffee finca in Colombia! Very very recommendable!

Location: 25, Valdivia, Norte, Antioquia, 052037, Colombia
Name: Hotel Restaurante La Piscina
Description:
Stopped here after 8 hours of hard driving south from Cartagena. Unlike nearby restaurant parking this was flat and level. 
Supper for two and overnight parking was 28,000cop (~$7), we stayed for breakfast for 18,000cop (~$4), Sausage,eggs, cheese and coffee.
This whole road is narrow as it follows the mountains and the river, not many opportunities for level parking. at least this was level, and for a Friday night there was no party music which is a plus... 
Unfortunately the highway is a stone's throw away with typical truck traffic in the night...

Location: Las Colinas, Calarcá, Capital, Quindío, 632020, Colombia
Name: Cinco Cacao Experience & Camping
Description:
Wonderful experience in a Cacao finca of an adorable family! You can visit the finca in Spanish or English, then they show you how to make chocolate, you can try chocolate in all steps of the process and of course eat the best chocolate at the end. :-) incl. hot chocolate, as well as chocolate with fruit. 
There is a possibility to camp in their finca but this should be requested a few days before by Whatsapp/phone +57 318 876 23 47 Felipe. 
Absolutely recommendable and a truly authentic cacao experience with a lovely family!

Clean bathroom and outdoor shower.

Location: Las Colinas, Calarcá, Capital, Quindío, 632020, Colombia
Name: Cinco cacao
Description: Experience a Cacao finca visit with « Cinco Cacao »: visit the finca and then chocolate making, very authentic! See comments on « Informal Campsite » at the same spot.

Location: Carrera 44D, España, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130004, Colombia

Description: little micro brewery run by 3 friends for the love of making beer. they are using state of the art equipment and literally traveled the world to find good recipes and get the ingredients from Yakima and Germany. they currently don't have a pub open to the public, they said they are hoping to get one open here in August, but if you reach out to them on Instagram or Facebook you can go to this pin and buy their beers and they can give you a quick tour of the facility. the Czech pilsner was incredible and their American pale ale was very tasty. 12 bottles to go with the tour was 75k.

Location: Biofilm, Calle Principal de Arroz Barato, Arroz Barato, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130013, Colombia

Description: I had to modify our van to get it into a shipping container. I even went climbing with some of the guys and girls I met there. The staff is also the nicest people I met in Bogotá. 
Also I recommend this place:)

Location: Complejo Acuatico Simón Bolivar, Glorieta de la aplanadora - Calle 63 con Carrera 50, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Teusaquillo, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 111321, Colombia
Name: Driving Restrictions Bogotá
Description:
Pico-y-Placa driving restrictions.
Although I haven't heard of any traveller having problems, please be aware of the driving restrictions in Bogota and that you risk a >100 dollar fine (460k COP) if you drive on the wrong days. Weekend and holidays anyone can drive. On odd-numbered weekdays, vehicles with license plates ending in odd numbers are restricted, on even days the ones ending in even numbers. 
Foreign license plates are NOT listed as exception to this rule. The restriction is for the whole day approx. 6am to 9pm (hard to get info on the most up-to date hours, as it changes) .


This does not apply for vehicles with foreign plates.

Description: We stopped here at an former petrol station as it had sign for water. Asked the guy there and we could fil up our car tank with the water a the washing station (right hand).

Location: Sibundoy, Putumayo, 861020, Colombia
Name: Central Park - free WiFi
Description: There isn’t much service in this town but you can get free WiFi in the Central Park. The WiFi name is Zona+Digital Mejor Pais.

Location: Vía Uribia - Puerto Bolívar, Terminal de Carbones del Cerrejón, Uribia, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Turn off to Cabo de la Vela
Description: This is the turn-off to the easiest road to Cabo de la Vela. Dirt road, but perfectly doable in any 2WD.

Location: Terra verde Camping, Vía Baranoa - Juan de Acosta, Baranoa, Atlántico, 082020, Colombia
Name: Terra Verde
Description: A very nice campground in the forest next to a small river. Natural pools, tables, some activities and a restaurant. Very helpful and friendly staff. The place has some hanging cabanas (built by an architect). You can not enter with a car!

Location: Hotel La Cabaña, Panamericana, El Tablon, Taminango, La Cordillera, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Hotel La Cabana
Description: Good hotel to stay overnight when it gets dark. 25000 COP for double room with bathroom. Cold shower and garage for our van.

Location: Vía San Francisco - el Pepino - Villa Garzon, Chorlavi Los Salados, San Francisco, Putumayo, Colombia
Name: Restaurant El Refugio
Description:
I stopped here just as it was getting dark and they let me put my tent next to the restaurant. It was raining a lot and the area was not covered. They had another area that was partially covered and they let me put my tent there because I was alone but it did not help much. A few trucks at night with big headlights. Dogs kept howling and barking at my tent for an hour or two until they got tired. In the morning they open at 630. Breakfast is basically the same as you have in the evening with the chicken replaced by eggs :)
Not a bad place but the previous restaurant (was los Cristales?) would have been a better choice because they offered me a completely covered area
Here they had a good wifi.

Location: Estadero Tranquilandia, Vía a Punta Orión, San José del Guaviare, Guaviare, Colombia
Name: Balneario Tranquilidad
Description:
Super nice place like cano cristales with the macarena plant it's a balneario so they've got banos and camping.You can swin in the river too. You can leave the car just 1km before at the finca and walk (if you're not 4x4)for 4000 to park. The entrance it's 25 000 per pers if you're 2 but if you're more it's less. If you just want to make the river and just swin, not the sendero it's 10 000 per pers. 

The plant is only from june to November when you have rain so the plant can grown.

The guid is mandatory but it's so worth it (spanish one)

But it's beautiful and people are really friendly. 

The road to come to the finca it's possible if it's not too rainy without 4x4 because lots of holl. You can also go through the puerta of Orion where you have rocks formation too.

Location: Hotel Guara Mar, Carrera 17, Peñon del Rodadero, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 005075, Colombia
Name: Carpinteria El Paysa
Description:
Came here to make some wooden wheels to make my van fit in a container. They understood the task and started working on it right away.
Next to this place, there is a "Llanteria" and another carpenter ("muebles modernos"). I brought the plywood (bought at Homecenter). They charged me 12000 for each piece (I made a several extra just in case one broke or I needed to put double plywood on each wheel).
Took a morning to complete the work.

Location: La Cordialidad, Tumaco, Pacífico Sur, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Playa el morro
Description:
Public parking in front of the beach of "el morro" next to the hotel zone. The space is spacious and rural without infrastructure but close to several shops and restaurants in the neighborhood. The neighbors are friendly and secure. At 100 meters there is a small tourist police station that helps to know the tourist offer of the region. It's free. There is no bathroom service. But it has a privileged location in front of the most important beach in Tumaco.

￼

Location: Zoe School, Rodadero - Cruce Alcatraces, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 005075, Colombia
Name: Llanteria
Description:
Got ripped off at this llanteria. Came asking for another thing and ended up paying (very expensively) for a bad repair of a puncture that didn't exist before arriving to this place.

AVOID AVOID AVOID.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: grassy field with shade
Description: big grassy field with many big shade trees big enough to park the biggest of vehicles. completely flat. lots of birds. when we crossed in the end of July, the creek was dry and the river just to the north had a tiny trickle.

Location: Pollo Sorpresa, Carrera 25, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520002, Colombia
Name: La María Cafés Especiales
Description:
For those of you who like a good specialty coffee, this cafe roast their own beans and has a very good pour over. A bit pricy at 12k for 300ml. They say para compartir but for me it is one single cup ;)
I did not like the espresso though, which was with a coffee which was alcoholic fermented. Quite an experience but not for me. I like the espresso sweet with some acidity but not with wine notes
I tried the pink bourbon on v60 which was excellent. 
Fast wifi. Relaxed ambiance. Entrance is very small door around the corner from the plaza…

Location: Teatro Imperial, Carrera 26, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520002, Colombia
Name: Moneta, café y memoria
Description:
This is the first place you should try if you are looking for specialty coffee in Pasto. Really friendly welcome. Also great coffee and not expensive like La Maria. Atmosphere is great.
They roast their coffee but work with different coffee fincas or producers in Nariño which is one of the hubs of specialty coffee in Colombia. 80% of the coffee in Nariño is specialty and is mostly exported but thanks to the educational work of some coffee shops like this one, more people are trying specialty coffee, coffee which is delicate and sweet without needing sugar, far away from the bitter tinted which are sold on the streets which are cheap coffee, a mix of lower quality pasilla beans and imported robusta
Try their pour overs, really delicious coffee. If you like give the Vandals a try. It is like a chemex but with cloth and made of ceramic.

Location: Escudo, Camino de Wimake, Cuatro casas, Wimake, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Restaurant parking area
Description:
We drove to Escudo with our RV. The road is in very good condition (all tarmac). We had more difficulties with the low hanging trees and wires (our height is 3.2m).
We asked a guy in the village and he said we should not park on the parking lot overnight (because of other cars that need to turn). So we stayed on the grass in front of his restaurant. Payed him 30000 per night. 
There is a viewing tower 2 min away (costs 3000$).
The view should be good, but we had lots of fog.

Location: Vía Voladero Fabio Boy, Tomine De Santa Barbara, Guatavita, Guavio, Cundinamarca, 271015, Colombia
Name: Tominé Reservoir
Description:
A very beautiful place overseeing the lake. Big flat space, surrounded by lush mountains. There are no neighbors, so it is very quiet and peaceful. 
Fabio, the owner is very friendly and you should contact him before coming to the campsite, so he can arrange opening the gate, as he does not live here. 
There are lots of activities in the area like hiking, biking and paragliding, which you can also arrange with Fabio.
During rainy season the entrance can be difficult if you don’t have a 4x4.
Cost is COP $15.000 pppn.
We love this place!!
Fabio Rodríguez 3132641115

Location: Gama, Guavio, Cundinamarca, 251260, Colombia
Name: Balcones de Siatala
Description: Bed & Breakfast. A cabin that offers all the comforts with Wi-Fi located in front of the Guavio Reservoir.  A viewpoint that offers an incredible view

Location: Vía Cienaga la Caimanera, Coveñas, Morrosquillo, Sucre, Colombia
Name: Maria e Fabio
Description: Beautiful safe spot in front of Maira's and Fabio's House directly at the beach. We spent 5 nights there and could use the clean toilet and shower as well as electricity. We paid 20'000/night for two people. They also have rooms for rent. An admirable, very warm and friendly family.

Location: Restaurante Tayrona, Carrera 22, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520003, Colombia
Name: Tayrona
Description:
Forget the “Mercer” restaurant close by, this is so much better. I had a absolutely delicious almuerzo (el plato del día) for 9k and it included the soup and juice. The two older people running this shop are also very nice 
They do also breakfast from 8am.
This was a tip from Liam, another cyclist staying at the Koala Inn ;)

Location: Estación de Servicio Primax, Intercambiador Versalles, Versalles, Calarcá, Capital, Quindío, 632001, Colombia

Amplias zonas verdes para camperistas y campistas, cuenta con todos los servicios, un lugar muy tranquilo y seguro, lugar ideal para pasar una buena noche y descansar, la señora sandra recibe viajeros con todo gusto, super amable

Location: Vía Santa Marta, Rio Negro, Dibulla, La Guajira, 446009, Colombia
Name: Acalypha Hostal
Description:
Very nice bungalows (110.000 COP for two, including breakfast) set in a lovely garden, run by an adorable French couple. There is a secure parking lot, no height restrictions and the gate is closed at night.
There’s a small pool and the breakfast is delicious! Homemade French bread and marmalades, fruit from their own garden, fresh juice, coffee and eggs to your liking. 
Owners will give you information on what you can do in the surroundings, like visiting an indigenous village or hikes along the river. 
It is close to the road, which you will hear during the day, but very quiet at night. 
Comfy beds with mosquito nets and strong WiFi in the bungalow.
Highly recommended!

Location: Vía Santa Marta, Rio Negro, Dibulla, La Guajira, 446009, Colombia
Name: Acalypha hostal
Description:
Translated:In the middle of nature wooded garden swimming pool secure parking ideal for recharging your batteries hiking along the rio Ancho village Kogui beach la Gaviota

Au milieu de la nature  jardin arboré piscine parking sécurisé idéal pour se ressourcer randonnée le long du rio Ancho village Kogui plage la Gaviota

Location: Aragones, 60, La Mesa, San Luis, Oriente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Zeus station shower
Description: Zeus station shower! Just before the bridge, at 500m from this point. There is the station Zeus and they had FREE shower. We didn't need gas so we just tip the guy. Clean and 2 different shower.

Location: Thai terrace, Carrera 22, Guatapé, Oriente, Antioquia, 053840, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero alto verde
Description: Parking 3000 one hour, we arrived on Saturday and it was not possible to park on the street. So here it was 3000 per hour so really interesting and lots of place.

Location: Carrera 6, Pitalito, Sur, Huila, 417030, Colombia
Name: casa del viajero, Yeimy
Description: resting place for every traveler, pleasant reception, kitchen, shower and comfortable bed. --- lugar de descanso para todo viajero, grato recibimiento cocina ducha y cama confortable.

Location: La Macarena, Ariari, Meta, Colombia
Name: Caño Cristales Tour -Agencia de Viajas y Turismo
Description:
We did the Caño Cristales tour with this agency and were very happy. We paid 370'000 COP per person for a full day tour incl. everything (e.g. park fees), which was a good price comparatively. You can also ask for an English guide. Groups are max. 7 persons. You can contact Doris, the manager under the following number: +573134996038. 

You can also sleep at the hotel here (80k COP for a double room), but we opted for one 2 blocks further: Posada los Cristales: Clean, 50k COP per room, A/C, dogfriendly, place for one high rig in the roofed shelter.

Location: 30, Chorreras, San Vicente del Caguán, Caquetá, Colombia
Name: Road No. 30 Neiva-San Vicente
Description:
As it was not clear whether this road (No.30) from Neiva to San Vicente can be taken (our friends took the long detour over Florencia for example) I set a pin here: Yes you can take the road, we had about 7 hours, high clearance recommended. It is very scenic (giant waterfalls next to it for example) but steep and in bad condition and there is a toll of 5k COP in contrast to the other one (Road No. 65 over Florencia). It is less busy, some houses of some villages are all marked with FARC markings but the military is also present. On the way out we took the route over Florencia to the main road 45 which took us about the same amount of time or a little bit less and which was in better condition.

I would still take the No. 30 if approaching from the North as you save the drive from Neiva to Altamira.

Location: Carrera 3, Altamira, Centro, Huila, Colombia
Name: Main Square Altamira
Description: Good option for a night if its getting late. Free parking at the main square, seems safe, directly opposite a municipal building and in the street next to it leading to the square is the police located. There are some cameras. Public wifi, for the rest no facilities. Spent a calm night here.

Location: Depresión El Vergel - Florencia, Florencia, Caquetá, 180002, Colombia
Name: another nice Terpel
Description: Terpel about 5km from Florencia. small mechanic shop on site. not many over night truckers and the road quiets down after 8. restaurant with decent typical food and beer that let us bring our dogs in. 2 bathrooms, it's to the right and down the ramp of the sign visible from the parking lot. no seats... but there is a pipe coming out of the wall, which seems typical of this area, for a decent cold shower. there is a water spigot with potable water down in this lower area you can fill from. there is apparently a hotel in site, but did not inquire. stayed in the lot off to the side door free.

Location: Simacota, Comunera, Santander, 683561, Colombia
Name: Finca Agroturística
Description:
Price is 5000 Cop p/p/pn.

A hidden gem, a gorgeous place to camp. You’re surrounded by nature and animals, right next to two rivers on a big grassy spot with a lot of trees for shade.

Very friendly people managing the finca and very generous, one of them speaks English. The camp is very quiet during the week and peaceful night, waking up to the sounds of the goats.

But the weekends are noisy !

They also offer food, have a little tienda, and offer horseback riding. You can swim in the river (the quebrada). Baños and showers available, but we did not check them out.

Plenty of space for several rigs and big rig friendly. Road is paved (with a lot of potholes) until you reach Rio Suarez, from there dirt road but doable for any vehicle. 

Highly recommended!

Location: Playa Hawai, Vía Ibagué-Gualanday, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, Colombia
Name: multigas de colombia
Description:
gas company with 4 delivery trucks. I was in playa hawai for a campervan meeting. a truck that fill a gas tank in the restaurant of this company accept to fill my 2 US 20 lbs bottle. Also they filled a US type RV with fixed gas tank 
call them at 3103445393 to locate a truck. this company is based in Ibagué.

Location: El Retiro, Oriente, Antioquia, 055437, Colombia
Name: Terpel gas station very quiet close to Medellín
Description: this Terpel station is a safe place overnight. the owner like overlanding. no trucks park here at night. it s close to Medellín with a bus. there is a D1 supermarket close by

Location: Calle 3, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, 418060, Colombia
Name: Italian Pizza
Description: This little place is owned and operated by an Italian expat who makes authentic Italian style wood-fired pizza. 15c for a personal and 25c for a family size. the small was at close to 15 inches across and easily filled me up. beers for 4.5c

Location: La Macarena, Ariari, Meta, Colombia
Name: Posada Los Cristales
Description: we stayed here during our stay in this town because they let us bring our dogs inside. 50k per night for 2 adults and 2 dogs. cash only and there isn't an ATM in this town. nice newer looking rooms with AC. new memory foam mattress were very comfortable! they have a parking area for 1 vehicle no height or width requirements but probably no longer then 7 meters would fit without poking out into the street. it's not secured but at least it's off the street. we parked our van right in front of the hotel without any issue.

Location: Comuna 7, Villavicencio, Capital, Meta, 500001, Colombia
Name: Street Parking
Description: We slept in this end road for 3 nights, it was quiet. We slept at the end of the road (we even left the car there and went to the city to eat). Locals say it is safe.

Location: Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154001, Colombia
Name: Escuela Herbolaria
Description:
Parking on the street is allowed safely for motorhomes and there is a room for rent, with bathroom services, laundry and water for refilling. Good Wi-Fi. In addition, medicinal plant extraction processes can be viewed with residents at the Herbal School.
.....
Se permite  el Parqueo  en la calle de forma segura para MotorHome y hay una habitación para rentar, con servicios de baño, lavandería y agua para recarga. Buen wifi. Además se pueden compartir con los residentes,  procesos de extracción de plantas medicinales en la Escuela Herbolaria.

Location: San Roque, Nordeste, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Eco Parque Santa Rosita
Description:
Great spot for camping, very beautiful and quiet (even on the weekend), right next to the river. The further you drive up, the more beautiful the places get. Very friendly people, ask for Carlos.

There is a little tienda, you can swim in the river. Big rig friendly. There are toilets and showers.

10000 pesos per vehicle per night. Follow the (easy) dirt road till the end, you’ll see the orange gate. Doable for any vehicle. Great for tent camping as well.
.....
Edit Sep 2022: You need to take the smaller-looking road to the south. See check-in below.

Location: Calle 4, Cáqueza, Oriente, Cundinamarca, Colombia

Location: Posada Jasmina, Vía Circunvalar de Providencia, Old Town, San Andrés and Providencia, Colombia

Description:

Jasmina es muy atenta y lo hace sentir a uno como en casa, el lugar está nuevo y bien cuidado. Las habitaciones son cómodas y limpias. Pagué $100.000/ noche incluyendo desayuno.

Lugar muy tranquilo y seguro. Cerca de Polideportivo. Una cuadra arriba de la plaza de mercado

Location: Vía Villeta - Guaduas, Cumbre, Guaduas, Bajo Magdalena, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Los Cristales
Description:
The arrival in Bogotá will take me very late and they have allowed me to have my vehicle safe inside a farm next to the Cristales hotel, owner Mr. Orlando Arroyave, everything very safe, I have slept inside my vehicle, the very kind owner has offered me the bathroom to take a shower and the next day continue my journey.
----
Me tomara muy tarde la llegada a Bogotá y me han permitido tener mi vehículo seguro dentro de una finca contigua al hotel cristales, propietario señor Orlando Arroyave, todo muy seguro, he dormido dentro de mi vehículo, el propietario muy amable me ha ofrecido el baño para tomar una ducha y al día siguiente continue mi viaje.

Location: Ruta del Sol, Caparrapí, Bajo Magdalena, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Botalon
Description:
Giant place where you can park your vehicle and sleep in it paying 5,000 Colombian pesos (1.5 USD), there is also a room for 25,000 Colombian pesos (6 USD), includes parking
----
Gigante lugar donde pueder estacionar tu vehículo y dormir en él pagando 5.000 pesos Colombianos (1.5 USD), También hay habitación por 25.000 pesos Colombianos (6 USD), incluye parking

Location: El Carmen, Occidente, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: Wild camping (Caracoli) next to rio
Description:
From the dirt road you’ll see a giant sign “CARACOLI” and a small road on your right. There is a parking lot here for people who drives a van or a car next to what seems to be an abandoned chill area. We went a little bit further down with our bikes and set up camp next the rio. 
Although, we put the tent and the bike in the little path (on the right when you go down) instead of right next to the rio, because it rained really hard and we thought the level might get higher during the night. 
We saw no one, and no one asked us for anything. If you parked in the lot, someone might come, although I am not sure. 
Sand flies of course, but incense works pretty well.
