El Mirador is an interesting tourist spot, where you can see the entire city of Barranquilla, from here you can enjoy a lot of the sunset, visiting mainly places to pass a pleasant mouse and at night, too, some people selling drinks and sweets. You are allowed to walk with pets and to park in front of the park to walk through the night and it is very safe.

El Mirador es un punto turístico interesante,  pues se puede ver toda la ciudad de Barranquilla,  desde aquí se disfruta mucho el atardecer,  llegan principalmente parejas para pasar un rato agradable y por la noche también llegan algunas personas a vender bebidas y dulces. Es permitido el paseo con mascotas y estacionar frente al parque para pasar la noche y es muy seguro.

Location: Parque Mirador Lago del Cisne, Vía al Mar, Puerto Colombia, Atlántico, 081007, Colombia
Name: Parque Mirador Lago del Cisne
Description: Great park with lots of shade and picnic tables on a lagoon. We stayed one night. Lots of locals come to have lunch and enjoy the breeze in the heat. Could fit one maybe two BIG rigs. Lots of space for medium to smaller.

Necesitarás agregar un numero de teléfono colombiano y registrarte,  pero es Wifi gratuito y con buena señal.

Location: Musunambe, Santiago, Putumayo, Colombia

Description:
it is the last station of the town, very small but right next to it they have parking space. Talking to the manager, he allowed us to spend the night and left the bathrooms open for us. we had a very quiet night

es la última estación del pueblo, muy pequeña pero justo al lado tienen espacio de estacionamiento. hablando con el encargado nos permitió pasar la noche y nos dejó abiertos los baños. pasamos una noche muy tranquila

Name: Aqua lavanderia autoservicio
Description: Here autoservicio is possible. Be careful its closed between 12h-14h but we clean it and went back to dry it. We had for 36 500 pesos for like 8kg, it's by pieces too.

Location: Mobil, Panamericana, Chachagüí, Centro, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Primax
Description: Large parking lot, clean bathroom. Arrived late.  We asked to stay and they told us that there was no problem. the next day they charged us 5,000 for the night. A lot of traffic.

Location: 25, Calamar, Dique, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: public área with roof and bathroom
Description: this is a public área with chairs and tables make for the people stop by take a rest eat in here and go to the toilet, also next is a nurse office, here you can park  for the night, and for sure camp in here, we are bicycle travelers spending the night here safe and  protect by the rain and sun

Location: Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, 684041, Colombia
Name: Burata Haus
Description:
This is a family owned complex that is being developed for tourism, up to date it has three cabins of different sizes and prices. We arrived at this sector looking for tranquility on the outskirts of  town where wey could set our tent and Camp for a couple of nights. We were welcomed to use a large flat and green area with no height restrictions. 
They are happy now to receive overlanders. They have a large flat and green space, with no height limit , any rigs sizes welcome. The road is not paved but is very well maintained even for small cars.  facilities are bathroom, shower, kitchen and other common areas that can be used. the host Ramon is very friendly and attentive. They charged us $20,000 pesos per person per night. Although it is the first time they have received overlanders, they are enthusiastic about the idea and plan to continue developing specific facilities for this area of ​​the farm. so each visit helps to make this place better and better. For reservations, inform Ramon prior your arrival +57 3188164284 If you want a more luxurious and private stay.

Location: Terpel, San Agustín - Popayán, Isnos, Sur, Huila, Colombia

Description:
Next to the Terpel service station. It costs 5,000 a night. the place is safe, quiet, surrounded by nature

Español
al lado de la estación de servicio Terpel. cuesta 5.000 la noche. el lugar es seguro, tranquilo, rodeado de naturaleza

Location: fabrica de biscochos, Carrera 5A, Piedras, Centro, Tolima, Colombia

Description:
I'll help you with a mechanical problem!

I offer you accommodation! 

FREE !!

Location: Panamericana, La Violeta, Rosas, Macizo, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Texaco Gas Station
Description:
New gas station in a region where it is not so easy to find fuel. Also, they have "gasolina plus" and diesel with techron (meaning: it has an additive that makes a little better than regular diesel where sulfur levels are high).

First we asked for water (another thing not so easy to find around here) and they showed us a tap where we could fill the water tank.

Nice people working there.

Location: Hotel Darimar, Calle 17, El Edén, Tolú, Morrosquillo, Sucre, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero Luxury. Safe and Cheap.
Description: Parking lot with bathroom and an improvised shower. We talked to the man in charge (Omar) and let us stay the night for 10.000 COP. safe and cheap.

Location: Calamar, Guaviare, Colombia
Name: Conflict zone
Description: As soon as we arrived authorities came. They were just worried about who we were. After realizing we are travelers they said this is still a conflict zone, it's not safe to be here. It was about to be dark so we had no choice but to stay overnight close to the police. The next morning we just left. It doesn't even worth it the drive, there is nothing to see on the way and the dirt road is still in really bad conditions; they are just starting to build a new road.

Location: Marulanda, Río Blanco, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, 170003, Colombia
Name: Fabrica de Ríos
Description:
Fabrica De Rios is a remarkable camping/glamping venue with exquisite views of Nevado del Ruiz, Nevado Santa Isabel, the city of Manizalez, Riosucio, Pereira and with great facilities. Hosts Alejandro and Alejandra are fabulous and offer comfortable yurts and bathroom facilities including toilets and hot showers (gas-powered and surprisingly strong!). You can also camp in tents or in your vehicle. They also have a restaurant with an extensive menu. Accessibility is via a 3k dirt trail accessible by 2WD.
Very cold overnight. 

* Be careful finding your way there, follow their instructions. There may seem to be a more direct route from Manizales, but it is a closed/private road *

Location: Calle 4, San Ángel, Sabanas de San Ángel, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Parque Central de San Angel,  Magdalena
Description:
San Angel is a small town lost in the middle of nowhere, but just like we got here by accident, the town and its people are very warm, if you can park and walk through the night in any street, for example at rededor del parque en donde hay seguridad, Wifi and servicios sanitarios.
San Angel es una pequeño pueblo perdido en medio de la nada, pero si al igual que nosotros llega hasta aquí por accidente,  el pueblo y su gente son muy cálidos,  se puede estacionar y pasar la noche casi en cualquier calle,  por ejemplo al rededor del parque en donde hay seguridad, Wifi y servicios sanitarios.

Location: Vereda el Salitre, San Luis, Centro, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Cascada El Mohan
Description: Amazing spot near a cascade inside a cavern. Run by a super nice family. Open only on weekends. 5000 cop to visit + 10000 cop to camp. Accessible by car but the road is 1- 2 km in dirt road. Food is reaaaaally good. Quiet. There is no one after 5pm. No wifi but 4g connection is good.

Location: Calle 1, San Francisco, Gualivá, Cundinamarca, 253601, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Campestre - Mi Pequeña Alemania
Description:
Nice restaurant offers typical german food (Schweinehaxe, Rindergulasch, Apfelkuchen). Entertainment by Otmar Gutmann with german folk music (from Heino to Rammstein).
The restaurant is placed on a rock next to a river with wonderful view to the natural forest.
We enjoyed food and Otmars hospitality.

Open on Saturday and Sunday. Also on holiday Monday. 12:00 - 21:00 h

Location: Victoria, La Dorada, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, Colombia
Name: Tuku Ecopart
Description: we are a beautiful farm that offers lodging service in a comfortable room with private bathroom and in a campsite with good lighting and fully equipped bathrooms, we have a river nearby, viewpoints, lagoons and many hammocks

Location: Transversal 9, Puerto Gaitán, Rio Meta, Meta, Colombia
Name: Hotel Puerta al Llano
Description: New hotel with A/C, private bath, flat screen TV, strong wifi & secure off-street parking. COP140,000 for a double.

Location: 45HL01, Campoalegre, Hobo, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Beach on the lake
Description: Very nice and quiet spot on the lake. There is a family at 100m who are really nice and gave us the thumbs up to stay here. The access is okay by car but a little bumpy until +/- 50m before the beach (we came cycling so we didn't really pay attention). We were lucky to have little wind so the mosquitos weren't a problem but it could be. You can swim but the rocks are slippery. 4g signal okay. Amazing view on the sunset ! You may wake up with cows around your tent ^^

Location: Antigua Ruta 45, Gigante, Centro, Huila, Colombia
Name: Access to the lake
Description: +/- 300m from the road. Nice spot with an access for fishermen to the lake + a hidden space perfect for camping. Please note road is currently not accessible by car because rocks have fallen and block the access at +/-100m from the road. You can go through by foot or with bicycles. No one here - even on weekends. You can hear the road but not too much. 4g signal okay.

Location: Zuluaga-Gigante, El Algarrobo, Gigante, Centro, Huila, Colombia
Name: Brisas de Mirthayu
Description:
a very nice house with an amazing viewpoint, the owner is very friendly. We paid 10,000 per person.
.....
una casa muy bonita con un mirador alucinante, la dueña es muy amable
 pagamos 10.000 por persona

Location: Parque 97, 19-15, Calle 97, UPZs Localidad Chapinero, Localidad Chapinero, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 110221, Colombia
Name: Hotel Parque 97 Suites
Description: Great value for a full-service hotel. US40.00 for a double with above-average breakfast. Luxury rooms with secure parking for large rigs. One of the better neighborhoods in town

Location: Quirama, Bravo, Calima, Centro, Valle del Cauca, 760530, Colombia
Name: Finca Paraiso
Description:
Free parking. it is about 30 minutes down an uncovered road but in good condition (we did it with a bus). On the farm there is a spa with waterfalls (entrance 5000 per person) and the parking is free and very quiet in the middle of nature. There is also a restaurant and cabins but I didn't try them. There is no phone line. Very nice! To get there: passing the bridge of the dam on the right there is a police CAI.  From there, the uncovered road begins for half an hour, more or less.
.....
free parking. queda a unos 30 minutos por un camino destapado pero en buenas condiciones (lo hicimos con un bus) en la finca hay un balneario con cascadas (entrada 5000 por persona) y el parking es gratis y muy tranquilo al medio de la naturaleza. Hay también restaurante y cabañas pero no los probé. No hay línea telefonica. Muy lindo! Para llegar: pasando el puente de la represa a la derecha hay un CAI de la policía ahí empieza el camino destapado de media hora más o meno.

Location: Riofrío-Salónica, Riofrío, Centro, Valle del Cauca, Colombia

Camping tranquilo numero de contacto +57 322 5078031 Tiene: baño con ducha, electricidad, amplias zonas verdes, río, zona de parqueo. por dos personas nos cobraron $30.000 aproximadamente $7 dólares

Location: El Dindal, Caparrapí, Bajo Magdalena, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: La casa el Caballo
Description: A place in case you have nowhere to go.  Although it is written as a camping zone, the place does not have basic conditions for camping.  The owner first wanted to charge me 30,000, and when I said that it was a lot, she reduced it to 20,000. Realistically, the price is 15,000. Shower and toilet in the owner's house.  It is very noisy from the highway, trucks rumble all night.  There are also 3-4 roosters that are very loud.  The village itself is very nice.

Location: Hostal Finca Cardonales, Carrera 6, Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631020, Colombia
Name: Hostal Finca Cardonales
Description: Excellent hotel-style farm lodging. Beautiful views of town. Short walk to main square but avoids noise & traffic. Secure parking. No height restrictions but tight turns may be difficult for larger rigs. USD 30.00 for a large single with private bath, fast wifi, flat screen TV and hot water. Private, outdoor seating area for each room.

Location: Paipa, Tundama, Boyacá, 150447, Colombia

around 20.000 per RV.

ESCUELA DE COCINA

Location: Vereda San José Del Triunfo, La Calera, Guavio, Cundinamarca, 251207, Colombia

This is a new campsite designated for Overlanders. The owner is super friendly, welcoming and communicative. Located in a beautiful valley with amazing views. Only an hour away from Bogota. Clean toilets, showers and a great communal kitchen. We stayed here while “commuting” to experience Bogota and the surrounding area. 
Ana’s number: +573212042388

Location: Vereda Montecillo, Guatavita, Guavio, Cundinamarca, Colombia

Offer some other activities. (slack lines, kayak, wall climbing lessons, guided tours, trail rides,  and more)
Wood cooking  spots available.
Pet Friendly.  Costo por persona en camper 20 mil pesos persona

Location: Almacen Agrogualilo, Vía Vélez - Landázuri, Zarandas, Vélez, Santander, Colombia
Name: el gualilo
Description: the rain was pouring. the night was coming. we found this parador with a quite inclined parking and a nice tienda. we spent the evening and decided to stay for the night. very friendly people. there is banos that we can use. noisy early morning

Location: Balcones de Oriente, 60, San Luis, Oriente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Hotel Balcones del Oriente
Description:
Dirt parking in front of the hotel. Asked the owner if we could stay for the night. We parked along the swimming pool, the only flat space.
A little bar opens very late an trucks stop there for a drink. It was a sunday night and loud music was on until 1 am.
Anyway, there were not many opportunities  on our way from Zapaquira to Medellin. We stayed for free.

Location: Centro Comercial Centronorte, Avenida Norte, Urbanización Las Quintas, Tunja, Centro, Boyacá, 150003, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero
Description:
Big dirt  parking lot for cars, trucks and buses. Asked if we could spend the night in our camper; First the man said he had to ask " el dueno" but after a few minutes told us that we could stay and only asked for 8000 cop for one night. arrived at 5 pm and left after visiting the historical center at 2 pm.
Quiet night.

Location: La Paz - Chipatá, La Loma, Chipatá, La Paz, Vélez, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hôtel Karol
Description: We wanted to camp at Hoyo del aire, but it rained pretty bad so we went on a hunt for a hotel to spend the night. We found this nice one in La Paz. 45 000 for a double room. Very nice room, clean, hot shower ( super nice bathroom ).

Location: Calle 88C, Francisco Antonio Zea, Comuna 5 - Castilla, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050040, Colombia
Name: Parque La 65
Description:
It is very close to the entrance to the city of Medellín. We parked in our van on the street, in front of some apartments, where they kindly provided us with water, laundry, Wifi and even invited us to bathe in their house.
---
Está muy cerca de la entrada de la ciudad de Medellín. Nosotros estacionamos nuestra van en la calle, frente a unos apartamentos, donde los vecinos amablemente nos ofrecieron agua, lavar ropa, Wifi y hasta nos invitaron a bañarnos en su casa.

Location: Colegio Integrado Ezequiel Florian, Florian - Jesús María, Centro, Florián, Vélez, Santander, 684541, Colombia
Name: Thysqua Refugio
Description:
Amazing place with a view of the Cascade. Owned by a nice couple, they offered camping for 20 000 pesos, and cabañas for 85 000 for two people. We did both, the cabañas are really comfy, clean and the view is breath taking. For camping, there is a palapa to camp under, bathrooms and showers next to it.
There is a rough spot on the road to get here, not sure a regular car can get through but we had no problem with our bikes. The owner said they will build a bridge soon.

Location: Hotel Mary, Calle 3, Ipiales, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, 524067, Colombia

gran espacio para estacionamiento de vehículos grandes

Description: Arrived after dark, got some food, which filled a void, could park for the night for free, road not very busy during night, baños only open throughout opening hours of the resto.

Location: Gazel, Calle 71, El Progreso, Comuna 5 - Castilla, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050040, Colombia
Name: Gasolinera Terpel
Description:
We asked permission to sleep on a Tuesday, there was some noise but we managed to rest very well. The boys at the firestation allowed us to stay and when the police arrived to ask what we were doing there was no problem. It is next to the Florida Shopping Center.
.....
Pedimos permiso para dormir un martes, hubo algo de ruido pero logramos descansar muy bien. Los muchachos de la bomba nos autorizaron quedarnos y cuando llegó la Policía a preguntar que hacíamos no hubo ningún problema. Está a un costado del Centro Comercial Florida.

Location: Saboyá, Occidente, Boyacá, 154601, Colombia
Name: Beside Road
Description: Not the fanciest, but a convenient spot if you’re in need of a place to spend the night. It’s an established campground with cabañas, a pool, and grass to set up your tent. It’s pretty dirty, the bathroom and shower are not great, but the guy working there, Daniel, is very very nice. There is a kitchen available on site as well. We paid 20 000 for two persons to set up our tent next to the chickens, but I am not going to lie, after thinking about it we figured it would have been best to keep going to the next camping spot 7km away.

Location: Libelula Azul, Vía al Mar - Troncal del Caribe, Santa Verónica, Juan de Acosta, Atlántico, Colombia

Description: I came here by bicycle with my dog. They let me spend a night camping on the terrace if I bought lunch here. It was much cheaper than paying for a hostel.

Location: Mariquita - Victoria, Mariquita, Norte, Tolima, Colombia

Name: duncan
Description: changed batteries here, effectivo is rey!

Location: Hostal Casa Loma Minca, Vía de Minca, Minca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470008, Colombia

Description: We offer bird-watching activities, hiking, waterfall.  With the best experiences, with a professional guide expert in birds and nature.

Location: Carrera 18, Berlín, Calarcá, Capital, Quindío, 632001, Colombia
Name: Taller Vallejo
Description: On our way from Bogota to Salento we had trouble with the breaks of our van. We found this mechanic on Google. He helped us immediatley and the pricing seemed fair to us.

Location: Calle 11, Sabana de Torres, Yariguíes, Santander, Colombia
Name: Parquedero at Hotel el Milagro
Description: A large enclosed gravel lot at the hotel for parking larger rigs. 10 foot tall vehicle no problem. We were traveling to the animal preserve nearby and when we arrived they said that we could not park there and that reservations were needed to take a tour (and they kindly helped us arrange that for the next day as they are volunteers and don’t have a lot of staff). This spot has slow (but available) Wi-Fi  and cellular 4G similar to much of Colombia, spotty. There’s also a single clothes washer they kindly let us use. An un-heated shower (nice temperature anyway) and toilet were also made available. The lot is guarded by two very friendly and well trained dogs. When the policia told our friends it was unsafe to stay in this town we spoke to the police and told them we were going to stay here and they said it was a very good and safe choice. We didn’t feel unsafe in the town, but North Santander still has it’s problems with extranjeros.

Location: Estacion de servicio Calibio, Carrera 9, Barrio aire de paz, Comuna 2, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, 190001, Colombia
Name: Primax fuel station

Location: PLATAFORMA, Carrera 4, CENTRO HISTORICO, Pamplona, Suroccidente, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel Hontibon
Description: Very nice hotel in the center of Pamplona, clean and spatious rooms, good shower and very friendly hosts. Private parking is on the premise, at least for motorcycles but there was also space for cars.

Location: Rionegro, Metropolitana, Santander, Colombia
Name: Balsas Paraiso Natural
Description:
If you like a quiet spot and refreshing water, you will find it here! Chill place next to the river with 2 big natural pools, toilet and shower. Pilar and her family are very welcoming - great place to relax.

Drive down the dirt road and cross the bridge, it’s the gate on your left.

Price 8kCOP/person/night

Location: El Maria, El Peñol, Oriente, Antioquia, Colombia

Description: Very safe place with spectacular views.  Is a place of pilgrimage.  Ideal for exploring the area (piedra Peñal) by car or boat.  Toilets available, but with coins.

Location: Cocora Trek, 10-11, Carrera 5, Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631027, Colombia

Location: 39-69, Avenida Calle 26, UPZs Localidad Teusaquillo, Localidad Teusaquillo, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 111321, Colombia

Description:
The Cologne Bigote runs an excellent pizzeria with his brother Mike.
There are also German delicacies every Sunday from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. (white sausage with pretzels, bratwurst, Bavarian potato salad, etc.) and of course good German beer. Enjoy it.

Location: Wharf, La Macarena - Loma Linda, Yarumales, La Macarena, Ariari, Meta, Colombia

Description:
There is no bridge here. However, with small vehicles, the Río Yarumales can be crossed with the help of a pontóon.

The road from Vistahermosa to here is not paved. The road is only recommended during the dry season (the more southerly the road is, the worse it is). High ground clearance is helpful.

Note: The original User who poster did not cross here with a 4x4 sprinter. See comment below for video link.

Edit February 2024: Bridge is under construction and should open 20th of March 2024.

Location: Troncal Central, Capellania, Pinchote, Guanentá, Santander, 684039, Colombia
Name: estacion Petromil
Description:
Large gas station, not the nicest but with a very large parking area at the back.  We paid 6000 for the night to the montallantas. away from the noise of the road.
We stayed here  because all the other places that we saw were either closed or too small for our big rig

Location: Selina Medellin Hostel, Calle 9, Carrera 32D, La Florida, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050020, Colombia

.....
Es un camping precioso, con acceso directo al río, restaurante, área amplia para carpas o campers.

Location: Bioparque los Ocarros, Vía del Piedemonte Llanero, Villavicencio, Capital, Meta, 500007, Colombia

Description: This is a small but very interesting Zoo. You'll get to see regional species like armadillo, tapir, capibara, anaconda, jaguar, cougar, monkeys and birds. Price is 15 000 COP per person (kids pay less). Parking is free and there is space for all kinds of vehicles. Restaurant and bathrooms inside. Very close to Villavicencio

Location: Nautilos, Sendero ecológico, Com. Negra Sapzurro, Capurganá, Acandí, Chocó, 278017, Colombia
Name: Bay Watch

Location: terpel, Carrera 1C, Sahagún, Sabanas, Córdoba, Colombia
Name: camping in an abandoned gas station
Description: It's an abandoned gas station, it's not working. I asked the tire lifter if I could stay camping in that place and he told me that there was no problem. He took care of my bike during the night, he was very kind.

Location: Libelula Azul, Vía al Mar - Troncal del Caribe, Santa Verónica, Juan de Acosta, Atlántico, Colombia

Description: we arrive at a restaurant and ask if we can stay camping on the seashore. They told us that we could camp on the terrace of the restaurant and that the place is very safe and quiet.

Location: Calle mocha, Zarzal, Norte, Valle del Cauca, Colombia

Nice location on the village square people are very nice to avoid Friday Saturday Sunday big music at disco not far away.

Buena ubicación en la plaza del pueblo, la gente es muy agradable para evitar los viernes, sábados, domingos, música en la discoteca

Location: piscina avandonada, Calle 8, Soata, Soatá, Norte, Boyacá, 151001, Colombia
Name: Juan Jose Rendon Park
Description: street next to nice park close to the police station, quiet night, locals said its a super safe town. we spend one night and home officed the next hole day. there is free wifi in the middle of the park. no facilities

Location: Reserva del Río - Torre 1, Carrera 44, Villa Carlota, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050021, Colombia
Name: parking in the street
Description: We spent two nights parked in this street with a 7m van, it's safe, quiet, the neighbours are very nice, we asked them for permission to stay.

Location: Vía Embalse Neusa, Tausa, Ubaté, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Mirador del Neusa
Description: Overview of the entire Neusa Lake. Great place to see the sunset. By car, motorcycle or bicycle.

Location: Carrera 6, Floresta, Ipiales, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, 524060, Colombia
Name: Punto Frenos
Description:
Workshop specialized in brakes, suspension and bearings for heavy diesel lines. senor Wilson is the owner. I had a bad rear bearing and they were able to change the part and repair it. It has a large patio and we were able to spend the night here, while we waited for the service to be finished, which ended on Monday.
---
Oficina especializada em freios, suspensão e rolamentos para linha diesel pesada. señor Wilson é o proprietário. tive um rolamento traseiro estragado e eles conseguiram trocar a peça e repará-lo. tem um pátio grande e pudemos passar a noite aqui, enquanto aguardávamos a finalização do serviço que terminou na segunda-feira.

Location: Mercaderes, Sur, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Very dangerous spot - don’t stop
Description: Very dangerous! Stopped  for 20 seconds here (first place to stop for 20km) and four police motors with seven police/soldiers came to us from all directions (they were not on the road before, they were on some kind of ambush) guns blazing and firmly told us to leave immediately as this place was “muy peligroso” (VERY dangerous). This was 16:30. Don’t stop anywhere outside of a village in this stretch

Location: Benposta, Carrera 11, Vista Hermosa, Ariari, Meta, Colombia
Name: La Posada Monte Real
Description: Great place to stay in Vistahermosa. Friendly owner and shop + restaurant right next door.

Location: Juan de Acosta, Atlántico, Colombia
Name: Clusupol Beach
Description:
I am Luis Barreto (e-mail: bkslmb@outlook.com), administrator of the Clusupol Becah site, I invite you to enjoy wonderful dream nights in front of our headquarters, where you can park your caravan on a flat site, with the peaceful sound of the waves and the refreshing wind of the sea, it is a pleasant, wonderful and clean place, on the beach of Santa Verónica (Atlántico), located between the cities of Cartagena and Barranquilla. Here you will have the careful attention of nice people, you can use WiFi, request a free cup of coffee when you wake up in the morning and make use of the bathroom, shower, cell phone recharge services; all for $10,000 COP per person (ppn).
---
Soy Luis Barreto (e-mail: bkslmb@outlook.com), administrador del sitio Clusupol Becah, te invito a disfrutar de noches maravillosas de ensueño en frente a nuestra sede, donde podrás aparcar tu caravana en un sitio plano, con el apacible sonido de las olas y el refrescante viento del mar, es un lugar agradable, maravilloso y limpio, en la playa de Santa Verónica (Atlántico), situado entre las ciudades de Cartagena y Barranquilla. Aquí contaras con la atención esmerada de personas agradables, podrás utilizar WiFi, solicitar una taza de café gratis al despertar por la mañana  y hacer uso de los servicios de baño, regadera, recarga de celular; todo por $10.000 COP por persona (ppn).

Location: ESCUELA VEREDAL EL TIRANO, Oiba - Las Gachas, El Arena, Guadalupe, Comunera, Santander, Colombia
Name: Parquedero by Las Gachas
Description: Just a little earlier down the road from the other posted spot on iOverlander for camping in your rig. A mostly sloped lot, but we stayed at the top of the lot in a flat spot for several days. Great views. A little quieter because it’s not right across from the cafe down the road. The owner of the lot is an older woman, grandmother to the young guy who manages the day to day, Jon. He’s an architect trained and worked in Bogota. Came home to run the lot during Covid. He was so generous, and when we said we were going to try and grab a taxi into Guadalupe he volunteered to drive us and show us around, with no pressure. We paid him a small fee for the ride. He brought his little sister along too. He also drove us to show us a couple other places. We paid him 10,000cop a night. Well worth it if you can grab that flat spot at the top of the lot. It’s also a less steep entrance to his lot vs the one down the street. We walked from his place down to the swimming holes in the river.

Location: Carrera 20A, Cereté, Medio Sinú, Córdoba, Colombia
Name: Carnivoros Grill
Description: We went here for lunch and got some starters and lemonade. Cheap and good food!

Name: Hotel El Endrino

Location: El Paraiso, Autopista Bogotá - Girardot - San Raimundo - Subia, Silvania, Sumapaz, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Taxaco gas station
Description:
We were on our way to Bogotá and the gas stations on the way were not allowing us to spend the night, until we found this Texaco gas station.  They authorized us, but charged us 7,000cop.  Parking is a little sloping, but for an overnight stay, it's OK.  They have a hotel and restaurant. 

Estávamos a caminho de Bogotá e os postos de combustível do caminho não estavam nos autorizando a passar a noite, até que encontramos este posto Texaco. Eles nos autorizaram, porém nos cobraram 7.000cop. O estacionamento é um pouco inclinado, mas para passar uma noite, é OK. Possuem hotel e restaurante.

Location: Biblioteca de proximidad La Floresta, 46 - 55, Carrera 86, La Floresta, Comuna 12 - La América, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050035, Colombia
Name: Library La Floresta
Description:
In the surroundings of the square La Floresta is not a good place to sleep anymore, as the streets are narrow. So for three nights we slept down the street from the library, and on the fourth night we came to sleep in front of the library, because that way we were able to use both the public library space during the day, and use the 24-hour Wi-Fi, as it worked ok inside the motorhome.  The street is not very wide, but for our Renault Master van it was ok, however big rigs can have problems.  At both points we slept we felt very safe and we had no problems with the neighbours. 

Nos arredores da praça La Floresta não é mais um bom lugar para dormir, pois as ruas são estreitas.  Então, por três noites dormimos na rua abaixo da biblioteca, e na quarta noite fomos dormir em frente à biblioteca, porque assim pudemos usar tanto o espaço da biblioteca pública durante o dia quanto usar o Wi-Fi 24hs, pois funcionou bem dentro do motorhome.  A rua não é muito larga, mas para a nossa Van Renault Master estava OK, no entanto grandes motorhomes podem ter problemas.  Nos dois pontos em que dormimos nos sentimos muito seguros e não tivemos problemas com os vizinhos.

Location: hotel mi guajira, Calle 9, Riohacha, La Guajira, 440001, Colombia
Name: History Travelers Agency
Description:
We did a 3 days and 2 nights tour to Punta Gallinas with this agency, and they allowed us to leave the van parked in front of the agency while we were on the tour.  The tour was amazing, our driver was excellent, the meals were delicious and plentiful, the rooms we stayed in were very good (we chose housing, but there is also the option of chinchorro - hammock).  As we were gone for a few days, we turned off the van's fridge, and Paola (the agency's owner) kept our food for us in her fridge.  She has a room that she rents to guests who will be taking the tour with her agency, and we stayed in this room before leaving for the tour, because it was too hot for us to stay inside the van, the room is very comfortable and the air conditioning worked. perfectly.  We recommend 100%. 

Fizemos um tour de 3 dias e 2 noites para Punta Gallinas com esta agência, e eles nos permitiram deixar a van estacionada na frente da agência enquanto estivemos fazendo o tour. O tour foi incrível, o nosso motorista era excelente, as refeições estavam deliciosas e fartas, os quartos que nos hospedamos eram muito bons (escolhemos habitação, mas também tem a opção de chinchorro - rede). Como ficamos fora por alguns dias, desligamos a geladeira da van, e a Paola(proprietária da agência) guardou pra gente os nossos alimentos na geladeira dela. Ela possui um quarto que aluga para hóspedes que irão fazer o passeio com a agência dela, e nós ficamos neste quarto antes de sair para o tour, porque estava muito quente para ficarmos dentro da van, o quarto é muito confortável e o ar condicionado funcionou perfeitamente. Recomendamos 100%.

Location: Sede Etnoeducativa Loma Fresca, Vía Santa Marta - Riohacha, Riohacha, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Jose Epiayu - Camarones
Description:
This place is a community of Wayuus Indians, where Jose is the leader.  We had an amazing experience with the locals. Jose saw us passing through town and offered to us to stay in his community (10,000 COP per night). He also offers a tour to see the flamingos (25,000 COP p/p). Everyone in this family is very kind and receptive, the children are very polite, we like to talk and play with them. The place has a beautiful landscape, but it is a simple place. They don't have running water, but they have energy. If you are open to having an authentic experience, we highly recommend this place. Jose number: +57 321 726 4461
.....
Este local é uma comunidade de índios Wayuus, onde o Jose é o lider. Tivemos uma incrível experiência com os locais. Jose nos viu passando pela cidade e nos ofereceu nos hospedarmos na comunidade dele (10.000 COP p/ night). Ele também oferece tour para ver os flamingos (25.000 COP p/p). Todos da família são muito gentis e receptivos, as crianças são muito educadas, gostamos de conversar e brincar com elas. O local possui uma linda paisagem, mas é um local simples. Não possuem água corrente, mas possuem energia. Se estiver aberto a ter uma experiência autêntica, recomendamos muito este local. Telefone do Jose: +57 321 726 4461

Location: Puerto Colombia, Atlántico, 081001, Colombia
Name: Muelle  de Puerto Colombia
Description:
The Puerto Colombia dock is a structure located in the municipality of Puerto Colombia, Atlántico, Colombia. Between 1893 and 1936 it served as Barranquilla's maritime terminal for the loading and unloading of goods and people, and until the 1920s it was considered the most important seaport in Colombia. Currently remodeled as a tourist attraction with a 300-meter pedestrian pier, plaza and restaurants on the outskirts.
----
El muelle de Puerto Colombia es una estructura ubicada en el municipio de Puerto Colombia, Atlántico, Colombia. Entre 1893 y 1936 funcionó como terminal marítimo de Barranquilla para el embarque y desembarque de mercancías y personas, y hasta los años 1920 fue considerado el más importante puerto marítimo de Colombia. Actualmente remodelada como atracción turistica con un muelle de 300 mts peatonales, plaza y restaurantes a las afueras.

Location: Monguí, Sagamuxi, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Ecolodge Chunzuá Tuche
Description: If you want to do a hike in Paramo de Oceta or stay a couple of days in this beautiful area, this is the place to be! Hard to get here with a car (with 4x4 possible, but they don’t have much parking space - although I am sure Maria will help you out), but perfect for people travelling by motor or bicycle. During COVID Maria worked very very hard to built wonderful ecolodges. She runs this place completely by herself and is trying to improve the region by planting a permaculture garden and cutting the invasive eucalyptus. We got to know her as our guide in Paramo de Oceta (see other post) and she showed us around at her ecolodge after. Her family has lived in the mountains for ages and she tells passionately about the plants, herbs, climate and biosystem, as well as about her fight to protect the area. You get a magnificent view of Peña de Oti, a quiet night in a cozy lodge and a relaxing bath in the hot tub. These kind of projects should be supported, so if you want to visit this beautiful area, I really recommend contacting Maria and staying a couple of days at her lodge. +57 (313) 479-8492

Location: Monguí, Sagamuxi, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: María Tours
Description: We hiked the Paramo de Oceta with Maria as our guide. Her family has lived here for ages and she knows everything about the region, the plants, herbs and animals. Due to the political situation access to the park is not guaranteed (there are some issues with local farmers who want to use the area for cow farming, but the cows destroy the paramo), so Maria is striving to save guard this precious piece of nature and doing whatever is in her power to restore or protect the paramo. She asks 50.000 COP pp and the tour takes all day. We can highly recommend her! 313 4798492

Double room with breakfast 315k. worth it!!! 
Possible to come with a van or Motorhome (all you need) but call before to find out if there is enough place (if the b&b is not full, they will receive you very well!!!) Maria Paula +573212407548

Car camping next to El Rosal park.  Park with courts, gardens and a small mall with access to restrooms and parking.  Opposite is a non-neighbouring construction.  Around the park there are various residential complexes.  Very quiet area, level floor.  Park suitable for dogs, children and picnics.
----

Al rededor del parque hay diversos conjuntos residenciales. Área muy tranquila, piso nivelado. Parque apto para perros, niños y picnics.

Location: Calle 2, Ciudad Mallorquín, Puerto Colombia, Atlántico, 080020, Colombia

Park in front of Colegio San Jose and next to Central Eléctrica.  Remote site, without much traffic of private vehicles and motorcycles.  It is better to place a tent away from the road and under the safety of trees and shadows.  Perfect place for car camping while the vehicle is insured.  Transit zone for school entrance until 7:30 a.m. and from 2 p.m. to 3 p.m.
----
Parque frente a Colegió San Jose y Junto a Central Eléctrica. Citio remoto, sin mucho trafico de vehículos particulares y motos. Es mejor colocar carpa lejos de la vía y bajo seguridad de arboles y sombras. Lugar perfecto para car camping mientras se asegure el vehículo. Zona transitada por ingreso escolar hasta las 7:30 a.m y desde las 2 p.m hasta las 3 p.m

Location: Calle 31A, San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, 684039, Colombia
Name: Best rated mechanic in San Gil, speaks fluently English!
Description:
We found Andy on google, his 150 4.5/5 star reviews convinced us to text him. After sending him a text he gave us a call soon after and we were very happy to hear he spoke fluently English (first mechanic in South America I guess). He and his father helped us out and gave us many good tips and tricks to prevent future maintenance, we used a couple of hours of their time and he did not charge us for that. Tough we bought some beers to show our appreciation. They are knowledgable and honest people and can help with most cars. We could even use their shower/toilet and sleep in front of their garage (see other post on Ioverlander for more info). Overall super recommendable! 

You can reach Andy on: +57 (316) 271-3781

Location: Calle 31A, San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, 684039, Colombia

Andy was a former tourist guide so knows a lot about area, super helpful! Neighborhood felt super safe and friendly! Overall super recommendable. You can call/whatsapp him: +57 316 271 3781

Location: Carulla Villa Susana, Calle 24A, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130001, Colombia
Name: Casa del Puerto Hostel & Suites
Description:
This is a VERY nice place to stay if you are shipping your vehicle from or to Colombia - the DIAN office for signing the papers is in 10 min walking distance, and if you sail from / to Colombia from/ to Panamá, the marina is 3 minutes away. There are shared hostel rooms and also regular hotel rooms, all with en suite bathrooms. Breakfast is included in the price, as is a nice pool. They have a well stocked bar, lunch and dinner are available. There are several sister hostels around town, offering free Spanish classes, Salsa lessons and free coffee all day :-) 
We just walked in and got a free room, booked it for 5 nights. Then we got our camper out of customs 3 days earlier than expected - we parked right in front of the hostel, we were allowed to plug in for electricity and also to fill up our water tank. We didn’t need the last night which was already paid for, so they just deducted the amount from our bill for food and drinks - we will stay here again on our way back to Central America next year, VERY lovely, VERY helpful staff, and a „guard cat“, Señorita Bella.

Location: San Luis de Palenque, Casanare, 853039, Colombia
Name: Rancho Llanerazo
Description:
El Rancho Llanerazo is a wonderfull and must see place to discover Llanos culture !!! Seudiel is an authentic llanero, proud of their traditions. 
Seudiel and Diana (his wife) welcome you in their beautifull traditional palm house where they make you discover through many activities the Llanos customs. Traditional music, stories, workshop artisania, démonstration of horse riding across the river, very good lunch with home product, walking tour and animals observation, cacao atelier, discover archelogical site...) worst it so much!!! 
you can spend a full day, and/or spend the night in a wonderfull house. 
The road (24km from San Luis) is not easy (better in dry Season) but dodable (we made it in Motorhome). The landscape is very beautifull (différent from the other natural réserve) with lots of animals (so many mono aulladores, caïman, turtles, birds, anaconda, osso hormiguero 
if you prefer you can easely come by boat. 
contact Diana for organise +57 311 8531265
a must to go!!!

Location: Troncal Central del Norte, Barrio Villa Betty, Soatá, Norte, Boyacá, 151001, Colombia
Name: Terpel gas station
Description: Small Terpel gas station road side, 24/7; small gravel parking lot - max two campers or one big rig will fit. Minimum traffic during the night - rather quiet.

Location: Terpel, Carretera de la Cordialidad / Troncal del Caribe, Villa Estrella, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130010, Colombia
Name: Terpel GLP / LPG Doña Manuela
Description: This is the only GLP /LPG station in Cartagena, open since 2021. It is still so unique that I was welcomed by the manager himself. You need a disc adapter, preferably bring your own, because the adapter at the station has a very small thread. Also it is made of sheet metal, so my solid brass adapter needed some persevance, but it fits just as well. You can pay with credit card.

Location: Vía El Peñol - Guatapé, El Peñol, Oriente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Parrilla Típicos
Description: We went to Piedra del Peñol yesterday and stopped here to sleep. Plenty of space, quiet, there is security overnight and restaurants and a gift shop. Don’t know about the facilities, but probably there is a restroom from the restaurant. We slept for one night. There’s Claro cell connection (4G). On the way to Piedra Peñol, there are other places to stop to sleep that seem good.

Location: Comuna 1 - Ciro Reina, Yopal, Casanare, 850001, Colombia
Name: Hotel Bon Habitat
Description: The only hostel in Yopal, just opened a year ago. Nice dorms with AC for 50k per night. space to park a couple of motorbikes inside. Looks like there's space to park a camper to the side too so definitely worth asking if you're looking for that.

Location: Corpbanca, Calle 19, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520003, Colombia
Name: soat seguro del estado
Description:
We get our SOAT here at the second floor. 
after trying to buy it in 6 shop in ipiales, a guy told us to come here.
it took more than 1h because any of our french car data made an error in the soat system. 
got a 3 month (no possible less) for 53usd. not cheap but seems to be the only way/place around the border.

Location: La Peña, Aquitania - Llano de Alarcón, Aquitania, Sagamuxi, Boyacá, 152420, Colombia
Name: Lakeside next to Virgin Mary
Description: Level parking, part grassy part asphalt, lake view. Only little traffic during the night, but almost every car, bus and motorcycle honk- to greet the Virgin Mary :-)

Location: Vía a Aguas Calientes, El Sifón, Casabianca, Nevados, Tolima, Colombia
Name: el Sifon termas
Description: the place is fantastic but be aware there is loads of sulphur in the hot water! if it goes into your eyes it will hurt preaty bad!☠️u will instinctively close your eyes for at least 10-15seconds..this could be dangerous if ur scrambling throu the rocks around here.keep a towel handy to dry your face!beware also Altitude+ hotwater will give u a goood buzz when u stand u up to leave the water! stay 20 min in and try how it feels.ENJOY! the place is magik! (without clouds and rain..)

Location: Carrera 8, Portachuelo, Rionegro, Metropolitana, Santander, Colombia
Name: El Crist Alto
Description:
Flat space for 3 vehicles. Paid $10usd per vehicle. 

Right off the highway but there is a creek flowing by that drowns out a lot of the
 noise. 5 resident dogs that are socialized and friendly. Not buggy. Cold showers across the footbridge. Clean restrooms, no tp. Covered picnic tables across footbridge. One or two bars of claro service. Not sure about Wi-Fi. 

Good spot for a night.

Location: Zona Franca, Palermo, Norte, Huila, 410006, Colombia
Name: Hotel Las Olas Palermo
Description: If you’re tired of choking on dust from the desert and need a good shower and A/C, we found this hotel a great value. 170K COP for 2 people with breakfast. It’s new and clean and has a huge pool. Neiva is not full of big hotels with big parking. It’s all little hostels downtown with tiny parking if any. This place is safe and easy for big rigs and right on the highway south out of town. Get here early or reserve because it fills up every night. Don’t let your Nav system take you over the tiny bridge crossing the Magdalena River unless you’re in a small vehicle. There’s a much bigger bridge to the south..

Location: Sendero de los Xilopalos, Vía a Tatacoa, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Sendero Valle de los Xilópalos
Description: Nice little circular walk through the desert down some little canyons and the river bed. Probably not fun after a lot of rain. Camping opposite or potentially here but we didn’t stay. 2k pp for the trial, mostly flat, takes just over an hour.

Location: Autopista Norte, Chocontá, Almeidas, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: El Fresal
Description: Small paved parking lot in front of El Fresal, a shop and coffee stop (place was founded by a Croatian family who emigrated after WWII). No amenities, and at the highway, so traffic noise, but good for one night. Asked for permission to stay in the shop, and bought a lot of sweet treats :-)

Location: Calle 17, San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, 684031, Colombia
Name: Parking Lot
Description:
This is secure parking for day use only. We parked here while our laundry was being done. Shaded. Left our dog in the car. There is a place right across the street that sells water in Garafons. 

Nice people. We paid 20000 per hour.

Location: Calle 17, San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, 684031, Colombia
Name: Punta Frio Metropolis
Description: They sell water in garrafons. Secure parking across the street. We paid 25000 for two garrafons.

Location: Montallantas Albeco, Avenida Carrera 7, Los Cambulos, Comuna Nororiental, Perímetro Urbano Neiva, Neiva, Norte, Huila, 410001, Colombia
Name: Very good car wash!
Description: Adding this because sometimes a good one is hard to find. High height limit, friendly and accommodating. Did an incredibly thorough job of washing the desert off our car including doing underneath properly. Snacks/drinks and toilets on site too.

Location: Barrio Los Robles, Pisojé Alto, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, 190001, Colombia
Name: Hacienda Pisoje
Description: An organic farm serving it's own coffee & honey in the middle of a eucalyptus forest. Not cheap, but definitely worth the stay in the house that was built in 1700. . All vehicles can reach it.

Location: Ricaurte, Alto Magdalena, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Xielo Skydive Hotel/Camping
Description: Newly built hotel with 8 rooms, next to the beautifully located skydiving Center. Rooms with A/C  and private bathroom. Cold (actually medium-warm) water. Extremely comfortable beds. No breakfast, no restaurant. The next grocery store or restaurant is 10 km away. Beautiful pool, from where you can watch people jump out of an airplane. They also offer camping. There is a separate shower/toilet building. Very clean. Very secure place, even with a night guard on duty. Don't let things outside, though. The bloody dogs steal everything. Ripped my 200$ hiking shoes apart.  Very strong WiFi. Don't miss this place. It's a beauty.

Location: EPM, Calle 57 Sur, Sabaneta, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 055412, Colombia
Name: down a quiet ally
Description: next to the gas station there is a dead end rd. some trucks from the company parked there .I camouflaged with them.surprisingly quiet night!

Location: Guaduas, Bajo Magdalena, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Sol de Verano Alojamiento Campestre
Description: Night fell and there was nothing on Ruta del Sol southwards - until we came by this small restaurant, behind which we could park and spend the night on the way to Bogotá. We had dinner here, simple but freshly prepared. Very friendly ladies.

Location: Vía Panamericana Jamundi - Villa Rica, Jamundí, Sur, Valle del Cauca, 764001, Colombia
Name: posto TERPEL 24h
Description:
Terpel station with ample parking and 24 hours. there are restrooms, water and Internet at the convenience store. good place to spend a night.
---
posto da Terpel com estacionamento amplo e 24h. tem banheiros, água e Internet na loja de conveniência. bom lugar para passar uma noite.

Location: Vía Anapoima, La Mesa, Tequendama, Cundinamarca, 252601, Colombia
Name: Peaje San Pedro on Route 21
Description: Small place right after the toll station direction south, there was a construction site and some trucks parked there as well. Not too much traffic during the night but you hear every truck breaking for the toll station. It was midnight and we had no other option.

Location: Plataforma Campíng Laguna, Sendero a Laguna Sabanas, Belmira, Norte, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Paramo de Belmira
Description: You are required to have a guide, and can hire one in town across the street from city hall. 3 hour steep muddy hike to an amazing landscape. The guide helped navigate some points where we would be lost. There's a waterfall on the way down. Belmira also has a basic hotel where you can stay the night and hike to the paramo the next morning when the sun is shining!

Location: Café de mi Tierra, Oiba - Las Gachas, El Arena, Guadalupe, Comunera, Santander, Colombia
Name: Trail to Las Gachas
Description: This trail to Las Gachas leads through private properties. At each one you have to pay between 1000-2000 COP (4000pp in total). But be aware at the 2nd property we got attacked by several aggressive dogs and the owners didn't care at all they just want your money. So we highly recommend the other trail from Guadalupe, which is public and free.

Location: Calarcá, Capital, Quindío, 632001, Colombia
Name: Primax
Description: Primax with free water hose and bathrooms. 1000.

Location: punta larga, Nobsa, Sagamuxi, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Hotel Puntalarga
Description: Traditional colonial-styled hotel. Very affordable rates and comfortable and cosy rooms breakfast included we pay $70.000 per person during week days.  Lovely gardens and it's pet friendly. around the area you have many things to visit. like Nobsa handcrafts. the Winery has amazing views over the valley. Totally worth it. clean and super friendly stuff. they went through hard times during the pandemic but they are getting back on their feet. highly recommend it.

Location: La Pola, Santa Fe de Antioquia, Occidente, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Riverside
Description: Not bad for a night. You turn around the trees twice to the river so in the night you are not visible. Bit of trash around.

Location: Pal' carajo, 3-30, Calle 12D, UPZs Localidad La Candelaria, Localidad La Candelaria, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 111711, Colombia
Name: Astromelia Hostal
Description: Very nice and clean Hostal in the center of La Candelaria/Bogotá. We booked the Hostel in Booking.com. The price for one night in a double room is 64800$/ 13 US$. You have a kitchen to use and shared bathrooms. There is a parking area next to the hostel. Safe parking for Motorcycles 5000$/ 1 US$ per day

Location: Vía Principal Puerto Valencia, Puerto Valencia, Inzá, Oriente, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Park in Puerto Valencia
Description: Street parking at the park, rather quiet at night, horses grazing in the park, some dogs barking, little traffic. No amenities. Had to stay here after a construction site and a broken down truck cost us almost 2 hours and it was dark. Felt safe, slept well.

Location: 37, Guadualejo, Páez, Oriente, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Armed Robbery - Road R37 between Guadalejo and bridge
Description: Had a run in with 5 armed guys blocking the street between Guadalejo and the bridge, on the way back from Tierradentro direction Puerto Valencia and La Plata. They claimed to be part of FARC. They didn’t ask for money, but asked for „tarjetas“ (don’t know if they meant credit cards or ID). Didn’t give them anything, and managed to escape unharmed with some minor damage on our camper including three holes from their pistols. Police told us that there are some dissident left-overs from FARC still active in Dept. Cauca. Be careful and if possible travel in groups of several cars.

Location: La Casona, Carrera 4, Monguí, Sagamuxi, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: La Casona Restaurant
Description:
Great traditional Boyacense Cuisine with a nice gourmet twist. 
Give it a go. You won't regret it.

Location: Hotel San Sebastián de Urabá, ## 49-50, Calle 46, Necoclí, Urabá, Antioquia, 057870, Colombia
Name: Beachfront Parquadero
Description: A corner parking lot on the beach .10000 x 24 hr. noisy at night til 2-3am. as all along the malecon, bars are open, but I survived.

Location: Chitiva Alto, Suesca, Almeidas, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Roadside
Description: Roadside wide corner with a fantastic view between Nemocon and Suesca

Location: Arboletes-Turbo, San Juan de Urabá, Urabá, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Pulled over
Description: Some weird guys in uniform just before the curve! kind of pulled me over, I was already wary ..he shook my hand and introduced himself showing the badge. I said nothing and left!!

Location: The Cranky Croc Hostel, 3-46, Calle 12D, UPZs Localidad La Candelaria, Localidad La Candelaria, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 111711, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero Arango
Description: Safe parking for cars and motorcycles. We paid about 10000$ per bike for 2 nights.  There is a good cafeteria inside the parking area.

Location: Lejanías, Ariari, Meta, Colombia
Name: Camping Guadalitos
Description: This finca is located at the side of Güéjar River, flat terrain that easily parks 20 or 30 rigs. A night costs $15.000 cop/person, they will try to charge for packages that cost $30 to $40 usd/person, but that is with food included (full pension). The entrance to the River cost $15.000  cop and you must pay a guide $50.000 if you want to see the up River and waterfalls. There is Wifi, bathrooms, restaurant and rooms. Bigs rigs can get here with no problem

Location: Calle 4, Camilo Torres, Lote 26, Comuna 8, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, 190004, Colombia
Name: Solar Panels and Equipment
Description: A good spot to upgrade your Solar system! Message them ahead of time and they can order any size solar panel for you in two days. They also have all types of Anderson cables and solar charge controllers, they even designed a cool solar bracket system. Prices are cheaper then Mercado Libre and half the price of the USA. Great guys! +57 314 3011434

Location: La Cosecha, Carrera 11, El Modelo, Comuna 1, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, 190003, Colombia
Name: La Cosecha Parridilla
Description: An institution! A must! Insanely delicious and always packed steakhouse. We keep coming back and ordering the Baby Beef. Around $10 USD per person

Location: Vía a Guateque, Machetá, Almeidas, Cundinamarca, 250840, Colombia
Name: next to the water fall
Description:
Wild campsite next to the road. 3 minutes away from the water fall.
We arrived at night so don't know the view.

Location: Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154001, Colombia
Name: Villa de Leyva dessert
Description: Wild camping next to the rural road. Not very flat but it works for one night.

Location: La Paz - Chipatá, La Loma, Chipatá, La Paz, Vélez, Santander, Colombia
Name: La Paz, Santander tour guide
Description:
We met Jorge at this location and he provided a tour to the “ hole in the ground” Hoyo del Aire” and cave Cueva del Molino. 

You might find the hole on your own but it’s “very” doubtful you will find the caves and/ or it’s inner reaches. 

Jorge speaks passable English and is a delight to be around. Our tour lasted 3 hours and the cost was $30. Well worth the money.

Jorge +573222201516 WhatsApp. Instagram @jorgematsa14

Location: Tausa, Ubaté, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Refugio del Neusa
Description: Campsite with nice lake view, restrooms and wi-fi

Location: Seguros Del Estado, 102A-34, Carrera 45A, UPZs Localidad Suba, Localidad Suba, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 111111, Colombia
Name: Seguros del Estado
Description:
Here you get your SOAT for Colombia. It’s important for foreigners to have a Seguros Estado.

You need your passport, driver license, papers from you vehicle and your DIAN.

We did our SOAT for 3 Month.

Location: Turbaco, Dique, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: finca jardin des délices
Description: Fabien and Ingrid - secure place for vehicle storage. Contact directly for the the price +573165068677

Location: 6-123, Calle 38, Barrio Escoflor, Zona Refrescante, Floridablanca, Metropolitana, Santander, 681004, Colombia
Name: Baterias Punto de Energia
Description: very good place for change battery. lot of choice with different price. Vehicle battery and cell solar panel battery. Very profesional and friendly staff. possible to park in front of the shop (even Big rig) open 7:30am to 21:30pm.

Location: Pitalito, Sur, Huila, Colombia
Name: Laguna Guaitipan
Description: Glamping by the side of a lagoon where you can hike, kayak and do canopy. very good infrastructure. We stayed in the parking lot close to the washrooms and the restaurant.

Location: El Salado, Guarne, Oriente, Antioquia, 050001, Colombia
Name: BIOHOTEL ECOHOUSE
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: Description provided by owner or manager.   
We are a Biohotel with 5 hectares of natural reserve, waterfalls, lots of flora and fauna, we are working to be the first sustainable hotel in Guarne, we implement bio-construction with art and friendly resources.
It is a retro hotel with vintage decoration at night everything comes alive with the lights. We have all kinds of accommodation for travelers and enough space to park your vehicle and camping

Somos un Biohotel con 5 hectáreas de reserva natural cascadas mucha flora y fauna estamos trabajando para ser el primer hotel sostenible de guarne implementamos la bio-construccion con arte y recursos amigables.
Es un hotel retro con decoración vintage en la noche todo cobra vida con las luces. Tenemos todo tipo de alojamiento para viajeros y suficiente espacio para parquear tu vehículo y camping

Location: Casa Borbon, 5-26, Carrera 8, Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631020, Colombia
Name: Acampada en la calle
Description:
We have stayed 1 week and it is very quiet. One block from the main park.
There are vehicle guards, so far we have not paid. Here going up the block we follow who will charge us Gas in the 10Lb pipe.
We got showers at the Combi hostel half a block down.
Nos hemos quedado 1 semana y es muy tranquilo. A una cuadra del parque principal. 
Hay vigilantes de vehiculos, hasta ahora no hemos pagado. Aqui subiendo la cuadra co seguimos quien nos cargara Gas en la pipa de 10Lb. 
Conseguimos duchas en el hostal Combi a media cuadra bajando.

Location: ESCANER AUTOMOTRIZ CARS ELECTRICOS DORADAL, Autopista Medellin - Bogotá, Doradal, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Santorini
Description: These are not the exact coordinates but once you turn a right here (at the Santorini sign) just take the next left which will lead you to a beautiful little village full of white houses. It will remind you of Greece. There are a few little artisanal markets and ice cream parlours etc. Very pretty touristy place.

Location: Transversal 47A, Juan XXIII, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130004, Colombia
Name: AutoTokio
Description: Very friendly staff and manager. Very convenient for an oil change. They have many Liqui Molly, Bosch, and Würth products. Windshield wipers, V-belts, oil filters. Many oils from Liqui Molly, Mobil, Chevron, etc. You can also just shop without having an oil change.

Location: Contratación - Chima, contratación, Comunera, Santander, 683071, Colombia
Name: Contratación meadow
Description: Two, maybe three spots for one 5m vehicle each. Close to the road, but not much traffic during day, none during the night. On the other side a small creek with clear water. You need to conquer a small ditch to get on the plot. But there are plenty of rocks. Barely cell phone reception.

Location: San Roque, Nordeste, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Dona Ana's Finca
Description: we wanted to go to Santa Rosita but the washout had gotten worse so there at the entrance to ecoparque we talked to a lady named Anna and she opened her little farm to us. room for 1 or to cars and good for a night or 2. really nice lady.

Location: Dibulla, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Dibulla
Description:
A super large parking lot nice location near the sea very quiet and safe.

Estacionamiento súper grande buena ubicación cerca del mar muy tranquilo y seguro

Location: almagrario, Vía Mamonal, Santa Clara, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130013, Colombia
Name: la posada del viajero
Description:
A nice hotel when waiting for a container loading with CONTECAR. 
It's a straight 500m walk to the entrance of the container storage. 
The hotel is clean and the beds are good. The pool is big and clean. 
There is well-secured parking at the back of the hotel, max 3m height to enter and there is a roof on almost all parking places (very nice to prepare your camper before shipment). Long crafter and sprinter type camper will have any problem parking in.
The fan and AC are working but the main problem with the hotel is the very noisy road. Try to get a room close to the parking lot. 
We didn't ask to sleep in the camper but it may be possible.
Breakfast was included in the price (coffee, juice, fruits salad, and 2 big eggs+cheese+ham sandwiches)
Taxi/Uber to the old city is 17000cop in November 2022

Location: Sogamoso - Pantano de Vargas, Paipa, Tibasosa, Sagamuxi, Boyacá, 150447, Colombia
Name: Roadside Wide Shoulder, Pantano de Vargas
Description: Beautiful view next to the road, works for staying for one night. AMAZING view in the morning.

Location: Tolú, Morrosquillo, Sucre, Colombia
Name: Playa Palo Blanco
Description: Nice and quiet place between Coveñas and Tolu. At the end of a sandy track directly along the shore. Asked for permission from the very friendly couple living there, had a nice chat. Only the sound of the waves at night, no traffic.

Location: Calle 16, Pueblo de La Calera, La Calera, Guavio, Cundinamarca, 251201, Colombia
Name: Altoke La Portada en La Calera
Description: It is a Gas station and its Altoke mini market.  It has good WiFi and good bathrooms.  no showers

Location: San Vicente del Caguán, Caquetá, 182010, Colombia
Name: Hotel Juanchito
Description:
If you are in San Vicente del Caguan and need a hotel with Parking and safe and good in value for money, with a good restaurant, and a gas station just by hotel, this is the place. 
Whatsapp in advance to make reservation. 
+57 (312) 545-9385
2.2 km out of San Vicente del Caguan
With nice sunrise views!!!
No hot water but it is not needed in this climate!!!

Location: Mercado del Parque, 73-136, Calle 39D, Bolivariana, Comuna 11 - Laureles-Estadio, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050031, Colombia
Name: Lavato Laundry & Cafe
Description: AWESOME laundromat. You wash and dry your own clothes (25,000 for wash/dry for 1 load, includes soap). Bonus, the cafe has amazing food and a really nice leafy, relaxing vibe. Laundry heaven. Street parking out front of the cafe.

Location: Dibulla, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: La Punta
Description:
Small parking lot on the spot of the quiet and safe village on weekends there may be a little noise.
Pequeño estacionamiento en el lugar del pueblo tranquilo y seguro los fines de semana puede haber un poco de ruido.

Location: Calle 23H Bis, UPZ Fontibón, Localidad Fontibón, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 110911, Colombia
Name: Parking/ Estacionamiento
Description: SaFe parking for Motorcycles and Cars. We park our motorcycles for 3 days here. Price is about 10$ Dollars per day.

Location: Vía al Mar, Tubará, Atlántico, Colombia
Name: Texaco gas station
Description: Right on the highway, but little traffic, spent a quiet night here after asking the attendants. Clean bathrooms.

Location: Bodytech, Calle 32D, Fátima, Comuna 16 - Belén, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050030, Colombia
Name: Huge fenced parking lot + garage
Description:
Huge fenced and 24h guarded parking lot + parking garage suitable for all vehicles. No height restrictions for the outside lot, for the garage it’s 2.20m.

Parked our rig for 3 days and had no issues.

Cheap hourly rates and special overnight rate 15000$ per 24h. Area felt very safe, also at night.

Location: San Vicente de Chucurí, Yariguíes, Santander, Colombia
Name: Camping al Caravanas
Description: An absolutely stunning campsite just on the outskirts of San Vincente de Chucuri. We paid 40,000 Colombian Pesos for our truckcamper for the night. There is wifi, beautiful outdoor showers (cold), sink, toilets, sheltered area with hammocks and an area to charge your devices. They have a huge field for tents too. Super quiet with just the usual farm animal noises. Horses and goats on the property and plenty of orange and mandarins for the taking. There is a waterfall nearby which we‘re going to check out. The nearby town is huge and has everything you need. Definitely recommend.

Location: Asadero Combia, Autopista del Café, Calarcá, Capital, Quindío, 630004, Colombia
Name: Panaderia artisanal
Description:
This place is an excellent bakery. You'll find Sourdough bread, Brioches, Pan especial, cheese bread, Rosemary bread and much more. You can be served warm bread with coffee. 
Hernando is the owner and he is super nice! 
Open every day except Monday.

Location: Vía Cienaga la Caimanera, Coveñas, Morrosquillo, Sucre, Colombia
Name: Quite campspot at seaside
Description:
Beautiful place to spend the night, passing the bridge next to the Ciénaga de la caimanera, we arrived and asked the owner of the restaurant for permission and he had no problem letting us sleep here. The sea water looks like a swimming pool!


Hermoso lugar para pasar la noche, pasando el puente al lado de la Ciénaga de la caimanera, llegamos y pedimos permiso al dueño del restaurante y no tuvo ningún problema en dejarnos dormir acá. ¡El agua del mar parece piscina !

Location: Vía a La Laguna Negra, Mongua, Sagamuxi, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: beautiful view between Mongua and Laguna Negra
Description: Great spot near the road, amazing Landscapes in the day and night.

Location: Como en casa, Carrera 11, Vista Hermosa, Ariari, Meta, Colombia
Name: Restaurante El Paisa
Description:
Good value for money colombian food- 
Delicious, many options, excelent and friendly service

Location: Terminal de Transporte de Bogotá - El Salitre, Diagonal 23, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Fontibón, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, 110931, Colombia
Name: Yellow fever vaccine
Description: Yellow fever vaccine available for free here. Queue starts outside door 4. Expect a long wait since it's free, I waited 3 hours on a Saturday afternoon, probably not a good time to go. Bring your passport so they can put the right details on the vaccine card.

Location: Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631027, Colombia
Name: Hotel Rancho de Salento
Description: Very nice and relaxing hotel near Salento. Wonderful views, hiking options and beautiful environment. They have fibra, high-quality and high speed internet, which makes it a perfect spot for digital nomad travelers. The price includes breakfast. The owner Alberto is very nice and he will help you to organize your stay in the Eje Cafetero.

Location: Camping and Glamping, Camino del Indio, Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631027, Colombia
Name: family restaurants and activities
Description: This is a very nice place to spend the weekend in a family environment. You have 4 different restaurants and activities for kids and adults: mini-golf, zip line, jumping, Toro loco...

Location: Calle 2, Buga, Centro, Valle del Cauca, 763041, Colombia
Name: Gas del Valle
Description: They filled up our American 20lb bottles of gas. The access is tricky, take the dirty road just before the trail way. You can call Widmar and he will send you the GPS point. The number is on the picture.

Location: La Linda, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056050, Colombia
Name: Wild camping in the coffee hills of Jardín
Description:
If you go up the road to Morro Amarillo almost to the top you will find a horse stable. Make a right turn and then left at the fork up a small dirt road. There’s a wide flat area to park. (If you go right at the fork, the road will lead you to the Cueva del Esplendor trailhead.)

We asked two locals who were fine with us camping there. “Muy tranquilo” at night. Great views over the mountains and Jardín. You share the space with some free running horses from the stable.

The road up to Morro Amarillo is very narrow and steep. We didn’t have to engage 4x4 but definitely not big rig friendly. 

One of the best wild camping spots we found so far in Colombia.

Description:
The picture shows the first entrance gate from the gravel road (bright green gate). The property itself is behind the second gate. Watch out for the iOverlander sign "Established Campground" at the gate. For any questions, our cell phone and WhatsApp number is (+57) 324 685 9291. We are open 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. If possible, phone or send a message prior to arrival. Otherwise, ask the neighbors to contact us (our property is behind theirs).

We are a Colombian couple (Gloria and Albeiro) and we are pleased to receive tourists from all over the world. La Pradera is a beautiful farmhouse with large spaces to rest, where you will also have the opportunity to practice and improve your Spanish. It is a green place with six lovely dogs and four friendly cats with which the whole place is shared.

We welcome travelers who wish to camp or who are traveling in campervans, trailers, motorbikes, etc. In La Pradera, you can leave your vehicle for short or long periods. We will also gladly take care of your pet. From our property, you can reach Cartagena's beaches and historic center in 45 minutes by car, and Playa Blanca in 40 minutes.

Prices (as of April 2025):

- $35k COP per person/night
- $20k COP per laundry service
- $20k COP parking service for vehicles without visitors (24 hours)

Name: Gramalote Viejo
Description:
We were camping with another couple in our two truck campers in front of the remains of the old church in Gramalote. It was Christmas Eve and this was our second night there.

Two men, in full masks, armed with a machete and a knife, attacked our group. We were able to de-escalate the situation and after a lot of talking and discussing, the two men finally left.  

None of us were hurt, and no items were taken. They claimed to be part of a "national defense" and were there to "protect us", after they attacked us, and wanted money.

We have a Colombian friend who helped via phone during the incident to notify the police. He has also said that this region of Colombia is the most dangerous place in the country currently, and would not recommend any tourists go to this area.

Proceed with caution, or visit during the day and sleep in Gramalote Nuevo.

Location: Vía Caloto, Puerto Tejada, Norte, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Puerto Tejada and surrounding area
Description:
I am travelling by foot and was walking with a friend when we were given a police escort through this area organised by some locals in Guachené who were worried about our safe passage. 

You’ll see on google maps “PRECAUCION (Hurtos a mano armada ) Pandillas” -> CAUTION (Armed robberies) Gangs. 

This isn’t guerrilla activity, however it is serious. 

The police were with us along the PanAm from  the southern most entry to the northern most entry of the town (visible on my map image) and we were specifically told to stay out of the town, and not to use the back roads but rather stay on the PanAm. 

If you’re travelling through by bike or vehicle, do not stop in or along the parameter of the town and you should be ok. 

The police were comfortable with us continuing alone after point B on the map. 

The people from the town of Guachené where really warm and welcome but advised it’s better for travellers to stay in Caloto when heading south toward Silvia, or along the PanAm outside of the Puerto Tejada area.

She helped us to understand all the procedures to travel to Panama with our dog, which is a bit complicated!  Especially regarding the dates, since in Colombia, the certificate can not be issued before 5 days of the travel date! 
It was COP 150.000 for the consult.

Location: Vda. Canaveral, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Barranquero
Description:
Best place we've stayed at in Colombia so far (and we've travelled all the country for 5 months) !!!

The place is owned by Bruno and Laurence, a French couple who spent most of their life in Africa before they decided to build this place from the ground in the middle of the jungle.

It's a hotel, but being overlanders themselves they love to welcome other travelers like us. The place is incredibly beautiful and quiet, surrounded by nature and has direct access to the river with natural pools. Lots of space to camp on nice grassy area. Everything is very clean and well-arranged. No mosquitoes - which is rare in this area.

It is located just 5 minutes from the entrance of Tayrona Park but we saw more animals here than in the park (tons of birds, huge iguanas, monkeys, we even saw Cottontop Tamarins who are almost extinct!!). 

From here you can also hike in the jungle or until Las Cocos beach, rent horses, etc, just ask and they'll be pleased to help, there's a lot to do.

The food from the restaurant/bar was delicious, probably the best we've had in Colombia, including vegetarians/vegans options and cocktails.

Bruno knows everything about mechanics and has a big garage with lots of tools in case you need to work on your truck/car/bike.

To get there you'll need to cross the small village of San Rafael, there's a sign from the main road. Then head down the steep dirt road (4x4 mandatory during rain season) which leads to the first river to cross.The water level really depends of the rains but anyway you'll need high clearance. We crossed with motorbikes and it was okay. Then follow the signs and cross the second river (smaller) to get to the hotel.

They put up some drone shots showing how to access on their instagram account so people can figure out if its doable or not : @barranquero.hotel
I put a screenshot of the first river crossing (the river was low).

Last but not least : they have optical fiber so the internet is very fast and there is a super chill working space above the restaurant.

Price : 20.000 COP pp, definitely worth it. Very recommended.

Location: San Antonio, Sur, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Reserva Natural Finca El Manantial
Description: Finca El Manantial Nature Reserve is a wildlife sanctuary under restoration. It is located in the Cordillera de Calarma between 1800 and 2900 masl. This area is conserved with the objective of protecting the fauna and flora of the region, it is part of a large private conservation area that we conserve the water that supplies the urban aqueducts of San Antonio and Ortega, Tolima. Endemic, vulnerable and endangered bird species have been located there, it is a hotspot for bird watching and a great natural viewpoint, since you can see the Central Cordillera, El Nevado del Huila, La Yerbabuena in Roncesvalles, Cuchilla la Siberia, La Sucia, the Cerros de Cumbarco and the municipality of San Antonio.

Just a word of warning- they have license plate restrictions when driving in Bogotá, so check whether the last digit on your plate ends with odd or even and which day you can drive.

The food is also really good and around 20k per person. 
The termales are really hot and less crowded than the one up there. The view is stunning on the Valley.
