Location: Calle 63B, Siete de Agosto, UPZ Los Alcázares, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, 111221, Colombia
Name: Koju Store
Description:
If you’re looking for a place to build or re-design a luggage system for your motorcycle, this is definitely a place to go. This is an official Koju (google it) store, which is owned and managed by Billy - really knowledgeable an helpful pal (he’s also a motorcyclist). Here’s what he can help you with:

1. Since this is a Koju dealer, you can get both top and side aluminum cases and accessories (racks, internal bags etc.) for them. They aren’t as good, as the ones from, say, Givi, but overall it’s a really good price/quality ratio.
2. Billy has its own production of waterproof saddlebags, so you can order them here. You can choose the size, design etc. Might take a week or two to get them ready, but he can also send them to you across the country (I used this option, since didn’t want to wait).
3. Finally, you can order practically any kind of metalworks for your bike: side-racks, top rack, crash-bars etc. Billy organizes the whole process with one of the specialized nearby workshops, which includes the design, quality control etc.

I personally fulfilled all 3 points from above, and can’t recommend enough this service. Now, when I’m adding this place, I have more then 6 months of travelling with the new gear without any serios issues. If you’re curious about the prices: top rack + side racks + 47L top case + 2x 35L saddlebags costed me about $650 in total.

Location: Patacore, Panamericana, Puerto Nuevo, Patía, Piedrasentada, Sur, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Cmplejo Tuiristico Patacoré
Description:
Right next to the “Patacoré” complex, there is a small hotel which can also accommodate vans/motorhomes. There are only one or 2 places but even big rigs can fit (ours is 7m40 long, 3m high which is the maximum to fit). There is a swimming pool, billiards, electricity, toilets, water, etc.).  They also rent rooms if you need. It's smaller than Patacoré with a little fewer services (no restaurant but a fast food delivery service in the evening) but also more intimate (we were alone for 2 days)!

It is now 60.000 Pesos for 2 people, including use of the swimming pool.
The parking space is behind the restaurant and pool. 
The entrance was no problem with 3.30 meters height. 

Wonderful place to spend a safe and quiet night. We payed 30000 for two people, but just for the night. Without pool use! People are very friendly.

Toilets, showers, pool and hot (warm) tubs available until 8/9pm. Little shop with drinks and snacks. Right next to the road, so some traffic noise. Great cell reception and fast 4G. Pets only on the parking lot. There's a height restriction, but we went in easily with 3m, I guess 3.5m should be fine.

The town has everything you need, local Tejo bar close by if you want a Colombian experience.

Location: Calle 12; Gómez Ángel, Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056050, Colombia

Description:
A nice place to relax. They have a swimming pool, a restaurant, a natural pond with an ice cream bar and a short trail (1 km). 
We went here to see the Spix's Night Monkeys resting in a tree on the trail during daytime. We paid 36.000 pesos in total for two persons. We didn't use the swimming pool. Not sure if that's included. We also saw other monkey species such as Ecuadorian Squirrel Monkey and Lesson's Saddle-back Tamarin :) They have cabins where you can sleep. We don't know if you can stay here overnight. There were dogs around the restaurant and a rescued Common Woolly Monkey.

Enjoy!

Location: San Safael-San Roque, San Roque, Nordeste, Antioquia, Colombia

He fixed a lot of things in the motor and mechanical parts (starter, acceleration system, cooling system, air filer, gazoline filter, transfert oil, cardans...). He also helped with the painting, which had bad scratches, and also helped with the installation of a solar panel, including welding work. My Jeep is now like new, ready to take me for my South American adventures!!!

I had a nice bath here that was very needed

Location: Vía a Itaibe, Páez, Oriente, Cauca, Colombia

Slept great with the sound of the rapids.

The “road” is approximately 140 miles between carreno and primavera. In a Land Cruiser it took us 9.5 hours. He road was dry, very very dusty with huge holes and ruts. Brace yourself for this one. Can’t imagine what it would be like when wet. Gas up on both ends.

Location: Calle 5, Teruel, Norte, Huila, Colombia

Description:

I also asked the neighbors near the cemetery and futbol field. They also said it would be good. At that spot there is a very nice look out.  

I only picked the Virgin Mary spot over the other because I was invited into one of the neighbors house for a café so I stayed there.  But both looked good and calm

They did say there is a camping place you can pay to stay at somewhere near. But I wasn’t sure where and it was already dark

They said there is a park that is above the town some that is nice but said sometimes people go there to smoke weed.

Upper floor has a large common area with a bar, games and large smart TV. Nestor is the owner and will help with whatever your needs are. Groceries and restaurants are within walking distance. Parking across the road for 8k for a moto. 60k for a dorm room which is a bit much considering there’s hotels close by for less.

Location: NOTECEBES, Colombia

We stayed 3 days and we had the beach all for us

Share your experience if you go!
@rutaplanc

Location: Sopetrán, Occidente, Antioquia, 051440, Colombia
Name: Arreboles
Description:
This is a wonderful tranquil property in the middle of the forest overlooking beautiful views. 
We were actually on our way to al Bosque, when we bumped into German, who suggested we stay here instead. 
 
He is in the process of starting up a space for overlanders with outdoor kitchen, shower, fast wifi etc. (which will be ready very soon)- but when we were there, we were offered the use of the Cabaña ‘Arreboles’ (which is beautiful) kitted with kitchen, living room, log fire and bathroom with hot shower.

The property is away from the main road, so the only noise you’re going to get is from the chickens and roosters pottering around and that’s not even too loud. The fresh free range eggs are worth ever crow anyway. 

German is a travel guide and one that we can personally recommend. If you want to go on the cable car and book a tour around ‘Comuna 13, he can book it for you and take you. If you prefer to go to Medellin by car- he’ll also do that. Not to mention shopping trips to nearby Santa Elena or Guarne. 

…and looking to improve your Spanish? German and his wife Elena can help you. In a patient and unthreatening way, they’ll have you conversing with them only in Spanish no matter your level. And they would be happy to offer classes too. 

We spent 2 weeks here and really were relaxed. We were able to experience the Antioquia culture as well as having the space and time to catch up on work etc.

***Please note that the drive is narrow so it’s not big rig friendly. We are however, a 3.7 m tall truck camper and got down no problems. ***

The price is 20‘000p/p plus 10‘000p/vehicle. If you prefer the cabaña instead of Camping it costs 125‘000/night incl. the vehicle. Price can be negotiated for longer stays. 

Don’t miss out on this super tranquil spot near Medellin with cooler temperatures and with a personal touch!

Location: Carrera 61, Corazón de Jesús, Comuna 10 - La Candelaria, Perímetro Urbano Medellín, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, 050015, Colombia
Name: Muelles y Amortiguadores HD
Description: We had two sets of leaf springs made to replace our broken one in our Sprinter. Took the part there in the morning, had two new sets by the end of the day. With all brackets, bolts, etc for less then 400usd. Harald from HD is easy to reach in WhatsApp. See details in the picture.  This area 'barrio triste' has anything you need in terms of parts.

Location: Parqueo, Vía a termales el Escondite, Santa Marta Baja, Samaná, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, Colombia

Description: such a nightmare to get here.expecially the last 4kms! huge roots rocks.broken road.4wd and high clearance a must.but I would not come back.the unkept 'pool' is neglected and looks and feel like a soup!?  the water comes out of this pipes already brown.of what looks like soil and iron powder mixed with leaves  .to top up there is an unintelligent 'caretaker'that does absolutely nothing ! +speaks misleading info and wanted to charge me extra parking$$ + 20000 for 'swimming'.said his boss told him..BS! owner is in Bogotà! sad the place is managed badly.

Location: 40, Guacacias, Santa Rosalía, Rio Meta, Vichada, Colombia
Name: illegal blockade
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: Indian private land 
This is the first of five tolls you need to pay to continue to Puerto Carreño. They are run by the indigenous families that live there and each barrier is pretty close to one another. It’s a cool cultural experience with them selling bow and arrows, handwoven hats and bags, and honey. They will want 10 mil pesos just to get through each barrier. So have plenty of loose change. We recommend buying the bow and arrows - they’re really well made.

Location: Hotel Casa del Montañista, Carrera 3 - "Calle Real", El Cocuy, Gutiérrez, Boyacá, 151280, Colombia
Name: Ivan El Cocuy Parque guide
Description:
El Cocuy Parque is beautiful and well worth a visit IF you can figure out all of the logistics. It's incredibly difficult to get accurate information especially in English. The official park website offers inaccurate information, the biggest being that you need to register 30 days in advance, you don't.
What you need to know is this. There is no camping in the park. There are 3 hiking trails which you need a guide and have to register for ahead before entering the park. You have to register at a park office located in the town of El Cocuy or Guican and they are closed for lunch 11-2. In order to register you need daily insurance 9000/day/person (which you purchase across street a couple doors down, that's where it is in El Cocuy) and a guides name to put on the permit. Permit costs 85000/person good for 4 days. Where to find the guide is still a mystery to us. The website says there is a list on the wall we didn't see one and there wasn't any guides hanging around the office. You also have to watch a video on the park which is viewed via Google Meet twice a day once in the morning and afternoon, they will give the meeting details at the office. We were put in contact with Ivan after making many frustrating calls. Ivan is a park guide and speaks reasonable English. He was unable to actually guide us himself due to an injury but he did meet us at the park office to walk us through the insurance and registration process. He made all the arrangements for; guides for 2 days of hiking, transportation from town to La Esperanza lodge with our bikes, lodging and meals and transport for us and our bikes to the trailhead for the second hike. We tried for several frustrating days just trying to get info let alone make any progress on arrangements. He went on and above making our visit to the park happen and doing so for whatever commission he must make from the various services not his normal guide wage. He and his family are wonderful people and we literally couldn't have done it without him. You can reach Ivan at WhatsApp +57 310 7859943. 
We did 2 hikes which we highly recommend Laguna Grande de la Sierra and La Ritacyba. This website is also very helpful. 
 https://www.google.com/amp/s/thecurioustravel.com/blog/everything-you-need-to-know-about-hiking-in-el-cocuy%3fformat=amp

La Esperanza costs 80000 for lodging/dinner and breakfast or you can camp for 15000

Location: Barranca de Upía, Piedemonte, Meta, Colombia

Description:
Parking lot of the charm hot springs. We have stayed here for free for a couple of days. 
The entrance fee for the hot springs is Cop 10000 for the first day and for all the following days Cop 3000.
There is a lot to do in this area. Traveling the Upia river by boat, horse riding, rock climbing an of course the hot springs El Encanto.

It has a camping area and also has cabins for rent. The place is clean, safe and even with many guests it is very quiet.

Location: Love, Carrera 12, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, 418060, Colombia
Name: Veterinaria Animalia
Description: Very friendly staff, small veterinary office. They made us a health certificate for 30k.

Location: Victoria, La Dorada, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, Colombia

Description: nice grassy area next to a river.at 7am lots of birds flying around-chatting .sounds like parrots!agreed with the woman-owner living in the house opposite the entrance for 15000  camper+1.she started at 30 but I replied there are no services.0.but nice spot! way better then the opposite Taku ,superlit up last night and not on the river

It’s walking distance to the river. We’re glad we stopped by here- wasn’t busy for a Saturday night and the people that stopped by were all really lovely and welcoming.

The owner was super friendly. The grounds were impeccable.  The big pool looked clean.  I sat in the smaller pool for a bit.

I forget how much I paid to stay there. I remember it being a tad pricey.  

The vlbathroom in the cabana was ok.  Not great just ok.  

It's a short walk to the river and to the village. 

The place was perfect for one on my way to Tatacoa 

Yes there are bugs.  😯

Location: Calle 10, Centro, Guamo, Suroriente, Tolima, Colombia
Name: La Casona
Description: Decent hotel that has parking space for cars, motos and bicycles. Cold showers, they probably have wifi but i forgot to ask. Clean rooms with a fan. Friendly owners and near the center

Location: Restaurante Doña María, Carrera 5, Belén, Tundama, Boyacá, 150640, Colombia
Name: Hotel Colonial
Description: Hotel just off the main street. Clean, hot shower and able to accommodate our bicycles on the street level floor. Basic accommodations, bed is comfortable but does have a bit of a swale to it. At 40,000 for 2 people, if you're more thrifty than particular, this place is the place for you.

Location: Troncal del Magdalena, Pradera de Lourdes, Aipe, Norte, Huila, Colombia
Name: Pacande finca
Description:
Place with a nice pool and excellent suite. I’ll post a picture. 

They have a large parking that I don’t know for sure but I’m guessing they would be happy to let you park in.  

They have glamping with fans and a suite and room to rent with ac. 

Stayed 3 days for my bday here. Was great. 

Breakfast is light. 2 eggs and 2 Arepas 

Pool is amazing to have. We were in it each night and morning before doing our things for the day. 

It’s near aipe. The problem is the ferry to the desert is 6-6 so if you are late coming back it’s a long drive around to get across the river

Location: Casa guanacas, Calle 6, Paicol, Occidente, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hotel Posada Camino Guanacas
Description:
ADMIN NOTE: this entry appears to have been made by the owners/managers of this business - no independent traveller comments yet.

A charming stay where the difference is marked by a delicate balance between the traditional and the modern that is reflected in the entire infrastructure and in every detail that allows you to live the experience of accommodation with history, remembering your grandparents' house full of tranquility and harmony that invites rest and disconnection with the outside world.
The hotel posada camino guanacas is characterized by its philosophy of total satisfaction, which is based on offering customers a family atmosphere and meeting all their wishes if what is sought is a comprehensive rest.
The personalized attention makes every detail stand out together with a cuisine with a very traditional seasoning that reminds you of your grandmother's kitchen that you will find only in the hotel posada camino guanacas, it will make you long for a soon return.

Location: Mirador el Trampolín, Vía San Francisco - el Pepino - Villa Garzon, Mocoa, San Francisco, Putumayo, Colombia

You can drive this road on Monday, Wednesday and Friday from Pasto -> Mocoa between 4:00am and 20:00pm. Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday it's from Mocoa -> Pasto between 4:00am and 20:00pm). On Sundays the road is closed for maintenance.

Good luck!

Location: Calle 16 Juan Arias-Magangue Vía a Mompox, San Pedro, Sabanas, Sucre, Colombia
Name: Gabcha Spot - El Nuevo Cielito Asadero

Description:
A nice place with some cool monkey species. We saw the Pygmy Marmoset, Colombian Red  Howler monkeys and the Ecuadorian Squirrel Monkeys. They are open from 6:00-16:00. 
We paid 15.000 pp for the trails and 100.000 for a guide from 6:30-12:00. We reserved in advance via WhatsApp Fleyder Muriel +57 318 3559655. They have dogs at their place where you can leave yours if you have one;) And they offered us to spend the night there.

Enjoy!

Location: Calle 2, Villagarzón, Putumayo, 861080, Colombia

Enjoy! :)

Description:

Food service. WIFI zone. Laundry service. Pet friendly. Bonfire and Barbecue allowed. Bird Watching. 
$25.000 COP night per person
@GACHALA_CAMPING

Location: Iles, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, Colombia
Name: Panamericana Parking Spot
Description: The place is meant for trucks, cars and bikes to rest right on the highway from Pasto to Ipiales. It was created in 2023 and has services like baño(toilet), ducha (shower), potable water and emergency medical assistance..in fact there was a guy who was earlier a vet at the facility and he reviewed Harry for us and his export papers from Colombia. There's security on the premises and it is very safe. The location is such that the noise is not too high because vehicles don't need to accelerate much here. There's plent of places to park. Although the site is not level.

Location: Sendero Agualinda, Apía, Vertiente Occidental, Risaralda, Colombia

Location: Calle 5, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, Colombia

Location: Carrera 26, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, 520002, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero Galeras
Description:
there's two entrances. one small under a building and other one bigger in a open space. they accept big and tall cars. the only one that accept us.
6.000 COP for 4 hours

Location: Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, 661020, Colombia
Name: Fonda Mi Tierra
Description: Very good Bandeja Paisa and Chorizo Santa Rosano neer from the thermas. The owners are super friendly and let us stay for the night in the parking.

Location: Vía bata, Macanal, Neira, Boyacá, 152840, Colombia
Name: Wild Camping by the water
Description: A perfect wild camping place. Flat area, great weather, peaceful, amazing view. We love this place!

Location: Cristiana, Gachalá, Guavio, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 251260, Colombia
Name: Wild Camping by El Guavio Reservoir
Description: Wonderful and peaceful place near the water, full of vegetation and birds. Flat space at the end of a small dirt road.  The nearest neighbor is about 500 mts away, a very gentle and nice man, who was happy to see us enjoy this place. Walking down a small path, you can reach the edge of the water, with great views of the reservoir and the dam. Driving over the dam is a must and you need to go through two amazing tunnels.

Location: Girardot, Alto Magdalena, Cundinamarca, 252431, Colombia
Name: Glamping la Perla, Finca la Perla
Description:
Nice stay before we travel further to Deserto Tatacoa. Nice pool, cold showers, Internet. 
We paid 20.000 p.P. for one night. You can either rent a hut with all comfort, camp on the hill with a stunning few or stay with the camper next to the pool. Alexandros and his mother are very friendly hosts. Tel.: 3214406807

Location: Chaparral, Sur, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Rio amoya camping
Description:
Coming from planadas after the bridge there is a dirt road to the right.  It’s not far.  You can turn down and gain access to the river bank with your vehicle.  

High clearance is needed because of the rock field. 

I drove from aipe to planadas then planadas north to here.  From aipe the road is ok. Very senic and great to be out of the heat of the desert  Didn’t need 4x4 but it was mostly dry.  There are big ruts so high clearance is needed.  This road is a favorite road so far

After planadas the road is paved mostly and you could return to road 45. But I turned off to get here. After the turn off the road gets really big ruts but I did see a bus and box truck on the road. 

The river is fast moving so great for sleeping. There are some areas to get in the river. I rinsed off before bed but it was a bird bath. Not to deep

Location: Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631020, Colombia
Name: camping by the river
Description: was driving to town and see the camp-sign by the river.nice spot .just a caretacare here that was leaving.called the owner and first said 25k.but i dont see baños and do not need power so I offered 15k.only parking .ok. some tables chairs.3g signal.nice

Name: Autocucuta
Description: The place to be for all kind of electronics stuff. Nice and helpfull people

Location: Asociación Raudal Tours, Camino al Puerto Lucas, Puerto Lucas Ospina, San José del Guaviare, Guaviare, Colombia

Very nice spot over the Guaiabero river gorge. There is a small settlement of fishermen, ho will take you  with our small boats troth the river gorge to any rock paintings from Indian tribes. You can see also Amazon river dolphins. The Tour  costs COP 250 000 for 2 Persons and includes the Boat trip, the guided Tour to the Pinturas Rupestres and the Dolphin sights. 
The Campsite is basic but free.
They have Starlink Internet which they sell for 5000 COP per 24 hours.
A couple of shops sell basic food and cold beverages.

Location: Barranca de Upía, Piedemonte, Meta, Colombia
Name: Mirador Rio Upia
Description: Parking loft by the road side with a spectacular view form the first mountain chain over the los Llanos flats.

Location: Vía San Carlos de Guaroa, Villavicencio, San Carlos de Guaroa, Piedemonte, Meta, Colombia
Name: Guayuriba River Bridge
Description: Car parking by  side of the new river bridge. They let you park here over night for COP 3000.

Location: Las Avispas, 40, Coello, Centro, Tolima, Colombia
Name: quiet gas stop
Description: late night.was tired and see this corner (on the dirt under some trees, at the end on the right side.nobody there .no trucks stop here! I asked and the attendant.he just replied at what time I was leaving?said "early".some cars filled up occasionally but one of the quietest gas st. ever !

Location: Playarrica, San Antonio, Sur, Tolima, Colombia
Name: Rio cucuana camp in playarrica
Description:
In this small town there is a basket count and a road that leads to the river.  There is a large wall with grass that you can camp behind that is flat.  Lots of room.  The area by the basket court is paved but not very flat. 

The road continues out onto the river banks but the river is know to flood. 

In the morning there was a guy throwing rock into his truck. 

The place is nice and quiet a d close enough that I walked up to town for a beer and a papa before returning to camp for the night.

Location: Transversal 1b, Ciénaga, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: next to restaurant/beach/pools
Description:
Next to Centro Vacational Ocasiones.
3 pools inside, we could park on the beach, use their tables and chairs, palapa, etc.
Very friendly.

We used one room (50k) for our parents and could camp for free if we had some drinks. Without room you can also camp for free, just take something from the bar / restaurant.
Might be busy in the weekends.

Location: Riohacha, La Guajira, Colombia
Name: Puerto Chentico comunidad Wayuú
Description:
If you want to be in contact with a Wayúu family and go for a boat trip to see the flamingos, you've come to the right place!  Yeiner and his family are very kind!  There is even a small restaurant to have dinner.

Si quieres ponerte en contacto con una familia Wayúu y dar un paseo en barco para ver los flamencos, ¡has venido al lugar indicado!  
¡Yeiner y su familia son muy amables!  Incluso hay un pequeño restaurante para cenar.

Location: El Mirador Ruitoque, Vía Ruitoque, Ciudadela Los Principes, Zona Refrescante, Piedecuesta, Metropolitana, Santander, 681004, Colombia
Name: GABCHA SPOT
Description: Found this place after the two others around was closed (Argentino restaurant and paragling). Ask to the owner of the restaurant told us ok for free. Good view.

Location: Choriazados, Calle 8, El Modelo, Comuna 1, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, 190002, Colombia
Name: CIOM Laboratorio Clínico
Description:
we needed do some bloody test, and they do it for foreign people.
we paid 95.000 COP for 4 different things. 
of course it depends on your needs...
no prescription needed.
just say what you want

Location: Vía Gigante-Hobo, Hacienda La Loma, Gigante, Centro, Huila, Colombia
Name: Mirador Matumbo
Description: The view is one of the best we’ve had on this entire trip! It’s a massive property “selfie” park, they said we could park anywhere, so we went to the back far left behind the trees. A bit of road noise, but it’s not too bad, worth it for the view. Not many people coming in. There’s a clean bucket flush toilet, no shower. Bonus - you get to take some ridiculous photos. 15K per person to stay overnight.

Location: Alegria hostel, Carrera 12, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154001, Colombia
Name: Claro Store
Description: If you are traveling in Colorado for more than 30 days you have to register your phone with the government. It's best to get your SIM at an actual Claro or Tigo store not a Tienda and make sure they register it and you get the official your phone is registered email. If you don't ask for it to be registered it probably won't happen. That's what happened to me. l got the 3 week warning email and was unable to complete the form by myself multiple times. We went to another cell store and thought he was making progress but they were unable to do it. Went to this official shop and they had me set up 8n 5 minutes and where able to confirm that my wife's phone was also registered. We only know about the registration because we met a couple that had a locked phone that they had tried and tried to get unlocked and were currently unsuccessful. Good luck.

Location: Sibaté, Soacha, Cundinamarca, 250078, Colombia
Name: Ozagua/Guatytua
Description:
This is a Campground but they also have a park with plants, animals and a restaurant where they cook typical Colombian food and use the produce of their farm. The Owners are very nice, help you with everything and they teach the locals how to respect nature. He took the time to do a tour and explained every plant, bird and animal to us. They also have a treehouse where you can do some birdwatching.
The price is 12'000 per person per night, but you can also have some food (we had breakfast) and then it is 20'000 pppn.
There is a lot of space to camp on grass or concrete (big rig friendly). They have clean flush toilets and cold showers. You can also use the BBQ or just grab a chair and sit in nature and much more...

Location: Puerto Rico, Ariari, Meta, Colombia
Name: Laguna San Vicente
Description: Beautiful place  on Laguna San Vicente beach. There is a lot of space in the shadow of trees, there is a bar  on weekends. You can swim in the lake, go fishing or just relax. On weekends may be crowded by locals. The entrance fee is COP 3000 p/P, Car parking COP 5000.

Location: Floridablanca, Metropolitana, Santander, 681004, Colombia
Name: Hostel Casa de Campo Ruitoque
Description:
Very nice place at Claudia and Willy’s house/hostal.
We came here by chance with a meeting with Willy who invited us to come to his home, offering hostal and camp with some services and a pool!!! 

Hostal is 4 rooms for a total of 13 beds (double and single) with kitchen, laundry, wifi, electricity, showers and toilets. 

Camp is ok up to 4 campers and for one big rig. Free access to the pool, free wifi, showers, free laundry machine, and toilets, free kitchen, games, big terrace…

The view is very nice, very close to a paragliding site  5min by car). Willy is a paragliding instructor and he will love to flight with you.

Price:
- Camper: 50000/p/n (kids free under 10)
- hostal room: 60000-70000/p/n
- paragliding: 140000P/pers for 15min with Willy 

Willy and Claudia are so nice and friendly! We recommend this place 100%!!!

Location: villa Claudia, Vía Gigante-Hobo, Gigante, Centro, Huila, Colombia
Name: Villa Claudia
Description: Friendly hotel, able to use private cold showers by the pool for 2000 pesos. I imagine you could just buy a beer or something too, they were very chill.

Location: Bao Bao Hostel, Carrera 6, Dibulla, La Guajira, 446009, Colombia
Name: Sisio Hostel and Camping
Description: Hostel with space for campers on the grounds. 10,000 COP per person. Oscar is a traveler who will be happy to serve you and do everything to make you feel good. I recommend

Location: KFC, Carrera 2, Bocagrande, Tierra Bomba, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130001, Colombia
Name: Banco Union Wester Union Câmbio
Description:
we had a lot of difficulty in Cartagena to withdraw in the western union, because the houses never have money.

in this place for being a small bank, it worked better.

Location: La Querencia, Calle 22, San Mateo, Marsella, Fusagasugá, Sumapaz, Cundinamarca, 252212, Colombia
Name: Chili Peppers
Description: We came passed here and stopped because next door is an Ara Groceries with spacious parking spots. At Chili's they have really good Burgers for a good price. Great spot if you are on the drive through and don't want to wander around and find parking. There is also a pretty nice looking butcher shop next door.

Location: Cancha, Calle 20, Barrio Fátima, Yarumal, Norte, Antioquia, 052030, Colombia
Name: Terminal de transporte de Yarumal Antioquia
Description:
At the entrance to the town of Yarumal, is the new transport terminal.  They allowed us to sleep on the outskirts of the shopping center, asking the security personnel, to get up early the next day to follow the route to the Atlantic coast.  there are public toilets.  very quiet night.

Big parking space for buses. We paid 10’000 pesos for one night. at 22h they close the gate and there is a guardian. Felt very safe and the night was quiet and fresh!

En la entrada al pueblo de Yarumal , está la nueva terminal de transporte. nos permitieron dormir en las afueras del centro comercial, preguntando al personal de seguridad,  para madrugar al otro día a seguir la ruta para la costa atlántica. hay baños públicos. noche muy tranquila.

Location: Carrera 2, Moñitos, Costanera, Córdoba, Colombia
Name: La Barra de Chema
Description:
Site in front of the sea, safe, there are showers, toilets, water, power, they charged us 20,000 for the car, there is food service.  very kind attention
.....
sitio en frente del mar, seguro, hay duchas, sanitarios, energía  agua, nos cobraron 20.000 por el carro, hay servicio de comida. atención muy amable

20 por vehículo

Location: Vía los Santos, Vda. La Peña, Los Santos, Metropolitana, Santander, Colombia
Name: Chicamocha Vibes
Description:
The best place to enjoy the Chicamocha Canyon. Spectacular view, very friendly hosts and a thousand activities to do: canyon walks, bird watching, history of the villages. You can recharge water and energy.

Esp. El mejor lugar para disfrutar del Cañón del Chicamocha. Vista espectacular, muy amables los anfitriones y mil actividades por hacer: caminatas por el cañón, avistamiento de aves, historia de los pueblos. Puedes recargar agua y energía.

Location: Vía a Chingaza, Vereda Santa Helena, La Calera, Guasca, Guavio, Cundinamarca, 251208, Colombia
Name: The corner
Description:
An open space in the corner to park your car. We stayed here the night to bird the road the next morning. Quiet during the night and Claro signal.
Enjoy!

Location: Río Balcones, Camino a Mojanes, Vda. Mojanes, Guasca, Guavio, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: In the forest
Description:
We parked our Toyota 4Runner here to overnight. It is a small open area. You need a high clearance. It is not fancy but if you need to be here, this is a good option. It was a quiet and safe spot.

Enjoy!

Location: Hato, Comunera, Santander, Colombia
Name: Mirador Hato
Description:
Viewpoint near Hato with great views down on the village Palmar and the Rio Suarez valley. Road from Palmar to Hato mostly paved, from Hato to the mirador dirt track but doable for almost any vehicle.
Most probably you could stay here with a campervan overnight, just ask the family that lives right at the mirador.

Location: Calle 14, Zona Urbana, Mocoa, Putumayo, 860001, Colombia
Name: Fruit & Veg
Description: Awesome fruit & vegetables shop, lots of fresh variety!

Location: Carrera 7, Simijaca, Ubaté, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Andariegos
Description:
Simijaca is not a very memorable town but it does have this great vegetarian restaurant. We are not vegetarians but it's always challenging to find good meals with vegetables. We had a large appetizer, ratatouille, ramen, an eggplant dish and beverages for 100,000, all amazing.

This was one of the best meals that we have had during our month of travel in Colombia. Highly recommend it.

Location: Carrera 4, Tejar Samaria, Zipaquirá, Sabana Centro, Cundinamarca, 250251, Colombia
Name: Monkey Rainbow
Description: We were looking for some ice cream, but weren't expecting this. Great frappes, ice cream, waffles, service and ambiance. We had a maracuyá and chai, both great. Frappes are 16,000-24,000, worth it.

Location: Vía Mocoa - Pitalito, Cedro K25, Bruselas, Pitalito, Sur, Huila, Colombia
Name: Military Checkpoint
Description: Not exact location, but here is a military checkpoint. They wanted to look in the Camper, looked under the car and knocked everywhere. Probably looking for drugs or money. They are friendly and everything was ok.

Location: Carrera 20 A, La Florida, Zipaquirá, Sabana Centro, Cundinamarca, 250251, Colombia
Name: Juanchorizos gourmet
Description: in front of this (good) food place there's space for 2-3 truck campers .out of the way, in a small plaza .but is st. parking ok for one night

Location: Calle 5, Pacho, Provincia de Rionegro, Cundinamarca, 254001, Colombia
Name: Hotel La Posada
Description: Clean, nice/ accommodating staff, a place for bicycles or moto on the ground level inside and quiet (if non-street side room). 60,000 for 2, room is small but big enough for a firm queen sized bed, a night stand and bathroom. Decent internet, hot on demand shower head. A couple blocks from the main square. We were allowed to use the kitchen to heat h20 for breakfast. Water filter in kitchen.

Location: Escuela Veredal El Tirano, Oiba - Las Gachas, El Arena, Guadalupe, Comunera, Santander, Colombia
Name: hôtel terrassas de Guadalupe
Description: Unflated spot but ok with pool access. Easier access for long motorhome than Las Brisas.

Location: Mi refugio, Carrera 6, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154001, Colombia
Name: Villa Yesenia
Description:
Update August 9th 2024:

Name: Chingaza NP office
Description:
This is an office of Chingaza NP. It is in the back with a big photo of a Spectacled Bear. We went to the gate to buy a entrance ticket there, but that's not possible. You have to arrange it 15 days in advance online or you can stop by at this office. They need some contact details and you need to pay at the Banco Colombia. They will give you the paying details. The bank ( 4.720094, -73.968573) is at the plaza of the church. They made an exception for us that we could enter the park the same day, but normally it takes 3 days. After the payment, you'll also need an insurance for in the park. We paid for it with cash. For four days it was 56.000 cop in total for 2pp. Entrance was 141.500 cop for 2pp. If you want to walk the trails you'll need a guide. Without guide you can only drive to the camping area. We weren't allowed to sleep in our car. We had to sleep in a tent outside or in a room. 
In the end we don't think it is worth it to enter. It took us a lot of time to arrange to enter. They are very strict inside the park. We asked the camping owner if we could sleep in our car and he was fine with it, but late in the evening the rangers told us that we had to move to a room or a tent. Although the paramo is beautiful, there are other places where you can enjoying it without paying this amount of money. 

If you still want to go. Enjoy! :)

Location: Tagua, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Casa Cafe Hospedaje
Description: A quaint guest accommodation with beautiful views of Santa Marta and Cienega. On a clear day you can see all the way to the ocean. The hosts are super kind and serve fresh local food.  It's far from everything but close to the el dorado nature reserve, which is a must see for birding. The place is very tranquil and there are just a couple of spots for camping. One that you can car camp, but the space is rather small, not for big rigs and the other is big enough for three backpacker tents, but not accessible by car. There are two friendly dogs onsite, a few cats and chickens. In the distance you can hear the howler monkeys and wake up to the sounds of birds. They have shared bathrooms and allowed us to use their fridge and freezer, though it's not common. They have 4 guest rooms, we decided to stay in one that was very reasonable, 80k pesos per night or $16 for 4 people. Each room has the shower-head of death that provides hot water, but you have to find the sweet spot or it will be mediocrely luke-warm. Beautiful spot, highly recommend either come and stay or just eat, drink and take in the view!

Location: Guarne, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050001, Colombia
Name: Arreboles- villa felicidad
Description: Germán and Elena welcome overlanders to stay on their very tranquil property not far from Santa Elena, Guarne and the Parque Avi (and cable car to Medellin). They have two cabanas which they rent out, and plan to make a camping area on part of their land in the near future to accommodate travellers. In the meantime, they will open up the bathroom in one of the cabanas for your use. We stayed here for two weeks. Germàn is a wonderful tour guide and would be happy to drive you into Medellin or nearby Santa Elena/Guarne or even assist you on public transport. He will arrange tours for the communa 13 experience too. If you are looking to improve your Spanish he would be happy to teach you or just converse with you, in a slow and patient manner. Highly recommended. Word of warning: anything bigger than a truck camper might not make it down their drive way. Height is not an issue though. Do give German a call before arriving, he’d be happy to hear from you: +57 314 823 3938

Location: Vía Altamira-Garzón, Garzón, Centro, Huila, 414020, Colombia
Name: Armed Robbery
Description: We were wild camping at this site overlooking the lake.  About an hour after dark three men forced entry into our van.  One had a 9mm simi automatic pistol, and the others knives.  They had me outside of the van face down on the ground and my wife inside.  The stole $, wallets, phones, iPad, GoPro, my wedding ring, and many other items.  They escaped on two motorcycles.  We drove immediately to the police station.  They tried to help.  We spent the night parked next to the police station.  The commandant of the station said this town is very dangerous and should be avoided.

Location: Saladoblanco, Sur, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje Saladeno
Description: This is a 1-2 star hotel. To the best of our knowledge there are 2 hotels in this town. This is the better of the 2 and cost 30,000 for 2 shared bathroom. As apposed to the gringo pricing were offered at Hospedaje Central for a not so nice room, big swail in the bed with thread bare sheets for 45,000 shared bathroom or 50,000 private. The owner is very nice and super accommodating. The mattress is reasonable comfortable, sheets and bathroom clean, no WiFi or hot water. It's a first floor with a roll in ramp for our bicycles, plenty of room outside the room and behind a locked door for storing them You could even fit them in the room. It's a big day from La Argentina 35 miles with 6600' of steep climbing and 6000 of descending so we were happy to find anything. What you expect for 30,000.

WiFi available but did go down when I was there - apparently a power outage. Some basic restaurants and shops around the plaza. Nice view if you pay for the double, or from the balcony. It is on one of the main through roads so can be a bit noisy at the front or if people are playing football or volleyball in the square. Parking outside is probably safe since the police station is nearby. Bikes can be taken into rooms but you'll have to carry them up the stairs.

Location: Vía La India, Horizontes, Filandia, Fría, Quindío, 634001, Colombia
Name: Casa Matriz
Description:
If you come to Filandia you must stay in this place. The first thing is that its owners Lorena and Esteban are a total love and have built this beautiful cultural space for everyone to enjoy. In the parking lot you have a spectacular view, a landscape to enjoy in the morning with the green of the mountains.
You can arrange with the owners the prices for the bathroom and food if you wish, they also have delicious coffee.
We totally recommend this place, away from the bustle of the town and in contact with nature. You can also enjoy the various cultural activities that are scheduled in the place.
---
Si usted viene a Filandia debe quedarse en este lugar. Lo primero es que sus dueños Lorena y Esteban son un total amor y han construido este bello espacio cultural para el disfrute de todos. En el parqueadero tienes una vista espectacular, un paisaje para disfrutar en la mañana con el verde de las montañas. 
Puedes concertar con los dueños los precios para el baño y la alimentación si lo deseas, además tienen un café delicioso.
Recomendamos totalmente este lugar, lejos del bullicio del pueblo y en contacto con la naturaleza. también puedes disfrutar de las variadas actividades culturales que se programan en el lugar.

Location: Centro Ortopédico de Nariño, Calle 15, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520002, Colombia

Location: El Carmen de Atrato, Atrato, Chocó, Colombia
Name: Las Tangaras ProAves Reserva
Description:
We visit this natural reserve from ProAves to do some bird watching. We overnight here with our motorhome. It is a flat corner. If you drive a bit further down the road you'll find a little shelter. We used it to sit under it while it was raining. You can pitch your tent under it. Locals were friendly and we had two quiet nights here. 

Enjoy!

Location: Urrao, Suroeste, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: ProAves Colibri del Sol Reserve
Description:
We visit the ProAves Colibri del Sol Reserve to search for some nice bird species. There is a lodge in the reserve, but we stayed in our motorhome at this location. From here you have to walk +/- 2hours to the lodge. As day visitor we paid 50.000 cop per person to enter the reserve. Normally, they want it via bank deposit, but they made an exception that we could pay it with cash.

Enjoy!

Location: Registraduría Nacional del Estado Civil, 31-26, Calle 28, Urrao, Suroeste, Antioquia, Colombia

Enjoy!

Location: Casa del Artesano, Carrera 5, Horizontes, Filandia, Fría, Quindío, 634001, Colombia
Name: Centro de interprétation Del Bejuco Al Canasto
Description:
Here you can make your own basket in bejuco (wood liane) and learn about the whole process. Very interesting especially if you have kids. We add some photos ! 
Price 30.000 cop for 1h-1h30.

Location: Hotel Unión, Calle 1, Guayabal, Coveñas, Morrosquillo, Sucre, RAP Caribe, Colombia

Description: place to withdraw money via Western Union.  We went to the places that were in the app but none of them worked, this place was not in the WU App and it is possible to make withdrawals here.  (We were asked for a copy of the document)

Location: Edificio Torre Bolivar, 19-26, Carrera 7, Sector Plaza de Bolivar, Centro, Perimetro Urbano Pereira, Pereira, AMCO, Area Metropolitana Centro Occidente, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660002, Colombia
Name: SOAT - Seguro de Estado
Description: We found a Seguro Del Estado office in Pereira. You need to go in the Torre Bolívar, floor number 11. We paid 206.000cop for 3 months (they cannot do it for less) for our Fiat Ducato. Quick and helpful

Location: Florián - La Venta, Platanillo, Florián, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684541, Colombia
Name: La Cueva
Description:
Cool spot along the side of the road. Suitable for tent camping and vanparking. 

The ground is hardpack dirt, though there can be a muddy section along the road which you have to go through to get under the rock. I had no trouble with my motorcycle, a heavier vehicle may not be so easy.

Very spotty Claro signal. Lots of traffic until late in the night, but nobody bothered me, and I think most people didn't even see me.

Location: Simacota - Chima, Simacota, Comunera, Santander, 683561, Colombia
Name: Santa Rosa Bridge
Description:
Two grassy flat spots along Quebrada Santa Rosa suitable for tent camping and vanparking. One on each side of the road.

There is a nearby store selling snacks and drinks. I asked inside if it was ok for me to set up a tent and the lady inside said it was no problem. 

Sound of the whitewater river nearby, if that bothers you... or maybe it helps you sleep. Locals use it as a swimming hole in the afternoon. 

Decent Claro signal. Fair number of vehicles passing until late, but nobody bothered me, and I was mostly out of view of the road. 

There is an actual campground with what looks like a restaurant, store, and a (very dirty) pool on the other side of the bridge. It looked closed when I was there.

Location: Carrera 6, Localidad 2 Histórica - Rodrigo de Bastidas, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470004, Colombia
Name: Taminaka Hostel
Description: It is a small hostel in a quiet neighborhood, but close to the city center, which makes it very convenient because it is close to government offices and all kinds of shops and services. Pets are accepted, clothes can be washed, there is a equipped kitchen available.

Location: Hotel El Guayabito, Troncal del Magdalena Medio - Puerto Araujo - La Rochela, Cimitarra, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel El Guayabito

The hike la peña is near 
Area is different with pine trees and cafe trees. 
Road was a little muddy but no problem 
It’s off the plaza. If you can find a place to park and is down a long hallway to a inner courtyard. Was nice and quiet for the most part

Location: Pandi, Sumapaz, Cundinamarca, Colombia

100% recommended.

Location: Hotel El Viajero, Calle 7, Genderales, Landázuri, Vélez, Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel El Viajero
Description: Was the only hotel we could see with rooms on the ground floor so we didn’t have to carry bikes upstairs. Cheap room (50000 for 2 people/2 beds), fan, TV, patchy WiFi.

Description: Really nice clean hotel, 50000 for 2 people + 2 beds. Good wifi. No AC. The lady working was super friendly. Lots of space in a locked garage/courtyard areas for bikes if you’re cycling. **Google Maps has the wrong location for the hotel**

Location: Vía San Francisco - el Pepino - Villa Garzon, Mocoa, San Francisco, Putumayo, Colombia

also room to park car or van off the track

Location: Tibaná, Márquez, Boyacá, Colombia

Description: Great hospedaje. Rooms with private bathrooms. Some rooms will sleep up to four people. I paid 35000 COP for a very comfortable room with double bed and bathroom with hot shower. Secure parking on premises an extra 5000 COP. Fine for motorcycles but vans and 4WDs may struggle with height. The owner Mercedes is a lovely lady - friendly and super helpful with tips on places to visit in the area.

Location: Anorí - El Mango, Anorí, Nordeste, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: ProAves Chestnut-capped Piha reserve
Description:
We came here to bird the area. It is a small parking lot next to the road, but with our Toyota 4Runner we managed to place the car behind the road sign. It was a quiet night.

Enjoy!

Location: Oficinas de registro publicos, Calle 6, Concepción, García Rovira, Santander, Colombia
Name: San José Hotel Colonial
Description:
Inexpensive room right on the plaza in the cute town of Concepción. I paid COP40,000.

Inside a colonial-style building are several rooms. I had a single with a private bathroom and a loft. There was space for one or two motorcycles inside the room, though I didn't ask if I could park there. I parked my bike inside the hotel entryway. There is a parking lot nearby also. 

24-hour staff. Electric hot water shower. Pretty good wifi. Courtyard with a small drink counter and several tables. Nearby restaurant will deliver food. Clean and quiet; very relaxing place. 

I saw two other hotels in town.

Location: Puerto Velero, Tubará, Atlántico, Colombia
Name: Terpel
Description:
Terpel gas station, with showers, baths, drinking water, security with cameras and 24-hour service.  Caring people...Safe place to spend the night.
.....
Posto Terpel, com ducha, baños, água potável, seguro com câmeras e atendimento 24h. Pessoas atenciosas...Local seguro para passar a noite.

Location: ESE Chusacá, Carrera 4, Industrial Salitre, Compartir, Soacha ciudad, Soacha, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 250053, Colombia
Name: Had tire punctured by banditos
Description: While stopped at the stoplight near this fuel station a motorcycle drove up to our front passenger tire and stuck a sharp metal tube into our tire. As soon as we drove on it, our tire was flat in 5 seconds. This is a 'thing' in Colombia, and it likely happens at this location regularly, so keep an eye out, especially if you see a moto with no license plate. We involved the police and made an ordeal of it. Maybe they will do something about it someday.

Location: Patacore, Panamericana, Puerto Nuevo, Patía, Piedrasentada, Sur, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Parcela Hôtel Villa Maria
Description: Nice place to stay and relax. With plenty of outside space, a small swimming pool and plenty of lounging chairs.  Rooms are very clean and comfortable.  The administrator (Lucho) is super nice and takes great care of the place.

Location: Támesis, Suroeste, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Cabana ecologica
Description:
Really nice place with a great owner. The cabanas are really nice and extremely clean!
The rooms have a small kitchen so you can prepare your own meal as well. 100.000 incl breakfast (1person). Motorcycles will be safe here.
The whole area is taken care of and they have a beautiful garden.
5 min walk from a nice restaurant. 
Definitely can recommend this place

Location: Vda. Canaveral, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Hostal Flor Tayrona
Description: Hostal and Cacao Farm with nice accomodations and a wonderful staff. it's surrounded by a cacao and fruit plantation. You can reach it by 4x4 during the drier seasons where the river is lower.

Location: Niños & Niñas, Calle 11, Barrio latino, Comuna 1 - Centro, Perímetro Urbano Cúcuta, Cúcuta, Oriental, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 540006, Colombia
Name: Hotel Zaraya
Description:
Found this place on booking.com for US$20 per night. It's very nice and in the heart of Cúcuta.

Secure parking. Hot water. Mini-fridge. Large room with a large bed. I have a small balcony looking over the street. Pool. Everything is very clean. Wifi is slow.

A few blocks away are some fancy hotels and a street full of trendy restaurants, bars, and clubs. 

The area directly around the hotel, and probably the whole city, isn't perfectly safe at night. There is a large homeless population. 

But if you're coming through, I can recommend this hotel. I can't compare it to anywhere else in the city, since this is the only place I know.

Location: Carrera 1, Crespo, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130002, Colombia
Name: Agencia Lavanderia
Description:
12 thousand Colombian per kilo l, if it is for the same day it is more expensive

12mil Colombiano por kilo l, se for para o mesmo dia é mais caro

Location: Carrera 8, Roldanillo, Norte, Valle del Cauca, 761550, Colombia
Name: parque la ermita
Description:
We settled next to the church since it was raining too much when we arrived. The park could also be a good place to park since it is very wide. We didn't have any problems, and it's fine for one night.

Nos instalamos a un costado de la iglesia ya que estaba lloviendo demasiado cuando llegamos. El parque puede ser un buen lugar también para estacionar ya que es muy amplio. No tuvimos ningún problema y está bien para pasar una noche.

Location: Casa de Francois, Calle 8, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, 418060, Colombia
Name: José Horse Riding.
Description:
Just thought id share a wonderful horse riding experience with fellow overlanders. 

We stayed at La Casa François. 
José come and meet us here with his beautiful horses. 
He is also a tour guide for San Agustín and very knowledgeable man with indigenous background. 

Took us to the main sights of the town on horse back. 

4.5 hours cost from 80,000 paso to 100, 000  paso. 
His phone number is +57 320 5841246 on watsapp

Location: Carrera 10, Garagoa, Neira, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 152860, Colombia
Name: Hotel Queen Magdalena
Description: Really nice hotel in Garagoa. centrally located. Double room was 50,000COP with private bathroom, comfy bed, hot shower and secure parking for the moto.

Location: Calle 14, Abrego, Occidente, Norte de Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel, Parking, Car Wash, Oil Change
Description:
Paid 35,000 for a single room with a fan. Basic room, only a bed and a small night stand. No hot water. Decent WiFi. 

Safe, secure parking garage. Also a place in back for oil changes, and guys who will wash your vehicle. 

Town is at 1400 meters, so the climate is better than going to Aguachica.

Location: Universidad de Nariño Sede Centro, Calle 13 #27 - 42, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520003, Colombia

Description:
We got our SAOT at this place, because the other one next to this mark was already about to close.
Even better, because we could also choose only 1 month of SOAT although everybody was telling us, that a SOAT less than 3 months isn't possible in Colombia. So we only paid 60300$ instead of ~170000$+ for each motorcycle.

Location: Localidad 2 Histórica - Rodrigo de Bastidas, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 470002, Colombia

Location: Calle 22, Mahates, Dique, Bolívar, Colombia

Description: We got to San Basilio  but Barba  Blanca wasn't there. Florentino approached us and told us we could stay at his place. We just parked outside his house, he took us on a really nice tour of the town. It was a memorable experience. Don't expect much though. We were just parked outside his house.

Location: Yellow Restaurant, Carrera 45A, UPZs Localidad Suba, Localidad Suba, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111111, Colombia

Location: Torre Isabella II, 42-42, Carrera 28, Ciudad Universitaria, UPZ Teusaquillo, Localidad Teusaquillo, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111311, Colombia

25,000 pesos per person in a dorm room
They also private rooms 70,000

Lady owner is friendly and nice. 

Clean and tidy. 

Nice neighbourhood. Not too noisy. 

I parked my motorcycle at the front. no problem overnight.

Location: Carrera 1, Monterrey, Casanare, 855010, Colombia

Location: Moñitos, Costanera, Córdoba, Colombia
Name: Hotel Verano Azul
Description:
Excellent hotel place, camping is allowed in the car and in a tent if desired, the attention, the best, the beach is in front and is quiet, it has showers and bathroom service, they offer a restaurant, they charged us 20 per car and breakfasts from 8 thousand, lunches from 12 thousand

Excelente lugar hotel, se permite acampar en el carro y en carpa si se desea, la atención, la mejor, la playa está frente y es tranquila, cuenta con duchas y servicio de baño, ofrecen restaurante, nos cobraron 20 por carro y desayunos desde 8 mil, almuerzos desde 12 mil

Location: Nemocón, Sabana Centro, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: FoCa Camping
Description:
FoCa Camping is nestled on a privately owned secluded montain, just 30 minutes away from Zipaquira and surrounded by panoramic mountain views. Its location is convenient to unwind and to explore the area, with Neusa lake nearby, Tausa, Sutatausa and Ubate. It´s a place for people who seek nature and tranquility.

After living in a big city like Bogota, we move to the country farmhouse and started several sustainable and regenerative projects. On-site we offer Internet access, electricity (110/220), municipal water and a BBQ space. Furthermore, there are a bathroom, a kitchen/social area, a washing machine and we also offer fresh vegetables from our orchard. Please note that toilets with chemicals cannot be emptied here, that no chemicals or cleaning products are used. Garbage must be separated for disposal. We speak english, french and spanish.

Camping 25.000 pesos pp/pn (from 12 years of age onward). Children 4-11 years old 10.000 pesos and children up to 3 years old free of charge. Electrical connection to RV 15.000 pesos pn.  There is no height restriction. WhatsApp/Phone: +57 3156480695

Cuando estábamos guardando la garrafa de gas en la parte de atrás del motorhome, una persona nos abrió la puerta de la camioneta y nos robó documentos, dinero, celular. Tengan cuidado.

Location: Palmira, Sur, Valle del Cauca, Colombia

Location: Necoclí, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia

Enjoy!

Location: Salento, Fría, Quindío, 631020, Colombia

Location: El Carmen, Occidente, Norte de Santander, Colombia

Description: Quiet fairly level parking spot on the side of a gravel road, about 15km off the main highway. Road is in good condition even after a rain. We leveled when we parked and the view down the river valley was nice. Very quiet at night. Just a few motorcycles in the morning. Three bars of extended Claro with a cell phone booster.

Location: Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, 661020, Colombia
Name: Hostal Casa Marina
Description:
+573185342184 Julio 
Julio is a wonderful man we stayed with him for 2 nights. I could have stayed a week. It is such a nice location with beautiful balcony with excellent views of the nice green hills. 
The price was 45,000paso per person per night. Lovely big bids. He also made us breakfast. 
He  organised us the tickets to Thermals De Santa Rosa. 40,000paso form 5pm to 11pm. 
This was a wonderful experience. 
Sitting in the hot pools watching the waterfalls all lit up at night. Highly recommend this Hostel. Which in reality is a nice cute house. It is very comfortable.

Location: Necoclí, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057870, Colombia

For 20 thousand per person. (For the van) Telephone +57 3194585435
.....
Excelente  lugar para descansar y pasar tiempo frente a la playa, la anfitriona nos atendió como en nuestro hogar , se ofrecen habitaciones múltiples (consultar el valor vigente por persona ), la anfitriona nos ofreció espacio para la van y una carpa, hay duchas, servicio sanitario y cocina. Location: Calle 14, San Juan Nepomuceno, Montes de María, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Taller automotriz la fe
Description: Big workshop, friendly owner. We stopped here as the pipe of our turbo came loose and we couldn’t tighten the tube. He didn’t have the good tube to tighten it but he jumped on his bike to find it in town. Fast and friendly service.

Location: Vía Santa Marta, Marquetalia, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia

Description:

next door a little tienda that sells Appa rellena and empanadas , very cheap and tasty 2500 cop

Location: Vereda Noboa, Sutatausa, Ubaté, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Quinta de Fagua
Description:
Nice campsite, very quiet, WiFi 
Clean toilets, warm water.
Selling beer and drink and pet friendly.

Lots of rock climbing of all kinds around: bouldering, sport and trad.

The owner Jorge is very friendly and know about all the outdoor activities around Los Farallones. There is a slackline and even a highline rigged on site. Mirador nearby too! Jorge speaks English, you can call or text him on Whatsapp +573212442548.

He also rents cabanas.

Location: Carrera 34A, Bosques de la Enea, Comuna Tesorito, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, 170003, Colombia
Name: Hostal Los Pinos
Description: Nice little hostel with very friendly owner. We got a big room with 4 beds for 45000 COP with 2 people. WiFi, hot "suicide" shower and open parking in front of the hostel - area is safe though. There is a small restaurant in the building and a lot of food options in walking distance. Quiet and safe neighborhood.

Location: Calle 79C, Las Colinas, Localidad Suroccidente, Perímetro Urbano Barranquilla, Barranquilla, Atlántico, 080016, Colombia
Name: Asistencia mecánica JyL
Description:
Amazing Mechanic! Johnny and his crew are All Venezuelans and no problem is too hard for them. We stayed for more than 2 months at another mechanic who eventually still couldn’t solve our problem (which was recommended by Iguana 4x4). Johnny came and found the issue within 5 minutes! He’s specialized in Fords, but I see all branches standing on his property. Even his daughter is working here as a mechanic, the first female mechanic we’ve met all over the world!
They are very solution minded and I can’t recommend them more!

Location: Carrera 4, Guamal, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Offroad
Description:
This is 60km of offroad. In our opinion 4x4 not required if you have clearance and if it does not rain. If it does rain forget it you’ll get stuck in the mud.
Otherwise it is a very nice drive, beautiful scenery but long. 2h+ for 60km

Location: El Pomarrosal, San José de Suaita, Suaita, Comunera, Santander, Colombia
Name: cascada de los caballeros
Description: We spent one night parking in front of the waterfall. In the morning the lady of the house in front offered us some coffee, orange juice and then, as we spent more time with her, she cooked us something for lunch, everything for free. We went up to the waterfall, they charged us 1000 pesos, on the second entrance after the bridge. Amazing spot at the top of the waterfall. Very calm at night.

Location: El Playón - San Alberto, El Playón, Metropolitana, Santander, Colombia
Name: Terpel gas station
Description: Slept there after being rejected on the truck stop. This is actually way better. Calm, with free toilets and showers. A restaurant is also here but we didn’t try it. There is a water tap next to the toilets

Location: Carrera 50, Fredonia, Suroeste, Antioquia, Colombia
Name: Hotel Zulia
Description: We got ~200€ of COP stolen, while having breakfast the next morning for about an hour. We told one of them, that we would quickly leave for breakfast before checkout. There were no other people in the hotel that time and a camera facing towards our room door. They told us, that they can't check the video material and they would have to order a video technician, what would need ~3 hours. My wife got so angry, telling that we even would wait the whole day and also get the police involved, that they suddenly started negotiating the price to get out of the trouble. Finally, she got all the stolen money back + the price for the hotel room. You should definitely avoid this place.

Location: Calle 74, Urbanización La Navarra, Apartadó, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057847, Colombia
Name: Texaco Gas Station
Description: A few parking spots for up to medium sized rigs, 24/7 security present, toilets of the gas station were clean and always open. Perfect for the night!

Location: San Calixto, Carrera 3, Timaná, Sur, Huila, Colombia
Name: Hotel Hosteria La Gaitana
Description: Quoted 70000 for 1 person and they were very reluctant to lower it, but managed to get it for 60000 when I was about to walk away. Nice large room with multiple beds, so a couple would find it better value for money. The WiFi didn’t reach my room (near the pool), so I wish I’d gone to the other place on iOverlander instead.

Location: Edificio Hidalpa, 35-20, Calle 12A, San Ignacio, Comuna 7, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520001, Colombia

Description: Street parking next to a dog park and near a big shopping mall. Legal to park on this street, and was ok for a night. It's a city, so don't expect it to be quiet all night, but there were police around from time to time and seemed fine to spend the night here. The dog park is great for your dog too! The mall has clean bathrooms that are open until 11pm.

Location: Carrera 7, Belén de Umbría, Vertiente Occidental, Risaralda, Colombia

Description: Simple hotel, clean, friendly family running the place, quite a lot of stairs to carry bicycle up! 45,000 pesos for the night. (bring ear plugs the town centre is noisy!)

Location: La Rochela, Betania, Andes, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056070, Colombia
Name: Chorros Taparto Cáscaras
Description:
Very beautiful waterfall 
About 9km from the town
The road to the water fall is a little rough with rocks but no problem. 
I arrived with my Yamaha Tenere motorcycle. 
You can park at the cafe and walk 10 min from here. 
It has 3 waterfalls with a miradore and 2 places you can swim. 

Also a small track you can climb all the way to the tow waterfall. 

Came on a Tuesday only 2 other people here.

Location: Carrera 3b, Magangué, Mojana, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Robbery Attempt - Magangue
Description:
We had to slow down at this intersecrtion and someone (whom I saw noticed us coming from a distance) used the opportunity to jump on the side steps, lean inside the open windows and try to steal whatever he finds. He could not reach anything valuable so he demanded my phone. 
This all happened while we were in motion.
Arguing, asking, begging did not make him want to leave and get off of the truck so i accelerated which may have made him scared and finally he jumped off. He may have also concluded that we are not giving him anything.
It all happened very fast. 
A couple of times he reached down to his picket which retrospectively seemed like he had been reaching for a weapon of some sort. Luckily we never found out.

Location: Ammazza, Carrera 34, La Florida, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050020, Colombia

Location: Aguachica, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Cabana Milan
Description: Villa 10 beds with swimming pool and air conditioning in two bedrooms. Booking on Booking or Airbnb. Very pleasant to rest from the extreme heat of the region (300,000 COP/night). Possibility to park campers in the garden. Washing machine and possibility to fill up with water

Location: El Copial, Apulo - Tocaima, Anapoima, Tequendama, Cundinamarca, Colombia
Name: Llanero
Description: very rustic Restaurant, pork from open fire- Grill. big portions, we shared one for two of us, was 25 k and rico! Nice View. Second Restaurant other side of the street.

Location: Charalá - Virolín, Andorro, Charalá, Guanentá, Santander, Colombia
Name: high grass plateau
Description: Flat area (not super flat) on the left side of the way, if you come from San Gil, with very high grass where you can find space for one or maybe two tents. You have to climb to the plateau on the left. Don't expect a nice spot, this is only useful for an overnight. But the surroundings are beautiful and it is not easily visible from the path.

Location: Panamericana, Patía, Sur, Cauca, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Sabor con Tradicion
Description: We spent the night here. Basic with shady parking and clean toilets and adjacent to both the road and the restaurant. Once the sun went down, traffic on the road was very minimal. Food at the restaurant was very plain and very limited menu. Soup and eggs for breakfast. Fresh juice was excellent. Coffee was a sad example from a country that grows some of the best coffee in the world.

Location: Riohacha, La Guajira, 440007, Colombia
Name: Riohacha
Description: Very easy access for any type of vehicle.  Great place, wild and very spacious, fishermen right next door.  Calm night.  We stayed 2 nights.

Location: Pan tipico, 8-27, Calle 10, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, 154001, Colombia

Location: Vía Villavicencio - Acacías, Villavicencio, Capital, Meta, Colombia

Natural place for camping and swim. Parking. Food and bathroom.
Cheap

Location: Aguazul, Casanare, Colombia
Name: Beautiful River Access
Description: Beautiful little place at the river. Plenty of shade from the surrounding trees. Very quite and peaceful. Level spot for one or two cars. We stayed for one night and saw nobody else. One of the better wild campspots in Colombia.

Location: La Candelaria, Piedecuesta, Santander, 681011, Colombia
Name: Taller El Molino
Description: Many tallers here. We went to El Molino. We had problems with the alternator and they fixed it! Very sympathetic and very efficient! Thanks Miller (mecano electrico) for your help.

Location: Vía El Carmen de Chucuri - San Vicente Chucurí, NOPAL, El Carmen de Chucurí, Yariguíes, Santander, Colombia
Name: Road between El Carmen and San Vicente
Description:
A really bad road. We drove it after it rained. It was very muddy and slippery. There were a lot of 'cleaned' landslides. If you want to go to San Vicente go via north (7.147691, -73.302571). That road is in way better condition. 

Good luck!

Location: DISTRI YEPEZ - Gaitan, 15-58, Carrera 15, Comuna 4 - Occidental, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, 680001, Colombia
Name: Taller Auto Adila - Toyota cars
Description:
Freddy and his team helped us a lot. We had problems with our fuel pump. After two other mechanics (who couldn't solve our problem) Freddy could solve it. He worked for more than 10 years for an official Toyota dealer. So he has a lot of knowledge about Toyota cars. 

The neighborhood isn't the best to wait outside with your mobile phone in your hand. They have a waiting room upstairs with WiFi, coffee and potable water.

Highly recommended! Good luck!

Location: Saboyá, Occidente, Boyacá, Colombia
Name: Spot for one vehicle with river access
Description: We were looking for a wild spot, which is close to the Highway 45A, and we found this beautiful spot. There is space for one vehicle direct at a small road (nothing bigger than a minivan). It seems to be the access to the river for the locals and it’s in between two properties. You are surrounded by Eukalyptus trees and meadows, it’s calm and beautiful. No overview or something really special, just nature. We arrived at 3pm and some locals were passing by until 8pm (car, bike, foot). Everyone besides one where really friendly. One seems to be not that amused. We asked him, if it’s ok when we stay for one night, and he said yes. We had a calm night. If you stay on weekdays, be aware that you park as far as possible away from the road. The school bus needs the corner for his turn.

Location: Calle 66A, Cristo Rey, Comuna 15 - Guayabal, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050023, Colombia
Name: Mayorca HomeStay
Description: Mayorca HomeStay is a very quiet hostel. It has 3 rooms, each with its own bathroom.  It is in front of a park with many trees.  The room is 120k pesos per couple with breakfast.  Hugo and Stella are very good hosts

Location: Florián - Tununguá, Florián, Vélez, Santander, 684541, Colombia
Name: “Thysqua Refugio Florián”
Description: Thysqua Refugio Florián offers 2 Cabañas with breathtaking view of the cascadas. We paid 100’ per night.  The place is not accessible with big rigs. Only bikes and 4x4 recommended, especially when it’s wet. Tents are also welcome. Theres a place under a round pavilion and also shower and a toilet. At this location you can easily blend into nature. We stayed 3 nights and visited the cave (ventana de Thisquizote) and the base pool (charco azul). From the cabanas You can hike directly to the base and do a loop via the village back to the place. Like 12 km and 3h absolute worth the effort. Sergio, his mom Rubiela and José are super friendly hosts. They help you with everything. We felt that this is a really special location in Colombia.

Location: unidad medica radiologica del carmen, Cra. 12 #44, Calle 10, Riohacha, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 440001, Colombia

Lugar tranquilo y muy seguro. Parqueadero de una familia que vive al lado, super dulce y servicial. Obtuve agua y hay una salida en el lugar, pero no la usamos.

Lugar tranquilo e bem seguro. Parqueadero de uma família que mora ao lado, super queridos e solícitos. Consegui água e tem uma tomada no local mas não usamos.

Location: Donde Santiago, Guasca - La Calera, Salitre, Guasca, Guavio, Cundinamarca, 251217, Colombia

Description: This is a gravel road all the way to Jardin from Jerico. You save 45km instead of going back to the main road but def not time. Views are amazing as you drive through coffee culture and along a river. 4x4 recommended but no required when dry but clearance is better.

Location: Via a Buenos Aires, Jericó, Suroeste, Antioquia, Colombia

Description: Here you can have access to the river from the road. Very refreshing cold water !

Location: Vía Guatapé - San Rafael, San Rafael, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053837, Colombia

nice small Hostal direct at the street between Guatape and San Rafael, they offer privat rooms, breakfast and dinner,
natural pool direct by the house, we stand for two nights with our camper (land rover with rooftent), the entrance is app. 2,5 meters! there is space for two campers, 
all is very clean.
the owners name is Perla. they offer hiking tours with different duration and grads into the mountains.

Location: Café Frances, Carrera 3; Córdoba, Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, 056050, Colombia

Description: Great French cafe, where you can taste the best ice cream in Colombia for us.  They have an incredible variety of flavors and all the ice creams are homemade.  You can also enjoy excellent Breton crepes with the icing on the cake, salted butter caramel.  Vero and Matthieu the owners welcome you with a smile.  A delight!!!!

Location: Carrera 32, Los Alamos de Occidente, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, 190004, Colombia

As well they have a small secure parking but only for small car or motorbike. 
If not there is a parking right next to the hotel but it’s indépendant from the hotel for bigger car super secure with camera and guard.
The people who run the place are soooo lovely. 
The place is secure.
Private rooms with own bathroom and hot shower.

24h checkin 
Highly recommend !

Location: Mutatá, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057420, Colombia

Totally worths it because is an unexplored area that has much to offer!

Description: This place is an absolute gem. They have actual brown bread without a ton of sugar, with nuts and natural ingredients. Like real "European" bread. Best I've had after a year around South America. The coffee is also divine. They have a nice little patio to chill on, bring bug spray though. Coffee take away also available, along with the best brownies and some other delicious cakes. Not the cheapest, but seriously the best!

Location: Calle 12, Ipiales, Ex-Providencia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524060, Colombia
Name: Multiseguros Insurance Ipiales
Description:
We bought our SOAT with Olga from MULTISEGUROS today. Easy process. Although the sign says you need copies of various documents, we didn't have to provide them. Olga made all required photocopies from our original documents. You need to bring:
- Passport 
- Driving Licence
- Vehicle Registration 
- TIP
!!! You can only pay in cash. They accept USD but add an extra charge for the conversion. 

We paid COP 391.000 (06/2024) for 3 months for a 7.5t truck. A lighter vehicle would have been approx. COP 90.000 to 100.000 less. 

The office is open Mondays to Fridays from 8:00am to 12:30pm and from 2:00pm to 6:00pm

See photos for more details.

Don't know about prices because it was a gift for us :) Very delicious and also the dough, very tasty and crunchy.
