Name: Previsora
Description:
At Previsora, it was possible for us to renew a SOAT for a foreign-plated vehicle, and for as little as one month. 

However, the process of getting an appointment here is a bit complex! Apparently it’s been this way since 2022, so as the other SOAT entries in Cali are several years old, I thought it would be useful to share our experience.

Previsora give out 20 appointments each day, and in order to get one, you are supposed to queue up outside the office building before it opens. A security guard advised us that people usually arrive from 5am - we arrived shortly before 5 the next day, and several people were already there. I think they started around 4. At 7:30am someone came out and assigned everyone a number - the first 10 got an appointment in the morning, the other 10 in the afternoon (from 2pm). 

Besides this, the appointment itself was simple enough. We spoke to other insurance offices in the city, who seemed to have the same type of system - none were pre-booking any appointments. 

Maybe this will change at some point, but for now this seems the only way to get your insurance in Cali, so better to avoid doing it here if you have the option, and go to another city!

Es un EDS con un restaurante Altoque y tiene una llave (grifo) disponible para llenar agua (water) del RV. Nosotros llenamos 300 litros gratis (free). Aprovechamos para tanquear diesel ahí mismo. 
La llave está al lado del punto de inflado de llantas.

Location: Oiba - Guadalupe, Guadalupe, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Parking Guadalupe
Description: Opposite the Terpel gas station you can park and stay overnight. An older, nice man runs the place.

Location: Troncal Central, Pescadero, Piedecuesta, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 681011, Colombia
Name: Restaurante La Alemana
Description:
Restaurant and little tienda and they sell some bikeparts like tires and brakepads. Free cold water for cyclists.
Kind of Cafe de cyclista.

On the other side of the road is a supermarket.

Location: Mirador Del Chicamocha, Troncal Central, Aratoca, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 682051, Colombia
Name: Mirador del Chicamocha
Description: Litttle restaurant with great view.  They also sell some artesanian bread and cookies.  Food is not really spectcular bit oke when you are a hungry cyclist climbing up this hill.

Location: Aratoca, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Alto de Aratoca
Description: Good restaurant at the highest point of the route to San Gil. They serve delicious meals with fresh ingredients. Friendly staff.

Location: Calle 30A, La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 055060, Colombia
Name: Asados Doña Rosa
Description: Huge restaurant with a big menu. Typical food, huge parking with lots of shade. There is also a drogueria right next to it. Food was delicious!

Location: Guarderia San Francisco de Asis, Calle 1, Alfonso Lopez, Oriente, Perimetro Urbano Pereira, Pereira, AMCO, Area Metropolitana Centro Occidente, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660099, Colombia
Name: Edier‘s Workshop
Description:
General mechanic fixing all type of problems on all types of cars. Very well equipped and huge network, for special tasks he includes colleagues or specialists. 
Edier has a great working manner. Very honest and transparent, kept us updated with videos and always kept in touch with us. Absolutely reasonable pricing. 
In total highly recommendable.

Location: Villa Del Prado, Isnos, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Cielo Parapente
Description: Nice and safe Campground on the top of a hill. From here you have a wonderful view to the Canyon del Río Magdalena. The owner also offers Paragliding-Services. There is enough place for all kind of Overlanders. It is a 'must' if you visit San Augustin. Price is pay as you wish… no fixed price.

Location: Tello, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje beatriz
Description: Very nice welcome, original environment, quiet and full of flowers.

Location: Carrera 8, Mogotes, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Mogotes - Hotel La Casona
Description:
Hotel/restaurant on the main square of Mogotes. Nice old colonial building in a friendly town.  We had a double room with own bathroom, tv, wifi for 70.000.  We could park our bicycles in the restaurant.

The restaurant wasn’t open when we were here but there are a few others next door.

Clean and friendly staff

Location: El Rancherito, Doble Calzada Niquia - Hatillo, Copacabana, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 051037, Colombia
Name: El Rancherito
Description:
A restaurant with a large parking lot. Park your car for free. The area is very quiet. there is a service station in front. Lunches from 18k COP, I slept one night without inconveniences, inside the restaurant there are bathrooms and you can work on your laptop, the people are generous.
.....
Es un restaurante con un gran Parquedero donde puedes ingresar Parquear tu auto sin valor, La zona es muy tranquila hay una Estación de servicio al frente Encuentras almuerzos desde 18k COP, Dormí una noche sin inconvenientes, dentro del restaurante hay baños y puedes trabajar en tu portátil, la gente es muy formal y generosa

Location: 40, El Pescador, Calarcá, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 632001, Colombia
Name: Intento de estafa/robo
Description:
On the road a motorcycle approaches with 2 men who tell us that we could not enter Armenia because they did not allow the circulation of cars or motorcycles that day (that was true), they put the motorcycle in front and we had to brake, one of them approaches. passenger side and tells us that one wheel was losing brake fluid. We decided to start and go the other way, we stopped at a Primax 2 blocks away, they followed us, they told us again about the fluid loss and that they had a workshop to check it. We didn't give it much importance and we told them that we were going to pay attention and they left. When we looked we had some fluid stained on the wheel but there are no traces of leakage from the brake system. It seems to be a common form of deception. Be careful

Sobre la ruta se acerca una moto con 2 hombres que nos dicen que no podíamos entrar a Armenia porque no permitían ese día circulación de carros o motos (eso era cierto), ponen la moto adelante y tuvimos que frenar, se acerca uno de ellos del lado del acompañante y nos dice que nos perdía líquido de freno una rueda. Decidimos arrancar e irnos hacia otro lado, paramos en una primax a 2 cuadras, nos siguen, nos vuelven a decir sobre la perdida del líquido y que tenían un taller para revisarlo. No le dimos mayor relevancia y le dijimos que nosotros nos íbamos a fijar y se fueron. 
Cuando miramos teníamos manchada la rueda con algún líquido pero no hay rastros de perdida desde el sistema de frenos.
Parece ser una forma frecuente de engaño. Tengan cuidado.

Location: Ecolodge peñas blancas, Vía Otoval - Bocas - pueblo Viejo - Arales, El Peñón, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Entrance bosque de Pandora
Description: This is the entrance to the trail of the pandora forests. The road to get here is small and all gravel. At the trailhead is enough space for 4 cars.

Location: Vía Granada - Mesetas - Granada, San Juan de Arama, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Checho's Place. Finca La Gloria
Description: Nice and safe place to stay near Lejanias and Mesetas. Rio Güejar, rafting and sightseeing. Wonderful surroundings. Highly recommended.

Location: Florián - Tununguá, Florián, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684541, Colombia
Name: Roadside opening
Description:
Slightly overgrown small quarry site. Good to spent a night since not much is listed around here. Visible from road but quiet/cool/not a lot of bugs at night. 
Space for 2 medium sized rigs or 1 bigger rig. Along a typical dirt road, no 4x4 needed.

Location: Complejo Turistico Aguablanca, Troncal Central, Rio Suarez, La Capilla, Puente Nacional, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Garden of Hotel Agua Blanca
Description:
We were the first overlander here, but they offered us to park in their garden next to the hotel. It’s a beautiful area next to the river and the garden also offers three trees for shade. 
The gate is quite narrow. We fit with a Fiat Ducato / Ram Promaster so every van should fit. The price is 25k ppn including use of the pool. It’s a beautiful place, check the photos.

Location: Carrera 7, Belén, Tundama, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 150640, Colombia
Name: parque principal belen
Description: Quiet place next to the church, it has a mini blind block where any type of camper can fit, that is, the church rings the bells every hour, we believe, although nothing out of this world.

Location: Santa Elena, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: estación de gasolina Zeus
Description:
At the back of the gas station there is a viewpoint, I asked for permission and without any problem I was able to stay one night with a great view, there are bathrooms, a restaurant and you can ask for water for whatever you need, it is a good place if you are passing through and need to rest for a while. evening. At 11:00 am the next day, the security guard asked me to please move the vehicle to another place because it is a commercial area. 

Al fondo de la estación de gasolina hay un mirador, pedí permiso y sin problema pude quedarme una noche con una gran vista, hay baños, restaurante y puedes pedir agua para lo que necesites, es un buen sitio si estás de paso y requieres descansar una noche. Siendo las 11:am del día siguiente, el guardia de seguridad me pidió el favor de mover el vehículo a otro lugar por que es una zona de comercio

Location: La Cabaña, Camino a la Laguna Verde, Túquerres, Sapuyes, La Sabana, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Trailhead to Volcan Azufral/Laguna Verde
Description:
You can park in front of the cabaña, which is actually an abandoned former ranger station. The parking lot is big enough for several rigs, but it's not that flat. But it's easy to level out your camper. The night was super quiet, we felt safe. No cellphone service.
The road up here is a dirt road and it get's a little narrow at the end. High clearance is recommended, but columbians drive in any kind of car.

Don't miss the hike to the Laguna (11km roundtrip). A sign on the other side of the entrance says its not allowed to walk to the volcano. We talked to locals and they said it's fine to hike to the laguna, we met about 15 other hikers on our way.

Location: Guaduales de la Floresta, Calle 10, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631020, Colombia
Name: Horse Riding Salento Tour
Description: here you can book wonderful horseback riding excursions. the horses are treated very well and are well trained. also highly recommended for beginners. there are different tours, we chose the 3 hour tour through the river for 90,000 cop ppn. it was an unforgettable experience, we can only recommend it. the family also owns the associated campsite

Location: Turbaco, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Robbery with knife at noon
Description: Be careful in Tubarco. We were said it is safe to walk here if you don't have phone in hand. But the second day we were robbed by a guy with huge knife. He took a drone and phone from us and escaped with a friend on moto. Police told us it's not safe to walk in side streets. Only on the main shopping street in town.

Location: Casa Lobo, Carrera 5, Finca Bolivar, Minca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470008, Colombia
Name: Public Parking Minca
Description: Daytime parking. No overnight staying allowed. Space for light vehicles or vans.

Location: Carrera 8B, Modelo Sur, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad San Cristóbal, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 110411, Colombia
Name: Taller Sanchez
Description:
This garage (Taller) is a family business and can help you out with effectively any possible problem you might have with your car! They are specialized in Land Rover and 4x4 but can deal with any brand.

We got our 40 year old Land Rover Defender repaired by the Sanchez family and parts that are not available to buy they can get made locally! We stranded 500km away from Bogota but the family also arranged a semi-trailer to retrieve our car!

Extremely nice and helpful family run by father Armando, son Christian and uncle Alberto.
If they cannot fix it they know where to go and the same is true for any other business you might need to do or help you need in Bogota and surroundings!

We strongly recommend this garage and family!

To contact them you can use the WhatsApp of Christian Sanchez: +57 313 4727927

Location: Estatua Juan José Rondón, Carrera 5, Soata, Soatá, Norte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 151001, Colombia
Name: parque de soata
Description:
quiet park and has a public water tap where you can get supplies, very quiet next to the police command

parque tranquilo y cuenta con una llave de agua pública donde abastecerse, muy tranquilo al lado del Comando de policía

Location: Calle 30A, La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 055060, Colombia
Name: La Pintada
Description: ATM struggle to find, but this on Calle 30A , a local.lady guided us!

Location: Carrera 17B, Comuna 6 - La Concordia, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 680003, Colombia
Name: Calle 51

diagonal hay un negocio que se llama Súper, ahí son muy atentos con los visitantes y les pueden ayudar con lo que necesiten en Bucaramanga.

Location: Pijao, Cordillerana, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 632060, Colombia
Name: Space on the side of the road with view to the town
Description: This is a space on the left side of the road, like 150 meters on the way up after the river. Pretty quiet, you hear the river sound from here and you are able to see the town.

Location: Carrera 10, Mutatá, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057420, Colombia
Name: Eco hotel Alazán
Description:
Nice decent modern and clean hotel. I paid 60.000 for a single bed room (2p) airconditioning , a simular room with a ventilator is 50.000. I was alone so I don’t know if that affects the price.

Wifi works but cuts off frequently.

They have double bed rooms as well (4p).

I could park my bicycle in a safe common room, but with a bit of convincing I could park it in the room.

There is big safe parking for vehicles.

This town is full of hotels. I went for the best looking one and agreed with the price and I liked it. If you want to spend less, there are cheaper looking ones.

Location: Ecolodge peñas blancas, Vía Otoval - Bocas - pueblo Viejo - Arales, El Peñón, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Bosque Pandora | tour and camping
Description:
Pandora Forest when you see the sign, you have arrived  A place worth visiting. Remote and magnificent. 

Contact : Jose +57 314 322 210 6

The road to get here isn't the easiest, but we managed it without any issues with our Citroën Jumper, a 2WD. It's narrow and rugged, and even trucks and buses take the same route. We just had to take our time :)

The spot to park your vehicle is right along this small road with very little traffic. There's a small parking area in front of the sign. Edgard, the guide, will show you around the area, and you can enjoy the fantastic terrace and toilet/shower facilities.

They offer several outings:
- Vertical Hills: The Colombian Avatar. Unmissable and breathtaking.
- Cueva el Oro: The most famous one.
- Cueva La Trônera: Immense.

Each activity is around 60,000 pesos, and the price also depends on whether you choose to have a meal on-site or not.

The team is incredibly welcoming, accommodating, and lovely. We had one of our most beautiful moments here in Colombia.

Location: Calle 52, Abejorral, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 055030, Colombia
Name: Casa Las Abejas (Hotel Casa on Google)
Description:
Central hotel with secure gated parking for motorcycles and cars (sorry, low garage door so not even small campers fit). Plus ok WiFi.
60,000 COP for double room, 2 persons/night.
Beautiful colonial Hotel that has most definitely seen better days. I love the rickety charm, but it's not for everyone. Totally clean though, desk, storage for clothes, hot suicide shower that actually gets real hot and was quiet at night. 
Plus playful cat that loves to be stroked.

Location: Calle 20, Comuna 4, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520003, Colombia
Name: Baloo motorcycle self wash
Description: This is a selfwash place for motorcycles. For 3000 pesos you can wash your motorcycle. Really good and modern place.

Location: Galería Hopulus, 8-60, Calle 81, El Nogal, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Chapinero, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 110221, Colombia
Name: Galeria Hopulus - German Brewery
Description:
A real treat for those who like to enjoy a good German beer and a crunchy pretzel in a relaxed atmosphere.
In case the owner is on site, he may give you some valuable travel tips. He loves 4x4 off-road tours and is an excellent photographer (www.hopulus.co/pages/the-hopulus-experience)

Location: Doradal, Puerto Triunfo, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Infront of a supermarket
Description: I asked the owner David if it’s possible to park here for one night. No problem.for me it’s more safe and quite than on the Main Street to the park👍

Location: Calle 8, El Cocuy, Gutiérrez, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 151280, Colombia
Name: Café de mi Tierra
Description:
Cool colonial building with a coffeebar with really good Colombian coffee. In the evening there is a restaurant in the same courtyard with tasty “comidas rapidas” like pizza, hamburgers, hotdogs, fries and patacones with guacamole and pulled carne de res.  Very good and something different etc.

Wifi in the coffeebar is good

Location: Carrera 46, Perpetuo Socorro, Comuna 10 - La Candelaria, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050016, Colombia
Name: Greiautos Mecanica General
Description:
AleJandro is a very nice, englisch speaking owner. He is very helpful and his mechanic guys do a really good job.
He made my front and rear brakes, oil & filter change and  Diesel filter. The whole for 760.000, while the oil was already 350.000
They made a really good job.

Location: Cañasgordas, Occidente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Hotel el Real
Description:
Simple and clean hotel. Good WiFi. No parking. My room didn’t have aircon or a ventilator, but it was less warm as I thought at night.

The lady that helped me was nice, but she tried me out if I could pay more. I asked for the cheapest room and first she wanted to show me the 60.000 pesos room. I told here I was looking for something more cheap, then it turned out she had a 1 person room as well. First she said 40.000, but finally I paid 35.000. Which is the regular price I think. Just be careful what you pay.

My bicycle fitted inside the room. 

There are several other hotels in town as well. I didn’t checked them out.

Location: Puipuren, Manaure, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: poromana
Description:
It is a Wayuu Indigenous community.

Where people are very cute and friendly

There's good shade and a lot of tranquility

Try to contact Professor Eli +573226044918

You can get energy and there's a river 500 meters away

The children are very friendly

There's Internet at school where you can connect

------------------------------

donde la gente es muy linda y amigable 
hay buena sombra y mucha tranquilidad 
tratar de contactar al Profesor Eli +573226044918 
te pueden pasar energía y hay un río a 500 metros

tiene Internet en la escuela donde te puedes conectar

Location: Carrera 2, Bocagrande, Tierra Bomba, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Doctor Guau
Description:
To make the certificate of good health to travel to another country. It cost $180 thousand pesos. Location: Cafetal Gumer, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 418060, Colombia
Name: ATV Quad Bikes Tour
Description:
Do you want to live a unique experience in San Agustín, Huila? Join our ATV adventure tour and discover the most impressive tourist sites in the region! Explore the natural and archaeological beauty of St. Augustine while having fun on an exciting ATV adventure. Visit the tourist sites of La Chaquira (sculptures in the canyon), La Pelota (mountain sculptures), El Purutal (colorful sculptures) and much more. The tour guide will take you along the safest paths and will provide you with interesting information at the tourist sites about the history and culture of the region. Don't miss this unique opportunity to explore St. Augustine in a different way! Book your ATV tour today.

ATVs: automatic, easy handling 
route difficulty: medium

includes:

-Medical insurance 
-helmets 
-parking lot 
-gasoline 
-ATV for 2 people

All-inclusive price: 250,000 COP (1 or 2 people in 1 ATV). 
Ask about the discount price for Overlanders

Location: Hotel & Camping La Cumbre Del Macizo San Agustin 
phone: +57 3204780261

www.cuatrimotossanagustin.com

Location: Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Villa Margarita - Glife Apartments
Description:
Several apartments of Glife, located in Villa Margarita complex.
Manga neighborhood has small shops, restaurants, car wash, etc. and seems safe, even at night. 
Taxi ride to the historic center is approx. 10 minutes.
It has one larger parking spot in front of the building, outside the gate. It can be useful for persons with a campervan who want to have their vehicle close to an apartment.

Location: Carrera 2B, Leticia, Amazonas, RAP Amazonía, 910001, Colombia
Name: Ticket Office for Leticia  to Manaus
Description:
Here you can buy the tickets for the fast and the slow ferry. It's all fairly easy. Tickets for the vehicle must be purchased directly at the vessel.
Take a Mototaxi to get here.
Deck passage 250real, cabin 750real for the slow ferry, plus 10% if you want to pay eith credit card. That includes meals, bring own dishes.

Location: Doradal, Puerto Triunfo, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: street parking
Description: Quiet street next to a hotel, police around the corner, which we asked if it is ok. nothing fancy but we had a calm Saturday night

Location: Corrales, Tundama, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 152020, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje El Campanario
Description:
Small hotel/hostel near the main square of a friendly little village.  
Hotel is very clean, good beds and the staff is very friendly.  We could store our bikes in the bar of the hotel, which was closed. We paid 80.000 for a room with a double bed with own bathroom. 
Wifi is good. 

Around and near the mainsquare there are coffeebars, tiendas, panaderia’s and little restaurants.

Location: Calle 8, San Fernando, Comuna Fundadores, Perímetro Urbano Armenia, Armenia, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 630001, Colombia
Name: CONFORD CENTER Mecánico Ford
Description: Mechanic specialised on Ford, very quick, very helpful, very friendly, professional work. Better ask for 1) price of "repuestos" (spare parts) and 2) price of "mano de obra"(working time) first. He first wanted to "gringoe" us with the "mano de obras", but we could talk to him and lower the price to a reasonable one. Right next to his workshop is a parking lot that fits for big rigs, there we could stay for the repair.

Location: 57, Gámbita, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel Maria Fernanda
Description:
Quite a fancy hotel with swimming pools and luxury rooms. 
We treated ourselves after a long and heavy day on our bikes. 
We paid 80.000 per person after a bit of negotiation. A good breakfast is included. 
Wifi, tv, hot shower etc.

Location: 17-59, Calle 10, San Fernando, Comuna El Cafetero, Perímetro Urbano Armenia, Armenia, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 630004, Colombia
Name: Solujer Llantas
Description:

Trocamos os pneus da nossa VW Kombi (185/70r14) aqui, COP 270.000 cada. Atendimento excelente, serviço rápido, aceita pagamento com cartão de crédito. Contato Arturo +57 320 7202283

Place to get Colombian pesos via Western Union, super easy, great service.

Location: a Termales de San Vicente, Predio Altamira, Vereda Potreros, Canoas, Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia

Location: Cepitá - Panachi - La Mesa de Los Santos - Acuarela, Aratoca, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 682051, Colombia

Location: El Socorro, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia

Location: Calle 14, Los Angeles, Universidad, Perimetro Urbano Pereira, Pereira, AMCO, Area Metropolitana Centro Occidente, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660003, Colombia
Name: San Lucas Centro Veterinário y Diagnóstico
Description:
Complete veterinary clinic, laboratory and imaging exams.  Great service, we brought our dog for a checkup and we really enjoyed it.  Very attentive veterinarians. 24h

Clínica veterinária completa, exames de laboratório e de imagem. Ótimo atendimento, trouxemos nossa cachorrinha para fazer um checkup e gostamos muito. Veterinários bastante atenciosos. 24h

Location: 90, Lorica, Bajo Sínú, Córdoba, RAP Caribe, 231020, Colombia
Name: EDS La Playita
Description:
We stayed there for almost a week. We got a deal for $10,000 COP per night per car. It is possible to get a shower for $ 3.000 COP.

Even you can go to the town on a motorcycle for $ 8.000 COP round trip

Friendly people and quiet place

Oct. 23

Location: 64, San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684039, Colombia
Name: Extrema aventura
Description:
Extreme sport above an 860m canyon. Bungee jumping, zip line, bicicable…. Recommended

Sport extrême au dessus d’un canyon de 860m. Saut à l’élastique, tyrolienne, bicicable…. Recommanded

Location: Tree Gana Hostal, Camino interveredal, Rio Ciego, San Francisco, Acandí, Darién, Chocó, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Treegana hostal
Description:
Superb place run by Arnaud (a Frenchman) and his Colombian wife. A little paradise, with its natural swimming pool, its tree houses. His house with different bedrooms and shared bathroom. It is also possible to sleep in a tent or hammock. A kitchen area available and a restaurant. 1 km from the port. RECOMMENDED +++
--------
Superbe endroit tenu par Arnaud (un français) et sa femme colombienne. Un petit paradis, avec sa piscine naturelle, ses cabanes dans les arbres. Sa maison avec différentes chambres et salle de bain commune. Possibilité aussi de dormir en tente ou en hamac. Un espace cuisine à disposition et un restaurant. A 1 km du port. RECOMMANDED +++

Location: Playona, Acandí, Darién, Chocó, RAP Pacífico, Colombia

Description:
Superb place by the sea, with pretty colorful cabins. Sandra is very welcoming. She organizes tours to see the leatherback turtles laying eggs as well as the baby turtles returning to the sea. Very good meal and breakfast. Accessible on foot or by boat RECOMMENDED+++
--------
Superbe endroit au bord de la mer, avec de jolies cabanes colorées. Sandra est très accueillante. Elle organise les tours pour voir la ponte des tortues luth ainsi que les bébés tortues qui rejoignent la mer. Très bon repas et petit dej. Accessible à pied ou en bateau RECOMMANDED+++

Location: Iglesia Asamblea Cristiana, 6 - 38, Avenida Central, Arcabuco, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154201, Colombia
Name: Hotel Orígenes
Description: Fancy hotel on the mainsquare of Arcabuco. Luxury rooms. We had the cheapest room for 165.000 cop.  Breakfast included. Indoor parking, elevator

Location: Vía Arcabuco - Villa de Leyva, La Periquera, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154002, Colombia
Name: Trattoria Villa Venezia
Description:
Italian restaurant with delicious home made products. The owner is an Italian and makes the artesian food.
Homemade ravioli, real tiramisu, espresso, limocello …… the perfect place for the real italian food lover

Location: Calle 13, Mutatá, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056450, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje Linda Mariana
Description: 30,000 pesos for a room with 2 beds, private bathroom, TV. There are rooms with one bed as well, but the lady at the desk was very kind and let me use a bigger room so that I can bring my bicycle into my room. Nothing fancy but  clean linen and a good night to rest.

Location: Alejandría - Santo Domingo, Santo Domingo, Nordeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Road from Alejandria to Santo Domingo

Location: 60, Vereda Centro, Sáchica, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 153880, Colombia
Name: Hotel San Luis Sachica
Description:
Clean and good hotel on the main road through Sachica. Spacious rooms and nice bathroom with good showers. 
There is a little swimming pool/jacuzzi, indoors. We paid 180000 for a double room including breakfast.

Location: Hacienda el Recuerdo, Minca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470008, Colombia
Name: Flat parking lot
Description: I stayed here at a flat parking lot,I think it will be quite in the night,but the other campground I couldn’t find or it was closed…nice view here and the restaurant is close.

Location: Vía Candelaria_Ráquira_TresEsquinas, La Candelaria, Ráquira, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje Santa Barbara
Description:
In front of the monestry is a little square with a few little tienda’s and a kind of restaurant.  There are two hospedajes on the square. Sant Barbara was the only one which was open. It’s a beautiful house with modern and spacious rooms. Beautiful bathroom. Quite luxurious.  We had to pay 160000 for a double room. We could park our bicycles in the garage.

The lady of the house is very helpful.

We visited the monestry as well but it’s a long storytelling trip along the paintings.  It”s a kind of spiritual centre for people who wants a retreat or so.

Location: Casa Azul, Güicán, Gutiérrez, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 151440, Colombia
Name: Posadas Tashikewo
Description: Posada in an old farmhouse. All kind of farm animals and cats and dogs play around on the property, very amusing to see. We stayed one night, and we were not cold at night altough the rooms were not heated here. Plenty of blankets were provided to keep warm. We had breakfast an dinner, which were both very simple and traditional, but that very much was in line with the surroundings. The host was also very nice, he greeted us with coffee when we arrived.

Location: Camino real, Vereda Noboa, Sutatausa, Ubaté, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Ambiente familiar, en ubicado en la parte baja de los farallones de sutatausa, estacionamiento grande, fogata, asadores, restaurante, agua caliente, bar

Location: 25B, Tarso, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Área de Serviço/ Descanso
Description:
Excellent support point on the alternative road to Medellin, good road, not busy, several parking spaces, clean bathrooms, restaurant, public Wi-Fi and incredible upload speed.  We were just going to stop for a coffee and decided to stay for the night.
.....
Excelente ponto de apoio na estrada alternativa para Medellin, estrada boa, sem movimento, várias vagas de estacionamento, banheiros limpos, restaurante, wi-fi público e com velocidade de uploads incrível. íamos parar apenas para tomar um café e decidimos ficar para passar a noite.

Location: Calle 6, Guadalupe, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia

Description: Stayed here for a very quiet night and left our car here during the hike to the Gachas. there is a restaurant/cafeteria and in the Museo Cultura there are toilets as well. there should also be public wifi but it didn't work when we were there.

Location: Sol de verano - Estadero Donã Lilia, Vía a Tatacoa, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Description:
Location that accepts travellers in trailers, camper van, motorcycle passengers, overlanders, etc. Price per vehicle per day $10. 000 Colombian pesos to the date of October 2023. Attended by John Claros and his working group including Ariel and his family from Argentina. It has a camping area, cabins, swimming pool, parking lot, gastrobar. Close to different tourist sites (Salto del Mortiño, San Agustin Archaeological Park, Magdalena Strait and much more).
.....

Location: Diamante Real, 17-93, Calle 17, Ciénaga, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, Colombia

Ok for women traveling alone

Location: Carrera 3, Zona Urbana de Ráquira, Ráquira, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Posada de San Antonio - Raquirá
Description:
A nice and clean hotel in the centre of Raquirá, run by a very friendly and welcoming family. They rent out a few apartments with a living, bedroom(s) kitchen and own bathroom.  TV, good wifi, secure parking available. We parked our bicycles inside. 

Andrés speaks good English and invited us to the pottery/factory of his parents.  
This pottery is what  Raquirá is famous for. 

There is also the possibility to do your laundry.
We payed 130.000 cop for the two of us for the whole appartment.

Close to restaurants, ATM and tienda’s/supermercado

Location: Vía Cimitarra - Landazuri, Aguachica, Landázuri, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia

Perfecto para pasar una noche. Hay un hotel de camioneros, así que nos dejaron usar la ducha por COP $10.000 está retirado de la principal, así que dormimos bien. El encargado se llama Luis

Location: Mundo Juegos XBOX 360, 6-28, Carrera 8, barrio las guitarrillas, Socha, Valderrama, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 151640, Colombia
Name: La Florida Casona Hotel
Description: Very nice, clean and spacious quality Hotel in the middle of Socha. Ideal for Motorcycle and Bicycle traveller. Safe parking in the locked hotel parking. Nice bathroom with hot shower. Payed 100k including breakfast as a solo traveler in the double room. Not cheap but worth the money.

Location: Sagrado Corazón, Ipiales, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524067, Colombia
Name: Peñaflor Casa Campestre
Description: Beautiful colonial country house, a fantastic place where you can enjoy a pleasant stay overlooking the Guáitara River canyon, with large spaces full of energy that will allow you to rest and have the opportunity to visit the Majestic Sanctuary of Las Lajas just 2 km from distance, in addition to the proximity to regional gastronomic centers. Country, quiet environment, enjoy the sound of nature without interruptions. Breakfast can be requested from the host at an additional cost. Contact Monica: +57 311 4646643 ..... Hermoso lugar, la anfitriona muy amable y agradable, hermosos perros

Location: La Cristalina, Puerto Boyacá, Occidente, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hostal El Paujill
Description:
The place has two little cabanas. The one we slept in has 3 rooms with queen size beds. We had to park our motorcycles on the other side of the river  under a roof at the house of the grandmother of the hosts. We had to cross the shallow river on foot, very cool experience. The family cooked a delicious meal for us and served a great breakfast as well. They also offered to show us the canyon the la Cristalina, but unfortunately we did not have time for that.

To get there take the path (not in Google maps) that is marked with a pretty big signpost in one of the corners of the main road.

Location: Camino Alto Bonito, Santa Isabel, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Location: Pan-American Highway, Coloradas, Santa Fe de Antioquia, Occidente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia

His wofkshop is in the back if a parking lot. There are no signs, jzst ask for Francisco.

Location: Carrera 23, Nuevo Éxito, Soledad, Atlántico, RAP Caribe, 083001, Colombia

Description: We needed an oil change and then noticed we also needed a new battery. Excellent service. Super friendly and helpful people. Can totally recommend this place!

Location: Carrera 19 (Ruta Verde), San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684031, Colombia
Name: Motorcycle Tours (Adrenaline Addicts)
Description:
Adrenaline Addicts in San Gil.

We booked the two day Mesa Santos motorcycle tour there and had the most amazing experience!!! 
With almost zero previous riding experience and no extra license we had such a good time driving up and down the Chicamocha Canyon on those Honda Navis. - There’s bigger bikes for those with a license as well ;)
We also have been able to ride quite a bit of off-road routes which led through the most beautiful landscapes. It was sooo fun!!! 

Our Guide Andy was just awesome and he totally customized the tour to our interests. So we drove a bit more off-road and also organized a climbing session for us the first day.
He took us to swimming places usually tourists don’t visit and got us really delicious food. 
He is genuinely excited himself about the places and foods he showed us which makes it even more legit ;)
Also Andy speaks English fluently and is happy to tell you more about Colombia and its culture!

For us it was a great way to experience Colombia! Since most of the people here are riding on two wheels, it gave us a different perspective from driving in our van all the time!

Location: Calle 13, Pelaya, Cesar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: La Casona Camping
Description:
Huge gravel park behind the hotel.
We were looking for a place with internet and we found this one. The owner asks for 20.000 per night. The place is suitable for any vehicle. Smaller ones (under 2.7 mt high) can also fit under the shade (which is very helpful since this part of Colombia is crazy hot). Internet is fast and water is available. Nothing fancy but quiet, convenient and secure (the place is gated).
They don't have a bathroom for vanlifers but they also have rooms available. Ask for Rodolfo.

Location: Vía a Tatacoa, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Casa de Campo Los Cactus
Description: It's a cliche but this is a fantastic oasis in the desert. coffee on tap, awesome home-cooked food. Buildings made from reclaimed items and it's worth visiting just for the dinosaur shower! Great value, 90 per night for 2 of us. food served 3 times a day and they have beer, sodas and jugo natuales. Friendly staff. 5 mins car/ 10 min walk to observatory. so many areas to chill here too, in the shade.

Location: Carrera 13, El Altico, Comuna Centro, Perímetro Urbano Neiva, Neiva, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 410400, Colombia

.....
Un sitio especial para comer, con un buen parqueadero, apto para casas rodantes. Aunque no lo ofrecen,  permiten pasar la noche. Hernan es un excelente anfitrión. Lo pueden llamar al celular 3132668326.

Location: Bio Habitat Hotel, Vereda El Congal, El Bosque, Norte, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631001, Colombia

You could also book just for lunch dinner or even breakfast and enjoy a great moment on your way to Salento.

Location: Poza del amor, Vía Santa Marta - Riohacha, Vda. Trompito Bajo, Colinas de Calabazo, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Frana Lodge
Description:
Frana Home is an eco-boutique hotel with magical views over the tropical forest and the Tayrona Park.  The hotel is a 15-minute walk from the main road. They are surrounded by rivers, waterfalls and great biodiversity.  The best view in the area!

Accommodation
We offer four big rooms with spacious bathrooms which allows us to offer a personalized service, with comfort and food made with love for all tastes.  The common spaces are large, open and provide different views onto the rainforest and upto the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta. Each room has very spacious bathrooms with hot water for cool nights, large and excellent quality beds, with mosquito net. Prices start at 300.000 pesos breakfast included. Check the booking App for more informations

Location: La Pola, Santa Fe de Antioquia, Occidente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Santani Casa de Descanso
Description:
Nice Airbnb loft that could be a great break for motorcycle travelers looking to recharge after hectic days in Medellin or Cartagena. Usually I wouldn’t add this type of place, it was about $50USD on Airbnb. But it’s special enough to warrant a look. The place is a ground floor loft style accommodation with two bedrooms, a huge master suite, and a secondary bedroom with 2 beds. It has a large kitchen, and a large outdoor area. The outdoor area has a fabulous private jacuzzi which is really the highlight. You feel like you’re in a super high end loft here, which for the price is pretty remarkable.

You could park up to 4 or 5 motos in the secure inner parking area, so this might be a great crash pad for a group of motos traveling together. You could probably fit a normal size Car or smaller 4x4 easily as well, but the gate might be a clearance issue. Look for it on Airbnb or possibly via WhatsApp: +57 323 3639951

Location: Villa Paz, Murillo, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Cost of 20 m per night, friendly, helpful people, wooden cabins and warm welcome that contrasts with the cold climate of the environment near Nevado del Ruiz. I advise it

Location: 25, La Paz, Andalucía, Centro, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Corrupt police

additional person : 20.000pesos

Location: San Augustin, Calle 5A, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 418060, Colombia

Owners so kind, like a mom and pop. just used the washing machine, Tom working at a desk they found him, hammocks to relax in too. Quiet on a night, highly recommended

Location: La Vega, Gualivá, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 253610, Colombia

Location: Biblioteca Colsubsidio Funza, Carrera 9, Bellisca, Funza, Sabana Occidente, RAP (Especial) Central, 250020, Colombia
Name: Punctured Tire Scam
Description: While we were waiting at a red traffic light, a guy on a moped moved by really close to our car and after the traffic light the air went out of our tire really quickly. Another really pushy guy came and wanted us to come with him. Our luck was, that we parked in front of a fire station and the men helped us. The fireman told us that these pushy guys puncture your tires and either want to have way too much money to repair the tires or rob you. They also said that we should call the police if something like that happens again.

Description:
This motorbike workshop is specialized in KTM and Husqvarna bikes, but also does Kawasaki, Yamaha and Honda.

They are also the workshop for the official KTM/Husky dealer in Chia (Bike Project Shop).

Larry, the mechanic, is a really nice guy and knows his stuff well. It is a new workshop (about 5 months as of November 23), it's a clean place and well equipped. They also have the KTM and Husqvarna diagnostics tool, which many places don't.

We had our two 701 Enduro LRs there. One got new piston rings, valves adjusted and a few small things, the other had the gear sensors recalibrated and valves as well. Manual labour cost for the first bike (piston rings, valves, small stuff) was 650.000 cop. So prices are fair for professional work like this. On top I was also allowed to "help" (meaning I got to learn from Larry while pestering him with questions.)

Larry does not speak english, but his business partner from the workshop does. He's also a really nice guy, very kind. Highly recommended. Say Hi from Tim when you go there.

Name: US Embassy
Description:
This pin is the entry gate for US Citizens. Obviously no knives, guns, etc. You check in at the gate. Walk into the compound and sit under the covered area before being invited in to the first scanning point. You’ll need a drivers license to leave at the desk (along with electronics). After that you’ll cross a small courtyard to another entry point and go through security once again. To your immediate left you’ll see a waiting room for US Citizens. 

Note: if you need an emergency passport it will be printed same day. You must make an appointment online. We had to wait about 45 days for the next available. The emergency passport is small… and only lasts 1 year max. For Bolivia, Ecuador, and Peru you need 6 months in your passport for entry. (We’ll post at the borders to see if they accept).

Location: Departures, El Refugio, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Fontibón, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 110911, Colombia
Name: ICA Bogota Airport
Description: This is where you get your certificate for exportation from ICA. Open 8am-4pm Mon-Fri and 8am-12pm Sat. You need to bring your pet, a health certificate, vaccine certificate, antiparasitic certificate, the pre-export exam CIS that was sent to your email after the vet, and proof of payment (~60,000 COP). The payment link they send you will not work if you don't have a Colombian bank account. You will need to log in to your SISPAP account with ICA and pay via credit card using the links at the top of the page. The ICA certificate is valid for 5 days and you really should start this process several days in advance. All documents need to be printed ahead of time. There is a printing kiosk on the second floor of the airport next to a money exchange that charges 3,000 COP per page printed. Also arrive early if you can. I arrived with my dog at 8:30am on a Tuesday after a holiday weekend and there were at least 20 people and pets in line.

Description: A surprisingly modern feel to the rooms with a decent bicycle/moto storage area on the back. 44000 gives you a room for two including a massive fan to cool you down if you wish. the busy street is right next door with a nightclub a bit further away playing Colombian classics. very satisfied overall.

Location: Parqueadero, Autopista Medellín-Bogotá, Ciudadela Artesanal, Marinilla, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 054020, Colombia
Name: Madoa SAS multiservicio
Description:
Mechanics who fix cars in general. They specialize in alignment and balancing, brakes and discs. Juan Estevan is the owner, an enlightened person who likes to help travelers. They fixed the clutch discs on my car (Mercedes Sprinter) and the pulley on my friend's car (Land Rover), very fast service and an excellent price. I highly recommend it.

Mecânica que arruma carros em geral. São especializados em alinhamento e balanceamento, freios e discos. Juan Estevan é o dono, pessoa iluminada que gosta de ajudar viajantes. Arrumaram os discos de embreagem do meu carro (Mercedes Sprinter) e a polia do carro do meu amigo (land rover), serviço muito rápido e com um preço excelente. Super recomendo.

Mecánicos que reparan autos en general. Están especializados en alineación y equilibrado, frenos y discos. Juan Estevan es el dueño, una persona ilustrada a la que le gusta ayudar a los viajeros. Me arreglaron los discos de embrague de mi auto (Mercedes Sprinter) y la polea del auto de mi amigo (Land Rover), servicio muy rápido y excelente precio. Lo recomiendo altamente.

Location: Vía Uribia - Puerto Bolívar, Uribia, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Fim do asfalto/ Finish good road
Description:
here ended the good road. becareful with animals crossing way and try drive slowly 

Aqui termina a pavimentação da estrada e inicia o trajeto de terra. Alguns buracos e trechos piores que outros, precisa dirigir devagar e tomar cuidado pois há muitos animais cruzando a pista.

Location: Carrera 27, San Vicente de Chucurí, Yariguíes, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Bypass road piscinas
Description: Google tells you to go on a road that is currently closed and we could not find another way around the closure so a local allowed us to follow them to this bypass road. It’s about 1km of rough dirt road with a little sketchy bridge. Then you get back onto the main road to the piscinas

Location: Carrera 4, Virgilio Barco, Comuna Norte, Perímetro Urbano Neiva, Neiva, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 410001, Colombia
Name: Bicycle shop Ciclo Castillo
Description: Good bicycle shop with lots of spare parts and good mechanics.

Location: San Antonio de Prado - Armenia, Pueblito-Heliconia, Heliconia, Occidente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050029, Colombia
Name: La Circasia farm
Description: Camping spot,Héctor Is the owner very kind AND frienly

Location: Carrera 27B Bis, Siete de Agosto, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 111221, Colombia
Name: Euromarcas
Description:
Bad mechanic - don’t go here! 

We visited this mechanic at the start of our trip, and in the months since have basically found out that everything they did was bad work that’s been damaging our van. The brake discs they serviced very quickly became warped and needed an expensive replacement. The clutch disc they serviced was replaced completely incorrectly, and has again caused a costly repair job. 
Avoid this place!! On this street with many mechanics, it’s the one with the black and red sign.

Location: Juya hostel and tours, To Cabo de la Vela, Cabo de la Vela, Uribia, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 440029, Colombia
Name: Juya Tour Embarcadero
Description:
Embarcadero to Punta Gallinas when the road is closed, it is possible to travel by boat, round trip costs an average of $ COP $ 250,000 per person to spend the day there. The boat leaves at 4am, but we recommend taking the full tour with the History Travelers agency in Riohacha, it's really worth it and a unique experience.
---------
Embarcadero para Punta Gallinas quando a estrada esta interditada, é possível fazer o trajeto de lancha, ida e volta custa média $ COP $ 250.000 por pessoa para passar o dia por lá. O barco sai às 4am, mas recomendamos fazer o tour completo com a agência History Travelers de Riohacha, vale muito a pena e é uma experiência única.

Location: Carrera 8, Jordán VIII Etapa, Comuna 5 - Jordán, Perímetro Urbano Ibagué, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, 730002, Colombia
Name: Economic Manoa Hostel with breakfast
Description:
Nice Hostal, friendly owners, you can hear street a bit depending on room, kichten with foodprocessor, breakfast included, 2nd floor but you can put a (1-3) bikes in 1st floor into their kitchen. More than one electrical soket and it was even near the bed! And free toploader washing machiene :)

Entrance hidden, there is just a bell with the Name Manoa. If they dont come shout to the trace or go to their shop continuing left of the entrance crossing the street.

Price was negotiated 50.000.

All in all seemed like the Perfect deal :)

Location: Carrera 1, La Playa de Belén, Occidente, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Restaurante El Portal
Description: Excellent restaurant with very good food in a nice environment. They mainly serve lunch (until 4pm) and if you like meat, go for the Filet Mignon! It was the best piece of meat we had in 16 months. But also their fish dishes and juices are really affordable. Menu price between 20k and 25k COP.

Location: Camino Nacional, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631027, Colombia
Name: Finca Momota
Description: A small scale (7ha) coffee farm offering 1-3 hour tours around their farm. 65000/pp for two hours gives you a good feeling for the coffee growing, the different variants common in the region, plants with symbiotic relation to the coffee, the benefit of the drink and its history. This finca does currently not have many workers (actually, they are not picking their fruit due to not having the manpower) so it feels like it might be closing down soon enough. I haven't been to other fincas around Quindío/Salento to compare. We two were alone with our guide so that certainly weighed up the experience, but maybe a more functioning finca would feel more alive.

Location: Vía San Andres, Inzá, Oriente, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje y restaurante Pisimbala
Description:
Also known as Hospedaje de Doña Libia. This place was recommended by another hostel in Neiva. 

Home stay hostal and restaurant with private rooms. 

Warm showers, I don’t know if it works because due to the heavy weather the village was out of electricity for while. There is WiFi but the speed changes. 

I paid 30.000 for one person in a two person room with two beds.

Location: Justo y bueno, 6-83, Carrera 6, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684041, Colombia
Name: D1 Supermarket
Description: Cheap D1 Supermarket in Barichara. Enjoy:)

We spent one night here.  On Friday the square is very busy until late.  The people are very friendly and we felt safe.  We spent one night here.  On Friday the square is very busy until late.  The people are very friendly and we felt safe. There are many bars, kiosks and bakeries around the square. We do not recommend big rigs, see the photos.  Our car is a 515 sprinter.

Location: Vía Villagarzon - Puerto Caicedo, El Porvenir, Villagarzón, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, 861080, Colombia
Name: Terpel gas station
Description: It was late so we parked here, ok for one night, we asked if it was possible to sleep here and the staff was very nice, didn't ask any money for it. Clean toilet, there is a shower but without door.

Location: Carrera 6, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684041, Colombia
Name: Hospejade Aqui Estoy Bien
Description: The best shower we had in a long time. 8.000pP. Enjoy :)

Location: Calle 8 N, Barrio Guiamaral, Comuna 5 - Nororiental, Perímetro Urbano Cúcuta, Cúcuta, Oriental, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 540003, Colombia
Name: plaza
Description:
Quiet place to spend the night in Cucuta. There is surveillance and the neighbors are cool. Street with little traffic. Nice place for one nigth.

lugar tranquilo para pasar la noche en cucuta. hay vigilancia y los vecinos son buena onda. calle poco transitada

Location: Troncal Central, Aratoca, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 682051, Colombia
Name: Access point to free campsite near by
Description: This is the start point to access the free campsite near by, from main road. Don't trust OSM maps! Possible for all kind of vehicles, but would recommend 4x4 and high clearance!

Location: Calle 6, Bonafont, Riosucio, Alto Occidente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Mirador del picará
Description:
To sleep you can use Bonafont Square, right in front of the police station. Very quiet and the townspeople very friendly.

Para dormir se puede utilizar la plaza de bonafont, justo al frente de la estación de policía. Muy tranquila y la gente del pueblo muy amable.

Location: Alegria Hostel Boutique, 500 mts Finca Hermosa, Vía Guatapé - San Rafael, Guatapé, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053840, Colombia
Name: Alegría Hostel
Description: Hostel with dormitory and single rooms. 30.000 for dormitorios and 80.000 for single room. nice and clean with a kitchen and plenty of secure parking on premise. excellent wifi. you can also rent a kayak to use at the lake. they can also serve breakfast for payment if you order it in advance

Location: Panamericana, La Violeta, Rosas, Macizo, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Texaco gasstation
Description: Spacious gasstation with super clean banos and a shower. It’s a gasstation and on the Panamericana so traffic noise but not too bad. Friendly staff.

Location: Autopista Norte, Tocancipá, Sabana Centro, RAP (Especial) Central, 271015, Colombia
Name: Fuel Station with Adblue
Description:
Gas Station / Truckstop. 

We filled up our Adblue here. 
11l for 40.000p.

Location: Carrera 5, Palomino, Dibulla, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 446009, Colombia
Name: Alhelí Café and School
Description: Best coffee I have had in Colombia so far and the owners are some of the nicest you will ever meet! Do yourself a favor and stop by this place.

Location: 90, La Cazada, Coveñas, Morrosquillo, Sucre, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Finca Jerusalem Coveñas
Description:
Great place to stay on the way to Cartagena. On the highway and 5 minutes from the beach. We stayed at the Camping for one day. Daniel is the owner and is super attentive and honest. The value is negotiable. Safe, spacious place with plenty of shade, electricity and showers. Perfect. It has space for large cars, bicycles and tents.
He also rents rooms, with private bathrooms.
Owner contact +57 3117700371

Ótimo lugar para ficar a caminho de Cartagena. Na rodovia e a 5 minutos da praia. Ficamos no Camping um dia. Daniel é o dono e super atencioso e honesto. O valor é negociável. Lugar seguro, amplo com bastante sombra, energia Eletrica e duchas. Perfeito. Tem espaço para carros grandes, bicicletas e barracas. 
Ele também aluga quartos, com banheiros privativos.
Contato do proprietário +57 3117700371

Gran lugar para alojarse de camino a Cartagena. En la autovía y a 5 minutos de la playa. Nos alojamos en el Camping por un día. Daniel es el dueño y es súper atento y honesto. El valor es negociable. Lugar seguro, espacioso con mucha sombra, electricidad y duchas. Perfecto. Hay espacio para coches grandes, bicicletas y carpas.

También alquila habitaciones, con baño privado. Contacto propietario +57 3117700371

Location: Avenida los Fundadores, Pio XII, Risaralda, Bajo Occidente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Restaurant Rancho
Description: Phenomenal restaurant with splendid view over the Rio del Cauca Valley. 19000 for menu del día and 14000 for the jarra de limonada that you'll probably get after cycling up the uphill ;). the menu options are slightly above average prices but since everything here is delicious it could very well be worth it!

Location: Calle 7, Nobsa, Sagamuxi, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: NOBSA handcraft market
Description: charming little town famous for it's traditional market of handcrafted goods made of wool.  perfect for buying some clothes if you are going high in the Andes mountains. very calm and safe to stay overnight. also have a couple of nice restaurants by the main square. We recommend ALTIPLANO restaurant. you can park safely just in front of the main square which is a beautiful spot too.  Smaller but similar sort of goods to those found in OTAVALO Ecuador.

Location: Ruta El Carmen - Santuario, El Santuario, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 054450, Colombia
Name: Puerta del Sol
Description:
good value/quality hotel, next to the main street. and walking distance to the town and it's center. with a playground and restaurant.

53.000 Pesos for a single room 
76.000 pesos for double
the rooms are spacious and well maintained.
the shower was actually hot

while the parking itself is not locked, there is no issue with security. 
overall good attention and complimentary coffee if you ask. 

the wifi itself is fast and works well, if you get a room close enough to the router.

Location: Calle 12, Riosucio, Alto Occidente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Hotel San Antonio
Description: Nice hotel, single room with private bathroom 35.000 COP including space in garage (fits 2 cars or a few motorcycles).

Location: Iglesia Parroquial San Luis, Carrera 6, Centro, Cabecera Municipal San Luis, San Luis, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: close to the church
Description: a big area on the side of the church, very close to the park. it looks like a safe city, we parked here and there is a lot of space, not on the street so it's safer for the night. No facilities.

Location: Cortaderal, Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Camping next to clear river behind fence
Description:
Best place to camp coming from Santa Barbara.
Clean River, bathing possible, grass, flat, no roof, no sun in the morning, no view, fishing prohibided.

If you continue in direction of Santa Barbara for 3.5 km with not much elevation (30min by bike) there would be also a abandoned school with a roof and view over the valley. : I ment Santa Rosa not santa barbara Includes crossing the river or climbing the fence

Both places no reception with WOM, this starts further down :)
Tiendas are verry rare further up

Location: Bambu, Carrera 13, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 418060, Colombia
Name: Hostal Bambu
Description:
Nice hostel with nice vibes, cool people amazing views and sunsets from the roof terrace. Good beds, kind and helpful staff. Relaxed and quiet at night.

I paid 35.000 per night for a dorm. I could put my bicycle in a safe place inside. 

Breakfast available for 10.000

Location: Tinjacá, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 153820, Colombia
Name: San Miguel Dairy Farm
Description: A campground at a dairy farm with an artisanal cheese production plant where  you will learn the process of making artisanal cheeses. Very close to the town of San Miguel de Sema, 1 hour from villa de Leyva Boyaca.

Location: 4-72 (Colombian postal service), 10-50, Carrera 10, San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684031, Colombia
Name: Hostal La casona Don Juan
Description:
good Hostel with good wifi and lots of activities such as rafting, and other tours. the wifi works well all over the hostel and the price includes breakfast, and complimentary coffee.
overall pretty clean Hostel

in the courtyard you can park you motorcycle if the handlebar fits through the door. they do provide a wooden ramp to help you getting in.

opposite of the street is a big garage for secure parking to the public 

25000 for a dorm
40000 for a single room

Location: Calle 19 B, Morasurco, Comuna 9, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520001, Colombia
Name: Poc Language School
Description: we stayed in Pasto for 3 weeks and took a course of Spanish lessons here. The school is like a family and they welcomed us and made us feel at home.  We came away understanding so much more not just of the language but also of the people.

Location: Vía Tocaima - Jerusalén, Jerusalén, Alto Magdalena, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje Las Brisas
Description: 30k pesos for a room with private bathroom. Simple but kept very clean and the lady is nice and friendly. Also a little bit away from the town center so  very quiet. Initially she said 35k but agreed with 30k. Because there are limited rooms available, the lady does not show this place on Google Maps, but this is probably the better value hotel in this town.

Location: Carrera 8, Villa de Leiva, VILLA DE LEYVA, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154001, Colombia
Name: Hostal El Pino
Description:
Nice family owned hostel in walking distance to all down town places. Good hot showers, everything very clean. Kitchen and laundry are for common use. Secure parking space for 2-3 cars (no big rigs). Secure parking also for motorcycles behind the house in the grassy area. 
We payed (low season) 60.000cop for a double room with shared bathroom.
The family also helps you to organizing your tours and have lots of tips for the whole area.

Location: La Casa Loca Guatavita, Antigua vía a Antigua Guatiavita, Guatavita, Guavio, RAP (Especial) Central, 251060, Colombia
Name: Casa Loca Guatavita
Description:
'Casa Loca' is a complete house upside down which you can visit! 
Parking space available for all kind of vehicles. We didn't had to pay for parkibg.
Big bags/backpacks/helmets you have to leave at the restaurant (as pictures wouldn't work with them on). All safe, we didn't had problems.
We payed 20.000cop pP to go inside Casa Loca. 
Restaurant with also Austrian and German dishes on this property. Cafe, shops with local products are also here.

Location: Carrera 51, Camino Real - Los Fundadores, Comuna 19, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760033, Colombia
Name: Parque Camino Real - Calle Carrera 51
Description:
We found this place by chance while going to the other park that is marked nearby. It is perfect for sleeping. It is a dead end street that leads to a dog park. There is only room for two vehicles and since it is a dead end, the length doesn't matter! It's great because it is literally in front of the entrance to a gated community so there is 24-hour security next to the vehicle. In the area there are supermarkets, kiosks and restaurants. We came three nights to sleep and it was very quiet at night. The neighbors go out to walk their dogs and everyone is nice, some even wrote us messages to see if we needed anything.
--
encontramos este lugar de casualidad yendo al otro parque que sale marcado cerca. es perfecto para dormir. es una calle sin salida que da a un parque de perros. solo hay lugar para dos vehículos y como es sin salida no importa el largo! es genial porque está literalmente enfrente de la entrada de un barrio cerrado entonces hay seguridad 24h al lado del vehículo. en la zona hay supermercado, kioskos y restaurantes. vinimos tres noches a dormir y muy tranquilo por la noche. los vecinos salen a pasear perros y todos son agradables incluso algunos nos escribieron mensajes para ver si necesitábamos algo. lol

Location: La Nota Musical, 7-51, Calle 6, El Centro, Comuna 4, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 190003, Colombia
Name: Moto & SUV overnight parking
Description:
Secure and cozy parking in the heart of downtown, great for motos, cars, and SUVs -  Clearance for RTT.  Best to reverse in thru the opening. 12,000cop/24 hours. 
Entrance open 7am-8pm, and locked overnight.
WhatsApp +57 312 2783371
We stayed across the street in the Hotel Dorado, 100,000cop/nt for 2.
There's a bigger lot on the left just after the hotel with a wider entrance for a 4x4, 6.4m van, but it's for day parking only, no overnight parking as it belongs to another hotel.

Location: Vereda Montecillo, Guatavita, Guavio, RAP (Especial) Central, 251060, Colombia
Name: Camping San Francisco
Description:
Wonderful campground, really big and flat space. Beautiful views all around.
Quiet, peaceful especially during weekdays.
Highly recommended!
Very friendly owners.

Location: Río Ancho, Dibulla, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: playa cerca del rio
Description: Quiet place to pitch the tent, very close to the river and with few people, far from the village and with indigenous communities nearby that let you camp without problems, everyone was friendly and greeted

Location: Calle 3, El Encanto, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Residencias El Encano
Description:
The only have a green sign: Hotel
You have to call them, if there is nobody at reception. The number is on the sign. The owners live close by. 
I stayed here for one night, 40.000 for a one person room. I could put my bicycle inside in the ground floor room. Decent WiFi.
I could make it before night to Pasto, so I stayed here. 
Parking available, for motors with a roof. Bicycles can be parked at the balcony as well.

Location: Aragones, 60, La Mesa, San Luis, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Zeuss Gasolinera
Description:
Good place for a rest. Big parking area at the gas station. Quiet and safe. a little noise off the route but its ok. If you face the shop, on the right side there is a field further behind which is further from the road and quieter.
The view is nice.
Toilets and shower in the back. Water potable. and wifi with password, ask the worker.

Location: Quimbaya, Valle, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Tukawa camp-ground
Description:
Camping for campers and converted trucks, hotel/hostel/farm run by 3 French people. 
There is a camping area for campers and trucks at 250 meters to the hostel under a large roof which protects against both rain and sun. There is a sink, a table in order to cook, toilets and a (cold) shower just next to the campers' location. You can enjoy the pool, board games, ping pong, bar and everything else the hostel has to offer in a quiet and secluded setting. 
The hostel has also individual cabanas with every comfort but also dormitories, rooms with double bed with private bathroom and double rooms with shared bathroom. Restaurant for meals, pool, magnificent view of the plantations of coffee, wireless and TV. They also offer horse riding, visit to the coffee farm and more activities. 
The prices are very correct (25.000 COP / person for the camping area). Contact Mathieu or Dimitri on +57 321 2205413 to book and get more info. They speak French, English and Spanish and are very friendly!

Camping pour camion aménagé et Van, hôtel, Hostel et ferme tenue par 3 français. 
Ils proposent un espace camping pour van/camions situé à 250m de l'espace hotel/hostel sous un grand toit qui protège de la pluie mais aussi du soleil, il y a un évier et une table pour cuisiner ainsi qu'un toilette et une douche (froide) à proximité immédiate de l'emplacement. Vous pouvez profiter de la piscine, des jeux de sociétés, ping-pong, bar et tout ce que propose la partie hôtel tout en étant dans un endroit calme et retiré.
L'hôtel quand à lui propose  des cabanas individuelles avec tout confort mais aussi dortoirs, chambres avec lit double avec salle de bains privative et chambres doubles avec salle de bain partagée. Restaurant pour les repas, piscine, magnifique vue sur les plantations de café, wifi, TV. Ils proposent des sorties chevaux, visite de la ferme de café. Les prix sont très corrects (25.000/pers pour l'emplacement camping). Contactez Mathieu ou Dimitri au +57 321 2205413 pour réserver et avoir plus d'infos. Ils parlent français, anglais et espagnol. Ils sont très sympatiques.

Zona para parquear una van bajo techo en una finca hotel administrada por 3 franceses. 
Proponen un zona de camping para van ubicada a 250m del espacio hotel/hostal debajo de un gran techo que protege de la lluvia y del sol. Hay un lavaplato, un meson para cocinar, un sanitario y una ducha (agua fria) muy cerca a ese espacio. Pueden disfrutar de la piscina, de los juegos de mesa, de la mesa de ping pong, del bar y de todo lo que propone la parte hotel estando en un lugar tranquilo y aislado. El hotel ofrece cabañas individuales con todas las comodidades, pero también dormitorios, habitaciones con cama doble con baño privado y habitaciones dobles con baño compartido. Restaurante para comidas, vista espectacular hacia los cafetales, wifi, televisor. Ofrecen paseos a caballo, visita de una finca cafetera entre otras actividades. Los precios son muy correctos (25.000/pers para parquear en la zona). Comuníquese con Mathieu o Dimitri al +57 321 2205413 para reservar y obtener más información. Hablan francés, inglés y español. Ellos son muy amigables.

Location: Glorieta Carlos Londoño G., La Tebaida, Armenia, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Davivienda and Bancolombia
Description:
ATM Davivienda and Bancolombia in front of a small Mall / Supermarket. Lots of parking lots. 

Seems like a very safe area here - perfect for getting money and get some groceries.

Location: ApartaHotel Letty, Calle 4, Cachipay, Tequendama, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hotel Letty
Description: The best hotel in this town. 60k pesos for a room for one person but the lady was very very kind and let me stay with a more reasonable price, probably because I am on a bike from Alaska to Argentina. Very clean rooms with hot water and everything.

Location: Avenida 3, CONJUNTO CERRADO, Comuna 2 - Centro Oriental, Perímetro Urbano Cúcuta, Cúcuta, Oriental, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 540006, Colombia
Name: Tours Cielo Azul - Tourguide Cucuta
Description:
A small family owned business called Tours Cielo Azul. Leidy and Saúl help you to find the perfect tour to discover Cúcuta and the surroundings. They are great tour guides for the city and all the attractions here. 
The prices depends on the tours - they organize it how you like it! 

You can reach them via www.somosconexion.net or via Instagram: @tourscieloazul !
+57 310 324 3155

We were very happy with them and would definitely come again to here!

Location: Simacota, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Loma Balneario
Description: This is a Hotel, a restaurant and a pool with a big waterslide. They allowed us to stay in their parking lot with our truck for price of the entrance to the Pool (10k) pp. A very good deal in these hot days. Pool, toilets and showers are very clean.  The night had a little sound from the street, but okay. We had no food from the restaurant, but it looked very good. People very friendly!

Location: Toca, Centro, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Bicicleteria Rafael
Description:
Rafael is a very kind guy, a good neighborhood bike dealer, reliable and economical.
Highly recommended.
---
Rafael es un chico muy amable, buen bicicletero de barrio, confiable y económico.
Muy recomendable.

Location: El Túnel - Playa Blanca, Tota, Sagamuxi, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 152240, Colombia
Name: Mirador perfecto
Description:
Place for a couple of vans next to a quiet road. Unbeatable views of the
lake. Going down an almost invisible path that leaves from the same point, you reach a beautiful solitary beach. Highly recommended to visit it.
---
Lugar para un par de vans al lado de una tranquila carretera. Vistas inmejorables del
lago. Bajando un sendero casi invisible que sale desde el mismo punto, se llega a una playita solitaria hermosa. Muy recomendable visitarla.

Location: Carrera 6, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684041, Colombia

Dining room inside the house. Economical and good. They only make a closed menu that varies every day. Generous, with juice, soup, main course and a small piece of fruit, only for 11,000.
They can also do laundry and it is economical.
---
Comedorcito dentro de la casa. Económico y bueno. Solo hacen un menú cerrado que varía cada día. Generoso, con zumo, sopa, segundo y postrecito pieza de fruta, solo por 11.000.
También pueden lavar la ropa y es económico.

Location: Calle 1A, Taganga, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470004, Colombia
Name: Taganga Macabi hostel
Description:
Nice new hostel with parking space (there's space for a few bikes and a small car, contact them in advance) 
We paid 90000pesos for a matrimonial with shared bathroom and breakfast included. The owner is super nice, she even offered us an amazing Sunday lunch!
There are a few hammocks and an open kitchen you can use

Location: Carrera 53, Pablo VI, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Teusaquillo, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 111321, Colombia

Location: Carrera 50, Vegachí, Nordeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 052830, Colombia

Location: Avenida Carrera 19, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Usaquén, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 110111, Colombia

Av. Cra 19 #103-91, Usaquén, Bogotá, Kolumbien

Location: Montería, San Carlos, Medio Sinú, Córdoba, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: tool both park
Description: we asked the guard if we could sleep here, at first he said no and than he let us stay on the side, in the grassy area. calm night, it is very close to the road so it'll be a bit noise, bit not much. low traffic during the night, we felt safe as there is a guard 24hrs. We could use toilets and shower for free.

Location: Café el Altillo, 5-68, Calle 119B, Usaquén, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Usaquén, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 110111, Colombia
Name: Julia
Description: I am traveling South America for 14 month now, and confidently I can say that is the best and most authentic Napolitan pizza I have found so far. good ambiance and they serve beside pizza some other dishes as well. I highly recommend this place.

Location: Vía Bucaramanga-Cucuta, La Caldera, Mutiscua, Suroccidente, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Parking Lot El oasis
Description: We stayed here in our Truck in the dirty parking lot of the Hotel Oasis on our way to Venezuela. the friendly owner charged us 10k COP and offered us a toilet which we did not used. The night was very very noisy. Good claro 4g Signal

Location: Calle 9, Yajaira, Melgar, Oriente, Tolima, RAP Eje Cafetero, 734001, Colombia
Name: Bomberos
Description:
Stop searching : the best bomberos we had in 5000km biketraveling. We could use the kitchen, the facilities, the pool table and even the swimming pool !! Staff is super friendly.
There's a wifi, but didn't ask for it.
Lots of light at night though.

Location: Usaquen Station Hostel, 116-29 Interior 1-10, Carrera 6A, Usaquén, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Usaquén, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 110111, Colombia
