Description:
This place offers rental cabins, however, we asked if we could set up our tents and they agreed. They charged us 10,000 COP per person with access to shower, bathroom, tables and river. The place is very nice and quiet. The person who manages it is called Evelio.

Este lugar ofrece Cabañas de alquiler, sin embargo, nosotros preguntamos si podíamos armar nuestras carpas y accedieron. Nos cobraron 10.000 COP por persona con acceso a ducha, baño, mesas y río. el lugar es muy bonito y tranquilo. La persona que lo administra se llama Evelio.

Location: Vía al Mar, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130007, Colombia
Name: Peaje
Description:
Water to fill the tank of the motorhome. Before crossing the toll. Road from Barranquilla to Cartagena

Agua para cargar el tanque del motorhome. Antes de cruzar el peaje. Camino de Barranquilla hacia cartagena

Location: La Macarena - Loma Linda, Loma Linda, Vista Hermosa, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: La Ye
Description:
This is a small Hospedaje and shop. We arrived here at around 5pm on our way to La Macarena and asked if we could spend the night here. Super friendly woman. She sells beverages and prepares lunch and probably breakfast during the week for the farmworkers.
Toilets are available. She didn't know how much she should charge as we were obviously the first people who wanted to camp there, so we offered 15.000 COP and she accepted.

Good place to stay if it gets late.

Location: La Macarena, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hotel El Jardín
Description:
This Hotel has several Cabañas with private bathrooms available. We spent a night there camping in our Camper. They have a restaurant and they prepared us a vegetarian meal although we were the only guests, as it was low season.
There is not a lot of space on the property so we just parked on the street in front of the hotel. There is almost no traffic anyway. They said we could park wherever we want, even in the field with the cattle.

Fast Wi-Fi, clean toilets, showers, friendly people, restaurant, free coffee in the morning, everything you need. 
We paid 10.000 COP for two persons. Cabañas cost 80.000 COP.

Location: Via Narices a Muros, Puerto Garza, San Carlos, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Basketball court with roof
Description: For cyclists and motorcyclists. A basketball court with a roof that provides a good cover when it's raining. Asked if I could camp here and everyone said no problem.

Location: Carrera 8, Villa Ivon, Ipiales, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524060, Colombia
Name: Punku Co-working
Description: Co-working space with shared desks and private offices. Fast internet, good prices. You can pay by the hour, day, week or month. Closes for lunch which is a bit weird. Contact Andrea for detailed info. +57 317 2800044

Location: Vallejuelo - San Rafael, San Rafael, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053830, Colombia
Name: Santa Maria del Rio
Description:
Large place for camper vans on a very quiet restaurant parking.
You can fill water, lunch, dine.
we paid 5000 cop for one night.

Location: El Puente, Coello, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Coello River
Description:
Magnificent little beach near the Coello River. Delicious to rest and take a bath in these warm waters. We came in February. We recommend going to the Coello police and announcing yourself. They are very friendly. Come with water. Yes, there is a mobile signal with Claro data.
======================================
Magnifica playita cerca al río Coello. Delicioso para descansar y darse un baño en estas tibias aguas. Vinimos en febrero. Recomendamos ir a la policía de Coello y anunciarse. Ellos son muy amables. Llegad con agua. Sí hay señal móvil con datos de Claro.

Location: Vía Veredal, San Simón partealta, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Zona Parqueo Río Coello
Description:
A place next to the road to rest in Camper. The place is very safe. There is a store on the corner and the people are very friendly. The Police arrived and told us that we could sleep peacefully. The Coello River can be heard and deafens the sound of traffic.
==========================================
Un lugar al lado de la carretera para descansar en Camper. El lugar es muy seguro. Hay una tienda en la esquina y las personas son muy amables. La Policía llegó y nos dijo que podíamos dormir tranquilos. El río Coello se escucha y ensordece el sonido del tráfico.

Location: Los Balcones, 96-68, Avenida Calle 17, Villemar, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Fontibón, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 110921, Colombia
Name: Los Balcones Hotel
Description: Great value hotel in a safe area close to the airport. 64,000 cop for twin room (cheaper than a double) with en suite bathroom. Very clean, great service and free secure parking for a few cars and motorbikes (reserve before to make sure). Booked on Booking.com as it was cheaper than on site, and here you can request the parking. Highly recommended since it's hard to find good value hotels in Bogota.

Location: Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 121164, Colombia
Name: Coffee Cupping
Description:
We visited this place to learn about roasting coffee.

Javier is very friendly and take time to explain every steps. We learned how to use the V60 and tasted 4 different coffees.

Very recommandable visit. Road in good condition but if you need a Willys to come there, you could order one on the main place. Price is COP 55'000 p.p. (2 hours). Phone number of Javier +57 316 823 3722

Location: Carrera 3, Zona Urbana de Ráquira, Ráquira, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Poterie
Description:
Translation: Pottery class at Pablo Santa. 35,000/person. Pablo is great, the children and I did a pottery class with no time limit. Modeling by hand and on a lathe, decoration, painting... the children leave with all their creations

Cours de poterie chez Pablo Santa. 35000/personne. Pablo est génial les enfants et moi avons fait un cours de poterie sans limite de temps. Modelage à la main et sur tour, décoration, peinture… les enfants repartent avec toutes leurs créations

Location: Vía Laguna de La Cocha, El Puerto, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Dangerous dogs
Description:
We were walking down the street with my girlfriend, not far from the El Paraiso restaurant which is at the end of the cul-de-sac.  One of the owners' dogs arrived suddenly and bit my girlfriend violently on the thigh, inflicting a serious injury.  According to neighbors, this is the 5th time that one of their dogs has bitten passers-by.  At mediation, the owners lied to try to avoid paying compensation.  In short, DON'T GO THERE!
---
Nous nous promenions dans la rue avec ma copine, pas très loin du restaurant El Paraiso qui est au bout de l'impasse. Un des chiens des propriétaires est arrivé brutalement et a mordu violemment ma copine à la cuisse, lui infligeant une grave blessure. D'après le voisinnage, c'est la 5ème fois qu'un de leurs chiens mord des passants. A la médiation, les propriétaires ont menti pour essayer de ne pas payer d'indemnisations. Bref, N'Y ALLEZ PAS!


Estábamos caminando por la calle con mi novia, no lejos del restaurante El Paraíso que está al final del callejón sin salida.  Uno de los perros de los dueños llegó de repente y mordió violentamente a mi novia en el muslo, causándole una herida grave.  Según los vecinos, esta es la quinta vez que uno de sus perros muerde a los transeúntes.  En la mediación, los propietarios mintieron para intentar evitar el pago de una indemnización.  En resumen, ¡NO VAYAS ALLÍ!

Location: La Capilla, Puente Nacional, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Old train station
Description: Nice, safe and quite place to camp on the old railway station. We travel by bike but definitely there's place for medium and big rigs. Little tienda close by and all neighbours are friendly and willing to help with anything.

Location: BMC Switzerland, 40A-293, Calle 12, Lalinde, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050021, Colombia
Name: Bikexperts
Description: Bicycle shop sells bicycles, parts and services

Location: Vía Bucaramanga-Cucuta, Floridablanca, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Villa Flores Hostal
Description: Nice basic place to spend the night. Many orchids and plants, lots of colibris, friendly people. No wifi but Clare 3G. 50k for 2p.

Location: Calle 13, Ipiales, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524060, Colombia
Name: Hostal de la montaña
Description:
Gloria, the owner, is a very Kind Lady who offers  1 room with Double-bed in her House.
Very clean ! Very Beautiful View!
Next to her House is also a Restaurant.
Highly recommended for friendly people!

Location: Calle 3, Los Libertadores, Comuna 3, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760043, Colombia
Name: Lavanderia en libertadores
Description: Don’t go in here. The lavandería was recommended to us by our hostel. We left a bag of clothes (btw max 5kg for 25k COP) and were told to come back the next day. After 24h, the clothes weren’t ready, the lady even struggled to find the right basket and when we checked the clothes, 5 of the shirts were still smelly. We left them there for another washing machine round (free ofc), but it’s really annoying.

Location: Frutera, Vía Cabo de la Vela, Kasiuoluin, Cabo de la Vela, Uribia, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 440029, Colombia
Name: La Cabaña Hostal
Description: La Cabaña Hostal, simply and relax place for rest in your bicycle trip in La Alta Guajira just in front of Caribean sea, have hamacas and second floor for enjoy the view, Yepez is a really good kind guy, i pay 15cop pppn for a tent in a second floor, have private room option and camp in the beach. you can save the bicycle in to the hostel. WhatsApp Yepez +57 310 381 8710

Location: "Ukampu", Camino a Pico de Loro, Jamundí, Pance, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Pacho Villa
Description:
Great mountain campground. They offer meals at 15k cop, a bed in shared dorm for 20k cop or a place to camp. There is also potable water and bathroom.
From this place you can walk to pico pance or just visit the river and its natural pools

_________________________

Refugio de montaña pacho villa. Alberto es muy simpático y acoge a los caminantes. Ofrece comida abundante a 15k cop, cama a 20k cop la noche o zona donde acampar (no se el precio). En el refugio hay aislantes y cobijas.
También hay baño seco y agua potable. No hay señal.
Desde aqui se puede subir a balcones o pico pance, o visitar el rio y los charcos por ejemplo.

Location: Calle 8, La Hormiga, Valle del Guamuez (La Hormiga), Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Bomberos La Hormiga
Description: Big firefighter station with amazing friendly firefighters. You can sleep in the half open station under the big roof or pitch your tent or park your big vehicle in the secured backyard next to an old big firefighter truck. there is lots of space. you can use the cold shower (not really cold, nobody wants a warm shower here), kitchen, wifi. some of the bomberos were very interested to talk about foreign countries, politics in colombia,... the host a lot of travellers. i was waiting for friends and stayed two nights with them.

Location: Campoalegre, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Grassy flat place
Description: Nice flat grassy area on the heights of the lake. This place is accessible to all types of vehicles. It is possible to access the lake on foot and to swim there.

Location: Sibundoy, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, 861020, Colombia
Name: Colon riverbed
Description: River bed accessible with a vehicle. 4wd recommended as the descent can be muddy but once in the river bed the ground is hard and stony. It is also possible to stop before if you prefer. Very beautiful place by the river and very quiet. The water is clean and transparent, however it is very cold. A few men work here collecting sand or stones. Like any river, be careful the water can rise quickly in the event of a storm.

Location: Universidades, Calle 20, La Paz Central, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Santa Fé, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 110311, Colombia
Name: Viajero Hostel Bogota
Description: Great Hostel with private rooms and dormitories. I stayed some nights in a private room with air conditioning and own bathroom and shower for 120k and some nights in a dormitory (4beds) for 70k COP with own shower and bathroom. There is a spa as well and sauna included . Quite. Very good breakfast for reasonable price and restaurant. Located close to historic center and close to public transportation. Shuttle available as well. Very nice and helpful people. Highly recommend

Location: Filandia, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 634001, Colombia
Name: Finca café Esmeralda
Description:
Great place, warm and full of sharing with the hosts. Possibility of carrying out all the stages of the coffee yourself and taking care of the banana trees. Small Rio at the bottom of the property to cool off. A great time spent with Fernando and his wife.
We stayed 2 nights with our 6m sprinter valve. 40,000COP per day/person including night and 3 meals. Half price for children. Wc and hot shower, terrace, garden… there are rooms too, a corner of paradise.
To get there you have to continue 3km on the track (in good condition) and follow the direction of Esmeralda.

Location: CANCHA DE FUTBOL, Vía A Zapatoca, Galán, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Cancha de Fútbol
Description: It's a big soccer field. Asked at the police station in town if I could camp here and they said no problem. Pitched my tent in the corner. No facilities here but it's quiet and there is water at the town plaza.

Location: Carrera 5, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631020, Colombia
Name: Tacos Micos
Description:
Fantastic Mexican food at a great price! 
Choose between chicken or mixed meat tacos (3 tacos for 10k cop)
or a burrito (15k cop.)
This shop just opened and is operated by a group of friends

Location: Calle 8, Curumaní, Cesar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Café- Colombianita Cafe
Description: Nice little Café. Cafe, Frappés, cakes, empanadas … and Air condition but not too cold.

Location: Centro Histórico de Santa Marta, Calle 11, Localidad 2 Histórica - Rodrigo de Bastidas, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470002, Colombia
Name: Parking in the centre, 2.8m entry hight
Description:
parking with high entrance (2.8m approx) to be able to walk around the centre. 4.000 cop per hour
----
parking con entrada alta (2.8m aprox) para poder recorrer el centro. 4.000 cop la hora

Location: Las Américas, Vía al Mar, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130002, Colombia
Name: Next to the Hotel Las Américas
Description:
Good spot to park your motor home next to the Hotel Las Americas. Be careful not to park near the sea because the tide rises. We felt safe, we rested without any problem. Free Wifi from the hotel.
----
Buen punto para estacionar casa rodante al lado del hotel las Américas. Tener precaución de no estacionar cerca del mar porque sube la marea. Nos sentimos seguros, descansamos sin problema.
Wifi libre del hotel.

Location: Carrera 4, 009, Comuna 1, Perímetro Urbano Valledupar, Valledupar, Cesar, RAP Caribe, 200001, Colombia
Name: Lava Autos Emanuel
Description: Had my 4Runner 4x4 cleaned here with an excellent job. Price not that cheap, this is because the car had a lot of mud underneath the car..

Location: Centro Histórico de Santa Marta, Calle 11, Localidad 2 Histórica - Rodrigo de Bastidas, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470002, Colombia
Name: párking enfrente del puerto
Description:
parking without height limit, perfect for exploring the Malecón and the city center
  It is in front of the DIAN so it is also perfect for parking and doing paperwork. 3,000 an hour. Super friendly people.

parking sin límite de altura, perfecto para recorrer el Malecón y el centro de la ciudad
 está enfrente de la DIAN así que también es perfecto para aparcar y hacer los trámites. 3.000 la hora. Gente super amable.

Location: Ruta del Sol, Puerto Salgar, Bajo Magdalena, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Gasolinera terpel
Description:
Large, clean safe place to sleep, clean bathrooms and showers
---------------
Lugar seguro amplio y limpio para dormir, baños y duchas limpias

Location: Popayán - Belalcazar, Ararat, Totoró, Oriente, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Mirador de Popayán
Description:
Stayed 2 nights at this very comfortable restaurant- campground.  Jose and his wife are excellent hosts and work hard to ensure your stay is a good experience. Hot shower, clean bathroom and the food at the restaurant is also good.  Camping is in the parking lot and the street noise is very low - we had 2 good nights sleep.  Highly recommend.

Mirador de Popayan has a restaurant, cabins, a camping area and a motorhome area. The route is paved and easily accessible. We have wi-fi, bathrooms, hot water, water to refill tanks, drainage for gray/black water. We are waiting for travelers, to receive them with the best attention. wasapp: +57 316 8616015 and+57 321 2274969

*******
Yo soy José Luis y soy el dueño. Mirador de Popayan tiene restaurante, cabañas, sector de camping y sector para motorhome. La ruta es pavimentada y de fácil accesibilidad. Tenemos wi-fi, Baños, agua caliente, agua para recargar tanques, desalojo para aguas grises/negras. Estamos esperando viajeros, para recibirlos con la mejor atención. wasap: +57 316 8616015 y +57 321 2274969

Location: Túnel Tesalia, San José, Bajo Occidente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Túnel Tesalia - no cyclists
Description: Be aware that cyclists are not allowed to pass the tunel. We tried but were denied entry. We were lucky to get a transport through the tunel organized by a friendly and helpful local. You can try to get a ride with one of the trucks at peaje 1km down.

Location: Caldas, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Cascadas la Clara
Description:
Very beautiful campspot for tents directly at the first waterfall. Very friendly people in the quiet village. Water good to filter and for a bath. We got told mir up there are more waterfalls with even. Ore beautiful campspots, but we didn't check out those. Little tienda with drinks only 50m walking distance. Very safe, but might get busy on weekends. We are cyclists, so I am not sure if a big rig would fit more up at the second waterfall, but for a campervan it should work directly at the first waterfall.
Very beautiful firefly during the night.

Location: Hotel La Casona, 9 - 41, Calle 12, Viterbo, Bajo Occidente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Hotel La Casona de Viterbo
Description: Very clean and friendly hotel in the cute town of Viterbo. We paid 70.000 Cop for a  double room with clean shower and toilet. Nice courtyard to sit, very quiet outside the center and very friendly and helpful staff plus a super sweet black.

Location: De La Casa, 8-40, Calle 9, Viterbo, Bajo Occidente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Antojos y mas
Description: Not as cheap as other places, but still really affordable. There was one super friendly English speaking waiter. The food was super delicious and they offer more than the usual rice, beans, plátanos and any meat dish. We had carrot soup, ceviche, a burger and 3 juices and paid 100.000 COP including tip.

Location: Carrera 3, Vijes, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760550, Colombia
Name: La Casa Hostal
Description: Nice clean and relatively new Hotel/Hostel. Very friendly owners. We could park the bicycles inside the house. Double room with private bathroom and van 55.000 COP for the two of us. Room with shared bathroom 40.000 COP. Everything is very clean. Wrong location on Googlemaps. It's actually Carretera 3, calle 10, 10-17.

Location: Camarones, Riohacha, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Flamencamarones Hotel
Description: Small hotel with air conditioned rooms with good WiFi  and a restaurant with ice cold beers. They have a large dirt parking area for RVs no facilities. They can organize flamingo tours which are well worthwhile.

Location: Termales El Ocho, Zetaquirá - Pesca, Zetaquira, Lengupá, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Termales el ocho, villa de Santa Helena
Description: Hot spring hotel with natural attractions around.  Offers parking for any size vehicle.  There are toilets and showers.  The hosts, Edilson and Sandra are fantastic.  Value per person $30,000.

Location: Carrera 7, Ipiales, Potosí, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524067, Colombia
Name: Hotel Las Lajas Confort
Description:
Small hotel with secure parking lot. 
10mins walk from the cathedral. 
WhatsApp +57 311 7603421

Location: El Arrayán, Piendamó, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 190530, Colombia
Name: Finca de café La Esmeralda
Description:
This is a great rural coffee farm where you can see all parts of the process. It's a family of farmers where the mom is a professional taster, the daughter is a professional coffee maker, so it's incredibly weird to see all this combination of knowdledge together.
They do a tour of the processes and coffee preparation process. They also sell their own coffee that costs almost the same than the one from the supermarket.
Besides, the route to get to the farm has some sculptures of a local artist (@angela_ipiart)
Very recommended!!
--------
Finca de café familiar con todos los procesos del café y marca propia. La madre es catadora profesional y la hija barista profesional.
La explicación y el conocimiento de esta familia son muy valiosos y muy recomendables. El café es riquísimo y de precio similar al del supermercado.
Además, la ruta para llegar a la finca desde el pueblo tiene unas esculturas sobre la región de una artista local (@angela_ipiart)

Location: Sotaquirá, Centro, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Lugar de Acogida el Olivo
Description:
El Olivo reception area for Campervan- motorhome, motorhome,

We offer a place to rest, with an excellent view.

⁃Electric power
⁃ Laundry area,
⁃ BBQ, grill area
⁃ Internet 
⁃ Black and gray water discharge point.
⁃ Drinking water refill point
⁃ Pets allowed
⁃ Good safety conditions
⁃ E-coworking

Location: Eco posada, 24, Pilimbala, Puracé, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Posada brisas del volcán
Description:
Great hostel to spend few nights and visit the national park.
30k cop per night per person. It has restaurant and shared dorms. They are very nice too.

Muy buena posada para dormir y visitar el parque nacional. 30mil pesos por persona y noche. También tienen restaurante y son muy amables

Location: Calle 8, Predio patiño, Piendamó, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 190530, Colombia
Name: Las delicias de Santa Maria
Description:
Great food at good price. Local food for 9k cop or so.
Classic colombian menu: soup, meat, rice, beans...

Buen almuerzo a buen precio. 9mil por ejemplo el pollo, sin sopa.

Location: Nilo, Alto Magdalena, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: MANA DULCE - Reserva Natural
Description: This spot is very nice, into to the nature, good trekking  and totally peaceful on the route.

Location: Rincón del Mar, San Onofre, Morrosquillo, Sucre, RAP Caribe, 707017, Colombia
Name: Mango feliz
Description:
Campground, hammocks, bungalows.. secure parking for bikes and possibly van / bigger rigs. it's around 25 mins walk from the village, quiet though, with a lot of trees and shade. 
15 / 20k for the tent depending on the season, +5 for the bike which is a bummer but, pretty much everything is an extra, water 1k, tea/coffee 3k, use of kitchen (only low season 5k).
still, good overall, the owner/staff are friendly..

Location: Calle 7, La Isabela, Piendamó, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 190530, Colombia
Name: Café InCoffee
Description:
Very nice coffee place on a garden with few tables. It has local organic coffee that you can drink or even buy a bag at good price.
Approximately 5k cop a nice cup of coffee or cheaper if it's a simple option. Approximately 15k cop 250gr of coffee.

Una pequeña cafeteria muy agradable en el jardín detrás de la estación antigua.
Preparan café de muchos tipos con café orgánico local y también venden el café. No recuerdo el precio pero no era costoso, unos 5mil pesos un café gourmet y más económicos el tinto o expresso. Más o menos 15mil media libra de café de calidad de la zona.

Location: Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684041, Colombia
Name: Villa San Rafael
Description: Beautiful gated villa with 10 rooms, 10 min walk from the town center, has a common kitchen, plenty of space for parking. The owners are very welcoming.

Location: Vía El Peñol - Guatapé, Guatapé, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053854, Colombia
Name: Castillos del Lago
Description:
Cabañas / Hostal with different rooms from 1 to 5 persona in each. Nice View on the Rock of Guatape. Nice Garden. Clean bathroom.
Price 50.000.- / Night for me in Cabaña 7.
Secure parking Inside locked Gate.

Location: Troncal del Magdalena, Chaguaní, Magdalena Centro, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: dirt road to chaguani
Description:
small dirt road off main hwy. peaceful night with just the sounds of nature. rode a couple hundred meters down the road and there were 
spots to camp not visible from main hwy. traveling by bicycle but this would also work well for big rigs and car campers. great spot!

Location: Calle 6, Calle Antioquia, Falan, Norte, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Aparta Hotel El Balcón del Tolima
Description: good place for motorcycles, locked parking. nice clean rooms for good price with great view

Location: Carmen de Carupa, Ubaté, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: El Regreso Hospedaje Rural
Description: Hi! Welcome to our warm and cozy place in the middle of Cundinamarca mountains. This is an amazing spot for those who share love for nature and the great outdoors. You can rest and go to amazing places nearby. Just prepare yourself to have fun and bring your adventure spirit.

Location: Terpel, Calle 3, Palermo, Sitionuevo, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 083002, Colombia
Name: Estación de Servicio
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: User does not mention that water is potable. Use caution.
.....
They let us fill our water tank after refueling. friendly staff, they pull out a hose that they have connected to a tap inside a place.
---
nos dejaron cargar el tanque de agua después de repostar combustible. personal amable, ellos te sacan una manguera que tienen conectada a un grifo dentro de un lugar

Location: Calle 12, Villa de Leiva, VILLA DE LEYVA, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154001, Colombia
Name: Soccer Field
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: User does mention that water may not be potable. Use caution.

Next to the covered soccer/basketball court you will find a series of makeshift sinks, presumably so that the athletes can wash after a match. Not sure if it's potable or not but good for washing and cleaning. Each sink has a faucet that you can connect a hose to.

Location: Troncal del Magdalena Medio - Puerto Nare - Puerto Araujo, San Juan, Cimitarra, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Al lado del hostal D'J
Description:
It is a parking lot where trucks stop. There is a service station and next to it a hostel. We asked at the hostel if we could sleep there and they told us no problem but not near the tower because there are cameras and if they see the cameras they have to charge us. We slept in front of the bathroom.
There is a bathroom with a cool shower and it felt very safe. The one who takes care of the hostel makes rounds at night.
Good place to sleep if you go this route.

Location: OZIP, Calle 14, Zona Urbana, Mocoa, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, 860001, Colombia
Name: OZIP Organizacion de Indigenas
Description:
Cyclists: You can ask at the organization of the indigenos people of Putumayo if they let you sleep in their very big meetingroom. There are some members of the community who live upstairs and sometimes others come to sleep here too, when they come to town. There is no shower, but a big watertank and buckets in the staircase, that you can use to shower. So it's not private at all, but in general it was very quiet in the evening. The big hall where you can sleep has a lot of windows, you want to keep them open because it's hot. Therefore you hear all the noise from the street. Not much traffic, but colombia is not the most quiet country. There is a kind of kitchen with a sink, but no stove, use your own. When it rains heavily the town cuts off the water because it gets dirty and it can take half a day, till they turn it on again. So better be prepared and have some drinkingwater or you'll have to buy it. You can always use the water in the huge tank to shower and flush the toilet.
The people are very nice and relaxed. I stayed 5 nights and joined them two nights for an important indigenous fiesta. But be prepared that somebody might ask you for money or to "borough" money. You can always say, you don't have money right now. That's also what they do, even if it is obviously not true. Also watch your food, somebody ate all my chocolate that was in my open panniers. Nobody said thank you for anything, like invitations for lunch or a contribution for the community, so i wouldn't do that anymore. And you'll hear the same sexist, misogynistic talking like everywhereeldse.

Location: 24, Puracé, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Armed holdup in Purace National Park
Description:
We were held up by two guys with guns in the national park. They made like it was a military check and asked for my papers, then asked me and my wife to get out of the car. They then demanded cash to let us carry on. Luckily they didn't take passports, cards or cameras.

The local indigenous guides in the park were shocked and said nothing like this had happened for many years. The then escorted us through the rest of the park with other groups and back down again. When I asked to make a "denuncio" for insurance purposes, we ended up in a meeting with the Governor and 10-15 other officials in the Purace community. They wanted to refund us half of the lost money which I refused.

Hopefully this isn't a sign of any future disturbance here as it's a lovely park and the community were wonderful with us. But the police gave us the good advice to never stop at a roadblock if there isn't an official army or police car there.

Location: Transversal Momposina, Los Palmitos, San Pedro, Sabanas, Sucre, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Restaurante, hospedaje y parqueadero donde "José"
Description:
A great alternative to parking overnight in super hot Mompox. Benjamin, the owner was a little confused by our request to spend a night here and sleep in our Campervan but ultimately he said yes and we negotiated 20,000 COP for 2 people  plus he gave us a key to room #1 so we could use the shower and toilet! Such a great deal. There’s a bit of a breeze and it’s much cooler here than Mompox a few hours away. Our friends are there and say it’s blazing hot and parking spaces are “dismal”. We are happy to have stopped here instead. 
The rooms here  are super clean and have A/C so that always an option if you decide not to sleep in your rig. We have  a lovely view of the countryside and some farm animals. There’s some music coming from the beer and  billiards shop across the field but we are hoping it doesn’t go on all night as Benjamin says it’s a family place. There’s a small restaurant on site here that serves breakfast and lunch only. 
There’s a water tap but not sure if it’s potable. We didn’t ask. 
There’s electrical outlets if you need to charge and have your own extension cord but unsure if there’s an extra charge for that. 
We have 3 bars of tigo service.

Location: Calle 19, Concepción, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero El Rio
Description: We checked at Villa Linda but they wanted 60000 COP for the night so we came to this parqueadero close to downtown in Concepción. No height restriction for entry, but narrow streets and some tight corners approaching the entry probably restrict length to about 7m. The parking lot itself has lots of open parking area and some covered, depending on your needs. There are absolutely no services here so you must be completely self-contained and -supported. The lot itself is staffed from 8:00 am every day until 8pm M-F, 9pm Sat, 7pm Sun. Those are the official hours but our attendant left earlier on a Saturday night. This is important because the main gate is closed when they leave. Access to/from the lot after the attendant leaves is enabled by staff of the tienda (a round, pink building) in the roundabout outside the entrance to the lot until it 11:00 pm or when the tienda closes. We paid the 24 hour rate (16,500 COP) and spent the night, which was relatively quiet considering it was the opening weekend of Semana Santa. We appear to be the first to have spent the night in our vehicle and no one seemed to mind. The town itself is quite charming and prices were what might be expected of rural Colombia. People were very friendly and judging by the attention we garnered we may be the only foreign tourists in town. The drive from Barbosa is quite scenic, but be aware that about 1/4 of the distance is not paved and in very rough condition in spots. Still doable by 2WD vehicle when dry. We have had no Tigo cell service since leaving the main highway. Views of the surrounding hills and adjacent riverside park are quite nice.

We visited our van almost daily to pick up or drop off stuff and we were greeted with smiles each and every time.

Name: Hotel Mahoma
Description: Nothing special but clean and very friendly owners. You can have breakfast and dinner if you want and they also work together with the guiding company. Street parking only but no one seems bothered by it as there are tourist motorbikes outside of most hotels. 80k/night for a double room

Location: Morasurco, Comuna 9, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520001, Colombia
Name: Texaco
Description:
We went to an iOverlander location at the skate park, but it was full of parked cars.  We looked for a police officer and asked where we could sleep and they told us that Bairro Morasurco was safe and showed us the location.  We found this gas station and they allowed us to stay the night for free.  We didn't use any resources, we just spent the night.
---
Fomos a um local do iOverlander na pista de skate, mas estava cheio de carros estacionados.  Procuramos um policial e perguntamos onde poderíamos dormir e nos disseram que o Bairro Morasurco era seguro e nos mostrou a localização. Encontramos este posto de gasolina e eles nos permitiram passar a noite gratuitamente. Não usamos nenhum recurso, só passamos a noite.

Location: Arabe Real, Calle 25, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Café 472
Description:
Very friendly place to stop for a coffee. The owner Thomas was a guide and just opened this speciality coffee. You can try different drinks and methods of extraction. 

He also offer coffee experiences. If interested, you should write to him and ask what you can do. His number +573145134352.

Location: Vía Arrecifes, Zaino, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Tayrona NP parking lot
Description:
It is possible to overnight park your van at the main parking lot of the park. 
You pay for your vehicle access (19.000 cop for small cars, 48.500cop for bigger rigs, more for buses etc) and your own entrance (different prices for high and low season and for locals and foreigners - we paid 73.500 cop each for low season) and mandatory insurance (6.000cop pp/day) and you can stay inside for up to 4 days. 
The toilets and showers are not located in this parking lot but if you walk 2 minutes to where the ambulance and medics tents are, there’s a building with toilets (bring your own toilet paper) and outdoor showers. 
The nearest beach where you can swim is an hour walking away but the hike is easy. 
It’s so quiet and not that hot overnight. We stayed two nights. 
The restaurants are located at the main beaches/campgrounds.

Location: Cacicasgo, Suesca, Almeidas, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Villa Rosita
Description: Several cabanas with possibility to cook your self. Garden is amazing and the kitchen is really complete with a couch and fireplace. Every cabana has showers and toilet and fireplace. Owners are again incredible friendly and Juan Carlos speaks a bit English. The Suesca cliffs are in walking distance also centre of the town.

Location: Carrera 72D, Argelia, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Kennedy, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 110841, Colombia
Name: Proyectar
Description: This is a specialist in (electric) sliding doors. He fixed our sliding door. Because it was making a cracking sound. We wanted to readjust the door and he helped us perfect with that. Super nice and friendly guy!

Location: Transversal 44, Juan XXIII, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130015, Colombia
Name: Hotel bosque de la americas
Description: Basic clean hotel. many rooms, ask to see another one if not happy. better rooms have windows giving on the steeet. around 55k pesos single. 15 min taxi to getsemani. the guy next door will guard your motorcycle in his backyard for 4k per night and 4k per day.

Location: Calle 51A, Alejandro Echavarría, Comuna 9 - Buenos Aires, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050013, Colombia
Name: cooking school - Vía Cocina
Description:
We did a very interesting cookery course at vía cocina. The chef Brian is originally from Canada and has already collected a lot of experience all over the world. He came to Colombia in 2012 and started the cookery school as a community project. (More information on his website). We started the cookery lesson on his terrace, where he grows many herbs, vegetables and fruits himself. There we were able to taste the typical Colombian fruits. Afterwards, we cooked a three-course meal with him. We had a very interesting and instructive evening in the vía cocina.

Brian's telephone number: +57 300 483 8599
Website: viacocina.wordpress.com

Location: Estación Cocorná, Puerto Triunfo, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Pesca Tour y Aventura
Description:
A local tour guide organization with the amazing Yamit Diaz. Here you can go hippo watching (in the wild, even though they're invasive), do 2 day bird watching tours or fishing tours. 

They also have a secured camping area that fits two/cars or two mid-sized campervans. Included are a clean cold shower and toilet and the area is right next to the river and HQ of the organization. Lots of wildlife in the area!

Yamit also runs a turtle rescue center with his parents nearby, which is free to visit. They show amazing passion for the care of wildlife. They're donation based, so more than welcome to donate some cash!

The town itself is adorable, clean and filled with kind people that love to chat. Everyone knows eachother so great sense of safety and community.

WhatsApp Yamit Diaz at: +57 312 7902422

Location: Clínica Victoriana, Calle 58, Villa Nueva, Comuna 10 - La Candelaria, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050012, Colombia
Name: Ecoboutique USA2 and 2 other second-hand clothing store
Description:
A great second-hand clothing store, with lovely variety and cheap prices.
very close to 2 other second hand store:
• Según La Moda Store
• Súper Ropero (even cheaper!)
highly recommend!

Location: Carrera 17A, Tierra Blanca, Compartir, Soacha ciudad, Soacha, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 250052, Colombia
Name: parque escondido tierra blanca
Description:
This is a place to pass through, you could stay a couple of nights, it's a quiet place! I knew it because I used to live in this area. It's safe, it's an unpaved road behind the Avenida Indumil.
----
este es un lugar de paso, podrías quedarte un par de noches, es un lugar tranquilo!   lo conocí por que antes vivía en esta zona. es seguro es una vía sin pavimentar detrás de la avenida indumil.

Location: parqueo, Barrio El Contento, Comuna 1 - Centro, Perímetro Urbano Cúcuta, Cúcuta, Oriental, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 540006, Colombia
Name: SOAT cucuta
Description:
I was able to take out a SOAT for my motorcycle here. 3 months for 209,000 COP. Available for external travelers. 
La Previsora, Calle 14 No. 3- L 108 
Opening hours: 8 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 1 p.m. to 5 p.m. - SOAT issue 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 1 p.m. to 4 p.m. 
There is a side entrance.
You will need a copy of your passport, vehicle registration document and TIP. 
A copy shop is within sight. At the end of the street. (approx. 50 m). It is possible to send the data via WhatsApp. 
The insurance can be paid for by credit card or cash.

Location: Restaurante "El Jeque", Troncal Central del Norte, Tipacoque, Norte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 151040, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje El Jeque
Description: The rooms have been newly renovated and everything is clean. Typical truck stop. Ideal for an overnight stay. A restaurant that is well attended. I paid 30,000 COP for a room.

Location: Calle 41, Torices, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 472000, Colombia
Name: Hostal Cartagonova
Description:
We stayed 10 days at this very welcoming family.
There are 3 different rooms with or without attached bathroom and one dormitory with 6 beds.
All the rooms are equipped with AC and have fans.
Communal clean kitchen, laundry, living room, fast internet, airport pickup and parking lot for small car.
Martha can provide breakfast and dinner if you want. Lovely coffee!
Little tienda just across the street and supermarket 10 minutes walk.

Martha and Jose helped us a lot while we had to visit the hospital unfortunately. Jose speaks English.

We paid 129.000 for room with attached bathroom. Discount for longer stays possible.

Telephone number: +57 324 667 3698

Location: La Salada, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056050, Colombia
Name: Start of Hiking loop to Cueva de Esplendor
Description: We started our hike to Cueva de Esplendor here. It is ca. 8 km uphill, gaining 870 meters of altitude, 3 hours. At the Cueva you pay 20.000 pp for entrance, count 1 hour more or less with break. Then we continued the hike down the trail which is the official road up to the Cueva. That took us another 3 hours for ca. 10 km. So 7 hours in total, 18 km loop. Amazing scenery, great views, totally recommend. If you prefer less steep uphill walk, then do it the other way round. It’s just more km uphill then. They sell beverage and snacks at the Cueva, otherwise there is nothing on the way, so take water and food.

Location: Panamericana, PRADOS DEL NORTE EL BORDO, Patía, El Bordo, Sur del Cauca, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Taller Volante
Description: We went there to check a strange sound in your Kombi VW. they were very serious and friendly. help us with others little staffs on the van. we didn't wait before they come to check the van.

Location: Carrera 11, San Basilio de Palenque, Mahates, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Simankongo Hotel
Description: Very simple, bear and clean accommodations. A full size bed, a chair, a shower, a toilet and a small sink. The best part is the air conditioning, as the town is very hot. Our room #7 looked at the street, so it was very noisy. We paid C60k for one night. We had asked people in town and everyone said we could sleep in our van for free in front of the main square, but we wanted the shower, and the AC.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje Payende
Description: A friendly site with six cabañas and places for pitching tents. The cabañas are 230k COP per night with use of the pool and breakfast included. Pitching a tent costs 20k per person per night, includes use of the pool and WiFi. Breakfast is 15k per person with plenty of coffee.

Location: Gachetá, Guavio, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Place with a spectacular view. Very friendly people, and beautiful and quiet nights

--

Maria Fernanda receives you inside of a gated community in the outskirts of Cartagena (35 min to city center) and you can park in front of their house. the parking is not private but shared with the neighbors. you can use their bathroom. 
write Maria on Whatsapp at +57 300 5689836

Location: Calle 19, Trujillo, Centro, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Hotel Trujillo Plaza
Description: Direkt on Square Place, beautyfull Hotel look really Luxory in Colombian Style! Hot Water big Beds so clean we paid 22 Dollar! Good Coffeeshop belong to Hotel with nice Espresso! I recomend it!!! Parking on Street, no Problem!! Or you ask Owner he let your bike park in Coffeeshop at 10 pm!

Location: Calle 7, Oporapa, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje El Rosario
Description:
Basic but clean hotel in Oporapa situated at the back of the petrol station . Only 4 rooms, I was charged 40,000 COP for one person for the night. The owners let me keep my bicycle in a garage attached to the petrol station overnight.
If full, there is another hotel around the corner

Name: Polideportivo in El Salto de Bordones
Description:
Covered area with concrete floor next to the polideportivo near the church close to the centre of town. I asked a couple of people if it was ok to camp here and they all said yes.
Very poor cell signal in the town. Quite noisy with loud music coming from a nearby bar as it is the weekend. There are also rooms available in the town if you ask around.

Location: Vía Moniquirá - Villa de Leyva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154001, Colombia
Name: Villa Dunia
Description:
Big spot full of space for parking all size trucks and campers, you can put your tent, also. 

This is a private place manage for a colombian guy: Gerardo. He lives in small home with 2 dogs, 2 horses and chickens.  He was a traveler, too, and he wants that his land become a place of travelers. 

Wifi, watter, súper close to the Museum Fósil (you can go by foot), and there you can find a restaurant.
5/10 minuts to the center of the village by car.

Gerardo is super friendly and helpfull. 

You can do a Laundry leaving a tip, speak with Gerardo. 

You can contact directly at: (+57) 302 486 1053 by WhatsApp. Sorry, but Gerardo only speak Spanish

All was really clean

Location: Carrera 5, El Centro, Comuna 4, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 190003, Colombia

Location: Ebenezer, Suroccidental, Fusagasugá ciudad, Fusagasugá, Sumapaz, RAP (Especial) Central, 252212, Colombia
Name: Street Campsite
Description:
We spent the night in the bay on the street; it was very quiet at night. During the day, many vehicles pass by, but it's very safe, especially being close to the police school. It's perfect for spending the night.
---
Pasamos la noche en la bahia en la calle, muy tranquilo en la noche, en el dia pasan muchos vehiculos, muy seguro, cerca a la escuela de policia. perfecto para pasar la noche

Natural shop

A lot of community activities.

Pátio em frente à ao escritório concessionária, que também funciona como SOS e tem opção de dormir. 
Passamos uma noite aqui bem tranquila.

Location: Hostal El Ramo, Carretera Tagua, Tagua, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: El Ramo
Description: Very basic, 2 rooms with 7 beds, excellent dinner (nicely priced at 20 mil in comparison to the fancy, overpriced Eco-places around) and breakfast (10 mil). Perfect for a night as a base for Cerro Kennedy. Don't expect luxury.

Location: Calle 2, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 418060, Colombia

Montallan.

+57 312 382 2345

Location: Vía San Andres, Inzá, Oriente, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje y Restaurante Pisimbala
Description:
What a welcoming family. They directed us to park next to the house/ hostel. The whole family were all fascinated with the campervan. Also, allowed us to use the bathrooms and water. 
We cooked into the campervan.

Location: hostal backpackers musica y arte, 4, Calle 4A, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 418060, Colombia
Name: Hostel Musica & Arte
Description:
On Sunday afternoon we parked outside Hotel Musica and Arte and woke up with our rear tyre purposefully punctured. We discovered not all characters that associate with the hostel are safe. 

Steven at the hostel was very welcoming and shared their wifi and allowed us to use the showers.

Name: short term parking

Location: Las Flores, Eduardo Santos - La Playa, Barranquilla, Atlántico, RAP Caribe, 080020, Colombia
Name: Bocas de Ceniza hike start
Description: This is the place where you can park your car and start a 5 km hike one way to Bocas de Cenizas. It's a beautiful hike with Magadalena River on one side and ocean on the other side. You can hike or get a moto ride to the end. Make sure to carry water with you. Not many tiendas on the way there

Description: You can park here for w4 hors. They charged me 45000 pesos per night. It has camera and is attended by guard 24/7.

Location: Café Salento Plaza, #6-11, Carrera 6, Horizontes, Filandia, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 634001, Colombia
Name: Ornella cono pizzas
Description:
Excellent pizzeria! Big and good for a reasonable price! The boss is very friendly and helpful! It's a little difficult to find: you have to enter the patio passing through a café, go to the very back and climb the stairs!

Excellente pizzeria! Grandes et bonnes pour un prix raisonnable! Le patron est très sympathique et serviable! C’est un peu difficile à trouver : il faut rentrer dans le patio en passant dans un café, aller tout au fond et monter l’escalier!

Location: Calle 15, San Isidro, El Placer, Valle del Guamuez (La Hormiga), Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Tourist information office - El Coca
Description:
Here you can find the official tourist office.
They provide you with the latest information about events in the area and all the tours in the Amazonas! 
Go to here before going to the tours operators, so you have better knowledge of what/which tour you want to book!

The tour information you can also find on their website: http://www.elcocavivelo.com/informacion/

We got a lot of information what we can do in this area and they also help if you have only a smaller budget!

Location: Carrera 9, Maicao, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Hotel NES
Description:
Nice simple hotel with secure parking for vans. no height limit. but not suitable for big rigs.

Paid 100.000Cop for two ppn. inclusive nice breakfast, wifi AC and parking. 

Claro, Atms and money exchange in walking distance.

Location: 25, Puerto Caldas, AMCO, Area Metropolitana Centro Occidente, Pereira, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660007, Colombia
Name: Terpel
Description:
We slept one night at this station, the staff was very kind and said we could sleep in a retreat that has a direction towards Medellín.  There is a lot of noise from the road, as it is next door.  It has a bathroom, but it closed for a period due to lack of water.  We don't pay anything, we just fill up the car in the morning.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
Dormimos uma noite neste posto, o pessoal foi muito gentil e disse que poderíamos dormir num recuo que tem sentido Medellín. Tem bastante ruído da estrada, pois fica ao lado. Possui banheiro, mas fechou por um período por conta de falta de água. Não pagamos nada, somente abastecemos o carro pela manhã.

Location: 27, Carrera 28A, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520002, Colombia
Name: Gira el Sol - Veg Restaurant
Description:
Vegetarian restaurant that offers a vegan lunch with vegetarian (cow’s milk/eggs) desserts. Lunch is 10k for a small and 12k for a large. This is a vegan’a paradise. You actually leave full after eating a healthy meal for a great price. You get a bowl of fruits or soup, the main lunch plate, and a juice. Definitely come here! 

They also sell tofu labeled as ‘queso de soya’.
Pet friendly.

Location: Vía Gigante-Hobo, Gigante, Centro, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Clandestino Hostal
Description:
Came here cycling, two persons.
The owner is really friendly. They told us for the moment there is nothing to pay to camp here. Just to help him back for some stuff at the place.
So to pitch your tent it’s free (under a Tree, some grass) and if you want to sleep in a bed it’s 10k per person. He proposes a restaurant too.
Cell signal, wifi, water, electricity, kitchen, bathrooms, cold showers.
There are two dogs friendly.

Location: Calle 8A, El Centro, Comuna 4, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 190003, Colombia
Name: En la plaza de los perros
Description:
It is Benito Juárez Square, this is the place where it is possible to park. We felt safe the 3 nights we spent here. The police are in the square and the square is lively and quiet at night. In the central area to walk everywhere.
--
Es la plaza Benito Juárez este es el lugar donde es posible estacionar. Nos sentimos seguros las 3 noches que pasamos aquí. La policía está en la plaza y la plaza es animada y tranquila en la noche. En la zona céntrica para ir caminando a todos lados.

Location: Camino al Cerro Montecillo, Vereda Montecillo, Guatavita, Guavio, RAP (Especial) Central, 251060, Colombia

Description: Beautiful hike up, views of the lake and town the whole way. 5km up and down, pretty much up hill the whole way up but not too steep and only short. Would recommend, no one else on the path and we went on a weekend, muy tranquilooooo! Also a spot to camp in a tent up here! Hike is on alltrails and maps me! Enjoyyy

Location: 90, Zapata, Necoclí, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia

Beautiful host. Delivers a walking tour of La Floresta area around 10am daily. Contact him in advance to confirm timings. Floresta y Floresta plus 4131742metrofloresta

Name: Sarab Arabie Restaurant
Description:
The  best Mediterranean restaurant in Barranquilla. A must stop if you like Lebanese food. 
Tony the owner speaks great English. Have some Arak and Fateh for me.

Location: Juzgados, Calle 40, El Rosario, Localidad Norte - Centro Histórico, Perímetro Urbano Barranquilla, Barranquilla, Atlántico, RAP Caribe, 080002, Colombia
Name: Fan repairs.

Location: Sutatenza, Oriente, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 152860, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Espíritu Santo
Description: Great place to eat, clean, nice staff, huge portions of food, one dish can full 2 person easily and the best of all, cheap as f... 19.000 cop or USD5 pear meal.  Gran lugar, buena atención, gran comida, grandes grandes porciones (con un plato comen 2) y a un precio razonable 19.000 cop/5USD

Location: Vereda El Juncal, Iles, Contadero, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 523087, Colombia

Description:
Peaceful place between fields, away from the main road. Small leveled turn-off with space for one car or two tents, the last 20m are a bit steep on loose gravel, might be difficult in a 2wd. Not suitable for big rigs.
There is a house near by they came and were really friendly and told us it's save place. 
We took the switch backs from the bottom. But also saw some cars coming from up.

Location: Hotel estación Aeropuerto, Panamericana, Chachagüí, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Texaco
Description: I parked where the trucks normally go. no one came to charge me. quiet night after 10ish. they have showers and baños but I did not use them

Location: Chigorodó, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Los Rosales
Description: Very nice Place for overlander´s , totally green and super quiet, nice and clean Pools, lots of animals to knuddle, our daughter really enjoyed this Place. We could use shower and toilet from one cabana. Paid 70k for us 2.5 and our Truck, a bit expensive but totally worth the Price. In front of properes is a small woodden bridge, no Problem for our 8t, but for heavier trucks??

Location: Parqueadero, Autopista Medellín-Bogotá, Ciudadela Artesanal, Marinilla, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 054020, Colombia
Name: Terpel gaz station
Description:
Terpel station. We were able to refill water for free (200L) after filling up.

Station Terpel. Nous avons pu recharger gratuitement en eau (200L) après avoir fait le plein.

Location: Paso del Mango, Minca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470008, Colombia
Name: wild camping near Finca de La Candaleria
Description:
Came last night to Finca. It was too late for the tour. they close at 4 pm. They did not allow us to use RTT on Finca. Instead we pulled in this spot as it was getting dark and the road is Hi 4x4. Peaceful and tranquil here. Tomorrow  we plan to go for chocolate tour at Finca at 9 am. 
Only 4x4 and high clearance vehicles can make it here.

Location: 10, San Fernando, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520009, Colombia
Name: Police checkpoint
Description:
Police checkpoint checking for TIP and SOAK (insurance) 
They wanted to charge us 150$ for not having insurance and tow the car… would have been a nightmare. 
After an hour and a tow truck pulling up in front of us they send us back to Pasto to buy insurance, without a fine.

Location: Tierradentro Café & Co, 2-81, Carrera 12, San Antonio, Comuna 3, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760044, Colombia
Name: Pastelería Alemana
Description:
Perfect bakery/restaurant/bar run by German lady. She has delicious strudels, lots of cakes, sandwiches and of course coffee and jugos. Very lovely, peaceful place, little oasis. 
Parking is on the street and she has camera so felt okay. 
She was very nice!

Location: Carrera 16 Bis, Pinares de San Martin, Universidad, AMCO, Area Metropolitana Centro Occidente, Pereira, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660003, Colombia
Name: Taller mecánico de Segundo
Description:
Segundo, who is a mechanic, and Jorge, who is an electrician, work here. We have experience with Segundo, he repaired the steering and the homokinetics of the Kombi, even without getting spare parts. The work was excellent and at a great price. He let us sleep inside the workshop. He is an excellent person and we highly recommend him.
---
Acá trabajan Segundo que es mecánico y Jorge que es eléctrico. Nosotros tenemos experiencia con segundo, nos reparo la dirección y la homocinética de la Kombi, aún sin conseguir repuestos. El trabajo fue excelente y a un precio bárbaro. Nos dejó dormír adentro del taller. Es una excelente persona.
Lo recomendamos mucho

Location: PAQUEADERO PANTANO DE VARGAS, Carretera Pantano de Vargas, Paipa, Tundama, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 150447, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero
Description: Parking in front of the monument of Pantano de Vargas.  Quiet and safe place.

Name: Parquedero
Description: If you are taking Tour of Punta Gallinas with history travel, you can park the car here. They charged me 8000pesos per day, 24000 pesos for 3 days. You park outside and your solar panel will have access to sun.  No height restrictions.

Location: Carrera 6, Palomino, Dibulla, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 446009, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero asociación comunal Palomino
Description: It is a comfortable place, with drinking water, quiet and safe. You must pay 10,000 COP per night. We have been here for 3 weeks and everything is very good.

Location: Rainbow beach, Vía Cabo de la Vela, Kasiuoluin, Cabo de la Vela, Uribia, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 440029, Colombia

posada Toche near the church.
20k for a bed
10 k for camping
10k breakfast.
wa 3142864022
fast wifi, cold shower.
very clean

restaurant in the street for 11k a meal

Location: Vía Cabo de la Vela, Kasiuoluin, Cabo de la Vela, Uribia, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 440029, Colombia

Location: Vía Cabo de la Vela, Kasiuoluin, Cabo de la Vela, Uribia, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 440029, Colombia

Description: This is the parking lot where all tours come for sunset. You could park here and enjoy tge views after everyone leaves.

Location: Diagonal 7, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Puente Aranda, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 111611, Colombia
Name: JAL Dealer 4x4 Parts, Tires & Accessories
Description:
This shop installed a rear view camera for us and also organised original Toyota coil springs for our Landcruiser HZJ78.
They also have lights, 4x4 Accessories, quality tires, car Hi-fi and electronics. Super friendly, easy and quick contact and process.

They don't have a workshop so they only sell the parts. But they do minor repairs and they do install the tires. Just contact them beforehand and ask if they will do the installation for you. 

You can contact them via Instagram @jal_dealer or via Whattsapp +57 322 9129 741.

Location: Carrera 28, Galerías, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Teusaquillo, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 111311, Colombia
Name: Bogota football tour
Description:
Charlie has been hosting football tours for over eight years. He shared heaps of information about the team and the game. 
We join him on a Sunday afternoon game Santa Fe v’s Tomlina. We paid 200,000 Cop for transport to and from the game and drinks. 
WhatsApp: +57 315233494

Location: San Remo, Camino a Mina del Chaquiro, Mina del Chaquiro, Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 661020, Colombia
Name: Rural San Remo
Description:
A lovely place with lodges where we could stay with the van. We were the first that stayed here with the van and they want to attract more vans. The lodges are in booking if you want to see more info. Since our parents stayed at the lodge we didn’t have to pay for the van but you’ll have to negotiate a price if you’re here with the van. 

It’s close to the thermals. The path to the place is narrow so not suited for big rigs.

Location: Oikos Storage Centro Empresarial Metropolitano, Km 3.5, Autopista Medellin, Siberia, Cota, Sabana Occidente, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 250017, Colombia

Lugar especializado en camperizacion  mantenimiento de casas rodantes , venta de accesorios para su Motorhome , especialistas en sistemas eléctricos ,solares plomeria

Spa with natural water pool, sale of food and drinks, with parking space for a motor home. Parking cost COP 20,000 per vehicle
