Balneario con piscina de agua natural, venta de comidas y bebidas, con espacio de parqueo para casa rodante. Costo de parqueo COP 20.000 por vehículo

Location: Carrera 6A, Camilo Torres, Comuna 2 Nuevo Centro, Riohacha ciudad, Riohacha, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 440007, Colombia
Name: Jhon Repuestos y Frenos
Description: My 4runner brake pedal was applying brakes low. So I was brought in here by Oswaldo, driver of the History Tours that take visitors to Punta Gallinas. They have all Toyota Prados & Land Cruisers. They are in tip-top top conditions. I felt they know the best mechanics. Brought my car here. He thought the pas needed replacement but that was not the issue. He alternatively thought the pedal needed adjustment but tried to adjust it but could not. In reality it was Master cylinder gradually failing. Good for routine brake repairs.

Location: Vía Ubate - Capellania, Tarabita, Capellanía, Fúquene, Ubaté, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Police check point
Description:
Small/ informal police check point. 
Asked for vehicle details and passports. Seemed happy with them and let us continue.

Location: Susa, Ubaté, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Piedra Colgada
Description:
Awesome camping spot to head out to the hills for some hiking.

WhatsApp: +57 (313) 838-8165

PIEDRA COLGADA PARQUE ECOTURISTICO Adventure Park WhatsApp: +57 (311) 292-2954

Location: Avenida Guaimaral, Barrio Guiamaral, Comuna 2 - Centro Oriental, Perímetro Urbano Cúcuta, Cúcuta, Oriental, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 540003, Colombia
Name: ICA new location to legalise papers for exporting dog
Description:
The ICA building on google maps is no longer correct. They moved to this place. Other than a poster it has no sign or whatsoever. We asked and they confirmed. You can park in front of the building. Beware of the steep ramp. 

It’s open during weekdays between 7.30 total 11.00 and from 14.00-17.00. Changes could be made since they’re undergoing changes currently. 

Here at ICA you can legalise your health certificate for the dog to leave Colombia.

Location: Susa, Ubaté, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: PIEDRA COLGADA PARQUE ECOTURISTICO
Description:
The family are so welcoming. Great activity with a view over the valley. 
Various costs for each of the different activities. 
We parked, used toilets and showers for free. 


WhatsApp: +57 314 226 9413

Location: Umaña - Dajud, Vereda El Espinal, Sáchica, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 153880, Colombia
Name: Viñedo Umaña Dajud wineyard tour
Description:
Cute little winery, produces three different varieties of red and one rose wine.
European prices for glasses or a bottle.

Location: Calle 7, Santa Rosa del Sur, Magdalena Medio, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Tailler el wicho and TCG Tapiceria carpas garcia (auto trimming/vehicle upholstery)
Description: The Tailler el wicho (tel. 3026748641) does fantastic Carosserie works on Toyota, but also on other cars. If there is a problem with the seats or something interior works like that, there is shop just on the other side of the road. Good experience

Location: Carrera 3 Este, Las Mercedes, Paicol, Occidente, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hostal El Triangulo
Description: this is the hotel of the gas station. there is enough space in the room to put your bikes in. 60 000 pesos one night two persons with AC in the room. average wifi.

Location: Carrera 5, Santa Rosa del Sur, Magdalena Medio, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Taller El Mugre
Description: One of the best garages I ever have seen. There are a lot of specialist for everything. And they have long time experience.  So if Toyota Landcruiser has a problem that will be the place for sure. They work very good and fast and with a high competence.

Location: 4-23, Carrera 5, Sutamarchán, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 153860, Colombia
Name: Sutamarchán - Quiet street parking
Description:
Arrived into the town late at night. Good overnight spot walking distance of the cute town square. 
Good Claro signal
No amenities.

Location: Sutamarchán, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 153860, Colombia
Name: Grape Juice Tour - Viñedo Abarán
Description:
Lovely father and son team.
We believed this was a winery and they kept insisting that we can try wines as well as juice. However, they don’t produce wine. It was from Chile!
25,000 pp for a tour.

Location: Avenida Libertadores, La Plata, Occidente, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: La Marqueza cocina y coctelería
Description: really good menu del día for 10000. very friendly owner. vegetarian friendly.

Location: Calle 12, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154001, Colombia
Name: José Bodyshop
Description: We hit our van in a tough spot to fix. Somebody in town recommended Jose. He did an incredible job, for an incredible price, all in half anday. His WhatsApp +57 320 2647115.

Location: Camp Alfredo, Camino a Ciudad Perdida, Mutanyi, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Teyuna Tours - Day 1 campsite
Description: This is the site where the tour company makes you stay overnight for the first night of the 3 night trip. Great Accomodation and food is served here. All beds have mosquito nets.

Location: Carrera 9, Palermo, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: hospedaje
Description:
hospedaje without name close to the main square. Paid 25k for a room.
cold shower. wifi. place for bicycle, motorbike I guess

Location: Carrera 4, Paicol, Occidente, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: hostal zurumba
Description: good place to camp. 15k per night to camp 10k breakfast They don’t offer camping at the moment and a room is 48k.

Location: San Rafael, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053830, Colombia
Name: La Clarita
Description: Nice flat green space next to the river. Clean bathrooms and showers. Weather is quite warm so no need for warm shower… We stayed Thursday to Saturday, the first night it was perfectly quiet, the second one not so much. Not recommended during weekend as it’s a very popular spot and people play loud music day and night. The River access is only a few meters away and the water is nice and clear. There was a big family of MONKEYS passing by very close to us early in the morning, this was a special and unexpected treat (pay attention to high pitch sounds) The owner (Doña Blanca) offered to prepare food so we had a fish plate which was good. Good place to relax next to the river for a day or two and enjoy nature.

Location: Rio Claro zona de camping, 60, San Luis, San Francisco, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Camping La Peña
Description: Beautiful HUGE flat green area next to amazing Río Claro which has clear water and natural pools to swim and refresh yourself. Bathrooms and shower are basic but clean. They sell beverages and snacks on site. The surrounding area has mining activity so there’s some truck noise during the day. Make sure to take mosquito repellent as there are bugs early morning and evening. It’s quite hot so our rechargeable fan was perfect during the night. Crowded on weekends. Weekdays are the best! Love this place!

Location: La Paz, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470006, Colombia
Name: Zuagencia Beach resort
Description: You can stay overnight or can have a day pass to enjoy the beautiful facilities  here. They charge $250,000 pesos for day pass of which 118,000 pesos is towards consumables. The resort is on the beach

Location: Carrera 4, Nemocón, Sabana Centro, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Almacigo Food & Drinks
Description: We came to this restaurant. We enjoyed all their food. We noticed they had rooms. We asked to use the showers. We were charged COP$20K for the 2 of us. A bit expensive, but very convenient. Showers were hot, but you need to make sure to ask for them to turn on the water heater...hahaha

Location: Calle 30, 11 de Noviembre, Localidad 1 Cultural Tayrona - San Pedro Alejandrino, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470001, Colombia
Name: Mechanic Richard
Description:
Richard is very knowledgeable on cars. A local Shop owner from Aguacatera who owned a 4runner recommended Richard name. I came here and he was able to diagnose the brake issue immediately. He does not know English but we were able to communicate through translator. Highly recommend Richard for the car repairs
 He has adjacent hotel too where you could stay for the night. 
Since my brake Master cylinder needed the electrical repairs so he had his son take me to Louis Carlos shop, Taller Eurocar (pin added) so he can scan, diagnose and  repair the master cylinder. At the end of the day, he did not ask for labor but just said whatever proposal is worth to you. I gave him 27000 pesos.

Location: Calle 29 F, Portal Universitario, Localidad 1 Cultural Tayrona - San Pedro Alejandrino, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470003, Colombia
Name: Louis Carlo
Description: Louis was recommended by Mechanic Richard. He is tge expert of Toyota electronic system. He is going to fix my 4runner Master Cylinder. He charged me $170 for rebuilding master cylinder. An additional $30,000 pesos to do the electronic scan on the brakes.

Location: Calle 28, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Casa Tamarindo
Description:
A great little hostel with decent off street parking and well priced. Aircon, WiFi, reasonable rooms and a small communal kitchen. If you were prepping a sprinter van or similar for shipping you could even do that here instead of out at the popular fincas. See pic for parking space.

It is operated remotely so you need to book online (we did this on the day of arrival) and recieve access codes: @casatamarindo or WhatsApp +57 320 476 5431 

We think it is the same owners as Casa do Los Almendros but this one offers better parking space.  

Google will take you to the the above hostel so refer to pics for correct street number.

Location: Carrera 21, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Hotel Casa Mishka
Description:
A great place while waiting for you vehicle to arrive  at the port.
Good WiFI. New, clean, peaceful and nice boutique hotel with a parking space right in front.  24hrs security cam and reception. Common kitchen for light cooking. Walking distance to collect your TIP.  20 minutes walk to Old Town/Getsemani. Very helpful staffContact Roberto.

Location: Portal de San Diego Hotel, 36-17, Calle Segunda de Badillo, San Diego, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 472000, Colombia
Name: Pezetarian
Description: Sushi/asian-ish place with interesting food and several vegetarian / vegan options, typical old-town prices.

Location: Calle 103B, Pasadena, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Suba, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 111111, Colombia
Name: Hostal Bogotá Real - correct location
Description: THIS is the correct location. Nice hostel with 2 friendly hosts, Eduardo and Mauricio. Rooms (already a little run down) in 2nd floor are nice with a nice view to the parks around. We could use the (not very clean) kitchen for boiling water and preparing our breakfast. Eduardo is very helpful. 1 fenced parking lot, good for a car or 2-3 motos. Walking distance (5min) to Carulla Supermarket and other shops/banks/ATMs. Walking distance (30 min) to our garage (KTM Powershop). We left most of our luggage here to leave the country for about 2 months and payed 1 night extra(100000 cop) for the storage. Safe and very quiet place. +57 311 2121599

Location: Barrio Monte Blanco, Otu, Remedios, Nordeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Primax Gas
Description: We stay one night, this is part of the new road to Medellín, so need one place to sleep, we enter to Segovia, but is more caotic

Location: Vía Mocoa - Pitalito, Villa Fatima, Bruselas, Pitalito, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Finca cafetera Boscafé San Juan
Description:
A little bit up the hill from the main road (steep but possible to cycle for me). The gate entrance to the Place is directly at the main road, towards the east, quite visible with signs.

The place has a small parking lot.
A clean restaurant and bar.
They're renting a cabin (one cabin) with own bathroom and electricity.
Friendly staff and some dogs and chickens.
WiFi 4mb/s.

Around the restaurant and cabin, I couldn't hear the road, but I didn't pay special attention.

Seems kids and family friendly.

They grow and sell their own coffee.

The owner was very happy having a foreigner as a guest and told me very excited that once a couple from Europe rented a cabin.

I pitched up my tent somewhere on the property. They don't have fixed prices for tents. They said, if I want to give a small donation, I can.

Telephone: 3123835200

Location: Inspeccion de Policia Santa, Hato Corozal, Casanare, RAP Llanos, Colombia
Name: Río Ariporo cobble beach
Description:
An incredible place at the end of a small dirt road. Surrounded by lush vegetation and a a lot of birds.
As this is rainy season, we camped a little far from the river, but we can see it and hear it.
Very peaceful… a couple of friendly fishermen came in the afternoon.
One of the best wild camps we have been so far.
It is very hot, but dipping in the river is truly refreshing.
4x4 recommended if you want to access the beach, otherwise you can stay at the end of the road

Location: Hato Corozal, Casanare, RAP Llanos, Colombia
Name: Parque ecoturístico Fabian Parra
Description: A very special place with a truly unique landscape of mountain plateaus. At an altitude of 800 meters, you can escape the heat of the rest of the llanos. Nice and windy. Gorgeous 360 degree views. Several camp spots to choose from. On a clear day you can see Nevado del Cocuy on one side and the flat lands of the Llanos on the other side. Beautiful sunrises!!! You MUST CALL in advance to make a reservation otherwise the gate will be closed. 4x4 access only as the road is very steep and rocky. Contact +57 3132802980

Location: Carrera 54, Comuna 12 - Cabecera del Llano, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 680003, Colombia
Name: End of cul-de-sac backing into woodland
Description:
Decent spot for one night. Close to sports pitches. Locals were friendly. Couple of small shops within a couple of hundred metres. 
Good Claro signal.
No amenities.

Location: Calle 28, Comuna 2, Perímetro Urbano Valledupar, Valledupar, Cesar, RAP Caribe, 200003, Colombia
Name: Tyre place
Description: Awesome team who kindly stayed late on a Saturday to change our tyres.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Manantial Tatacoa Pool
Description: Our camphosts told us they have the best water. All natural, running, no chlorine. We were there on a Tuesday afternoon shortly after noon and were the only guests. Unfortunately the restaurant was closed - we assume it might only be open on weekends and holidays. Still - a nice place to cool off in the desert. Entrance fee is 10.000 COP/p closed at 6pm.

Location: Calle 235, Hacienda San Sebastián, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Suba, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111176, Colombia
Name: Estación de Gasolina Puma
Description: We had an appointment at a truck shop close by and asked the night before if we could overnight here, which they confirmed. We paid 5.000 COP for the night and stayed actually two nights more and we did our visit to Bogotá center from here via uber. The road passing by is pretty busy during the day but mostly quiet at night. The first activity at the airport starts around 5am.

Location: Carrera 14, Tunja, Centro, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 057117, Colombia
Name: Hotel Kastello
Description: Cheap and clean hotel with safe gated parking. COP25k ($7) for a room with double bed and TV, toilet sharing. COP30k ($8) for room with ensuite toilet. The receptionist David can speak fair English.

Location: El Salto de Bordones, Isnos, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: panadería el sol laboyano
Description: surprisingly good panaderia (for small town colombian standards) on the village main square.

Location: Arimaca, Hacienda el Recuerdo, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470008, Colombia
Name: redemption waterfall
Description:
from here to hike down to the waterfall
 it is private waterfall. Cost 25000 pesos to go there. Go to central Hostel in Minca to take guide with you. It is 45 min. hike one way.

Location: Minca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470008, Colombia
Name: Redemption  waterfall hike starting point
Description: This is the fork in road where you take right and follow tge trail to waterfall. 200m down the road is an open gate which you go through. You hike for half hour where there is a private property gate. You need to pay $25000 pesos/person to visit the fall. I took the tour from Central Hostel. The tour starts at 9 am if enough people and end at 1:00 pm. You should be able to park the car here. The whole town is safe for tourists.

Location: Vía Embalse la Copa, Toca, Centro, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: View to represa La Copa
Description: We went to the nearby spot but there was a potato plantation with lots of workers so we we went up a little further and found this secluded spot away from the road and hidden by trees. We can still see the lake and have a nice view of the mountain landscape. Quiet and safe place to spend the night.

Location: Calle 10, El Bosque, La Tebaida, Valle, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Parque Tebaida
Description:
Very quiet place, very welcoming people, we took very nice memories with us, there is no service, a lot of shops around.
---------
Lugar muy tranquilo, personas muy acogedoras nos llevamos muy lindos recuerdos, bueno para vender. no hay ningún servicio. mucho comercio al rededor

Location: Vía San Francisco - el Pepino - Villa Garzon, La Tebaida, Vereda La Tebaida, Mocoa, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Big roof for camping, next to cancha and school
Description:
Its a roof next to the football field ("cancha"). Easily big enough for two three tents and bicycles/bikes.

The football field itself is covered by a huge roof as well. Everyone we asked in the village for a spot to camp, told us the football field or the roof next to it is a great place to camp.

There is a tap with water.

There is a toilet, but because of the hygienic state of the toilet, I would say there is no toilet. During school time it is probably possible to use the school toilets.

The house east of the football field has two electricity plugs outside of the window.

If you travel by car/caravan, there is enough place around to park your vehicle. But we did not ask about cars.

Cellular connection (with claro) is between Okish and EDGE. There is a free WiFi where one has to register sign up to use it.

This company is among those authorized to issue insurance.
He took our information, we paid at a Bancolombia correspondent half a block away (Pasteur pharmacy) and when we returned he already issued the policy.
super friendly and willing.
For our kombi model (81) we paid about 279,000 COP.
The only thing was finding the model right within their system because it asks for data that does not appear in our ID, but we were able to do it without problems for 3 months.
State insurance quoted us 310,000 so we chose this one because it was cheaper. recommendable.

Fuimos al local de AXA COLPATRIA dentro del shopping Novacentro y fue rapidísimo. lo hicimos en el día y casi no había gente.
ésta empresa está dentro de las habilitadas para emitir el seguro.
nos tomó los datos, pagamos en un corresponsal del Bancolombia a media cuadra (farmacia Pasteur) y cuando volvimos ya emitió la póliza.
súper amables y predispuestos.
por el modelo de nuestra kombi (81) pagamos unos 279.000 COP.
lo único fue encontrar el modelo justo dentro de su sistema porque te pide datos que no figuran en mí nuestra cedula, pero lo pudimos hacer sin problemas por 3 meses.
seguros del estado nos cotizo 310.000 así que elegimos este por ser más barato.
recomendable.

Description:

Under the stands, there is a an open space, 4 x 5 meters. It's dry and a good spot for cyclists.
This side of the stands points towards the town. The other side is more quite but less sheltered.

The doors to enter inside the stands were all closed when I was there. But the windows were all demolished. Inside is no water. Inside are toilets and showers, but water doesn't work. So they haven't been flushed for quite a while.

Non of the electricity plugs worked when I was there. Lights neither.

Before I went to the football field, I asked at the alcaldía for water. There are outside tabs. I was surrounded there by friendly people. They told me its totally alright to sleep at the football field, but they suggested me to sleep in the open sports complex just above the alcaldia. They said its saver and has toilets and showers. But its louder and more people, since it is surrounded by streets and town.... But good to know they allow people to sleep there

Opening hours: 
Monday to Saturday 7-7, if I understood their Spanish correctly

Policemen were friendly but firm and obviously were looking for some pocket money. We could talk our way out of it and were reminded that in Barranquilla there are some stricter traffic restrictions for motos in effect. To cross the Magdalena river you should use Calle 17 and then turn left onto Carrera 9 instead. Take care.

From here about 40 minutes up the path to the viewpoint and Páramo.
The path can be muddy and slippery, in addition to being rocky and steep.
Still worth it, though.
Take your rubber boots, walking sticks could be handy, too.

When I arrived they were working on an Africa Twin and they have tons of BMW parts on display so seems they know big biges and small.  Paid 68k for a full maintenance of my rear brakes and changing fluid.  Really professional and they have parts for all bikes as well.

Description:

Paid £11 or $14usd or 58,000cop at the time of writing june 2024 for a twin room which had 2 double beds. Triple room is also available. Found it on booking.com so it’s easy to see current prices and book. 
Don’t recall seeing a card machine so think it is cash payment. 
Showers were cold unfortunately. Good, powerful fan. Free wifi. In lobby there is a water dispenser that does hot water too. Instant coffee and cups there too for you to use. Overall pretty decent place for the money. Would recommend

There is free Wifi from the community.

This is the place to park! Alex is so nice and the multiple restaurants give you dining options. We paid $30.000. Price is $20.000-$30.000 depending on size of vehicle. Google Maps will bring you here if you search for Alex Parrilla Restaurant. 
There are bathrooms when the restaurants are open. $1000
It was quiet by 10pm, not much traffic on the road until around 7:30am. Perfect place to walk to El Penol, and you can take a TukTuk to the Guatape Zocolo. Stay multiple days is ok too. 
Alex owns the property and there will be a hotel soon and grocery store.
Down by the lake is where you can take a private or group boat tour of the lake.

Location: Eco Hostal Las Camelias, Calle 13, Boquía, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631020, Colombia
Name: Eco Finca Salento
Description: Nice hostel/campground in town, we paid $25k per person per night to use bathroom and shower. Nice bathrooms, warm water with electric shower. They also have shared kitchen but that will be $35k per person per night.

Location: Calle 1, Coveñas, Morrosquillo, Sucre, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Los Containers
Description: Great place to have a family lunch or dinner with stands offering different dishes: pizza, hamburger, grills, etc... The restaurant is a large outdoor room covered by a thatched roof. Many animals for children: pony, rabbits, goat. A huge pool in repair when we were there.very friendly staff. Fast service

Location: Concepción - Alejandria, Concepción, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Selvatika Cabana
Description:
Beautiful  Cabanas in natural setting with pool & accommodations. The Cabana rents for $160,000 pesos a night of weekday and 180K on the weekend. It includes pool, food & drinks. 
If you just need to use swimming  pool it is 30k for the day. 
Beautiful  place, really popular  with locals.

Location: Estación de Policía, 22-22, Carrera 20, Concepción, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Alto de la virgen Mirador
Description: Great views of concepcion  from this Mirador. 15 min. hike to the top.Must visit if in concepcion

Location: Concepción, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Cascada Matasano
Description:
A beautiful  Cascada. Just a 5 min. hike to Cascada from the roadside. Just park on the road, it is quite safe. 
When coming from Concepción take a right on the main road. Stay right all the way to this point.

Location: Pamplonita, Suroccidente, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Darle la vuelta: Parque principal Pamplona
Description:
Quiet town, we slept in front of the town hall in the main square. We had to level our van because it is inclined, but it sleeps well. There is free wifi and water nearby. The people are friendly and it is very safe.

Pueblo tranquilo, dormimos frente a la alcadia en la plaza principal. Tuvimos que nivelar nuestra van porque esta inclinado, pero se duerme bien. Hay wifi libre y agua cerca. La gente es amable y es muy seguro.

Location: Calle 2, El Remolino, Taminango, La Cordillera, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Bomb! ! Dangerous area! !
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: WARNING! violent crime reported in this location. Please use caution.
---------
Travelers don't pass here at night! ! Don't leave the main road! ! This area is not safe!!
We arrived in this town at 21:30 last night and the street were blocked by soldiers. The hotel owner said that because someone threw bombs on the street! !The next morning we found that the explosion area was right next to our hotel, the car was burned to ashes, the glass of nearby houses was blown, and there was a lot of blood on the ground! !

Location: Panamericana, Mojarras, Mercaderes, Sur del Cauca, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Terpel Gas Station next to the road
Description: On the Road Side, 5k pesos to sleep in the parking lot. Pay inside the restaurant. Trucks coming in and out during the night. Safe. Not the best but not the worst either. Probably best to stay at the place with the view place a few km close to Popayan which is free, quiet and beautiful.

Location: Colombia
Name: Hostal Don Gabo
Description: A new hostal and a restaurant run by a super friendly local family, located just next to Bahía Hondita. You can sleep in hamacas (around 20/25.000 cop p.p.) or set your tent (20.000 for a two person tent). You can also walk from here to playa Punta Agujas (the boys will show you the way), they said they could even organize a transport but we didn't use. The fish we ate here was delicious. Whatsapp: (+57)3218454732

Location: BLESSING BARBERSHOP - NAILS SPA - MASAGGE - HAIR SALON - BRAIDS, Calle de la Moneda, San Diego, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130003, Colombia
Name: Hostal Casa Torres
Description:
We slept in this hostel for 10 nights while we waited for our camper/container to arrive.
Very cheap but still clean and well equipped, breakfast is included in the price.
Very good located, ideal for exploring the city.
34‘000 COP per Person

No parking facilities.
Good cellphone reception.

Location: Maicao, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero Climax
Description:
We stayed 4 nights in this truck parking lot, we had to wait for the weekend and a holiday Monday until SENAIT in Venezuela was open for the kombi's documentation.  Super safe, as it's a weekend a little noisy until later. There is energy but we only use it to charge our cell phones, there is water and wifi. 10.000 COL per night. There are rooms with air conditioning but we didn't ask how much.

Ficamos 4 noites neste estacionameto para caminhões, tivemos que aguardar o final de semana e uma segunda-feira de feriado até o SENAIT na Venezuela estar aberto para documentação da kombi.  Super seguro, por ser fim de semana um pouco de barulho até mais tarde. Tem tomada mas só utilizamos para carregar o celular, tem agua e wifi. 10.000 COL por noite. Tem quartos com ar-condicionado mas não perguntamos o valor.

Location: Camino Los Rieles, Mirador del Doce, El Picacho, San Cristóbal, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050041, Colombia
Name: Terribly steep paved street.
Description: This is a paved street that gets to 20+ degrees steep. Its very narrow with tight steep switchbacks and oncoming traffic. It required 4WD to get up as our rear wheels would just spin. Another route is advised.

Location: Sol de Minca Ecolodge, Vía de Minca, Localidad 1 Cultural Tayrona - San Pedro Alejandrino, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470008, Colombia
Name: Sol de Minca
Description:
Hotel and Hostel near Minca.
A very quiet place with incredible views of Santa Marta, surrounded by nature, very friendly staff, a good option to stay near Minca and enjoy nature.
----
Un lugar muy tranquilo con vistas increíbles a Santa Marta, rodeado de naturaleza, el staff muy amable, una buena opción para quedarse en cerca a Minca y disfrutar de la naturaleza.

Location: La Selva, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056050, Colombia
Name: Cascada Escalera Trailhead.
Description:
You park your car here and hike to tge Cascada. It is safe to park the car.  
Cascadas are 10-15 min uphill hike from here

Location: Calle 54, Andes, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Montana Llantas
Description: Had a new tire burst by a rock on major highway. The tire was too gone. Found a used spare for 50k pesos. Guy is really good.

Location: Carrera 20A, Lo Amador, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: VW KOMBI MECHANICS - VIBE DE DOIS
Description:
A great Kombi mechanic in Cartagena. Marlon is a fair person.

Um otimo mecanico de Kombi em Cartagena. Marlon é uma pessoa justa.

Location: Calle 6 - Calle de La Cruz, Horizontes, Filandia, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 634001, Colombia
Name: Lavan Lavanderia
Description:
24h service. Nice young ladies. 
COP 2.800 per libra.

Location: Calle 2, Pore, Aguadas, Norte, Caldas, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Jose López Sombrero
Description: Jorge makes and gives tour of the hat making process. His hat are half the price you will find at the shop. A really nice guy

Location: Carrera 29, Siete de Agosto, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 111221, Colombia
Name: Talbot Land Rover
Description:
Land Eover specialized mecanic. 

We had our bearings and brakediscs changed. We also noticed a broken bake line and they immediatly organised a new one. 

Fair prices as well.

Totally recommend.

Location: Vía Ocaña - Cúcuta, La Estancia, Abrego, Ábrego, Occidente, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Cold fresh water / centro de medicine ancestral
Description:
Cold, fresh, water on the side of the road. Tap. 

Parking for many rigs. On the site of the centro de medicine natural ancestral

Location: Restaurante y Hospedaje San Jorge, 25, Iles, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Restaurante y Hospedaje DIAL
Description:
Basic rooms. Totally fine. Wifi, cold shower. Bike in room. 30,000 per person per room. Don’t think they had twin rooms so we got separate rooms. Not sure price to share the double bed. Cheap. Tried to go to the one at Terpel up the road. Attendant said you needed a reservation but didn’t explain how to get one and that it was full (was nobody there) so we had to cycle back here. Go to this one. 
Not sure on food but think they sell some snacks in the office like crisps and drinks

Location: Calle 21A, Ciudadela Artesanal, Marinilla, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 054020, Colombia
Name: Taller Mecanico Los Pibes
Description: A mechanic for travelers from Argentina and Chile, for travelers. They know our needs and have great knowledge to solve any problem with our motorhomes, of any size and any brand.

Location: Calle 3, Los Empleados, Salamina, Norte, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Fotocopias Don Hector
Description:
If you need to have anything copied or printed for DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales), this shop can do it for you. You can email or WhatsApp him information. Contact information  photo attached. 
just a block from centeo

Location: Calle 4, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684041, Colombia
Name: LUCIA Caney Restaurante
Description: BEST ITALIAN FOOD HERE! We‘ve been traveling for 1 year now and we were blown away by this cuisine. Loved the vibes and the (fresh hand made) pasta has a good price. Can recommend this 100%!

Location: Calle 16, Santa Cruz de Mompós, Santa Cruz de Mompóx, Depresión Momposina, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 132560, Colombia
Name: Parking, even for tall rigs
Description:
10,000 COP per night. Very lovely lady and her family running. My rig is 2.25m tall / roughly 7 feet 4 inches and the roof is maybe 4-5 feet taller than my rig

Located one block from the river where it’s pedestrian walking only 

Easy access open all day and night. Space for 32 vehicles.

Location: Hospedaje Los Olivos, 8-40, Carrera 10, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154001, Colombia
Name: parqueadero San José
Description:
Closed parking lot with cafeteria, bathrooms and wifi. Alejandra and Christian, the young hosts, are very friendly and know the best mountain bike routes in Villa de Leyva and surroundings. They are experts in preparing a good cup of Colombian coffee and accompany it with delicious empanadas. We stayed 2 weeks in this comfortable place, located just 2 blocks from the main square of the town. Highly recommended !!!
-------------
Parqueadero cerrado con cafeteria, baños y wifi. Alejandra y Christian, los jovenes anfitriones, son muy amables y conocen las mejores rutas de mountain bike en Villa de Leyva y alrededores. Son expertos en la preparacion de una buena tasa de café colombiano y lo acompañan con deliciosas empanadas. Nos quedamos 2 semanas en este comodo lugar. ubicado a solo 2 cuadras de la plaza principal del pueblo. Muy recomendado !!!

Location: Vereda Noboa, Sutatausa, Ubaté, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: La mina alojamiento rural
Description:
It's a great place. You can enjoy a very quiet campsite.  Set up your campsite with a mountain view.  Its owners are very friendly and will guide you on the hikes.

Also you have restaurant in the place. It's very cheap.

You can make a bonfire

Contact: Call and WhatsApp 

+57 3115014507
+57 3107657897

Location: Vía Bocatocino, Piojó, Santa Catalina, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Brisas del mar
Description:
Playa punta astilleros contact José at 3135036425. Ample parking with space for small motorhomes and camping.
