Playa punta astilleros contactar con José al celular 3135036425. Amplio parqueo pero espacio para motorhome pequeño y camping.

Location: Carrera 23C, Palogrande, Comuna Palogrande, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 170002, Colombia
Name: Previous Seguro (SOAT insurance)
Description:
This is the insurance office where you get the SOAT insurance. It is at Mezzanine level. If you stand in front of DIAN office you can see their office sign. 
You will need valid SOAT to get your TIP extended. So get your SOAT extended. For 3 months  extension I paid $464,400 pesos. 
They need to see copy of car title, registeration, passport, driver license, DIAN paper and visa extension paper. They accept cash & credit card.

Location: La Colina, Comuna 9, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520001, Colombia
Name: Hotel Naisca 47
Description: Great value hotel, clean, hot water with high pressure, pet friendly! We paid $60k for two per night + dog. Parking is limited and only for small cars or motorcycles, but you can park in front of the hotel on the street, the neighborhood feels safe, it’s right across from a big police station.

Location: Calle 29, La Bocana, La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 055060, Colombia
Name: Doña Rosa Campestre
Description:
As it was getting dark and we could not make it all the way to medellin we stopped here at the restaurant.

we asked the lady if we can stay here in our car for the night and would eat here of course. 
waitress asked the boss who said immediately that this is totally fine.

we had a good dinner...kids enjoyed the play/climbing house a lot and at night we even jumped into the pool which was really nice and cozy!

Location: Vía Tolu-Cienaga del Frances, Tolú, Morrosquillo, Sucre, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Alegria
Description: Spectacular space to park any type of motorhome or caraban with a private beach.  Ask for Orlando Espinosa who is very kind.  With his family they prepare the best Caribbean meals.  We went for a day and stayed for a week.  Widely recommended.

Location: Primax EDS Via al Mar, Vía al Mar, Puerto Colombia, Atlántico, RAP Caribe, 081007, Colombia
Name: Primax Petrol Station
Description:
Asked for portable water without filling up the petrol. They pointed to one and we filled up water for free.

Looks like an 1-inch socket.

Water is clean.

Location: Palenquera, carrera 1, Carrera 1, Bocagrande, Tierra Bomba, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Morros City
Description:
Excellent apartment complex to wait for your vehicle to be shipped in. Right at the beach (good swimming), view from the balcony (each apartment has one) to the sea. You can see the big container ships pass by in far distance.

Apartments have a kitchen, living room and bed room. Outdoor pool and good gym in the house and free of charge. Very western (American) and like a 5 star hotel.

Good to pack your vehicle after picking it up as you can park it right in front of the lobby. Guarded 24/7 and felt very safe as only apartment holders can get in. You can fill up the water at the parking, not sure about electricity.
Big rigs might have a problem due to length (height is not an issue at all). Parking is free of your stay there.

Good WiFi in both apartments we stayed in for remote working. Good claro signal as well. Free WiFi at pool/gym.

10 Mins drive into old town. But a lot of restaurants and shops around but less annoying people trying to sell you something.

For more pictures use the Google Maps link or search for "Morros City". To book look on the map on Airbnb or Booking. In June plenty apartments were available and it was easy to extend day by day when waiting. Once we had to move to another apartment on another floor.

Location: Carrera 49, Armenia, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130015, Colombia
Name: parqueadero
Description: They kindly allowed us to park and sleep for $10,000 for 24 hours.  It is a closed, safe and quiet place

Location: El Santuario, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 054450, Colombia
Name: Posto Terpel
Description:
Gas station with ample parking for trucks, we talked to the gas station attendant and she said we could stay overnight without any problems. It has water and bathrooms. There is a hotel that sells hot showers for 10 thousand Colombian pesos. And the restaurant has wifi and tables. Good food and price a little higher than other places we went.
---
Posto de Gasolina com amplo estacionamento para caminhões, conversamos com a frentista e ela disse que poderíamos pernoitar sem problemas. Possui água, e banheiros. Tem um hotel que vendem duchas quentes por 10mil pesos colombianos. E no restaurante tem wifi e mesas. Comida boa e preço um pouco mais alto que em outros lugares que fomos.

Location: El Guaico - Colmenas, Guaicogrande, La Ceja, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Wild Camping - Vereda Piedras, La Ceja
Description: Wild Camping near the Piedras river in La Ceja, Antioquía. There are a bunch of spots where you can park your rig and have a wonderful stay.

Location: Nilo, Alto Magdalena, RAP (Especial) Central, 734001, Colombia
Name: Mirador Villa Mercedes
Description:
Ideal hotel to rest, it consists of 8 rooms, some with aircon and balcony, others with aircon without balcony and others with fan and balcony and others with only fan, at an affordable price, you can enjoy the common recreation areas, swimming pool, wifi, food, restaurant service, parking as a reference has capacity for the entry of a Turbo or Dump Truck.
To check availability and prices, please call 3102028480 or make your reservation through the following platforms: Bookin Mirador Villamercedes or Lobby PMS.
.....

Location: Carrera 2, Bocagrande, Tierra Bomba, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Edición Los delfines Laundry oasis
Description: Laundry very clean. Today July 2/2024 Lavanderia super excelente

Location: Calle 64G, Bosque Popular, UPZs Localidad Engativá, Localidad Engativá, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111061, Colombia
Name: FORD TECNIEXPRESS TALLER MECANICO
Description: "General Maintenance Specialized Ford Workshop Ford Revision Ford Revision General Mechanical Suspension Oil Change Scanner Synchronization Engine Verification Belt Change Lubrication General Settings"

Location: Helecho Vegan Sushi, #10-16, Carrera 43C, El Poblado, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050021, Colombia
Name: DF 18 Moto - Self service moto workshop
Description:
This is a place where you can work on your own motorcycle or you can let it he repaired by the mechanics.
They charge 43 USD (per day) for renting a work spot but I negotiated to 30 USD. 
The shop provides you with a hydraulic platform and all the tools. You can also buy engine oil here.

Location: Rio Elemento, Paso del Mango, Finca Bolivar, Minca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470008, Colombia
Name: Rio Elemento Hostal
Description:
We asked if we could park and sleep at the Hostal Parking. It was 60.000 COP a night and very safe and more relaxed than in town.
You can walk in 5 mins to the town center.

For the price we were allowed to refill our water bottles for free and use all amenities. Pool, direct and beautiful river entrance, hammocks, fast wifi, warm showers , toilets...
Every day is another event (e.g. yoga in the morning) and we could participate free of charge.

With a tent you can camp right at the river side which is even nicer.

4x4 or at least a higher clearance required to drive up the last 100 meters. But you can park below, walk up and check yourself.

I can highly recommend it.

Location: Carrera 3, Anserma, Bajo Occidente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Plaza Anserma
Description: We stay one night, safe and quiet. A few steps from the police station

Location: La Asomadera No. 3, Comuna 9 - Buenos Aires, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050020, Colombia
Name: Tunel Oriente no vehicles > 3.4 tons
Description: We wanted to drive from Medellin to Bogota with our 7.5 ton truck. Organic Maps navigated us via Tunel Oriente. However, although the tunel is used by busses, vehicles heavier than 3.4 tons are not allowed. The first time we saw a respective sign was, when we were on the final road leading to the tunel (~50 meters before the tunel). We stopped immediately and a polive guy asked us to park on the right. He then explained that we’re not allowed to drive there and was talking about a multa. We said that we couldn’t see this earlier because of missing signs and therefore had no chance to drive differently. After a couple of minutes of discussion he showed us which road to take and let us go back without paying anything.

Location: Primax, Troncal del Caribe, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 005075, Colombia
Name: water tap at primax
Description: There is a water tap with good water and good pressure and they were willing to give us water. We told them we needed 60 liters and took a "litle bit" more.

Location: Vía Laguna Negra, San José del Guaviare, Guaviare, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: laguna negra boat tours
Description: You can take the boat tours here. It is about 35 min. from San Jose. You may have to coordinate with folks here to get a bird watching tour.

Location: 60, El Santuario, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 054450, Colombia
Name: Parking Restaurant Valle de Maria
Description:
Shortly before the peaje station, there is the restaurant Valle de Maria/La Mayorista with big parking lot. Accessible for all kinds of vehicles. Trucks stop there as well. The restaurant offers a decent Menu Ejecutivo for COP 17.000 (Mondays- Fridays) and desayuno as well (we didn’t try). As it’s close to the main road, there is some traffic noise, but was ok during the night.
Medium Claró 4G signal. Toilets inside restaurant.

Location: Calle 3, Irra, Quinchía, Vertiente Occidental, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: hotel with swimming pool at the river
Description:
It is a small basic hotel, clean. Cold shower. 
It is after the tyres place, there is a small road going down to the right, keep going for few minutes and at the very end there is a restaurant , a swimming pool and a small hotel. We paid 20000 for a double room, if you want to use the swimming pool they say it was 30000. We parked our 2 motorbikes between the pool and the hotel, it felt safe.

Location: Carrera 6, Palomino, Dibulla, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 446009, Colombia
Name: Next to Baruch Hostal
Description: Shop has a variety of anti mosquito sprays which were hard to get at other places

Location: D1, Carrera 7, Palomino, Dibulla, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 446009, Colombia
Name: Shops D1
Description: Biggest supermarket with parking places for small rigs we could find in Palomino.

Location: Carrera 10, Neira, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 171001, Colombia
Name: Hostal Buena Vista
Description: Really nice hostal ! Friendly staff, very clean room and bathroom with hot shower, everything smells fresh and clean (towels and extra blankets). There is a kitchen we can use and a beautiful view over the city and the valley, good WiFi as well. Very close to the city center (main place, restaurants, D1…) for 40.000 for two. We could fit the bike in the room :)

Location: Vía a Punta Orión, Vda. El Retiro, San José del Guaviare, Guaviare, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: finca la esperanza
Description: hike to Labyrinth Angostura. Need a guide or permission to hike. I was with a guide when we came here. it is 5 km hike.

Location: Calle 24, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: allong the Harbour
Description: Perfect place to spend a night. Nice and quite with an amazing view of the skyline. We were here on a Friday night and there was no noise whatsoever. Our rig is to long for the normal parking lots a bit further so this was the better option for us. Police drove by but didn't bother

Location: Miabe, Pauna, Occidente, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154801, Colombia
Name: El Charco
Description: hotel out in the country side. 100000 for a private room with bathroom including breakfast and dinner. has a large pool and a bar.

Location: Carrera 4, Guarinocito, La Dorada, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Guarinocito behind Texaco Station
Description:
Huge parking behind Texaco gas station. A lot of trucks came for the night. There is a guy who organised the parking of the various vehicles and later on collected COP 10,000 from us. 
You can probably use toilets at Texaco (we didn’t check). 
4 bars Claró 4G signal.

Location: Carrera 8, Barrio Obrero, Comuna 9, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760010, Colombia
Name: Electro elementos e ingeniería
Description: Solar panel installers.  I don't have solar, but I charge my lithium batteries from the alternator. I had an issue that I couldn't figure out. These guys spent two full days testing and trying different things, not giving up on the problem and insisting that they wouldn't charge for the help. Only charging if a solution was found and that solution required me buying something. They are amazing people.

Location: Calle 17, Comuna 3 - San Francisco, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 680001, Colombia
Name: land rover parts
Description: I found a small Landrover shop .I needed a fan belt for a 200 TDI and he went to get one for me as he didn't have it in stock, his wife talk's a little English very nice people and very helpful.

Location: Muzo, Occidente, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hotel El Cristal
Description: Decent hotel. I had a private room with my own bathroom and fan for 45000cop a night. secure gated parking for my motorcycle.

Location: Casa de José Rojas (guía), Vía Cerro Azúl, San José del Guaviare, Guaviare, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: finca La Florida
Description: Here you park to get to Cerro Azul. you have to register up the road to enter this reservation. if you are interested in hiking cerro Azul, please contact Anderson at +573136745939. He does not speak English but knows the whole trail.

Location: Camino al Puerto Lucas, Puerto Lucas Ospina, San José del Guaviare, Guaviare, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Puerto lucas
Description: this is the place where you get off the Canoe to get to the Mirador. you have to take a power Canoe from Puerto Lopez to get here. There you have to check in and accompanied by the guide.

Location: BetaXplore, 3-45, Calle 7, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631020, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero Salento Vive
Description: Spacious 24/7 open pit parking for large Motorhomes with toilet service included, no showers. Very quiet and 3 blocks from the main square.

Location: Carrera 41, Necoclí, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057870, Colombia
Name: Afro Hostel
Description:
Comfortable hostel near the port, just a block back from the water. Three of us stayed in a room with a double bed and a bunk for 38,000 per person.
Bathroom was very nice and the kitchen was good too. They have a big back garden where we stored our bikes and rebuilt them after the ferry crossing.

Location: Press Burguer, 12 - 28, Carrera 7, Floresta, Ipiales, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524060, Colombia
Name: Da Vinci cafe
Description:
Great cafe just round the corner from doing SOAT at Olga’s (seperate entry).
Omelette and coffee x2 $5 total….lovely ladies, great service, good coffee.

Location: San José del Guaviare - Villavicencio, Puerto Arturo, San José del Guaviare, Guaviare, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Entre el Llano y La Selva
Description:
Stayed here four nights and sightsee the beautiful sites around this area. Perfect place to see Cerro Azul (paintings) Finca Chuntadoro, take boat to Raudal caves, Caños Sabanas(pink river) and other Pozos. 
A beautiful place that also offers breakfast as part of your stay. Luces is a great host and very helpful with ensuring your stay is wonderful.  Great place to stay. Breakfast arepas with Queso were out of this world. I asked Luces to teach me. Her help Clara was my teacher. Thank you Luces & Clara, my stay memories will always be etched in my mind when I will think about Colombia.

Location: Vía Vélez - Landázuri, Gualilo, Vereda Gualilo, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Highway 62 Bogota - Medellin
Description: Highway 62 has some really bad sections. Very big potholes, dips, bumps, a lot of landslides and unpaved sections sometimes muddy. Plan enough time.

Location: Carrera 8, San Juan Nepomuceno, Montes de María, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Bomberos
Description:
Friendly Bomberos, which let us cyclists stay in an old school room. They only have water from a well, but it’s good enough for a bucket-shower. 
Not suitable for campervans.

Location: El Arenal, Candelaria, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 763577, Colombia
Name: Brio: estacion de servicio
Description:
Petrol station, with ample space, cyclists are very welcome, not much structure but perfect for a safe night.
------------
Posto de gasolina, com amplio espaço ciclistas são muito bem vindos, não tem muita estrutura mas  perfeiro para uma noite segura.

Location: San Antero Cispata Playa Blanca, San Antero, Costanera, Córdoba, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Parking free
Description:
A free parking lot with outdoor games and close to a restaurant. The parking lot is municipal, so there is no cost to stay on site.
--------
Un parqueadero gratuito con juegos al aire libre y cerca a un restaurante. El parqueadero es municipal, por tanto no tiene ningún costo su permanencia en el lugar

Location: Autopista Circunvalar de la Prosperidad, Eduardo Santos - La Playa, Barranquilla, Atlántico, RAP Caribe, 080020, Colombia
Name: Ecoparque Mallorquin
Description: "A perfect stop on the way from Barranquilla to Cartagena! The completely new and huge facility offers beautiful wooden walkways through mangroves and along the sea. Signs in English, free toilets and parking make the visit pleasant. Entry is even free, with various entrances and routes to choose from (see photos). It could be quite busy on weekends. Much of the trail is in the sun, so it is advisable to bring a hat and water. We visited during low tide and were able to spot a turtle, water birds and millions of crabs. A truly fascinating experience in nature!"

Location: 23VL07, Bolívar, Norte, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Next to Embalse Sara Brut
Description:
This spot has a nice view, clean air and cow dung.
End of a narrow dirt road, normally not used by cars, narrow in the end, not easy to turn around. Actually, technically the road doesn't end here, but there is a fence across the track. The road is not an Google maps, just turn left at the first opportunity after the Embalse, coming from Roldanillo. Camping WITH A TENT etc seems prohibited, but parking appears allowed. There is a hill to climb in the end, low gears recommended for safety, although 1st gear should be possible as well.
No cell reception at all, no amenities. More like parking on the side of an unused road.

Location: Carrera 6, San Juan del Cesar, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 444030, Colombia
Name: Hotel Provincia Plaza
Description:
The only decent accomodation we have found in this city. Clean, modern rooms with AC with not super comfortable beds and a cold shower.
Price is usually 170.000 COP per night which includes a tiny breakfast but thanks to booking.com we got it for 123.000 COP. 
Secure parking is included and located around the block.

Location: Carrera 1, Dibulla, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Banco de Bogota ATM
Description: ATM in Dibulla. If you need cash come here. There are no ops to chance or get cash in the area. Big white building end of road.

Location: Vereda Guásimo, Angostura, Norte, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Quiet spot
Description:
Area next to a gravel road, about 500m from the highway. Quiet place, only a few workers in the morning going to work on the surrounding farms. No internet signal. Small stream below, we slept very well. It was 16° in July. Perfect.
----
Área ao lado de uma estrada de pedras, a uns 500m da rodovia. Lugar tranquilo, somente alguns trabalhadores pela manhã indo trabalhar nas fazendas ao redor. Sem sinal de Internet. Pequeno riacho mais abaixo, dormimos super bem. No local estava 16° no mês de Julho. Perfeito.

Location: El Guineo, Villagarzón, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, 861080, Colombia
Name: Donde se oculta el sol
Description: It's a natural reserve where there is monkey and the amazonia. You can enjoy cold shower, bathroom and natural pool. It's a paradise here. 20k/pp

Location: Mr. Bross, Avenida Calle 116, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Usaquén, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 110111, Colombia
Name: Parking next to Laundry
Description: You can park your car here while you do the laundry. It is ~6k per hour. Door is little narrow for big rigs. They have a Banos here too.

Location: Hotel Pedregal Getsemani, 26A-124, Calle Lomba, Getsemaní, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Copies, email prints, phone plans
Description: This shop sells phone sims, photocopies, and print from email. 1500COP for 6 pages.

Location: Ministerio del Trabajo, TransCaribe, La Matuna, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 472000, Colombia
Name: Seventh Notaria of Cartagena
Description:
Notary for port paperwork. ~8500COP for authentication. 

Bring the pages printed out and your passport. 
They appear to have a photocopier, not sure if you can use it.

Location: Street art, Avenida del Pedregal, Getsemaní, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 472000, Colombia
Name: Shop. Garrafones (20L jugs)
Description:
24000 COP if you don’t have a bottle, 14000COP to refill if you do. You can return the bottles for a deposit. 

Cash only.

Location: Antigua Vía al Mar, Las Brisas, San Jerónimo, Occidente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 051070, Colombia
Name: segunda casa ciclista medellín Manuel
Description:
Translation: Manuel's house is very comfortable and pleasant to stay at. Manuel's cyclist's house in Medellin is a place recommended by Bivico. Manuel has two houses. I recommend that you call him a day in advance so that he can make his space available for you. Very nice people who accept all travelers. 3127907507

casa de Manuel muy cómoda y agradable estadía , Manuel casa de ciclista medellín es un lugar recomendado por bivico Manuel tiene dos casas  te recomiendo que lo llames un día antes para que te habilite su espacio muy buena gente acepta a todo viajero 3127907507

Location: Calle 134A, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Usaquén, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 110121, Colombia
Name: 24/7 urgent care Movet
Description:
Open 24/7. Pink building. You cannot miss it. This is the vet to come if you have an emergency. They have ultrasound, imaging, and a hospital for surgical procedures and the space to keep animals overnight if they medically require it.
Tons of excellent food and treat options to stock up on and an on site pharmacy if you need medications. 
Highly highly highly recommend.  Decent amount of English

Location: Carrera 9A W, Comuna 1, Montería, Córdoba, RAP Caribe, 230004, Colombia
Name: parking Olimpica
Description:
Translation: This place is a parking lot of a 24-hour Olympic supermarket located in a quiet neighborhood. There are fast food restaurants and a gym nearby.

Este lugar es un parqueadero de un supermercado Olímpica el cual está abierto 24 horas ubicado en un barrio calmado. Hay cerca comidas rápidas y un gimnasio.

Location: Carrera 10, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684041, Colombia
Name: Elvia
Description:
One of the best restaurants we’ve been to period. The concept is based on local ingredients and inspired by Grandma Elvia. The food is definitely haute cusine and worth a visit. Plus (for EU standards) it is very affordable, about €15 for a main dish. I would reccommend sharing all dishes with your table! 

Enjoy!

Location: Claustro San Francisco, 7-92, Calle 10, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154001, Colombia
Name: public library
Description: There is a computer room you can use for free. Fine wifi too. they are open from Monday to Friday in the morning until 12.30 and from 2-5 pm

Location: Calle 2, Vereda Montecillo, Guatavita, Guavio, RAP (Especial) Central, 251060, Colombia
Name: Colectivo to Guatavita
Description: This is the station were colectivo goes to Laguna de Guatavita. The RT cost is 20k pesos. It leaves in the morning , 11:00 am and 1:00 pm. You will need to check out exact times at the station. The collectivo waits while you take the tour and brings you back. On the way back ask the driver to drop me off at the Marina as I was overlanding there.

Location: Sesquilé, Almeidas, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Laguna Guatavita pickup point
Description: If you hike the Guatavita with a guide, your colectivo will pick you up here. They have ample parking and a restaurant to chill out. You may be able to camp out here for the night too.

Location: Vía Ebanal - Arroyo Arena, Don Vicente, Comojenes, Riohacha, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Queso from local family
Description: Here you can buy queso... chese...from a local family. There is a sign on the left side of the road coming from the coast. Taste wonderful. We bought 500 g for 8000 Cop.

Location: Calle 15, Hato Nuevo, Hatonuevo, Hato Nuevo, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Place to eat
Description: Good place to eat menue del dia. Very tasty, clean and recommended. We stopped here on our way down south.

Location: Barrio Monte Blanco, Remedios, Nordeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 052810, Colombia
Name: Hotel Remedios Real
Description:
New hotel behind the petrol station and next to D1 supermarket. 

The room and bathroom were clean, nice shower pressure and a comfy bed. We paid $80,000 total for three people for a room with two double beds. No aircon but a good fan and it’s definitely much cooler up here.

They put our bikes in the garage downstairs and said they are safe because the petrol station guards are there all night.

Location: Residencias Suya, Calle 19, Yalí, Nordeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Hotel Suya
Description:
Nice hotel just off the main square in Yali. A beautiful little village with a nice church on top of the hill.
Here we got a room with a double bed and a single bed for $45,000 for two people. We brought our bikes upstairs. Amazing views from the hotel, and a plus is the shared balcony overlooking the square to cook on. 

There is another hotel lower down the hill for a bit cheaper but it’s nearer the ‘red light’ bars. Also another hotel opposite this one. Worth a visit to this place!

Location: Tibasosa, Sugamuxi, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Mirador Bella vista.
Description:
Lookout point 30 min. hike from town. You get great views of Tibososa and Duitama. 

It is just a shed and bench by the roadside.

Location: Reculada del Ovejo, San Diego, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 472000, Colombia
Name: Secure set of ATMs in fancy mall
Description:
ATMs are on the bottom floor of the mall. Seems like a really safe place to withdraw cash.

Davivienda
Servibanca
Scotia
Colombia 
And more

Location: Milano, cra 3 # 43-80, Avenida Soledad Román, Marbella, El Cabrero, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 472000, Colombia
Name: Dentist Dr. Fanny Valera
Description:
Good place for a dental cleaning while waiting for your rig.
The doctor speaks Spanish and English and all the staff is very nice.
Reserve online, pay cash or by card (290 000 COP pp)

Location: Montenegro, Valle, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 633001, Colombia
Name: Hotel Hacienda el Percal
Description: A beautiful and very quiet hotel, super-friendly and open to home car visits. They lend you a one-room bathroom and give you towels. for us that was a wonderful detail, in the hotel there is a restaurant, swimming pool and a great place to park your camper. Also, if you prefer, you can take advantage and rest in one of its rooms. They are very clean and comfortable.

Location: Calle 13, Bosconia, Cesar, RAP Caribe, 201020, Colombia
Name: Olympia store
Description: Big Olympia Store with ATMs inside on the main street of town. Here you can buy everything you need.

Location: Herveo, Villamaría, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: glamping león dormido
Description:
Parking at the León Dormido glamping on the side of the road...30 thousand per night for a car, no bathrooms, no electricity in the parking lot, but there is electricity in the restaurant which is 100 meters up the mountain, very windy, temperature of -2... but the view is worth it, it is backed by the snow.
----------
parqueadero en el glamping león dormido a borde de carretera..30 mil noche de carro no baños no electricidad en el parqueadero pero si en el restaurante q es a 100 mts subiendo la montaña mucho viento temperatura de -2.. pero la vista lo vale ya queda al respaldo de la nieve  ...

Location: Panamericana, Sotará, Timbío, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 190003, Colombia
Name: Texaco gas station
Description: Brand new gas station with free shower if you refill gas. If not it’s supposed to be 5000p

Location: Carrera 3A, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 005075, Colombia
Name: Terrazas Tayrona
Description: Water tap in front of the building. I went inside to ask if I could take water for our tank and the lady behind the desk said no problemo. Super clear water and super high pressure

Location: 62, La Floresta-Maceo, Maceo, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Zeus Gas Station
Description:
We slept here one night, as we were too tired to drive to Medellin. 
we asked the guys at the gas station, if we could stay here. Very friendly staff, 24h service at the station.
Flat parking space, not too nice, toilets available.

Location: Valledupar, Cesar, RAP Caribe, 200001, Colombia
Name: El Campestre Restaurant & Bar
Description:
We were searching for a safe and fenced parking and contacted these guys via WhatsApp. It was the best we could do.

Great couple running this place. It is called a Restaurant but it has a pool, huge grounds, chairs and table, a river access, ...
People usually stay here during the day (restaurant is not open during the evening).

We went there, they opened the 3 m high gate for us and we were driving 500 m to the parking spot. As it was already evening and we asked whether the restaurant was open, they said no. 30 mins later we got some fresh empanadas and a juice. All for free. Gave us WiFi access.

We had breakfast in their restaurant the next morning and for everything including the food they wanted 50 k but we gave them 70 k.

WhatsApp 300 3107041

They have never done it before so did not know a price to ask for. Please be nice and do not rip them off, very friendly people.

Quiet night, at 8 am they open and some people come to spend the day there. Highly recommended!

Location: Calle 19B, Comuna 1, Perímetro Urbano Valledupar, Valledupar, Cesar, RAP Caribe, 200001, Colombia
Name: Energiteca Valledupar
Description:
We needed a new battery for our Toyota Landcruiser. As we have a small Optima Battery in Place, we wanted to replace it 1:1 and finally found Energiteca on the Internet.

You can WhatsApp with the Colombia Chat Bot +573204938265 and they will connect you to an agent who can tell you whether the battery is in stock. We did not do an appointment with him, just drove by.
Mechanic changed the battery immediately without time for wating. Great service!

Our rig was to high to fit into the garage but he changed all of it on the street (not a busy street).

We saw them also change some Hankook tires.

We got a discount as they could keep our old battery (200.000 COP).

Location: Panamericana, Comuna 5, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520003, Colombia
Name: Del Vamos mas lejos
Description:
Mechanic for car, van , truck and big rig

Here, I make the change of the front discs of braking. But it is possible to make also alignment of the front wheels changing of oil etc …

Location: perfect view of rock and lake, Vía El Peñol - Guatapé, Guatapé, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053854, Colombia
Name: Piedra View Point
Description:
You will see the lake and the piedra in background. Worth a stop.
You can park your rig at the pullout, the walk is about 2min.

Location: VIA DE ACCESO AL MUNICIPIO, Finca El Mango, Confines, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Grassy spot next to the road
Description:
Flat grassy spot on the side of the road.
It’s located right behind a gas station and a hotel
It’s quiet at night.
No amenities, good for 1 night.
There’s water at the gas station just near by (non-potable)

Location: Maracaibo, Vista Hermosa, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: river pass Maracaibo
Description: you need 4x4 for cross the river from vista hermosa to Maracaibo

Location: Caramanta, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Above the Road
Description: There is a small dirt road with no gate here. It leads to a flat spot above the road and ends. A tent can be hidden around the corner, even a small van. I talked to the woman in the house across the road. She was fine with it and gave me water. Other people generally agreed that this road is safe.

Location: 36-45, Calle Segunda de Badillo, San Diego, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 472000, Colombia
Name: Laboratorio Clinico Eduardo Fernandez
Description:
Various tests possible here (we did a hemogram). 
No reservation needed (mo-fri 7-10am, sa 8-9:30 am). 
Quick results, kind staff. 
No English spoken when we were there.

Location: A Salto Candelas, Pajarito, La Libertad, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: La candela waterfall split
Description: This is the location where the trail goes another 200m uphill to the falls. All uphill.

Location: Avenida La Salle, Pensilvania, Alto Oriente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Hotel Edén Campestre
Description: Good family-run hotel with good breakfast and an even better staff. We were welcomed like family also we showed up without reservation early afternoon. Margot even managed to prepare an excellent lunch also the restaurant was closed during the week and we were too tired to walk into town. Average Claro Signal and decent wifi. Secure parking. Stunning surroundings. 15 min walk to main square with restaurants and shops. Trekking area. 150k for a double room.

Location: Vía Moniquirá - Villa de Leyva, Santa Sofía, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154240, Colombia
Name: place to spend the night.
Description: We stopped here for the night.  You need to turn left from the cafe and drive towards a private house.    The driveway is wide and level, and you can stop here for the night.  The owners of the house may come up to you and chat, nice people.

Location: Moñitos, Costanera, Córdoba, RAP Caribe, 231001, Colombia
Name: Pedacito del cielo
Description: Hostal and camping in front of the beach. We were looking for a place to camp and Suzanna welcomed us very warmly. We’ve put the tent on her terraza and she put a fan for us for the night. We could use shower and toilets, sink to wash clothes and hammock on the terazza. She offered us water and coffee on the morning. Lots of animals. The beach is at the end of the Camino. Muy amable and tranquilo. Suzana : 311 398 8186

Location: Carrera 11, El Modelo, Comuna 1, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 190003, Colombia
Name: Servicentro AC. Parqueadero y lavadero
Description:
Spacious parking for small and large motorhomes. You can't sleep in the car, but one block away are 2 hotels with all amenities for COP$80,000 a night per couple ($20). The historic centre is a 10-minute walk away. There is the office of the Chamber of Commerce where the tourist information office is located.

Estacionamiento amplio pastas pequeños y grandes carrocasas. No se puede dormir en el auto, pero a una cuadra hay 2 hoteles con todas las comodidades por COP$ 80.000 la noche por pareja (US$ 20). El centro histórico queda a 10 min caminando.  Allí se encuentra la oficina de la Cámara de Comercio en donde está la oficina de información turística.

Location: Balcones de Segovia, 26-19, Calle 26, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: ECOS Escuela de Español, Inglès y Salsa
Description:
We learnt Spanish here for a week. Great atmosphere, good organisation! We had a lot of fun.
They also offer salsa classes. 
Highly recommended

Location: Calle 30, Caucasia, Bajo Cauca, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 052410, Colombia
Name: Hotel Tania
Description:
75,000 COP (cash only) per night for a 2 person room with AC

59mbps download and 36mbps upload on Claro 

49mbps download and 37mbps upload on WiFi in our room

Friendly employees here and was plenty of availability when we stopped. They have secure parking which is a garage on the bottom floor of the hotel. Our rig is 2.2m tall and the opening was tall enough for us but it was close. They let us try parking before we paid which was great! The price they quoted us was actually better than the total price we'd seen on booking.com.

Location: LOS TOCAYOS, 5, Calle 5, Vado Real, Suaita, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 683049, Colombia
Name: Hotel finca las orquídeas
Description:
Very nice place in vado real Santander Colombia to relax and spend time admiring the orchids and enjoying a natural pool and very soon lodging.
---
Muy bonito lugar  en vado real Santander Colombia pará relajarte y pasar El rato admirando las orquídeas y disfrutando dé una piscina natural y muy pronto hospedaje

Location: Vía Mediacanoa - Buga, Yotoco, Centro, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Terpel shower
Description:
We found free shower in the station.
.....
Excelentes duchas, limpias y, aunque no tienen agua caliente, el calor ayuda a que no sea duro bañarse allí.
Recomiendo

Location: Yopal, Casanare, RAP Llanos, 850001, Colombia
Name: Mirador La Cumbre
Description: This is a Mirador where you can get great views of Yopal. A great restaurant to enjoy views and see the town.

Location: Vía Santa Marta - Riohacha, Vda. Los Naranjos, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Los Mechones
Description:
Family resturant with maple parking for all type rigs. Big rigs slso. Beside the road and bit noise during the day. Food was excellent at the restaurant. There are rooms available and 2 trucks parked also but engines off. Dirt/gravel lot with plently flat space. Bathrooms
 at restaurant but ask permission first.

Location: Yopal, Casanare, RAP Llanos, 850001, Colombia
Name: Museo de Piedra
Description: Stone Museum. The fee is $5000 pesos. You can walk through it in 10 min.

Location: Vía Santa Helena, Flandes, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Don’t try to avoid toll
Description: Don’t try to avoid the toll, the road is just impossible to take with a car, even with a moto we don’t recommend it. Just pay the toll

Location: Comuna 7 - Juan Nepomuceno Moreno, Yopal, Casanare, RAP Llanos, 850001, Colombia
Name: Restaurant Palo Alto
Description:
There were not many wild camping sites in Yopal to park. Iguana Park was not rec. by locals. So the first night as I got here late,  I parked at hotels Saman Del Rio. They were charging 50,000 pesos per night,  seemed little high for just parking so after parking the first night the next morning I went across to the police headquarter and inquired about the possible safe places to park for overnight. After checking out couple of places this was the place that they recommended to me and they brought me here. I was able to park for two nights free of charge. The host was really great very welcoming ther is water and bathroom access that you can utilize at night. they're open until 10:00-10:30 and sometimes there may be a birthday party but it's not too bad really. Great place to stay.   before travelling  to San Luis Palenque for Llanero Safari.
just keep in mind at night time they will close the gate to the restaurant so you may not be able to get out until like 9:00 in the morning. Lewis works here and he arrives in the morning so you can ask him to open the door for you if you have to leave early

Location: Clínica Psiquiátrica San Juan de Dios, Calle 72, Sancancio, Comuna Palogrande, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 170004, Colombia
Name: Morro Sancancio
Description:
We stayed here one night, as there are no other places in Manizales. Sadly the road is not good enough to go all the way up. We slept in the turn on the right side.
Very calm, no services. Good Claro reception.
We drove up here with our 2WD van. No big rigs! 4WD  or good driving skills.

Location: Carrera 8, Guillermo León Valencia, Filandia, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 634001, Colombia
Name: La Palma Coffee Tour
Description: A small family owned coffee farm. The tour is very autentic and the tourguide Julian is the owner himself. He showed us the prozess of the coffee making, from the growing of the plants till the finished coffee and diffrent ways to cook coffee. We could try 6 cups of the very tasty coffee and we learned a lot of interesting facts about it. It costs 90 000 cop p/P including the transport from town to his Finca. We can recommend this tour.

Location: Carrera 6, Malecón, San Luis de Palenque, Casanare, RAP Llanos, 853030, Colombia
Name: Palenque Main Park
Description:
I had to go to Guanapalo safari the next day at 9:00 am. Decide to sightsee this sleepy town and chill here for the night. Spent the Sunday evening here. A nice tranquil and peaceful town. Set up my RTT at night and went to sleep. 

Police on bike swing by couple of time at night. No problem here. Also, checked out other wildcamp pin in town by River, spent afternoon there and came out here to campout for the night. 

Do not park by church on Sunday eve. as it gets busy. Also, check out restaurant El Patrona. They had culture Llanera music show on Sunday night. I am not sure if it's every Sunday or it was just this Sunday only.

Also, right across the church door in the Central Park there's a water faucet which you can use to fill up the water

Location: Carrera 5, Tena, Tequendama, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: grassy area in front of the church
Description: This is a big grassy area with shades, I spent one night here and felt completely safe. just some cars and motorbikes passing along the road in the morning. No amenities.

Location: Petrobras, Autopista Bucaramanga-Girón, Girón, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 687541, Colombia
Name: MB Sprinter Service. Estacion de Servicio Insercol
Description:
This workshop was recommended to us and it turned out to be simply divine.  one of the few workshops in South America that treats its work so professionally.  We repaired our Mercedes Sprinter in less than 2 hours and changed all shock absorbers, brake pads, air filters, etc.  Highly recommend!By the way, we bought oil filters and original 5W-30 oil at a reasonable price.


Нам посоветовали эту мастерскую и она оказалась просто божественной. одна из немногих мастерских в южных Америке которая Так профессионально относится к своей работе. отремонтировали наш Mercedes Sprinter менее чем за 2 часа поменяли все амортизаторы, тормозная колодки, воздушные фильтры и т.д. Очень рекомендую!

Кстати, купили с собой масляные фильтры и оригинальное масло 5W-30 по адекватной цене.

Location: Hato Altamira, Km. 9, El Encanto de Guanapalo, San Luis de Palenque, Casanare, RAP Llanos, 853039, Colombia
Name: Hato Altamira
Description:
This is one of the Hotels where you stay if you have paid for the El Encanto de Guanapalo safari. Here are the directions from the main road to get here that were shared with me:

When you arrive at the nature reserve by the main road, you will find a closed blue gate. The gate is unlocked, open and drive through it. Hato Altamira where you will be staying is 8.8 km from this gate. 

Follow the dirt road, *km. 1* Blue gate, follow and turn left.

• *km. 2 * Orange gate, open and go through it. This is access to the nature reserve. 

• *km. 3* Palm plantation collection center, continue straight on the left path •

*km. 3.5* Bridge of tubes, keep following the path.

 *km. 6.5* Detour to the Mata de Palma, Altamira and Montana Hatos continue to the left to the Altamira Hato.

• *km. 7.5* Hato Altamira access gate, enter. 

• *km. 8.8* Right entrance and arrival at Hato Altamira.

At times you will feel you may be lost but if you follow road tracks, you should be good to go.

Location: Camino a Ciudad Perdida, La Aguacatera, Guachaca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Juan Quesos
Description:
Wonderful artisanal cheese shop.
The owner Juan is a passionate cheese producer. He can give you little tours of his shop and explain the cheese making proces.

He sells a huge selection of all kinds of delicious cheeses. Including difficult to find cheeses in this part of the world. Not limited too: Brie, Gorgonzola, Feta and many more older and extremely ripend variations.

Visiting the shop is an amazing experience. The owner can talk passionate about his products and lets you sample everything. His prices are extremely affordable.

Location: 37, Inzá, Oriente, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: FARC Activities, too Dangerous
Description: MODERATOR NOTE: If you pass here and the road is open please let us know.. June 2025: extortion attempts between popoyan and Inza Bridge was closed on 23/07/2024 afternoon due to bomb alert. Went to check to the transport terminal of la Plata on 24/07/2024 morning to see if the bomb alert was cleared but unfortunately the bomb is still on the bridge. If you want to access to Tierradentro you will need to come from Popayan or ask the police/transport terminal of la Plata about the situation

Location: 6-15, Carrera 7, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684041, Colombia
Name: Cogar Factory
Description: Here you can see how they produce columbian cigars. Very nice people. You can also take a tour to roll your own cigar. In the yard there is a nice bar/ cafe where you can smoke and drink coffee or rum. Beautiful place.

Location: Puerto Berrío, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Terpel station, margaritas
Description: big gas station, the worker showed us a spot were we were our tent with the condition of leaving early as it was not allowed officially. it has a store and bathroom. if you prefer there is a hotel also but we didn't check the rooms. the site was very very warm that night and it was uncomfortable because of it.

Location: 62, Santo Domingo, Nordeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: motorcycle shop on the road
Description: we were eating at the little store next to the gas station and asked the guy there about a place to set our tent, he offered this space for the night and also offered us to use the bathroom from the store if it was necessary.

Location: San Luis de Palenque, Casanare, RAP Llanos, 853030, Colombia
Name: Hato El Diamante
Description:
A great Hato where you will be welcomed by Edward(architect  by trade) and his beautiful wife at the Hato. Ample parking space to park your rig and enjoy the Hato. 
The Hato has a Sandero where you you can watch nature and head to the River. A nice and tranquil place to campout.
I had taken the Llanero Safari to Hato Guanapalo. I had met Edward there and he invited me to his Hato. I gladly accepted his offer. He did not even charged me to stay at his Hato for the night. On top of that he took me out to his family restaurant La Patrona for dinner. At the restaurant every Sunday there is a Llanero culture music show. 
Met a stranger and became a lifelong friend. A must stop in Palenque if you want to know what Colombia is all about. 
He has starlink fast wifi on property too.

Location: Terpel, Troncal del Magdalena Medio, Barrancabermeja, Yariguíes, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: TERPEL
Description:
Ample parking at Terpel service station next to the route. 
The staff was super friendly and immediately told us where we could park. We did it right at the entrance of the restaurant (there was a European motorhome too) 

There are free showers in both men's and women's bathrooms, the water is only cold but with the heat in the area it is very good to cool off! 

The restaurant is open until 10 p.m. and the fuel filling station also closes at that time. 

There are watchmen taking care of the place and that gives you peace of mind. We spent only one night and it was quite good to rest! 

They gave us the rest's wifi key without any problem.---
Amplio estacionamiento en estación de servicio Terpel al lado de la ruta.
El personal fue súper amable y enseguida nos indicaron donde podiamos estacionarnos. 
Nosotros lo hicimos justo en la entrada del restaurante (había un motorhome europeo también)

Hay duchas gratis tanto en baños de hombres como mujeres, el agua es solo fria pero con el calor que hace en la zona viene muy bien para refrescarse!

El restaurante está abierto hasta las 22 hs y la estación de carga de combustible cierra también a esa hora.
Hay serenos cuidando el lugar y eso te da una tranquilidad.
Nosotros pasamos solo una noche y fue bastante buena para descansar!

Nos brindaron la clave wifi del restó sin ningún problema.

Location: San Ramón, A La Viga, reversadero, Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 661020, Colombia
Name: Hostal San Ramon
Description:
A nice place located on the road to Termales Santa Rosa de Cabal. Good rooms with private bathroom, wifi and parking. The rooms costs $ COP 90k in 2024 and includes parking and a delicious breakfast for 2 people.

There is camping zone available and enough space for medium size caravans. 

Very kindly attention by its owners. Highly recommended.

Location: Transversal 7, Old road residential club, Comuna 2, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 190001, Colombia
Name: Don Fierro
Description:
Andrés is the owner of this hotel which offers individual but also shared rooms and parking for travelers in a van. there is a bar and a restaurant which offers good cocktails and local coffee as well as food. decent wifi, hot showers and toilets available, as well as the swimming pool and relaxation areas located in this nature reserve in the center of the city. real impression of being in the heart of nature, and the colonial house has a crazy charm, possibility of observing many species of birds right inside the park!  25,000 COP per person per night (free for children under 8 years old) for vans. possibility of connecting to 110v and soon to 220v.
+573183264173

Location: Carrera 30A, Nacional, Honda, Norte, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, 732040, Colombia
Name: Rincón Natural
Description:
A large place to camp, both in a vehicle and in a tent. You have access to a bathroom and a kitchen. There is also internet. 
Cost per person COP $10,000. It is located in Honda, Tolima; perfect stop between Bogota and Medellin.
Contact: +57 313 685 2174
.....
Un lugar amplio para acampar, tanto en vehículo como en carpa. Tienen acceso al baño y la cocina. También hay internet. Costo por persona $10.000.  Está ubicado entre Bogotá y Medellín. 
Contacto: +57 313 685 2174

Location: La Argentina, Villavicencio, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, 500007, Colombia
Name: Bosque Bavaria Mirador
Description:
The Bosque Bavaria road continues past this Mirador. There was a hut with some chairs. With no end in sight, I turned around. Beautiful views. Definitely need a 4x4.
You can definitely spend a day here enjoying the views.
Alfonso owns the place I found out the next morning. He allows camper to stay overnight. He can be contacted at +57 3103296116.

Location: Vía A Restrepo, Villavicencio, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, 500010, Colombia
Name: Street parking near Tropical Truck
Description:
I stopped at this tienda and asked the owner about a nice place to wildcamp in town. He immediately said, why don't you park across the street in the driveway, I will sleep in my hammock by my tienda. I was concerned about night traffic, but after 830 it gets really quiet. Stayed 2 nights. No problems at all. 
Just had coffee and empanada at his tienda next morning. A gem of a person.

Location: Vía Vereda el Carmen, Mesetas, Comuna 2, Villavicencio, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, 500005, Colombia
Name: Verada El Carmen hike parking
Description: You can park the car here to hike the Sandero. On weekend there is an attendant here who keeps an eye on car.

Location: Vía Vereda el Carmen, Villavicencio, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, 500001, Colombia
Name: Mirador Verada El Carmen
Description:
This is Mirador Verada El Carmen. You can continue hike up to Buena Vista. From parking lot pin that I put in to here was 1 hour coming up. 
Map attached if you want to continue hiking up. 
From here to Buena Vista it is half hour up and then another hour down to Buena Vista.

Location: Vía A Restrepo, Villavicencio, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, 500010, Colombia

You can park the car by big tree on the left or entrance and can walk

Location: 25, La Bocana, La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 055060, Colombia
Name: Mirador del Cauca Restaurant.
Description:
We have requested the restaurant Mirador del Cauca to stay on the parking for the night, the boss said yes, we paid anything. But we bought something for the dinner because there is a « panaderia » and also a restaurant.

There is also a free WiFi via a QR code.

Location: Mina, Guachetá, Ubaté, RAP (Especial) Central, 250610, Colombia
Name: El Pino Glamping / Camping / Overland
Description: Beautiful place to visit surrounded by mountains, trees and more important nice people. They have Glampings, restaurand and its posible to do camping and Overland. Many things to do, horses, Quadbikes etc. Easy Access

Location: Hotel Tayrona, 3-103, Calle 5, Puerto Araujo, Cimitarra, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel Tayrona
Description:
Nice little hotel. Secure parking for
Motorbikes. Would also have parking for overland van, etc. Small rooms. Restaurants nearby with decent food and very cheap. 70,000 COP.

Location: Calle 49, Hispania, Cabecera Municipal Hispania, Hispania, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Fami Hotel
Description:
Small hotel just on the corner by the park.

We got a room overlooking the park for two people for $60,000 in total. Private room with fan. It actually had one double bed and two sets of bunk beds. 

There’s a small kitchen area (with no appliances) where we used our stove to cook our meals. The town is beautiful and well worth a visit. 

They let us bring our bikes inside but you have to carry them up one flight of stairs.

Location: Acacías, Piedemonte, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Meraki Eco Turismo
Description:
This is the trailhead to four Cascadas that you can hike tom . The biggest Cascada is  San Miguel. There is a restaurant, duchas, huge parking lot for overnight stay here. It may be an issue for RV and large vehicle to make it here due to narrow road and overgrowth. 

It will take 1.5 hours to hike all the Cascadas. San Miguel is the largest and the first. To get to this one's as you get to the bottom from trailhead to the shack, make a right and go all the way down. To go to Cascadas 2, 3 & 4 you have to come up back to the shack and hike to Cascadas 2, 3 & 4. You can swim around all the cascadas. 
The entrance fee is $20k pesos. If you stay overnight they charge $5k for the parking. Fast wifi is fast and available 24/7.

Location: Acacías, Piedemonte, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: pozos La Chorrera
Description: These are the pools to enjoy during your visits. They are closed on Mondays and Tuesday

Location: Vía a Cubarral El Castillo, Brisas del Ariari, Puerto Ariari, Cubarral, Piedemonte, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, 506001, Colombia
Name: travesía Aventura rafting
Description: This outfit handles rafting in Rio Ariari. Weekend no problem getting on a rafting tour. On weekdays you better coordinate. You need min 2 people to go for rafting on the  boat. Cost is $90k pesos. they are good about communicating via WhatsApp. Phone number and contact info provided.

Location: Las Cascada, Las Palomas, Cubarral, Piedemonte, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Cascada Esmeralda End
Description: This is the end of the trailhead where you see the waterfall. Except at the beginning the trail is well defined. A local guy helped me get on the trail.

Location: Las Cascada, Las Palomas, Cubarral, Piedemonte, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: cascada Esmeralda trailhead
Description: This is where the trail starts You may have to cross some fences to get here but once you get here just follow the path and it will take you straight up to the end of the trail where the cascada is

Location: Vía Guamal - San Martin - Guamal, San Martín, El Gaucho, San Martín, Piedemonte, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

So decided to came back here and asked the gas attendant if I can sleep overnight. She had no problem with that. In the back of the gas station there's a parking area where trucks park so parked my car and called it a day. 
Later in the evening quite a few local delivery trucks came and parked by. It was quite through the night.

Location: El Rosario, La Cordillera, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: La Bocana
Description:
Camp site with all services: shower, restaurant, electricity and a small shop. 20'000 pesos

Swimming pool for 8000 pesos per person. It’s deserve it.

Quiet and very comfortable place recommended by locals. 

Perfect place to relax, barbecue and spend the day at the pool.

4 km of dirth small road with some steep parts but double for all vehicles.

Claro 4G.

Location: Guachaca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Puerto Nuevo
Description:
Jesus can be found in a little groceries store im the back street of the main road. Its a blue house. He runs the shop with his wife.

My car broke down overheating.
Gasket seal, fan and radiator were not working properly. Jesus basically overhauled my engine, cleaned the insides and replaced the bad parts and also put a new timing belt in. He is a great mechanic with a lot of experience. Highly recommend it. He doesnt have a garage shop, Only work on projects when it comes along. Find him in Puerto Nuevo or call +57 314 7925648

Location: Calle 15, Bocagrande, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Lavanderos laundry
Description: Washing machine 35 mins and dryer 45 mins, price include both and you can have it for the same day (it’s better to go early in the morning). They have wi-fi and sitting area to wait while you’re doing the laundry. The clothes were clean and smell good. Nice workers. I add a picture of the self-service prices

Location: Carrera 29, Zona Refrescante, Floridablanca, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 681004, Colombia
Name: Parking for high vehicles

Location: Mesetas, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Cabañas rent for $120k pesos per night. 
please contact William +57 3108058133. He also owns Cascadas property and they can coordinate with him. If you need cascada hike You can coordinate with him. It is $250k per person and includes transportation and lunch to Cascadas.

Location: Normal Superior de Pamplona, Calle 15, Pamplona, Suroccidente, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia

Excellent place to spend the day and night. The access to the river is very close. Much quieter than the stadium where activities start very early. During the day people come to walk their dogs but at night it is very quiet.

excelente lugar para pasar el día y la noche. muy cerca está el acceso al río. mucho más tranquilo que el estadio donde comienzan las actividades muy temprano. de día vienen a pasear perros pero de noche es muy tranquilo .

Location: Calle 3, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684041, Colombia
Name: Claro Shop

They recommended not parking on the side of the square in front of the police station because it has the most traffic. 

Lots of friendly locals also welcomed us to town and were curious to hear more about Canada

4G cell service

Location: Vda. El Piñal, Mesetas, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Description:
you can stay here for overnight they do have a restaurant and also they have cold showers and and baños. Jasmine and her two boys are really friendly people. you can stay free or you can pay them  $10k pesos.
to get here you have to come through part of the road that has some water running on it but I've seen local drive two wheel drive so you should be okay

this is the entrance to the attraction I have taken the photo of the sign where the contact information is provided.

it's a bit of a climb down from the road. It's best to start at 7.035850,-73.239091.
there are trales that lead to the top and to the bottom of the waterfall.

Location: Vía Mesetas - Jardin de la Peña - La Uribe, Jardín de Peñas, Mesetas, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Description: This is a beautiful waterfall adjacent to the bridge. You can park by the bridge and walk over to see the waterfall.

Location: Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
