Location: 62, Moniquirá, Arcabuco, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154260, Colombia
Name: Hotel Ecoturístico El Castillo
Description: El Castillo Ecotourist Hotel opened its doors to the public in November 2008. Moniquirá is a charming tourist destination located in the Boyacá department, in Colombia. This municipality has a great cultural and historical wealth that makes it a fascinating place to visit. Its name means "Strong place surrounded by walls" from the definition, and from the etymology of the old Castilian castle, and this from the Latin castellum, diminutive of castrum, camp. That's why El Castillo Ecotourist Hotel is in the middle of nature, on the great mountains of Moniquirá, making us the ideal camp, and our strength is nature; offering our clients a total rest. More than a hotel, we are the ideal place to spend quality time with loved ones.

Location: Diamante, Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Cortina El Diamante Trailhead
Description:
This is the trailhead where you purchase the ticket $150. It includes guide and need min. three hours to see the the three waterfalls.   

Jose is the owner and dad of Steven. 

You can come directly here or get a tour from Uribe.

Location: Herveo, Villamaría, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Do not use this road - sketchy people
Description:
We entered this road searching for a place to sleep and it looked from the distance like a nice farm. There are also some cows next to the road. Road is only 4x4 anyways.

However after driving for 10 mins there was the only part where a car could park as right and left are always fences. We waited there thinking on whether just to camp here as a guy on a horse came from the opposite direction. He passed our parking car as if we were not there. I got out to ask him whether it is okay to park here for the night and he said yes but way very uncommunicative and pulled out a radio in which he shouted (!) "ven rápido, rápido" (come fast). We thought he was asking the owner to come and speak to us.
3 mins later a quad popped up with 8 men on it. They jumped down and I asked them again, trying to overplay the fright that we had at that moment. They also did not talk much, did not want to talk about their cows either. We were frightened as hell as they left 10 mins later without wanting anything. However they definitely were no farmers and I think they did not want us to go further and see what they are doing there.
After they left, we left directly. Do not recommend anyone else to drive there.

Location: 40, Balcones de Sumapaz, Melgar, Oriente, Tolima, RAP Eje Cafetero, 734001, Colombia
Name: Hotel Piedras Blancas Melgar
Description:
Hotel with bungalows and camping area. Restaurant as well. Camping area is near river. Good clean environment. I’m on a bicycle. 30mil per night for camping (8/4/24)

Creek, rooms (80mil) double with breakfast included.

Two pools. One kids pool. Big rigs friendly.

Location: Calle 3, Palomino, Dibulla, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 446009, Colombia
Name: Jui Chi Mama
Description: Amazing ecolodge at the border of the town and the forest. Very peaceful, friendly owners (German was super nice and available all the time). Rooms with private or shared bathrooms - mosquito net and fan. Clean, big open kitchen, different sittings areas. Possibility to make fire, to work with a good WiFi, to observe birds (colibris and small tucanos). Perfect place to relax in Palomino !

Location: Vía Ocaña - Cúcuta, La Curva, Bucarasica, Norte, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: By the river
Description:
beautiful place to cool off in the river. We stopped to rest the Kombi's engine and we found a beautiful river and a pool that the locals built with stones where they come to bathe. There is a place to stop and rest and enjoy the river. It's cold water but it's worth it. right halfway between Ocaña and Cúcuta.

_________________________

hermoso lugar para refrescarse en el río. paramos a descansar el motor de la Kombi y nos encontramos con un hermoso río y una pileta que armaron los locales con piedras donde vienen a bañarse. hay lugar para parar y descansar y disfrutar del río. es agua fría pero vale la pena. justo a la mitad entre Ocaña y Cúcuta.

Location: Vía la Uribe - Jardin de la Peña - Mesetas, Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Uribe adjacent to Gas station
Description:
this is an empty lot adjacent to the gas station. It has the gas stations tended he had no problem me staying overnight here I also checked with the police if it will secure the indicated as long as it was agreed with the owner I should be all good. Not much traffic at night. 

the gas station closes at 8:00 p.m. but before that you can use their toilet.

Location: Calle 5, Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Tourist information
Description:
they guided me here to talk to the owner to get me the tourist information I had no information at all so I came here to talk to the guy and he showed me on Google map exactly where the trail leads are and I will also put the pins in ioverlander.
I have also attached a photo from the billboard at the entrance to the town which shows all the activities you can do in this town

Location: Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: cascada del Amor trailhead.
Description: This is the entrance to Cascada del Amor. From the street you have to cross the bridge to this trailhead.

Location: Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: cascada del amor water fall
Description: This is the waterfall where you can swim and enjoy the views. ait is just 10 min. hike from trailhead.

Location: Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: 7 Cascada & Sendero Loma Linda split
Description: This is where The trails split to 7 Cascada and Sendero loma Linda. if you have a 4x4 you can drive until here and park the car. Some areas are rough and steep. I would park in town and hike these trails.

Location: Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: 7 Cascada pozos
Description: Is where 7 cascadas waterfall is. End of turaui7l and pools are uhueurue7

Location: Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: 7. cascadas turn
Description: make right turn her. pozos are 5 min. down the trail

Location: Calle 5, Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: New restaurant
Description: the locals recommended to eat at this restaurant is usually closed on Monday

Location: Concepción, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Neat space near Cascada
Description:
Access road to the waterfall, a larger space allowing to park. Access in 2x4 with good clearance. During the day tuctucs to the Cascada.
No cellphone coverage.

Location: Calle 5, Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Restaurant Asadero y la Yrucha
Description: one of the better restaurants here locos brought me here to eat lunch a nice Hardy plate was for 15,000 pesos.

Location: Carrera 9, Támesis, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Cabañas El Tesoro Támesis
Description: nice little hotel on the edge of town. some rooms overlook the valley. very clean, ran by a nice family. very secure parking for a motorbike or vehicle. serve breakfast but I can't remember how much.

Location: El Guaico - Colmenas, Guaicogrande, La Ceja, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Waterfall Salto del Buey
Description:
Waterfall, quite spectacular, a bit tricky to get there because of missing gps satellites.
Google maps positioning is correct,  though.
Don't get fooled by the often ambiguous road signs.
22000 cop per person
Short hike down to the waterfall, prepare to get wet on the last meters (August).

Location: Carrera 5, Abrego, Occidente, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Parque central
Description:
you can overnight. loudly because is in the middle of two routes (north and south). 
plaza

 ruidosa pero no molestan. lo más importante, se puede vender artesanias! mucha gente en fin de semana por la iglesia.

Location: Carrera 21, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero 1 park
Description: I needed overnight parking in Cartagena for my van while I went to an island off the coast for a few nights. Trying to get to the lots near Getsemani and Centro Histórica was a nightmare and when I finally reached one, the guy turned me away even though my van is a ford transit regular wheel base, so tall but not huge. Anyway found this secure place run by a very friendly man who charged me 20.000 cop per night! Not sure if big rigs can fit but certainly vans and trucks!

Location: Vía la Uribe - Jardin de la Peña - Mesetas, Uribe, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Carlos Finca
Description:
This is Carlos Finca. I met him at the Coffee shop and he invited me to stay at his place. A very welcoming man. Please call on him and he will welcome you to stay at his finca. He can be texted at WhatsApp +573124721616.  
if you decide to stay be careful where you park in the finger because when it rain, the parking lot gets soft.  
please say hello to Carlos for me

Location: Guadalupe, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Blockage for cars
Description: We drove from Guadelupe to here, and the road gets very narrow at a point where we with our pick-up could not pass. There is some improvised wooded beams placed as a ‘bridge’, but too narrow and we didn’t trust the beams to hold the weight of the car. Had to go all the way back to Guadelupe. No issues for motorbikes.

Location: Vía Marinilla - El Peñol, Marinilla, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 054020, Colombia
Name: Casa Corona Gourmet
Description:
Excellent restaurant on the way to Guatapé and Piedra del Peñol. It has space to receive travelers and also has rooms. The space is large and you can arrange with the owners to spend a few days there. The food is delicious and the guys who work there are very friendly.
Excelente restaurant de camino a Guatapé y la Piedra del Peñol. Cuenta  con espacio para recibir viajeros y también tienen habitaciones. El espacio es amplio y puedes acordar con los dueños para pasar unos días allí. La comida es deliciosa y los chicos que allí trabajan son muy amables

Location: Vía Granada - Mesetas - Granada, San Juan de Arama, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Agroturismo Indio Acostado
Description:
A beautiful Mirador where you see the  Guejar Canyon Vista. It  opens at 9:00 in the morning and and the last tourist is,allowed to visit at 4:30. After 4:30 they do not allow anybody to go up there. Mirador is 20-25 min hike from parking lot.

the cost to hike the middle door is 15K and if you also want to hike to San Jos and Guajer Rivers e River the total cost is 50K.

you can easily spend a day here they also have cabanas to rent from 350 k. No car camping allowed.
.

Location: Museo de Historia Natural La Tatacoa, Carrera 4, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Museo de Historia Natural de Tatacoa
Description:
The museum opened in 2021 and has the largest collection of fossil animals in Colombia.
It was sponsored by an American ex-astronaut and is obtained by a guy that has searched all his life in the Tatacoa. It is such a pleasure to listen to him and to see the giant fossils and even touch some of them.

The price is 10 k COP p.p. and you will be guided through the whole exhibition. For me it was one of the greatest things to see in Colombia (even better than the gold museum in Bogotá!).

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Campground next to riverbed
Description:
4x4 required

Follow the dry riverbed and you will find a shallow and safe place to stay overnight, which can not be seen from the road.
However the view is not as great as in the other places.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Opposite side of Tony's Place
Description: Just drive behind the plants. Great view but you can not be seen from the road.

Location: Ruta a Termales Espiritu Santo, Nariño, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Thermal baths Termales Espíritu Santo
Description:
Thermal baths, nice reception area with good WiFi and commentary Tinto.
COP 30000 pp during the day, COP 35000 in the night (6-10 pm). There are options with meals but I didn't get that.
Varied basins, a nice accessible river in the middle.
No foreigners like me.

Location: Carrera 49, Comuna 12 - Cabecera del Llano, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 680003, Colombia
Name: Quite place on dead end street
Description:
This is the best place we found to rest and stay for the night in Bucaramanga. 

It's quiet dead end street,  so no cars passing by. Very good area to stay. We asked neighbourhood,  they say we can stay here. Many of them offer us even help or water. 

Police stop by to ask , what we doing here and said, we can stay here and it's very safe. Beautiful park / botanic garden near by.

Location: Calle 7, San Juan de Arama, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Destinos Naturales
Description:
The toot company arranges tours for hikes to cascadas and rafting. I took a tour with them on a very short notice. None of the other travel agencies in Mesetas were able to accommodate me they were very professional and crossed  all the x's and o's to make sure I had a great hike and visit to Cascada.
 
I took the tour of Cascada Salto de Santa Domingo and returned late from the hike and needed a place to stay night Andrea the owner offered me to stay in her driveway and use the restroom. I really professional and great for some highly recommended.

Location: Vía a la Costa san Alberto -San Martin, Líbano, San Alberto, Cesar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Mineroil Gas Station
Description:
We stayed for the night at this gas station after the guy at the Terpel 1km before denied us to overnight there.
It's a small and simples gas station, but with a very big yard behind it where some trucks stop by for the night. The station closes at 10pm but security guards keep on watch. 
It's simple but has plenty of space, it's quiet and felt safe.

Location: Guayabal, Pensilvania, Alto Oriente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Roadside
Description:
Lovely flat grassy spot next to the road Pensilvania to Pueblo Nuevo.
No amenities, no cell reception.

Location: Calle 28, Centro, Girardot ciudad, Girardot, Alto Magdalena, RAP (Especial) Central, 252432, Colombia
Name: Hotel Elimar
Description:
Good hotel, a few blocks from the center. Clean rooms. Friendly service. Breakfast available. Covered and secure garage. 

Rooms with a fan start at COP$50,000. Rooms with air conditioning start at COP$70,000.

The shower has unheated water, but it comes out of the tap warm from the sun.

Location: Capitanejo, García Rovira, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Canyon Road
Description: Here you will start driving into a Canyon. Very beautiful road, but extremely rough, covered with potholes almost the whole way. Be careful, take your time, don’t drive during rain or right after rain. Can be slippery and muddy. Some parts of the street are already broken and falling rocks. We took this road coming from NP Cocuy. The road is definitely beautiful, but if you just need to keep it going, take the mountain roads beginning at Soatá.

Location: Tres Filos, San Juan de Arama, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Mirador Del Canyon Fragua
Description:
This is the Mirador where you get to see the Guejar Canyon views. it takes about 20 minutes to hike up here and it is a tough hike. For the climb only, they charge 15K pesos but if you also want to visit and swim in the San Jose and Guajer Rivers, the cost is 50k 

The parking area is beautiful but they do not allow car camping also they have three four cabanas and if you want to rent those they are 350 k. Jonas is the guide and he's really nice kid.

Location: Tres Filos, San Juan de Arama, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Rio San Jose
Description: This is where you hike with La Fragua guide to see Rio Guejar. Beautiful rocks and swimming is great.

Location: Tres Filos, San Juan de Arama, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Rocka El Grito
Description: The screaming Rock. looks like a person screaming. It is part of Frugua hike to Rio San Jose and Rio Guajer.

Location: Las Fosas, Lejanías, Mesetas, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: La Encantada Turn
Description: This is where you make a left turn to get to Cascada la Encantada if you are coming from Mesates. Look for the sign on the lefthand side. The waterfall is 1.3 km from here.

Location: AirCenter, 85C-45, Diagonal 25G, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Fontibón, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 110931, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero el Dorado
Description:
Covered long-stay car park. 5 mins taxi to airport.  Parked up here for 2 weeks (SUV with roof top tent) 18,000 COP/24 hours.  Responsive to whatsapp, Good service.

5 mins walk to nearby Colonial International Hotel (good value) - separate entry

Location: Calle 25G, Modelia, UPZs Localidad Fontibón, Localidad Fontibón, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 110931, Colombia
Name: Colonial International Hotel
Description:
Double room, US$34/night.  Good for an overnight stay waiting for early flight.  
Long-stay car park (separate entry Parqueadero del Dorado) walkable 5 mins and fabulous cheap restaurant next door to hotel - dinners and breakfast.  A great easy place to park for long stay and have hotel/food if you have to depart Bogota Airport for a short trip.

Location: Carrera 82, Modelia, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Fontibón, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 110931, Colombia
Name: Colonial International Hotel
Description:
Double room, US$34/night.  Good for an o/n stay waiting for early flight.  
Longstay car park (separate entry Parqueadero del Dorado) walkable 5 mins and fabulous cheap restaurant next door to hotel - dinners and breakfast.  A great easy place to park up long stay and have hotel/food if you have to depart Bogota Airport for a short trip.

Location: El Rincon, Mesetas, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Cascada La Encantada Parking
Description:
You can stay overnight here at the trailhead parking and it is free . I wanted to stay here and the owner of the finca did not have any problems. If you ever get into a bind thinking about coming to this waterfall you can always stay overnight here. There are 2 waterfalls, La Encantada  and Diamante. There is a tienda at the Finca where they sell drinks and some trinkets. The lady is really nice really nice. You can easily spend all day at the waterfall. It is beautiful. 

The waterfall is 15 minutes from the trailhead. The trail was not properly cleared so it was difficult to follow. But as you enter from the Finca,  follow the fence down to the first wooden bridge, you will hike up and down to second bridge (follow fence again), pass through the avocado garden(red are  not ripe, yellow are ripe and yummy). Next at the split if you go right you will hike down to Diamante (+5 min). At the end trail was really bad. 

At the split if you stay to the left, you will hike to La Encantada waterfall. This is the better of the two and you can swim here.

Location: Lejanías, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Cascada De Azufre
Description:
This is where you park the car and walk all the way down to the cabanas and water charco. There are quite a few things that you can do here. I have attached a photo to give you an idea what are all the things you can do here. You can easily spend 1-2 full days here.

if you are staying, travel light as the stairs are long and steep. You have to take your luggage down and you'll have to haul your luggage back. I am guessing it will be 20 min. steep hike up the stairs.

Location: Lejanías, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Piscina del Guajer
Description:
There is a split in road here, stay left (if driving from Mesetas) to get to Piscina Del Guajer.

if you make a right turn in another 40 minutes you will be in Lejanias, where 65W crosses this road.

Location: VILLA NICO, Sendero Ecologico Agua Blanca, Bochalema, Suroriente, Norte de Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel Campestre Villa Nico
Description:
A country place with the comforts of the city, the resting place of the owners now open for the public who wish to rest. I am a consultant for the owner, I am not a traveler.
---
Un lugar campestre con las comodidades de la ciudad, el lugar de descanso de los propietarios ahora abierto para descanso del público que asi lo desee. Soy asesor de la propietaria no soy viajero.

Location: Lejanías, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Finca Eco Turística Piscina Del Guajer
Description:
I made it here late in the day and since I had not many options to stay so decided to car RTT camp here for the night. 

if you decide to come here you would want to see and enjoy the pools and the waterfall so they have guided tours and they offer packages. The guy  offered me $150k pesos pp package wo food ($180k with food pp) sightseeing and meal package for $180k pesos and since I have cooking facilities so I have did not get the food package. I was able to negotiate the package $120k pesos wo food and night stay. 
if you have no interest in pool and sightseeing, you could camp out here but you will have to negotiate the price most likely they're going to ask something between $50-30k per night pp for the stay. 

due to heavy then the electricity was out for the night so I could not tell whether they have Wi-Fi or not. Clarol cell signal was really good

Location: Olímpica, Troncal del Caribe, La Paz, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470006, Colombia
Name: Supermarket with parking for big rigs
Description: Mercado Olimpica: Big and new supermarket, with plenty of space in the parking lot. The best option we could find tha has space to park our big rig.

Location: Vía Vereda Tendidos, El Peñón, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Pk cerro de Panama
Description:
Good alternative to Pandora grove if you just want to enjoy nature without paying. Parking at the entrance to a quarry with no activity. Access by a track equivalent to Pandora, a little tight at the entrance (worst passage). Come and enjoy a spectacular view of sheer cliffs of 1000m. Be it early morning or sunset. Continue on foot after the climb, take the path to the left, pass the gate and then leave the path 50m to the left, climb all the way up the stone stream to the summit! Caution: risk of vertigo!
---
Bonne alternative au bosquet de Pandora si vous voulez juste profiter de la nature sans payer. Parking a l'entrée d'une carrière sans activité. Accès par une piste équivalent à Pandora, un poil serré à l'entrée (pire passage) . 
Venez jouir d'une vue spectaculaire avec des falaises abruptes de 1000m. 
Sois tôt le matin ou coucher de soleil. Continuer le chemin à pied après la monté prendre le chemin à gauche , passer le portillon puis quitter le sentier 50m à gauche, remonter toute le ruisseau en pierre jusqu'au sommet ! Attention risque de vertige !
Réseau au sommet

Location: terpel, 70, Platanal, Río de Oro, Cesar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Terpel
Description:
great space where we spent the night. Free showers in both bathrooms and they remain open all night. They also provide you with WiFi. The only shocking thing is that you are greeted by a security guy with a shotgun on his shoulder. but beyond that the night was super quiet where there is also a hotel for truckers.

gran espacio donde pasamos la noche. duchas gratis en los dos baños y los mismos quedan abiertos toda la noche. también te brindan el WiFi. lo único shockeante es que te recibe un muchacho de seguridad con escopeta al hombro. pero más allá de eso la noche fue súper tranquila donde también hay un hotel para camioneros.

Location: Lejanías, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Finca Eco Turística Coffee demo
Description: As you get down from the stairs you get welcomed here. Isabel and her family welcomed and give a demonstration of how coffee is made. Also, there is a great view that you should take a photo of finca..

Location: Lejanías, Ariari, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, 506061, Colombia
Name: Mirador Ser Feliz
Description:
Great views of the vista. There are cabanas for overnight stay too. The food was okay but the views are excellent. Worth a stop.
From this turn you need to go past 800m.

Location: Carrera 1A, Peñon del Rodadero, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 005075, Colombia
Name: Ocean Mall
Description:
Large mall where you'll find basically anything. 
There are ATM machines (several from different banks), and a place to exchange money and buy the SOAT.

Location: Full Arabe, Circular 5, Bolivariana, Comuna 11 - Laureles-Estadio, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050031, Colombia
Name: Fulĺ Arab
Description: In a quiet side street with indoor and outdoor seating. Delicious Lebanese dishes from 20 TCop, pita, sharwarma or great mixed plate dishes. Portions are large, service very friendly.

Location: Calle 48, Suramericana, Comuna 11 - Laureles-Estadio, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050034, Colombia
Name: B48 Living by B Rent
Description: The location is ideal for exploring the city, next to the Suramerikana metro, supermarkets and many restaurants nearby. The facilities are sufficient for making breakfast, but not for proper cooking. Everything is new, only opened in 2024. The bed is comfortable, large refrigerator, warm rain shower. Free gym with steam bath in the basement, nice roof terrace. Traffic can be heard during the day. Quite quiet at night. Around €55 per night. Very friendly service, mostly in English. Can also be booked via booking.com, but more expensive.

Location: Marizagua pan-cafe, Calle 4, Monguí, Sugamuxi, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Café en Grano
Description:
Nice coffee shop serving only local coffee. Good espresso, pastries, and food. Dog friendly. Clean bathrooms and possibly wifi. 

We came every day that we were in town, and we bought a bag of whole bean coffee.

Location: 45, Vereda Las Toldas, Mocoa, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, 860001, Colombia
Name: Terpel
Description: Last petrol station for a long time when going north.

Location: City Parking, Calle 93, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Chapinero, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 110221, Colombia
Name: City Parking
Description: It's a big open lot where you can park and your solar panel is exposed to sun. They close at 11:30 p.m.Yiu can leave the car here for night.You pay $30k for every 12 hrs of parking. I dropped the car off at 4pm and the next morning picked at 10pm, I paid 60k.

Location: 62, Barbosa, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Barbosa's coliseum
Description:
We arrived to the sportive units and talked with the manager, he authorized us to spend the night in the coliseum. the afternoon security guard was very friendly and showed us option to set our tent. at the morning the next guard was not that friendly but did not rushed us nor said anything for being there. manager was also very friendly as we are bike tourist. 

el gerente del polideportivo nos permitió quedarnos dentro del coliseo, el guardia de seguridad de la tarde fue muy amable con nosotros, el de la mañana no nos dijo nada ni nos afanó ni nada.

Location: Super Breakfast, 8-45, Carrera 5, Boquía, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631020, Colombia
Name: Donde Yuri empenadas Venezoleanos
Description: AMAZING empanadas Venezuelan style. Super delicious and different from the typical Colombian empanada.

Location: Paramo Trek, 9-33, Carrera 5, Boquía, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631020, Colombia
Name: Bumi
Description: Amazing home-style restaurant owned by a herbalist. All dishes are made to order, healthy, and in most cases organic and home grown. Her food is amazing! Highly recommend trying the lychee lemonade and chocolate cake for dessert. Also, if you’re sick, the owner can make you a medicinal concoction! Highly recommend visiting!

Location: Primax El Placer, Panamericana, Yacuanquer, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Primax gasstation
Description:
we spend one night here

Hay duchas con agua fria, baños limpios y agua.

Location: Hotel San Andreas, Carrera 5, Ipiales, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524060, Colombia
Name: San Andrés
Description: Excellent hotel, well located, central, has parking for motorcycles, free coffee at all hours and good service, they help you with border procedures and provide you with a heater on cold nights, highly recommended

Location: 2-57, Calle 9, Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056050, Colombia
Name: Banco Agrario de Colombia
Description: ATM up to 2,000,000 COP. 22,500 fee. Best atm in Jardin we could find.

Location: Carrera 41, Morasurco, Comuna 9, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520001, Colombia
Name: Hotel Morasurco
Description:
I chatted via WhatsApp with them whether we could sleep in the fenced parking lot and use the bathrooms.

The hotel is in the best area of the town and has a fenced parking. In Google Street view it also looks like big rigs would fit in as well.

They agreed but said that they had no "public" showers and if we needed one they would charge extra.

20.000 COP/car.

WhatsApp 3156531121

In the end it was too late so we stopped at another place. Just WhatsApp them if you are interested and see whether they agree.

Location: corporacion regional de educacion superior, #27-100, Carrera 26, El Cedro, Comuna 19, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 720025, Colombia
Name: Kaporal llantas moto tires
Description:
IRC offroads, anakee Wild, mitas (few), Sahara 3 all sizes, mt6, scorpion rallye.
overall good shop for tires.
for more choice mundimotos is another good option

Location: Calle 1 Sur, Belalcázar, Bajo Occidente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: parqueadero frente a Terpel en los pies de Cristo rey
Description: Mrs. Maria manages a small parking lot where she allows homecars, buses and trucks to stay overnight, provides toilets and showers and prepares breakfast, charging 10 m per night per car. humble people and collaborators

Location: Vía Salida Taparcal, La Isla, Belén de Umbría, Vertiente Occidental, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Camping la palmera
Description: Large flat site next to the Risaralda River with cabins and ecological trail, open weekends, shop, toilets and showers, friendly staff 10m per person and 20m per vehicle, suitable for camping and rest

Location: E D S TEXACO ARMERO GUAYABAL, Carrera 4B, Zona Industrial, Armero Guayabal, Armero - Guayabal, Norte, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Plus Gas Station
Description:
Texaco across the street does not allow wild camping anymore. When I went there, they asked me to go over here. The attendant had no problem me parking here for the night. Adjacent to gas station there is a big parking area so I parked there for the night. They charge 10K. I am not sure even if you have to ask the gas station to park here, seems to be an open lot. Just park here and don't say anything, it's pretty safe area. not knowing what I know now I paid the attendant 10K.

Also, keep in mind there's quite a bit of heavy truck traffic at night so you will need some good earplugs. 

there's a water fountain at the gas station that has potable water and you can use for drinking and to fill up your tanks.

Location: Padilla, Lérida, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Reserva Natural
Description:
This this is a reserva which has Cabanas swimming pool and kitchen. You can rent a cabana for $120k pp a night that includes dinner, breakfast. and lunch next day. 
If you want to Overland they charge 50K and your access to the swimming pool, bathroom and internet. The swimming pool is under construction but it's a good place to stop on the way to Nevada del Ruiz.
Carlos is the administrator and a nice guy.

you can leave the car in the frontier and do a 5-minute hike to the cascados. do not drive past here as the road gets worse that's on zero for the Cascada is on the right if you continue on the road. I was here on the weekday and there was no one here so nobody charged me any money maybe on the weekends they charge money.

Location: Padilla, Lérida, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Las Cascadas
Description:
This is the cascadas. You can park your car in front of Reserva Natural and take the Sendero here. It will be on your right as you will walk towards the road away from reserva. 
You can easily spend a day between the reservoir and the cascadas. 
As you will take the Sandero on the right just follow it to the right, do not cross the first bridge on the left. You will cut the stream on the second bridge on the left. just follow the sound of cascading water.

Location: San Agustín, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 418060, Colombia
Name: Buena Vista Hotel
Description: Nice spacious campground and hotel. Not muddy. Level and easy access.

Location: Café Concorde, Tour de Café, Buenavista, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 632060, Colombia
Name: El Concorde
Description:
Restaurant with an amazing view, open from 11 to 19 from tuesday to sunday.
Food is really good but more expansive than usual in Colombia.
At least, come for desert and coffee and enjoy the view.
Very quiet and calm place (maybe not in week-end, because is't a big one).

Enough space to park with big rig but the road is a little narrow and very steep.

Location: Calle 76, Jorge Eliecer Gaitan, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 111211, Colombia
Name: Diagnostic Centro Sarmiento
Description: Hello, I tried around 10 electric mechanics in Central America and in Colombia. And no one could solve our problems. This man is really educated in diagnostic problems. He has many many diagnostics for old and new cars too. He has finally solved our problems with the temperature sensor in VW Jetta transplanted to VW T3 westfalia.

Location: Carrera 4, La Esperanza, Murillo, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Cascada Silencio Murillo
Description:
This is the street entrance to the sandero trailhead. As you walk down you will see agate that will lead to Cascada.  The hike is 20 min. from here.
You can leave the car parked in cabana parking lot  to the right or leave on a wide street or leave it here. It is a tourist town, it is very safe here.

Ezekiel is the owner here. he sells Coke and bocadilla's at his Tienda before you do you final descent down to Cascada. The bocadillas very tasty, Costs 2K each

Location: Villapinzón, Almeidas, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Refugio de Guacheneque
Description: Very beautiful place. with rooms, a cabaña and  room for camping. there is a small restaurant. you can book via booking.com or direct. super tranquil, with beautiful views. the host is super sweet and very welcoming towards cyclists.

Location: Carrera 9, 8 de Marzo, Murillo, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Horse riding stable
Description: if you need to ride the horses this is the place you need to come. They charge 30k per hour.

Location: Calle 5, La Esperanza, Murillo, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Cabana Parking Lot
Description:
This is a parking lot of Cabanas. As I was driving around and checking out town, I turned in here. The guys who take care of the property Carlos Jiménez, Albeiro Pineda and his mother in law  Magnolia were very welcoming. I asked them where Cascada Silencio trailhead was and where to park the car. They walked me over and told me to leave the car here. The offered me Tinto too. They also told me what I must visit in town

Long story shorts when I return late in the evening and asked if I can park the car here overnight and sleep, they had no problems with it. Really friendly and great people. We all had breakfast together by my car the next morning. 

If you have a oet, I'm not sure if that's would work out here or not as they are three dogs tied to the tree and barking  a lot when the saw me. Also keep in mind if you are here on the weekend this parking lot maybe full because of the Cabana guests.

Location: Vía a Tatacoa, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: lay-by with great view quiet at night
Description:
Lay-by next to the main road with good view, quiet at night. It seems very public, so nobody cares. Probably crowded on weekends.
OK claro reception
Dry and cool in the night, few or no mosquitos.
I wouldn't put up a tent: people say and try all kinds of things in this touristy area.
Just keep to "Parqueadero" - just parking here.

Location: Calle 15, Arauca, RAP Llanos, Colombia
Name: Arauca Migration office
Description:
This is exactly the point where you stamp passport very easy, very nice officer on the Colombian side. 
Five minutes to stamp and continue ! This is very little border crossing they don’t know what is a motorhome on the Venezuela side, they will check everything! So you must say to them that you are tourist and that you want to go to see Venezuela first you said you will go to this nice place “Hato El Cedral “ everybody knows this place! 
We came from Venezuela and went to Colombia  !

Location: Posada del Angel, Calle 6, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631020, Colombia
Name: BikingTourCarbonera
Description:
Amazing downhill mountainbike tour to the beautiful Carbonera valley, which is an absolute must-see in the coffee region with a lot more and a greater variety of wax trees. 

You meet at 7:30 am at the central square, where a 4x4 will pick you up to drive 1h30 uphill to an altitude of 3.400m.

From there on, you go 10km downhill by mountainbike to the beautiful Carbonera valley making stops along the way for pictures and information on the fauna and flora in the valley. 

After the first descend, you are offered a traditional Colombian breakfast in a cosy finca with view on the mountain hills.

After breakfast, the 4x4 will take you back up the same hilltop, but now you will be biking down all the way back to Salento, which is about 22km downhill, where you will be offered a healthy lunch and a beer.

The downhills were a bit technical and demanding at times, but anyone who has ridden a mountainbike before should be able to do it.

We paid 240.000 Colombian pesos per person, which included breakfast, lunch, transport, high-quality mountainbikes, helmet, gloves and rain jacks.

The owner Sebastian is super friendly and passionate for what he does, making the whole tour a fantastic experience.

The location on the map is where the tour ends and where the guys have their biking atelier. Sebastian is available over WhatsApp: +57 321 314 3568 (note that they don’t have a physical office).

Location: El Sifón, Vía a Aguas Calientes, El Sifón, Casabianca, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Termales De Agua Caliente
Description: this is not too famous thermal pools they charge 15K for entry great parking area. they let you park in and stay overnight too they're closed for the service right now

Location: Vía a Aguas Calientes, El Sifón, Casabianca, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Termales Agua caliente
Description:
This is the parking area of the thermal pools. This is also known as Termales  El Sifon. It has a really large parking area. The cell signal is good. just temporary close because they are doing maintenance on it. No access to the bathrooms.

 They had no problem me staying overnight here as long as I had the bathroom in my camper. It is a beautiful area with great views. A great place to stay overnight

Location: Herveo, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Nevada Del Ruiz Entrance gate
Description: this is the entrance gate to Nevada Del Ruiz volcano from here the brisas is about 7 minutes drive at brisas you pay the entrance fee you sign in and you pay 45k for the guy to a company you and it takes about 2 hours

Location: Calle 6, Pueblo Nuevo, Pensilvania, Alto Oriente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Hotel Campestre Pueblo Nuevo
Description:
A hidden gem. 

Very nice hotel in this small town, just a few kilometers from the hot spring. 

Standard single rooms are available for COP$30,000.

They have larger rooms and private cabins also. 

Clean pool. Meals available. 

No air conditioning or hot water. Wifi works well near the office, but not in the rooms. 

Gated parking for one or two motorcycles.

Location: Carrera 22, Guatapé, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053840, Colombia

Location: Morelia, AMCO, Area Metropolitana Centro Occidente, Pereira, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660008, Colombia

Location: Herveo, Villamaría, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia

Description: Beautiful laguna Negra with great vista. couple of tiendas where you can stop and have a photo taken.  I do not think you can hike to the Laguna

Location: HOSPEDAJE BUENOS AIRES, Arboletes-Turbo, Necoclí, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057870, Colombia
Name: Tiki Lounge, Necocli
Description:
It is a nice lugar direct at sea. They rent rooms. This place is far more amable then Olgas place 50m before.

Be careful with big rigs.

Location: Calle 48C, Estadio, Comuna 11 - Laureles-Estadio, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050035, Colombia
Name: Nattypapas
Description:
Super burger joint with homemade bread, many choices of homemade dishes. Steak frites , friendly staff, come early as there's a long queue.

Location: Avenida del Río, Zona Industrial - Loma N° 3, Localidad Norte - Centro Histórico, Perímetro Urbano Barranquilla, Barranquilla, Atlántico, RAP Caribe, 080003, Colombia
Name: Near Shakira's statue
Description:
Really nice, safe and quiet place to spend the night close to the shakira statue. Some soldiers of the colombian armada keep on watch across the street 24h and they were super friendly with us and said we could stay as long as we wanted.
No ammenities, but you can enjoy some nice breeze from the river as well as the gym equipment right in front.
We came on a thursday morning and the place was practically empty, but a lot of people come to walk and exercise by the night. Gotta be here early if you wanna secure a nice spot.

Location: Museo Paleontológico, Vía Moniquirá - Villa de Leyva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154001, Colombia
Name: Centro de investigaciones paleontologicas
Description:
A Little museum of fossil. They provide activity for the kids: modling of a little skeleton and excavation of a fossil. Kids where happy and they wanted to continue! 
24000 cop just for the activity.

Location: San Rafael - San Carlos, San Carlos, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Finca Hotel la vida es un paseo
Description: Finca Country Hotel, family atmosphere, surrounded by nature, private natural pool, comfortable rooms with private bathroom, ample and comfortable parking, Wifi.

Location: Ráquira, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: La casa al reverse
Description:
Well… it’s a new attraction about a house built upside down. It is just rooms were the fourniture have been instaled on the top. 
You’re doing the visit with a guide who is there to take pictures. 
For the moment it costs « just » 10000cop per person. 
It is just closed to El Mano del artisano. 
Not really worth it

Location: Hospital Universitario Clínica San Rafael, #56-50, Carrera 24, Belén, Comuna Palogrande, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 170004, Colombia
Name: Clínica Santillana
Description:
I had some health issues so I went to the University hospital IPS Universitaria De Caldas for check up(I have added a PIN to ioverlander). There doctor check up appt. fee was $39,000 pesos. For further evaluation they sent me here. A great place and professional staff they really took care of me. please do not hesitate to stop here if you have any health issues. 
most of the doctor speak English they do accept credit card.

Location: Carrera 1, La Vega, Gualivá, RAP (Especial) Central, 253610, Colombia
Name: Zona de camping en lo alto de la montaña
Description:
A very well located site next to a paved road 5 minutes from La Vega, with a warm but cool climate with breezes without any mosquitoes and a wonderful view in the morning. The hosts are very friendly and the stay is comfortable. They charged us 20k pesos PP includes showers, hammocks, bathrooms and space for campfires. Great space for RVs and campers. Pets allowed, very quiet at night

Un sitio muy bien ubicado al lado de carretera pavimentada a 5 minutos de La Vega, con un clima cálido pero fresco con brisas sin ningún mosquito y una maravillosa vista en la mañana. Los anfitriones muy amables y la estadía es cómoda. Nos cobraron 20k pesos PP incluye duchas, hamacas, baños y espacio para fogatas. Gran espacio para Rvs y campers. Permiten mascotas, muy tranquila la noche

Location: Fusca, Chía, Sabana Centro, RAP (Especial) Central, 250008, Colombia
Name: Terpel gas station
Description: We spent one night here. There is a large truck parking area at the rear of the station. It’s 24 hours with clean bathrooms and a shower. We didn’t use the shower so I’m not sure if you have to pay but it wasn’t locked. There was security cameras and a security guard walking around so we felt safe. The parking is set off the highway so road noise not too bad. It’s a great spot 10 KM out of Bogota.

Location: San José del Guaviare, Guaviare, RAP Amazonía, 950001, Colombia
Name: Ecoraudal posada campestre
Description: This lovely hotel is just outside the city of San Jose del Guaviare. This hotel has all the facilities and the owner, Andres, gives tours to all the sites in Guaviare. We didn’t stay in the hotel, but since we used them as guides on tours, they allowed us to park and use their facilities for free. Andres and his wife are incredibly kind and helpful. They can be reached by WhatsApp (‪+57 316 8738510‬) or on Waze, EcoRaudal Posada Campestre.

Location: Calle 19, San Luis, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Glamping, Bosque La Manguita
Description:
Glamping La Manguita, in San Luis Antioquia, if you travel along Route 60, it is truly a place to come visit. In the San Luis area there are a lot of rivers, impressive waterfalls to visit and in glamping la manguita you can enjoy cabins, glamping and also camping and stopping your Motorhome or Camper. Here in this beautiful place and it is very safe, it has cameras and highly recommended. Staying overnight has a small cost. Ask for Mr. Elkin, phone +57 304 4900519.

Glamping La Manguita, en San Luis Antioquia, si recorren la ruta 60 es un lugar verdaderamente para venir visitar. En el área de San Luis hay un montón de ríos, cascadas impresionantes para visitar y en glamping la manguita pueden disfrutar de cabañas, glamping y además de acampar y detener su Motorhome o Camper. Aquí en este lugar bellísimo y es muy seguro, cuenta con camaras  y altamente recomendable.
El pasar la noche, tiene un pequeño costo.
Preguntar por el señor Elkin, telefono +57 304 4900519.

Location: Puerto Rico, Caquetá, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Villa Roca
Description: Good place for overland, is safe and excellent attention.

Location: San José del Fragua - Florencia, Belén de los Andaquíes, Caquetá, RAP Amazonía, Colombia

Description: Great place to arrrive, is safe and the owner is a good person, the place have hiking and lake, is a beautiful place! I recommend

Location: Carrera 12C, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Usaquén, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 110121, Colombia
Name: Nuevo Parque Country (dog park)
Description: This is a lovely park in an enclosed area, surrounded by buildings and houses in a neighborhood called Cedritos in Bogotá. We have stayed here in several occasions, it’s perfect for spending the night, it’s very quiet and beautiful.

Location: 30, Rovira, Guayabal, San Vicente del Caguán, Caquetá, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Road #30 Neiva towards San Vicente
Description:
As of today (Aug 18, 2024) there seems to be a de facto curfew in place for this road. "Closed after 7pm" I was told at the "Peaje" (5000COP), manned by an Indígena woman and consisting of a roap crossing the road, a lose to Guayabal (coming from Neiva). 
A lot of quite recent FARC graffiti.
I was warned by another local before, not to drive "at night" but also not to be anywhere near the road at night, so no wild camping at all. Early morning, after 5.30am would be OK. 
No cell reception whatsoever.

Location: Carrera 4, La Ermita, Mariquita, Norte, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Casa de los virreyes hostal
Description:
It is an old house with many comfortable spaces to stay, has many rooms, has a large parking area that allows entry to campers and RV's, the entrance has a height of 2.5 m, it has pool service and kitchen with access for all, has very clean bathrooms and the host is very friendly. Pets are allowed and the owner has no problem with it. There is no established price for campers, we gave a voluntary value of $60,000 and the owner was very satisfied. 
----
Es una casa antigua con muchos espacios cómodos para quedarse, tiene muchas habitaciones, tiene una zona de parqueo amplia que permite ingreso a campers y RV's, la entrada tiene una altura de 2,5 m, tiene servicio de piscina y cocina con acceso para todos, tiene baños muy limpios y el anfitrión es muy amable. Permite el ingreso de mascotas y el dueño no tiene ningún problema con ello. No tiene un precio establecido para ingreso de campers, nosotros dimos un valor valor voluntario de $60,000 y el dueño quedó muy conforme.

Se puede parquear uno o dos Rvs, la noche cuesta 60k pesos por vehículo. Excelente sitio para realizar el recorrido en ciudad perdida. Excelente vista. También hay sitio d e camping

Location: Doradal, Puerto Triunfo, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: chicky doradal
Description: agua potable tratada / eau potable/ treated water

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Banco Agrario de Colombia
Description: ATM good to 2,000,000 COP. 22,500 COP fee. Best atm in town!

Location: Calle 51, Urbanización Vista Hermosa, Centenario, Comuna Centenario, Perímetro Urbano Armenia, Armenia, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 630008, Colombia

Possibilité d'acheter des bouteilles au petit format (qui entrent dans l'un camping car europeen).

Location: Serendipia, Carrera 6 - Calle Real, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631020, Colombia
Name: Serendipia
Description:
Very good vegetarian restaurant that also serves pizzas but only in the evening.
There are dishes with meat as well. Well presented and very tasty. Not the cheapest but very good quality.

Location: San Remo, 3-36, Calle 8, Aldea de Piedras, Jericó, Cabecera Municipal Jericó, Jericó, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056010, Colombia
Name: Hotel Atenas
Description:
The best budget hotel I could find in Jericó after a brief search. 

I paid COP$50,000 for a single room with private bathroom. Larger rooms are available. 

Electric shower. Wifi. Breakfast included. 

Parking is included in a gated lot a half block away. 

Friendly staff. Clean, comfortable rooms.

Location: Autopista Conexión Norte, El Bosque, El Saltillo, Zaragoza, Bajo Cauca, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: estadero el bosque
Description: they have rooms (40k) but allowed us to set our tent in the upper floor, very friendly people. offered us a shower. they have restaurant service and a very little market with some basics.

Location: Oiba - Las Gachas, El Arena, Guadalupe, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Start of Road to cascada de los Caballeros- Bad road
Description: Here is the start from Guadalupe coming towards the cascada de los caballeros. If you don’t have high clearance or you have something bigger than a sprinter, I wouldn’t go this way.

Location: Carrera 6, Aguadas, Norte, Caldas, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Hotel Casa Blanca
Description: This hotel has different levels of accommodation. The 3 we looked at were 100k for basic double room, 135 double room, and 150 for suit, which has a spa bath.  Try and get a room at the back, which has a view. Comes with breakfast, free coffee all day, and free laundry, which was washed and dried overnight.   Some of the staff speak English.  The hotel is on a level street where you can park your moto to unload gear.  Has secure parking two blocks away.  Also a number of good restaurants on same street. Only one  block from square.  Good wifi and quite.

Location: Carrera 8A, Baraya, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Cancha Baraya
Description: Cyclists: I asked the Police just around the corner for a save space to camp and they send me to the sports ground which has a big roof. Between 9 and 10 pm it got quiet and I could pitch the tent. There is light all night, from time to time the police or military will come for a control walk. The toilets are out of service.

Location: Escuela Normal Superior de Manizales, Carrera 25A, La Estrella, Comuna Palogrande, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 170004, Colombia
Name: Velódromo Universidad de Caldas Parking
Description:
This is the dirt parking lot where everyone who wants to use the Velódromo or the soccer field parks their car. There is also a school on the hill so in the afternoon when it shuts off, parents pick their kids from this parking lot. From time to time it does get busy. 

I had to go through kidney stone removal at nearby Clínica Santillana(pin added) so I used this lot on and off over 7 days. At times I left my car here, there are two local guys with whistles around their neck that keep an eye on the cars. On and off I gave them tip $2000 pesos/day. Really nice guys. They look homeless but guide everyone to park the carand keep an eye 

There are also 2 food shacks here where you can buy drinks and snacks. One of the guy is really friendly. He can keep an eye on car too. He speaks little English. 

Regarding bathroom nearby restaurants and cafe you can go and use bathroom. They charge $500-1000 pesos for use. 
For water, go across the street to the University Residence hall parking drive, there is a faucet there. I am told it is potable water. 
A great place to stay in Manizales. DIAN is 10 min. walk away. 
I will add a pin to water faucet in ioverlander.

Location: El Balcón, Carrera 7, Confines, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Just in Front of grandpas hous
Description:
They were reconstructing road to te main square, so we couldn’t get there and we saw this place and kindly asked the old man, if we could stay here for a night. Grassy spot, in front of his house, locals told us it’s safe. Spot light in the night , quiet. You drive inside trough small gate, which stays open. 
We gave him 8 000 COP as thank you, he was happy, but haven’t expect to get something.

Location: Depresión El Vergel - Florencia, Florencia, Caquetá, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Florencia - Suaza layby
Description:
A wide flat area without a gate and a rudimentary structure as a meeting place.
Next to the road to San Agustín, protected from view next to the structure (see pictures).
No cell reception, just for a night on my way to San Agustín.
Probably won't stay open for long.

Location: Vía Otoval - Bocas - pueblo Viejo - Arales, El Peñón, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Finca el Chobo
Description: Very friendly young family with a beautiful property, who are just starting their “business”. They’re going to build step by step a parking lot, spaces for tents and shower plus bathroom (we used theirs - no problem) They have a beautiful view over their property, really breathtaking. The path to cueva el oro is starting right here and their son Hayder (14y) organized helmets and lamps and took us to the cave. Breathtaking! We payed 60.000cop/p for the hike and had two times delicious dinner with the family. Aswell whole fried fish. Each “comida” is 15.000cop. We were offered aswell some fresh juices of chobas. For staying overnight they charged 20.000cop for two adults and a child in a van on the grassy property with a view. From here you can walk to the pandora forest, but to stay here is half the price. ( at least :) )

Location: Guita, Suesca, Almeidas, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

En Aranzazu está este punto de EDS y se coparon para prestarnos una garrafa de 10 libras (4,5kg) para hacer nosotros mismos la recarga de nuestras garrafas (2 y 3 kg)

Un amigo de Manizales nos recomendó venir a este tradicional café a probar 2 cosas muy unicas y riquisimas: el macaná y los huevos al vapor. Muy muy recomendable.

Note, because it happened to us that we got stranded in El Cedral on our way out: The Chiva bus might not go to El Cedral, but only to La Suiza during weekdays! The Taxi is expensive! No phone signal anywhere.

Location: Calle 4A, Viejo San Fernando, Comuna 19, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760042, Colombia

Be warned that there’s 2 parkings, we had been at the one along the highway with of course noise all the night but fresh clean grass in front the truck. And there’s a second parking, to enter you have to drive under  a bridge with 2m50 high max. I think the security won’t be ok to stay the night in this one because it’s in the park, but the other one is ok. 
Anyway we have spend a good night even with the noise, securised by the guard all the night. 
Info : water park : 13000$pp (very cheap) but the half water slides are closed for security reason for 4 years. Beanie obligatory. Worth it if you have kids

Highly recommend.

Restaurante en frente barato también. 13K por el almuerzo.

Location: Tu Casa narural, Carrera 67B, Suramericana, Comuna 11 - Laureles-Estadio, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050034, Colombia

Location: Carrera 3, Onzaga, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Hostal El Parque
Description:
Good budget option located right on the main plaza next to the church. 

COP$30,000 per person. 

Motorcycle parking in the courtyard. 

Electric showers.

Location: Bancolombia, Calle 5, El Centro, Comuna 4, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 190003, Colombia

They have a lunch break from 12-2

Location: 19-40, Calle 1C, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Los Mártires, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 111411, Colombia
Name: Carlos Mesa Automotriz
Description:
Best taller in Bogotá. Clean, well organized. Fair local prices. They always explain you everything and show you the things to fix / to change before doing anything. They never change something for new if it can be fixed. 
I lived in bogotá for 4 years. They fixed my van all along. I wouldn't go to any other place in the capital. I am traveling in all south america... everything they did... was perfect! Highly recommended !!!

Please go early at the morning it is always full of taxi drivers waiting in front of the taller (taxi drivers know where to go to fix their cars). 

Ask Andres o Alex.

Location: Centro Histórico de Santa Marta, Carrera 3, Localidad 2 Histórica - Rodrigo de Bastidas, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470002, Colombia
Name: Robery to the car
Description:

But them stop him

Location: Carrera 18, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Casa Bahia Colonial
Description:
Very great place to stay while you are preparing to ship your vehicle by container or waiting for your container to arrive.
It's a family run hotel and the owner Andrés and his family are very nice and helpful. Highly recommended. 

It’s possible to park two vehicle in front of the hotel, very safe area and it has a fence around. 

Port and historic centre is both more or less 20 minutes to walk. 

Andrés is a very great host, in case that you need a parking space contact Andrés. WhatsApp +57 322 5050904

Location: 19, Calle 17, Centro, Comuna 1 - Centro, Perímetro Urbano Ibagué, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, 730001, Colombia

Location: Carrera 3, Horizontes, Filandia, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 634001, Colombia
Name: Bidea Hostel
Description:
You get can a hot shower at the hostel for 5000 COP. We messaged 
 ahead of time in WhatsApp, no problem.

Location: Filandia, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Finca Recua
Description:
Secure overnight parking is allowed with the purchase of a finca tour. 

There is space for 2 or 3 vehicles, and there are bathrooms and shower on site. 

A really great tour at a family run finca. Tours are around 4 hours long and go really in depth through the whole process. You can pick coffee beans, separate, roast and prepare great coffee.

Location: Carrera 1, Marbella, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 472000, Colombia
Name: Elvis "the stud mechanic"
Description:
We were stranded with our generator not working after shipping at Cartagena and our hotel (Bondo Estudio ) guy connected us to "Elvis Stiven" (mobile no. +57 300 7172945) who was an excellent electronic troubleshooter. 

The generator would not crank at all and even after trying to fix it ourselves by following the manual troubleshooting process we could not get it to start. We tried to show to another mechanic he also didn't have a clue. 

However Elvis came with another guy and they both figured that the motherboard was fried and they could see some components in the motherboard were black and burnt out. 

After spending 2 days and with the help of the wiring diagram (in English) he was able to fix the motherboard with a lot of trial and error. Fixing a motherboard is not easy specially when the circuit diagram is unknown but the way Elvis approached the problem was amazing. It was from basic principles studying each signal on the board by using a simple multimeter, figuring which components were not working and then replacing them one by one. I personally have seen very few people have this kind of a problem solving approach. Not to mention to work 10 hours (till 12:30am) at a stretch and then again come back on a Sunday to try to fix it. Plus he said if he'll charge X for fixing it and X/3 if he's unable to fix the problem. So his professionalism was also amazing..

Bottomline if you have any electrical or electronic problems in your vehicle in Cartagena, I would strongly advice you to reach out to him to get things fixed. He speaks broken English so communicating is relatively easier. He's available on WhatsApp also on this number.

Location: Vía a San Rafaél, Pardo, Potrerillo, Tuluá, Centro, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: FARC activity
Description:
We tried riding east from Tuluá through San Rafael > Roncesvalles > San Antonio. 
At about this location, there was FARC graffiti on a traffic sign.

We stopped a local on a motorcycle coming the other way, and asked if the route was safe, his face went grey when I mentioned Roncesvalles. I clarified, and asked if it was safe for foreigners. "Very dangerous." 

Back in Tuluá at a petrol station, we were approached by some Police (curious about our bikes and wanting to show us photos of theirs!)... I asked again, they said 100% this area is not safe for travel as a foreigner. 

Also, I asked about a different route days later with some locals around Tatacoa. They said that area is notorious. 

See other warnings about FARC presence of routes... I would avoid.

Location: Roncesvalles, Sur, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: FARC activity
Description: Please see warning I have placed further west on the road to Tuluá. We turned around trying to ride this route. Confirmed with locals and police that this area, associated with the name of this town has strong FARC presence and not safe for foreigners to travel.

Location: Calle 8, Natagaima, Sur, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Description:
I know from some others bikers the ferry does run, for us however there was only a "lancha" service. The trail going south on the East side of the river is... Hard-Very-Severe (HVS), with short sections that are not suitable for large bikes/two-up (maybe passable with some serious 4x4, but I'm not a four-wheel kinda guy). 

If you have small bikes, putting them on lanchas, and like rough terrain... It's great. 

I checked with a few locals. They said no concerns for Guerilla activity on the East bank between here and Tatacoa.

Location: Palomos, Fredonia, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Amaga Viaduct #2
Description:
To get here you have to ride some single track. The second Amaga viaduct is longer, far more dangerous, has huge gaps between the sleepers, no safety barrier, and does not have the centre line cemented for your convenience.... Yes, there are videos online of people "riding" across this one, but you need to place one foot on each sleeper and waddle across... Not for me. 

BUT. It is worth going to check it out and walk across it. It's a nicer looking bridge, a bit more rustic, and lacks the safety barrier.

There is a small hamlet with two grocery stores close by to buy supplies. 

A place to come to rest and enjoy nature.
