Location: Calle 10, Cabecera municipal Florida, Florida, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: KALDI BARRA CAFÉ
Description:
KALDI BC is a charming coffee shop that has been a part of the municipality of Florida, Valle for 12 years. Its cozy and relaxed atmosphere makes it the perfect place to have a coffee or tea, enjoy a dessert or simply relax and chat with friends. 

Also, their coffee is of high quality and can be enjoyed both hot and cold. The staff is friendly and attentive, which makes the experience at KALDI BC even better. 

If you are looking for a coffee shop in the Florida Valley, you should definitely visit KALDI BC.

Location: Carrera 12, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154001, Colombia
Name: El Chingón de Villa
Description: The best tacos we've had since Mexico! The very friendly guy running the place lived in Mexico for years and has his tacos down perfectly. speaks good English too, highly recommended!

Location: Variante Chicoral - Gualanday, El Caimito, Coello, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Tata
Description: Clean free cold showers behind the shop of the gas station.

Location: Total spanish, Carrera 37, Lalinde, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050021, Colombia
Name: Total Spanish language school
Description: Spanish school offering group and private lessons in el poblado area. 650k-700k per week depending on length of booking. After lesson activities for free or small cost 3-4 days a week (tours, salsa, language exchange etc). Definitely recommended but tbh all schools are probably the same

Location: Minca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470008, Colombia
Name: Dunarinka Hostal
Description: This was the best place we could find in Minca for our motorhome, especially if you have a smaller vehicle. Great view, electricity power, reasonable internet, clean and quiet. Hammocks and suspended net to chill. Close enough to the village but also to some beautiful hikes. Also possible to set a tent or rent a room. I think it’s ok even for bigger vans like a normal Sprinter, but might be tricky to level with a larger car. we loved staying here for two weeks. it's common that nobody is around so call the owner on the phone or keep waiting. Senora Luz is the owner. The price is 25k pp Price in June 2025 is 30k pp New contacts: dunarinkahostal@gmail.com https://www.dunarinka.com WhatsApp +573052595542

Location: EDS Villa María, Carrera 12, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Biomax Villamaria watertap
Description:
After we visited some campsites in the dessert where we found out they all have very low pressure water (non potable), so we went to ask for water here but the guy at the pomp said no. But after asking again he texted the owner and he came out of his house and was super friendly and was very happy to help us out! 
Super high pressure (what we need because we fill trough a filter system) so we filled up our tank in 10 minutes (225 Liter) he told us to come back when we needed a refill. Super nice guy! We also filled up our diesel tank afterwards. So great place so fill up you’re water before going into the dessert.
You can also clean your car here.

Location: Carrera 3, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Desert garden
Description: Super nice and tranquil restaurant with Vega option. If you like a peaceful place with chill music and no tv

Location: La Vega, Gualivá, RAP (Especial) Central, 253610, Colombia
Name: Clamping La Vega
Description: Went to ask if we could stay on his parking lawn for the night. There was water and nothing more. He asked 300.000 COP for one night. I said no way and then said 150.000 COP. I said thank you and good bye  don’t waste you’re time on this street.

Location: Parabricentro Fontibon, 120 80, Avenida Calle 17, La Perla, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Fontibón, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 110921, Colombia
Name: La Rueda tires and Alignment
Description: Perfect shop to let your wheels aligned. We needed to let our Mercedes Sprinter 2021 to be aligned and they do a pro job here. We paid 105.000 COP so a very good price for a 2 hour job (including switching the front wheels with the back wheels)

Location: Sutamarchán, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 153860, Colombia
Name: Close to the olive farm
Description: Nice and quite place to spend the night if you want to go to the olive farm the next morning. We came late in the evening so this was a good option for us

Location: EFECTY SERVIENTREGA 7 DE AGOSTO, 26-25, Calle 66, Siete de Agosto, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 111221, Colombia
Name: Carlos H. Cabaliero pneumatic parts
Description: Shop where they sell pneumatic parts for compressor

Location: Calle 140B, La Chucua, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Suba, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111131, Colombia
Name: Mag motorhomes
Description: Mag Motorhomes is a high end camper builder so he can help you out with everything you need

Location: Carrera 38, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Puente Aranda, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111611, Colombia
Name: Super Llantas
Description: Good shop where you can replace your tires. Ask for Giovanny. They have all the good brands and have a lot of knowledge of the tires

Location: Carrera 69C, La Floresta, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Suba, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 111121, Colombia
Name: Mercedes Benz Motorysa
Description: This is the official Mercedes dealer in Bogota where they also maintain Sprinters. This is a professional workshop! They helped me out with a problem with the engine of my 2021 Sprinter caused by a disconnected cable on the air filter what was caused by Tramicon. So if you have any issues with your Mercedes Sprinter go here and DON’T GO TO TRAMICON! they are a bunch of monkeys!

Location: Carrera 47, Comuna 12 - Cabecera del Llano, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 680003, Colombia
Name: Next to the library
Description: We found this spot better than the other spot “Bucaramanga” quite place with a garbage can nearby. If you need water go to the teleferico during the day. They will charge you 7K to 12K Cop for parking during the daytime (closing at 21:00) perfect clear potable water with high pressure outlet. With good cell phone reception

Location: Anillo Vial Vía Girón, Girón, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 687541, Colombia
Name: Primax gas station
Description: We spend the night at this place because Mercedes has a workshop here for vans and trucks. And we could fill our tank at the gas station. Non potable but crystal clear and high pressure. The tap is next to the small white building. Ask the employees

Location: Barrancas, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Water at gas station
Description: Gas station with potable water. We asked if we could fill up our tank and he said no problem. The guy called said it was potable water. Looks very clear and we fill true filters so for us it’s good to drink any way. We paid him 5K as a donation

Location: Vía al Mar, Tubará, Atlántico, RAP Caribe, 081001, Colombia
Name: Toll port behind the store
Description: There is a water point behind the store at this toll port. The water looks crystal clear and has a lot of pressure. Ask the guy from the store if you can fill up and he will say yes. Nice guy.

Location: Buritaca, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Hostal Baruch
Description:
We got water from the owner and paid him 10 K
Very nice guy! The water comes directly from the river so is not potable but it’s pretty clear and has good pressure. Water is super hard to get from Santa Marta till Rioacha so we added this one for the ones in surch of water. We fill true a three stage filter so we need some pressure to be able to fill our tank and we need water with not to much dirt in in because of that.

Location: Al Toque, Rodadero - Cruce Alcatraces, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 005075, Colombia
Name: Potable water at gas station Arcos
Description: I asked for water and they were happy to help. The guy had to put the pump to get it running. Water looks super clean and because of the pump it has good pressure. I think it is potable water, but we fill true a filter system so for us it’s good

Location: Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470006, Colombia
Name: Playa Bello Horizonte
Description:
Great place at the beach. Super quit at night. Not to many mosquitoes (compared to Gaira)
We stayed here for five nights in a few weeks time and after a few nights the cops came to tell us the apartement complex complained so they asked us to stay a little further from the beach in the same street along road during the night. Other than that this is a perfect place in Santa Marta! 100 meters away there is a water tap we could use after asking the security with very clean water and high pressure!

Location: Cocora, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Park and hike big & small loop
Description:
This is where you park your vehicle and as you get out of the parking lot, make a left. Follow the sidewalk as you walk out of the parking lot on your left to the park Boletería. It is 200-300m on your right. You cannot miss it. You will have to pay a fee of 20k pedos. If you want to do the big loop,  which takes about 6 hours and you walk through 5 Miradors,  stay on the left and follow red marking on park map at entrance. You will be going counterclockwise. If you intend to do the small loop (2 hrs), follow the same route as long route to Mirador 2, then hike back down slope to Mirador 1 and get to entrance from where you started. 

For the long route, must do Mirador 1 and then Mirador 2.

Location: Pijao, Cordillerana, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 632020, Colombia
Name: Mirador Pijao Quindio
Description:
Great views of the valley. you could also park here by the night. locals told me it's safe. there may be some traffic noise at night.
I'm  sure on the weekends the locale may be coming here and enjoying musics and drinks. Beware of that.

Location: Panamericana, Chachagüí, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Hotel Arizona (formerly known as Biomax)
Description: Clean small hotel on Panamerica. 28k as of 09/2024. Cold showers, WiFi, may have hot water eventually as there are wires sticking out of the wall.

Location: La Manuela, Puerto Asís, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Hotel Limoncocha
Description:
A hotel with a big parking space for motorhomes. They have a big seating space under roof with tables, chair and hammocks. WC and showers. Internet and electricity. $5 per vehicle per night. They can also wash your clothes in their washing machine and dry it in drier, price $1.5 per kilo. 
the family lives there, they are very kind and have a friendly dog. The hotel doesn't have a sign, it's just a big house.

Location: SANTA RITA, Agrado, Centro, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Rio Magdalena
Description: Good camping spot Big, easy to access safe and very calm during the nigth

Location: Carrera 27A, Siete de Agosto, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota Capital District - Municipality, RAP (Especial) Central, 111221, Colombia
Name: Ruben Alternadores
Description: Came here for recommendation from an electrician in Tenjo (also in iOverlander). You can bring your alternator here to repair.

Location: Carrera 3, Loma de Cartagena, Comuna 4, Popayán, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 190003, Colombia
Name: El Payanés - Cafeteria/Restaurante
Description: Menu for 12,000 COP, including soup, main course, juice. Friendly staff. Outdoor area. Live music. Clean. Recommended.

Location: Machetá, Almeidas, RAP (Especial) Central, 250840, Colombia
Name: Machetà climbing house
Description:
Catalina runs a small climbers refuge where she rents cabañas and tents. She has a spot for one Overlander rig to park/camp in her property for 20k per night. Toilet, outdoor shower, chill out area and kitchen for use.
Find them on Instagram before showing up.
The climbing crag is next door with an entry fee of 7500pp.

Location: Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Playeta
Description: We were here on a Saturday morning and it was very peaceful. A couple was selling lunch (we had a delicious fish with coconut rice, patacones and salad for 35.000cop.) They let us park and stay how long as we wanted. We didn’t spend the night here but they said it was ok. Best spot for snorkeling! Don’t forget your sandals to go in the water and to pass the rocks to see the corals and fish.

Location: Diagonal 13, Bojacá, Casco urbano de Chía, Chía, Sabana Centro, RAP (Especial) Central, 250002, Colombia
Name: wash&go lavanderia automatica
Description:
One of the few laundromats in Colombia. It's placed in a shopping court with many amenities nearby. New machines and toilet/table/wifi. 24k for wash and dry of the standard units (soap and softener included) and 32k for the bigger one. 90 min for full circle washer drier. We started the washer and went shopping, and the owners started driers and Whatsapped us when the circles were done.
Underground parking part of the shopping mall, owners will let you park near the entrance if you have a bigger rig (like it was our case).
Washed and dried all our stuff (15kg+) for 56k which we thought was a very competitive price.
This is a mom&pop shop and the owners are super nice and speak English too.

Location: Vía Bogotá - Choachí, Choachí, Oriente, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: ecoparque el mirador de choachi
Description: We could not find a quiet place to stay near the rock climbing area till we spotted this mirador. Asked the owner Roberto to stay in the parking lot of the mirador. He's a truly wonderful person and let us stay for free, use the toilets, showers, and offered us coffee and soda. He's building the land into a camping/recreational area that includes a dog park and play area so I'm sure the facilities will improve soon too.

Location: Guacamayas, Gutiérrez, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 151220, Colombia
Name: Landslides
Description: Not possible to go this way. Landslides. you have to go all the way round

Location: Charguayaco, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Genoa community Center
Description:
I was attending Zona Gastronomia in Pasto when I met Natalia, owner of AndandoTravel agency and inquired about the wild camping in Pasto so she recommended Tarmales de Genoa. Unfortunately when I got done there, it was late in the evening and when I got here after a 15-20 minutes drive it was dark and Tamales was closed so instead of getting into an unknown spot I turn around and stopped at one of the houses and ask them if I could park around their street.  They advised me to park it at this spot and indicated it is really safe place, no problems at all. The night was quiet and tranquil and no problems at all. 
The back option is also Termales de Genoa park lot ( if there is one, I did not check) which is little bit up a hill from here (just about 2 minutes drive on the right)  if you come before they close for the day.

PLEASE ASK BEFORE PARKING HERE

Location: Valle del Guamuez (La Hormiga), Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Ayahuasca and camping
Description:
We came here after a recommendation from fellow Colombian travelers. Taita, a local shaman (his name is Jesus) does Ayahuasca ceremonies here every Saturday. Other indigenous people from other villages come for the ceremony. We were the only foreigners (and one Italian guy who lives in Quito). It's 50k per person for Ayuaska and if you want "cleaning" in the morning it's another 50k. They let us stay one more night here just so we can relax after the ceremony. It's authentic not touristic place so the experience is more raw. However, it's not very big space, with us there were another 25 people and it was overcrowded. But they say that's not usually the case....
Safe and tranquil place to stay. Electricity, Internet, bathroom, showers.

Location: Calle 3, San Martín, Salado Blanco, Totoró, Oriente, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Hotel
Description: 80,000 Col Pesos for two people for one night. We came here with our bikes, stored them downstairs. We got two double beds. There’s a private bathroom, hot water included.

Location: Vía a las Lajas, Colina Verde, Las Lajas, Ipiales, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524067, Colombia
Name: Mirador Las Lejas Church.
Description:
This is the Mirador where you should stop first if your driving your own car when you come to see Las Lejas Church. The street side  parking is limited here but if you come during the weekdays you should be okay to park. Great view of the Valley and the church. Once you are done here then you should drive downhill the road and get to park your vehicle in town and hike down to the church. You can also  hike  up the hill to Telefrrique there's a pin for that in ioverlander. It is 15 min. hike. 

I asked the local taxi driver what was the best way to see the church, they said you should park your car in the town hike down to the church which is easy(downhill) then take the Telefrtique up and back seeing the church in the valley with an aerial view and then climbing up to where your car was parked in the town.

For people with limit mobility and hiking problems I would come to the Mirador first then drive up to take roundtrip to Telefrtique. after you are done you can stay overnight there in your car it is free.

Location: Calle 4, Las Lajas, Ipiales, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524067, Colombia
Name: Las Lejas Church parking
Description:
if you do not intend to take hike to the church you can park the car here. Initially attendant asked me that I will have to leave the keys to which I declined but later he found me a spot. It was really crowded so on the weekends there's no way you'll be able to park here at least unless you come bright and early. Weekdays there is a possibility. 

The charges here are $1 for the first hour and $1 for an additional hour.

if you cannot find the parking here maybe in town you can find it I did not look for it the other option is you can go to teleferique and hike down and up, 45 minutes each way

Location: Calle 14B, Comuna 5, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520003, Colombia
Name: hotel santa clara
Description: Great hotel, brand new renovated rooms, smells good, very clean, garage for car or motorcycle available. bed is a bit hard but 30k for a double bed room. the guy at the reception is very nice.

Location: 35-175, Carrera 17, Urb. La Española, Torices, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 472000, Colombia
Name: Calle 17, Cartagena
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: WARNING!!! Thefts and vandalism reported in this location. Please use caution.
-----------
Robbery just after the castle San Felipe around 10pm by a group of 8 that took us by surprise while we were walking (4 adults). It is recommended to use taxi/uber from the end of daytime out of El Centro, Boca Grande and Manga. If not, be aware of any motorcyclist that passes by.

Location: Avenida Trisesquicentenario, Santa Cruz de Mompós, Santa Cruz de Mompox, Depresión Momposina, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 132560, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero El Rey
Description:
Secured short term parking along the main road. You might even pass the night, we just parked for a couple of hours while visiting the town (beautiful).

Around 3k / hour

Location: Viracachá, Márquez, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Fuente antigua
Description:
Overnight stay, no security problems and very close to town. There is a water source and a historical site 
--------
Sitio para pernoctar, sin problemas de seguridad y muy cerca al pueblo. Hay una fuente de agua y un sitio histórico

Location: Hacienda el Tivoli, Vereda Centro, Sáchica, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 153880, Colombia
Name: Casa cantarana
Description:
Casa Cantarana is a spiritual retreat held by Temascals and they have music classes.
It has parking for campers and several cars. There is plenty of space to pitch tents. The entrance is a bit hidden. To receive information write to Violeta. 
The services are WiFi bathrooms and showers. 
It's 20'000 pp a night. If they want, they can also offer work help around the house instead of payment.

Casa cantarana es un retiro espiritual que hacen temascales y tienen clases de música.
Tiene parqueadero para camperos y varios carros. Hay mucho espacio para armar carpas. La entrada está un poco escondida. Para recivir informaciones escribenle a Violeta. 
Los servicios son WiFi baños y duchas. 
Son 20'000 pp la noche. Si quieren también pueden ofrecer ayuda laboral alrededor de la casa en vez de el pago.

Location: Popayán, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Finca Pilaju nuevo
Description: We have built a new campground in the beautiful area of Vereda Clarete bajo. This small village is safe and very close located to Popayan. This campground is owned by a very friendly and helpful family. Alexa, Frankie and Laura give you a very warm welcome. The campground itself provides all services you need as an Overlander. Flat and grassy area, electricity (if needed), potable water, wifi, showers and restrooms. They also offer a room with a double bed and a single bed in their house. Also your pet is very welcomed and has a lot of space on this property. They also can wash your clothes, do not hesitate to ask Alexa for this service. It costs an extra amount

Location: El Retiro, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 055010, Colombia
Name: Trakventure Casa Turpial
Description: Welcome to Casa Turpial, the main headquarters of TrakVenture. Here, you can stay for free as many days as you need. There is a room available for your stay. If you prefer to camp, there is an extensive area where you can do so. We have a bathroom with a hot shower, WiFi, a kitchen, and drinkable water. The camping area also has access to the kitchen and bathroom. Regarding cell signal, there is good reception for Claro operators. For Tigo and others, the signal is not very strong. Additionally, there are two restaurants nearby, and we are located approximately 15 to 20 minutes from La Ceja, El Retiro, and Llanogrande. Welcome! For anything you need, please contact us at 311-308-0997 or through Trakventure’s social media channels @trakventure

Location: Hotel Álamos del Parque, 24 139, Calle 13, Los Angeles, Universidad, AMCO, Area Metropolitana Centro Occidente, Pereira, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660003, Colombia
Name: Residential Area
Description: Super nice area in a very residential neighbourhood, we were trying to park in Parque Álamos but there weren’t spots available, so we parked here instead and had a really chill and safe evening. Very friendly area aswell, with a lot of cafes and restaurants. Definitely recommend!

Location: Mambrú, 10-47, Carrera 5, Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056050, Colombia
Name: Mambru
Description: Mhhhh ! Amazing cocktails and food : the pizzas are excellent !

Location: Diagonal 99, Urbanización La Campiña, Apartadó, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057840, Colombia
Name: Casa Hotel Mateguadua
Description:
This is an 8-room hotel outside Apartadó. Comfortable and affordable. So far, in Colombia, many hotels are not cyclist-friendly, and bringing the bike to the room requires extra effort. So, this is the hotel for us. For overlanders, the hotel has a parking lot in front for medium-sized vehicles. The price range is: for a single room, 90,000 pesos, and for a double room, 135,000 pesos. Includes Wi-Fi, parking, and breakfast.
---
Este es un hotel de 8 habitaciones en las afueras de Apartadó. Cómodo y asequible. Hasta ahora, en Colombia, muchos hoteles no son amigables para ciclistas, y llevar la bicicleta a la habitación requiere un esfuerzo extra. Por lo tanto, este es el hotel para nosotros. Para los viajeros en vehículos grandes, el hotel cuenta con un estacionamiento al frente para vehículos medianos. El rango de precios es: para una habitación individual, 90,000 pesos, y para una habitación doble, 135,000 pesos. Incluye Wi-Fi, estacionamiento y desayuno.

Location: Carrera 100, Barrio La Unión, Chigorodó, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Hotel Aventuras de Occidente
Description: For cyclists and backpackers only. The place does not have parking, but bicycles can easily be brought into the rooms. It is a safe and clean place. It only has rooms with fans and private bathrooms. The price for a single room is 30,000 pesos. There are supermarkets and affordable dining options nearby. --- Solo para cicloturistas y mochileros. El lugar no tiene parqueo, pero las bicicletas se pueden meter fácilmente en las habitaciones. Es un sitio seguro y limpio. Solo cuenta con habitaciones con ventilador y baño incluido. El precio por una habitación sencilla es de 30000 pesos y 40000. En los alrededores hay supermercados y lugares donde comer barato.

Location: Cacao Hostal, Carrera 11, Localidad 2 Histórica - Rodrigo de Bastidas, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470004, Colombia
Name: Cacao Hostel
Description:
Nice clean hostel for 32k/night with cooked desayuno and air con rooms at night. Swimming pool and bar but doesn’t get rowdy. Bit of a walk to the malecón but one walk there was enough to see it (dirty beach with rubbish, homeless, drug dealers everywhere). Definitely recommended if you need somewhere in Santa Marta. 

Plenty of motorcycle parking, cars on the street.

Location: Calle Circunvalar, Coloyita, Líbano, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, 731040, Colombia
Name: Hostal nature green
Description: Hostel under construction. Already has a couple of rooms available and you can camp in one of the unfinished apartments with an amazing view for $15.000 pesos.

Location: Residencia Mutatá, Carrera 10, Mutatá, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057420, Colombia
Name: Hotel Mutatá
Description:
Hostel with 14 rooms, ideal for cyclists and backpackers. The rooms have a bathroom, Wi-Fi, and a fan. There is no parking, but bicycles can be brought into the room. The cost of a single room is 40,000 pesos. It is located by the roadside, and there are places to eat and a supermarket nearby.

---
Hostal con 14 habitaciones, ideal para cicloviajeros y mochileros. Las habitaciones tienen baño, Wi-Fi y ventilador. No hay parqueo, pero se puede meter la bicicleta en la habitación. El costo de una habitación sencilla es de 40.000 pesos. Está a la orilla de la carretera y hay lugares para comer y un supermercado cerca.

Location: Vía Cimitarra - Landazuri, Aguachica, Landázuri, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Punto costeño
Description: A really cool place with very friendly owners. Super clean, loads of parking, food, drinks, clean bathrooms. A recommended stop on this route!

Location: Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 005075, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero Cabo Tortuga
Description:
Only 200 meters from the beach you will find this small parking with the most welcoming people. They have water, shower, electricity... We felt like at home and we ended up spending Christmas and New Year together. 
They charged us 10.000 COP per night (we are 5, they charge per vehicle, not per person). 
You can also rent an small apartment with bathroom and small kitchen.

Location: Aguanile Youth Hostel - alternative medicine, Antigua vía del Ferrocarril, La Explanación, Boquía, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631027, Colombia
Name: Posada Aguanile
Description:
A fantastic hostel with lots of secure parking on grass. Plenty of space to camp, we stayed in a room though for a break! There’s a gate to get through but no height restrictions for it.
They do laundry for 25,000 onsite, also their breakfast is the best breakfast we’ve had in all of South America. 
Great for not having to drive or park in town, buses come by often and it’s 2,000 in or out of town from here and around 10 minutes on the bus. 
Drinking water, kitchen, relaxing space all available. Would highly recommend!

Location: Vía Duitama-Charalá, Vereda Santa Barbara, Duitama, Tundama, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Abandoned house for cyclists
Description: Abandoned house next to the road with great views. Very hidden behind some pine trees and no visible entrance to go down. But it‘s possible to get bikes down a little path. Door is open. We asked the neighbour (the arepas place). She wouldn‘t let us camp at her house but said it‘s fine to come here (house of her sister or something). We cleaned the anteroom a little bit to put the tent. Two more rooms but lot‘s of dirty stuff. Maybe fits two tents. Please don’t leave anything behind!

Location: Doradal, Puerto Triunfo, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Apartahoteles Eliana
Description:
MODERATOR NOTE: Place added by owner/manager

Eliana Aparthotels, excellent furnished apartments for your relaxation, have private parking, available all year round, air conditioning, kitchen, living room, laundry room, refrigerator and more. Excellent location in Doradal, just one kilometer from Hacienda Nápoles. Cell phone +57 3217182042
----
Apartahoteles Eliana, unos excelentes apartamentos amoblados para su descanso, cuenta con parqueadero privado, disponible todo el año, aire acondicionado, cocina, sala, lavadero, nevera y demás, Excelente sitio en Doradal, a tan solo un kilómetro de la Hacienda Nápoles. Celular +57 3217182042

Location: Aratoca, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Finca El Nogal
Description:
Great place to spend the night in an authentic artisan coffee finca. Very welcoming to people in a 450-year-old house. the price of 25,000 pesos per person includes the night and the visit to the farm. accessible to all types of vans or camping cars even 2wd but not certain for big rigs.
we went there with à 7m sprinter 4x4.
Before coming, please contact Elvin.
Whatsapp +573142175211.

Location: Primax, 66, Barrancabermeja, Yariguíes, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 687031, Colombia
Name: Hotel/ Gas Station Olga Lucia
Description: Very good place to park your RV or Campervan. Very safe and cost 6000 pesos. In the hotel is posible to pay the pool service all day. Here is also a store

Location: Vda. Nuevo Tolima, San José del Guaviare, Guaviare, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Rupiguare
Description:
At this site you will find the rock paintings of Nuevo Tolima. It is a large, flat, quiet and beautiful garden.  Fast Starlink internet, clean and comfortable bathrooms, and the locals are very, very friendly. The entrance fee to the attraction varies as follows: Colombians $22,000, foreigners $25,000, and the cost of the guide $30,000 for groups of 1 to 5 and $50,000 for 1 to 10. Sleeping at night is a pleasure, because of the tranquility. In addition, there is a natural creek very close where you can bathe.
The value for accommodation is $10,000 per person.
WhatsApp 3116471663.

En este sitio encontrarás las pinturas rupestres de Nuevo Tolima. Es un amplio jardín, plano, tranquilo y bello. Internet rápido de Starlink, baños limpios y cómodos y las personas del lugar muy, muy amables. La entrada a la atracción varía así: colombiano $22.000 extranjero $25.000 y el costo del guía $30.000 de grupos de 1 a 5 y $50.000 de 1 a 10. Dormir en la noche es un placer, por la tranquilidad. Además, hay un caño natural muy cerca donde puedes bañarte.
El valor por el alojamiento, es de $10.000 por persona.

Location: Vía Bogotá - Choachí, Choachí, Oriente, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: on farmers land, below climbing crags agua dulce
Description: the super nice owner Jorge let us stay here for three nights, ideally located for climbing, no facilities except for water. toilet at the climbing registration place down the road. bad signal. hot shower possible at the refugio across the road. no shops nearby. cows roam the land:)

Location: Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520001, Colombia
Name: hombrecitos
Description: we camped here for two nights while rock climbing at hombrecitos. pullout just perfect for our truck camper. no facilities.claro signal. nobody bothered us. sound of rover and wind. nice views.

Location: Carrera 2, Horizontes, Filandia, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 634001, Colombia
Name: Parking
Description:
Secure parking spot
3,000 per hour
25,000 per day

Great for staying in a hostel in town since they were the same price as camping outside when we visited. 
No height restrictions, plenty of space in the lot
We stayed overnight here. Very friendly owner, basic but very clean toilet, great view over the valley to the mountains, quiet on a Friday night, no barking dogs. 25,000 Colombian pesos

Location: Hostal Casa Victoria Pijao, 7 11, Carrera 6, Pijao, Cordillerana, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 632060, Colombia
Name: El Deposito Café
Description: Really nice little spot for a tasty coffee. Family run, coffee straight from the finca with homemade cakes and treats. Cool rustic feel inside.

Location: Sauka Loft - Rincon del Mar, Puente Artesanal La Punta, Rincón del Mar, San Onofre, Morrosquillo, Sucre, RAP Caribe, 707017, Colombia
Name: Taida Hostel
Description: Nice hostel for 42k. iOverlanders pay 28k each person. 15-20k for breakfast. Safe gated parking for bicycles and motorbikes, possibly a car. Air conditioned rooms. They also own the hostel across the road which is a bit cheaper but I think without air con. The owner is a traveler himself having spent 3 years going around South America on a tuk tuk which he still has and has written a great book about.

Location: Carrera 10, Amuchen, Uribia, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Hostal Meta
Description:
Despite being called a hostel it is small private rooms with ensuite only. 70k was the price they decided on when I asked (I didn’t have a reservation) so certainly open to negotiation if saving 2 dollars is your thing. Rooms have air con and plenty of secure parking (despite being behind a big gate they made me put everything from my moto in my room). Must be almost brand new, very clean. 

This is the last main town before going to the northern point, if you’re not doing that, there’s no point coming this far. Otherwise, I think my favourite part of this town will be leaving it. There’s no super mercados just lots of tiendas you can’t enter, resupply before coming this far.

Location: Vía a Guateque, Chocontá, Machetá, Almeidas, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 250840, Colombia
Name: El sabor de mi rancho
Description:
It's a restaurant called el sabor de mi rancho We spent the night for a reasonable price The night was quiet, a little noise from trucks, but normal. 
Es un restaurante que se llama el sabor de mi rancho 

Pasamos la noche por un precio razonable 

La noche estuvo tranquila, un poco de ruido de camiones, pero normal

Location: Mirador La Chapa, Camino real, Pandi, Sumapaz, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Mirador La Chapa
Description:
It is a tourist place that has a restaurant, swimming pool, billiards and shuffleboard. They allow camping anywhere for 5000 COP per person per night (price 2024). There is access to water, bathrooms and showers.
--
Es un lugar turístico que cuenta con restaurante, piscina, billar y tejo. Permiten acampar en cualquier lugar por 5000 COP por persona por noche (precio 2024). Hay acceso a agua, baños y duchas

Location: Dorada Stereo 89.1 F.M, 15-35, Carrera 3, La Dorada, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 175031, Colombia
Name: Villa del Rio
Description: Very simple hotel, but very inexpensive. 25k for a single room. Bikes can be stored inside the hotel or in the corridor. The staff are very friendly and WiFi works well at reception but doesn't always reach the rooms at the back. Quiet but close to everything.

Location: Cerrito, García Rovira, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Glamping La Loma
Description: glamping complex under construction with infrastructure to stop with Camper, very quiet and with good views. ..... complejo de glamping en construcción con infraestructura para parar con Camper, muy tranquilo y con buenas vistas

Location: Morro Amarillo, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056050, Colombia
Name: Finca Patio Bonito
Description: Beautiful finca hotel with shared kitchen facilities. A bit pricey but great if you fancy a treat (we managed to get a last minute deal on booking.com on a quiet Monday night). Up in the hills around Jardín surrounded by coffee and bananas - super tranquil.

Location: El Jardín de Jardín, 6-04, Calle 11, Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056050, Colombia
Name: Tepuyé
Description: Little cafe that does fantastic pizzas and really lovely sandwiches. Staff are super friendly and the place has a great atmosphere and loads of books to read through while you have your coffee 100% recommend for a tasty lunch or dinner.

Location: Amuchen, Uribia, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Supermercado
Description:
This is the only supermercado in Uribia and the last one you’ll see if heading north. Minimal fresh food. Advisable to stock up in Riohacha instead. They take card which is unusual for the area.

Next door is the ferrematerials which seems to have a surprisingly large stock of general hardware items, engine oil, tyres etc. 

Across the road is a Lavadero for washing the Punta Gallina salt off but probably only suitable for motos.

Location: 12-75, Carrera 18, Pinares de San Martin, Universidad, Perimetro Urbano Pereira, Pereira, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660003, Colombia
Name: Dental Coworking
Description: It is difficult to find a real dental surgeon among all these orthodontists who only work on the aesthetics of the teeth. Germán Betancur is a true professional. He intervened to treat an infection, remove the crowns of an implant, improve the possibility of cleaning them and put them back in place. He explains particularly well what he is going to do. Perfect equipment and hygiene. Dental office 1101 on the 11th floor of Torre 2 in the Pinares center. WSP of thé office :  +57 318 827 27 55. Recommended.

Location: calle 14, Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056050, Colombia
Name: Cerveza Artesanal
Description:
Little shop that sells all sorts of artesanal beer, and hats and shirts. Run by a lovely family, they have like 40 different artesanal beers and all like 13,000 or 15,000. 
A few seats around or you can take them to go!

Location: Carrera 5, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Pandemono Bakery
Description: One of the few places where you can enjoy good bakery products (cinnamon rolls, empanadas de horno, exceptional pan de bono) with juice and coffee in complete silence. No music, just a quite courtyard with the wind rustling through the plants.

Location: estacion de bomberos, Apartadó - Turbo, Bellavista, Turbo, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057868, Colombia
Name: bombereros, fire station turbo
Description:
crossed the darien gap with a motorcycle on boat from Panama, in capurcana put the motorcycle on a cargo boat and me on a speed boat, so the boat with my motorcycle arrived later than expected, so camped at this fire station for the night, tomorrow will collect my bike and do the tip paperwork. 
really nice firefighters, camped in the TV room, bucket shower.

Location: Restaurant, Dabeiba - Mutatá, Santa Teresa, Mutatá, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057420, Colombia
Name: Next to „62“
Description: It is a large gravel area next to a small hotel and a small restaurant which is closed

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Cosmos Tatacoa Hotel
Description:
Great hotel for overlanders. Secure parking for motorcycles and cars, although we just left ours outside the hotel as it feels like a very safe town, but there's a large lockable gate. 
Rooms are large and very clean, fast WiFi, a swimming pool, private bathrooms, breakfast included, restaurant, friendly staff. 
For a double room for two people we paid 120,000COP. 

It's close to the town too, but just far enough away that there's no noise. We just rode our motorbikes to the red and grey desert and then to the observatory. But there's tour guides here if you prefer. 

thanks

Location: Hotel Torres de Oro, Calle 14, Ipiales, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524060, Colombia
Name: Hotel Danevi
Description: Brand new hotel, only been in business for a month, so currently (October 2024) it has few reviews on GoogleMaps. But what a nice hotel! Everything new, everything modern, everything clean, fast wifi, large flatscreen smart tv with streaming services. Located in the center, near the square and in the middle of many shops and restaurants. An attractive price/quality ratio: we paid 80k for a double room.

Location: Vía Barrichara Galán - Zapatoca, La Paz, Galán, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Restaurant by the river
Description: Restaurant/shop off to the road with ample parking, roofed pavilions, bathrooms, wifi, access to the river. Good for tents and vans. Quiet and green.

Location: Troncal del Magdalena, Rivera, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: RESTAURANTE "EL PORTAL CAMPESTRE"
Description: Delicious food stop, they're cooking meat on spits and smoking it and you're brought a big plate of delicious meats. Very friendly and well worth a stop if you're hungry!

Location: Juan de Acosta, Atlántico, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Ecohostal Campomar
Description:
Campomar is a smal dry tropical forest, with 3 eco-lodges and a house, surrounded by more than 108 species of birds.
The wifi And cellphone signal is good. 
The electricity has 110 voltage available. 
Food
Treeplatform for readng
Birdswatching
A little pool
Surfskate concrete wave
Parking

Location: Cabecera Municipal Lebrija, Lebrija, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Club campestre Ferrosantander
Description:
A place with many services, completely safe and very friendly. Good place to spend time with the family or to rest. The road is good with a small slope at the entrance but any 4*2 can cope with it without problems. We were charged 40k for 2 people 2 dogs. There are barbecue grills and games such as pool and shuffleboard at no extra cost. 
---
Un sitio con muchos servicios, completamente seguro y muy amables. Buen sitio para pasar en familia o descansar. La vía es buena con una pequeña pendiente a la entrada pero cualquier 4*2 puede afrontarlo sin inconvenientes. Nos cobraron 40 mil por 2 personas 2 perros. Hay hornillas para asar y juegos como billar y tejo sin costo adicional

Location: Ruta del Cable 1 - Zapatoca - Minas - Raspaculos - Villanueva - San Gil - Los Santos Pueblo y La mesa con Barco, San Pablo, Zapatoca, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 604069, Colombia
Name: Mirador Guane...... Allá arriba en aquel alto
Description: The owners of the restaurant „Allá arriba en aquel alto“ let you camp in front of their restaurant. Ample parking with great views over the canyons. For tents and rigs (if you manage to drive the road up here). On weekends they play music until late (after midnight), even though only very view people were there. But there is enough space to camp a bit further away.

Location: Calle 24, Manga, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Parking with a city view
Description: This place was quiet and safe with police occasionally driving by. It’s along a sidewalk where lots of people exercise during the day, and has a great view of the city. It has restaurants and grocery stores in walking distance, and about a 15 minute walk to Getsemani

Location: Barranco de Loba, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Ferry (moto and ppl only)
Description:
Ferry over the river.
Motorcycle, people and animals only
No cars
3k cop
Don’t catch this boat unless you’re comfortable with what may be ahead, the road turns in to moto/horse only trail and gets remote with road blocks and groups asking questions. It’s ‘un poco caliente’ beyond here

Location: EDS La Hormiga, Carrera 15, Comuna 3 - San Francisco, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 680001, Colombia
Name: Lavador with pressure cleaner
Description:
Car wash with proper pressure cleaners, first I’ve seen in Colombia. Let me take my plastics off and gave it a proper clean. Don’t come here if you’re precious about where the water goes cos they’ll clean everything.
15k for a moto
Unsure about car costs, plenty of room for big rigs

Location: Carrera 2A, Pácora, Norte, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 172040, Colombia
Name: Polideportivo Pacora
Description:
A safe and friendly place to park, spend the day and sleep. There are bathrooms and drinking water. The ground is level. There are also swimming pools. Everything is free. For your peace of mind, when you arrive, ask the manager, Mr. Aurelio (everyone knows him as PARTNER). We spent two nights and walked to the city center.

lugar seguro y amable para estacionar, pasar el día y dormir. Hay baños y agua potable. el terreno es horizontal. También hay piscinas. Todo es gratis. Para su tranquiñidad cuando llegue consulte al encargado que es el señor Aurelio (todos lo conocen como SOCIO). Pasamos dos noches y fuimos caminando hasta el centro de la ciudad.

Location: Posada Saquenzipa, 11A-16, Calle 12, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154001, Colombia
Name: Posada La Rioja
Description: Warm shower. Friendly lady. Clean room. Place for parking in the street. 5000 pesos pp.

Location: Aldea de Piedras, Jericó, Cabecera Municipal Jericó, Jericó, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056010, Colombia
Name: Palmar de Jerico Suites
Description: Great apartment style hotel, each room has a lounge area and kitchenette with hob, fridge and microwave and private bathroom. There’s a ‘minibar’ with reasonably priced drinks and snacks in each room and supermarkets nearby. Good WiFi and a desk in each room if you need a place to work too. Parking outside the hotel but on a super quiet cul-de-sac street. Really lovely staff and super clean. We paid 132k COP for a double room (their double rooms all have 2 double beds) but other size rooms available too

Location: El Socorro, San Luis, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Zona de Camping
Description: Beautiful campsite next to the river (possible to swim in the river) with a simple bathroom and shower. Very stable Wifi. Big rig friendly and enough space for 5-6 vehicles. Easy and paved access from San Luis. We paid 20k cop for 2 in a van.

Location: Calle 21, San Luis, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Stunning La Planta waterfall
Description: This is the free parking and the start of the walk to the beautiful La Planta Waterfall. From the secure parking it's 600 stairs to the waterfall with a massive swimming hole, 40m deep. Easy walk and a great swim. Completely free. We highly recommend it.

Location: Guatavita, Guavio, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 251060, Colombia
Name: Camping finca las acacias
Description:
Camping finca las acacias is close to the village and very quiet, they are animal lovers, has parking, they offer many plans within them hiking, sailing, ATV. They also offer breakfast, lunch and dinner and everything is very homemade.
---
Camping finca las acacias esta cerca del pueblo y muy tranquilo, son amantes a los animales, tiene parqueadero, te ofrecen muchos planes dentro de ellos caminatas, velero, cuatrimotos. Además, en el establecimiento ofrecen desayuno, almuerzo y cena y todo es muy casero.

Location: Imurra, Riosucio, Alto Occidente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Emerson Torno welder
Description: They only place in Riosucio where they could re-attach our airconditioner pump after it was broken by a rock on the road to Jardín. Emerson is able to weld aluminium. Very friendly and professional, and speaks a little bit of English. We could stay overnight in our vehicle here during the repairs. +57 310 4483428 on WhatsApp.

Location: Calle 11, Riosucio, Alto Occidente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Fernando mechanic
Description: This is Fernando’s workshop, he mostly does motorcycles but he was a lifesaver when our camper van broke down on the road between here and Jardín. Fernando came out to juryrig our fan belt so we could get down the mountain and then worked with a welder (see Emerson Torno welder further north) to permanently fix it. Right next to his workshop is Servirepuesto Riosucio selling spare parts. Fernando’s WhatsApp is  +57 323 4443997

Location: Calle 41A, Bolivariana, Comuna 11 - Laureles-Estadio, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050031, Colombia
Name: Baku Laureles
Description:
Nice hostel in a good location with almost pod like beds, kitchen and plenty of room to hangout, doesn’t include breakfast. Doesn’t seem to have the usual volunteer worker problems everywhere else has. 
45k/night for 8 bed dorm. 
Has motorcycle/bicycle parking, not 100% secure but was more than adequate for myself.

Location: Calle 55, Barrio Unidos, Puerto Berrío, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053420, Colombia
Name: Casa Madrid
Description: Great little hotel in the centre of town, perfect for breaking the journey. Great private parking right next to the rooms and lovely staff. We got a big double room with en suite bathroom, air con, TV & fridge for 90k COP for the night.

Location: Vía Mocoa - Pitalito, Fronteriza, Santa Rosa, Macizo, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje El Calvo
Description: We went here because our option for today (Casita Azul) no longer exists. It’s a very basic hospedaje. Offers rooms with two beds or double bed. Rooms don’t have windows. Not very clean but beds are. Hospedaje has a restaurant with the standard options but it’s tasteful. WiFi is average and not stable. No cell service (Claro). Shower is cold. No towels provided. We paid $30k for two.

Location: Troncal de Occidente, Valparaíso, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Donde Dorita
Description:
Restaurant with good parking space, facing the road, quiet and allow you to rest or spend the night in motorhome, there are showers and toilets 24/7, in the morning you can have breakfast with a beautiful view and go on your way.
-----------
Att nomads on the road
Restaurante con buen espacio de parking, frente a la carretera, silencioso y permiten descansar o pasar la noche en motorhome, hay duchas y baños 24/7, en la mañana puedes desayunar con una vistas hermosas y seguir tu camino

Att nómadas en la ruta

Location: Vía Acacias - Guamal, Guamal, Piedemonte, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Finca Los Mangos
Description:
Roadside lodging site with a medium-sized pool, shuffleboard and volleyball courts. It does not officially offer camping or camper, but speaking with Doña Kathe, she allowed us to spend the night and enjoy the pool and bathroom with showers for 40,000 pesos per vehicle even though they already had reservations. In this season there are no mosquitoes and the weather is perfect. You don't hear much noise from the road.
--
Sitio de alojamiento al borde de la carretera con piscina mediana, canchas de tejo y voleibol, no ofrece oficialmente campamento ni camper pero hablando con Doña Kathe nos permitió pasar la noche y disfrutar de la piscina y baño con duchas por 40.000 pesos por vehículo aún cuando ya tenían unas reservas. En esta temporada no hay mosquitos y el clima es perfecto. No se siente mucho ruido de la carretera

Location: Carrera 55, Tenche, Comuna 15 - Guayabal, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050021, Colombia
Name: Tornero (machinist)
Description: Workshop full of lathes and mills. They machined some small spacers for me for a very reasonable price (a third of the price that the pre made part cost in the US) and did it there and then. They had a very helpful English speaking worker which ensured no translation confusion. True professionals unlike the previous ‘mechanics’ (the most recommended motorcycle mechanics in Medellin) who created the problems. Also open on Saturday morning.

Location: 30-49, Carrera 16, Armenia, UPZ Teusaquillo, Localidad Teusaquillo, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111311, Colombia
Name: Carrera 16 , small park
Description: The place is very nice and we had a good night for sure. The neighborhood is full of middle and working class people. The Transmilenio is just one block away. The plaza just needs a little bit of care and cleaning.

Location: Calle 6, Astorga, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050021, Colombia
Name: A small dead end street in poblado
Description:
A great place to park your car during the day, and also at night. In poblado. Close by to all the places.
Lots of shade from the trees. Nice path next to the river.
Free of payment.
Stayed there for almost a week.

Location: Plaza de Mercado, Calle 7, Sotaquirá, Centro, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Polideportivo de Sotaquirá
Description:
Nice, quiet place at walking distance from the village. We spent 3 nights at this place and slept very well. Of course, we first asked to the municipality, who asked to the Policia, and both totally agreed. 
Sotaquirá is a nice village mainly dedicated to agriculture, the origin of the Paipa cheese, only one in Colombia with Denomination of Origin. 
Everyone told us about the local famous dish named « Los Indios » and that the best one is in the restaurant Naty on main square. Restaurant open on weekends only. We didn’t try it there as we have been invited to eat it in a family. Was really delicious. If it’s as good in the restaurant, we would recommend you to try it. Good pasteles de yuca at Del horno Panadería. Delicious bread and biscuits at Doña Lucila shop and panaderia, one corner from the main square, going down in direction of Polideportivo, in front of Como en casa, simple but also good, people working there really kind, restaurant. 
Good Claro signal everywhere in the village.

Location: La Catedral - Arenales, Envigado, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 055457, Colombia
Name: Territorio
Description:
It is place made for over landing and camping. They have restaurant, bathrooms, WiFi and more amenities. 

We were there in a overlanding event and it was amazing

Location: Conceptos Diseño y Soluciones Visuales, 18 78, Carrera 3, La Dorada, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 175031, Colombia
Name: Hotel Los Nevados
Description: Great place. A room with 4 beds including a double with a private bathroom for $30 negotiated down to $27. Excellent WiFi, few power cuts unlike many places in Ecuador. Our bikes were stored in the locked garage. Right next to a supermarket and BiciO bike repair shop. I would recommend

Location: 43B-06, Calle 8, Astorga, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050021, Colombia
Name: 24 Hours
Description: This is a very good, secure parking aerial for 39‘000 pesos 24 hours with electricity if necessary. The guys are so friendly and you can wash the car as well. Nice area, nice hotels, the best hotel we stayed in South America around the corner, Golden Valley Hotel. Possible up to a Sprinter, no bigger

Location: Carrera 12, Barrancabermeja, Yariguíes, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 687031, Colombia
Name: Hostal Gaby
Description: Cheap but solid Hostal. Quiet, airconditioning, place for laundry, fridge, friendly people and firm matress (at least in our room in the backyard). 60.000 COP for two in a private room. Also place to store bicycles safely and no stairs to conquer.  Location in google maps is wrong, it‘s basically across the street from the Hotel K12

Location: Clinica Los Rosales, 25-25, Carrera 9, Centro, Sector Lago Uribe, Centro, Perimetro Urbano Pereira, Pereira, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660002, Colombia
Name: Indamedic Vaccine Clinic
Description: This clinic in the Clinica Los Rosales (3rd Floor, Reception at the stairs with a yellow painting) offers a long list of vaccines. You can write them via WhatsApp to confirm they have the vaccine you are looking for. We got the first shot of our anti-rabies vaccine (140.000/shot) here, and also a seasonal flu shot (45.000). Name: Finca La Martina
Description:
We spent 5 days at Finca Martina with our car (L 6m, W 2.15m, H 3.20m). The entrance gate is big enough for much larger big rigs. The finca is a relaxed paradise, surrounded by great scenery, views of the Paramó, wonderful peace and quiet and lots of hummingbirds. The palm trees that you can see in the Valle Cocora also grow here on the surrounding hills. We were told that there are many more than in the Valle Cocora. A hiking trail leads to viewpoints. The Paramó is about 50 kilometers away. The water for the finca comes from there. Leandro the owner, Adrian his manager and Oswaldo are very warm, friendly and attentive hosts. We felt very welcome. One of the mainstays of the finca is agrotourism. There is a beautiful meadow where you can park your camper or have space for your tent. You can also rent a room with a bathroom or a comfortable cabaña. There is a restaurant, a bar, a swimming pool with a children's pool and slide, table tennis table, etc. Everything is very well maintained and clean. Very quiet at night. Leandro, Adrian and Oswaldo are happy to welcome other overlanders. We can highly recommend the place. However, they cannot accommodate guests with cats, as there are many hummingbirds and various birds on the finca. There are also peacocks, rabbits and a horse stud on the finca, so it is important that travelers with dogs clarify beforehand whether it is suitable. WhatsApp number +57 300 4009 707
We spent the night in our car. The overnight stay costs 25 COP per person. There is a clean washing machine that can be used. Electricity and washing machine cost extra.
