I stopped there for a night, I paid 40000 pesos for the cheapest room with a fan. There's different Wifi's depending on where your room is. They also offer food, I got a plate with rice and meat and a broth on the side for 12000 pesos.
I was able to bring my bicycle in the room. The owners don't mind. 
There's also a swimming pool but can't tell if it's clean as I arrived and left at dark.

Location: Variante Melgar, Nilo, Alto Magdalena, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 734001, Colombia
Name: Hidden behind the highway
Description: We found this spot by accident.

Location: La Tebaida - Pueblo Tapao, Pueblo Tapao, Montenegro, Valle, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Ecohotel El Prado
Description: This place is perfect to rest, spend the night in a room with a private bathroom, it has parking, a swimming pool, the kitchen is communal and it is pet-friendly, I stayed 2 nights and it was perfect. The price per night is from $40,000 COP you can write to this number +57 321 5675056

Location: Carrera 69, Los Chorros, Comuna 18, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760035, Colombia
Name: Taller Michel
Description:
We went here to do a brake check on our RV (Ford f450) and we also checked the batteries that had been failing. It is a family business of world-class mechanics. Honest, kind and very professional. Julian, he is a genius and a great person. It was a great luck to have arrived here. They do all kinds of Work from engines to paint.
----
Pasamos a hacer una revisión de frenos de nuestro motor home (Ford f450) y revisamos también las baterías que venían fallando. Es un negocio familiar de mecánicos de primera. Honestos, amables y muy profesionales.  Julian, es un genio y una gran persona. Realizan todo tipo de trabajos desde motor hasta hojalateria y pintura. Fue una gran suerte haber llegado aquí.

Location: Calle 13, Peñon del Rodadero, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470005, Colombia
Name: Doggy’s Park Guarderia Canina
Description: Really nice place near Santa Marta to put you dog for a few days (if you go to Tairona National Park). The couple is super nice, they keep dogs for the day and nights also, we left our dog for 3 nights there. Price per night : 48’000 COP per dog. They have an instagram to contact them : doggys_park

Location: Calle 7, Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 661020, Colombia
Name: Jose Lopez Gastro Cafe
Description:
It is a restaurant where you can find typical food of the area and you can also enjoy high quality coffee. 
----
Es un restaurante en donde se encuentra comida típica del sector y además se puede disfrutar de café de gran calidad

Location: 25B, Jericó, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Centro de Control
Description:
With showers, toilets and water. It has ample parking. Ideal for overnight stay and bathing. 
----
CCO multo servicios con duchas, baños y agua. Tiene un amplio estacionamiento. Ideal para pernoctar y bañarse

Location: Calle 3, Guaduas, Bajo Magdalena, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Posada casa de abuela
Description: Great option for motorcycle travelers.  Comfortable rooms with fans.  Upstairs is most refreshing.  Owner has garage to work on bikes, change oil, etc.  Vans can park in secure parking 3 blocks away or safely on the street in the plaza.

Location: Villavieja-La Victoria, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Behind a road
Description: Pass through an open  gate and find this place. The Hacienda not far from here was closed and we needed a place for the night. You hear the road until 20.00 for sure. Given the fact that it is not so easy to find “even”  places it was good for us.

Location: Complejo deportivo patinodromo, Puerto López - Puerto Gaitán, Puerto Gaitán, Rio Meta, Meta, RAP (Especial) Central, 502001, Colombia
Name: Complejo Deportivo Puerto Gaitan
Description:
Parking lot of the sports center of Puerto Gaitan, open place where you can spend the night without problems. A little noisy for being next to the main avenue. Close to gas station and close to downtown. At night it is well illuminated. It is not superfluous to be careful, since it is an open place.
--------
Parqueadero del centro deportivo de Puerto gaitan, lugar abierto y donde se puede pasar la noche sin problemas. Un poco ruidoso por estar al lado de la avenida principal. Cerca a gasolinera y cerca al centro. En las noches es bien iluminado. No está de más, tener cuidado, ya que es un lugar abierto.

Location: Cepitá - Panachi - La Mesa de Los Santos - Acuarela, Aratoca, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 682051, Colombia
Name: El Nido del Fenix
Description:
This Hostal is close to the paragliding place Fenixtreme. This is one of the only places we found where you can stay next to it. They have a paragliding agency which you can find on iOverlander Tourist attractions called "paragliding Fenixtreme", we can totally recommend it. 
They have rooms for 50000 COP p.P, a room with a private bathroom for 140000 COP and a kitchen that you can use. This place is quite new and very clean.
If you stay at the Hostal you can get a discount for paragliding with them. You can pay the Hostal and paragliding by card. They can speak English, just text Carolina on WhatsApp. 
We stayed here with a van and could use the showers for free and they also invited us to a birthday party.

Location: Institución Educativa San Luis, Calle 21, San Luis, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Waterfall Parking Lot - Estacionamiento de la cascada
Description:
Unsafe.
They opened the door of the van for us. Luckily we were having dinner and managed to close it while they were opening it. We had to leave at night when it was raining, the police didn't pay any attention to us.

We spent the whole day here, the neighbors said it was safe. We left the van, went to the waterfall without any problems. But don't stay at night.

Inseguro.
Nos abrieron la puerta de la camioneta. Por suerte estábamos cenando y logramos cerrarla mientras la estaban abriendo. Nos tuvimos que ir de noche lloviendo, la policía ni bola nos dio.

Pasamos todo el día acá, los vecinos dijeron era seguro. Dejamos la camioneta, fuimos a la cascada sin problemas. Pero a la noche no se queden.

Location: Carrera 4, Contadero, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 523087, Colombia
Name: Moto Posada Contadero
Description:
Space for travelers and motorcycle travelers, safe and cozy place to take a break and relax.
Welcome!

Location: Carrera 12, Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 411027, Colombia
Name: Water at Gas station
Description: There is a tap here with non potable water where they let us fill our tank.

Location: Calle 5, Las Lajas, Ipiales, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524067, Colombia
Name: Hotel casa de Peregrinos
Description:
100000 pesos a night for a single room with queen size bed, TV, Wifi and private bathroom. Breakfast included. The room was spacious, clean and nice.
It's not the cheapest option but for what you get it's still a good price.

Location: RN50-09, Salitre, Guasca, Guavio, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 251217, Colombia
Name: Área de servicio
Description:
EN: It is a rest area with ample parking. It has bathrooms and a tap to fill up with water (not drinkable). We did not stay overnight but the security guard told us that if you ask for permission they will probably let you stay overnight. Free
--
ES: Es un área de descanso con amplio estacionamiento. Tiene baños y canilla para cargar agua (no potable). Nosotros no nos quedamos a dormir pero el señor de seguridad nos dijo que si se pide permiso es probable que dejen pasar la noche. Gratis

Location: Carrera 9, Villa Emma, Líbano, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, 731040, Colombia
Name: NATIVA CAFÉ
Description:
best cafe in town. open after 3pm.
nice cheap coffee and delicious cake.
wifi + electricity. friendly staff.

Location: Casa Montes, Carrera 3, Cabecera Municipal de Jardín, Jardín, Cabecera Municipal, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056050, Colombia
Name: Colectores cafe de jardin
Description: Really nice little cafe woth a beautiful terrace. The guys running it are super friendly and there are power outlets and a Starlink ;)

Location: La Campana Hotel Boutique, 31 A – 70, Calle 11A, Las Lomas No. 1, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050020, Colombia
Name: La Campaña Hotel Boutique
Description: Very nice, small hotel (3 stars) with secure parking in the locked court (no height restriction), small garden, very clean and pretty rooms, extremely helpful staff, close to all the restaurants etc in central Poblado, rates are cheaper when booked via Booking.com (double approx. 45-55 US-Dollars), good breakfast included.  We stayed for four nights and were very happy with it.

Location: Vía al Mar, Tubará, Atlántico, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Water at Texaco Gas Station
Description: No problem getting water here. Thanks...

Location: La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 055060, Colombia
Name: Parador Restaurant
Description:
We had dinner in the restaurant and asked beforehand if we could spend the night in our Landcruiser. After dinner, they preferred us to book a room in the hotel, but then tolerated us spending the night in the restaurant car park. We were not allowed to spend the night in the hotel car park (larger and further away from the road)

Wir haben im Restaurant zu Abend gegessen und zuvor gefragt, ob wir in unserem Landcruiser übernachten können.
Nach dem Essen wollten sie lieber, dass wir ein Zimmer im Hotel buchen, haben es dann trotzdem toleriert, das wir auf dem Parkplatz des Restaurants übernachten.
Das Übernachten auf dem Hotelparkplatz (größer und weiter entfernt von der Strasse) wurde uns untersagt

Location: Los Guaduales 2, Mocoa, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, 860001, Colombia
Name: On the other side of the river
Description: If you do not mind to clean some plastics upon arrival - this place is an option. You hear the spund of the river and maybe of the bar. Music is not bad. Here is a space for one lqndcruiser. Directly next to the river. Better then the one across- ypu have more light for sure.

Location: Manaure, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Casa solea
Description:
Value 150 for 4 people day with WiFi pool bathrooms and water parking for medium vans .. good safe beach good attention from the workers .

-----

Valor 150 por 4 personas día con piscina WiFi baños y agua parqueo para vans medianas ..buena playa segura buena atención por parte de los trabajadores..

Location: Valledupar, Cesar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: SharedHorizons
Description:
Perfect place to spend the night with plenty of space, wifi. 

We asked Luis from El Campestre (+57 (300) 310-7041) around the corner if we could stay there; as there was a fiesta, he guided us here. 
Extremely friendly WhatsApp exchange, he sent us video instructions on how to get here, gave us wifi password and was ready to answer questions.

We arrived very late, toilets were closed and we used our own. 

We travel with a child and were happy to find a swing and a trampoline.

There is no official price, we were asked to give what we want and gave 35.000

Location: Carrera 16, Parcelación Guadalupe, Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 661020, Colombia
Name: Arraigo Hostal
Description:
Im a cyclist with my dog.
Parked my bike safe inside.
Very nice place in the centre of Santa Rosa.
Its a new place good beds.
There are rooms for 2 persons 100.000 
There are dorms for 45.000
Fully equipped kitchen.
Very friendly helpful staff !
Hot showers and very clean !
Pet friendly !

Parking for all Vehicles  nearby, garden, tours, massages, laundry, wifi, hot water, kitchen, good signal for devices.
---------
Estoy viajando con mi bicicleta y mi perra.
Parqueadero para mi bicicleta seguro.
Es un buen lugar para descansar en el centro de Santa Rosa.
Es nuevo y tiene buenas camas.
Hay habitaciones pivadas para 2 personas por 100.000 
Habitaciones compartidas por 45.000
Cocina bien equipada 
El personal es muy amable 
Duchas de agua caliente y muy limpio 
Se aceptan mascotas 

Hay parqueadero para todo tipo de autos cerca, jardin al aire libre, tours, ofrecen deportes de aventura, masajes, lavanderia, wifi y hay buena señal para dispositivos

Location: Supatá, Gualivá, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 253667, Colombia
Name: Parque principal supata
Description:
Main park quiet night the police station next door for more security, free wifi there is no restriction, bakery nearby for bathroom use no showers.

-----

Parque principal noche tranquila la estación de policía al lado para más seguridad, wifi gratis no existe ninguna restricción, panadería cerca para uso de baño no duchas

Location: Autopista del Café, Nuevo Horizonte - Sapera, El Caimo, Armenia, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 630008, Colombia
Name: La mía hospedaje
Description:
It is a very pleasant place with friendly people who are willing to help travelers.
Here, you can take a bath for just $10,000, which includes a towel, soap, and even access to the swimming pool. You can stay in a room, or if you prefer, there is a large parking area nearby, along with a service station and restaurants.
You can connect to Wi-Fi, and there is a 120V power connection available if you have an extension cord. The service is available 24 hours a day.
A very cozy and highly recommended place

Es un lugar muy agradable con perdonas amables y están dispuestos a ayudar a los viajeros.
Se pueden aquí bañar por solo $10.000, incluye toalla, jabón, y hasta bañarse en la  piscina. Pueden hospedarse en habitación o si quieren, tienen un gran parqueadero al lado hay una estación de servicio y restaurantes. 
Pueden conectar a wifi, tiene conexión a 120v si tienen extensión. Servicio las 24 horas.
Un lugar muy acogedor y recomendado.

Location: Tdelbec, Calle 24, UPZs de Bogotá, Localidad Los Mártires, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111411, Colombia
Name: Tdelbec, good mechanic
Description:
We had a problem with the brakes and ABS lamp flashing with our camper, and the mechanic we went in Cali recommended this place.

Carlos, the owner was super friendly and nice. He seems to specialize in classic cars, so maybe older vans are his field. He fixed everything that had a problem.  He first said he didn’t need to charge us, but we gave him a tip. Even if you have to pay  I’m sure he will give you a fair price.

WhatsApp him beforehand
Carlos: +57 314 3353642

The area seemed to be sketchy with homeless people and garbage on the street, so I don’t recommend staying here but the mechanic is sure a good option.

Location: Calle 42 Sur, Alejandría, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050022, Colombia
Name: Hotel Estelar Blue
Description: We picked this place as we could see in photos it had an outdoor lot. Fits maybe 20 vehicles including our two vans (22’ long) with plenty of room. Also the outdoor lot wasn’t ever crowded as they have an indoor underground lot too. The hotel itself was super clean and the staff was extremely friendly. We stayed for about a week while exploring Medellin. They have a small gym and great buffet breakfast that was included in price. The restaurant is open for all meals and the dinners were very good. We booked the day before in Expedia for $66 for each family of 3. Walking distance to several malls including Santa Fe and Ovieda which shows movies in English. About 20 min walk to the center poblado area. They even let us keep one van in their lot for free while we explored guatepe for a couple days. Pet friendly. Highly recommend!

Location: Lenguazaque, Ubaté, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: if nothing else
Description: It's hard to find a camp around here. No body seems to come on this trail. Can fit a couple of tents. Pretty flat but with every rain, don't camp here..

Location: Calle 6, Gachetá, Ciudad de Gachetá, Gachetá, Guavio, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hotel Los Ocobos
Description: Very friendly for cyclist. We got a room with 2 beds for 30000 pesos each. Basic but clean

Location: 62, Cisneros, Nordeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Hotel el Castillo
Description:
A hotel close to the highway with little noise, a large parking space where they allow arrival and offer some services to travelers in motorhomes. Very friendly, they let us stay for free for coming with other visitors to the hotel. They allow pets and offer coffee. It has access to the river with a good beach and you can make a bonfire and swim. We had no problems with mosquitoes.
--
Un hotel cerca a la carretera con poco ruido un amplio espacio de parqueadero donde permiten la llegada y ofrecen algunos servicios a viajeros en casa rodante muy amables nos dejaron quedar gratis por venir con otros visitantes en hotel. Permiten las mascotas y ofrecen café. Tiene acceso al rio con buena playa y se puede hacer fogata y nadar. No tuvimos problemas con mosquitos 

3235764705

Location: El Almendro, Sabana de Torres, Yariguíes, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Reserva Natural Cabildo Verde
Description: Travelers who visit the wildlife center / nature reserve can spend the night at the grassy parking lot. It’s a wonderful place with free Capibaras, Aras, parrots and monkeys which are looking for food and the other rescued animals. Send a whatsapp before (see iOverlander POI / sight) to arrange a guided visit. Absolutely worth it!

Location: Curumaní, Cesar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Hotel Campestre San José
Description: Brand new hotel in a quiet location in the countryside, a few hundred meters off the road so you don’t hear the noise from the trucks, spacious rooms with access to the veranda, modern bathrooms, AC, TV, secure parking in the walled and locked courtyard, no restaurant but cold drinks, 80.000 COP for a double

Location: Avenida 30, La Bocana, La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 055060, Colombia
Name: Hotel Pinares
Description:
A farm hotel that allows camping, camper accommodation, and glamping accommodation. It has a swimming pool, very good bathrooms with cold water, the space is super spacious. The cost was $30,000 per person, you can negotiate a little. It allows access to pets, has billiards and restaurant.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Una finca hotel que permite acampar, alojamiento de campers, y alojamiento en glamping. Tiene piscina, baños muy buenos con agua fría, el espacio es súper amplio. El costo fue de $30.000 por persona, se puede negociar un poco. Permite acceso a mascotas, tiene billar y restaurante.

Location: Briceño, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Briceño río gualanday
Description: Wild camping, nice Spot, close to river, only find a little Shop with drinks.

Location: Vereda Caracolí, San Luis, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Villa maría jose
Description: It is a nice place with a swimming pool. A large space to set up camp. It has rooms to stay in, it is an austere place, nothing fancy.

Location: Santa Rosa de Cabal, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 661020, Colombia
Name: Hospedaje campestre el Oasis
Description:
A safe and cozy place. We spent the night in the parking lot outside the lodge but the locals offered us the internal parking lot with bathroom, water and electricity. Highly recommended as the local people are very friendly. 
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Un lugar seguro y acogedor. Pasamos la noche en el parqueadero exterior del hospedaje pero la gente del lugar nos ofreció el parqueadero interno con servicio de baño, agua y luz. Muy recomendado ya que las personas del lugar son muy amables.

Location: Sesquilé, Almeidas, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Plaza principal
Description: Sesquilé is a very quiet place to spend a night. It is very close to the Tominé reservoir. The bad thing is that there is no water nearby.

Location: Nacumales, Landázuri, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Difficult Road to Pandora Forest
Description:
Google Maps may direct you this qay to the Pandora Forest (or el Penõl). If you dont have high clearence or a big rig, dont take this road. It is narrow and very rough. We damaged our 4x4 campervan.
E.g for Defenders or Motorbike the road is beautiful :-)

Location: Isla del Poe, Sendero ecológico, Com. Negra Sapzurro, Capurganá, Acandí, Darién, Chocó, RAP Pacífico, 278017, Colombia
Name: Melo Hostel
Description:
hostel with a lot of youth and party atmosphere. I will use it to camp here for 40,000 pesos. good facilities far enough away from the hustle and bustle of the center.

Open mind hostel.

Edu Zeta desde Tierra de Fuego a Alaska en bicicleta - neverstophacking

Location: La Habana, La Dorada, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Wild camping La Miel river bank
Description: A Perfect spot to set the camping. Ideally in roof top tent or RV. No tourist, no locals.

Location: Rancho Baru, Puerto Carreño, Vichada, RAP Llanos, Colombia
Name: Rancho Baru
Description: The best location in Vichada. Amazing hostess. Ask for Maria Fernanda, amazing ladie. Excellent food. Private rooms, hamacas and camping area

Location: Troncal del Eje Cafetero, Tapias, Neira, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Área de servicio La Caucana
Description:
It is a special place to stop on the road granted by the Pacific 3 concession, it has bathroom services, restaurant, telephones, a parking lot that is suitable for spending the night, access for the disabled. Its facilities are spacious and comfortable and it is located next to the road.

-----

Es un lugar especial para parar en carretera otorgado por la concesión Pacífico 3, tiene servicios de baños, restaurante, teléfonos, un estacionamiento que es apto para pasar la noche, acceso para minusválidos. Sus instalaciones son amplias y cómodas y se encuentra junto a la carretera.

Location: Jamundí, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: La choza de pocho
Description:
Beautiful place to wake up, you must ask permission from the community to enter the territory only with an authorization letter, only 4X4 vehicles or motorcycles for difficult terrain.
Remember you must call first to manage entry into the territory

-----

Hermoso lugar para amanecer, se debe pedir permiso a la comunidad para entrar en el territorio solo con carta de autorizacion, solo vehículos 4X4 o motos para terrenos dificiles.
Recuerde debe llamar primero para gestionar la entrada al territorio.

Location: Carrera 32, La Bocana, La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 055060, Colombia
Name: En la calle
Description:
We spent a quiet night. It is safe because it is behind the police. We slept well in front of the “public gym”. There are no services. There is a clear signal and stores nearby.
----------
Pasamos una noche tranquila. Es seguro porque esta atrás de la policía. Dormimos bien enfrente al "gimnasio publico". No hay ningún servicio. Señal de claro si y comercios cerca.

Location: Oicatá, Centro, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 150201, Colombia
Name: Ambarella
Description:
Welcome to our countryside family home! Nestled in a safe and peaceful location, our property offers everything you need for a comfortable stay:
	•	Starlink WiFi for high-speed internet access
	•	Washing machine for your laundry needs
	•	Secure parking inside the parcel (space for 3 vehicles)
	•	Clean and accessible bathroom facilities
	•	Fresh Colombian coffee, perfect for a relaxing morning or evening

Our family is happy to share good times and stories with travelers passing through. Whether you’re looking to rest, recharge, or connect, you’ll feel right at home here. Water is always available, and so is our warm hospitality.

We look forward to welcoming you!

Location: Vía Sueva-Gachetá, Vereda Diamante, Junín, Guavio, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Tienda del café de mi tierra
Description: Nestor is the host. Serves good coffee, $50.000/night. Near to main road. Great MTB routes around.

Location: Calle 5, Anaime, Cajamarca, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Anaime Plaza
Description:
Cute little hotel with english speaking owner. You can call Christian for assistance- 323 657 52 05 . Car park  in front Hotel is possible. Even one private car park is possible. A double room 30k pp. Do not miss the little town of Anaime with all its beautiful murals. We fell
In love with it.

Location: Carrera 6, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: El Triunfo
Description: Small shop in the corner sells bidones of 20 litres. 25000 for a new one, 15000 for a refill.

Location: Calle 61, Comuna 6 - La Concordia, Bucaramanga, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 680005, Colombia
Name: Euromotor
Description:
Lots of parts and a really dedicated team. Soon at Carrera 15 No 15-68.

Found shocks for my Citroën Jumper.

Location: Pijao, Cajamarca, Roncesvalles, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Semillas de Agua
Description: This place is a hidden treasure. When you can come and visit and stay overnight for sure. You will spend time in an amazing nature reserve. We stayed for 2 days. You can camp here . We prepared with a 4x4 and your own food.

Location: Carrera 6, El Laguito, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Local baseball/softball free games
Description: Local tournament games usually start at 7.30 pm, access is free. The bathroom is clean and you can have a good slice of pizza for 6-7k.

Location: Carrera 3, Bocagrande, Tierra Bomba, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: Notaria 4
Description: Quick spot to get the poder approved. Cost $1k to print and $8.4k for poder. 5 min process, very friendly.

Location: Necoclí, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057870, Colombia
Name: Estación de servicio Shell Necoluxe
Description: We asked for permission at the place and the people let us park, lent us the bathrooms, water to bathe in our portable toilet, and offered us coffee. We are very grateful to the service station and its staff. -- Pedimos permiso en el lugar y las personas nos dejaron parquear, nos prestaron los baños, agua para bañarnos en nuestro baño portátil, nos ofrecieron café. Muy agradecidos con la estación de servicio y su personal.

Location: Tauramena, Casanare, RAP Llanos, Colombia
Name: Restaurante zona D
Description:
Mr. Roberto is very kind and allows you to spend the night free of charge in the green areas of the restaurant. You can eat in the restaurant as a thank you because there is no charge for spending the night there. There are bathrooms…
--
El señor Roberto es muy amable y permite pasar noche sin costo en sus zonas verdes del restaurante. Puedes consumir en el restaurante en agradecimiento porque no hay cobro por pasar noche allí. Hay baños…

Location: Pueblito Postobon, Calle 30A, Saravena, Arauca, RAP Llanos, 815010, Colombia
Name: TuttiFruti Llanero
Description:
A good place to take a break from the route, it is on the main road, it has parking, bathroom service, good prices, hot and cold drinks, empanadas and other snacks.
--
Un buen lugar para hacer una pausa a la ruta, esta sobre la vía principal, cuenta con parqueadero, servicio de baño, buenos precios, bebidas calientes y frías, empanadas y otros snacks

Location: Saravena, Arauca, RAP Llanos, Colombia

We were warned by locals to not go further than Playa de Belen because of Guerilla activity. They are coming through PdB from time to time. Noone knows when. We don't want to say it is not safe there but we think it is good to know to stay alert when going there and to talk to the locals and the police about the current situation to stay as safe as possible.

Site on the highway with very little traffic, with the possibility of spending the night, crystal-clear stream of water for bathing and resting
The road that continues to San Bartolo and then to Pacora is not recommended for large or medium-sized vehicles, the entire road is uncovered.
--
Sitio en plena carretera con muy poco tránsito, con posibilidad de pernoctar, quebrada cristalina de agua par bañarse y descansar 

La vía que continúa para San Bartolo y luego para Pacora no se recomienda para vehículos grandes o medianos, destapada toda la vía

Location: Vía San Francisco - el Pepino - Villa Garzon, Chorlavi Los Salados, San Francisco, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Flat area behind abandoned house
Description: There’s a abandoned house right in the road, it’s seems ok to camp if it’s raining. Although, if you follow the path, you can go down and camp in a grassy flat area with beautiful view. Completely hidden from the road. Felt safe. There’s water running 20 metres going down the road after the house. Only cyclists

Location: Vía San Francisco - el Pepino - Villa Garzon, La Tebaida, Vereda La Tebaida, Mocoa, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Delicious Milk
Description: Amazing place where they sell dairy products like yogurt, ice cream, cheese, cuajada and arequipe. All products are homemade and with amazonian fruits. Lovely family

Location: Transversal Momposina, La Granja, Ancon, La Rinconada, Isla de Mompós, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Supermarkt/Tienda
Description: Just 15km before Mompox, there is a small Store. Before the heat got too strong, the shop was a relieve with some cold drinks and snacks

Location: Calle 16, Magangué, Mojana, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Hotel Drohi
Description:
Paid 95K pro one Person including breakfast. I could take my bike with me in my room. 
Water ran out in the evening and electricity in the morning, but was managed quickly. The room was big enough, comfy bed and clean. Would recommend this place.

Location: BambooMar, Calle 35, Torices, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130003, Colombia
Name: Hostal Bambumar
Description:
Good place to stay in Cartagena after / before you dropped off the vehicle. Might even have space for a moto.

Its close to the old city, so still fairly safe. There's a big shopping mall with a Jumbo close by. The castillo is right next door.

We've paid 100.000 COP for a room for tow, including AC and breakfast.

Location: Coveñas, Morrosquillo, Sucre, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: La tranquera restaurante cabañas bar
Description:
The place is in front of the beach, with a
beautiful and very quiet atmosphere, ideal
to disconnect. We stayed three days
and enjoyed the beach bar, where a full arepa costs around 5 dollars.
The people there were very
friendly and offered us access to showers
and electricity. We parked our van on the sandy street in front of the
beach. Without a doubt, a place we would
return to.
--
El lugar está frente a la playa, con un
ambiente hermoso y muy tranquilo, ideal
para desconectar. Nos quedamos tres días
y disfrutamos del bar de playa, donde una arepa completa cuesta alrededor de 5 dólares.
Las personas del lugar fueron muy
amables y nos ofrecieron acceso a duchas
y electricidad. Estacionamos nuestra
camioneta en la calle de arena frente a la
playa. Sin duda, un lugar al que
regresaríamos.

Location: Carrera 7A, Zona Urbana, Mocoa, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, 860001, Colombia
Name: Moto Club
Description: An excellent repair shop. They were very helpful fixing my from brake rotor. A classy and professional shop with good people. Different than the typical street repair shop.

Location: Calle 2, Zona Urbana, Mocoa, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, 860001, Colombia
Name: Asesorias Transito y Transporte
Description: SOAT can be very hard to find in Mocoa. For us anyways. Hector was very helpful and very patient with our poor spanish. Visit him for your SOAT needs. 5 min walk from the center plaza.

Location: CENTRO EDUCATIVO SAGRADA FAMILIA, Calle 24, Zona Urbana, Mocoa, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, 860001, Colombia
Name: Mocoa Samay
Description: An excellent and relatively new hotel. Friendly and attentive staff. Light breakfast included. Paid 170000col/ night with 2 people. Fan in room, Air con avail  in others. Big windows that open for air. Secure parking for motos. Lots of restaurants close by. Central is 20 min walk. Upscale for Mocoa

Location: 1-48, Calle 9, Barrio Centro, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel Gales
Description: A couple blocks from the central plaza and secure off street parking for motos and a car. Decent and clean rooms. 70,000 for 2.

Location: Hostal los 3 Leones, #7-37, Transversal 8, Boquía, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631020, Colombia
Name: Très leones
Description:
Really good familial hostel, 5 minutes from the mane square.
Sylvino and Lala use to receive lot of travellers from all over the world. Very kind family.
Simple, double and more spacious rooms.
Private and shared bathrooms.
Wifi, kitchen and hot showers.
Laundry service.
There is also a patio where you can enjoy sofas or ping pong!
Compared to other accommodation prices are low.
Really great experience and good spot for cyclists and travellers!!

Location: Transversal Tribuga - Arauca, Puerto Nus, Maceo, Magdalena Medio, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: San José del Nus
Description: Truck parking area - good phone reception (4G)

Location: Calle 4, Filadelfia, Alto Occidente, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Hospidaje CasaBlanca
Description:
Modest but clean and comfortable Hospidaje. The lady that manages it is really friendly and we were able to take our bikes upstairs. There is one flight of not steep stairs so it was ok to climb even with loaded bikes. It cost us 50k COP for a double room with bathroom. There is even WARM shower, towels, soap and good Wifi. 


I can see that there are 3-4more rooms and it may even be possible to use the washing machine(we didn’t ask). 
There are 2 more hotels in Filadelfia.

Location: Carrera 6, Tamalameque, Cesar, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Hotel Leo Mar
Description: As to other hotels are fully booked I was guided by two locals to this place. It was 35K a night, with shower and toilet, without Wi-Fi but AC. The AC was quite noisy so that I had to sleep with the earplugs. The room is quite small, but I managed to take the bike in. It was mostly clean, so absolutely okay for one night. They have a kitchen that guests can use and a supermarket, but the prices are three times higher than the D1 around the corner. Actually, the best part was that one of the owners showed me around in town which was a great experience.

Location: San Rafael, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053837, Colombia
Name: La Isabella
Description: This is a beautiful place for birding. Alvaro has basic accomodations. Hot showers in rooms. Camping cold. See photos. He creates a place for birds and monkeys to eat fruit. You can see the birds so close you can almost touch them. He has recorded 30 species of hummingbirds & 200 of other bird species. He offers guiding services. One can also camp here. See photos. See Facebook: Laisabelabirding

Location: Carrera 13, Palestina, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 176020, Colombia
Name: Eje Cafetero Ruta Campesina
Description: here is Valentina she offers an AUTHENTIC 2 day tour the name where you can find her on Google is "Eje Cafetero Ruta Campesina" you can communicate with her on WhatsApp to have all the details of the extraordinary stay (+57) 312 210 3242 I can tell you that you will go see a coffee finca another of chocolate a cane sugar factory tasting of all the possible fruits in Colombia do not hesitate it is really incredible far from mass tourism

Location: El Playón - San Alberto, Contadero, La Esperanza, Occidente, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel Oasis
Description: Hotel is on the Main Road. Basic accommodation with AC and bath for 50K. There is a small patio inside. Owner is friendly. Could take my bike inside the room. Okay for a night on the way to Giron

Location: El Playón - San Alberto, Contadero, La Esperanza, Occidente, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Supermercado
Description: There are just 3 small shops next to each other. They have fruits and all basic foods.

Location: El Pomarrosal, San José de Suaita, Suaita, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: posada san jose
Description:
The house is designed in a rustic style that blends perfectly with the landscape, providing visitors with an authentic and relaxing experience.

In addition, for those who need to stay connected during their stay, the inn offers free Wi-Fi.

The mountainous environment offers many options for hiking and other outdoor activities, allowing guests to enjoy the beauty of the landscape and the tranquility of the rural setting. Without a doubt, a perfect choice for those looking for a refuge in nature with modern comforts.

Location: hotel villa botero, Calle 115, Turbo, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057868, Colombia
Name: Hotel Villa Botero
Description: Don't expect a lot but there is space to park everything. I stayed one night to wait for the boat to send my motorcycle to Panama. Wifi isn't great and the boss is not very friendly. I paid 70k for AC.

Location: Villa Marley, San Carlos, Santa Isabel, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Villa Isabel
Description:
Villa Isabel is a restaurant with a small petting zoo, and a beautiful view and camping spot nearby. CARLOS and Sonia are very friendly and they also helped us to find a camping spot nearby. They allow us to use their bathroom and hot showers And made an excellent Colombian breakfast. The y also serve lunch and dinner. 

Mobile 3122243073 Sonia 

12k breakfast 
15k p.p. Per night with shower and bathroom

Location: Tota - Playa Blanca, Tota, Sugamuxi, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Playa blanca Baruch
Description: They offer parking for two campers, a restaurant, water available, safe, and a view of the lake, 50 meters from the entrance to Playa Blanca.

Location: Manaure, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Kaipalaa
Description: It is a restaurant that operates every weekend and within the premises there is the option of staying in a room or staying in a tent, either on the roof or on the floor. There is a kiosk nearby where there is a power point and depending on the season they also sell food. Staying in a room costs 100,000 and in a tent costs 30,000. It has a bathroom with a shower. Anderson is very helpful. 314 7671170

Location: EDS del Amparo, Calle 31, Contadora, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130011, Colombia
Name: Primax
Description:
very friendly staff just ask for the toilet key and you will find a tap under the sink we have loaded several times here top

personnel très sympa il suffit de demander la clés des toilettes et vous y trouverez un robinet sous l’évier nous avons chargé plusieurs fois ici top

Location: Hotel Acuario, Calle 101, Turbo, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057868, Colombia
Name: Bahía pisisi
Description: Nice hotel I was waiting for my motorcycle to be loaded on the boat to go to Panama. Very close to the port, paid 55pesos for road with AC. Owner very friendly

Location: Villahermosa, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Pull out
Description:
It is not allowed to spend the night here, it is a protected area. They came to tell us that we had to leave. 
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
No está permitido pernoctar aquí, es una zona protegida. Nos vinieron a decir que teníamos que irnos.

Location: Calima, Centro, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760537, Colombia
Name: San Sebastián Hostal Calima Darien
Description:
Nice place in the garden of a lovely family. They offer shower and bathroom. It's closed from the lake and protected from the wind of the lake. 20.000 each person. 
Fabiola +57 3137421932

Location: Hostal Musica y Arte, 9-69, Calle 4A, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 418060, Colombia
Name: Hostel música y arte
Description:
Lovely chill hostel in San Agustin. Cheap. Friendly people, breakfast, good WiFi , hot shower. They have shared rooms and private ones. Paid 25 coop through booking. 
Could put my bike inside in a safe place

Recommend it (but it’s not a place just to rest, there’s always something going on the roof top).

Location: Anorí - El Mango, Anorí, Nordeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Jack camp soccer field
Description: Just a stop for the night. We had a good night's rest. Very peaceful. Just a good pull off on the side of the road. Even level! No facilities. Good cell signal.

Location: Encino, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Hacienda los Iconos (+57 317 4404149)
Description: Homestay accomodation, surrounded by mountains. Spacious double room, hot shower, food available, and secure bike storage. 120,000cop for double room, breakfast and dinner. Contact them on WhatsApp or Instagram to book - they prefer if you do so at least 3 days in advance.

Location: Carrera 5, Soata, Soatá, Norte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 151001, Colombia
Name: Superbici
Description: bike mechanic and repair shop! small shop, but knowledgeable and helpful owner

Location: Banco Agrario, Calle 10, Oiba, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: hotel buganvilia
Description: basic but clean hotel, 40k pesos a night for a double ensuite room for one person. hot showers! friendly owner, and bike storage but you have to carry it up the stairs first

Location: Boutique de Yolis, 70, Calle 19, Las Cuadras, Comuna 1, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520002, Colombia
Name: Milhoja
Description:
The specialty from Villa de Leiva in Pasto.
Milhoja.
It's owned by people from Villa de Leyva and I would say it tastes even better than there!

Location: Ocaso Coffee Tour, KM 3,8, Antigua vía del Ferrocarril, Boquía, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 121164, Colombia
Name: Parador Turístico Brisas Del Magdalena
Description: Restaurant with large pool (5000 pp), baño open 24 hrs, stayed at no cost

Location: A Toche, Vereda Coello San Juan, El Guaico, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hotel Las Machin
Description:
Basic hotel/ hostel right next to the thermal pool. They also have their own thermal pool which guests can use, although the one around the corner is complitely free. 
We paid a steep-ish price of 160 COP for two people inc. breakfast and dinner(we don’t speak spanish so was hard to bring the price down- originally was 180). Rooms are super basic with just a toilet(no shower). Cold showers and access to a sink are available in communual areas. There is good wifi but limited phone connection otherwise. The place is quite and they were able to safely store our bycicles inside the hotel. 
There is also a small tienda on site.

Location: Girón - Zapatoca, Girón, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Tienda
Description: Small store that sells Empanadas and basic food. Next to the store you can camp for 8K. Friendly Lady runs this place

Location: Norte, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631001, Colombia
Name: Casa Basan
Description: Only 5 km from Circassia (10 min) by good road, cozy place, attended by its owner, coffee in the morning, tranquility and a beautiful landscape to get to know the EJE CAFETERO COLOMBIANO

Location: Carrera 9, Centenario, Comuna 2 - Calambeo, Perímetro Urbano Ibagué, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, 730001, Colombia
Name: Museo panoptico
Description:
The museum is surrounded by green areas and platforms with fruit trees, the signal is good if there are not too many people connected, it is very close to the administrative area of the city.

-----

El museo está rodeado por zonas verdes y andenes con árboles frutales, la señal es buena si no hay demasiada gente conectada, está muy cerca a la zona administrativa de la ciudad.

Location: Choachí, Oriente, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Guatoc glamping
Description:
Variable phone signal, but Starlink is available at the farm.
----
Señal telefónica variable, pero hay Starlink disponible en la finca.

Location: Corredor Vial de Cartagena, San Isidro, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130013, Colombia
Name: Nativos El Bosque
Description:
Local Healthy Drinks, ideal for people looking for a fruit smoothie, also offers healthy meals such as waffles, fruit salads, baked goods and non-fried foods.
-------
Local de bebidas Saludables, ideal para las personas que buscan un batido de frutas, también ofrecen comidas saludables como waffles, ensaladas de frutas, horneados y comidas sin frituras.

Location: Hotel La Fuente, 11-23, Calle 10, Rionegro, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel La Fuente
Description: Nice and clean hotel on my way to Girón. It was 90K for one person and I could take the bike into the room. Owner are very friendly.

Location: Caldas, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Finca Juan
Description:
Juan will let travelers stay on his farm.  Location on the property will depend on the size of your rig.  Very good cell signal.  

The cost for our camper van was 80000 pesos.  We camped by the house and had use of the toilet and shower.  +57 321 5835001 contact Juan directly to arrange a visit.

Location: Quibdó - La Mansa, El Carmen de Atrato, Atrato, Chocó, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Las Tangaras ProAves reserve
Description:
Another ProAves reserve with accomodations. Starlink. Larger rigs can get in here. There is room to turn around. This lodge is managed by Flor. Another lovely person. We are doing our own cooking. We are renting a room. Flor will cook for you for an extra cost. 
Beautiful place to see birds.

Location: Vía Bogotá - Choachí, San Carlos, Pueblo de Choachi, Choachí, Oriente, RAP (Especial) Central, 251620, Colombia
Name: Don Francisco
Description:
Very good mechanic. Solved all our problems. We got 2 new front axels - and wheel bearings. the part we brought as we have a VW T4. 
250.000 COP. Vor ½ day work. 
We can recommend.

Location: calle 20B, Peñon del Rodadero, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 005075, Colombia
Name: The cantamar
Description:
restaurant of the cantamar hotel where you can eat on the terrace with a view of the sea. the prices of the dishes go between 29000 and 52000 pesos. you can also enjoy the swimming pool and their small private beach. very welcoming staff. right next to an iOverlander bivouac which has a little wild air in the middle of the buildings.
--
restaurant de l’hôtel cantamar où vous pouvez manger sur la terrasse avec vue sur la mer. les prix des plats vont entre 29000 et 52000 pesos. vous pouvez aussi profiter de la piscine et de leur petite plage privative. personnel très accueillant. juste à côté d’un bivouac iOverlander qui a un petit air sauvage au milieu des immeubles.

Location: La Mesa, Tequendama, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Altos de la reserva
Description:
Campground about 2 hrs from Bogota. Some of the place is nice, the tent camping area is green and has lots of trees. 
The place doesn’t really look like it’s made for vans and big rigs won’t fit. The amenities are super basic (cold shower, toilets that you share with wildlife). No community areas, No WiFi.
A lot of dogs in the area that bark all through the night and are really close, makes sleeping hard.
For 80000/ couple without pool use or 110000/ couple with pool use not worth it. Not recommended.

Location: Homecenter, Avenida Pedro de Heredia, Ternera, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130010, Colombia
Name: Homecenter Cartagena
Description: We were able to buy a dog crate here for our flight back to Europe.

Location: Transversal San Gil - Mogotes - La Rosita, San Joaquín, Mogotes, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Green flat on the corner for tents
Description: Around the corner is a small green flat for a tent. I was camping a bit further down on a worst spot. Here you are only visible from one side

Location: Carrera 101B, Ciudad Campestre, Comuna 22, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760032, Colombia
Name: Casa Bella Suites
Description:
This is a large home with private bedrooms, and private bathrooms. Great for those of you who are on bicycles and motorcycles, and safe parking available. The Wi-Fi is Fast, good showers, and the rooms have AC. 
Breakfast  is included,  and the owner is extremely helpful and nice. This is in one of the better and safer  part of Cali with lots of options for food.
Extremely recommended

Location: Autopista Conexión Norte, El Chispero, Segovia, Nordeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: la finchitta
Description: Restaurant and bar with toilets and shower, the owner is very friendly and will help you. freshly open (6 month) with the new road that would be completed into 12 months.

Location: Hotel Guatapé, Calle 32, Guatapé, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053854, Colombia
Name: Casa de Ciclistas - Guatape
Description: A top quality informal restaurant that is run by an American and his Venezuelan wife along with several family members. They serve top quality coffee, artisan baked goods along with fabulous dishes inspired by various cuisines from around the world including many from Venezuela. We were in town two nights and ate there both nights and both breakfasts, reasonably priced with good sized servings and profits go to support their work with indigenous peoples in the Colombian Amazon.

Location: San Rafael, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Reserva Natural Piedra Montada
Description:
A fantastic little place that is set up as a private nature reserve with basic bunkhouses to rent. We happened across it when looking for a waterfall and the owner guided us down the access road to this idyllic spot. 
There is a small restaurant on site that is open at weekends,
We parked for the night for 50,000 COP for our small 4x4 camper and two people, camped next to a cristal clear mountain stream with swimming hole.
The track down is paved for most of the way but very steep, a short river crossing and a quite gnarly track for the last 100m would probably not be possible for 2 Wheel drive or non high clearance vehicles.
Message Rodrigo +57 310 363 4439 before you come as there is not always anyone here to open up the gates on the access track etc.

Location: Corregimiento de Palermo, Paipa, Tundama, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Santa Rosalia
Description:
Nice hotel, dinner and breakfast available. Not very good Wi-Fi, but mobile service with claro. Warmish shower. 

60,000 for a room, 1 person. 

Secure bike storage, and they had a hose pipe for me to wash the mud off! Very kind and helpful owners!

Location: Norte, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 630007, Colombia
Name: Finca la Molienda
Description:
I am Alejandra and I offer parking service for families on my farm, we have a hot shower service, bathroom and a great view to enjoy a beautiful sunrise in the coffee region.
Cost per vehicle $18 USD and per person $5 USD
We offer you a delicious coffee in the morning.

Soy Alejandra y ofrezco servicio de estacionamiento para familias en mi finca, tenemos servicio de ducha caliente, baño y una gran vista para disfrutar de un hermoso amanecer en el eje cafetero.
Costo por vehículo $18 USD y por persona $5 USD
Te ofrecemos un delicioso café en la mañana.

Location: Barrio Monte Blanco, Otu, Remedios, Nordeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Parque Los Minero
Description:
This is an excellent place for an overnight stay. It features a huge parking area, available Wi-Fi, showers, and a great dining spot. There is a security guard on duty throughout the night. Mario is the person in charge. If you are traveling to or from Cartagena or Medellín, this is a fantastic place to rest in between your journey.
----------
Un lugar excelente para pasar la noche. Mario es la persona que está a cargo del lugar. Ahí seguridad toda la noche.

Location: Calle 8, La Merced, Comuna 3, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760044, Colombia
Name: Comedir vegetariano
Description: Super tasty vegetarian restaurant. Super worth it to try even if you eat meet. For 14000 CLB you get a salad, soup, main dish, and dessert.

Location: Pueblo Rico - Santa Cecilia, Pueblo Rico, Vertiente Pacífico, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Alto Bonito hotel and restaurant
Description: This place has what a traveller needs. Hotel & restaurant. There is a mechanic on site. A man is washing the van. Reasonably priced. We are storing the rig for a few days while we visit a birding lodge nearby. Basic room. Hot showers up stairs. If you use iO, please contribute

Location: Transversal San Gil - Mogotes - La Rosita, San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684038, Colombia
Name: Eco hotel Oro de Gaque
Description:
Wonderful peaceful place to rest on my way to Mogotes. Fabi, Lara and their son have build a beautiful environment where you fell welcomed and home. They take care of the environment and resources. Lara cooked a delicious dinner and prepared a wonderful breakfast.
I was bikepacking and did a small detour on the route to stay here which is absolutely worth it.

Location: Trigo y Miel, 5-59, Carrera 9, San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684031, Colombia
Name: Triego y Miel
Description: I had a wonderful and delicious veggie!! Lunch here! It opens at noon just next to the bakery. Owner are very nice.

Location: Carrera 6, Mogotes, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Restaurante El Buensazon De Mogotes
Description: I had an amazing and rich lunch here. Owner is super friendly and it was the best veggie lunch for a while. Highly recommend!

Location: Calle 8, Soata, Soatá, Norte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 151001, Colombia
Name: Vlacem Gourment COLOMBIA
Description: I had an amazing dinner here. They prepared a great and big veggie meal for me. The dessert was so good, I ordered it twice! Staff was also super friendly.  Highly recommend this place.

Location: San Agustín, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 418060, Colombia
Name: Mirador Chenguilo
Description:
In very comfortable place, with telephone signal, bathrooms, wifi, you can arrive in any vehicle. very cheap prices for camping $60,000 cop.

In lugar muy cómodo , con señal de teléfono, baños, wiffi, se puede llegar en cualquier vehículo precios para acampar muy económicos $60,000 cop

Location: San Agustín, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 418060, Colombia
Name: chenguilo
Description:

In lugar muy cómodo , con señal de teléfono, baños, wiffi, se puede llegar en cualquier vehículo precios para acampar muy económicos $50,000 cop

Location: Avenida Central, Arcabuco, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154201, Colombia
Name: El Laurel Restaurante - Arcabuco
Description: Great food and service. Lots of options, drinks and dessert. Fast WIFI also - would recommend!

Location: Villamaría, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Road pullout tents only
Description: Flat, grassy, not seen from the road (you can hear it), amazing views. No facilities. Is just a pull out of the road, nice for cyclists

Location: Carrera 11, Zapatoca, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 604069, Colombia
Name: Hotel de la Prada
Description:
A good hotel where you can park the motorcycle in the hotel. So no cars. Nice people, next to the square.
35 cop per night, 2 persons 70. No breakfast

Location: A Toche, El moral, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Special roadside waterfall
Description: Surprisingly beautiful waterfall along the road. Great place to rest and have lunch. It is possible to swim. Not enough space to park overnight though.

Location: Montezuma Ecolodge, Pueblo Rico - Santa Cecilia, Pueblo Rico, Vertiente Pacífico, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, Colombia
Name: Montezuma Rainforest lodge
Description: This lodge catering to birders is the only access to Tatama National Natural Park. We stayed here a few nights hiring a guide and a driver to go up into the Park. It was an incredible experience if you are a serious birder. Also has endemic orchids. Not cheap. Meals included. The driver takes you to the end of the road where it stops at a military compound. Then you walk down with the guide. The driver delivers breakfast and then lunch. It is an all day affair. Starlink here. We left our rig at Alto Bonito near Pueblo Rico. The Lodge provided a driver ($30 each way). The road is 4x4 only.

Location: Carretera Panamericana, Hierbabuena, Patía, El Estrecho, Sur del Cauca, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Estrecho Patia
Description: We drive a usa vehicle, we got a flat on the road. This great shop was able to help us at a cheaper price. They charge us $3 dollars to fix a flat tire.

Location: Carrera 8, Castillogrande, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130001, Colombia
Name: playa castillo grande
Description:
Beautiful safe place to park on the street, 10 meters from the sea. Incredible beach with warm water and white sand. Quiet and safe. The police come by very often and the area is very nice with buildings. They let us fill up with water in the buildings in front. A D1 is 700 meters away.
---
hermoso lugar seguro para estacionar en la calle, a 10 mts del mar. playa increible con agua calida y arena blanca. tranquilo y seguro. pasa la policia muy seguido y la zona es muy linda de edificios. agua nos dejaron cargar en los edificios de enfrente. un d1 a 700 metros.

Location: Calle 27, Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 005075, Colombia
Name: Quite neighborhood
Description: Safe, quiet, and free place by the beach. In front of buildings. Neighrboors do not complain. There is free tap water in the building on the corner

Location: Autopista Conexión Norte, Zaragoza, Bajo Cauca, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Restaurante La Piña de Oro
Description: Good spot to spend the night. The restaurant has a spacious parking lot and the owner Jorge is happy to receive more overlanders. The place even has a clean shower and clean toilets. The place is not fenced but has a guard during the night. The place is suitable for any vehicle or tent, also big rigs. Jorge didn’t ask for money. We just ate at the restaurant and gave him a generous tip. Some road noise during the night but it didn’t bother us too much.

Location: Cay, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, 730010, Colombia
Name: Finca Ecoparaiso Ibagué
Description: Very beautiful ecohotel with plenty of space to receive vehicles and tent campers. Camping spot with a view! The owner is happy to receive more overlanders. The road up is steep and narrow but doable with low clearance 2WD. Could be tricky for big rigs. I would recommend to call or whatsapp in advance: +57 3213420692. The price is 35.000 pp per night and includes breakfast. Cold showers and clean toilets available.

Location: Las Máquinas del Café, 29, Oro Negro, Comuna Quimbaya, Perímetro Urbano Armenia, Armenia, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631001, Colombia
Name: Volkswagen dealer
Description: Ended up her to find new glow plugs for our VW T4 diesel camper. They turned out to be very helpful. The original part was not available in Colombia so they literally tried everything to find an aftermarket part for us that could work. Employee Orlando even took me on the back of his motorcycle into town to see if we could find something there and didn’t charge me anything. Furthermore their workshop looked very professional. They were working on modern cars and capable of working with car computers. Probably a potential spot to remove a diesel particulate filter for example. Orlando’s number (whatsapp): +57 3225673218. General number (whatsapp): +57 3212055236.

Location: Santa Helena, Roncesvalles, Sur, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Villa Allicia Eco lodge
Description: Really nice accommodation, traditional house with wooden floors and walls, and a long veranda looking over a great view. 90,000 for a matrimonial not including breakfast but breakfast is available. Secure parking but with height restriction. Showers tepid. Really nice host. There is another hospedaje in town too

Location: ESE Hospital Departamental Universitario Santa Sofía de Caldas, Avenida Centenario, Centenario, Comuna La Macarena, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 170001, Colombia
Name: Los Turpiales
Description:
Eco finca los turpiales, camping, rooms, bird watching, fauna and flora, internet, water, relaxation spaces. A natural reserve very close to the city.
------------
Eco finca los turpiales, camping, habitaciones, avistamiento de aves, fauna y flora, internet, agua, espacios de relajacion. Una reserva natural muy cerca de la ciudad.

Location: Restaurant Parrilla Paisa parill, Calle 32, Guatapé, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053854, Colombia
Name: Hotel nomada
Description:
Hotel in Guatapé, economic without reservation, we stayed two nights here, very friendly people, they offered us two types of rooms, one with balcony for a cost of 200,000 cop, and without views 100,000, we paid 120,000 with breakfast for two people. Highly recommended.
-----------
Hotel en Guatapé, económico sin reserva, nos quedamos dos noches acá, la gente muy amable, nos ofrecieron dos tipos de habitaciones, uno con balcón por un costo de 200.000 cop, y sin vistas 100.000, pagamos 120.000 con desayuno para dos personas. Muy recomendado.

Location: Calle de la Ronda, Centro, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, RAP Caribe, 130003, Colombia

Description:
It is a safe and quiet parking lot, there is no electricity but it is guarded, it is 2 blocks from the clock tower. The manager's name is Santiago

Es un parqueadero seguro y tranquilo, no hay electricidad pero es vigilado, esta a 2 cuadras de la torre del reloj. El encargado se llama Santiago

Location: Localidad 3 Turística - Perla del Caribe, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470003, Colombia
Name: Electromecanica Serviautomotriz
Description: Very clean, organised, honest professionals. I arrived here after 2 mechanics in town had not resolved the injection problem. Jorge and his team were super professionals and a fair price. Super recommend it!

Location: Cosechas, Calle 12, San Gil, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684031, Colombia

We went parapenting in the Chicamocha Canyon with Fredy and his team. Very communicative. 220k cop for the vuelo and 50k cop for 20-30 photos and 2 video's.
They also pick you up in San Gil or anywhere in the area included in the price.
Very good pilots, we did some acrobatics as well, I could even steer for a while.
You can contact Fredy on Whatsapp +573165423158

Lugar amigable para los moto viajeros y aventureros restaurante buena ventilación buen clima buen servicio playa limpia amistosa con todos los viajeros y aventureros. Precios justos menú del día con un precio económico parqueadero al aire libre excelente lugar para pasar un fin de semana. hostales cerca

Location: Troncal de Occidente, El Doce, Tarazá, Bajo Cauca, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: No stop in El Doce
Description: People in Tarazá warned us to stop in El Doce. Police confirmed and said it’s especially dangerous to leave the main road or to stay overnight. It’s “zona frontera” of different groups. Check ahead if you’re passing in Tarazá or Valdivia.

Location: Estación De Gasolina - El Papa, Calle 16, Barrio Santander, Buenos Aires, Maicao, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, 442001, Colombia
Name: Diesel
Description: Gas station with diesel available right before the border. Cash only

Location: Centro Comercial Llanogrande, Km 2, Calle 31, Palmira, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 763533, Colombia
Name: Llanogrande Shopping Center
Description:
This shopping centre, unlike so many, is Big Rig friendly (go to gate 3).  There is a height barrier, about 4m.

The shopping centre is huge and with an Exito supermarket.

Location: Hospedaje Mediacanoa, 23, Vijes, Yotoco, Centro, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: La Fonda Paisa Yotoco
Description: This is a service area on the 23 road. There is a fuel station (seems to be closed), a hotel (for truckers), and a restaurant.  We asked for and were granted permission to park behind the restaurant for the night.

Location: Peluquería, Carrera 6, Belén, Tundama, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 150640, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Donde Lucho
Description: Amazing place and a real restaurant! If offered a variety of food: comida rapida, pizza, pasta, quesadilla or wok dishes. I enjoyed the veggie rice wok and it was great (incl limonda natural =21K). Many veggie options! Lucho is super friendly and prepares everything fresh. Highly recommend this place!

Location: Vía Loboguerrero - Mediacanoa, Restrepo, Yotoco, Centro, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Forestal Bosque de Yotoco
Description:
A very pleasant visit to this forest reserve. There are two hiking trails here. There is plenty of bird life and a significant population of Howler Monkies.

One drawback is the road and lorries. But the noise dies away once you are deep in.

We were not charged, but we were advised that reservations are normally required. You can reserve by contacting Valentin Hidalgo on 3154714748.

Location: Hotel Medina, Calle Los Faroles, Samaná, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Hotel Medina
Description: Nice hotel overlooking the square, secure parking 200m away for 4-6 motos or one small van. 60k for a large matrimonial with bathroom. Shower is better than the average electric shower. No breakfast but hot water and instant coffee to help yourself to. Not a sweaty climate here. A number of other hotels in this town too. Recommended

Location: Samaná, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Donde Alba
Description: Not many places to eat in this town but this restaurant is really nice. Colombian food with all the usual choices of meat but they were happy to offer a vegan or veggie option if you talk to them. Soup and a bowl of chick peas and an excellent hot chocolate was 7.5k

Location: Calle 5A, San Agustín, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 418060, Colombia
Name: Tingo Tango
Description:
We went here for a beer and something to eat, no great expectations. We had Spaghetti Bolognese - it came cold and almost without sauce, a second try the same, the third was okay. 
The steak was well well well done instead of medium-rare  and cold, we reordered chicken, this was okay but side dishes not renewed and cold.
No service - we put the light on ourselves, no forks, no serviettes…  
So, after all: not recommended, they are still learning….

Location: Carrera 18, Francisco de Paula Santander, Comuna Francisco de Paula Santander, Perímetro Urbano Armenia, Armenia, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 630003, Colombia
Name: Lubricantes Armenia
Description:
Excellent quality products and the best price, recommended for foreigners as they will not try to charge unfairly.
--------
Productos de excelente calidad y el mejor precio, recomendado para extranjeros ya que no tratarán de cobrar injustamente.

Location: Buenos Aires, Andes, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Jardín del paraíso escondido
Description:
Excellent with parking for car and motorbike, it is a very cosy place with a beautiful garden, the people are very friendly and the beds are very comfortable.
It is close to Chorro Blanco and on the way to Jericho.
Highly recommended.
---
Excelente con parqueadero para carro y moto, es un lugar muy acogedor y con un jardín hermoso, las personas son muy amables y las camas muy cómodas.
Queda cerca de Chorro Blanco y de paso para Jericó.
Muy recomendado.

Location: Calle 7, Centro, Villahermosa, Nevados, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Donde Fabis
Description: Particularly excellent local food. Soup with two different types of potato, main meal with both beans and lentils, choice of chicken or meat or really nice stewed meat. The rice has grated carrot in and a great texture. Word of caution - both beans and lentils have some bacon in so though she is happy for you to mix and match, it's still not veggie. Station to wash your hands. 13k COP for two courses and juice

Location: La Loma, La Paz, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Casa pastuchito-cucu
Description:
Small family campsite near Hoyo del Aire.
There is space for up to 2-3 small vehicles.
A little further away, space for up to 10-15 vehicles can also be offered (these will be without shower and toilet).

There is a small shower (cold) with toilet. 
Doña Amanda will be happy to welcome you to her property.

What can be visited nearby: 
- Hoyo del Aire:
https://www.instagram.com/reel/DEa4hDGuZ_I/?igsh=MTkzNGdyOW5oeml4

- La Laguna Negra

Doña Amande also offers homemade local cuisine, most of which is cooked over an open fire. You can also enjoy a coffee produced on the finca. There are small chorizerias that sell their products.

In nearby La Paz you can buy fresh vegetables, mostly from local production.

- Traditional cuisine breakfast and lunch

Location: Centro Histórico de Santa Marta, Calle 18, Localidad 2 Histórica - Rodrigo de Bastidas, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, 470004, Colombia
Name: JJ MAC technology store
Description:
Cristian Pache is a great guy who will help you out with anything technological you might need. He got us 3 1TB external hard drives (HHD) for very good price and went the extra mile to get us protection cases for them too. 
highly recommended

Location: Vía Palermo - Gambita, Gámbita, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Nice pull out tents only
Description:
Just for tents!!! It’s a nice pullout on the top of the climb. Completely hidden from the road, flat, grassy, no one passed by during the night. Lots os birds and great views. 
No water, no facilities, not car friendly. 

If you’re doing o boyaca seems a nice place to camp, as the city Gambita is not welcoming for tents (asked everybody) and there’s only expensive hotels. 

See the fotos of the entrance and the place.

Location: Vereda Santa Barbara, Duitama, Tundama, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Camping next to ruins at 3.800m 4x4 only
Description:
Amazing place, one of the best so far in 1,5 year travelling. There are 2 house ruins, a lot of grassy and flat areas in the middle. Protected from the wind, stunning views and hidden from the road. Very calm and cold. No water, no facilities. There’s a part on the fence that you can open, than just follow the track till de ruins. 
Idk if you can make with a 4x4. Other cars is impossible.

Location: Brisas de Luisa, Rovira, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Nos detuvimos frente a la estación de bomberos donde fueron muy amables y nos ofrecieron agua. La calle es muy transitada durante el día, pero por la noche estaba muy tranquila. Muy cerca del centro y de todas las atracciones turísticas.

I recommend 5000 times. for info all the parquedero around here but they all refused to park more than one night. it is often 40,000 pesos per hour here we paid 180,000 for two days

Location: Sopó, Sabana Centro, RAP (Especial) Central, 251001, Colombia
Name: Alpes Café
Description: Amazing cafe with good cappuccino and great baked goods. Street parking available.

Name: Viaduct Hike - Parking for Big Rigs
Description: A good place to park for the Viaduct Hike (separately marked). Plenty of  space for a Big Rig and only a 100m or so to the start of the hike.

Location: Carrera 2, Jardín, La Salada, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056050, Colombia
Name: Spot near the river
Description: when i visited Jardín there was a building under construction near the end of the road. I walked behind it and there was a muddy path leading down to the river. Completely secluded and covered by trees from all angles. The only way you would be able to see it is if you walked down that path deliberately. Be careful if it rains, you can definitely slip.

Location: Estadio, Carrera 10, Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 631020, Colombia
Name: Trail behind soccer field
Description:
Might need to hop or crawl under the fence. There is a trail behind the soccer field, a bit hard to miss. Just lift up the fence or push your things underneath and walk down a bit. There are a few spots but there is one that overlooks the mountains. Very beautiful.

The trail leads down to a few farms but everyone seemed ok with the camping, though a bit weirded out. Gave one of them some chocolate and his mood seemed to change.

Location: Carrera 14, Villa de Leiva, Villa de Leyva, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154001, Colombia
Name: Ruta 40
Description: I had the best time staying 5 Nights in the Ruta40 Hotel. Manuel, Dario and Rachel are amazing Host. They take great care of the guest in any matter. As a cyclists, the bike shop next door is just great! Beds are super comfy and showers are hot! Highly recommend this place !

Location: Calle 3, Roldanillo, Norte, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 761550, Colombia
Name: Under a bridge
Description:

TONS OF MOSQUITOS!!

Lugar menos expuesto que el de Chipre, con menos espacio, pero no pasa el tránsito al lado nuestro. Ni pasan gente que vive en la calle ya que estas en el estacionamiento de la policía y la Ford. Location: Vergara, Gualivá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Donde Rosita
Description:
Amazing veggie Lunch for 10K. Staff was very friendly. They also offer the typical columbian lunch with meat. 
Street parking possible but difficult. Hilly and one-way street

Location: Agrovilla, Neira, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Restaurant Llano Grande km41 CYCLING ONLY?
Description:
Great place for one night if you are cycling. You can pitch your tent in a big area after they close at 4pm. Food is good. Nice juices.
Big plate + juice for 26k pesos. 
There is a river 5 min walk but they offered me shower too. 
Jonathan is the security guy all night.
Good stop before Pereira and eje cafetero.

Location: La Uvita - San Mateo, Urbanizacion Villa Laura, San Mateo, Norte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 151060, Colombia
Name: Abandoned house
Description:
It’s not actually an abandoned house, but a place where they store something. You can sleep under a roof or in the large grassy area. Hidden from the road, nice view and quiet night. 
If you’re coming from the south, there’s water almost in the end of the uphill, where you should refil your bottles (on the left side of the road, a little hard to see from the road).

Location: Soata, Soatá, Norte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 151001, Colombia
Name: Wild camping on the pass
Description:
Some options for wild camping here, under the trees, on the grassy area, quite a few leveled places and no one around. Didn’t see a person for 24 hours. Right in the border of Santander and Boyaca. Nice views and protected from wind. You can find well hidden places around. 
No facilities, no water…

Location: Vía Perimetral Bosatama, Bosatama, Corregimiento 2 Norte, Soacha, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 250051, Colombia
Name: Ruinas de ciudad verde
Description:
This is not a legal camping area. But you can spend the night and camp in this place (always at your own risk). 

There are no amenities besides a couple of walls of ruins of some old houses. It is very close to ciudad verde, which is a neighbourhood of buildings, where you can probably get some toilets and tents to stock up. 

I recommend setting up camp at night and packing up early in the morning as in this area many people go out to exercise and walk their dogs in the mornings. There is also a farm nearby with cows and other animals.

Está no es una zona de camping legal. Pero se puede pasar la noche y acampar en este lugar (siempre bajo su propio riesgo)
No hay ningún tipo de comodidad además de un par de muros de las ruinas de unas antiguas casas. Está muy cerca de ciudad verde, que es un barrio de edificios, donde seguramente se puede conseguir algún baño y tiendas para abastecerse
Yo recomiendo armar el campamento en la noche y recoger temprano en la mañana ya que en esta zona mucha gente sale a hacer ejercicio y pasear a sus perros en las mañanas. También hay una finca muy cerca con vacas y otros animales.

Location: Vía Campana Nueva - Dibulla, Campana Nueva, Dibulla, La Guajira, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Campesinos road blocks
Description:
On Feb 27th, 2025. Campesinos protesters made a roadblock with branches and tires at the crossing. Police on site.
They removed the roadblocks every 3h. No exceptions.
They were not aggressive nor threatening, just blocking the road. Be patient.

Location: Hotel San Francisco, Carrera 5, Tequendama, Pitalito, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 417030, Colombia
