Description: Cross the bridge turn left (you might have to jump the fence or climb over the gate) and walk a minute or two down the trail and take a left when you see a gap that opens up. There is a large space and its not visible unless you deliberately walk there. Its a little overgrown so I’m not sure many people pass through. It leads to the river and there is a cool view of the mountains.

Location: Avenida 4, Palmira, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Close to the airport
Description: We spent one night here before going to the airport. And don't want to pay 30,000 COP pp at the camping close to here. A bit noisy but nice for one night. There is a grassy area just on the side of a grocery. The owner was really nice and told us that it's a public space.

Location: Carrera 11, Sucre, Comuna 9, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760010, Colombia
Name: Volkswagen Taller Lucho
Description: We get there to fix a oil leak and Lucho was impressive. He don't speak a lot but when a heard the sound of the engine a just said "there is a problem with a spark plug", unplug two of them and they doesn't works. That is crazy because we went to other shop and told us "the sound is good".

Location: Chocontá, Almeidas, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Senderos del Sisga
Description: A nice and quiet place with view of the lake. It has a cost of $35.000 COP per person, you can't just arrive, there is a guard at the beggining of the road who will ask you to make a reservation to the number listed (+57 3202200470) to be let in. Once you arrive, you can find plenty of camping spots that you can get to with ease. Know there are some arches on the road up to the campsites where bigger rigs won't be able to go through. However, there's a small parking lot where you can leave your car. It also has a little kiosk where you can buy many goods like beer, some food and firewood.

Location: Colinas de Calabazo, Santa Marta, Magdalena, RAP Caribe, Colombia
Name: Portables Del Tayrona Garden Hotel
Description:
We found this great spot while we were looking for a place to stay before going into Tayrona NP the next day. It is a nice Hotel and Restaurant that fills up with locals on the weekends. They have a very large parking area. It looked perfect so we asked if we could stay. We paid 50,000 Col. they have a pool, but it is another $10,000 pp. they have bathrooms and cold showers. Did not ask about electricity. Not great cell service in this area, but lots of open sky for Starlink and solar panels.
The restaurant was pretty good and not super pricey. We paid about $30 US for 2 seafood dishes and 2 beers.
They said we could leave the van while we visit the park tomorrow.

Location: Buenavista-Simijaca, Simijaca, Ubaté, RAP (Especial) Central, 154660, Colombia

Hermosa finca, con los dueños mas amables y buenos. nos quedamos descansando vários días en esta casita de campo, muy lindas vistas y cerca del centro. muchas gracias a Edmo por ser tan amable con los viajeros y recibirnos.

hermoso y tranquilo lugar con baños gratuitos y permiten cargar agua potable. muy amable la gente . no permiten venta de artesanias. muy concurrido los fines de semana frente a las canchas de voley.

Description:
Several restaurants and two hotels are located at the entrance to the Porce fork in the village. They're called PUNTO a PARTE and RANCHO GRANDE. You have to go around the building visible from the main road. I noticed two water taps. The restaurants have affordable prices. The police came while I was having dinner and asked me for my ID. They politely asked me where I was from and told me it was fine for me to stay, that the place was completely safe. They were very kind, but I don't know why they did that.
>>>>
Varios Restaurantes y dos hoteles en la entrada a la bifurcación del pueblo PORCE.  Se llaman PUNTO a PARTE, y RANCHO GRANDE. Hay que dar la vuelta a al edificio que se ve desde la ruta principales. Vi que hay dos grifos para agua. Los restaurantes tienen precios económicos. Location: Buenaventura, Pacífico, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 764502, Colombia
Name: Front of Loui's house

Location: El Pomarrosal, San José de Suaita, Suaita, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: san  jose posada
Description:
The campsite in San José is located in a quiet rural area, surrounded by nature. It has basic services such as electricity and drinking water, which makes it a comfortable place to spend the night. It is an ideal place for those travelling with small cars or motorbikes, as it has parking spaces for both. The mobile phone signal in the area is good, allowing you to stay connected without any problems. In addition, the campsite offers Wi-Fi access, allowing visitors to enjoy the internet during their stay. It is a perfect place for those looking for a camping experience with the comfort of modern amenities,

El camping en San José está ubicado en una zona rural tranquila, rodeada de naturaleza. Cuenta con los servicios básicos como luz eléctrica y agua potable, lo que lo hace cómodo para pasar la noche. Es un lugar ideal para quienes viajan en autos pequeños o en moto, ya que tiene espacios habilitados para el estacionamiento de ambos. La señal de celular en el área es buena, lo que permite mantenerse conectado sin problemas. Además, el camping ofrece acceso a Wi-Fi, permitiendo que los visitantes puedan disfrutar de internet durante su estancia. Es un sitio perfecto para quienes buscan una experiencia de camping con la comodidad de servicios modernos,

Location: Troncal Central del Norte, Covarachía, Norte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: TALLER AUTOMOTRIZ INVECO
Description:
This place is amazing. Winson is a studied mechanic, who has been teaching mechanics across the country. He and his team were perfect to solve our problem.

We came with a Peugeot Boxer and a nonworking DPF and our car was already running in the emergency mode. 
They have a OBD2 scanner and planned to regenerate the DPF. It was so clogged that the system didn’t allow it anymore so they cleaned is manually and got our car back running.

There is enough place to sleep in the car while working on it and they also have an outdoor shower and bathroom we could use (we stayed for an extra night). Long term they plan to offer this place to overlanders as a place to stay the night.  

They welcomed us with open arms way beyond the mechanical service.

With energy of 220 and 110.

Good breeze.

Quiet in the night, even on a Saturday (based on my stay in the 7th floor). Secure indoor parking garage for cars and motorcycles. Decent Wifi, good Claro reception.

Description: Nothing fancy but a decent vegan menu for 16k. It tastes good. You get soup, main, salad and drink. Even a tiny desert.

Location: Moniquirá, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154290, Colombia
Name: Myofascial Release Therapy
Description:
I had pain on my shoulder and got Alejandros number from Marina, the campground owner of La Cabra Gris in Moniquira. The therapy of his consultation is integral and involves the structural and physiological approach from the myofascial release and the bioenergy from traditional Chinese medicine. The therapy lasted 2.5h and Alejandro taught me many exercises which I can practice on the road. Excellent! Of course I need more consultations to release all the  pain but I'm working on it with the exercises Alejandro showed me.

Cost: 50'000 COP for the whole therapy.

Alejandro is soon moving to another place within Moniquira. You can contact him and ask for an appointment and the proper location. 

WhatsApp Alejandro Rodriguez
+57 312 397 4063.

Me vine hasta acá para salir del ruido y de la música del pueblo, aunque es Domingo. Se siente seguro, y los lancheros dicen que lo es. Location: Aratoca, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Glamping Clavellinas
Description: Staying here was such a heartwarming experience! This lovely Colombian family made us feel so welcome, and their property is a peaceful mountain retreat. You can camp in your car on their gravel driveway with access to a shower and toilet or stay in a cozy cabin with a fireplace and bath—both offering stunning views. You can also camp with a tent on grass down by a little communal fire pit. There’s also a cute little house you can rent if you are a family. All around the area are some really nice sights, for example you can hike or drive to a tiny, historical town called Jordan all the way at the bottom of this valley or you can take a walk to the top of a waterfall (cascada manchego) cascading down the cliffs not far from here where you can go swimming with an amazing view of the canyon! Best to WhatsApp before arriving :)

Location: Carrera 65B, Santa Fé, Comuna 15 - Guayabal, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050024, Colombia

Location: Cabrera-San Juan, Peñas Blancas, Cabrera, Sumapaz, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Location: Troncal de Occidente, Tarragona, Florida, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Armed Robbery and then robbed by the police.
Description:
I was cycling south bound when I stopped for a few moments for some water and two young lads on a bike pulled off of a dirt track. They drove past me but then turned around and pulled up beside with. The guy on the back of the bike had a pistol pointed at me and they took my phone and wallet. This was on the stretch of road between Candelaria and Puerto Tejada.

I then cycled back towards Candelaria, hoping to get to Cali, when I saw two police officers. They offered to go after the robbers but I said I'd rather them take me to somewhere I can get a bus to Cali. They seemed fine but said I'd need some money for the bus - the only money I had left was in a folder which also contained my passport and a back up phone. Clearly they saw this as when they were 'helping' to put stuff on the bus, one of the officers was stuffing the folder down the front of his trousers. I was too scared to say anything, apart from make it clear that the folder was gone and they offered me the choice to either get on the bus, or take everything out. When the bus arrived in Candelaria, they turned up with the folder but without any cash nor the phone. 

I'd be super careful along this stretch of road as I wouldn't want anyone going through the same thing. If you're pre-planning your trip and see this, don't let it put you off Colombia - the rest of the time was amazing, I think I was just in the wrong place at the wrong time.

We flew with our cat to the Netherlands (most EU countries have the same requirements). Since it was difficult to find out how the entire process works, I'm adding this info here.
1. Make sure all your vaccines are up to date and that you have a valid rabies titer which is at least 90 days old.

2. Register at the government website: https://afrodita.ica.gov.co/ADM_IMPORTADOR_EXPORTADOR/AddADM_IMPORTADOR_EXPORTADOR_PUB.aspx
You will receive an email with your username and temporary password. Change the password using the link in the email, and you have an account.

3. Find a vet to do the paperwork. The vet will have the required European Health form. Take all your paperwork and the pet with you to the vet. 

4. If the vet did  everything right you will get an confirmation email with a payment link. I will add a printscreen of this email.

5. You either pay online or with card at the ICA office at the airport.

6. Go to ICA at the airport to pick up the paperwork. Take your pet with you! 

There are a few things to consider:
- we approached 3 vets through WhatsApp. Response was very poor. Best to call or go to the vet to make an appointment and ask for costs etc.
- Do this at least five days before flying. Your paperwork is valid for ten days. It is unclear how much time ICA needs. We asked at vets and got answers varying between 1-5 days. We went to the vet on Tuesday and picked up our paperwork from ICA on Friday.
-Expect system issues. It took us an hour to create the account mentioned in step one. Then after the vet visit we couldn't pay online. The system gave error codes. Eventually at the ICA office (super friendly and helpful)it turned out the vet also hadn't finished a last step in the online process. So definitely don't go and pick up your paperwork just before flying. ICA costs 70.000 pesos.

Description:
Overlander Parking Area – Los Caballeros Waterfall

Welcome overlanders: if you're exploring by camper, van, or 4x4, this parking area is the perfect place to stop, rest, and reconnect with nature. Located a short distance from the impressive Los Caballeros Waterfall, this area offers a safe and comfortable environment to spend the night or recharge during the day.

Features:

Ample, level parking for all types of vehicles.
 Free Wi-Fi, ideal for planning your next route or sharing your experience.

 Simple but clean shower area, perfect after a swim in the waterfall or a day of hiking.

Nature is all around you, with shaded trees, nearby trails, and the constant sound of running water.

The proximity to the waterfall makes it easy to enjoy a dip or a walk among green landscapes and fresh air.  It's an ideal spot for both travelers in transit and those looking to disconnect for a longer period of time.

Quiet, practical, and connected to nature: just what an overlander needs.
--
Zona de Parqueo para Overlanders – Cascada Los Caballeros

Bienvenidos overlanders: si estás explorando en camper, van o 4x4, esta zona de parqueo es el lugar perfecto para detenerte, descansar y reconectar con la naturaleza. Ubicada a corta distancia de la impresionante Cascada Los Caballeros, esta área te ofrece un entorno seguro y cómodo para pasar la noche o recargar energías durante el día.

Cuenta con:

 Espacio amplio y nivelado para todo tipo de vehículos.

WiFi gratuito, ideal para planear la próxima ruta o compartir tu experiencia.

 Área de duchas sencillas pero limpias, perfectas después de un baño en la cascada o una jornada de ruta.

 Naturaleza a tu alrededor, con sombra de árboles, senderos cercanos y el sonido constante del agua.

La cercanía con la cascada permite disfrutar fácilmente de un chapuzón o una caminata entre paisajes verdes y aire puro. Es un punto ideal tanto para viajeros en tránsito como para quienes buscan desconectarse por más tiempo.

Tranquilo, práctico y conectado con la naturaleza: justo lo que un overlander necesita.

Description: Common scam in Bogota happened to us here. Locals said this happens a lot in this section so be aware when passing through. A moto got close to our front passenger side tire and gestured there was a problem, a few seconds later it goes flat very quickly. Later found a broken drill bit/screw had been shoved into our tire. A taxi driver immediately pulled over and told us to use a local tire shop that seemed like part of the scam. They were only going to charge 30k pesos but the guy who turned up was clueless and had worse tools than ours and stank of booze so decided to fix it ourselves with the help of a very kind local policeman. Location: Isla del Poe, Sendero ecológico, Com. Negra Sapzurro, Capurganá, Acandí, Darién, Chocó, RAP Pacífico, 278017, Colombia

Location: Carrera 3, La Vega, Gualivá, RAP (Especial) Central, 253610, Colombia
Name: Delicias de Leito

Small parking strip next to commerce. Low cell signal, but at walkable distance from town square. Not recommended for long vans, as parking is diagonal from street.

Parqueadero pequeño en la calle. Señal de celular baja , pero está a distancia caminable del centro. No se recomienda para vans largas porque se parquea en diagonal.

Location: Vía Tarazá - Caucasia, Barrio Centro, Puerto Bélgica, Cáceres, Bajo Cauca, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Finca Puerto Bélgica
Description: Local cyclists recommended to me this farm to ask for camping. I wasn’t inspired by the spots in Puerto Bélgica so I came here and they accepted me. Really nice people. Came cycling and set up my tent under a big roof. Bucket shower, toilets with water, electricity, limited phone service with Tigo, quiet at night. Great spot to stay one night. The woman even offered me food for breakfast.

Location: Vía Neusa, Cogua, Sabana Centro, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

El parque rio neusa es un aula ambiental administrado por la corporación autónoma regional de Cundinamarca CAR, la cual ofrece un espacio natural ideal para campistas y familias. Contains con seguridad privada las 24 horas

Location: Carrera 50, Currulao, Urbanización El Baile, Currulao, Turbo, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Resedencias
Description: 35.000 for a private room. WiFi is decent, no running water as of this evening that I’m writing this, but maybe the water is turned off in the evening to save water.

Location: Kilele, 64-36, Carrera 55, El Chagualo, Comuna 10 - La Candelaria, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050010, Colombia

From air conditioning to electric or mechanical problems, finding parts and so on. Very friendly guys, hard working and fair prices. Highly recommend. Garage is small and unimpressive but fits my 6,5x2x3,2 van and they created a very professional solution for my electrical issue. Just spanisch speaking but totally fine with using the translator if you need to talk about details.

Location: Parqueadero, Carrera 69, San Joaquín, Comuna 11 - Laureles-Estadio, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050031, Colombia

Parking without height restriction in the center of Laureles. 
My 6,5m length was pretty much the limit they were willing to accept and just after they realised I will stay for a couple of days. Got a discount which was 50.000 COP per 24 hours.

Location: Carrera 111A, Versalles, UPZ Fontibón, Localidad Fontibón, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 110911, Colombia

Location: Calle 3, Barrio Aures, Buga, Centro, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 763041, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero del Rio Guadalajara

Parking for campers and big rigs. a short 10 min walk to the centre of Buga.

A few lorries and buses parked here when we were there.

Location: Zona Urbana de Ráquira, Ráquira, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Location: Troncal del Eje Cafetero, Tapias, Neira, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Terpel truck parking
Description: Place is empty very quite and there is water too

Location: Troncal de Occidente, Puerto Valdivia, Cachirimé, Puerto Valdivia, Valdivia, Norte, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Centro de Salud Puerto Valdivia
Description: Came here cycling after trying Quebrada Cachirime. I knew one guy working in this health center, he brought me up there where there is a nice flat place with a roof and bathrooms. I don’t know if they would host other cyclists but the whole team seemed nice and it can be worth asking.

Location: Troncal de Occidente, Morron O Sevilla, El Nevado, Valdivia, Norte, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 052010, Colombia
Name: Bomberos Valdivia
Description: Came here cycling, ask if I could stay at the fire station and they warmly welcomed me. I camped under the roof on the parking lot. Clean toilets and showers, electricity, water, kitchen, great spot to stay in Valdivia.

Location: Calle 1, El Centro, Comuna 1 Centro Histórico, Riohacha, La Guajira, 440001, Colombia
Name: Ducha
Description:
Showers near the beach for 3000 pesos, there are also bathrooms for 1500.

Duchas cerca de la playa por 3000 pesos, tambien hay baños por 1.500 :)

Location: Troncal Central, Aratoca, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia

Small hotel, very friendly owner who allowed us to keep our bicycles safely. No hot water, but clean.
.....
Pequeño hotel, pero muy amable el dueño porque es ciclista se pueden guardar las bicicletas. No tiene agua caliente pero es limpio.

Location: Carrera 53, Calle Nueva, Comuna 10 - La Candelaria, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050015, Colombia
Name: Taller Gonzalo Gomes
Description:
Very fast . There were 4-5 mechanics working on our vehicle when we came without appointment. We did not wait at all! They are all very kind. We recommend it of course!
.....
Très rapide pour la prise en charge. Ils ont regardé à 4 où 5 mécanos notre véhicule alors que nous venions sans rendez-vous. Nous n'avons pas patienté du tout ! Ils sont tous d'une grande gentillesse. Nous le recommandons bien sûr !

Location: Carretera de la Cordialidad, La Puntica, Luruaco, Atlántico, 080032, Colombia

Description:
After asking permission from the restaurant, we parked in this parking lot, guard at night, games for children, lookout, unlimited mangoes (it's the season), only negative point is the proximity of the road, 6 a.m. start of the passage of vehicles. You can eat or drink a beer at the restaurant (closing at 6 p.m.) and of course respect this place. Thank you.

après avoir demander l'autorisation au restaurant, nous nous sommes garés sur ce parking, gardien la nuit, jeux pour enfants, mirador, mangues à volonté ( c'est la saison), seul point négatif, c'est la proximité de la route, 6h du matin début du passages des véhicules . vous pouvez manger ou boire une bière au restaurant ( fermeture à 18h00) et bien sûr respecter ce lieu. merci.

Después de pedir permiso al restaurante, aparcamos en este parking, guardia de noche, juegos para niños, mirador, mangos ilimitados (es temporada), único punto negativo la cercanía de la carretera, inicio del paso de vehículos a las 6 am. Puedes comer o beber una cerveza en el restaurante (cierre a las 18:00 horas) y por supuesto respetar este lugar. GRACIAS.

Location: Carrera 8, La Feria, Cajamarca, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Cajamarca
Description:
We stayed on a quiet street near the center of Cajamarca. No problems, safe, and friendly locals. Perfect for a night or two.

Dormimos en una calle tranquila cerca al centro de Cajamarca.. sin problemas, seguro y locales amigables. Perfecto para una noche o dos.

Location: Calle 63F, 7 de Agosto, UPZs Localidad Barrios Unidos, Localidad Barrios Unidos, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111221, Colombia

Muy recomendado varias marcas Renault,Ford ,Kia, Mazda Nissan, Toyota etc

Location: Calle 12, Plaza central Cota, Puente de la Cruz, Cota urbana, Cota, Sabana Occidente, RAP (Especial) Central, 250010, Colombia
Name: Parque de Cota
Description:
After 8 pm, you'll find parking and sleeping spots here. It's very busy and hectic. We parked on another street when we arrived and then moved on to spend the night. It's safe. It's not suitable for large vehicles because you have to park diagonally. We left early the next day before the rush.

Despues de las 20 hs vas a encontrar para estacionar y dormír aquí ,es muy transitado y mucho movimiento . Estacionamos al llegar en otra calle para después movernos y pasar la noche . Seguro. No es para vehículos grandes porque se estaciona en diagonal . Al otro día nos fuimos temprano antes que empiece el movimiento.

Location: Calle 30, Cañasgordas, Occidente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057060, Colombia
Name: Hotel al Mar
Description:
35.000 as of May 2025. Nice rooms, appears to be done up quite recently, clean and modern. Owner is nice too. Nice little village also.


Peeta

Location: Consultorios Clínica Medellín Torre Fundadores, Carrera 43A, Calle 7, La Florida, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050021, Colombia
Name: Yellow fever vaccine
Description:
It's a big house with many different doctors.
If you need the yellow fever vaccine take the elevator to the 8. Floor and go to room 806.
It's the international vaccine center. 
The whole process took me 10 minutes and I paid 130.000 Cop.
Very recommended.

Location: DKché, Carrera 7, Oiba, Comunera, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Hotel D'Kche
Description: Nice hotel, good size double rooms with ensuite and fan. Secure bicycle storage on back patio. Paid 70,000 for 2 people 1 night

Location: Rincón del Mar, San Onofre, Morrosquillo, Sucre, 707017, Colombia
Name: Cabaña Valhalla
Description:
Found this Hostal/cabaña Valhalla in a side street a bit of the main road and before the busy town.  
Has street parking in front of the hostal for a few motorbikes. Super save because the police station is right next door.  Kitchen to use,  cold shower,  AC and fan,  several room options. 
Paid 50 K COP single person in off season.

Location: Calle 3, Vereda las lajas, Toche, Ibagué, Centro, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Toche town cancha
Description: We (two cyclists) stayed here after it seemed all the hotels in town were full. The cancha is an extension of a town health centre which was shut when we were there. It's not covered but is fenced off. Friendly people in town who had no issues with us camping there. Some people told us to ask permission from El Presidente but he wasn't around that evening. A few stray dogs passing whilst we were cooking but other than that a quiet night. There's access to the river and a few shops, but other than that there isn't any water so come prepared.

Location: San Juan de Rioseco, Magdalena Centro, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Plaza en la iglesia
Description:
It's a place to spend the night, quiet, but with history... although nothing happened, the people are very reserved and we didn't feel very comfortable with their stares.
___
Es como para pasar la noche es tranquilo ,pero con historia...  si bien no paso nada la gente es muy reservada y no nos sentimos muy a gusto con sus miradas..

Location: Acuaparque Panachi, Autopista a Floridablanca, Aratoca, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 682051, Colombia
Name: Aquaparc Chicamocha
Description: Aquaparc of the parque Chicamocha. Nice view but a bit expensive for the services: 22000 for daily parking (not possible to over night anymore they said), 40000 entrance for adult, 30000 entrance  for child.

Location: Coloradas, Santa Fe de Antioquia, Occidente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Bike shop (Mundo Bici)
Description: Couldn’t shift into my highest gear, not the biggest fix ever but these guy fixed it no problem and asked for only 5000 (I gave more obviously). Nice guys, would recommend. One guy speaks nice and slow/clear Spanish, the other guy with tattoos, I’ve absolutely no idea what he’s saying

Location: Carrera 4, Coloradas, Santa Fe de Antioquia, Occidente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Resedencia Familiar
Description: 45000 for a private room for 1 person as of May 2025. Average room with a fan. Good WiFi

Location: Carrera 8, Barbosa, Vélez, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 684511, Colombia
Name: Puerta de Oro
Description: Nice hotel, good size room with ensuite no fan or AC. Stored bicycles in another room for us, but did have to carry them up stairs. Paid $60,000 for 2 people 1 night

Location: Finca La Selvita, Calle Bonet, Santa Marta, Magdalena, Colombia
Name: Finca La Selvita
Description: Nestled in the heart of the world, La Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, La Selvita is a true hidden gem offering a complete cacao experience. From immersive jungle adventures filled with diverse bird species to exquisite vegetarian fusion cuisine and incredible tree-to-bar chocolate, it’s the perfect destination to relax, recharge, and disconnect.

Location: Transversal Medellin - Bogotá, El Vino, La Vega, Gualivá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Kombai park
Description: Free parking below on the grass, level and wide ---- Gratis parqueo abajo sobre el pasto, nivelado y amplio

Location: Marquetalia, Santa Marta, Magdalena, 446009, Colombia
Name: La Esquina Lejana
Description: A very nice accommodation. Has everything you need. 30 000 cop

Location: 45AHL01, Tello, Neiva, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Swimming hole
Description: Swimming hole good to let dogs out or take a quick dip. I wouldnt go out of the way to come here, but a good mid day break spot. There is basura around but the river its self looks clean.

Location: Calle 6A, San Alberto, Cesar, Colombia
Name: Iglesia San Alberto
Description: Parking lot in front of iglesia and escuela. Big rigs friendly, some streets are narrow but we didn't have problems with a 7.5m/3.15m motorhome. Quiet. Kids park. Friendly people living close. No services.

Location: Carrera 4, Barichara, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Taller Barichara
Description: We needed a filter tool to remove the oil filter. Friendly people in the city and police told us to go there. Nice taller. Very helpfull, nice person.

Location: Carrera 1, La Dorada, Magdalena Caldense, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 175031, Colombia
Name: Frente al río
Description: Parking in front of the river, the previous place disappeared after finishing the construction of the boardwalk. Expanded and leveled ----- Parqueo frente al río, el anterior lugar desapareció luego de terminar la construcción del malecón. Amplió y nivelado

Location: Avenida Calle 57R Sur, UPZs Localidad Bosa, Localidad Bosa, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 110741, Colombia
Name: Tire puncture scam
Description: Drove here on a Wednesday around 1pm. A guy on a bicycle acting drunk hit a car behind us, and then drove close by our car and the one in front of us. He didn’t stop and drove like 10km/h, but still managed to perfectly align a sharp object in front of our tire just before the light turned green. We didn’t trust it and checked, and found a sharp object in front of our passenger tire (see photo). They don’t stick it in the tire as is mentioned in the other warnings, but they place it on the ground using their feet. Watch out for anyone with bare feet I guess.. by the way, the police aren’t helpful as they were only 5m away from us when it happened. They also didn’t chase the guy, who was cycling only 30m away. They acted like they didn’t care at all. So even though there is a lot of police presence, it doesn’t mean you’re safe from these guys.

Location: Carrera 16, Belmonte, Comuna Olímpica, Perimetro Urbano Pereira, Pereira, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660006, Colombia
Name: Parque Belmonte
Description: A quiet spot in Pereira. We came here on a neighbor's recommendation. On one side, they have food carts. We arrived on a Friday, and it was a bit noisy until 2 a.m. During the day, many people come up to talk, and everyone is very kind and attentive. Lugar tranquilo en Pereira, llegamos por recomendación de un vecino. En uno de sus lados que ponen carritos de venta de comida, llegamos un viernes y si hubo un poco de ruido hasta las 2am. Durante el día mucha gente se acerca a hablar y todos son muy buenos y atentos.

Location: Calle 10, Ginebra, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Parque Saiman
Description: A quiet spot in Ginebra. We came here on a neighbor's recommendation. very quit in the night During the day, many people come up to talk, and everyone is very kind and attentive.

Location: Via Altagracia, El Oso, Altagracia, AMCO, Area Metropolitana Centro Occidente, Pereira, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660008, Colombia
Name: La divisa de Don Juan
Description: A beautiful place where you can learn about coffee, from the cultivation to the tasting. A four-generation family, they are passionate about their work and share their love and knowledge. Johana, our guide, taught us a lot about the coffee region, and her knowledge is evident; she was able to answer all our questions. Hermoso lugar, donde podes aprender sobre el café. Desde el cultivo hasta la cata del mismo. Familia de 4 generaciones, que le ponen pasión a su trabajo y transmiten von amor y conocimiento. Johana nuestra guía nos enseñó muchísimo del eje cafetero y se nota su conocimiento, supo responder todas nuestras dudas. A beautiful place where you can learn about coffee, from the cultivation to the tasting. A four-generation family, they are passionate about their work and share their love and knowledge. Johana, our guide, taught us a lot about the coffee region, and her knowledge is evident; she was able to answer all our questions.

Location: Calle, Palomino, Dibulla, La Guajira, 446009, Colombia
Name: Kasama
Description: One of the best restaurant in America de Sur. All the plates are veggans and home products. Since 16000 at 32000 cops.

Location: Calle 30A, La Pintada, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 055060, Colombia
Name: Casa Andres
Description: Pretty good small hotel. We paid 50k for a room with a double bed and a single bed, fan, wifi and private bathroom. And a tv, as it seems to be a thing here. We sneaked the bikes inside the room, wasn’t a problem at all. All remain pretty basic but for the price, we were very happy. Ps : couldn’t stay with police or Bomberos, and they sent us to the sport area behind the police station but this town feels somehow quite chaotic and we didn’t feel like camping in the street on a Saturday night…

Location: Calima, Centro, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760537, Colombia
Name: Club Campestre Provenza
Description: It's a new place, very close to Calima Lagoon, right in the middle of the lagoon and the town. It's a very quiet, safe place, and your hosts, Estefani and Juan David, are very friendly. It has lots of green spaces and no mosquitoes like at the lagoon. They charge approximately $30,000 per RV per night. There are bathrooms and showers.

Location: Calle 50, Carlos E. Restrepo, Comuna 11 - Laureles-Estadio, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050015, Colombia
Name: Attempted armed robbery
Description: Walking on the bridge alone at 11am, lots of people about and a man with a white tracksuit and a chain put his arm around me and pull a knife on me. Hit with the old no entiendo and eventually he let go of me and I ran away

Location: Carrera 15, Malagana, Mahates, Dique, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Robbery attempt
Description: A young man with sunglasses try to stop us showing a 'Pare' panel. We slowed down but there were no obstacle on the road nor on going work. Then we saw a group of 6-7 young men approching the vehicule. We quickly leave this place. Pay attention.

Location: San Agustín, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 418060, Colombia
Name: CAÑA Y CAFE & CAMPING
Description:
By chance I found this wonderful Atz and would like to share it with all of you.

Vehicles up to 5 meters high, tents and even a small sweet cabana are at your disposal. Restaurant & and an adventure swing are waiting here with a loving family for you.

Electricity and Wifi, WC & shower.

The place is in the immediate vicinity of the Parque Arqueológico. You can walk there. The place is also looking forward to your four-legged friends.

Location: Calle 11, Los Sauces, Mariquita, Norte, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Parque la concordia Mariquita
Description:
We found this park to stay overnight. It's large, with several games, courts, etc. While there isn't a tap, there are drinking fountains, and with patience and a bucket, we were able to carry some water. In the end, we stayed three nights, and some neighbors told us there's a public tap behind the hospital, where it's easier to get water. They were very friendly and told us it was safe to stay there.
-+
Encontramos este parque para quedarnos una noche es grande varios juegos ,canchas etc ,si bien no hay una canilla ,están los bebederos y con paciencia y un balde cargamos algo de agua  . Al final nos quedamos tres noches y unos vecinos nos dijeron que hay una canilla pública atrás del hospital , ahí se puede cargar mejor el agua . Muy amables y nos dijeron que era seguro quedarnos aquí.

Location: 25B, Tarso, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Hotel Bocas del Cauca
Description:
Good hotel, very close to the Autopista but pretty calm. Nice view behind the hotel.
60k cop for a double room, 80k with a fan, 100k with a/c.
We were allowed to park our bicycles inside the hotel.
You can ask for dinner and breakfast.
Drinking water available.

Location: Carrera 9C, Chipre, Comuna Atardeceres, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 170001, Colombia
Name: Chipre Parquecito
Description: Flat parking spot next to a park in the heart of barrio chipre, one of the best neighborhoods in Manizales. Next door (calle 11 9b-19) is an airbnb with great showers.

Location: Colombia, Manizales, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: By the river
Description: Super sweet spot by the river indicated by the owner of the restaurant next door. He offered to keep the bikes in a safe place if needed. Natural pools along the river to chill in the cold water. Very quiet night, just birds and tons of fireflies. Well known local spot but they were all gone before sunset and all smiled and waved at us.

Location: Carrera 3, Paraiso, Mariquita, Norte, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Agua potable gratis en Mariquita
Description: Free drinking water in Mariquita ___ Agua potable gratis en Mariquita, los vecinos buscan ahí ...

Location: Transversal 7, Calamar, Dique, Bolívar, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Brisas Del Magdalena
Description: Standard food + excellent air-conditioned lounge. --- Comida corriente + salón con aire acondicionado excelente.

Location: Calle 13, Villa Lucía, Comuna 2, Pasto, Centro, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 520003, Colombia
Name: Taller Duque (Welder)
Description: Good workshop for welding and fabrication. We had a crack in our steel wheel rim and they welded it up straight away didn’t need to wait

Location: La Herrera, Jardín, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056050, Colombia
Name: Side of the road infront of Mirador La Herrerita
Description: Space next to the unpaved road in front of the entrance to the Mirador La Herrerita. The place is perfect for parking a campervan. The man who works at La Herrerita told us that we could spend the night there, there is a water tap at the foot of the post which we were also allowed to use. I recommend eating at La Herrerita arepa with shredded meat is spectacular. The view is beautiful and the staff very friendly, obviously you can use the bathroom if you consume something. I thought it was a great place to camp. It is quiet and resourceful. On the same street are the waterfalls of love and beautiful birds can be seen. My score 9/10. --- Espacio al lado de la calle destapada frente a la entrada del Mirador La Herrerita. El lugar es perfecto para parquear un Campervan. El señor que trabaja en La Herrerita nos dijo que podiamos pasar la noche ahí, hay una llave de agua al pie del poste que tambien nos autorizaron a usar. Recomiendo comer en La Herrerita arepa con carne desmechada es espectacular. La vista es hermosa y los empleados muy amables, obviamente puedes usar el baño si consumes algo. Me pareció un excelente lugar para acampar. Tranquilo y recursivo. Sobre esta misma calle estan las cascadas del amor y se avistan aves bellísimas. Mi puntaje 9/10.

Location: Bolombolo, Venecia, Suroeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Bolombolo
Description: Quiet space in the square (I entered from the street where the petrol station is). Friendly neighbours and a good place to spend a night on your way to Medellin. There is a tap on the corner of the square with what the neighbours said was drinking water. Espacio tranquilo en la plaza (ingresé por la calle que está la estación de servicio). Vecinos amables y buen lugar para pasar una noche en tu camino a Medellin. Hay una canilla en la esquina de la plaza con lo q dijeron los vecinos agua potable

Location: Carrera 22, UPZs Localidad Teusaquillo, Localidad Teusaquillo, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111311, Colombia
Name: Casa Hotel Santa Teresita
Description: Super nice owner, showers are tipped based. Flow is medium but wonderful and warm. We gave 20 000cop for two people and baby.

Location: La Leonera, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Bichacue Yath Arte & Naturaleza
Description: When you feel like returning to your fairytale roots, enter this magical moss-covered world full of goblins, elves, fairies, and other mythical creatures hiding in the hills, quite literally. The entrance fee is 50k COL pp including guided tour. You may park right at the library.

Location: Anillo Vial Oriental, Las Margaritas, Villa del Rosario, Cúcuta, Oriental, RAP Gran Santander, 540001, Colombia

Location: Vía Pamplona - Cúcuta, Pamplonita, Suroccidente, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Fundacion Hermanos Caminantes International
Description: Reina and Ronald are taking care of this shelter to helps Venezuelians caminantes. Now all the international organisation left for political reasons and they are on their own. If you take this route, do not hesitate to stop here ! - big rigs friendly. - You can fill your water tank. - Good WiFi - Cold shower and Toilet - Water from mountain to wash your clothes and clean your dishes - Very basic kitchen and you can learn how to make real arepas and very good pizzas with Reina. Very safe, cameras… They are Venezuelians and Ronald can help and give you tons of advise on - how to fill your diesel tank, - how to manage money and cash - help with your itinerary tells you the place to go / to avoid - to do the paperwork to enter Venezuela. They also know good mechanics here and a lot of people. The family is just incredible and meeting them was the best gift of all on my one year trip. If you have kids they will be so happy to be play will Rossangela (2 anos) Rosy (12 anos) Raoul (15 anos), and also to be able to take the fresh eggs, meet the domestic pigs, the dogs and cats…All very friendly. IF YOU WANT TO HELP : They will probably ask for no money but if you can leave a little something…would be awesome. They also take donations of - clothes (every type but rain gear is very useful) - para medical - period protection for women - eventual transport of donation if you come from Cartagena Ronald : +57 318 8887407 Reina : +57 315 6597890

There is no shower on site, but you can rent the bathroom for 1,000 pesos. Contact number: +57 305 4713156. ___ Un gran lugar para tomar un café, desayunar o incluso para comprar souvenirs. Location: 2-47, Carrera 3, Centro Mosquera, Mosquera, Sabana Occidente, Cundinamarca, RAP (Especial) Central, 250040, Colombia

Description: The BEST pastelería outside of Bogota (and in the Bogota metropolitan area, if I’m honest). Simple ingredients (only fruit, no synthetic dyes, processed ingredients, only local coffee) and the owner and employees are so sweet. Fiorella is an angel along with her daughter, Silvana.

Location: Ipiales, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524061, Colombia
Name: Colibri Campestre
Description: Long term storage and camping on a grassy area (no dust here) at a quiet finca next to the border. 10,000 Cop per night. -about $2.42 usd. Might be negotiable for longer storage. The storage area is operated by a family living in a couple houses 20 steps from where your vehicle is stored. It’s also a very quiet place to camp. The camping for Colibri Campestre is marked in the wrong spot on iOverlander but it’s only a couple hundred meters off. The storage area is protected on one side by a house and another building and then a horseshoe of cliffs cut by Río Guáitara throughout the rest of it. There are also three large dogs living there. Ana who is fluent in English and Spanish will send photos of your vehicle upon request and even offered to start my van and let it run for 15 minutes every month. Ana is also a great resource for everything you need from supplies to mechanic work, paperwork translating etc. Ana. +57 316 7501136

Parking lot in the back for vehicles. Cameras for security. Bikes allowed in room. Eggs bread and coffee included in the morning. Also a restaurant downstairs Had trout dinner and it was good for 16000

Just contact the hotel via whatsapp. They had plenty of rooms available.

Location: Transversal Momposina, Mata de Caña, El Banco, Magdalena, Colombia

Description: Children and a few adults have set up a roadblock 100metres north of this point. Friendly. Wanted money and they had quite a bit of money in their bucket . We gave them a bag of 12 lollipops and they were happy. The barrier did not contain metal, unlike some heading to Punta Gallinas. It would have been possible to drive through but there were quite a few kids swarming around.

Location: Notecebes, Moñitos, Costanera, Córdoba, 231001, Colombia
Name: Playa en Pueblitos
Description: We spent 6 nights at this place, it is very quiet and safe. There is cell phone service. The road to get in is narrow but not complicated for a motorhome or truck. There are some plugs for charging... We believe that because it is low season there is almost no one in the hotels and cabins so we can be very calm, many motorcycles pass by, some selling. At night they go out on motorcycles or on foot to collect blue crabs... Very friendly police officers passed by and told us that it was safe here but it always doesn't hurt to be careful. Pasamos 6 noches en este lugar es muy tranquilo y seguro. Hay señal de celular . El camino para entrar es angosto pero nada complicado para un vehículo motorhome o camión . Hay unos enchufes para cargar ..Creemos que por ser temporada baja no hay casi nadie en los hoteles y cabañas por lo tanto podemos estar muy tranquilo ,pasan muchas motos algunos vendiendo Por la noche salen en moto o caminando a recolectar cangrejos azules.. Pasaron policías muy amigables y nos dijeron que era seguro aquí pero siempre cuidarse no está demás .

Local pra descansar antes de seguir pra Colômbia ou pra quem está indo pra Venezuela, fiquei aqui 2 noites para voltar para Venezuela, este estacionamento é excelente pois fica entre as duas migração. Sai da Venezuela, dei entrada na Colômbia, fiquei aguardando no estacionamento até o dia seguinte e voltei pra Venezuela.

Name: Parqueo callejero
Description: Si prefieres sombra o sol se puede parquear en ambos lados de la calle, no tiene frente a ningún edificio así que no hay problema en principio con los vecinos. A 50 metros de la playa, esta zona es mas tranquila que después del morro, la zona de "el Rodadero" es más concurrida.

Location: Carrera 108A, Villas del Dorado, UPZs Localidad Engativá, Localidad Engativá, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111041, Colombia
Name: STAY IN BOGOTA
Description: Very close to the airport, very basic rooms with shared bathroom but safe parking for 1 car or several motorcycles inside the house. Perfect when you need to pick your motorcycle up from the airport and stay one more night in Bogota. You can easily get an Uber to this place otherwise the owner offers Transportation to the Airport or Pick up for extra Costs. The owner is really friendly just contact her directly via WhatsApp. You will find it also on Booking.com. It was a bit cheaper on booking with Genius but we told her and she adjusted the price. We paid 105.000 COP for 3 people including parking for 3 motorcycles (which is 10.000 COP per motorcycle). Very cheap and very simple.

Location: Vía Guatapé - San Rafael, Guatapé, San Rafael, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053840, Colombia
Name: Wild Camping Near Guatape (tents only)
Description: Super calm and peaceful place for camping. NO RV/CAMPER. This area is best suited for bike touring. We spent 2 nights here. Everyone in the town of Guatepe told us it was a safe and free place to camp. Clean area, along side water to shower and clean. Really good place to settle and camp while exploring the Guatape area. 2 km up the road there is a restaurant with called Estadero y Mirador alto del chorizo with affordable menu of the day plate as well as other food options (vegetarian) plate of the day was 17000 while we were there. Bathroom and WiFi provided in the restaurant.

Location: Floridablanca, Metropolitana, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, 681004, Colombia
Name: International Paragliding Park
Description: Located near Floridablanca, this is one of the top paragliding spots in Colombia. Several schools operate here, but we trained and flew with Parapente Colombia, and couldn’t have been happier with the experience. Our instructors, Nathalia (who speaks English) and César, were absolutely fantastic – professional, patient, and always made us feel safe and confident. The equipment is high-quality and well-maintained, and the take-off area offers breathtaking views over Bucaramanga. It’s a perfect place for tandem flights or full paragliding courses. We highly recommend Parapente Colombia to anyone looking for a trustworthy, safe, and fun paragliding school in Colombia. http://www.parapentecolombia.com Nathalia +57 320 4545467

Location: Puente Natural, Pandi, Sumapaz, Tolima, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Location: Calle 8, El Altico, Comuna Centro, Perímetro Urbano Neiva, Neiva, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, 410400, Colombia
Name: Ultra Biker Group
Description: Great bike shop for parts or service. The staff are very helpful and sorted the bikes quickly.

Location: Carrera 8, Mutatá, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057420, Colombia

Location: Tunja - Moniquirá, Arcabuco, Ricaurte, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 154201, Colombia
Name: EDS BIOMAX SAN JERÓNIMO ARCABUCO
Description: Hotel San Jerónimo next to the gas station. Rooms on the 1st floor (building 2nd floor too). I was allowed to take my bike up to the room but also had the option to leave it downstairs in a lock and safe area. Even though it's next to the main road it wasn't noisy. Rooms small but very comfy and with hot shower. 35k per night. Restaurant downstairs offers full plate (soup and main dish) for 15k, very tasty.

Location: Finca El Jordan, Filadelfia - Neira, Neira, Centrosur, Caldas, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 171001, Colombia

Pueden hablar con él para pactar la posibilidad de acampar en el lugar. No hay electricidad, ni baños... ni acceso a otras comodidades.

Location: Villavieja, Norte, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia

Location: Puente Rojo, Guacarí, Centro, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Ski blue
Description: Fin de semana cuenta con agua potable, baños, agua natural de manantial. Y buena seguridad

Location: Avenida del Mar, San Diego, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 472000, Colombia

Description: Hotel Luxury Cartagena Colômbia com estacionamento

Fire rings. Raccomandet. Start asking 30k per night and person but negotiated to 30k per night per Motorhomes (two people). Easy contact with WhatsApp.

Location: Vía Mocoa - Pitalito, San Juan de Villalobos, Santa Rosa, Macizo, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Hotel Casa Torres
Description: Nice little roadside hotel, 60000 pesos for 2 person in a big room with 2 double beds. Very clean, very modern, friendly owner, decent WiFi.

Location: Carretera Panamericana, Patía, Piedrasentada, Sur del Cauca, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Restaurante de camioneros
Description: Este es un restaurante para camioneros pero le pregunté a los dueños si puedo pasar la noche y ellos son muy queridos dijeron que si y sin costo. Se puede comer desayunos desde $12.000 (3usd) almuerzos y cenas $18000 (4usd) Es seguro, Algo ruidoso por los camiones que pasan y una persona que pone música desde temprano. Tiene baño y lindos amaneceres en medio de las montañas.

Location: Jardín Botánico Las Delicas, Río Piendamo, Silvia, Centro, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Jardín Botánico - Community Misak
Description: If you want to learn more about the Misak’s culture and medicinal plants this botanic garden is wonderful. You can visit the garden (25.000 COP/p) and even participate in a “minga” if you have time to help. We entered the Misak territory with our guide Maria-Elena (WhatsApp +57 310 4566547). She speaks Spanish, is very friendly and funny. We met on the central place in Silvia at 9:30 am and she guided us through the village, the garden and explained us all the Misak culture. The all family just loved it. Ask her her price to guide you. It depends on how many and how long.

Location: Hotel Damasco, 11-44, Carrera 5, Ipiales, Exprovincia de Obando, Nariño, RAP Pacífico, 524060, Colombia
Name: Soat extranjeros
Description: Lugar para hacer seguro a extranjeros Demora una hora Y queda vigente para el próximo día

Location: Carrera 9, Curití, Guanentá, Santander, RAP Gran Santander, Colombia
Name: Ecofibras
Description: It is a wonderful town and place where they make many products out of agaves. You can make a tour for 4.000pesos per person and you can see how they make the fibers and the products. Very interesting and you support a local cooperation.

Location: Clínica Fundacion Valle del Lili, Carrera 95, Urbanización San Joaquín, Comuna 17, Cali, Sur, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 760026, Colombia
Name: Fundación Valle del Lili Hospital
Description: One of the best hospitals in Colombia, according to Colombians. Excellent service, clean, excellent professionals, and quick appointments. The prices may be a little high, but the value for money is excellent.

Location: Carretera Panamericana, Prados del Norte El Bordo, Patía, El Bordo, Sur del Cauca, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Gasolinera
Description: Lugar para estacionar tranquilo Baños agua Supermercado cruzando la calle

Location: Calle 49, Vegachí, Yalí, Nordeste, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 052830, Colombia
Name: Parqueadero Salida La Llana
Description: We spent one night here in our van. It's a 24-hour parking lot. The owner is very nice. We paid 10,000 pesos (COP). The parking lot is guarded 24 hours a day. We went into town in the evening and had a safe spot for our van. There's no height restriction. The "Claro" signal was very good.

Location: Petromil - Mamomal, Vía Mamonal, Bellavista, Cartagena, Dique, Bolívar, 130013, Colombia
Name: Potable water in gas station
Description: Water tap on the side of the Petromil building, just ask the guard for permission to fill your tank. We filled up our 80L tank quickly. It's potable. ___ Torneira de água potável ao lado da central Petromil, peça permissão para o guarda para encher seu tanque. Nós enchemos o nosso de 80L rapidamente.

Location: Pitalito, Sur, Huila, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Restaurante Roadside
Description: Very good roadside Restaurant with BBQ Pork and Beef. The plate was huge and the Pork very delicious for 30000 pesos. Good stop!

Location: Avenida la Paz, Otanche, Occidente, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Hotel Minero
Description: Convenient Hotel just outside Otanche. Has a huge and safe parking lot accessible for really big trucks. Wifi super fast and stable. We paid 100k COP for a double room with private bathroom. No AC but is not necessary, the nights are cool anyway. Room and bed nicely clean, free coffee ( tinto). Highly recommended.

Location: Km. 9 Via Pereira Cerritos, Estacion de servicio Fonda Central, AMCO, Area Metropolitana Centro Occidente, Pereira, Risaralda, RAP Eje Cafetero, 660007, Colombia
Name: Primax Gas Station
Description: I asked if I could spend the night in their parking lot and they just said yes. I said I would fill up. The next day they charged me 20,000 COP. Only for small cars. Perguntei se podia passar a noite no estacionamento deles e só me disseram que sim. Eu disse que abasteceria. No dia seguinte, me cobraram 20.000 cop. Só para carros pequenos.

Location: Cañasgordas - Santa Fé de Antioquia, El Balso, Pinguro, Giraldo, Santa Fe de Antioquia, Occidente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Restaurante
Description: At the Mirador. There is also a tienda, shop. Cheap and convenient, the first in a long time from Santa Fe.

Location: Carretera Pasto - Mocoa, Santiago, Putumayo, RAP Amazonía, Colombia
Name: Trampolina de la muerte
Description: A bridge has currently collapsed on the way to Santiago. At this point the road is closed, here are waiting times (we waited around 3 hours), since the detour is only temporarily open during the day. The detour goes through muddy dirt roads and a little town. Hard to estimate when the bridge will be open again.

Location: Calle 18, Villa Carlota, Comuna 14 - El Poblado, Medellín, Valle de Aburrá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 050021, Colombia
Name: End street infront to supermarket D1
Description: Parqueadero gratis por la noche. La alcaldia cobra 4200 pesos por hora de 8am a 6pm. Lugar muy tranquilo y agradable.

Location: San Antero, Costanera, Córdoba, Colombia
Name: Playa Punta Bolívar
Description: Nos quedamos 5 noches en este lugar ,el ingreso es de calle de tierra arena angosta ,en época de lluvia hay algunos charcos de agua pero se llega fácil. Pasan muchos vendedores ambulantes ofreciendo cosas tambien hay unos negocios de comida ,por la noche no queda nadie es muy tranquilo e iluminado . Es preferible llegar durante la semana ,los fines se llena.. Señal de celular muy buena . Es gratis

Location: 60, Oasis, Otanche, Occidente, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, Colombia
Name: Puesto Zipa
Description: Plenty of space right next to the Ruta 60, suitable for all types of vehicles. No privacy. Only for overnight stays. Plenty of space. Little traffic. We felt safe.

Location: Carrera 20, Urbanización La Isabela, Centenario, Comuna Centenario, Perímetro Urbano Armenia, Armenia, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 630002, Colombia
Name: Estación de policía
Description: El lugar es una estación de policía no se permite parquear a el rededor

Location: San Antero, Costanera, Córdoba, Colombia
Name: Mercedes House
Description: Lugar muy acogedor, Su propietaria y el personal muy atentos. Disponibilidad para camping $20000 p/p con parqueadero dentro del lugar. Frente a la playa.Disponobilidad apartamentos

Location: Tunja, Centro, Boyacá, RAP (Especial) Central, 057117, Colombia
Name: Hotel El Monarca
Description: Affordable hotel. 60,000 per night considering it’s in downtown. Accessible by bike. I came here to spend 2 nights. Comfortable and safe. Hot water too. Can take the bike inside the room.

Location: Cañasgordas - Santa Fé de Antioquia, El Tunal, Santa Fe de Antioquia, Occidente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, Colombia
Name: Finca El Doncel
Description: Basic hôtel and hostel but with a pool and a fantastic view I paid 30,000 COP for a prívate room with shared bathroom. There’s also a dorm.

Location: Restaurante El Camionero, Carretera Panamericana, Patía, Piedrasentada, Sur del Cauca, Cauca, RAP Pacífico, Colombia
Name: Restautante El Camionero Rica Comida
Description: Restautante El Camionero Rica Comida. Good and cheap (38k for two p) restaurant that allows us to sleep for free near their house. Basic toilet and shower open 24h. Wifi. Quite like a road side parking... Feel safe.

Location: Carrera 6, Horizontes, Filandia, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 634001, Colombia
Name: Recua Coffee Shop
Description: Recua Café Coffee Shop – Filandia, Quindío 🇨🇴 Ubicado frente al parque principal de Filandia, Recua Café Coffee Shop es un espacio lleno de alma, café y cultura. Somos una marca familiar con raíces cafeteras profundas: producimos nuestro propio café en una finca local y lo servimos directamente a tu mesa. Disfruta de cafés especiales preparados con pasión, postres artesanales, malteadas, y una carta pensada para el paladar del viajero. El lugar perfecto para recargar energía, trabajar un rato (¡hay WiFi!) o simplemente relajarte con una vista inigualable al colorido pueblo. ✨ Pet-friendly ✨ Espacio acogedor y cultural ✨ Punto de encuentro de mochileros y overlanders ✨ Música en vivo algunos fines de semana ✨ Atención cálida y productos locales ¡Ven, siéntete en casa y déjate conquistar por el sabor de la montaña en cada taza! 📍 Google Maps: “Recua Café Coffee Shop – Filandia”

Location: Guatapé, Oriente, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 053840, Colombia
Name: Hoel Finca Monte Carlo
Description: Really beautiful place for good price. The view is stunning. The hotel has a safe parking for any kind of van sized vehicles, the rooms are very clean, wifi is stable and fast, there is a kitchen equipped with everything one needs and to get down town it takes a walk of about 5 to 10 minutes. Perfect location to hang out a little bit.

Location: La Unión, Fómeque, Oriente, RAP (Especial) Central, 251640, Colombia
Name: Las delicias
Description: Pasa noche y estadía. Muy bien atendidos.

Location: MISIS, 50, Calle 50, Barrio Concordia, Sevilla, Nororiente, Valle del Cauca, RAP Pacífico, 762530, Colombia
Name: Hotel Aristi
Description: Great hotel 60.000 cop for a single room with bathroom. Breakfast included. Fast internet.

Location: Calle 126, La Alhambra, UPZ La Alhambra, Localidad Suba, Bogota, Bogota, Capital District, RAP (Especial) Central, 111111, Colombia
Name: Buen Appetit almuerzos
Description: Best daily menu I’ve had in Colombia. Big portions of slightly fancier daily plates like: pesto white fish, cerdo, cordon bleu (delicious). Plates were 24 mil. Perfect walk from the “dog park” spot for parking/sleeping. It’s inside the ‘guanabana’ tienda selling aguacate. We walked past it on accident. Really, you should eat there :)

Location: Salento, Fría, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 121164, Colombia
Name: FINCA LA ABUNDANCIA - COFFEE TOUR
Description: Private Organic Coffee Farm. We had a very informative tour (about 2 hours) with Sebastian and learned a lot. You're greeted with a coffee, and at the end, you get a coffee that you've roasted and ground yourself. In between, we sampled fruit straight from the tree and had a small snack. The whole atmosphere is relaxing and Sebastian made us feel like home. We could stay as long as we wanted after the tour and were given water and fruit. There's a parking lot, restrooms, and the road from Salento is okay. It might be a bit narrow for an expedition vehicle, but no problem with any other vehicle. A guide is always available from 9 a.m., offering tours in English or Spanish. If you want to be sure, you can also ask Diego beforehand: +573128415370. The tour costs 50,000 COP per person. The guides are not paid, so tips are very welcome.

Location: Calle 49, Necoclí, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057870, Colombia
Name: Calle angosta
Description: Calle estrecha frente a un hotel . Los vecinos muy amables nos brindaron agua e Internet y siempre pendiente de que estemos bien

Location: Calle 12, Mutatá, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 056450, Colombia
Name: Plaza mutata
Description: Lugar tranquilo y seguro .. vecinos amables .. agua en la plaza potable . Hay un D1 a media cuadra

Location: Calle 115, La Playa, Turbo ciudad, Turbo, Urabá, Antioquia, RAP del Agua y la Montaña, 057868, Colombia
Name: Calle pegada a la costa
Description: Pasamos 2 noches en este lugar muy tranquilo .. eran días de semana . Pareciera que los fin de semana es más movido

Location: Playa Caño Dulce, Vía Caño Dulce, Lomas Del Mar, Caño Dulce, Tubará, Atlántico, Colombia
Name: Carlos's parkinglot
Description: Carlos is a friendly fisherman that lives in the last house of the road at Caño Dulce. For a volunteer contribuition, he welcomes travelers into his land, in a parkinglot right in front of the beach. There's a shower and bathroom inside of his house. No luxuries, everything simple, but perfect for those who are searching somewhere calm and safe by the beach. We spent 3 nice nights at an extended weekend, the beach was crowded, but it didn't bothered us because the tourists went not till the end of the road. They all left before the sundown, so there's also no loud music at weekend nights :) ___ Carlos es un gentil pescador que vive en la última casa de la calle de caño dulce. En cambio de una propina voluntaria, el recibe viajeros en su lote, en un estacionamiento de frente a la playa. Hay ducha y baño dentro de su casa que puedes usar. Sin lujo, todo sencillo, pero perfecto para quien busca un lugar calmo y seguro en la playa. Pasamos 3 noches en un fin de semana extendido, la playa estaba llena, pero eso no nos molestó porque los turistas no iban hasta el final de la calle. Todos ya se van antes del bajar del sol, entonces no hay música alta en las noches de fin de semana.

Location: Armenia, Capital, Quindío, RAP Eje Cafetero, 630008, Colombia
Name: Los Caracolies
Description: 🌿 Los Caracolies Canopy – A Jungle Adventure Like No Other 🌿 Tucked deep in the lush Colombian jungle lies a hidden gem: Los Caracolies. This breathtaking experience lets you glide along six individual canopy lines, offering a unique, immersive view of Colombia’s vibrant rainforest. Floating above the treetops, you’ll witness the raw beauty and quiet magic of nature from an unforgettable perspective. Run by a warm, dedicated family, the park stands out for its top-notch safety standards and flawless organization. Every detail is crafted with care, putting nature and your experience at the heart of the adventure. 📞 Reservations recommended: +57 301 731 4553 +57 300 778 7099 (The experience is weather-dependent and space is limited, so it’s best to call ahead.) ✨ One of the most incredible parks I’ve visited in South America – truly unforgettable!
